items.title: Puntland Danab Commandos Warn of Escalating Internal Conflict
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland’s Danab Commando Force has issued an unusually forceful public statement warning that the region is on the brink of a dangerous internal conflict, cautioning that any renewed military confrontation—particularly against the Puntland Security Force (PSF)—could plunge Puntland into another round of destabilizing violence. The statement, released by the force’s leadership, reflects growing concern over rising tensions within Puntland’s security establishment following recent clashes involving the PSF and government forces. In the statement, the Danab Commandos accused Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni of steering the region toward internal conflict, alleging that his administration is once again preparing to use military force against fellow Puntland security personnel rather than pursuing dialogue. According to the command, reports suggesting the possibility of renewed attacks against the PSF have heightened fears of another armed confrontation. “We strongly warn against the outbreak of war in Puntland and against any unjustified military assault on the Puntland Security Force (PSF),” the statement said. The command accused President Deni of fueling political divisions that risk escalating into armed conflict, arguing that Puntland has already experienced several similar crises under his leadership. “This would be the fourth time such internal conflicts have occurred in Puntland, with state security forces being turned against one another,” the statement claimed. The Danab leadership stressed that the current crisis is not the result of an external threat or foreign aggression, but rather a political dispute among Puntland’s own leadership. “There is no outside force invading Puntland,” the statement asserted. “The conflict is political in nature and is rooted in disagreements among the people of Puntland.” The statement went further, alleging that the underlying dispute centers on what it described as “authoritarian rule and the monopolization of power by President Said Deni’s family”—language that underscores the depth of political polarization gripping Puntland. The command also accused President Deni of treating political dissent as a security threat. According to the statement, anyone expressing views that differ from those of the administration increasingly risks becoming a target, while Puntland is being transformed into a political environment where only one viewpoint is tolerated. The Danab Commandos appealed directly to Puntland’s political leaders, security institutions, and the wider public to prevent further bloodshed among forces drawn from the same communities. “We call on all Puntland stakeholders to prevent the shedding of Puntland soldiers’ blood and to stop efforts aimed at pitting Puntland’s security forces against one another,” the statement said. In one of its strongest assertions, the force declared that President Deni would bear full responsibility for any future outbreak of armed conflict within Puntland. “The responsibility for initiating any war or civil conflict in Puntland will rest entirely with President Said Abdullahi Deni,” the statement concluded. The warning comes at a particularly sensitive moment following recent fighting involving the PSF, whose legal and institutional status has become increasingly contested amid broader political disagreements within Puntland. The statement also highlights growing strains within Puntland’s own security institutions, raising fresh concerns that unresolved political disputes could increasingly spill over into military confrontations. Puntland authorities had not publicly responded to the allegations contained in the Danab statement at the time of publication. The unusually direct criticism from an elite security unit underscores the seriousness of the current political and security climate. As tensions continue to rise, observers warn that preventing further escalation will require political dialogue and restraint rather than military confrontation if Puntland is to avoid another potentially destabilizing internal conflict. items.title: Taliyaha Ciidamada Mareykanka ee AFRICOM oo booqasho ku yimid Muqdisho
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa gelinkii dambe ee maanta Magaalada Muqdisho kula kulmay Taliyaha Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Qaaradda Afrika (AFRICOM), General Dagvin Anderson oo booqasho ku yimid dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa yeeshay kulan la xiriira taageerada hawlgalada ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo dardargelinta wada-shaqaynta u dhaxeysa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa AFRICOM, sida lagu sheegay war ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga Somaliya. “Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray taageerada hawlgalada ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo dardargelinta wada-shaqeynta u dhaxeysa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo AFRICOM.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa sheegtay in sidoo kale kulanka looga hadlay diyaargarowga guluf ballaaran oo lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada, ayna Dowladda Mareykanka dib u xaqiijisay sii wadidda taageerada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. “Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay diyaar-garowga gulufka ballaaran ee lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada, iyadoo Dowladda Mareykanku ay dib u xaqiijisay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii wadidda taageerada ay siiso Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada hawlgalada iyo la dagaalanka argagixisada.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warka. Mareykanka ayaa Dowladda Somaliya ka taageera tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan Kumaandooska Danab, qalabayntooda iyo hawlgalada hawada ee ka dhanka ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Ciidanka Danab oo u tababaran la dagaalanka argagixisada ayaa fuliya weerarada qorsheysan ee lagu bartilmaameedsado Shabaabka, iyagoona ka qayb qaata hawlgalada dib u xoreynta dalka. Taageerada Mareykanka ayaa muhiim u ah dagaalka lagu la jiro Al Shabaab, oo Washington ay u aragto khatarta ugu weyn ee xilligan ka jirta Afrika.

items.title: Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kusoo arkay dekedda Muqdisho? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kormeer shaqo ku tagay dekedda caalamiga ah ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaasi oo uu ugu kuurgalay horumarka ka socda kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee dalka iyo qorshayaasha lagu casriyeynayo adeegyada dekedda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa soo indha indheeyay xarumaha kaydka Shidaalka dekedda, bakhaarada iyo dhismaha cusub ee xafiisyada maamulka dekedda magaalada Muqdisho. Xasan Sheekh ayaa xog ogaal u noqday dadaalada dib u habeynta iyo casriyeynta xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda iyo kor u qaadista tayada adeegyada ay helaan shacabka iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa kormeerka kaddib, kulan muhiim ah la qaatay wasiirka dekedaha iyo gaadiidka badda iyo maareeyaha guud ee dekedda Muqdisho oo uu ka dhageystay warbixin faah-faahsan oo ku saabsan xaaladda guud ee dekedda. Xasan ayaa indhaha saaray horumarka laga gaaray mashaariicda socda iyo qorshaha dhismaha dekedda cusub ee Muqdisho oo loogu talagalay in ay daboosho dhammaan baahida dakadeed ee caasimadda, isla markaana kor loo qaaddo awoodda ay u leedahay la tacaalidda kororka ganacsiga iyo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa adkeeyey in horumarinta dekedaha ay laf-dhabar u tahay kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka, kor u qaadista ganacsiga, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo xoojinta isku xirka dalka iyo suuqyada caalamka. Ugu dambeyntiina, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa kula dardaarmay masuuliyiinta wasaaradda iyo maamulka dekedda in ay laba jibaaraan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada dekedda. The post Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kusoo arkay dekedda Muqdisho? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The U.S. Should Embrace Somaliland to Break Iranian and the Houthi Trade Chokeholds
items.description: While Somaliland is entirely Muslim, it is anti-Islamist not only in rhetoric but also in deed. While terrorism is a weekly feature of life in Mogadishu, Somalia, there has not been a terrorist attack in Somaliland in almost 20 years. Shutterstock HARGEISA, Somaliland — The desire to embrace cause-and-effect rationality to blame President Donald Trump for Iran’s ongoing aggression gets two things wrong. First, the notion that the Islamic Republic would remain cautious and restrained had the United States and Israel not killed supreme leader Ali Khamenei on the first day of Operation Epic Fury ignores Khamenei’s age: The ayatollah was 86 years old and faced multiple health crises. Trump’s critics ignore that the eventual succession to his son Mojtaba Khamenei would likely have remained the same. Second, Trump’s critics say the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ closure of the Strait of Hormuz is a direct result of U.S. action, but, before the Iran war erupted and Tehran began seeking to impose tolls to pass through the strait, the Islamic Republic and its proxy Houthi militia were already testing the strategy in the Bab el-Mandeb, the narrow passage that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. As Yemen’s southern forces pointed out during a visit to Aden a year ago, the Houthis maintained an invisible line in the Gulf of Aden. With the help of Iranian spy ships and Russian satellites, the Houthis would demand payment for any ship that traversed the line on its way to the Red Sea. If they failed to pay up, they could expect drones, missiles, or mines to interrupt their passage. While American politicians, partisans, and the press prefer to play the blame game, the fact remains: Iran is blocking the Strait of Hormuz. The Houthis are threatening the Bab el-Mandeb and striking shipping in the Red Sea, and simply walking away will not resolve the problem. To make a World War II analogy, the United States lost the Battle of Bataan in 1942, and the Japanese then humiliated the U.S., killing over 10,000 more during the Bataan Death March. Fortunately, President Franklin D. Roosevelt did not face critics who sought to pillory him for challenging the Japanese. Returning home in 1942 may have cut losses, but it would have resulted in a far different world. If Trump means to win the war against Iran and the Houthis to restore freedom of navigation through the world’s choke points, it is time to bring the State Department into line. While Secretary of State Marco Rubio doubles down on Hillary Clinton’s Somalia policy, there simply is no way to win the war without Somaliland. Clinton doubled down on Somalia following the killing of U.S. Ambassador Chris Stevens in Libya, especially as critics began questioning whether she had any achievements to show. While Somaliland was briefly independent in 1960, it walked away from its union with the rest of Somalia in 1991. While Somalia descended into chaos and warlordism, Somaliland embraced democracy and remained open for business. While Somalia then tilted toward China and Turkey, Somaliland aligned itself with Taiwan and Israel. Somaliland may not be wealthy, but it is unapologetically pro-American. And while Somaliland is entirely Muslim , it is anti-Islamist not only in rhetoric but also in deed. While terrorism is a weekly feature of life in Mogadishu, there has not been a terrorist attack in Somaliland in almost 20 years. Given Somaliland’s preference for investment over aid and its rich, rare-earth reserves, embracing Somaliland could reap American companies windfall profits. The State Department’s reading of history is inconsistent. While Clinton and Rubio justify inaction on the supposed inviolability of borders, they ignore the long history of failed federations returning to their constituent parts: Czechoslovakia, the United Arab Republic that briefly united Egypt and Syria, Senegambia, and the Soviet Union. Given Somalia’s failure, forcing Somaliland’s subordination to it would be like forcing Texas into Mexico’s control or accepting Russia’s claims to Ukraine. The reason why Somaliland is crucial to winning the war is its strategic geography. It has a 530-mile coastline on the Strait of Hormuz. Its deepwater port at Berbera and neighboring airfield are both recently renovated and among Africa’s best-equipped. Running anti-piracy, anti-Houthi operations from Berbera could keep the Bab el-Mandeb. The port could also help resupply U.S. Navy ships at sea closer to Hormuz. Given Somaliland’s preference for investment over aid and its rich, rare-earth reserves, embracing Somaliland could reap American companies windfall profits. Rubio may default to State Department groupthink, but that has never won a war. Embracing Somaliland will. Michael Rubin Michael Rubin specializes in Iran, Turkey and the Horn of Africa. His career includes time as a Pentagon official, with field experiences in Iran, Yemen, and Iraq, as well as engagements with the Taliban prior to 9/11. Mr. Rubin has also contributed to military education, teaching U.S. Navy and Marine units about regional conflicts and terrorism. His scholarly work includes several key publications, such as “Dancing with the Devil” and “Eternal Iran.” Rubin earned his Ph.D. and M.A. in history and a B.S. in biology from Yale University.

items.title: Shirkii golaha wasiiradda Somaliland iyo waxyaabahii lagaga wadahadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 70-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-gudoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), isla markaana uu wehelinayey Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa waxa lagaga wada hadlay qodobbada soo socda: 𝟏. 𝐃𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐀𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐒𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐐𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐟𝐤𝐚 𝐗𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa dood qoto dheer ka yeeshay Siyaasadda Qaran ee Calafka Xoolaha, iyaga oo falanqeeyey muhiimadda ay Siyaasaddani u leedahay sugnaanta calafka Xoolaha, horumarinta wax-soo-saarka Xoolaha, iyo xoojinta adkaysiga bulshada reer miyiga ah ee la xidhiidha saamaynta Abaaraha iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada. Siyaasaddan ayaa dejinaysa hannaan Qaran oo lagu horumarinayo soo saarista, kaydinta, tayaynta iyo maaraynta calafka Xoolaha, iyada oo la dhiirrigelinayo maalgashiga, cilmi-baadhista, iyo iskaashiga Hay’adaha Dawladda, ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay iyo bulshada. Dood iyo falanqayn dheer kaddib, Golaha Wasiirrada JSL ayaa si buuxda oo aan loo kala hadhin cod gacan taag ah ku ansixiyey Siyaasadda Qaran ee Calafka Xoolaha, taasi oo laf-dhabar u noqon doonta horumarinta iyo tayeynta nolosha Xoolaha oo ah Tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee dhaqaalaha Qaranka JSL. 𝟐. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka, isaga oo xaqiijiyey in amniga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu yahay mid sugan, isla markaana dhammaan Gobollada dalka ay ka jirto nabad iyo xasillooni buuxda. Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka iyo Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdantu ay si wadajir ah u dejiyeen hannaan lagu adkaynayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada ee goobaha khayraadka dabiiciga ah, si gaar ah meelaha laga baadho lagana soo saaro dahabka iyo macdanaha kale, iyada oo mudnaanta la siinayo ilaalinta danaha guud ee Qaranka iyo nabadda bulshada. 𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JSL, Mudane Cabdilaahi Xasan Aadan ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee dhaqaalaha dalka, saamaynta ay colaadaha Bariga Dhexe ku yeesheen dakhliga Qaranka, korodhka qiimaha shidaalka iyo maciishadda, taasoo saamayn toos ah ku yeelatay nolosha bulshada. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha uga xog-warramay halka ay marayso diyaarinta Miisaaniyadda Qaranka ee sannadka 2027-ka, isaga oo xusay in mudnaanta la siinayo xoojinta dakhliga gudaha, adkaynta maamulka-maaliyadeed, ilaalinta xasilloonida dhaqaalaha, iyo dejinta miisaaniyad ku salaysan mudnaanaha horumarineed ee uu leeyahay Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. 𝟒. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐇𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐈𝐬𝐠𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐡𝐬𝐢𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐓𝐞𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐣𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 Wasiirka Wasaaradda Isgaadhsiinta iyo Teknoolajiyadda JSL, Mudane Dr. Cabdisalaan Xuseen Cawaale ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u guurto nidaamka casriga ah ee Digitalization, si ay ula jaanqaaddo horumarka teknoolajiyadeed ee haatan dunidu ku tallaabsatay. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sharraxay in qorshahani yahay hannaan Qaran oo dardar-gelinaya hufnaanta adeegyada Dawladda, kobcinta dhaqaalaha Dijitalka ah iyo horumarinta aqoonta, isaga oo Golaha ku boorriyey in arrintan loo aqoonsado Qorshe Qaran oo istaraatiji ah oo laf-dhabar u noqonaya horumarka iyo casriyeynta adeegyada Qaranka ee nidaamka Dijitalka ah. 𝟓. Waxa uu tilmaamay in Wasaaraddu dhamaystirtay diyaar-garowgii lagama maarmaanka ahaa si Horyaalku ugu qabsoomo jawi hufan oo waafaqsan qorshaha horumarinta Ciyaaraha Qaranka. Wasiir ku-xigeenku waxa kale oo uu Golaha la wadaagay in 14.08.2026-ka ay Somaliland marti gelin doonto Oroddada Mahratoonka, kaasi oo sannadkan ay ka soo qayb geli doonaan Waddamo badan. 𝟔. Xasan ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada la wadaagay warbixin la xidhiidha waxqabadka Wasaaradda, gaar ahaan xoojinta xidhiidhka Hay’adaha Dastuuriga ah, horumarinta nidaamka sharci-dejinta iyo la socodka hirgelinta arrimaha Dastuurka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Wasaaraddiisu ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso tayeynta Hay’adaha Qaranka iyo adkaynta Tiirarka Dawladnimada, dib-u-habaynta Xeerarka iyo Shuruucda Qaranka ee weli qabyada ah, kobcinta Waddaniyadda, fahamka bulshada ee Dastuurka Qaranka iyo Xeerarka ka farcama, kor u qaadista ka-qayb-galka muwaadiniinta JSL ee nidaamka dawladnimada iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda. 𝟕. Wasiirku waxa uu adkeeyey in guusha himilooyinka diblomaasiyadeed ee Qaranka JSL ay u baahan tahay juhdi iyo dedaal mideysan, Xukuumad iyo Shacabba. items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo caawa ku dhawaaqay in Soomaaliya ay gashay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed oo caawa shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dalka uu u baahan yahay badbaado qaran, uuna haatan galay xaalad halis ah, sida ay sheegeen. Golaha ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu god dheer ku riday Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu dalka ku sii hayo sharci-darro, iyagoo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ugu baaqay inay u istaagaan badbaadada dalka. “Waxaan u arkaa xilliga hadda la joogo, iyadoo muddo-xileedkii dowladda uu dhammaaday, doorasho heshiis lagu yahayna aysan dalka ka jirin, inay tahay nasiib-darro. Bani’aadamku wuxuu wax ka bartaa wixii hore, in meeshii la joogi jiray maalin walba la taagnaado waxay dhaawac ku tahay dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo adduunkaba,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Shariifka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay haatan gashay marxaladdii Afghanistan oo kale, ayna weliba ka sii liidato, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Lacagta Soomaaliya lagu bixinayay iyo tan Afghanistan lagu bixinayay iskuma dhowa. items.title: Emergency Uganda AUSSOM summit opens as U.S. funding threat puts Somalia mission at risk
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Countries contributing troops and police to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) convened an extraordinary summit in Uganda’s capital, Kampala, on Wednesday to discuss urgent measures aimed at preventing the mission from sliding toward a potential crisis after the United States threatened to end its support for continued United Nations logistical assistance beyond December. The emergency meeting opened at Speke Resort Munyonyo under the theme, “To Sustain the Stabilization Process in Somalia,” bringing together representatives from AUSSOM troop- and police-contributing countries — Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Djibouti, Ethiopia, Egypt and Somalia, the host nation of the multinational mission. Senior officials from the United Nations, including the UN Department of Peace Operations (DPO) and the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS), the African Union Commission and the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD) are also participating in the summit. The three-day Uganda summit is being held in stages. Chiefs of Defence Forces met on Wednesday, defence ministers are scheduled to meet on Thursday, July 30, while heads of state and government from AUSSOM troop-contributing countries will conclude the summit on Friday, July 31. The Kampala summit is expected to review the prevailing security situation in Somalia, evaluate AUSSOM’s operational performance and transition process, and discuss funding, logistics and long-term strategies aimed at sustaining regional stability in the Horn of Africa. The meeting comes amid mounting concern over the future of the African Union mission after Washington threatened to discontinue support for continued UN logistical assistance beyond December. Troop-contributing countries and Somali officials have warned that such a move could place AUSSOM under severe strain. UN logistical support has long served as the operational backbone of AUSSOM, enabling the mission to sustain its operations across Somalia. For nearly two decades, the African Union mission has remained the principal bulwark against the Al-Shabaab militant group, which continues to wage an insurgency with the stated objective of overthrowing Somalia’s Western-backed federal government in Mogadishu. Former Somali National Security Advisor Hussein Sheikh, who worked with the current administration for years, said he does not know how Somali security forces would sustain the security gains achieved over the years if AUSSOM were to draw down completely. He warned that such a scenario raises fears that Al-Shabaab could mount a significant comeback and regain control of large parts of south and central Somalia. The summit also takes place against the backdrop of Somalia’s escalating political crisis, with elections delayed and the constitutional terms of both the federal government and parliament having expired months ago. Earlier this week, Somalia’s opposition appealed to leaders attending the Kampala summit to support the establishment of an inclusive national transitional council to help resolve the political impasse, steer the country toward elections and oversee a peaceful transfer of power. The opposition argues that such a transitional arrangement is the only viable path to prevent what it describes as the potential collapse of a Somali state rebuilt over the past two decades with the support of Western taxpayer funds and the sacrifices of African troop-contributing countries. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Puntland and Galmudug Security Chiefs Unite in Galkacyo as Leaders Push Dialogue Over Escalation
items.description: Galkacyo (WDN) – Senior security officials from Puntland and Galmudug met in Gaalkacyo on Tuesday in a significant show of cooperation, reinforcing calls for restraint and dialogue at a time of growing tensions fueled by the deployment of additional Federal Government forces near Puntland. The joint meeting, held at the Puntland Presidency in Mudug, brought together senior officials from both regional administrations to discuss ways of strengthening security coordination, preserving stability, and preventing any deterioration of the fragile peace that has prevailed along one of Somalia’s most sensitive regional boundaries. The meeting was co-chaired by Puntland’s Deputy Minister of Security, Abdirahman Yusuf Dujaana, and Galmudug’s Minister of Security, Adan Warsame Ilmi. It was attended by ministers, regional administrators, district commissioners, and senior security officials from both sides. According to officials, discussions focused on enhancing joint security cooperation, improving communication between the two administrations, and ensuring that Mudug remains insulated from the broader political disputes unfolding elsewhere in Somalia. Following the talks, the delegations made a symbolic walk across both sides of Gaalkacyo—a city divided administratively between Puntland and Galmudug but whose residents have spent years rebuilding trust after repeated cycles of violence. The gesture was widely interpreted as a public affirmation that both administrations remain committed to peaceful coexistence despite mounting political pressures. Officials stressed that security cooperation and community unity remain the strongest foundations for long-term peace, emphasizing that continued dialogue between Puntland and Galmudug is essential to preventing misunderstandings from escalating into armed confrontation. The renewed commitment to cooperation comes as concerns continue to grow over the deployment of additional Federal Government forces near Puntland, a move that Puntland officials have repeatedly criticized as unilateral and politically motivated. Political observers warn that, should tensions erupt into open conflict, it would not be national political leaders who bear the immediate consequences. Instead, it would be the ordinary residents of Mudug—families, traders, students, and pastoral communities—whose homes, businesses, and livelihoods would once again become the battlefield. Many local elders argue that the people of Gaalkacyo have already endured enough bloodshed over the past three decades and have invested enormous effort in restoring peace between Puntland and Galmudug. That hard-won stability, they say, should not become collateral damage in disputes driven by national politics. Negotiation, Not Confrontation Community leaders across Mudug continue to urge all political actors to prioritize negotiations over military posturing. They argue that dialogue remains the only sustainable path toward resolving Somalia’s widening political crisis and caution against allowing local communities to become victims of decisions taken hundreds of kilometers away in Mogadishu. Analysts note that any military confrontation would almost certainly undermine years of confidence-building between Puntland and Galmudug, disrupt trade across central Somalia, displace civilians, and divert security resources away from the ongoing fight against Al-Shabaab. For many residents, the message emerging from Saturday’s meeting was both practical and urgent: whatever political disagreements exist at the national level, they should be resolved through negotiation—not through armed confrontation. As Somalia grapples with one of its most delicate political periods in recent years, the images of Puntland and Galmudug officials walking together through Gaalkacyo served as a reminder that cooperation remains possible—and that preserving peace may ultimately require leaders to place the welfare of ordinary Somalis above political rivalry. items.title: Somalia’s Defense Minister Weighs in on Puntland Again
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s Minister of Defense, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, has once again stepped into a politically charged debate far beyond the traditional remit of his ministry, dismissing reports that the Federal Government is conducting military operations against Puntland in the divided city of Galkayo. The remarks are the latest in a long series of public interventions by Fiqi on virtually every major political controversy in Somalia—a habit that has earned him a reputation among many Somalis as one of the government’s most outspoken political spokespersons rather than simply its defense chief. Critics often joke that no national issue is complete until Fiqi comments on it. Addressing tensions in Puntland, the minister rejected allegations that Mogadishu is orchestrating military activities aimed at destabilizing the regional state. “There is no operation being conducted by the Federal Government against Puntland,” Fiqi said, urging both sides to preserve peace in Galkayo. He noted that the city had remained free from major conflict for the past eight years, arguing that its last significant unrest occurred during President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s previous administration. Rather than substantively and constructive addressing the issue, Fiqi claimed that the current tensions stem from Puntland opposition groups, whom he alleged have established bases in and around Galkayo. He also denied persistent accusations that the Federal Government has supplied weapons, logistics, or military support to those groups through neighboring Galmudug. Those denials, however, are unlikely to settle the growing political controversy. Puntland authorities have repeatedly accused Mogadishu of attempting to undermine the region’s stability by cultivating armed groups and encouraging political unrest—allegations the Federal Government has consistently rejected. The dispute has intensified in recent weeks after Puntland security forces seized weapons from troops they said were operating under the authority of the Federal Government in Bari region. Puntland has since announced efforts to identify and dismantle any remaining armed elements it believes maintain links to Mogadishu. Fiqi’s comments have drawn mixed reactions. Supporters of the government argue that the minister is merely attempting to calm tensions and prevent further escalation. Critics see something different. They argue that Fiqi has become the administration’s chief political defender, routinely commenting on elections, constitutional disputes, federal-state relations, opposition politics, diplomacy, and regional crises—subjects that often bear little direct relation to Somalia’s defense portfolio. That pattern, critics say, has diminished the impact of his public statements. “Whenever there’s a political controversy, Fiqi is first to the microphone,” one political observer told WardheerNews. “Yet Somalis rarely hear him speak in comparable detail about defense reform, military modernization, or battlefield strategy.” Whether that criticism is fair or not, it reflects a broader perception that the Defense Ministry has increasingly become one of the government’s principal political messaging platforms. As tensions between Puntland and the Federal Government continue to rise, the challenge facing both sides extends beyond competing public statements. For many observers, preventing further deterioration will depend less on political rhetoric and more on sustained dialogue, confidence-building measures, and credible efforts to reassure regional administrations that Somalia’s security institutions remain national rather than partisan. For now, however, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi remains one of the loudest voices in the debate—speaking frequently on almost every issue confronting the country, even as many Somalis continue to ask whether the Defense Minister’s greatest battlefield has become the political arena rather than the defense ministry itself. items.title: Jubaland Accuses Federal Government of Turning Its Attention to Puntland After “Failure” in Jubaland Campaign
items.description: Kismayo (WDN) – Jubaland has accused Somalia’s Federal Government of shifting its political and military focus toward Puntland after, in its view, failing to achieve its objectives during last year’s confrontation in Jubaland. In a strongly worded statement posted on his official Facebook page, Jubaland’s Minister of Information, Abdifatah Mohamed Mukhtar, alleged that Mogadishu is pursuing against Puntland the same strategy it previously employed in Jubaland. “The Federal Government of Somalia, after failing in its offensives against Jubaland and after the people of Jubaland firmly defended themselves, has now redirected its political ambitions and pressure toward Puntland,” the minister wrote. His remarks come amid escalating political and security tensions surrounding Puntland, where concerns have grown over the deployment of Federal Government forces and armed units in and around the region. Puntland officials have repeatedly argued that such deployments have taken place without consultation with the regional administration, raising fears of a wider confrontation. Mukhtar expressed confidence that Puntland would respond in the same manner that Jubaland claims to have resisted previous federal pressure. “The reality is that the people and the Government of Puntland are equally capable of resisting and confronting any attempt that threatens their peace, stability, and self-governance,” he said. The comments underscore growing solidarity between Puntland and Jubaland, the two Federal Member States that have frequently found themselves at odds with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration over constitutional reforms, electoral arrangements, and the balance of power within Somalia’s federal system. The Jubaland minister also delivered a direct message to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, warning that political decisions based on coercion rather than dialogue could carry lasting consequences. “Politics is not built on power and pressure alone,” Mukhtar wrote. “Every coercive action carries political consequences that will ultimately have to be accounted for.” The statement reflects the increasingly confrontational rhetoric emerging from Somalia’s regional administrations as relations between Mogadishu and several Federal Member States continue to deteriorate. Rising Political Tensions The exchange comes at a particularly sensitive moment as Somalia faces deep disagreements over elections, constitutional legitimacy, and the future of the country’s federal structure. Opposition leaders and several regional administrations have accused the Federal Government of centralizing power and undermining federal autonomy, allegations that Mogadishu has consistently rejected. With Puntland and Jubaland openly aligning their political messaging, observers warn that the dispute risks widening the divide between the Federal Government and key regional stakeholders, adding further uncertainty to Somalia’s already fragile political landscape. Whether the latest accusations will lead to renewed dialogue or deepen the political standoff remains uncertain, but the increasingly sharp exchanges illustrate the growing strain on Somalia’s federal system at a time when national consensus has become more elusive than ever. items.title: Galmudug oo lagu soo rogay bandow guud + Sababta
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ku dhawaaqay bandow guud oo laga hirgelinayo dhammaan magaalooyinka waaweyn ee deegaannada maamulkaas. Bandowgan ayaa bilaabanaya caawa oo Khamiis ah kuna eg habeen dambe, iyadoo tallaabadan lagu sheegay mid lagu xoojinayo amniga inta lagu jiro diyaar-garowga doorashada qof iyo cod. Bandowgan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorsheyaasha amni ee ay wadaan hay’adaha ammaanka Galmudug, xilli maamulka uu isu diyaarinayo qabashada doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo la filayo inay maalmaha soo socda ka dhacdo deegaannada maamulka. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in ujeeddadu tahay in la xaqiijiyo jawi amni oo suurtageliya qabsoomidda doorashada. Taliyaha qeybta booliska Galmudug, Gaashaanle Sare Khaliif Cabdulle Maalin oo warbaahinta la hadlay ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay amarka bandowga. Wuxuu sheegay in dhaqan-galkiisu uu bilaabanayo caawa, isagoo shacabka ugu baaqay inay si buuxda ugu hoggaansamaan awaamiirta ciidamada amniga. Taliyaha ayaa caddeeyay in muddada bandowga la xaddidayo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka iyo dadweynaha, si looga hortago wax kasta oo halis gelin kara amniga ama carqaladeyn kara habsami u socodka doorashada. Wuxuu xusay in ciidamada ammaanka ay si dhow ula socon doonaan fulinta amarkan. Si kastaba, waxaa jira adeegyo iyo hay’ado laga reebay bandowga. Kuwaas waxaa ka mid ah gaadiidka laamaha amniga, gaadiidka Guddiga Doorashooyinka, hawl-wadeennada doorashada iyo warbaahinta, si ay u gutaan waajibaadkooda inta lagu jiro howlaha doorashada. “Ujeeddada bandowgu ma aha in shacabka la dhibaateeyo, balse waa in la sugo nabadgelyadooda iyo tan doorashada taariikhiga ah ee nagu soo fool leh. Waxaan ka codsaneynaa muwaadiniinta inay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan ciidamada ammaanka,” ayuu yiri Taliyaha Booliiska Galmudug. Sidoo kale, ciidamada ammaanka ayaa lagu arkayay iyagoo si weyn loogu daadiyay waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee magaalooyinka Dhuusamareeb, Gaalkacyo iyo Cadaado, halkaas oo ay ka wadaan howlgallo lagu adkeynayo amniga iyo dhaqan-gelinta amarka bandowga. Doorashada qof iyo cod ee Galmudug ayaa lagu wadaa in lagu soo doorto xubnaha goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee maamulka, waxaana loo arkaa mid ka mid ah tijaabooyinka ugu muhiimsan ee maamulka uu ku hirgelinayo nidaamka doorashooyinka tooska ah. Go’aanka maamulka Galmudug ee ku aaddan bandowga ayaa imanaya xilli indhaha lagu hayo sida ay u qabsoomi doonto doorashadan iyo heerka amni ee deegaannada maamulka. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa muujiyay rajo ah in tallaabooyinka la qaaday ay gacan ka geysan doonaan qabsoomidda doorasho nabdoon oo hufan.
