items.title: Virtual Press Briefing with U.S. Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon, Japanese Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, and ROK Rear Admiral In-ho Kim on the Closing of the 2026 Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) Exercise
items.description: Virtual Press Briefing with U.S. Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon, Japanese Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, and ROK Rear Admiral In-ho Kim on the Closing of the 2026 Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) Exercise Special Briefing Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon Deputy Commander, U.S. Pacific Fleet Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, Commander, Escort Flotilla ONE, Japan Maritime Self Defense Force Rear Admiral In-ho Kim, Combined Forces Maritime Component Commander Asia Pacific Media Hub July 29, 2026 Audio Player 00:00 00:00 MODERATOR: Greetings from the U.S. Department of State’s Asia Pacific Media Hub. I’m Tim Johnson, and it’s my pleasure to welcome journalists to today’s on-the-record briefing. Today we’re honored to be joined by Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon of the United States, Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi of Japan, and Rear Admiral In-ho Kim of the Republic of Korea. Our speakers today will discuss the 2026 Rim of the Pacific Exercise, known as RIMPAC. With that, let’s get started. Vice Admiral Jablon, I’ll turn it over to you for your opening remarks. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Well, thank you, Tim, and good afternoon. As Tim said, I am Vice Admiral Jeff Jablon. I am Commander, Combined Task Force RIMPAC, and I want to thank each of you for joining us from across the Pacific and around the world this afternoon. I really appreciate the work that you do, and we are all happy here to take the time with you this afternoon as RIMPAC 2026 comes to a close this week. So I want to give some background on RIMPAC. RIMPAC began in 1971, and this year marks the 30th iteration of the world’s largest international maritime exercise. Over the past several weeks, we’ve brought together 30 nations, more than 30,000 personnel, 31 surface ships, five submarines, and over 190 aircraft to train together in and around Hawaii. Our theme this year is “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” and it captures exactly what this exercise is all about. The SAILEXes on the way to RIMPAC demonstrated coordinated maneuvering, maritime fires, and combined command and control across a diverse multinational formation. This year’s major tactical events showed integration in action. Our SINKEXes brought together nine nations to identify and destroy two hulls, the ex- Mobile Bay and the ex- Peleliu , in a realistic maritime environment. Our culminating amphibious operations, led by Peru, validated integrated planning, ship-to-shore movement, and combined effects across the maritime, air, and land domains. Each event reflected the professionalism, trust, and capability this coalition brings to the Pacific. RIMPAC 2026 strengthened humanitarian assistance and disaster response, or HADR, readiness. Our training brought together military forces, interagency partners, nongovernmental organizations, and international observers to rehearse core disaster response tasks, including mass casualty care, medical triage, logistics coordination, and rapid delivery of relief supplies. These events sharpened our ability to respond at a moment’s notice and reinforce the trust and interoperability we rely on when communities across the Pacific and the world need help. This event was so successful, we will be expanding HADR operations in RIMPAC 2028. No single nation can ensure security in the Pacific alone. The global maritime environment is too large and too complex for any one country to safeguard by itself. RIMPAC gives us the chance to build the trust and relationships that make us stronger long before any crisis happens. When nations know each other, train together, and communicate well, they can respond faster and more effectively, whether it’s a security challenge, a humanitarian crisis, or a natural disaster. This year during RIMPAC ’26, our forces executed more than 500 maritime exercise events, over 2,400 flight sorties, and responded to more than 5,000 scenario-based problem sets. Those realistic scenarios strengthen combined readiness across the maritime, air, cyber, and amphibious domains. We saw real interoperability gains, including coordinated maritime operations, integrated logistics, and improved information sharing practices that allow this coalition to operate as a cohesive, capable force. We also incorporated more than 35 experiments focused on unmanned systems and emerging technologies. We demonstrated shipboard 3D printing linked with autonomous drone delivery and executed an historic unmanned underway replenishment when a Typhoon unmanned surface vessel autonomously entered the well deck of the USS Essex . These efforts help us understand how new capabilities fit into the fight and give operators real-world feedback early in the process. RIMPAC showcased historic leadership milestones. The Republic of Korea commanded the Combined Force Maritime Component for the first time. Peru led the Amphibious Task Force, a first for any Latin American navy. Chile served as a deputy commander of the entire Combined Task Force. And the Philippine Coast Guard participated for the first time with an offshore patrol vessel. These roles reflect partner capability, shared responsibility, and the momentum this exercise continues to build towards future multinational exercises and readiness. Environmental stewardship was one of my top priorities. We work closely with the state of Hawaii, their agencies, Native Hawaiian organizations to protect cultural resources, and we continue the Navy’s commitment to marine mammal research and mitigation. Balancing realistic training with responsible environmental practices is essential to how we operate. This year’s exercise carried additional significance as it coincided with the 250th anniversary of the United States. For 250 years, our nation has built enduring relationships with allies and partners based on trust, mutual respect, and shared interests. RIMPAC demonstrates that the U.S. operates alongside capable partners who share a commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific for all nations, regardless of size or strength. I’m proud of what this team accomplished and I’m confident these partnerships will strengthen how we operate together in the years ahead. I appreciate your interest in this year’s exercise and look forward to your questions. With that, I’d like to introduce two key leaders who played central roles in RIMPAC 2026: Rear Admiral Kobayashi, our Vice Commander of the Combined Task Force, and Rear Admiral Kim, the Commander of the Combined Force Maritime Component. I’ll first turn it over to Rear Admiral Kobayashi. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Thank you, Admiral Jablon. Thank you, Tim, and good afternoon, all. I’m Rear Admiral Kobayashi from Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force. It is my pleasure to join Vice Admiral Jablon and Rear Admiral Kim today. Japan has participated in RIMPAC exercises since 1980, and each exercise gives us an important opportunity to improve how we communicate, coordinate, and operate with our partners, such as Korea. I look forward to sharing the lessons we gained from this year’s training. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: And now I’ll turn it over to Rear Admiral Kim. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Thank you. Good afternoon. I’m Admiral In-ho Kim of the Republic of Korea Navy. (Inaudible) this year’s RIMPAC. It is my pleasure to join this interview and speak about the 2026 RIMPAC. Just like all RIMPAC, the SINKEX’s main focus was to bring all participating nations together as one team. I look forward to sharing how ROK Navy worked and contributed toward this goal (inaudible). Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you very much. We’ll now turn to the Q&A portion of today’s briefing. Our first question goes to Hyunsoo Kim of Yonhap, if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hello, can you hear me? MODERATOR: Yes. QUESTION: Oh, great. So my question is: How do you assess South Korea’s role as Commander of Combined Maritime Component Forces during this year’s RIMPAC? And how did South Korea’s taking on this role bolster or enhance the country’s efforts to achieve OPCON transfer from Washington? And also, my second question is: Did RIMPAC open up new opportunities for shipbuilding cooperation between South Korea and the U.S. and/or Japan? Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Okay, thank you for a good question. RIMPAC is a multinational exercise that helps protect the sea lanes of communication and respond to maritime threat and improve interoperability and combine operational capabilities. By taking part in RIMPAC, the ROK Navy continues to strengthen its ability to conduct combined operations. In this sense (inaudible), RIMPAC (inaudible) give us a valuable opportunity to further improve our ability to lead and carry out combined maritime operations. However, RIMPAC is not a training exercise specifically designed for the transfer of wartime operational control. Through RIMPAC and other combined exercise, the ROK Navy will continue to improve our ability to plan and command combined operations following the transition. With respect to shipbuilding cooperation, those policy matters that are best addressed by the appropriate national authorities. From the RIMPAC perspective, our purpose is on improving interoperability through realistic multinational training. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. Our next question goes to Ridzwan Rahmat of Janes in Singapore, if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Yes, hi. Thank you for the opportunity. I would just like to ask about the Taigei-class submarine that was involved in the SINKEX. I understand it’s the first time that a torpedo has been used from the Taigei-class submarine in a live-firing exercise at RIMPAC. Correct me if I’m wrong. So can I understand what are the lessons learned from that firing exercise? Are there any implications with regards to capabilities of the submarine that you have not tested before? And what are – were there any sharing of sensor information with the U.S. Navy with regards to the sinking exercise? Thank you very much. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Okay. This is Vice Admiral Jablon. So the SINKEX, we actually had two SINKEXes that were extremely successful. And the SINKEXes were one of the clearest demonstrations of what “Partners: Integrated and Prepared” looks like in practice. We had forces from Australia, Canada, Italy, Japan, New Zealand, Spain, and the United States who worked together to execute the full kill chain. So detecting, tracking, targeting, and engaging, as you talked about with the submarine engaging with a torpedo, using live ordinance in a realistic maritime environment. Now, what stood out was how seamlessly these nations integrated sensors, shooters, and command and control across different platforms, languages, and technologies. Each of those nations brought real capability to the table, and the Combined Force operated as a single cohesive team. That level of coordination strengthens deterrence, improves readiness, and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. Multilateral partnerships enhance regional security and prosperity by demonstrating collective resolve and shared capability, and the SINKEX was just one example during RIMPAC. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you. Our next question goes to Ben Packham of The Australian , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hi, thank you. Look, just a broader question. What sort of relevance does this exercise have in a sort of future Taiwan scenario? VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: This is Admiral Jablon again. RIMPAC isn’t about signaling to any one country; it’s about readiness of all the participation nations. And the Pacific is really vast, and no single nation can ensure stability alone. And what you see during RIMPAC is 30 nations improving their ability to operate together, respond to crisis, and deter aggression. The scale reflects our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific and the strength of our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared.” This exercise strengthens collective capability, which is essential in today’s security environment. RIMPAC participants work together to strengthen regional security, prevent coercion, and preserve sovereignty across the Pacific. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you. Our next question goes to Rex Espiritu of The Manila Standard , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning here from the Philippines. U.S. Vice Admiral Hablon, this question is directly to you, sir. Sir, I believe the Philippine Coast Guard and other nations joined RIMPAC HADR exercise. Given the situation and location of the Philippines, sir, in the Indo-Pacific region and its experiences in different disaster and calamity, how this exercise, sir, will strengthen participant skills when it comes to HADR? Thank you, sir. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: So first I want to talk about the Philippine Coast Guard participation, which was the first time ever the Philippine Coast Guard has participated. And they really brought valuable capability to the exercise, especially in maritime law enforcement, search and rescue, and humanitarian assistance that you just talked about. BRP Gabriela Silang integrated seamlessly with partner nations throughout the at-sea phase. Their participation reflects the growing role of coast guards in regional security and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. It also highlights the strength of the U.S.-Philippines partnership. Capable maritime partners are essential to sharing the burden of securing the global commons and preserving sovereignty across the Pacific, and the Philippine Coast Guard involvement in RIMPAC is just one example. So thank you for that question. MODERATOR: All right, our next question goes to Samantha Beltran of The South China Morning Post , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning. So I have two questions. So first, for allies such as the Philippines and those in the first island chain, what were the most important benchmarks for success in this exercise? And for my second question, South Korean Rear Admiral In-ho Kim is the first officer from an Asian country to lead RIMPAC’s Multinational Component – Maritime Multinational Component, while Japan’s Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi served as Vice Commander of the Combined Task Force. What was the value and importance of having officials from Asian forces take on leadership roles in this exercise? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Let me answer – this is Admiral Jablon. I’ll answer the first one and then I’ll turn it over to my leadership on my right and left side to answer the second question. So really, for RIMPAC 2026, what stood out is how quickly this multinational force integrated. Our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” isn’t just a theme. It’s exactly what we saw in land, in air, and at sea. We had 30 nations executing more than 500 maritime events, and the combined force demonstrated real gains in how we detect, track, and defeat maritime threats together. The leadership structure – including Chile, the Republic of Korea, Canada, and Japan – that could meet in key command roles allowed us to operate as a cohesive, capable team from day one. This level of integration reflects an asymmetric advantage – interoperability with allies and partners that adversaries cannot match – and it strengthens our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. And I’ll turn it over to Admiral Kobayashi for his thoughts on the leadership aspect. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Yeah, this is Rear Admiral Kobayashi. So again, no single nation can address these complex security issues around. So that’s why the RIMPAC force is needed to have a multinational leadership for (inaudible) and soldiers. From my perspective serving as the Vice Commander for this Multilateral Combined Command, (inaudible) for me that despite their different capabilities and expertise, nations can collaborate effectively towards a shared objective. I believe that the foundation for successful multilateral cooperation lies in the relationship of trust and the mutual understanding built over time. That’s why we are here for our RIMPAC Exercise. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Okay. I’m Rear Admiral Kim. I believe this exercise showed that the ROK Navy can effectively command and integrate to the Multinational Maritime Force (inaudible) and coordinated multinational ships and assessed to conduct its mission on the common operation objective. This achievement was not built in a single exercise. It was based on many years of RIMPAC experience and the trust we built with the participants. I believe the ROK Navy successfully met the given responsibility and expectation. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Hey, Admiral Jablon. I just want to add one more thought about this, is that from my perspective, I saw high-level professionalism and trust between the leadership roles and the individuals. As I mentioned earlier, Chile served as deputy commander. Korea commanded the maritime component. Canada commanded the air component and Japan led the humanitarian assistance and disaster relief. And those leadership roles weren’t symbolic; they were operational. And each nation brought real capability and the combined force benefited from their leadership. Shared responsibility is a core part of the theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” and it strengthens our ability to maintain a free and open Indo-Pacific. What you saw were closer to closer military integration, which enabled clear lines of communication and fostered cooperation to meet regional and global challenges. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. We’re going to move to Raissa Robles of South China Morning Post , if you could unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning from Manila. From your brief history, RIMPAC was established during the Cold War. I want to ask: What has changed with RIMPAC since the end of the Cold War to today, when new technology like drone swarms and submarine drones are being used with much effectiveness in certain ongoing conflicts? And my second question is: How is RIMPAC relevant to the Philippine Navy and Coast Guard and its conflict in the South China Sea? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: I think the theme of RIMPAC with multinational cooperation with likeminded nations to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific remains from the start of RIMPAC in 1971 all the way through to 2026. And what you’ve seen is a expansion, which started in 1971 at five nations, now out to 30 nations, that likeminded nations joining together to improve trust, build those relationships, being able to operate together is really a common theme throughout, but the expansion has been really significant. And I think that’s a major impetus for maintaining a free and open Indo-Pacific. As I talked about before, the participation of the Philippines, especially the first time for the Philippine Coast Guard, is really a significant event for RIMPAC as we look to expand in the future participation of a coast guard through law enforcement, through maritime exercises, to make RIMPAC even more effective in ensuring a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you. Our next question goes to Jayvee Vallejera of the Pacific Island Times , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hello, can you hear me? MODERATOR: Yes. QUESTION: Hello. Thank you and good morning. I have two questions. First, in early July, China test fired a nuclear-capable ballistic missile into the Pacific Ocean. They said it was part of their annual training. It happened as RIMPAC was ongoing and was about to wrap up. Would you like to comment on that? Secondly, Guam is often called the tip of the spear in America’s defense strategy in the Indo-Pacific region. Was there any reason why Guam was not included in the RIMPAC this year? That’s all. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: So to answer your question, RIMPAC isn’t about signaling to one country; it’s really about readiness. And as I mentioned before, the Pacific is extremely vast. No single country can ensure stability alone. When you see 30 nations improving their ability to operate together, respond to crisis, and deter aggression, that’s significant. And that scale reflects our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific and the strength of our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared.” And as I said previously, this exercise strengthens collective capability, which is essential to today’s security environment. RIMPAC participants work together to strengthen regional security, protect coercion, and preserve sovereignty across the Pacific. With respect to your question of Guam, Guam is a part of the United States, and we had U.S. forces obviously as part of RIMPAC. MODERATOR: All right, thank you. We have time for one more question and it will go to Franco Jose Baroña of The Manila Bulletin , if you could please unmute yourself – excuse me, The Manila Times , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Yes, good morning from Manila. How does RIMPAC contribute to improving maritime security and freedom of navigation in the Indo-Pacific, particularly in contested areas such as South China Sea/West Philippine Sea? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Again, RIMPAC, for our theme of “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” brings together 30 likeminded nations who build the trust, cooperation, and the interoperability to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific. Through our exercises over the last month, we’ve been able to work together, operate, and conduct, as I said, over 5,000 different events in RIMPAC, showing our relationship is true. We’re able to operate together, we’re able to communicate together, and we enabled a very successful RIMPAC. We’ve got most of the force coming back to Pearl Harbor today, and we’ll be ending RIMPAC this Friday. But overall, extremely pleased with the RIMPAC 2026 and the outcome of all our events. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. That brings us to the end of today’s briefing. Before we conclude, though, I’ll turn it back to our speakers if they have any closing remarks. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Okay, what we’ll do is I’ll turn it over to Admiral Kobayashi first, then Admiral Kim, and then I’ll provide closing remarks at the end. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Thank you, Admiral Jablon. For me, RIMPAC reminded us that the interoperability is something we must continue to develop. Different language, procedures, and systems can create gaps, and realistic trainings allows us to identify and reduce those gaps before a real crisis occurs. (Inaudible) shared experiences and personal relationships developed during RIMPAC Exercise strengthen our ability to respond together, whether supporting maritime security or assisting communities after disaster. By continuing to prepare together, we support secure sea lanes in a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: I’m Admiral Kim. As the (inaudible) for this year’s RIMPAC, I would like to thank all participating nations for their strong support and commitment. I believe we successfully achieved our shared goal of establishing maritime security and enhancing interoperability. Also, I want to express my gratitude to the media for the strong interest in the exercise. Thank you all for joining us today. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Thank you, Admiral Kim. And I also want to express my thanks to the media and for you that are out there on this call for your thoughtful questions and for your continued coverage of RIMPAC 2026. The interest from journalists across the Pacific reflects the importance of this exercise and the value of transparency as our nations train together. RIMPAC is about strengthening relationships, improving interoperability, and preparing capable partners to operate together whenever and wherever needed. While RIMPAC lasts a little over a month, the trust, cooperation, and integration built here endure well beyond the conclusion of this training exercise. This year’s training across the maritime, air, cyber, and amphibious domains shows what “Partners: Integrated and Prepared” looks like in practice and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you again for joining us today, and we all appreciate your time and your interest. Thank you. MODERATOR: All right, thank you so much to our speakers and thank you to journalists for joining us today. We’ll provide a transcript of the briefing to participating journalists as soon as it’s available. If you have any feedback or further questions, please feel free to contact us at AsiaPacMedia@state.gov. Thanks again for your participation and we hope to join – hope you can join us for another briefing soon. Take care.
items.fullContent: Virtual Press Briefing with U.S. Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon, Japanese Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, and ROK Rear Admiral In-ho Kim on the Closing of the 2026 Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) Exercise Special Briefing Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon Deputy Commander, U.S. Pacific Fleet Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, Commander, Escort Flotilla ONE, Japan Maritime Self Defense Force Rear Admiral In-ho Kim, Combined Forces Maritime Component Commander Asia Pacific Media Hub July 29, 2026 Audio Player 00:00 00:00 MODERATOR: Greetings from the U.S. Department of State’s Asia Pacific Media Hub. I’m Tim Johnson, and it’s my pleasure to welcome journalists to today’s on-the-record briefing. Today we’re honored to be joined by Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon of the United States, Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi of Japan, and Rear Admiral In-ho Kim of the Republic of Korea. Our speakers today will discuss the 2026 Rim of the Pacific Exercise, known as RIMPAC. With that, let’s get started. Vice Admiral Jablon, I’ll turn it over to you for your opening remarks. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Well, thank you, Tim, and good afternoon. As Tim said, I am Vice Admiral Jeff Jablon. I am Commander, Combined Task Force RIMPAC, and I want to thank each of you for joining us from across the Pacific and around the world this afternoon. I really appreciate the work that you do, and we are all happy here to take the time with you this afternoon as RIMPAC 2026 comes to a close this week. So I want to give some background on RIMPAC. RIMPAC began in 1971, and this year marks the 30th iteration of the world’s largest international maritime exercise. Over the past several weeks, we’ve brought together 30 nations, more than 30,000 personnel, 31 surface ships, five submarines, and over 190 aircraft to train together in and around Hawaii. Our theme this year is “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” and it captures exactly what this exercise is all about. The SAILEXes on the way to RIMPAC demonstrated coordinated maneuvering, maritime fires, and combined command and control across a diverse multinational formation. This year’s major tactical events showed integration in action. Our SINKEXes brought together nine nations to identify and destroy two hulls, the ex- Mobile Bay and the ex- Peleliu , in a realistic maritime environment. Our culminating amphibious operations, led by Peru, validated integrated planning, ship-to-shore movement, and combined effects across the maritime, air, and land domains. Each event reflected the professionalism, trust, and capability this coalition brings to the Pacific. RIMPAC 2026 strengthened humanitarian assistance and disaster response, or HADR, readiness. Our training brought together military forces, interagency partners, nongovernmental organizations, and international observers to rehearse core disaster response tasks, including mass casualty care, medical triage, logistics coordination, and rapid delivery of relief supplies. These events sharpened our ability to respond at a moment’s notice and reinforce the trust and interoperability we rely on when communities across the Pacific and the world need help. This event was so successful, we will be expanding HADR operations in RIMPAC 2028. No single nation can ensure security in the Pacific alone. The global maritime environment is too large and too complex for any one country to safeguard by itself. RIMPAC gives us the chance to build the trust and relationships that make us stronger long before any crisis happens. When nations know each other, train together, and communicate well, they can respond faster and more effectively, whether it’s a security challenge, a humanitarian crisis, or a natural disaster. This year during RIMPAC ’26, our forces executed more than 500 maritime exercise events, over 2,400 flight sorties, and responded to more than 5,000 scenario-based problem sets. Those realistic scenarios strengthen combined readiness across the maritime, air, cyber, and amphibious domains. We saw real interoperability gains, including coordinated maritime operations, integrated logistics, and improved information sharing practices that allow this coalition to operate as a cohesive, capable force. We also incorporated more than 35 experiments focused on unmanned systems and emerging technologies. We demonstrated shipboard 3D printing linked with autonomous drone delivery and executed an historic unmanned underway replenishment when a Typhoon unmanned surface vessel autonomously entered the well deck of the USS Essex . These efforts help us understand how new capabilities fit into the fight and give operators real-world feedback early in the process. RIMPAC showcased historic leadership milestones. The Republic of Korea commanded the Combined Force Maritime Component for the first time. Peru led the Amphibious Task Force, a first for any Latin American navy. Chile served as a deputy commander of the entire Combined Task Force. And the Philippine Coast Guard participated for the first time with an offshore patrol vessel. These roles reflect partner capability, shared responsibility, and the momentum this exercise continues to build towards future multinational exercises and readiness. Environmental stewardship was one of my top priorities. We work closely with the state of Hawaii, their agencies, Native Hawaiian organizations to protect cultural resources, and we continue the Navy’s commitment to marine mammal research and mitigation. Balancing realistic training with responsible environmental practices is essential to how we operate. This year’s exercise carried additional significance as it coincided with the 250th anniversary of the United States. For 250 years, our nation has built enduring relationships with allies and partners based on trust, mutual respect, and shared interests. RIMPAC demonstrates that the U.S. operates alongside capable partners who share a commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific for all nations, regardless of size or strength. I’m proud of what this team accomplished and I’m confident these partnerships will strengthen how we operate together in the years ahead. I appreciate your interest in this year’s exercise and look forward to your questions. With that, I’d like to introduce two key leaders who played central roles in RIMPAC 2026: Rear Admiral Kobayashi, our Vice Commander of the Combined Task Force, and Rear Admiral Kim, the Commander of the Combined Force Maritime Component. I’ll first turn it over to Rear Admiral Kobayashi. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Thank you, Admiral Jablon. Thank you, Tim, and good afternoon, all. I’m Rear Admiral Kobayashi from Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force. It is my pleasure to join Vice Admiral Jablon and Rear Admiral Kim today. Japan has participated in RIMPAC exercises since 1980, and each exercise gives us an important opportunity to improve how we communicate, coordinate, and operate with our partners, such as Korea. I look forward to sharing the lessons we gained from this year’s training. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: And now I’ll turn it over to Rear Admiral Kim. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Thank you. Good afternoon. I’m Admiral In-ho Kim of the Republic of Korea Navy. (Inaudible) this year’s RIMPAC. It is my pleasure to join this interview and speak about the 2026 RIMPAC. Just like all RIMPAC, the SINKEX’s main focus was to bring all participating nations together as one team. I look forward to sharing how ROK Navy worked and contributed toward this goal (inaudible). Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you very much. We’ll now turn to the Q&A portion of today’s briefing. Our first question goes to Hyunsoo Kim of Yonhap, if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hello, can you hear me? MODERATOR: Yes. QUESTION: Oh, great. So my question is: How do you assess South Korea’s role as Commander of Combined Maritime Component Forces during this year’s RIMPAC? And how did South Korea’s taking on this role bolster or enhance the country’s efforts to achieve OPCON transfer from Washington? And also, my second question is: Did RIMPAC open up new opportunities for shipbuilding cooperation between South Korea and the U.S. and/or Japan? Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Okay, thank you for a good question. RIMPAC is a multinational exercise that helps protect the sea lanes of communication and respond to maritime threat and improve interoperability and combine operational capabilities. By taking part in RIMPAC, the ROK Navy continues to strengthen its ability to conduct combined operations. In this sense (inaudible), RIMPAC (inaudible) give us a valuable opportunity to further improve our ability to lead and carry out combined maritime operations. However, RIMPAC is not a training exercise specifically designed for the transfer of wartime operational control. Through RIMPAC and other combined exercise, the ROK Navy will continue to improve our ability to plan and command combined operations following the transition. With respect to shipbuilding cooperation, those policy matters that are best addressed by the appropriate national authorities. From the RIMPAC perspective, our purpose is on improving interoperability through realistic multinational training. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. Our next question goes to Ridzwan Rahmat of Janes in Singapore, if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Yes, hi. Thank you for the opportunity. I would just like to ask about the Taigei-class submarine that was involved in the SINKEX. I understand it’s the first time that a torpedo has been used from the Taigei-class submarine in a live-firing exercise at RIMPAC. Correct me if I’m wrong. So can I understand what are the lessons learned from that firing exercise? Are there any implications with regards to capabilities of the submarine that you have not tested before? And what are – were there any sharing of sensor information with the U.S. Navy with regards to the sinking exercise? Thank you very much. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Okay. This is Vice Admiral Jablon. So the SINKEX, we actually had two SINKEXes that were extremely successful. And the SINKEXes were one of the clearest demonstrations of what “Partners: Integrated and Prepared” looks like in practice. We had forces from Australia, Canada, Italy, Japan, New Zealand, Spain, and the United States who worked together to execute the full kill chain. So detecting, tracking, targeting, and engaging, as you talked about with the submarine engaging with a torpedo, using live ordinance in a realistic maritime environment. Now, what stood out was how seamlessly these nations integrated sensors, shooters, and command and control across different platforms, languages, and technologies. Each of those nations brought real capability to the table, and the Combined Force operated as a single cohesive team. That level of coordination strengthens deterrence, improves readiness, and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. Multilateral partnerships enhance regional security and prosperity by demonstrating collective resolve and shared capability, and the SINKEX was just one example during RIMPAC. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you. Our next question goes to Ben Packham of The Australian , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hi, thank you. Look, just a broader question. What sort of relevance does this exercise have in a sort of future Taiwan scenario? VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: This is Admiral Jablon again. RIMPAC isn’t about signaling to any one country; it’s about readiness of all the participation nations. And the Pacific is really vast, and no single nation can ensure stability alone. And what you see during RIMPAC is 30 nations improving their ability to operate together, respond to crisis, and deter aggression. The scale reflects our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific and the strength of our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared.” This exercise strengthens collective capability, which is essential in today’s security environment. RIMPAC participants work together to strengthen regional security, prevent coercion, and preserve sovereignty across the Pacific. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you. Our next question goes to Rex Espiritu of The Manila Standard , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning here from the Philippines. U.S. Vice Admiral Hablon, this question is directly to you, sir. Sir, I believe the Philippine Coast Guard and other nations joined RIMPAC HADR exercise. Given the situation and location of the Philippines, sir, in the Indo-Pacific region and its experiences in different disaster and calamity, how this exercise, sir, will strengthen participant skills when it comes to HADR? Thank you, sir. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: So first I want to talk about the Philippine Coast Guard participation, which was the first time ever the Philippine Coast Guard has participated. And they really brought valuable capability to the exercise, especially in maritime law enforcement, search and rescue, and humanitarian assistance that you just talked about. BRP Gabriela Silang integrated seamlessly with partner nations throughout the at-sea phase. Their participation reflects the growing role of coast guards in regional security and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. It also highlights the strength of the U.S.-Philippines partnership. Capable maritime partners are essential to sharing the burden of securing the global commons and preserving sovereignty across the Pacific, and the Philippine Coast Guard involvement in RIMPAC is just one example. So thank you for that question. MODERATOR: All right, our next question goes to Samantha Beltran of The South China Morning Post , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning. So I have two questions. So first, for allies such as the Philippines and those in the first island chain, what were the most important benchmarks for success in this exercise? And for my second question, South Korean Rear Admiral In-ho Kim is the first officer from an Asian country to lead RIMPAC’s Multinational Component – Maritime Multinational Component, while Japan’s Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi served as Vice Commander of the Combined Task Force. What was the value and importance of having officials from Asian forces take on leadership roles in this exercise? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Let me answer – this is Admiral Jablon. I’ll answer the first one and then I’ll turn it over to my leadership on my right and left side to answer the second question. So really, for RIMPAC 2026, what stood out is how quickly this multinational force integrated. Our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” isn’t just a theme. It’s exactly what we saw in land, in air, and at sea. We had 30 nations executing more than 500 maritime events, and the combined force demonstrated real gains in how we detect, track, and defeat maritime threats together. The leadership structure – including Chile, the Republic of Korea, Canada, and Japan – that could meet in key command roles allowed us to operate as a cohesive, capable team from day one. This level of integration reflects an asymmetric advantage – interoperability with allies and partners that adversaries cannot match – and it strengthens our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. And I’ll turn it over to Admiral Kobayashi for his thoughts on the leadership aspect. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Yeah, this is Rear Admiral Kobayashi. So again, no single nation can address these complex security issues around. So that’s why the RIMPAC force is needed to have a multinational leadership for (inaudible) and soldiers. From my perspective serving as the Vice Commander for this Multilateral Combined Command, (inaudible) for me that despite their different capabilities and expertise, nations can collaborate effectively towards a shared objective. I believe that the foundation for successful multilateral cooperation lies in the relationship of trust and the mutual understanding built over time. That’s why we are here for our RIMPAC Exercise. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Okay. I’m Rear Admiral Kim. I believe this exercise showed that the ROK Navy can effectively command and integrate to the Multinational Maritime Force (inaudible) and coordinated multinational ships and assessed to conduct its mission on the common operation objective. This achievement was not built in a single exercise. It was based on many years of RIMPAC experience and the trust we built with the participants. I believe the ROK Navy successfully met the given responsibility and expectation. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Hey, Admiral Jablon. I just want to add one more thought about this, is that from my perspective, I saw high-level professionalism and trust between the leadership roles and the individuals. As I mentioned earlier, Chile served as deputy commander. Korea commanded the maritime component. Canada commanded the air component and Japan led the humanitarian assistance and disaster relief. And those leadership roles weren’t symbolic; they were operational. And each nation brought real capability and the combined force benefited from their leadership. Shared responsibility is a core part of the theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” and it strengthens our ability to maintain a free and open Indo-Pacific. What you saw were closer to closer military integration, which enabled clear lines of communication and fostered cooperation to meet regional and global challenges. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. We’re going to move to Raissa Robles of South China Morning Post , if you could unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning from Manila. From your brief history, RIMPAC was established during the Cold War. I want to ask: What has changed with RIMPAC since the end of the Cold War to today, when new technology like drone swarms and submarine drones are being used with much effectiveness in certain ongoing conflicts? And my second question is: How is RIMPAC relevant to the Philippine Navy and Coast Guard and its conflict in the South China Sea? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: I think the theme of RIMPAC with multinational cooperation with likeminded nations to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific remains from the start of RIMPAC in 1971 all the way through to 2026. And what you’ve seen is a expansion, which started in 1971 at five nations, now out to 30 nations, that likeminded nations joining together to improve trust, build those relationships, being able to operate together is really a common theme throughout, but the expansion has been really significant. And I think that’s a major impetus for maintaining a free and open Indo-Pacific. As I talked about before, the participation of the Philippines, especially the first time for the Philippine Coast Guard, is really a significant event for RIMPAC as we look to expand in the future participation of a coast guard through law enforcement, through maritime exercises, to make RIMPAC even more effective in ensuring a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you. Our next question goes to Jayvee Vallejera of the Pacific Island Times , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hello, can you hear me? MODERATOR: Yes. QUESTION: Hello. Thank you and good morning. I have two questions. First, in early July, China test fired a nuclear-capable ballistic missile into the Pacific Ocean. They said it was part of their annual training. It happened as RIMPAC was ongoing and was about to wrap up. Would you like to comment on that? Secondly, Guam is often called the tip of the spear in America’s defense strategy in the Indo-Pacific region. Was there any reason why Guam was not included in the RIMPAC this year? That’s all. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: So to answer your question, RIMPAC isn’t about signaling to one country; it’s really about readiness. And as I mentioned before, the Pacific is extremely vast. No single country can ensure stability alone. When you see 30 nations improving their ability to operate together, respond to crisis, and deter aggression, that’s significant. And that scale reflects our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific and the strength of our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared.” And as I said previously, this exercise strengthens collective capability, which is essential to today’s security environment. RIMPAC participants work together to strengthen regional security, protect coercion, and preserve sovereignty across the Pacific. With respect to your question of Guam, Guam is a part of the United States, and we had U.S. forces obviously as part of RIMPAC. MODERATOR: All right, thank you. We have time for one more question and it will go to Franco Jose Baroña of The Manila Bulletin , if you could please unmute yourself – excuse me, The Manila Times , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Yes, good morning from Manila. How does RIMPAC contribute to improving maritime security and freedom of navigation in the Indo-Pacific, particularly in contested areas such as South China Sea/West Philippine Sea? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Again, RIMPAC, for our theme of “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” brings together 30 likeminded nations who build the trust, cooperation, and the interoperability to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific. Through our exercises over the last month, we’ve been able to work together, operate, and conduct, as I said, over 5,000 different events in RIMPAC, showing our relationship is true. We’re able to operate together, we’re able to communicate together, and we enabled a very successful RIMPAC. We’ve got most of the force coming back to Pearl Harbor today, and we’ll be ending RIMPAC this Friday. But overall, extremely pleased with the RIMPAC 2026 and the outcome of all our events. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. That brings us to the end of today’s briefing. Before we conclude, though, I’ll turn it back to our speakers if they have any closing remarks. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Okay, what we’ll do is I’ll turn it over to Admiral Kobayashi first, then Admiral Kim, and then I’ll provide closing remarks at the end. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Thank you, Admiral Jablon. For me, RIMPAC reminded us that the interoperability is something we must continue to develop. Different language, procedures, and systems can create gaps, and realistic trainings allows us to identify and reduce those gaps before a real crisis occurs. (Inaudible) shared experiences and personal relationships developed during RIMPAC Exercise strengthen our ability to respond together, whether supporting maritime security or assisting communities after disaster. By continuing to prepare together, we support secure sea lanes in a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: I’m Admiral Kim. As the (inaudible) for this year’s RIMPAC, I would like to thank all participating nations for their strong support and commitment. I believe we successfully achieved our shared goal of establishing maritime security and enhancing interoperability. Also, I want to express my gratitude to the media for the strong interest in the exercise. Thank you all for joining us today. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Thank you, Admiral Kim. And I also want to express my thanks to the media and for you that are out there on this call for your thoughtful questions and for your continued coverage of RIMPAC 2026. The interest from journalists across the Pacific reflects the importance of this exercise and the value of transparency as our nations train together. RIMPAC is about strengthening relationships, improving interoperability, and preparing capable partners to operate together whenever and wherever needed. While RIMPAC lasts a little over a month, the trust, cooperation, and integration built here endure well beyond the conclusion of this training exercise. This year’s training across the maritime, air, cyber, and amphibious domains shows what “Partners: Integrated and Prepared” looks like in practice and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you again for joining us today, and we all appreciate your time and your interest. Thank you. MODERATOR: All right, thank you so much to our speakers and thank you to journalists for joining us today. We’ll provide a transcript of the briefing to participating journalists as soon as it’s available. If you have any feedback or further questions, please feel free to contact us at AsiaPacMedia@state.gov. Thanks again for your participation and we hope to join – hope you can join us for another briefing soon. Take care.

items.title: Muxuu yahay mashruuca Bankiga Adduunka bixinayo ee laga reebay Waqooyi Bari?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Bangiga Adduunka iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kala saxiixday heshiis ballaaran oo lagu maalgelinayo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha dalka, kaas oo lagu dhisayo laguna dayactirayo garoomada diyaaradaha, waddooyinka, biyo-mareennada magaalooyinka iyo adeegyo kale oo muhiim u ah kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo isku xirka gobollada. Mashruucan oo lagu qiyaasay $500 milyan ayaa la qorsheeyay in laga hirgeliyo Gobolka Banaadir iyo dowlad-goboleedyada dalka, sida ku cad heshiiska ay labada dhinac kala saxiixdeen bishii April 2026. Ujeeddada mashruuca ayaa ah in sare loo qaado tayada kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, lana xoojiyo adeegyada muhiimka u ah bulshada iyo ganacsiga. Sida ku xusan heshiiska, mashruucu wuxuu socon doonaa illaa sannadka 2031, iyadoo muddadaas lagu fulin doono wejiyo kala duwan oo dhismaha iyo dayactirka ah. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Bangiga Adduunka ayaa si wadajir ah uga shaqeyn doona xulashada goobaha mudnaanta la siinayo iyo jadwalka lagu hirgelinayo mashaariicda. Qeyb muhiim ah oo mashruuca ka mid ah ayaa lagu horumarinayaa garoomada diyaaradaha si loo xoojiyo badqabka duullimaadyada gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Garoomada lagu xusay qorshaha waxaa ka mid ah kuwa Muqdisho, Baydhabo, Kismaayo, Hargeysa, Garoowe, Gaalkacyo, Jowhar iyo Dhoobley. Mashruucu wuxuu sidoo kale xoogga saarayaa horumarinta nidaamyada biyo-mareennada iyo xakamaynta fatahaadaha ka dhaca magaalooyinka, iyadoo la doonayo in la yareeyo saameynta ay roobabka iyo daadadku ku yeeshaan bulshada iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. Intaa waxaa dheer, qorshahan waxaa lagu daray dib-u-dayactirka iyo casriyeynta garoomada diyaaradaha qaarkood, si loo kordhiyo awooddooda adeeg iyo soo jiidashada maalgashiga. Dowladda iyo Bangiga Adduunka ayaa aaminsan in horumarinta kaabayaasha ay door weyn ka qaadan doonto kobcinta dhaqaalaha, fududeynta ganacsiga iyo abuurista fursado shaqo. Si kastaba, mashruucan laguma xusin magaalada Laascaanood oo ah xarunta maamulka Waqooyi Bari, mana jirto sabab rasmi ah oo ilaa hadda lagu caddeeyay sababta looga reebay qorshaha, inkastoo Gobolka Banaadir iyo dowlad-goboleedyada kale lagu daray mashaariicda la maalgelinayo. Ka maqnaanshaha Laascaanood ee liiska goobaha mashruucu ka hirgelayo ayaa dhalin kara su’aalo ku saabsan habka loo xushay deegaannada ka faa’iideysanaya maalgelintan. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Bangiga Adduunka ayaan weli ka hadlin sababta magaaladaasi uga maqan tahay qorshaha, iyadoo la filayo in faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga bixiyo marxaladaha dambe ee hirgelinta mashruuca. The post Muxuu yahay mashruuca Bankiga Adduunka bixinayo ee laga reebay Waqooyi Bari? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Fiqi oo sheegay in la garaacay guri uu shir uga socday horjoogeyaal ka tirsan Al Shabaab
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga Somaliya, Axmed Macalin Fiqi oo galabta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa sheegay in weerar xagga cirka ah lagu qaaday guri ku yaala Degmada Aadan Yabaal ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, halkaas oo uu sheegay in uu shir uga socday horjoogeyaal ka tirsan Al Shabaab. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka ay Isniintii afar duqaymo oo waaweyn oo xagga cirka ah ka fuliyeen Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, ka dib xogo sirdoon oo la helay. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in la beegsaday guri lagu magacaabo Villa Aadan Yabaal, oo ay ku shirayeen horjoogeyaasha Al Shabaab, isla-markaana uu shir guddoominayay Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade, Gudoomiyaha Al Shabaab ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. “Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka ayaa waxay afar duqaymo oo waaweyn oo dhanka cirka ah ay ka fuliyeen Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, taasoo loo qorsheeyay, laguna hagayay xogo sirdoon, lana fuliyay taariikhdu markay ahayd 27-kii bisha 7aad, 2026. Meesha la beegsaday waxay ahayd guriga Villa Aadan Yabaal la yiraahdo oo ay ku shirayeen horjoogeyaasha maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta ah ee Al Shabaab.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. “Shirkan horjoogeyaasha argagixisada ayaa waxaa shir guddoominayay waali ku sheega argagixisada Al Shabaab ugu magacaaban Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade.” Ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi oo intaa raaciyay in hawlgalka lagu dilay 11 ka mid ah horjoogeyaashii uu shirka gurigaasi uga socday, laguna dhaawacay afar kale. “Hawlgalkan oo u dhacay, sidii loo qorsheeyay ayaa waxaa argagixisada Al Shabaab lagu gaarsiiyay khasaare xoogan, waxaana lagu khaarijiyay 11 ka mid ah horjoogeyaashii shirka halkaa uga socday, waxaana sidoo kale dhaawacyo culus la gaarsiiyay afar horjooge. Hawlgalkan ayaa waxaa sidoo kale lagu gubay afar gaadiid ah.” Ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Fiqi ayaa xusay in hawlgalka lagu dilay laba ka mid ah ilaalada Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade, kuwaas oo magacyadooda uu ku soo koobay Cabdifitaax iyo Xaashi. Waxa kaloo uu sheegay in Kaba Kutukade uu ka mid yahay xubnaha ku dhaawacmay weerarkaasi, kaasoo uu sheegay in dhaawac culus uu soo gaaray. “Horjoogeyaasha ku dhaawacmay hawlgalkan waxaa ka mid ah Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade, waaliga argagixisada ugu magacaaban Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe oo runtii sida xoguhu ay sheegayaan dhaawac culus inuu halkaa ka soo gaaray.” Ayuu yiri Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga. Fiqi ayaa tilmaamay in xubnaha kale ee la dilay ay ka tirsanaayeen horjoogeyaasha Al Shabaab ee Gobolada Shabellaha Dhexe, Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud iyo niman u qaabilsanaa dhinaca qabaa’ilada. “Waxaa halkaasi ka socday qorshe weeraro iyo qaraxyo la rabo in deegaanada iyo degmooyinkaasi saddexda gobol in laga fuliyo ay kooxdaasi qorsheynaysay oo loogu soo diray in Kaba Kutukade ay xoojiyaan qorshihiisa.” Ayuu yiri Fiqi. Shabaabka ayaan ka hadlin duqayntan oo habeen hore ka dhacday Degmada Aadan Yabaal, inkastoo ay dabeecad ka dhigteen inaysan ka falcelin waxyeelada horjoogeyaasha iyo maleeshiyadooda ka soo gaarta hawlgalada socda.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ka hadashay weerar lagu qaaday Masjidka Aq-Aqsa
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul u cambaareeysay weerar lagu qaaday Masjidka Barakeysan ee Al-Aqsa, kaasi oo hoggaaminayay sarkaal Israa’iil ah oo ay wehlinayaan kooxo xagjir ah iyo ciidamaa ammaanka Israa’iil. “Falkaani wuxuu ka dhigan yahay xadgudub weyn oo lagu sameeyay karaamada iyo xurmada mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu barakaysan Islaamka, isla markaana gef ku ah dareenka malaayiinta Muslimiinta ah ee dunida ku nool” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxa ay sheegtay in ay taageersan tahay shacab ah Falastiin iyo goobaha Barakeysan magaalada Qudus. Waxa ay ugu baaqday beesha Calaamka iyo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay inay ka hortagaan falalka noocan oo kale ah ee kicinta xambaarsan isla markaana la hubiyo isla xisaabtan ku aaddan cid kasta oo ku lug leh. Sidoo kale Soomaaliya waxay ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is xakameyn isla markaana ay u istaagaan wadahadal miro dhal ah oo lagu gaari karo nabad caddaalad ku dhisan oo waarta, taas oo waafaqsan sharciga caalamiga ah iyo qaraarrada Qaramada Midoobay. The post Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ka hadashay weerar lagu qaaday Masjidka Aq-Aqsa appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Duqeyn ka dhacday Shabeellaha Dhexe oo lagu beegsaday hoggaamiyeyaal ka tirsan Al-Shabaab
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in duqeyn ka dhacday gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe lagu dilay madax ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, halka lagu dhaawacay xubno kale oo uu ku jiro Yuusuf Ciise Kabakutukade. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo ka hadlay magaalada Gaalkacyo, ayaa sheegay in duqeyntu ka dhacday degmada Aadan Yabaal, isla markaana lagu beegsaday goob ay ku sugnaayeen hoggaamiyeyaal sare oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Wasiir Fiqi ma uusan shaacin tirada rasmiga ah ee dadka lagu dilay ama lagu dhaawacay weerarka. Wuxuu sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay sii wadi doonto howlgalka ka dhanka ah Madaxda Shabaab.

items.title: Real Madrid oo xiriir rasmi ah la furtay Manchester City si ay ula saxiixato Rodri
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Kooxda Real Madrid ayaa qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo ku aaddan saxiixa xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Manchester City, Rodri, kaddib markii madaxweynaha kooxda, Florentino Pérez , uu bixiyay oggolaanshaha in wada-hadallo rasmi ah lala furo kooxda reer England. Sida ay sheegayaan warbaahinta Isbaanishka, labada kooxood ayaa sii wada wadahallada, iyadoo la filayo in heshiis lagu gaaro dhawaantaan . Tallaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah Rodri, oo 30 jir ah, waxa uu ka mid yahay ciyaaryahannada ugu wanaagsan adduunka isagoo ku guulaystay Ballon d’Or 2024 iyo inuu Spain ku hoggaamiyay guushii Koobka Adduunka 2026 . Heshiiskiisa hadda wuxuu ku dhammaanayaa xagaaga 2027, Man City -na waxay halis ugu jirtaa inay ku lumiso lacag la’aan haddii aan la iibin sanadkan . Sida ay sheegayaan ilo wareeg ah, Real Madrid waxay hore ula heshiisay dhinaca wakiillada Rodri shuruudaha shaqsiyeed, iyadoo hadda diiradda la saarayo wada-hadallada tooska ah ee labada kooxood. Man City ayaa la filayaa inay dalabto ilaa €100 milyan, halka Real Madrid ay rabto inay ku dhowaato €60 milyan , iyadoo lacag dhex-dhexaad ah oo ku dhow €80 milyan la filayo inay heshiisku ku dhammaado . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Rodri ayaa dhawaan la qabtay qaliin yar oo dhabarka ah, waxaana la filayaa inuu ka maqnaado muddo gaaban. Tababare cusub ee Man City , Enzo Maresca , ayaa sheegay in uusan ka walaacsanayn xanta ku saabsan Rodri, isagoo yiri: “Ciyaartoyda waaweyn waxaa ku wareegsan xanta, taasina waa wax caadi ah. Waxaan u maleynayaa in kastaabarbaraha uu rabo inuu lahaado Rodri, waayo waa ciyaaryahan heer sare ah” . Waxaa sidoo kale lagu soo waramayaa in Real Madrid ay soo jeedisay in ka badan €50 milyan si Rodri ugu soo biiro Bernabéu, laakiin Man City ayaa la filayaa inay dalbato lacag ka badan taas. Ilaa hadda, kooxda Ingiriiska kama aysan jawaabin dalabka rasmiga ah, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inay kooxo kale ku soo biiraan tartanka saxiixa ciyaaryahanka. Rodri ayaa la sheegay inuu mudnaanta siinayo ku biirista Real Madrid, taasoo sare u qaadaysa rajada kooxda reer Spain. The post Real Madrid oo xiriir rasmi ah la furtay Manchester City si ay ula saxiixato Rodri first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Maxkamad Brazil oo ganaax culus ku ridday Victor Gabriel
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Maxkamadda ciyaaraha ee Brazil ayaa ganaax aan horay loo arag ku ridday daafaca kooxda Internacional, Victor Gabriel, kaddib dhaawac halis ah oo uu u geystay weeraryahanka Cruzeiro, Gabriel Pec. Go’aanka maxkamadda ayaa dhigaya in Victor Gabriel laga mamnuuco ka qeybgalka dhammaan tartamada rasmiga ah ilaa Gabriel Pec uu caafimaad ahaan u soo laabto tababarka, iyadoo xadka ugu badan uu yahay 180 maalmood . Go’aankan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay ciqaab aan horay loogu arag kubadda cagta Brazil. Maxkamadda ayaa sheegtay in ganaaxyada caadiga ah ee u dhexeeya hal ilaa lix kulan aysan ka turjumeyn culayska dhaawaca . Sidaas awgeed, waxaa la go’aamiyay in la adeegsado Qodobka 254aad ee Xeerka Ciyaaraha Brazil, kaas oo ogolaanaya in muddada ciqaabtu la jaanqaado wakhtiga ay dhaawaca u baahan tahay . Gabriel Pec, oo 25 jir ah, waxa uu lahaa kulankiisii ugu horreeyay Cruzeiro kadib markii uu kaga soo biiray LA Galaxy lacag dhan $12 milyan . Dhaawaca ayaa ku yimid 13 daqiiqo kadib intii uu ciyaarta ka soo galay, waxaana lagu ogaaday inuu ka dhacay lugtiisa bidix . Waxaa la filayaa inuu ka maqnaado 3 ilaa 4 bilood . Victor Gabriel, oo 22 jir ah, ayaa maxkamadda kaga hadlay dhacdada, isagoo sheegay inuusan u jeedin inuu dhaawaco Pec. Wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaan soo dhaafay habeeno aan hurdayn anigoo u duceynaya, waxaanan si qalbiga ah ugu raali-gelinayaa dhamaan taageerayaasha Cruzeiro” . Wuxuu kaloo sheegay inuu uu raaliga ka yahay, isla markaana uusan u jeedin wax xumaato ah . Go’aanka maxkamadda ayaa kala qaybiyay garsoorayaasha, iyadoo mid ka mid ah u codeeyay ganaax caadi ah oo lix kulan ah, laakiin inta badan waxay ku wada oggolaadeen ganaaxa dheer . Kooxda Internacional ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigtay caddayn been abuur ah oo ah duubis VAR ah, taasoo ay markii dambe ka baxeen . The post Maxkamad Brazil oo ganaax culus ku ridday Victor Gabriel first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Soomaaliya ka qeyb gashay Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ku taageera AUSSOM
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka XDS, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta magaalada Kampala ee Jamhuuriyadda Uganda kaga qayb galay Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Difaaca (CDFs Meeting) ee Dalalka Ciidamada ku taageera Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM). Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda amni ee Soomaaliya, dib u eegista horumarka laga sameeyey dib u dhiska iyo tayeynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, xaaladda guud ee hawlgalka AUSSOM iyo taageerada la xiriirta, iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo isku duwidda hawlgallada wadajirka ah ee u dhexeeya Ciidanka XDS iyo Ciidamada Hawlgalka AUSSOM. Intii uu shirku socday, madaxda ka qayb gashay waxay adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda wada shaqeynta istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka ciidamadooda qaybta ka yihiin hawlgalka AUSSOM, si loo dardargeliyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga dalka, korna loogu qaado awoodda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, loona xoojiyo la dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada. Ka qaybgalka Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee shirkan ayaa muujinaya doorka hoggaamineed ee Ciidanka XDS ku leeyahay xoojinta iskaashiga amniga gobolka iyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabad waarta, xasillooni iyo isku filnaanshaha awoodda difaaca ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: Five Kenyan Security Officers Killed in Al-Shabaab Attack in Mandera
items.description: MANDERA, — At least five Kenyan security officers were killed in an attack by suspected Al-Shabaab militants in Mandera County, near the border with Somalia, according to Kenyan police. The officers, who were attached to the Alungu-based Special Operations Group, came under attack in the Wantey Dam area, triggering a heavy exchange of gunfire with the militants. A preliminary police report said five officers were killed during the confrontation. Reinforcements were deployed to the area shortly after the fighting began to support the security team and pursue the attackers. However, an armoured vehicle carrying members of the reinforcement unit was struck by an improvised explosive device planted along the road. Police did not immediately disclose whether the explosion caused further casualties. Security forces subsequently launched an operation in the area to track down the militants and secure the surrounding communities. Al-Shabaab has carried out repeated attacks in Kenya’s northeastern counties, particularly in areas close to the Somali border. The group frequently targets security personnel and government vehicles through ambushes, roadside bombings and other armed attacks. items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo diyaarado u adeegsaday howlgal maanta ka dhacay…
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta howlgal qorsheysan oo diyaarado loo adeegsaday ka fuliyay deegaanno ku teedsan jiinka Webiga Jubba, halkaas oo lagu beegsaday fariisimo iyo difaacyo ay Al-Shabaab ku leeyihiin aaggaas. Diyaaradaha milatari ee ka qayb-qaatay howlgalka ayaa lagu daabulay ciidamada la geeyay goobta, iyaga oo kadib si toos ah u gaaray aagagga ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, sida lagu sheegay bayaan kasoo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Gaarka ah ee Danab. Howlgalkan oo ahaa bartilmaameed ayaa khasaare culus lagu gaarsiiyay argagixisada, iyada oo la burburiyay fariisimo ay ku lahaayeen halkaasi. “Markii ciidamada ay gaareen goobta, waxay qaadeen hawlgallo qorsheysan oo lagu beegsaday fariisimihii iyo difaacyadii Khawaarijta, waxaana kooxda la gaarsiiyay jab xooggan iyo khasaare culus,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Intii uu socday hawlgalku, ciidamada ayaa burburiyay awooddii Khawaarijta ee goobihii la beegsaday, iyadoo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda la gaarsiiyay khasaare, halka qaar kalena ay ka firxadeen fariisimahoodii”. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in howlgalkan uu muujinayo awoodda iyo diyaar-garowga Ciidanka Danab, iyo sida ay uga go’an tahay inay gaaraan goob kasta oo Khawaarijtu isku daydo inay gabaad iyo difaac ka dhigato. Dhanka kale, Taliska Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ayaa xaqiijiyay in howlgallada socda lagu wiiqayo awoodda Khawaarijta iyo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga deegaannada ay sii socon doonaan, iyadoo ciidamada ay ka go’an tahay difaaca shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo ilaalinta qarannimada Soomaaliya. Jubbooyinka ayaa kamid ah meelaha ay ku xooggan yihiin Al-Shabaab, waxaana badanaa howlgallo ka fuliya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Jubbaland. The post Ciidanka Danab oo diyaarado u adeegsaday howlgal maanta ka dhacay… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: MADAXWEYNE XASAN SHEEKH OO KORMEER SHAQO KU TEGAY DEKEDDA MUQDISHO
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kormeer shaqo ku tagay Dekedda caalamiga ah ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaasi oo uu ugu kuurgalay horumarka ka socda kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee dalka iyo qorshayaasha lagu casriyeynayo adeegyada dekedda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa soo indha indheeyay xarumaha kaydka Shidaalka dekedda, bakhaarada iyo dhismaha cusub ee xafiisyada maamulka dekedda, isaga oo xog ogaal u noqday dadaalada dib u habeynta iyo casriyeynta xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda iyo kor u qaadista tayada adeegyada ay helaan shacabka iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa kormeerka kaddib, kulan muhiim ah la qaatay Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda iyo Maareeyaha Guud ee Dekedda Muqdisho, oo uu ka dhageystay warbixin faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan xaaladda guud ee dekedda, horumarka laga gaaray mashaariicda socda iyo qorshaha dhismaha Dekedda Cusub ee Muqdisho oo loogu talagalay in ay daboosha dhammaan baahida dakadeed ee caasimadda, islamarkaana kor loo qaaddo awoodda ay u leedahay la tacaalidda kororka ganacsiga iyo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa adkeeyey in horumarinta dekedaha ay laf-dhabar u tahay kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka, kor u qaadista ganacsiga, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo xoojinta isku xirka dalka iyo suuqyada caalamka, waxa uuna kula dardaarmay masuuliyiinta Wasaaradda iyo maamulka Dekedda in ay laba jibaaraan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada dekedda.

items.title: Mashruuc heer qaran ah oo lagu horumarinaayo waxbarashada Ceel-afweyn
items.description: Ceel-afweyn: Masuuliyiin Heer Qaran iyo Heer Gobol ah oo Daah-furay Mashruuc Lagu Horumarinayo Waxbarashada 19 Dugsi oo ku yaalla Gobolka Sanaag Agaasimaha Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Barbaarinta iyo Sayniska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Sanaag, Gudomiyaha Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Barbaarinta iyo Sayniska ee Gobolka Sanaag, Maayir Ku-xigeenka Degmada Ceel-afweyn Maamuulaha Wasarada Waxbarshada Barbaarinta Iyo Sayniska Degmada Ceelafwayn iyo Agaasimaha Dugsiyada Hoose ee Degmada Ceel-afweyn ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daah-furay mashruuc ay fulinayso hay’adda YOVENCO, kaas oo laga hirgelinayo 19 dugsi oo ku yaalla gobolka Sanaag. Mashruucan ayaa diiradda saaraya horumarinta tayada waxbarashada, kor u qaadista deegaanka waxbarasho iyo taageeridda dugsiyada degmada Ceel-afweyn, oo waxbarashadoodu dib-u-dhac la kulantay sannadihii u dambeeyey. Masuuliyiintii ka qayb-gashay munaasabadda ayaa sheegay in mashruucani wax weyn ka tari doono dib u soo kabashada waxbarashada degmada Ceel-afweyn, isla markaana uu sare u qaadi doono tayada waxbaridda iyo waxbarashada ardayda dhigata 19-ka dugsi ee mashruucu ka hirgelayo. Waxay sidoo kale bogaadiyeen doorka ay hay’adda YOVENCO ka qaadanayso horumarinta waxbarashada gobolka Sanaag, iyagoo xusay in iskaashiga Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo hay’adaha horumarintu uu muhiim u yahay horumarinta adeegyada waxbarasho iyo tayaynta fursadaha ay helayaan ardayda gobolka.

items.title: Taliyaha Militariga Somaliya oo ka qaybgalay shir la xiriira Hawlgalka AUSSOM
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta Magaalada Kampala uga qaybgalay Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ee dalalka Afrika ay ciidamada ka joogaan Somaliya. Shirkan oo ay martigelisay Dowladda Uganda ayaa looga hadlay Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Somaliya (AUSSOM), waxaana uu yimid, ka dib markii Mareykanka uu horaantii bishan sheegay in uu joojin doono taageerada Ciidanka AUSSOM, oo aan waqtigooda la cusbooneysiin doonin, marka la gaaro 31-ka bisha December. Mareykanka ayaa go’aankiisan u sababeeyay fashilka dagaalka Al Shabaab iyo horumar la’aanta amniga Somaliya. “Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda amni ee Somaliya, dib-u-eegista horumarka laga sameeyay dib-u-dhiska iyo tayaynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, xaaladda guud ee Hawlgalka AUSSOM iyo taageerada la xiriirta iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda hawlgalada wadajirka ah ee u dhaxeeya Ciidanka XDS iyo Ciidamada Hawlgalka AUSSOM.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Militariga Somaliya. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Intii uu shirku socday, madaxda ka qaybgashay waxay adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda wada-shaqaynta istiraatiijiga ah ee u dhaxeysa Dowladda Federaalka Somaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka ciidamadooda qaybta ka yihiin Hawlgalka AUSSOM, si loo dardargeliyo dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga dalka, korna loogu qaado awoodda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, loona xoojiyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada.” Dalalka Uganda, Burundi, Kenya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti iyo Masar ayaa ah dalalka ciidamada ku deeqay Hawlgalka AUSSOM, iyadoo Uganda ay tahay dalka ciidamada ugu badan ka joogaan Somaliya. Xoogaga AUSSOM ayaa Dowladda Soomaaliyeed ka taageera howlaha sugidda amniga iyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada.

Shirkan oo ay martigelisay Dowladda Uganda ayaa looga hadlay Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Somaliya (AUSSOM), waxaana uu yimid, ka dib markii Mareykanka uu horaantii bishan sheegay in uu joojin doono taageerada Ciidanka AUSSOM, oo aan waqtigooda la cusbooneysiin doonin, marka la gaaro 31-ka bisha December. Mareykanka ayaa go’aankiisan u sababeeyay fashilka dagaalka Al Shabaab iyo horumar la’aanta amniga Somaliya. “Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda amni ee Somaliya, dib-u-eegista horumarka laga sameeyay dib-u-dhiska iyo tayaynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, xaaladda guud ee Hawlgalka AUSSOM iyo taageerada la xiriirta iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda hawlgalada wadajirka ah ee u dhaxeeya Ciidanka XDS iyo Ciidamada Hawlgalka AUSSOM.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Militariga Somaliya. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Intii uu shirku socday, madaxda ka qaybgashay waxay adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda wada-shaqaynta istiraatiijiga ah ee u dhaxeysa Dowladda Federaalka Somaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka ciidamadooda qaybta ka yihiin Hawlgalka AUSSOM, si loo dardargeliyo dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga dalka, korna loogu qaado awoodda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, loona xoojiyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada.” Dalalka Uganda, Burundi, Kenya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti iyo Masar ayaa ah dalalka ciidamada ku deeqay Hawlgalka AUSSOM, iyadoo Uganda ay tahay dalka ciidamada ugu badan ka joogaan Somaliya. Xoogaga AUSSOM ayaa Dowladda Soomaaliyeed ka taageera howlaha sugidda amniga iyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo kormeeray howlaha ka socda Dekedda Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kormeer ku tagay Dekedda caalamiga ah ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaasi oo uu ugu kuurgalay horumarka ka socda kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee dalka iyo qorshayaasha lagu casriyeynayo adeegyada dekedda. Qoraal kasoo baxay Villa Somalia ayaa lagu sheegay in madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu indha indheeyay xarumaha kaydka Shidaalka dekedda, bakhaarada iyo dhismaha cusub ee xafiisyada maamulka dekedda, waxa uuna xog ogaal u noqday dadaalada dib u habeynta iyo casriyeynta xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda iyo kor u qaadista tayada adeegyada ay helaan shacabka iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed Sidoo kale madaxweynaha ayaa kormeerka kaddib, kulan muhiim ah la qaatay Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda iyo Maareeyaha Guud ee Dekadda Muqdisho iyo qorshaha dhismaha Dekedda Cusub ee Muqdisho oo loogu talagalay in ay daboosha dhammaan baahida dakadeed ee caasimadda, islamarkaana kor loo qaaddo awoodda ay u leedahay la tacaalidda kororka ganacsiga iyo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka. Ugu dambeyn madaxweyne Xasan ayaa adkeeyey in horumarinta dekedaha ay laf-dhabar u tahay kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka, kor u qaadista ganacsiga, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo xoojinta isku xirka dalka iyo suuqyada caalamka, waxa uuna kula dardaarmay masuuliyiinta Wasaaradda iyo maamulka Dekedda in ay laba jibaaraan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada dekedda. items.title: Galmudug oo hakisay duulimaadyada rayidka inta lagu jiro doorashooyinka
items.description: Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ku dhawaaqday in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo hakinayo dhammaan duulimaadyada rayidka ee ka baxa kana soo dega garoomada diyaaradaha Galmudug, iyadoo la tixgelinayo sugidda amniga iyo xaqiijinta habsami-u-socodka doorashooyinka. Warqad kasoo baxday Xafiiska Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada, Cabdiqor Maxamed Maxamed, ayaa lagu sheegay in go’aankan uu dhaqan geli doono 30-ka Luulyo 2026, isla markaana uu sii jiri doono inta ay socoto doorashada ama ilaa amar kale oo rasmi ah kasoo baxa Wasaaradda. Go’aanka ayaa khuseeya dhammaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha, maamulka garoomada, Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) iyo hay’adaha kale ee ay quseyso. Wasaaraddu waxay xustay in duulimaadyada la xiriira xaaladaha degdegga ah, gargaarka bani’aadannimada ama arrimaha amniga loo oggolaan doono oo keliya fasax rasmi ah oo ay bixiso Wasaaradda. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda ayaa ugu baaqday dhammaan hay’adaha iyo shirkadaha ay khuseyso inay si buuxda u fuliyaan amarkan, isla markaana ay la shaqeeyaan hay’adaha amniga si loo xaqiijiyo nabadgelyada iyo habsami-u-socodka doorashada.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay cadadka lacagta ay beesha calamka ka goosatay Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Biixi Imaan Cige ayaa sheegay in ay hoos u dhacday kaalmadii iyo deeqihii ay Dowladda Federaalka ka heli jirtay caalamka, isaga oo shaaciyay cadadka lacagta ay beesha caalamka ka goosatay Soomaaliya. Wasiir Biixi ayaa qiray in sanadihii 2025 iyo 2024 ay si weyn hoos ugu dhaceen deeqihii ka imaanayay caalamka, isla markaana loo baahan yahay in la qaado tallaabooyin gudaha ah oo lagu xoojinayo isku tiirsanaanta Soomaaliya. “Labadii sano ee ugu dambeysay kaalmada soo gasha Soomaaliya 25% ayay hoos u dhacday, wayna kasii badaneysaa sanadba sanadka ka dambeeya. Waa lama huraan qorshe gudaha ah inaan yeelano oo isku tiirsanaan ah oo laga maarmayo deeqaha dunida,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wuxuu xaqiijiyay in dalalka beesha caalamka ay goosteen lacag dhan 450 illaa 600 milyan oo dollar, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay howlaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda, gaar ahaan arrimaha bulshada iyo amniga. “Waxaan ka hadleynaa sanadkii 450 milyan, illaa 600 oo milyan oo dalka soo geli jirtay oo meesha ka baxaysa,” ayuu mar kale yiri Wasiir Biixi Iimaan Cige. Waxaa kale oo uu intaasi sii raaciyay “Qeybaha u badan ee ay saameynta ugu wayn ugu yeelaneysaa waa Sector-ka Social-ka sida caafimaadka, waxbarashada, arrimaha la xiriira security-ga iyo arrimaha bani’aadanimada”. Hadalka Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda ay wajahaysa caqabado dhaqaale oo ay ka mid yihiin hoos u dhaca deeqaha dibadda iyo baahida loo qabo in la helo ilo dhaqaale oo gudaha ah, si loo sii wado adeegyada muhiimka ah iyo hawlaha dowladda. Soomaaliya ayaa muddo ka badan labaatan sano si weyn ugu tiirsaneyd deeqaha iyo kaalmada ee beesha caalamka, si loo maalgeliyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah sida caafimaadka, waxbarashada, gargaarka bani’aadannimada iyo dib u dhiska hay’adaha dowladda. The post DF oo shaacisay cadadka lacagta ay beesha calamka ka goosatay Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .
