items.title: DF oo si kulul u cambaareysay weeraradii lala beegsaday…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay weerarradii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones-ka) ee lagu beegsaday Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa lagu muujiyay walaaceeda ku aaddan badqabka dadka rayidka ah, waxayna mar kale xaqiijineysaa garab istaaggeeda buuxa ee Sacuudiga oo ay ku tilmaamtay inuu yahay dal walaalo ah, isla markaana ah saaxiib U dhaw dowladda Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale taageertay dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagu ilaalinayo amniga, madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Boqortooyada. “Amniga Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya wuxuu laf dhabar u yahay xasilloonida gobolka iyo xorriyadda isu socodka maraakiibta ee Badda Cas,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka dowladda Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale waxaa lagu yiri “Soomaaliya waxay taageereysaa dhammaan dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu xallinayo khilaafaadka si nabad ah, waxayna ku baaqeysaa is xakameyn si looga hortago sii hurinta xiisadaha.” Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto la shaqeynta iyo isku duwidda dadaallada ay la leedahay saaxiibbada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah si loo ilaaliyo nabadda iyo amniga gobolka. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqday in xallinta khilaafaadka loo maro wada-hadal iyo waddooyin diblomaasiyadeed, halkii laga adeegsan lahaa falal hubeysan. items.title: Galkayo on edge as Somalia govt, Puntland inch toward armed conflict
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former Somali Prime Minister Omar Abdirashid Ali Sharmarke on Tuesday warned that Somalia risks sliding into another internal conflict as military tensions between the federal government and Puntland escalate around the strategic central town of Galkayo, cautioning that a new confrontation would divert critical human and military resources from the country’s fight against Al-Shabaab and ISIS while deepening an already severe political crisis. Sharmarke said the growing military buildup around Galkayo carries the potential to ignite a conflict whose consequences would extend far beyond the disputed front lines, threatening national stability and undermining ongoing counterterrorism operations. “Galkacyo is not Almiskad. Puntland State authority must refrain itself from waging a war of aggression against fellow Puntland Forces without any legal justifications,” he wrote in a statement posted on X. “The amount of weaponry that has been directed towards this looming conflict in Galkacyo city will definitely drain human and material capital needed for the war on terror.” The former prime minister warned that fighting in Galkayo could trigger widespread instability, fuel a humanitarian crisis and draw additional actors into an already volatile confrontation. He urged Puntland politicians, traditional elders and religious scholars to intervene before the situation deteriorates into open warfare. Sharmarke’s warning was echoed by former Foreign Minister Abdisaid Muse Ali, another senior politician from Galkayo, who also cautioned against allowing political disagreements to spill into armed conflict. Referring to Puntland’s objections over the federal government’s appointment of Gen. Jimale Takar as commander of the 54th Division, Abdisaid argued that the dispute should not become a catalyst for violence in Galkayo. “If Puntland claims are correct that FGS appointed the 54th Division commander then he is already in Garowe, deal with the issue in there. There is no reason for this political dispute to spread to Gaalkacyo,” he wrote on X. “Its residents have paid enough for conflicts they did not create. HSM, Deni, & Golaha Mustaqbalka should put their efforts into reaching a credible elections agreement instead of opening another front.” The warnings come amid mounting concerns over an expanding military buildup around Galkayo. Earlier this week, a clan leader in Galmudug claimed that the federal government had deployed about 3,000 soldiers who recently completed military training in Galmudug to Galkayo, alleging the deployment was intended to undermine Puntland’s security. Combined with Sharmarke’s assertion that Puntland has also directed substantial weaponry toward the looming confrontation, the claims have heightened fears that Somalia’s widening political crisis could soon evolve into another armed conflict between the federal government and a regional administration. Relations between Mogadishu and Puntland have deteriorated sharply in recent weeks. This week, Puntland authorities accused Somalia’s federal government of carrying out a troop buildup and military maneuvers in Galkayo that they said were intended to undermine the regional administration and its security, urging residents to stand behind Puntland leadership in the face of what they described as escalating threats. Puntland authorities recently said they captured 30 fighters aligned with the federal government and seized 13 military vehicles after attacking positions held by federal-aligned PSF forces near Bosaso, in the first major military confrontation between the two sides in the region. The latest tensions unfold against the backdrop of an increasingly polarized political landscape. Since President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud returned to office in 2022, his administration has entered into confrontations with two regional states – Jubaland and Southwest. The federal government suffered a setback in its conflict with Jubaland but prevailed in Southwest after regional president Abdiasis Laftagaren was removed from office in March and the outgoing speaker of the regional parliament, a close ally of President Mohamud, assumed the presidency. Should tensions around Galkayo escalate into open warfare, the confrontation would mark a third major conflict between the federal government and a regional administration during Mohamud’s current term, although the outcome of any such conflict remains uncertain. The mounting security concerns come as Somalia remains mired in an escalating political crisis over elections, with the mandates of both the federal government and parliament having expired months ago and no agreement yet reached on a path forward. The federal government maintains that it has another year to remain in office and insists it is committed to holding a one-person, one-vote election. Opposition leaders say they do not oppose universal suffrage in principle but argue that any election must be free, fair and credible. They have criticized the elections conducted in Southwest State and Mogadishu’s municipal polls, describing them as controlled, rigged and lacking legitimacy. Against that backdrop, political tensions have increasingly overlapped with security concerns, raising fears that unresolved disputes over governance could further complicate Somalia’s efforts to confront Al-Shabaab and ISIS while preserving fragile relations between the federal government and regional administrations. On Monday, opposition leaders also appealed to countries contributing troops to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) ahead of their July 29 meeting in Uganda, urging them to help establish a transitional governing body to administer the country until elections are held and legitimate institutions assume office. The opposition argued that what it described as the federal government’s attempts to consolidate power are deepening the political crisis that has prevented Somalia from fully assuming responsibility for its own security, contributed to growing international donor fatigue and increased the risk of a complete collapse of the AUSSOM mission. The warnings from Sharmarke and Abdisaid, coupled with claims of military deployments around Galkayo and the recent confrontation near Bosaso, underscore growing concerns that Somalia’s long-running political dispute could enter a more dangerous phase if tensions between Mogadishu and Puntland continue to escalate. With competing political camps locked in an impasse over elections, military tensions rising between the federal government and Puntland, and the country simultaneously battling Al-Shabaab and ISIS, the prospect of another internal conflict threatens to open a new front at a time when Somalia is already facing one of its most consequential periods of political and security uncertainty in nearly two decades. items.title: Cumar Cabdirashiid oo si adag uga hadlay xiisadda Gaalkacyo, una digay Puntland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Cumar Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke ayaa si cad uga horyimid dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo maamulka Puntland uu ka wado magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug. Cumar Cabdirashiid ayaa uga digay madaxda maamulka Puntland inay ka fogaadaan hurinta dagaal cusub, isagoo sheegay in Gaalkacyo aysan ahayn buuraha Calmiskaad ee ay ka socdeen howl-gallada ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish, isla markaana aysan habboonayn in awood ciidan loo adeegsado dagaal uu ku tilmaamay mid “gardarro ah” oo ka dhan ah ciidamo kale oo Puntland ah, iyadoo aanu jirin, sida uu sheegay, saldhig sharci ah oo lagu cuskado tallaabadaas. Qoraal kooban oo uu ku daabacay bartiisa X, ayuu ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ku sheegay in hubka iyo awoodda ciidan ee loo weecinayo colaadda ka soo cusboonaaneysa Gaalkacyo ay si weyn u wiiqi karaan awoodda iyo agabka loo baahan yahay si loo sii wado dagaalka lagula jiro kooxaha argagixisada. Wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay in haddii uu isku dhac ka qarxo magaalada Gaalkacyo uu yeelan karo cawaaqib amni iyo mid bani’aadantinimo oo culus, sidoo kalena horseedi kara xasillooni-darro ku baahda gobolka, barakac shacabka soo gaara iyo suurtagalnimada in ciidamo kale ay ku lug yeeshaan iska horimaadka. Cumar Cabdirashiid ayaa farriin u diray mas’uuliyiinta Dowladda Federaalka, isimada dhaqanka iyo culimada Soomaaliyeed, isagoo ugu baaqay inay qaataan door muuqda oo lagu baajinayo colaadda. Wuxuu ku adkeystay in wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad ay yihiin waddada keliya ee lagu xallin karo khilaafaadka jira, halkii loo adeegsan lahaa awood ciidan. Hadalka ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo horraantii toddobaadkan maamulka Puntland uu uga digay Galmudug in deegaannadeeda loo soo mariyo saanad ciidan iyo ciidamo la sheegay inay u sii gudbayaan dhinaca Puntland, taas oo ku tilmaantay arrintaasi mid khatar ku ah amniga deegaannadeeda. Dhankeeda, maamulka Galmudug ayaa ka jawaabay hadalka Puntland, isagoo sheegay in uusan diyaar u ahayn dagaal ka dhaca magaalada Gaalkacyo. Galmudug waxay ku baaqday in khilaafaadka ka dhex taagan Puntland lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, isla markaana aan magaalada Gaalkacyo loo adeegsan goob lagu xalliyo murannada siyaasadeed ama kuwa ciidan. Si kastaba, xiisadda ka taagan Gaalkacyo ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo inay saameyn ku yeelato amniga gobolka Mudug iyo dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha argagixisada. Waxaana isa soo taraya baaqyada uga imanaya siyaasiyiinta, waxgaradka iyo bulshada rayidka ah ee ku aaddan in dhinacyadu ka fogaadaan dagaal, isla markaana mudnaanta siiyaan wada-hadal iyo xal nabadeed. items.title: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Cagaarshowga Adduunka
items.description: 28-ka Luulyo sannad kasta waxaa dunida laga xusaa Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Cagaarshowga Adduunka (World Hepatitis Day). Ujeeddada maalintan waa in kor loo qaado wacyiga bulshada ee ku saabsan cudurka cagaarshowga, muhiimadda ka hortaggiisa, baaritaankiisa iyo daaweyntiisa. Maalintan waxaa loo asteeyay in lagu maamuuso dhalashadii saynisyahankii Baruch Samuel Blumberg, oo helay fayraska Cagaarshowga B (Hepatitis B) isla markaana door weyn ka qaatay samaynta tallaalka cudurkaas. Sannadka 2026, hal-ku-dhigga maalintan waa “Aan jebinno caqabadaha Cagaarshowga”, taas oo diiradda saaraysa in dadka loo fududeeyo helitaanka baaritaan, tallaal, daaweyn iyo adeegyada caafimaadka. Cagaarshowgu waa cudur ku dhaca beerka, waxaana sababa fayrasyo kala duwan oo loo yaqaan Hepatitis A, B, C, D iyo E. Noocyada B iyo C ayaa ah kuwa ugu halista badan, maadaama ay isu beddeli karaan cudur daba-dheeraada oo sababi kara beer-fadhi (Cirrhosis) iyo kansarka beerka haddii aan la daaweyn. Calaamadaha cudurka waxaa ka mid noqon kara indhaha iyo maqaarka oo huruud isu beddela, daal badan, qandho, lalabbo, matag, calool xanuun iyo kaadi madow. Dad badan ayaa se aan wax calaamado ah yeelan muddo dheer, taas oo sababta in cudurka la ogaado xilli dambe. Ujeeddada maalintan waa in kor loo qaado wacyiga bulshada ee ku saabsan cudurka cagaarshowga, muhiimadda ka hortaggiisa, baaritaankiisa iyo daaweyntiisa. items.title: Uganda oo si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay inuu dalkeeda  ka baxay cudurka Ebola
items.description: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Uganda ayaa si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday in dalka uu ka xoroobay cudurka Ebola, kadib markii la xaqiijiyay in uu dhammaaday cudur-faafiyihii ugu dambeeyay ee dalka ka jiray. Go’aankan ayaa yimid kaddib 42 maalmood oo xiriir ah oo aan la diiwaangelin wax kiis cusub ah, taas oo waafaqsan shuruudaha caalamiga ah ee lagu soo afjaro cudur-faafinta Ebola. Saraakiisha caafimaadka ayaa sheegay in cudurkan saf marka ah, oo billowday bartamihii bishii May, uu sababay 20 qof oo la xaqiijiyay inay qaadeen cudurka, halka laba qof ay u dhinteen. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay xuseen in 15 ka mid ah kiisaskaas ay xiriir la lahaayeen cudurka ka sii fidaya Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC). Guushan ayaa loo aaneynayaa dadaallada degdegga ah ee dowladda Uganda, kuwaas oo isugu jiray baaritaanno ballaaran, dabagalka dadka la kulmay bukaannada, karantiil, iyo wacyigelin bulshada loo sameeyay. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto feejignaanta maadaama cudurka Ebola uu weli si xooggan uga jiro dalka deriska la ah ee DRC, taasoo sare u qaadaysa halista kiisaska laga soo gudbin karo xadka. Hay’adaha caafimaadka caalamiga ah ayaa soo dhaweeyay tallaabada Uganda, iyagoo ku ammaanay sida ay uga hortagtay faafitaanka cudurka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay ku baaqeen in la sii xoojiyo ilaalinta xuduudaha iyo la socodka caafimaadka, maadaama xaaladda DRC ay weli tahay mid walaac leh oo ay ka jiraan kumannaan kiis oo Ebola ah.

items.title: Puntland security forces seize vehicle carrying 250 military uniforms in Galkayo
items.description: Puntland security forces have intercepted a vehicle carrying 250 military uniforms in the divided city of Galkayo, according to a statement issued by the Mudug Regional Police Command. Police said the Toyota Noah, bearing registration number WQ 713, had entered Galkayo from the Galmudug-administered side of the city. Security agencies had reportedly been monitoring the vehicle’s movements before intercepting it during a coordinated operation. The driver was arrested and taken into custody for questioning. Authorities said an investigation had been launched to establish the origin and intended destination of the uniforms, as well as to identify any individuals or groups involved in their transportation. In a separate incident, Puntland security forces arrested a motorist accused of driving while intoxicated after allegedly hitting a civilian in the Israac neighbourhood of Galkayo. Police said the driver attempted to flee the scene following the incident but was later apprehended. The condition of the injured civilian was not immediately disclosed. Mudug Regional Police Commander Colonel Mahmoud Muse Bille, commonly known as Farda-fuul, called on residents to cooperate with security agencies and report activities that could threaten public safety. He also warned that individuals involved in criminal activity or acts of insecurity would be held accountable under the law. The seizure comes amid heightened tensions between Puntland forces and units affiliated with Somalia’s Federal Government operating in Galkayo. Puntland has previously accused the Galmudug administration of cooperating with the Federal Government in recruiting and mobilising armed groups that it claims could be used to undermine security in Puntland. Neither the Galmudug administration nor the Federal Government has publicly responded to the latest allegations. items.title: Firdhiye oo shaaciyay arrin uu ka baaqsaday ka hor inta xildhibaannadu is-casilin
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari, Cabdiqaadir Axmed Cali Firdhiye ayaa si kulul uga hadlay xildhibaanno ka tirsanaa baarlamaanka maamulkiisa oo dhawaan u goostay dhinaca Somaliland. Tallaabadan ayuu ku ku tilmaamay mid dhaawaceysa kalsoonidii shacabka, inkastoo uu sheegay inay fursad u abuurtay maamulka uu ku soo xulo xubno uu sheegay inay si dhab ah ugu istaagayaan difaaca qadiyadda Waqooyi Bari. Firdhiye ayaa sheegay in bishii March ee sanadkan uu guddoonka baarlamaanka ku wargeliyay in qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada ay qorsheynayeen inay u safraan Hargeysa, hase yeeshee wuxuu xusay in xilligaas aan la qaadin tallaabo degdeg ah, maadaama arrinta xil ka qaadista xubnahaasi ay ahayd mid muran siyaasadeed dhalin kartay. “Waxay qaateen go’aan ceeb ah, balse annaga sharaf ayay noo tahay inay naga baxaan dad aan ku kalsooneyn mabda’a maamulka. Taasi waxay noo oggolaaneysaa in boosaskooda lagu beddelo dad u taagan danaha Waqooyi Bari,” ayuu yiri hoggaamiye Firdhiye, isagoo muujiyay in maamulka uusan ka walaacsaneyn bixitaanka xubnahaasi. Firdhiye ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay xildhibaannadii sheegay inay kasoo horjeedaan xukuumaddiisa, isagoo xusay in haddii ay jireen tabashooyin siyaasadeed ay ahayd inay ku soo bandhigaan gudaha hay’adaha maamulka, halkii ay ka dooran lahaayeen inay ka baxaan maamulka kuna biiraan dhinaca Somaliland. Sidoo kale wuxuu qiray in maamulka Waqooyi Bari uu weli wajahayo caqabado dhinaca horumarinta ah, isagoo sheegay in mashaariic badan oo adeegyo iyo kaabayaal ah aysan weli si buuxda u gaarin deegaannada maamulka. Si kastaba, hoggaamiyaha Waqooyi Bari ayaa ku dooday in arrintaan aysan waxba u dhimayn sharciyadda maamulka, isla markaana ay tahay marxalad ay soo mareen dowlad-goboleedyadii kale ee Soomaaliya markii la aas-aasayay. Dhanka kale, Hoggaamiyaha Waqooyi Bari ayaa ku eedeeyay Somaliland inay waddo olole siyaasadeed iyo mid warbaahineed oo lagu wiiqayo maamulka uu hoggaamiyo, isagoo sheegay in xubnaha u wareegay dhinaca Somaliland aysan wax saameyn ah ku yeelan doonin jiritaanka iyo mustaqbalka maamulka Waqooyi Bari. Sidoo kale, Firdhiye ayaa uga digay Somaliland inay sii waddo waxa uu ku tilmaamay fara-gelinta ay ku heyso deegaannada maamulka, taas oo uu sheegay inay sii kordhin karto xiisadda ka jirta gobolka. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in maamulka Waqooyi Bari uu difaacan doono jiritaankiisa iyo deegaannadiisa. Hadalka Firdhiye ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo loollanka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Waqooyi Bari iyo Somaliland, kaas oo salka ku haya maamulka iyo gacan ku haynta deegaanno ka tirsan gobollada Sool iyo Sanaag. Xiisaddan ayaa weli ka mid ah arrimaha ugu xasaasisan ee ka taagan waqooyiga Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada dhinac ay is dhaafsanayaan eedeymo la xiriira amniga iyo maamulka deegaannada lagu muransan yahay. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Howlgal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka Fuliyay Shabeellaha Dhexe
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay inay howlgal amni ka fuliyeen deegaanka Sumadaale ee degmada Cadale, gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, halkaas oo lagu beegsaday fariisimo ay ku sugnaayeen dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab. items.title: Bangiga Dhexe oo Ballaarinaya Nidaamka Lacag-bixinta Degdegga ah ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, 27 Luulyo 2026 – Bangiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqay qorshe lagu ballaarinayo Nidaamka Lacag-bixinta Degdegga ah ee Soomaaliya (SIPS), kaas oo isku xiraya bangiyada ganacsiga, adeegyada Mobile Money-ga iyo shabakadaha lacag-bixinta ee gobolka, si loo helo nidaam mideysan oo lacagaha loogu kala wareego si degdeg ah. Guddoomiyaha Bangiga Dhexe, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay soo afjareyso kala-go’naantii hore ee u dhexeysay bangiyada iyo adeegyada Mobile Money-ga, taas oo sare u qaadi doonta helitaanka adeegyada maaliyadeed iyo fududeynta lacag wareejinta. Nidaamka SIPS oo la hirgeliyey Janaayo 2025 kuna dhisan heerka caalamiga ah ee ISO 20022, ayaa markii uu si buuxda u shaqeeyo isku xiri doona 14 bangi ganacsi iyo 8 adeeg bixiye oo Mobile Money iyo e-wallet ah, isagoo taageeri doona lacag isu dirista, lacag bixinta ganacsiyada, adeegyada dowladda iyo macaamillo kale oo dijitaal ah. Bangiga Dhexe ayaa sidoo kale qorsheynaya in SIPS lagu xiro nidaamyada lacag-bixinta ee Bariga Afrika iyo Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS) ka hor dhammaadka 2026, si loo dardargeliyo lacagaha xuduudaha ka gudba, ganacsiga iyo xawaaladaha. Wasiirka Maaliyadda, Biixi Iimaan Cige, ayaa sheegay in nidaamkan uu yahay maalgelin istiraatiiji ah oo lagu xoojinayo hannaanka maaliyadeed ee dalka, korna loogu qaadayo hufnaanta, daahfurnaanta, kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo ka mid noqoshada adeegyada maaliyadeed ee bulshada.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo si kulul uga hadashay weerar lagu qaaday Sacuudiga
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay weerarradii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones-ka) ee lagu beegsaday Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. “Soomaaliya waxay muujineysaa walaaceeda ku aaddan badqabka dadka rayidka ah, waxayna mar kale xaqiijineysaa garab istaaggeeda buuxa ee Boqortooyada, iyadoo taageereysa dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagu ilaalinayo amniga, madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Boqortooyada” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay Xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegtay in Sacuudiga uu laf-dhabar u yahay xasiloonida gobolka iyo xorriyada isu socodka maraakiibta Badda Cas. Sidoo kale dowladda Soomaaliya, waxa ay tilmaamtay in ay taageereyso dhammaan dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu xallinayo khilaafaadka si nabad ah, iyada oo ugu baaqday  in si xakameysan looga hortago sii hurinta xiisadaha. Ugu dambeyn dowladda Soomaaliya waxay ay xustay in ay sii-wadi doontaa la shaqeynta iyo isku duwidda dadaallada ay la leedahay saaxiibbada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah si loo ilaaliyo nabadda iyo amniga gobolka. The post Dowladda Soomaaliya oo si kulul uga hadashay weerar lagu qaaday Sacuudiga appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Sacuudiga oo xukun dil ah ku fuliyay muwaadiniin Itoobiyaan ah
items.description: Riyaad ( Raxanreeb Online) Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa gobolka Casir ku dishay shan qof oo kale oo u dhashay Itoobiya, waxa ayna wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha ee Sacuudi Carabiya sheegtay in muwaadiniintan la dilay maalintii Axadda. Wasaaraddu waxay soo saartay bayaan ay ku qoran yihiin magacyada muwaadiniinta lagu xukumay dilka. Horaantii bishii Nofeembar, Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sidoo kale dishay laba Itoobiyaan, halka bishii Oktoobarna ay dishay afar kale. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka, muwaadiniintan waxaa la xiray iyagoo lagu eedeeyay inay daroogo ama xashiish ka tahriibinayeen xadka. Xukunnadan dilka ee ugu dambeeyay ayaa kordhiyay tirada muwaadiniinta dhowaan lagu fuliyay ama lagu xukumay dil. Wasaaraddu waxay bayaankeeda ku sheegtay in baaritaannada lagu ogaaday in Itoobiyaankaasi ay galeen falal dambiyeed. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in xukunnada dilka loo fuliyay “si looga ilaaliyo muwaadiniinta iyo dadka deggan dalka waxyeellada ay daroogadu leedahay.” Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sii wadday fulinta xukunnada dilka inkastoo bilihii la soo dhaafay ay ururrada xuquuqda aadanaha iyo hay’ado kale oo kala duwan walaac ka muujiyeen qoysaska dadka la xukumay. The post Sacuudiga oo xukun dil ah ku fuliyay muwaadiniin Itoobiyaan ah appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Mucaaradka oo iska dhaliyey gool siyaasadeed taariikhi ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Isbahaysiga mucaaradka Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe dhisayay dood siyaasadeed oo culus oo ku saabsan muddo-xileedka dowladda, khilaafka doorashada iyo baahida loo qabo heshiis qaran oo lagu gaaro hannaan doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay. Hase yeeshee, warqad furan oo uu Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed u diray dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka AUSSOM ayaa dooddaas u weecisay jiho aanay mucaaradku filayn. Warqadda ayaa lagu soo jeediyay in la sameeyo “Gole ku-meel gaar ah oo loo dhan yahay”, kaas oo maamula geeddi-socodka dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka ilaa laga soo dhisayo hay’ado qaran oo sharciyad lagu wada qanacsan yahay. Halkii soo jeedintaasi ay cadaadis ka saari lahayd Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo dowladdiisa, waxay dhalisay caro, shaki iyo kala qeybsanaan ka dhex muuqata mucaaradka laftiisa. Dood sax ah, xal khaldan Mucaaradku wuxuu haystay qodobbo uu si xooggan ugu difaaci karo mowqifkiisa. Waxaa weli taagan khilaaf ku saabsan muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, guddiga doorashada, sharciga doorashada iyo qaabka ay u dhacayaan codbixinnada soo socda. Golaha Mustaqbalka wuxuu ku adkeysanayay in isbeddelladaas aan hal dhinac lagu go’aamin karin, isla markaana loo baahan yahay heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay wada gaaraan dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo mucaaradka. Hase yeeshee, soo jeedinta Gole ku-meel gaar ah ayaa si weyn uga xoog badatay doodihii kale ee ku saabsanaa doorashada. Dad badan ayaa fahmay in mucaaradku doonayo in meesha laga saaro hay’adaha dowladda ee hadda jira, laguna beddelo gole aan la dooran, inkasta oo warqaddu aanay si cad u sheegin in la kala dirayo madaxtooyada, baarlamaanka ama xukuumadda. Erayga “ku-mee lgaar” ayaa Soomaaliya ku leh xusuus siyaasadeed oo culus. Dalka wuxuu muddo dheer ku jiray dowlado ku-meel gaar ah, shirar dibadeed iyo nidaamyo awood-qeybsi oo aan ku imaan cod dadweyne. Soomaaliya waxay si rasmi ah uga baxday marxaladdaas sanadkii 2012, markii la dhisay hay’adaha federaalka ee joogtada ah. Sidaas darteed, soo celinta fikrad magaceedu yahay “Gole Kumeelgaar ah” waxay dad badan ku abuurtay cabsi ah in dib loogu noqonayo nidaamkii dalka laga soo gudbay. Khilaafka mucaaradka Dhaliisha ugu weyn kama iman Villa Somalia, balse waxay ka timid xubno ka tirsan isbahaysiga siyaasadeed ee Golaha Mustaqbalka. Xildhibaan Maxamed Abuukar Islow, oo horay u soo noqday wasiirka amniga gudaha, iyo Thaabit Cabdi Maxamed, duqii hore ee Muqdisho, ayaa si cad uga horyimid soo jeedinta. Labadooduba waxay ka tirsan yihiin Isbaheysiga Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor, oo qeyb ka ah Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed. Islow ayaa sheegay inuu aad ula yaabay warqadda lagu dalbaday in Soomaaliya loo sameeyo Gole ku-meel gaar ah. “Waxaan aad ula yaabay qoraal la sheegay inuu kasoo baxay Golaha Mustaqbalka oo beesha caalamka looga dalbaday in Soomaaliya loo dhiso Gole Kumeelgaar ah,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in arrinta xal u baahan ay ahayd muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo in la helo qaab doorasho oo lagu heshiiyay. “Laakiin in lagu beddelo gole iyo koox is-magacawday ma ahayn mid looga fadhiyay cid dan ka leh dowladnimada,” ayuu yiri Islow. Thaabit Cabdi ayaa isna ka digay in dib loogu laabto nidaam kumeelgaar ah, isagoo sheegay in taasi ay wiiqi karto dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “Dowladnimadu ma aha wax si sahlan loo dayici karo ama dib loogu laabto ku-meel gaar,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in sameynta gole cusub oo talada dalka la wareega ay Soomaaliya dib u celin karto 15 sano, isagoo ku baaqay in xal lagu raadiyo wada-hadal lala galo madaxda muddo-xileedkooda lagu muransan yahay. Diidmada labada siyaasi waxay muujisay in soo jeedinta aan si buuxda looga tashan gudaha mucaaradka, ama aanay taageero ka haysan dhammaan dhinacyada ku jira Golaha Mustaqbalka. Taasi waxay mucaaradka gelisay xaalad adag: isbahaysi dowladda ku eedeynaya go’aanno aan loo dhammayn ayaa isaguna soo bandhigay qorshe aan xubnihiisa oo dhan ku mideysnayn. Xubno oo difaacay warqadda Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur Warsame, oo kamid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha Golaha Mustaqbalka, ayaa sheegay in ujeeddada warqaddu aysan ahayn in Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyo dowlad ku-meel gaar ah. Wuxuu BBC-da u sheegay in isbahaysigu doonayay in mustaqbalka AUSSOM lala xiriiriyo xalinta khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. “Aragtideenna waxaa shirka looga doodi doonaa mustaqbalka ciidamada AUSSOM ee muddada dheer waddankeenna joogay,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu xusay in Mareykanka uu sheegay inuusan sii wadi doonin dhaqaalaha lagu bixiyo saadka iyo taageerada ciidamada, taas oo saameyn karta joogitaanka howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada Afrika ay Soomaaliya u sameeyeen fursad ay dadkeedu uga doodaan dowlad-dhiska, balse aan dooda AUSSOM lagu koobayn karin mushaarka iyo saadka ciidamada. “Dooddeenna waxay ahayd in siyaasadda laga heshiinayo ay asal tahay,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in mucaaradku diyaar u yahay wada-hadal, isla markaana uu aqbalay mabda’a doorasho qof iyo cod ah, balse uu weli diiddan yahay guddiga doorashada ee hadda jira, sharciga doorashada iyo qaabka loo maamulayo codbixinta. Sharaxaadda Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur waxay iftiimisay ujeeddada siyaasadeed ee warqadda, balse ma aysan tirtirin dhibaatada ka dhalatay erayada iyo qaabka loo soo bandhigay. Haddii ujeeddadu ahayd in la dalbado guddi doorasho oo lagu heshiiyay, hannaan doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay iyo wada-hadal qaran, mucaaradku wuxuu si toos ah u sheegi karay qodobadaas. Bedelkeeda, wuxuu adeegsaday erayga “Gole ku-meel gaar ah”, oo markiiba qariyay dhammaan doodihii kale. Warqad loo diray cid khaldan Warqadda waxaa loo diray madaxda, wasiirrada gaashaandhigga iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada Uganda, Kenya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti, Burundi iyo Masar, kuwaas oo ciidamo ku leh ama lagu wado inay ku biiriyaan AUSSOM. Dalalkaas waxay dan weyn ka leeyihiin amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya, ciidamadooduna waxay dalka ku bixiyeen naf iyo dhaqaale. Hase yeeshee, in dalal shisheeye laga codsado inay taageeraan qaab-dhismeed siyaasadeed oo cusub, ka hor inta aan Soomaalida dhexdooda lagu heshiin, waxay abuurtay muuqaal siyaasadeed oo aad u xun. Waxay mucaaradka u ekaysiisay inuu taageero dibadeed u raadinayo qorshe aan weli ka dhaadhicin xubnihiisa iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Arrintaas ayaa sidoo kale soo noolaysay shakiyo hore oo la xiriiray saameynta dowlado shisheeye ku leeyihiin siyaasadda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xiriirka Puntland iyo Jubaland ay la leeyihiin Imaaraadka Carabta. Hase yeeshee, warqad furan oo uu Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed u diray dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka AUSSOM ayaa dooddaas u weecisay jiho aanay mucaaradku filayn. Warqadda ayaa lagu soo jeediyay in la sameeyo “Gole ku-meel gaar ah oo loo dhan yahay”, kaas oo maamula geeddi-socodka dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka ilaa laga soo dhisayo hay’ado qaran oo sharciyad lagu wada qanacsan yahay. Halkii soo jeedintaasi ay cadaadis ka saari lahayd Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo dowladdiisa, waxay dhalisay caro, shaki iyo kala qeybsanaan ka dhex muuqata mucaaradka laftiisa. Dood sax ah, xal khaldan Mucaaradku wuxuu haystay qodobbo uu si xooggan ugu difaaci karo mowqifkiisa. Waxaa weli taagan khilaaf ku saabsan muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, guddiga doorashada, sharciga doorashada iyo qaabka ay u dhacayaan codbixinnada soo socda. Golaha Mustaqbalka wuxuu ku adkeysanayay in isbeddelladaas aan hal dhinac lagu go’aamin karin, isla markaana loo baahan yahay heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay wada gaaraan dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo mucaaradka. Hase yeeshee, soo jeedinta Gole ku-meel gaar ah ayaa si weyn uga xoog badatay doodihii kale ee ku saabsanaa doorashada. Dad badan ayaa fahmay in mucaaradku doonayo in meesha laga saaro hay’adaha dowladda ee hadda jira, laguna beddelo gole aan la dooran, inkasta oo warqaddu aanay si cad u sheegin in la kala dirayo madaxtooyada, baarlamaanka ama xukuumadda. Erayga “ku-mee lgaar” ayaa Soomaaliya ku leh xusuus siyaasadeed oo culus. Dalka wuxuu muddo dheer ku jiray dowlado ku-meel gaar ah, shirar dibadeed iyo nidaamyo awood-qeybsi oo aan ku imaan cod dadweyne. Soomaaliya waxay si rasmi ah uga baxday marxaladdaas sanadkii 2012, markii la dhisay hay’adaha federaalka ee joogtada ah. Sidaas darteed, soo celinta fikrad magaceedu yahay “Gole Kumeelgaar ah” waxay dad badan ku abuurtay cabsi ah in dib loogu noqonayo nidaamkii dalka laga soo gudbay. Khilaafka mucaaradka Dhaliisha ugu weyn kama iman Villa Somalia, balse waxay ka timid xubno ka tirsan isbahaysiga siyaasadeed ee Golaha Mustaqbalka. Xildhibaan Maxamed Abuukar Islow, oo horay u soo noqday wasiirka amniga gudaha, iyo Thaabit Cabdi Maxamed, duqii hore ee Muqdisho, ayaa si cad uga horyimid soo jeedinta. Labadooduba waxay ka tirsan yihiin Isbaheysiga Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor, oo qeyb ka ah Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed. Islow ayaa sheegay inuu aad ula yaabay warqadda lagu dalbaday in Soomaaliya loo sameeyo Gole ku-meel gaar ah. “Waxaan aad ula yaabay qoraal la sheegay inuu kasoo baxay Golaha Mustaqbalka oo beesha caalamka looga dalbaday in Soomaaliya loo dhiso Gole Kumeelgaar ah,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in arrinta xal u baahan ay ahayd muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo in la helo qaab doorasho oo lagu heshiiyay. “Laakiin in lagu beddelo gole iyo koox is-magacawday ma ahayn mid looga fadhiyay cid dan ka leh dowladnimada,” ayuu yiri Islow. Thaabit Cabdi ayaa isna ka digay in dib loogu laabto nidaam kumeelgaar ah, isagoo sheegay in taasi ay wiiqi karto dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “Dowladnimadu ma aha wax si sahlan loo dayici karo ama dib loogu laabto ku-meel gaar,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in sameynta gole cusub oo talada dalka la wareega ay Soomaaliya dib u celin karto 15 sano, isagoo ku baaqay in xal lagu raadiyo wada-hadal lala galo madaxda muddo-xileedkooda lagu muransan yahay. Diidmada labada siyaasi waxay muujisay in soo jeedinta aan si buuxda looga tashan gudaha mucaaradka, ama aanay taageero ka haysan dhammaan dhinacyada ku jira Golaha Mustaqbalka. items.title: Dowladda Xasan Sheekh oo caddeysay in aysan dib uga laabaneyn…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Cali Xoosh) ayaa sheegay in siyaasiyiinta iyo mucaaradka ay xaq dastuuri ah u leeyihiin inay soo bandhigaan aragtiyahooda siyaasadeed, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in aragti kasta ay noqoto mid dhiirrigelinaysa horumarka dalka, ilaalinta dowladnimada iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in doodaha ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka ay galeen marxalad cusub, isagoo ku eedeeyay qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka inay ku guul-dareysteen inay soo bandhigaan qorshe siyaasadeed oo beddel u noqon kara nidaamka cusub ee doorashooyinka. Sida uu sheegay, halkii ay xalal cusub soo jeedin lahaayeen waxay hadda ku baaqayaan in dalka dib loogu celiyo nidaamkii hore ee doorashooyinka dadban. Cali Xoosh ayaa xusay in lix dowladood ay Soomaaliya soo mareen tan iyo dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha dowladda, kuwaas oo dhammaantood ku yimid hannaan doorasho dadban. Wuxuu sheegay in saddex ka mid ah ay ahaayeen dowlado KMG ah, halka saddexda kalena ay ahaayeen dowlado rasmi ah oo lagu soo dhisay isla nidaamkaas. Wuxuu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay haatan u gudubtay nidaamka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod, isagoo ku sifeeyay tallaabadaasi mid ka tarjumeysa rabitaanka shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee ah inay si toos ah u doortaan hoggaankooda. Isbeddelkan ayuu sheegay inuu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada lagu dhameystirayo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda iyo dowlad-dhiska dalka. Wasiir Cali Xoosh ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay siyaasiyiinta weli taageersan nidaamka doorashooyinka dadban inay kasoo horjeedaan isbeddelka horumarka siyaasadeed ee socda. Wuxuu sheegay in baaqyada lagu dalbanayo in dib loogu laabto nidaamkii hore aysan waafaqsaneyn danaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana aysan la jaanqaadeyn rajada shacabka ee ku aaddan dhismaha nidaam doorasho oo joogto ah. Isagoo ka hadlay jihada siyaasadeed ee dowladda, Cali Xoosh wuxuu sheegay in xukuumaddu ay xoogga saareyso dhammaystirka dastuurka, hirgelinta doorashooyinka qof iyo cod iyo dhismaha hay’ado dowladeed oo ku saleysan sharciyad buuxda. Wuxuu caddeeyay in dowladda aysan qorsheynayn dib ugu noqoshada nidaamyadii hore ee doorashooyinka dadban. Wasiirka ayaa intaas ku daray in mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ay go’aamin doonaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isagoo ku adkeystay in dowladda ay dooratay waddo horumarineed oo aan dib looga laaban doonin. Wuxuu sheegay in isbeddellada socda ay yihiin kuwo lagama maarmaan u ah dhismaha dowlad casri ah oo dimuqraadi ah. Hadalka Cali Xoosh ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, iyadoo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay si weyn ugu kala aragti duwan yihiin jihada geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Sidoo kale, hadalkan ayaa yimid xilli Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed uu soo jeediyay in la dhiso gole KMG ah oo loo dhan yahay, kaas oo maamula marxaladda kala-guurka, dib u soo celiya sharciyadda hay’adaha dowladda, isla markaana haga dib-u-habeynta dastuurka iyo geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka ilaa laga soo dhisayo hay’ado qaran oo sharciyaddooda si wadajir ah loo aqoonsan yahay. items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Siyaasiga Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur Warsame ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyey ujeeddada warqad furan oo Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed u diray madaxda dalalka ciidamada iyo booliska ku biiriya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, taas oo dhalisay dood iyo dhalleeceyn xooggan. Warqadda, oo ku taariikheysan 27-ka July 2026, ayaa loo diray madaxda dowladaha, wasiirrada gaashaandhigga iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada Uganda, Kenya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti, Burundi iyo Masar. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa warqadda nuqulkeeda sidoo kale gaarsiiyey guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika, dalalka Afrika ee xubnaha ka ah Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, IGAD, Mareykanka, Britain, Midowga Yurub, Turkiga iyo howlgalka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ee UNTMIS. Cinwaanka warqadda ayaa ahaa: “Heshiis siyaasadeed oo Soomaaliyeed waa inuu saldhig u noqdaa kala-guur kasta oo amni.” Warqadda ayaa dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM looga codsaday inay taageeradooda Soomaaliya ku xiraan heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu soo jeediyey dhismaha gole ku-meelgaar ah oo si wadajir ah u kormeera marxaladda dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka. “Weli ma jiro heshiis siyaasadeed oo lagu maareynayo marxaladda kala-guurka ah ee xigta,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda, iyadoo lagu dooday in Soomaaliya ay gashay marxalad siyaasadeed oo aan lahayn hannaan sharci ah oo lagu heshiiyey oo qeexaya cidda dalka maamuleysa iyo qaabka loo maamulayo. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa sheegay in guddigaasi uu ilaalin lahaa dhexdhexaadnimada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda, isla markaana xaqiijin lahaa in kala-guurka loo maareeyo qaab loo dhan yahay, daah-furan oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Soo jeedintaas ayaa dhalisay muran xooggan, gaar ahaan qodobka ku saabsan dhismaha gole ku-meelgaar ah, oo siyaasiyiin ay ku jiraan xubno ka tirsan isbahaysiyada ku mideysan Golaha Mustaqbalka ay ku tilmaameen mid Soomaaliya dib ugu celin karta ku-meelgaarnimadii laga soo gudbay. Cabdiraxmaan oo sharraxaad bixiyey Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur, oo ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha Golaha Mustaqbalka, ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in ujeeddada warqaddu aysan ahayn in la wiiqo dowladnimada Soomaaliya, balse ay tahay in xal siyaasadeed laga hormariyo doodda ku saabsan mustaqbalka AUSSOM. “Aragtideenna waxaa shirka looga doodi doonaa mustaqbalka ciidamada AUSSOM ee muddada dheer waddankeenna joogay,” ayuu yiri Cabdiraxmaan. Waxa uu sheegay in howlgalka Midowga Afrika uu wajahayo dhaqaale yari, isaga oo tilmaamay in Mareykanku muujiyey inuusan sii wadi doonin qaybo ka mid ah taageerada dhaqaale iyo saad ee ciidamada. “Maaddaama dooddan ay socoto, annaga waxaan aaminsannahay in ciidamada ay shaqo badan qabteen, ayna abuureen masaaxad ay dadka Soomaaliyeed dowlad-dhiskooda uga doodaan, uga heshiiyaan ama ay hore ugu socdaan,” ayuu yiri. Cabdiraxmaan ayaa intaas ku daray in aan doodda lagu soo koobi karin mushaarka, saadka iyo joogitaanka ciidamada AUSSOM, balse loo baahan yahay in wax laga qabto khilaafka siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya. “Dooddeenna waxay ahayd in siyaasadda laga heshiinayo ay asal tahay. Dalkan hadda wuxuu ku jiraa marxalad kala-guur ah, dowladdana sharciyaddeedu way dhammaatay. Marka keliya inaan laga hadlin ciidankaas mushaarkiisa iyo saadkiisa, ee laga hadlo arrinta asalka ah ee siyaasadda,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay in Golaha Mustaqbalka uu doonayo in heshiis siyaasadeed uu saldhig u noqdo sii socoshada taageerada caalamiga ah iyo howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Mucaaradka oo ku kala aragti duwan Hase yeeshee, warqadda ayaa muujisay kala aragti duwanaansho ka dhex jira kooxaha ku mideysan mucaaradka. Xildhibaan Maxamed Abuukar Islow, oo ka tirsan Isbahaysiga Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor, kana mid ah isbahaysiyada ku jira Golaha Mustaqbalka, ayaa sheegay inuu la yaabay qoraalka lagu dalbaday gole ku-meelgaar ah. “Haddii qoraalkaasi sax yahay, waa wax aad looga xumaado inay maanta jiraan dad mustaqbal ka leh hoggaaminta dalka oo doonaya in Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyo ku-meelgaarnimo,” ayuu yiri Islow. Waxa uu sheegay in xal loo baahan yahay laga gaaro madaxweyne muddo-xileedkiisa dhammaaday iyo hannaan doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay, balse aan hay’adaha dowladeed lagu beddeli karin gole ay soo xuleen shaqsiyaad aan sharciyad haysan. “Shaqsi ahaan waxaan qabaa inaan cidna lagu metelin taladan oo kasoo horjeedda danta, dalka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri. Guddoomiyihii hore ee gobolka Banaadir Thaabit Cabdi Maxamed, oo isna ka tirsan isla isbahaysiga, ayaa si la mid ah uga digay in dib loogu noqdo nidaam ku-meelgaar ah. “Dowladnimadu ma aha wax si sahlan loo dayici karo,” ayuu yiri Thaabit, isaga oo sheegay in wiiqidda sharciyadda hay’adaha hadda jira iyo dhismaha gole cusub ay Soomaaliya dib u celin karto 15 sano. Thaabit ayaa ku dooday in xalka ugu dhow uu yahay in lala xaajoodo madaxda muddo-xileedkooda lagu muransan yahay, labada dhinacna ay sameeyaan tanaasul siyaasadeed. “Khilaafaadka siyaasadeed waa la xallin karaa haddii la hormariyo wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, maadaama gobonnimada iyo jiritaanka dowladnimada Soomaaliya ay ka weyn yihiin khilaafka siyaasadeed ee dhexdeenna ah,” ayuu yiri. Baaq wada-hadal oo ku socda Xasan Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur ayaa dhinaciisa sheegay in mucaaradku diyaar u yahay wada-hadal iyo tanaasul, isaga oo madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ugu baaqay inuu miiska wada-xaajoodka yimaado. “Annaga tanaasulka ugu badan ayaan sameynay. Markii wada-hadalka la isugu yimid, doorashada ay dowladdu wadatay ayaan la qaadannay,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay in mucaaradku diyaar u yahay in laga wada-hadlo qodobbada dhiman, qaabka loo dhisayo guddiga doorashada iyo habka ay doorashadu u dhacayso, balse uusan aqbalin guddiga iyo sharciga ay dowladda hadda ku dhaqaaqday. Muranka warqadda ka dhashay ayaa hadda u muuqda mid aan ku koobneyn khilaafka dowladda iyo mucaaradka, balse bannaanka keenay kala duwanaansho ka dhex jira Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo isbahaysiyada xubnaha ka ah, gaar ahaan su’aasha ah in xal siyaasadeed lagu raadiyo gole ku-meelgaar ah ama wada-hadal lala galo madaxda hadda talada haysa. Warqadda ayaa sidoo kale dhalisay mucaarado xooggan oo mucaaradka uga timid shacabka, oo lama filaan ay ku noqotay in dad doonaya in ay dalka maamulaan ay hadda dalbanayaan in dib loogu noqdo marxalad ku-meel gaar ah. items.title: Sideen ku Heli Karnaa Bulsho ku wada Nool Caddaalad iyo Sinnaan?
items.description: Habnololeedka bulshada Soomaaliyeed wuxuu aalaaba ku tiirsanyahay hanaan ismaamul iyo xeerar ay degsadeen oo iyaga u gaar ah. Sidoo kale, waxa ay leeyihiin dastuur iyo sharci ku qotama habnololeedkooda maalinlaha. Waxaa jira xeerar ay bulshadu ka soo minguurisay dhaqanka iyo hiddaha soojireenka ah, kuwaas oo ay ku dhaqmayeen sannado badan, laga soo bilaabo markii ay ahaayeen reermiyi dabeecadda noloshu ui taliso ilaa hadda oo ay yihiin reermagaal ilbax ah. Weli way haystaan, kamana aysan tegin. Marka shuruucda dalka laga soo tago, marjica ugu danbeeya ee ay u laabtaan waa xeerdhaqameedkooda. Hannaankaas bulsheed ee ab-ka-soogaarka ah waxaa garsoorayaal ka ah odaydhaqameedyo, guurti iyo xeerbeegti goobjoog u ahaa dhacdooyin tiro badan oo ay xalkooda qeyb ka ahaayeen. Ma jirin maxkamad dhisan oo ay khilaafaadka iyo dhibaatooyinka la soo gudboonaada kula ciiraan, laakiin waxa ay hoos fariisan jireen geedaha waaweyn ee harka fiican leh, sida geedka gobka, quraca, galoolka iyo kuwa kale. Taariikh ahaan, marka aan ka hadlayno caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta ka dhex jirtay bulshada Soomaaliyeed, sida aynu hore u soo sheegnayba, waxa ay ku dhisnayd wax lagu magacaabo Xeer Soomaali. Ma ahayn mid qoran, waxa uu ahaa wax la isku wada raacay oo laga wada heshiiyay. Dhacdooyinka inta badan dhici jirayna waxa ay ahaayeen kuwo la wada yaqaan, ciqaabta ka dhalan kartana waxa ay ahayd mid shaacsan. Way jireen dhacdooyin cusub oo aan hore u dhici jirin, sidaas oo ay tahayna waa la xalin jiray. Garta waxaa loo kala qaadi jiray labo: gar cadaawe iyo gar colaadeed. Waxyaabaha la isku qabsan jirayna waxaa ka mid ahaa saddex: dhiig, dhaqan iyo qabno. Haddii ay dadku midkood isku qabsadaan, waxa ay isu soo geed fariisan jireen. Waxyaabaha qofku garta ku qaadan karo way caddaayeen, inta uu ku waayi karana sidoo kale way caddayd. Qofka denbiga laga galay, haddii uusan hadalka ku fiicnayn oo uusan ahayn codkar cadkiisa goosan og, waxa uu wakiilan jiray aftahan hadalka kala dhigdhigi yaqaan. Marka geedka laga kacayo oo boorka la iska jafayo, waxaa lagu kala tagi jiray gartii oo qof qaatay iyo isa saamaxaad aan dabadeed hadal jirin. Sidaas ayuu qofku ku heli jiray caddaalad uu ku qanco. Qofka denbiilaha ahina waxa uu tagi jiray isaga oo looga gar helay ama qirsan denbiga uu qofkaas ka galay. Xeerdhaqameedka Soomaalidu waxa uu caan ka ahaa guud geyiga Soomaaliyeed, meel kastana waa looga dhaqmi jiray. Ka dib markii ay dadkeennu noqdeen dad reermagaal ah oo la jaanqaada dunida horumartay, waxaa isbeddel ku yimid sidii garta loo qaadi jiray iyo denbiyadii ay dadku isu geysan jireen. Kolkii hore, markii dadku reermiyi wada ahaa, waxa ay isku qabsan jireen dhaqanka, dhulka daaqsinta ah, ceelasha, carshinta, xoolaha iyo wixii dhiig quseeya. Hadda waxa ay intaas isu beddeshay in dadku isku qabsadaan lacago la kala dhacay ama bangiyo la iska jabsaday. Waxaa kaloo la isku qabsadaa guryo ama dhismayaal la isku haysto, waxaana dhaca in gabdhaha si foolxun loogu xadgudbo, halka markii hore dumarka aad loo qaddarin jiray. Intaas iyo in ka badan ayaa hadda la isku qabsadaa. Goobtii garta lagu goyn jiray ee geedka hoostiisa ahayd waxaa beddelay dhismayaal casri ah oo maxkamado ah ama hoteello iyo meelo kale oo la mid ah. Waagii hore, marka ay gartu dhammaato oo fadhigaas go’aan lagu gaaro, ma jirin wax hadal ah oo ka danbayn jiray. Hadba ixii markaas la isugu afgarto ayaa fulintooda lagu dhaqaaqi jiray. Laakiin, hadda waxaa dhaca dhacdooyin waaweyn oo qaarkood laga yaabo in aanay hore u dhicin, ka dibna waa laga gaabsadaa, iyada oo maxkamaddu go’aan ka soo saartay qofka denbiga galay. Waxaa aad u yar kalsoonida lagu qabo caddaaladda ka jirta guud ahaan dalka. In badan ayaynu aragnaa dhacdooyin waaweyn oo dadka oo dhammi u wada arkaan in ay yihiin xaalado adag oo u baahan in wax laga qabto, haddana laga tago iyada oo aan wax laga qaban. Maalmo gaaban ayaa la buunbuuniyaa, ka dibna waa la iska tagaa. Waxaa caqabad weyn ku ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed in ay hesho caddaalad loo wada dhanyahay oo ay maxkamadaha iyo garsooreyaashu madax bannaan yihiin. Waxaa jira sharci iyo dastuur loo sameeyay in dadka lagu kala saaro oo lagu kala siiyo xuquuqdooda iyo waajibaadkooda. Laakiin waxaa maqan in maxkamadaha iyo hay’adaha caddaaladdu ay u madax bannaanaadaan shuruucda iyo tallaabooyinka ay qaadayaan. Waxaa inta badan soo farageliya dawladda iyo nidaamkeeda, oo sida ay rabaan ayay wax uga dhigaan. Bulshada Soomaaliyeed, iyaga oo markii horaba aan haysan caddaalad dhammaystiran, haddana waxaa dhibaato kale ku sii noqday in ay dhexdooda iskala saaraan oo ay kala yihiin qabiillo kala sarreeya. Qabiillada qaar ayaa la takooraa, laga soo bilaabo nidaamka ay dawladdu ku dhisantahay ee 4.5, oo macnihiisu yahay in ay jiraan qabiillo aan dhammaystirnayn oo aan hal gaarin. Sidaas awgeed, qabiilladaas waxa ay la kulmaan caddaalad darro dhinacyo badan leh, haddii ay noqon lahayd dhinaca waxbarashada, helidda shaqooyinka iyo guud ahaan ka qaybgalka arrimaha siyaasadeed. Sida ay diinteenna na fartay, caddaaladdu waa udubdhexaadka nolosheenna. Eebbe iyo Rasuulkiisa SCW waxa ay na fareen in aan adkayno caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta . Ma jiro qof ka sarreeya qof kale, Eebbana ummaddiisa oo dhan way u simanyihiin, laakiin waxa ay ugu kala dhowyihiin sida ay ugu kala cibaado iyo taqwo badanyihiin. Soomaalidii hore waxaa halkudheg u ahaa, marka ay geedka hoos fadhiyaan oo ay laba qof u kala garqaadayaan, in ay yiraahdaan: “Gari Allay taqaan.” Oraahdaas oo ahayd mid muujinaysa in Alle-Weyne ma ahane aan cid kale looga waabanin sheegidda xaqa iyo ka-hortagidda dulmiga. Bulsho kastaa waxa ay caddaalad iyo sinnaan ku heli kartaa in garsoorkeedu madaxbannaan yahay, sharciguna ka sarreeyo wax kasta oo kale. Sidoo kale, waxa ay leeyihiin dastuur iyo sharci ku qotama habnololeedkooda maalinlaha. Waxaa jira xeerar ay bulshadu ka soo minguurisay dhaqanka iyo hiddaha soojireenka ah, kuwaas oo ay ku dhaqmayeen sannado badan, laga soo bilaabo markii ay ahaayeen reermiyi dabeecadda noloshu ui taliso ilaa hadda oo ay yihiin reermagaal ilbax ah. Weli way haystaan, kamana aysan tegin. Marka shuruucda dalka laga soo tago, marjica ugu danbeeya ee ay u laabtaan waa xeerdhaqameedkooda. Hannaankaas bulsheed ee ab-ka-soogaarka ah waxaa garsoorayaal ka ah odaydhaqameedyo, guurti iyo xeerbeegti goobjoog u ahaa dhacdooyin tiro badan oo ay xalkooda qeyb ka ahaayeen. Ma jirin maxkamad dhisan oo ay khilaafaadka iyo dhibaatooyinka la soo gudboonaada kula ciiraan, laakiin waxa ay hoos fariisan jireen geedaha waaweyn ee harka fiican leh, sida geedka gobka, quraca, galoolka iyo kuwa kale. Ma ahayn mid qoran, waxa uu ahaa wax la isku wada raacay oo laga wada heshiiyay. Dhacdooyinka inta badan dhici jirayna waxa ay ahaayeen kuwo la wada yaqaan, ciqaabta ka dhalan kartana waxa ay ahayd mid shaacsan. Way jireen dhacdooyin cusub oo aan hore u dhici jirin, sidaas oo ay tahayna waa la xalin jiray. Garta waxaa loo kala qaadi jiray labo: gar cadaawe iyo gar colaadeed. Waxyaabaha la isku qabsan jirayna waxaa ka mid ahaa saddex: dhiig, dhaqan iyo qabno. Haddii ay dadku midkood isku qabsadaan, waxa ay isu soo geed fariisan jireen. Waxyaabaha qofku garta ku qaadan karo way caddaayeen, inta uu ku waayi karana sidoo kale way caddayd. Qofka denbiga laga galay, haddii uusan hadalka ku fiicnayn oo uusan ahayn codkar cadkiisa goosan og, waxa uu wakiilan jiray aftahan hadalka kala dhigdhigi yaqaan. items.title: Trump oo diiday cadaadiska Israa’iil kadib ballan-tii uu ka qaaday saaxiibkiis Erdogan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa si cad u diiday diidmada Israel ee ku aaddan in Washington ay diyaaradaha casriga ah ee F-35 ka iibiso Turkiga, isaga oo Ankara ku tilmaamay xulafo weyn oo aan dal kale looga amar qaadan doonin xiriirka difaaca. Trump ayaa hadalkan Isniintii ka sheegay diyaaradda madaxweynaha ee Air Force One, xilli uu Washington uga sii jeeday gobolka Michigan, waxaana la weydiiyey walaaca uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ka muujiyey suurta-galnimada in Turkiga dib loogu celiyo barnaamijka F-35. “Turkigu wuxuu ahaa xulafo weyn,” ayuu Trump yiri. “Cidina iima sheegayso waxa ay tahay inaan iibinno ama aynaan iibin.” Hadallada Trump ayaa yimid maalin ka hor kulanka la filayo inuu Aqalka Cad kula yeesho Netanyahu, kaas oo la filayo inay labada hoggaamiye uga wada hadlaan Iran, Gaza, xiriirka Israel iyo Turkiga iyo arrimo kale oo amniga Bariga Dhexe ah. Trump ayaa sidoo kale mar kale ammaanay madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, isaga oo ku tilmaamay saaxiib iyo hoggaamiye si wanaagsan u maareeyey xaaladda dalka Syria. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa qiray in Ankara iyo Tel Aviv ay ka dhexeeyaan khilaafaad siyaasadeed oo muddo dheer soo jiitamayey, balse wuxuu sheegay in arrimahaas aysan meesha ka saarayn muhiimadda Turkiga u leeyahay Mareykanka iyo isbahaysiga NATO. Wuxuu Turkiga ku tilmaamay dal awood leh oo leh ciidan ballaaran, qalabeysan, kana mid ah ciidamada ugu xooggan gobolka. Netanyahu oo ka digay heshiiska Netanyahu ayaa horraantii bishan si fagaare ah uga digay in Turkiga la siiyo diyaaradaha F-35 ama matoorro Mareykan ah oo loo adeegsan karo diyaaradda dagaalka ee KAAN. Ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel ayaa ku dooday in heshiis noocaas ahi uu wax ka beddeli karo dheelitirka awoodda militari ee Bariga Dhexe, isla markaana uu dhaawici karo awoodda sare ee ciidamada cirka Israel. Warbaahinta Axios ayaa markii dambe sheegtay in hadallada Netanyahu ay ka careysiiyeen Trump. Saraakiil ka tirsan Aqalka Cad ayaa lagu soo warramay inay sheegeen in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu rumeysnaa in Netanyahu uusan xaq u lahayn inuu farageliyo go’aannada Washington ee la xiriira cidda ay hubka ka iibinayso. Trump ayaa hadda si fagaare ah u xaqiijiyey mowqifkaas, isaga oo adkeeyey in dowladda Mareykanka ay kaligeed go’aamin doonto siyaasaddeeda dhoofinta hubka. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa khilaaf cusub oo ka dhex curtay Trump iyo Netanyahu, inkasta oo labada dhinac ay xiriir dhow ka leeyihiin dagaallada iyo arrimaha amniga gobolka. Turkiga iyo barnaamijka F-35 Turkiga waxaa barnaamijka caalamiga ah ee F-35 laga saaray sanadkii 2019, kaddib markii uu Ruushka ka iibsaday nidaamka difaaca cirka ee S-400. Mareykanka ayaa ku dooday in nidaamka Ruushka uu halis gelin karo xogta farsamo iyo awoodaha qarsoon ee diyaaradaha F-35, haddii labada nidaam lagu wada isticmaalo hal dal. Washington ayaa sidoo kale Turkiga ku soo rogtay cunaqabateyn waafaqsan sharciga CAATSA, inkasta oo Ankara ay ka mid ahayd dalalkii maalgeliyey, qeybaha soo saarayey, isla markaana diyaaradaha ka dalbaday barnaamijka F-35. Wasaaradda Difaaca Mareykanka ayaa waqtigaas sheegtay in F-35 iyo S-400 aysan farsamo ahaan is waafaqi karin, taas oo sababtay in shaqaalaha iyo shirkadaha Turkiga laga saaro barnaamijka. Erdoğan ayaa marar badan go’aankaas ku tilmaamay mid aan caddaalad ahayn, wuxuuna ku dooday in dib loogu soo celiyo Turkiga barnaamijka ay xoojin lahayd awoodda guud ee NATO. Trump ayaa shirkii NATO ee Ankara horraantii bishan sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu qaado cunaqabateynta saaran Turkiga, isla markaana uu tixgelinayo in Ankara loo oggolaado inay iibsato diyaaradaha F-35. Hase yeeshee, heshiis rasmi ah weli lama gaarin, waxaana caqabadda ugu weyn sii ahaanaya nidaamka S-400 ee Turkiga yaalla. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Ankara aysan weli buuxin shuruudaha looga baahan yahay dal doonaya inuu helo diyaaradaha F-35. Warar soo baxay ayaa tilmaamayey in labada dhinac ay ka wada hadlayaan xalal ay ka mid yihiin in nidaamka S-400 loo wareejiyo dal saddexaad, laakiin qorshahaas weli heshiis kama dambeys ah lagama gaarin. Ankara oo xoojisay warshadaha difaaca Turkiga, oo leh ciidamada labaad ee ugu tirada badan NATO, ayaa sannadihii lasoo dhaafay wajahayey xayiraado hub oo ay kusoo rogeen qaar ka mid ah xulafadiisa reer Galbeedka. Ankara ayaa arrintaas uga jawaabtay inay si weyn u ballaariso warshadaha gudaha ee difaaca, iyadoo hadda soo saarta diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaallada, gaadiidka gaashaaman, maraakiibta dagaalka iyo nidaamyo kale oo militari. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale horumarinaya diyaaraddiisa dagaalka ee jiilka shanaad ee KAAN, taas oo duullimaadkeedii ugu horreeyey sameysay bishii February 2024. Shirkadda Turkish Aerospace ayaa sheegtay in diyaaradda loogu talagalay howlgallada cirka iyo weerarrada bartilmaameedyada dhulka. Si kastaba, helitaanka F-35 ayaa Turkiga siin lahaa awood militari oo degdeg ah, halka Israel ay ka cabsi qabto in arrintaasi ay meesha ka saarto kalinimada ay gobolka ku leedahay adeegsiga diyaaradaha dagaalka ee noocaas ah. Hadallada cusub ee Trump waxay muujinayaan in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu diyaar u yahay inuu xiriirka difaaca ee Ankara dib u soo nooleeyo, xitaa haddii tallaabadaas ay ka hor yimaadaan Israel iyo qaar ka mid ah xubnaha siyaasadda Mareykanka. Trump ayaa saaxiib aad u dhow la ah madaxweyne Erdogan, isaga oo marar badan ka ammaanay fagaare, si xitaa ka duwan xubnaha xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee sida aad u dhalleeceeya madaxweynaha Turkiga. items.description: Dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa ka digtay in kooxda Xuutiyiintu ay doonayso inay ku dayato istaraatiijiyadda Iiraan ee marin-biyoodka Hormuz, iyagoo isku dayaya inay gacanta ku dhigaan marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandeb, oo isku xira Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee dowladda Yemen, Afrah al-Zouba, oo warbaahinta kula hadashay safaaradda Yemen ee magaalada Riyadh, ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay doonayaan inay xakameeyaan isu socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah, taasoo halis gelin karta laba ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga adduunka. Al-Zouba ayaa sheegtay in jawaabta caalamka ee uu ku tilmaamay mid aan ku filnayn ay dhiirrigelisay Xuutiyiinta, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay sii kordhiyeen weerarrada ay ku beegsanayaan maraakiibta iyo dalalka gobolka. Marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandeb ayaa ah marin istaraatiiji ah oo ay maraan boqolkiiba 30 gaadiidka konteenarrada caalamka iyo inta u dhexeysa 12 ilaa 15 boqolkiiba guud ahaan ganacsiga adduunka. Dowladda Yemen ayaa ka digtay in haddii marin-biyoodkan la carqaladeeyo ay saameyn weyn ku yeelan karto dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo isu socodka badeecadaha. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii Xuutiyiintu bishan ku dhawaaqeen go’doomin dhinaca badda ah oo ka dhan ah maraakiibta la xiriira Sacuudiga, iyagoo sidoo kale qaaday weerarro loo adeegsaday gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Dowladda Sacuudiga ayaa dhankeeda ku jawaabtay duqeymo cirka ah oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday magaalada dekedda leh ee Xudeyda, oo ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu. Dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay haddii dagaalku sii ballaarto, iyadoo xustay in dagaallo goos-goos ah ay weli ka socdaan jiidaha hore ee u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo Xuutiyiinta, inkastoo aan weli la bilaabin guluf militari oo ballaaran. Dagaalka Yemen oo billowday sanadkii 2014 markii Xuutiyiintu qabsadeen caasimadda Sanca ayaa sababay mid ka mid ah masiibooyinka bani’aadantinimo ee ugu waaweyn dunida. Inkastoo xabbad-joojin la gaaray sanadkii 2022, haddana Xuutiyiintu weli waxay gacanta ku hayaan caasimadda iyo deegaanno badan oo dalka ka tirsan, halka xiisadaha cusub ee gobolka ay sare u qaadeen cabsida laga qabo in colaaddu mar kale si buuxda u qaraxdo.

items.title: Opposition Leader Accuses President Hassan Sheikh of Expanding State Asset Sales Abroad
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) – Senior Somali opposition leader Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame has accused President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of extending what he described as the sale of national assets beyond Somalia’s borders, escalating his criticism of the Federal Government amid the country’s deepening constitutional and political crisis. Abdirahman, who heads the Wadajir Party and is a leading figure in the opposition Future Council, alleged that after exhausting public assets inside Somalia, the President has now turned his attention to Somali-owned properties abroad. “After the auctioning of public land inside the country was no longer enough, Hassan Sheikh has now moved on to Somali national assets located overseas,” Abdirahman said. The opposition politician did not identify the specific overseas assets he was referring to, but his remarks add to a growing exchange of accusations between the Federal Government and opposition leaders over the management of public resources. Abdirahman went further, warning that unless the President is restrained, the government could eventually seek to dispose of even more strategically significant national assets. “If this is not stopped in time, he may ultimately move to sell the country’s islands,” he claimed. He stressed that Somalia’s public assets belong to the nation as a whole and should never be treated as the property of any individual administration. “National assets are not the property of any individual or any government to misuse. They are the inheritance of the Somali people and future generations. It is a national duty to protect them, manage them transparently, and hold accountable anyone who abuses or misappropriates them,” Abdirahman said. His comments come at a time of heightened political tensions, with Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition groups locked in disputes over constitutional legitimacy, electoral arrangements, and the management of state institutions. The Federal Government has not publicly responded to Abdirahman’s latest allegations. As of publication, no official evidence has been presented publicly to substantiate the opposition leader’s claims regarding the sale or planned disposal of Somali state assets overseas. The accusations nevertheless underscore the widening political divide between President Hassan Sheikh’s administration and the opposition, as both sides continue to clash over issues of governance, accountability, and the stewardship of Somalia’s national resources. items.title: Fahiima Yusuf Quunje waa hooyo Somalilander ah
items.description: Fahima Yusuf Quunje waa gabadh reer Somaliland ah oo ilmaheeduna yahay reer Hargeisa kana soo jeeda mid ka mid ah beelaha dega Hargeisa, Sanaag,Togdheer,Sool iyo Saaxil meel kalana kuma noolaanayaan oo aan Hargeisa ahayn dalka dawlad iyo sharci ayuu leeyahay. Dadku waa is wada yahay hoos ha la isu eego, caasimadda waxa u siman dhamaan gobolada dalka oo dhan, ta kale dhibkii ama dagaalkii ka dhacay Sool ma jirto cid uu si gaar ah ugu dhacay labada dhanba dhibi gaadhay waxa loo baahanyahay is cafis iyo wada noolaansho. Waxa amaan leh dadka reer Hargeisa ee ka soo jeeda xaafad walba ee heeganka ugu jira dadka ka soo.laabanaaya Sool bari. Somaliland bari iyo galbeed waa dad walaalo ah oo Ilahay meel wada dhigay   Somaliland guul   Xuseen Xasan Saalax Hargeisa

items.title: Why the US Should Encourage Ethiopian Recognition of Somaliland
items.description: The Berbera Port in Somaliland, located on the Gulf of Aden, on August 21, 2024. Ethiopian recognition of Somaliland may ease tensions in the Horn of Africa. (Shutterstock/Abdulkadir Hirabe) Topic: Diplomacy Region: Africa , and Middle East Tags: Abiy Ahmed , East Africa , Egypt , Ethiopia , Horn of Africa , Red Sea , Somalia , Somaliland , Tigray , Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) , and Turkey Why the US Should Encourage Ethiopian Recognition of Somaliland By: Merit Habib Matta Revisiting a recognition agreement could limit bloodshed in the Horn of Africa—but Washington must first facilitate diplomacy. The Horn of Africa risks a new war amid an intense power struggle between the Ethiopian federal government and the separatist Tigray People’s Liberation Front ( TPLF ) in the Tigray Region. As Ethiopia renews its push for Red Sea access, clashes with the TPLF risk expanding into a broader confrontation with Eritrea . Further conflict in the Horn of Africa would be a strategic disaster for the West, cementing the influence of regional powers in an already sensitive maritime corridor. Revisiting Ethiopian recognition of Somaliland could address Ethiopia’s Red Sea insecurity and reduce the spread of violence. Decisive action is needed from Washington, however, to encourage this dormant solution in the face of local opposition. Unrest in Tigray has intensified as the federal government and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front compete to secure control of the region. Tigray, Ethiopia’s northernmost state bordering Eritrea , was the epicenter of a brutal war between 2020 and 2022: the 2022 Pretoria Agreement aimed to end the conflict, yet disagreements over power-sharing persisted. SCROLL TO CONTINUE READING By May 2026, the TPLF reinstated the pre-war Tigray regional council —a move that deepened the rift with the central government under Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed . Recent reports have emerged of forced civilian recruitment by the TPLF-aligned Tigray Defense Force, as fears of renewed fighting rise. This ongoing crisis has provoked renewed hostilities between Ethiopia and Eritrea. Despite a brief alliance against the TPLF in the Tigray War, relations are once again strained. Addis Ababa has accused Asmara of backing the TPLF , a cooperation that is indeed likely to materialize should civil war break out. Underpinning accusations of collusion lies a deeper source of tension—the Red Sea. The secession of Eritrea in 1993 left Ethiopia landlocked, a loss that continues to sour Ethiopia’s politics, both domestically and diplomatically. Abiy Ahmed’s increasingly urgent calls for access to the coastline have fueled Eritrea’s fears that the Port of Assab could become a target of Ethiopia’s maritime ambitions, causing further friction. Revived fighting in the region not only risks large-scale humanitarian crises, but further threatens counterterrorism efforts against groups such as Al-Shabaab , consequences that the West cannot afford. While conditions for conflict are ever-present, and maritime security perceived as existential, war is not inevitable. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991, yet has only been formally recognized by one UN member state— Israel . The country has operated as a de facto state for over three decades, with its own currency, airport and democratic institutions. Signed on January 1, 2024, a memorandum of understanding reportedly envisaged granting Ethiopia access to around 20 kilometers (12 miles) of Somaliland coast in exchange for formal recognition. Although bilateral ties between Ethiopia and Somaliland remain warm, no meaningful steps have been taken to implement the MoU’s proposals. Following strong opposition from Somalia, the Turkish-brokered Ankara Declaration effectively sidelined Ethiopian recognition of Somaliland. Currently, Ethiopia relies on Djibouti for around 95 percent of its import and export traffic, an expensive dependence. While the MoU promised Ethiopia access to Somaliland coast for a naval base, strengthened relations could also expand Ethiopia’s commercial access to Somaliland’s Port of Berbera. Development of the Berbera Corridor has made this an attractive alternative to reliance on Djibouti. Washington should quietly encourage Ethiopian recognition of Somaliland. The UAE, the UK, and Ethiopia all hold stakes in the Port of Berbera; Somaliland serves as a promising partner for the West, particularly as China’s strong presence in Djibouti may expand into Ethiopia. In fostering dialogue between Ethiopia and Somaliland, the United States would be making an early investment in relations with Somaliland. This move could see long-term economic and strategic gains. Targeted US diplomacy is necessary to secure both Washington’s strategic influence in the region and demonstrate initiative in maintaining regional stability

items.title: Mucaaradka DF oo isku khilaafay dalabkii gole KMG ah iyo Islow oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa isku khilaafay warqaddii furneyd ee maanta Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed u diray dalalka ay ciidamadoodu qeybta ka yihiin howl-galka AUSSOM iyo taageerayaasha caalamiga. Warqaddaas ayaa waxaa durba si adag uga horyimid qaar ka mid ah garabyada mucaaradka, iyadoo Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga, Xildhibaan Maxamed Abuukar Islow uu si adag uga horyimid dalabkii ku qornaa warqaddaas. Warqadda ayaa dalalka ay ciidamadoodu qeybta ka yihiin howl-galka AUSSOM loogu soo jeediyay in loo baahan yahay dhismaha gole KMG ah, si loo badbaadiyo sharciyadda iyo kalsoonida. Golaha ayaa dalalka Afrikaanka ah ee ciidamada ku taageera howl-galka AUSSOM ka codsaday inay sii wadaan taageeradooda inta laga helayo xal siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro khilaafka ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Sidoo kale, waxay madaxda dalalka ay ciidamadu ka joogaan Soomaaliya ka codsadeen inay taageeraan dadaal kasta oo horseedaya heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, iyagoo sheegay in heshiiskaas uu yahay shuruudda ugu muhiimsan ee guusha howlgal kasta oo amni iyo xasilin ah oo ka socda gudaha Soomaaliya. Diidmada Islow Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga oo ka tirsan Haybad Qaran ayaa sheegay inuu aad ula yaabay in Golaha Mustaqbalka uu kasoo baxo dalab la xiriira dhismaha gole KMG ah, isagoo sheegay in arrintaasi ay god ku rideyso dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “Waxaan aad ula yaabay qoraal la sheegay inuu kasoo baxay Golaha Mustaqbalka oo Beesha caalamka looga dalbaday in Soomaaliya loo dhiso Gole Kumeelgaar ah,” ayuu yiri Islow oo kamid ah garabka mucaaradka ee Haybad Qaran. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray “Haddii qoraalkaasi sax yahay, waa wax aad looga xumaado inay maanta jiraan dad mustaqbal ka leh hoggaaminta dalka oo doonaya in Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyo Kumeelgaarnimo.” Sidoo kale waxa uu lama filaan ku tilmaamay in lasoo jeedio talo ah in hay’ado sharci ah oo xilligoodii dhammaaday lagu bedelo Gole ka kooban shaqsiyaad aan wax sharciyad ah lahayn. “Shaqsi ahaan waxaan qabaa inaan cidna lagu metelin taladaan oo kasoo horjeeda Danta, Dalka iyo Dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri xildhibaan Islow. Wasiirkii hore ee amniga ayaa caddeeyay in arrinta xalka u baahan ay tahay “Madaxweyne muddo xilleedkiisa dhammaaday iyo qaab doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay,” balse aysan aheyn in lagu bedelo Gole iyo koox is magacawday, taas oo uu xusay in aysan ahayn mid looga fadhiyey cid dan ka leh dowladnimada. Sidoo kale, waxay madaxda dalalka ay ciidamadu ka joogaan Soomaaliya ka codsadeen inay taageeraan dadaal kasta oo horseedaya heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, iyagoo sheegay in heshiiskaas uu yahay shuruudda ugu muhiimsan ee guusha howlgal kasta oo amni iyo xasilin ah oo ka socda gudaha Soomaaliya. Diidmada Islow Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga oo ka tirsan Haybad Qaran ayaa sheegay inuu aad ula yaabay in Golaha Mustaqbalka uu kasoo baxo dalab la xiriira dhismaha gole KMG ah, isagoo sheegay in arrintaasi ay god ku rideyso dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “Waxaan aad ula yaabay qoraal la sheegay inuu kasoo baxay Golaha Mustaqbalka oo Beesha caalamka looga dalbaday in Soomaaliya loo dhiso Gole Kumeelgaar ah,” ayuu yiri Islow oo kamid ah garabka mucaaradka ee Haybad Qaran. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray “Haddii qoraalkaasi sax yahay, waa wax aad looga xumaado inay maanta jiraan dad mustaqbal ka leh hoggaaminta dalka oo doonaya in Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyo Kumeelgaarnimo.” Sidoo kale waxa uu lama filaan ku tilmaamay in lasoo jeedio talo ah in hay’ado sharci ah oo xilligoodii dhammaaday lagu bedelo Gole ka kooban shaqsiyaad aan wax sharciyad ah lahayn. “Shaqsi ahaan waxaan qabaa inaan cidna lagu metelin taladaan oo kasoo horjeeda Danta, Dalka iyo Dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri xildhibaan Islow. Wasiirkii hore ee amniga ayaa caddeeyay in arrinta xalka u baahan ay tahay “Madaxweyne muddo xilleedkiisa dhammaaday iyo qaab doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay,” balse aysan aheyn in lagu bedelo Gole iyo koox is magacawday, taas oo uu xusay in aysan ahayn mid looga fadhiyey cid dan ka leh dowladnimada. items.title: TRUMP oo shaaciyay amar culus uu bixinayo haddii Iiraan…
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in maamulkiisu uu Iiraan kula jiro wada-hadallo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo “aad u qoto dheer,” balse wuxuu uga digay Tehran in haddii dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ay fashilmaan, uu amri doono hawl-gallo militari oo “aad u xooggan.” Trump ayaa sheegay in haatan uu hakiyay weerarradii ka dhanka ahaa Iiraan kadib codsi uga yimid dalal dhex-dhexaadin ka wada xiisadda labada dal. Go’aankan ayuu ku tilmaamay mid fursad dheeraad ah lagu siinayo wada-hadallada. “Waxaan Iiraan kula jirnaa wada-hadallo aad u qoto dheer. Haddii ay miro dhalin waayaan, waxaan dib u billaabi doonnaa hawlgallo militari oo aad u culus,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Trump, isaga oo muujiyay in Washington aysan ka tanaasuli doonin cadaadiska saaran Tehran haddii xal diblomaasiyadeed la waayo. Markii la weydiiyay muddada uu diyaar u yahay inuu siiyo wada-hadallada socda, Trump ayaa sheegay in uusan qorsheynayn inay muddo dheer socdaan. “Ma aha waqti badan. Ama si degdeg ah ayaa lagu dhammeeya ama gebi ahaanba lama dhammeeyo,” ayuu yiri, isagoo tilmaamay in maamulka Mareykanka uu wada-hadallada ka doonayo natiijo degdeg ah. Hadalka Trump ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo xiisadda u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ay mareyso meel sare, inkastoo ay jiraan dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay wadaan dalal kala duwan oo doonaya inay labada dhinac ku qanciyaan inay ka fogaadaan iska horimaad militari oo cusub. Si kastaba, dowladda Iiraan ayaa si cad u beenisay jiritaanka wada-hadallada uu Trump sheegay. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan ayaa maanta sheegay inaysan jirin wax wada-hadallo ah oo u socda Tehran iyo Washington, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in Iiraan aysan aqbali doonin in Mareykanku go’aamiyo waqtiga dagaalka ama nabadda. Hadalladan is-khilaafsan ee ka soo kala baxay Washington iyo Tehran ayaa muujinaya kala fogaanshaha labada dhinac, xilli caalamka uu si dhow ula socdo mustaqbalka xiisadda iyo suurtagalnimada in diblomaasiyaddu ay ka hortagto isku dhac cusub oo ka dhaca Bariga Dhexe. items.title: Dowladda Shiinaha oo deeq waxbarasho u qaaday hawl-wadeenno ka tirsan Wasaaradda Kalluumeysiga Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, 27 Luulyo 2026 – Koox hawl-wadeenno ah oo ka tirsan Wasaaradda Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ka ambabaxay magaalada Muqdisho, iyagoo u safraya dalka Shiinaha si ay uga faa’iideystaan deeq waxbarasho oo heer sare ah. Barnaamijkan ayaa qeyb ka ah iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha ee dhinacyada horumarinta aqoonta, tababarrada farsamada iyo kobcinta awoodda shaqaalaha dowladda, gaar ahaan kuwa ka shaqeeya kalluumeysiga iyo dhaqaalaha badda. Mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda ayaa sheegay in tababarkan uu sare u qaadi doono xirfadaha iyo aqoonta hawl-wadeennada, si ay door muuqda uga qaataan horumarinta maamulka kheyraadka badda, ilaalinta kalluumeysiga iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ee Soomaaliya. Shiinaha ayaa ka mid ah dalalka taageera Soomaaliya dhinacyada tababarrada, waxbarashada iyo dhismaha awoodda hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo deeqahan ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada dal.
