items.title: President Hassan Sheikh: Do Not Let Somalia’s Statehood Collapse on Your Watch
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor The greatest asset Somalia possesses today is neither its land nor its natural resources. It is the Federal Government painstakingly rebuilt through more than two decades of sacrifice—from the Arta Peace Conference in 2000 to the peaceful transfer of power on 15 May 2022, when the presidency was entrusted to you – Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. That government embodied the hopes of millions of Somalis who believed the country was finally on the path toward a stable, accountable, and democratic state. Today, however, many believe that promise is slipping away. The institutions painstakingly rebuilt over two decades have gradually been transformed into a family enterprise, with power concentrated within a narrow political circle rather than exercised through strong, independent state institutions. Among the opposition’s most serious allegations are claims that large areas of public land in Mogadishu have been sold without transparent accounting of the proceeds, while hundreds of thousands of vulnerable residents—estimated by critics at more than 750,000—have been displaced by controversial land policies. Opposition figures also allege that Somali state-owned properties abroad, including embassy compounds in Europe and Africa, have been disposed of without public disclosure of how the proceeds were managed. These allegations remain fiercely thought and continue to fuel political controversy. Critics also contend that the national army inherited from former President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed (Farmaajo) has been committed to military campaigns that lacked strategic planning, weakening rather than strengthening Somalia’s security capacity. They contrast the current administration with the peaceful transfer of power in 2022, when President Farmaajo declared: “I hand over to you every inch of state property that was entrusted to me.” To many of the government’s opponents, those words symbolized a commitment to institutional stewardship and continuity that they believe has since eroded. Perhaps most concerning, they argue, is that Somalia’s hard-earned international standing—gradually restored after years of conflict—has been overshadowed by allegations of corruption, weak governance, political polarization, and an erosion of the rule of law. Whether these accusations ultimately withstand political or legal scrutiny remains a matter of ongoing national debate. What is undeniable, however, is that they have become central to the criticism confronting the current administration and have deepened concerns about the future of Somalia’s fragile state-building project. Constitutional Disputes and Political Polarization Mr. President, your critics argue that you have abandoned the very Constitution under which you were sworn into office, replacing it with amendments they contend were drafted without broad political consensus. They further allege that the electoral commission established under your administration lacks genuine independence and was designed to implement an electoral model developed without meaningful consultation—as though Somalia was governed by executive decree rather than constitutional consensus. Opposition leaders also argue that, even while internationally mediated negotiations continue between the Federal Government and opposition groups over the Constitution and the country’s next elections, your administration has refused to suspend controversial policies that lack broad political support. In their view, this has undermined the very dialogue intended to resolve Somalia’s constitutional crisis. Military Force Instead of Political Dialogue? Critics further accuse your administration of escalating political disagreements into military confrontations. They point to the Federal Government’s military operation in Ras Kamboni, Jubaland, as one example. They also argue that, while internationally facilitated negotiations over Somalia’s electoral future were still underway, Federal forces—reportedly supported by Turkish assistance—were deployed in South West State. Opposition figures maintain that the subsequent installation of Aden Mohamed Nur (Aden Madoobe) as President of South West State did not reflect the will of the region’s people but was instead intended to produce a future parliamentary bloc aligned with Villa Somalia. According to the same critics, the strategy extends beyond South West State. They allege that your administration is attempting to shape political outcomes in Galmudug and Hirshabelle by promoting preferred candidates for the presidency of those Federal Member States. They specifically claim that Liban Shuluq is being positioned for the Galmudug presidency and that similar efforts are expected in Hirshabelle, with the broader objective of influencing the composition of Somalia’s next Federal Parliament. Whether those allegations are justified remains a matter of intense political disagreement. Nevertheless, they illustrate the profound mistrust that continues to obstruct efforts to achieve a broad national consensus on Somalia’s constitutional and electoral future. Somalia’s Greatest Security Test As AUSSOM prepares to conclude its mission by December 2026, Somalia is approaching one of the most consequential security transitions in its modern history. Following years of supporting Somali security institutions, approximately 12,500 African Union personnel are expected to withdraw, leaving responsibilities that many observers fear Somali forces may not yet be fully prepared to assume. Government critics argue that the past four years represented a missed opportunity to prepare for that transition. Instead of focusing on institutional reform, military professionalism, and national cohesion, they contend that the administration became increasingly consumed by political disputes, allegations of corruption, controversial land transactions, clan-based politics, and confrontations with several Federal Member States. In their view, those policies weakened national unity precisely when it was needed most. hese concerns have also been echoed by former National Security Adviser Hussein Moalim, who recently warned of the dangers Somalia could face following AUSSOM’s withdrawal. In an interview with journalist Hafid Nur, Hussein Moalim was asked whether Somalia risked experiencing a collapse similar to Afghanistan after international forces departed. His response was stark. “The Somali government should concentrate its defense on Mogadishu and the Shabelle regions and leave the rest of the country to Al-Shabaab. Otherwise, Somalia risks being overrun in the same way Afghanistan was.” His remarks generated significant debate but also reflected growing anxiety among security analysts over Somalia’s readiness for the post-AUSSOM era. A Legacy Still Unwritten Mr. President, your critics believe history will judge your administration by whether it strengthened Somalia’s institutions or weakened them. They argue that your government has become synonymous with corruption, political division, and constitutional controversy, setting Somalia’s state-building project back by years. They urge you to place the nation’s interests above personal political ambition, abandon your bid for another term, and return to the path of constitutional consensus. They also contend that many of the experienced advisers who once surrounded you have departed, leaving behind a shrinking circle whose loyalty, they argue, has replaced independent judgment. Whether one agrees with these criticisms or not, one reality is increasingly difficult to ignore. As AUSSOM prepares to leave, Somalia’s greatest challenge is no longer solely defeating Al-Shabaab. It is whether its political leadership can overcome deep constitutional divisions, restore public trust, and preserve the state that generations of Somalis struggled to rebuild. The future of Somalia’s statehood may ultimately depend less on the battlefield than on the willingness of its political leaders to choose national consensus over political confrontation. Abdullahi A. Nor Email: abdulahinor231@gmail.com The post President Hassan Sheikh: Do Not Let Somalia’s Statehood Collapse on Your Watch appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Wasiir Jaamac oo la heshiiyay ninkii sheegay inuu ka dhacay kursiga
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ee Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo sidoo kalena ah xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ayaa maanta la heshiiyay Isaaq Cali Subag oo ay hore u dhexmartay xiisad siyaasadeed. Isaaq ayaa hore ugu eedeeyay Wasiir Jaamac inuu ka dhacay kursiga tirsigiisu yahay HOP#204, kaas oo bishii April guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka ay sheegeen inuu ku guuleystay Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur. Wasiir Jaamac oo caawa soo saaray qoraal kooban ayaa shaaciyay in isaga iyo Isaaq ay ka heshiiyeen xurguftii siyaasadeed ee dhexmartay. Labada nin oo isku deegaan ah ayaa hore iskugu seegay kursiga HOP#204, taas oo haatan la soo afjaray. “Waxaan maanta magaalada Muqdisho Kulan islaab xaarasho ah ku yeelaney walaalkeey Isak Cali Subag oo naga dhexeyso wax ka weyn siyaasad,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Jaamac oo baahiyay sawirka isaga iyo Isaaq oo is gacan qaadaya. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Is-cafin iyo islaab xaarasho kadib, waxaan isla garaney in si wadajir ah uga wada shaqeyno midnimada iyo wada jirka dalka si gaar Beesha aan ku matalo Kursiga HOP#204.” Wasiir Jaamac ayaa qoraalkiisa kusoo xiray: “Doqoni meeshii lagu dagaallay ayay ogeyd, meeshii lagu heshiiyeyna ma oga.” Arrintan ayaa imaneysa xilli Xildhibaan Jaamac uu u sharaxan yahay kursiga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, kaas oo uu baneeyay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe kadib markii uu noqday hoggaamiyaha maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Jaamac ayaa taageero weyn ka helaya Villa Somalia oo dooneysa inay ku guuleysato kursigaas, si uusan uga bixin gacanta shaqsiyaadka daacadda u ah Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. The post Wasiir Jaamac oo la heshiiyay ninkii sheegay inuu ka dhacay kursiga appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Is-cafin iyo islaab xaarasho kadib, waxaan isla garaney in si wadajir ah uga wada shaqeyno midnimada iyo wada jirka dalka si gaar Beesha aan ku matalo Kursiga HOP#204.” Wasiir Jaamac ayaa qoraalkiisa kusoo xiray: “Doqoni meeshii lagu dagaallay ayay ogeyd, meeshii lagu heshiiyeyna ma oga.” Arrintan ayaa imaneysa xilli Xildhibaan Jaamac uu u sharaxan yahay kursiga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, kaas oo uu baneeyay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe kadib markii uu noqday hoggaamiyaha maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Jaamac ayaa taageero weyn ka helaya Villa Somalia oo dooneysa inay ku guuleysato kursigaas, si uusan uga bixin gacanta shaqsiyaadka daacadda u ah Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. items.title: Somaliland Signals Readiness to Help Secure Bab el-Mandeb
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) – In a move that has drawn regional attention, the commander of Somaliland’s Navy and Coast Guard has declared that the self-governing territory is prepared to contribute to international efforts to safeguard the strategically vital Bab el-Mandeb Strait, signaling an ambition to assume a more visible role in one of the world’s most sensitive maritime security zones. Rear Admiral Ahmed Haari Hariye said Somaliland stands ready to cooperate with neighboring countries and international partners to help protect maritime security and ensure the uninterrupted flow of commercial shipping through the narrow waterway linking the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden. The announcement comes as security concerns in the Red Sea continue to intensify following repeated attacks on commercial vessels, raising questions about whether Somaliland is seeking to expand its international security profile beyond coastal patrol operations. “Our priority is to preserve maritime security and guarantee freedom of navigation in accordance with international maritime laws and conventions,” the admiral said. He described the Bab el-Mandeb Strait as one of the world’s most critical shipping corridors, noting that it serves as the gateway between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden and carries a significant share of global trade moving between Asia, Europe, and the Mediterranean via the Suez Canal. Although Somaliland is not known to maintain a naval fleet, its statement appears to signal an ambition to assert greater influence in the Gulf of Aden and the strategically critical Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a posture that some observers believe may have been encouraged by its growing relationship with Israel. Expanding Maritime Ambitions Although Somaliland has long maintained a coast guard responsible for securing its extensive coastline along the Gulf of Aden, the latest statement suggests a broader willingness to participate in regional maritime security initiatives. According to the naval commander, Somaliland could contribute through: Coastal and territorial water surveillance. Monitoring commercial maritime traffic. Counter-piracy and maritime crime operations. Intelligence-sharing on maritime security threats. Cooperation with international naval forces protecting commercial shipping. Supporting efforts to preserve freedom of navigation. However, the commander stopped short of suggesting that Somaliland intends to undertake military operations beyond its maritime jurisdiction. His remarks instead framed Somaliland’s role as one of security cooperation rather than direct participation in regional military campaigns. A Strategic Moment The timing of the announcement is particularly striking. The Bab el-Mandeb Strait has become one of the world’s most contested maritime chokepoints following attacks by Yemen’s Houthi movement on commercial vessels transiting the Red Sea. Those attacks have prompted several major shipping companies to divert vessels around the Cape of Good Hope, dramatically increasing shipping costs and transit times. The growing instability has led the United States and several allied nations to expand their naval presence in the region to safeguard international shipping lanes. Somaliland appears eager to emphasize the strategic value of its geography. Its long coastline faces the Gulf of Aden, while the Port of Berbera sits close to one of the busiest maritime routes in global commerce. In recent years, Berbera Port and its adjacent airport have attracted growing interest from international investors and regional partners, further enhancing Somaliland’s geopolitical significance. While the statement focuses on maritime security, it also carries broader political significance. Any expanded role for Somaliland in international security cooperation around Bab el-Mandeb would inevitably intersect with wider regional rivalries involving Middle Eastern powers, African states, and major global actors competing for influence in the Red Sea. Analysts note that any future security cooperation would need to be carefully defined—including the identity of Somaliland’s partners, the scope of any operations, and the limits of its involvement—to avoid becoming entangled in the broader military confrontations unfolding across the Middle East. For now, Somaliland’s naval leadership has presented its proposal as an offer of cooperation rather than military intervention. Nevertheless, the announcement reflects Somaliland’s growing determination to leverage its strategic location to expand its role in maritime security, deepen cooperation with international partners, and position itself as an increasingly important stakeholder along one of the world’s most critical shipping corridors. items.title: Sideen ku Heli Karnaa Bulsho ku wada Nool Caddaalad iyo Sinnaan?
items.description: Habnololeedka bulshada Soomaaliyeed wuxuu aalaaba ku tiirsanyahay hanaan ismaamul iyo xeerar ay degsadeen oo iyaga u gaar ah. Sidoo kale, waxa ay leeyihiin dastuur iyo sharci ku qotama habnololeedkooda maalinlaha. Waxaa jira xeerar ay bulshadu ka soo minguurisay dhaqanka iyo hiddaha soojireenka ah, kuwaas oo ay ku dhaqmayeen sannado badan, laga soo bilaabo markii ay ahaayeen reermiyi dabeecadda noloshu ui taliso ilaa hadda oo ay yihiin reermagaal ilbax ah. Weli way haystaan, kamana aysan tegin. Marka shuruucda dalka laga soo tago, marjica ugu danbeeya ee ay u laabtaan waa xeerdhaqameedkooda. Hannaankaas bulsheed ee ab-ka-soogaarka ah waxaa garsoorayaal ka ah odaydhaqameedyo, guurti iyo xeerbeegti goobjoog u ahaa dhacdooyin tiro badan oo ay xalkooda qeyb ka ahaayeen. Ma jirin maxkamad dhisan oo ay khilaafaadka iyo dhibaatooyinka la soo gudboonaada kula ciiraan, laakiin waxa ay hoos fariisan jireen geedaha waaweyn ee harka fiican leh, sida geedka gobka, quraca, galoolka iyo kuwa kale. Taariikh ahaan, marka aan ka hadlayno caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta ka dhex jirtay bulshada Soomaaliyeed, sida aynu hore u soo sheegnayba, waxa ay ku dhisnayd wax lagu magacaabo Xeer Soomaali. Ma ahayn mid qoran, waxa uu ahaa wax la isku wada raacay oo laga wada heshiiyay. Dhacdooyinka inta badan dhici jirayna waxa ay ahaayeen kuwo la wada yaqaan, ciqaabta ka dhalan kartana waxa ay ahayd mid shaacsan. Way jireen dhacdooyin cusub oo aan hore u dhici jirin, sidaas oo ay tahayna waa la xalin jiray. Garta waxaa loo kala qaadi jiray labo: gar cadaawe iyo gar colaadeed. Waxyaabaha la isku qabsan jirayna waxaa ka mid ahaa saddex: dhiig, dhaqan iyo qabno. Haddii ay dadku midkood isku qabsadaan, waxa ay isu soo geed fariisan jireen. Waxyaabaha qofku garta ku qaadan karo way caddaayeen, inta uu ku waayi karana sidoo kale way caddayd. Qofka denbiga laga galay, haddii uusan hadalka ku fiicnayn oo uusan ahayn codkar cadkiisa goosan og, waxa uu wakiilan jiray aftahan hadalka kala dhigdhigi yaqaan. Marka geedka laga kacayo oo boorka la iska jafayo, waxaa lagu kala tagi jiray gartii oo qof qaatay iyo isa saamaxaad aan dabadeed hadal jirin. Sidaas ayuu qofku ku heli jiray caddaalad uu ku qanco. Qofka denbiilaha ahina waxa uu tagi jiray isaga oo looga gar helay ama qirsan denbiga uu qofkaas ka galay. Xeerdhaqameedka Soomaalidu waxa uu caan ka ahaa guud geyiga Soomaaliyeed, meel kastana waa looga dhaqmi jiray. Ka dib markii ay dadkeennu noqdeen dad reermagaal ah oo la jaanqaada dunida horumartay, waxaa isbeddel ku yimid sidii garta loo qaadi jiray iyo denbiyadii ay dadku isu geysan jireen. Kolkii hore, markii dadku reermiyi wada ahaa, waxa ay isku qabsan jireen dhaqanka, dhulka daaqsinta ah, ceelasha, carshinta, xoolaha iyo wixii dhiig quseeya. Hadda waxa ay intaas isu beddeshay in dadku isku qabsadaan lacago la kala dhacay ama bangiyo la iska jabsaday. Waxaa kaloo la isku qabsadaa guryo ama dhismayaal la isku haysto, waxaana dhaca in gabdhaha si foolxun loogu xadgudbo, halka markii hore dumarka aad loo qaddarin jiray. Intaas iyo in ka badan ayaa hadda la isku qabsadaa. Goobtii garta lagu goyn jiray ee geedka hoostiisa ahayd waxaa beddelay dhismayaal casri ah oo maxkamado ah ama hoteello iyo meelo kale oo la mid ah. Waagii hore, marka ay gartu dhammaato oo fadhigaas go’aan lagu gaaro, ma jirin wax hadal ah oo ka danbayn jiray. Hadba ixii markaas la isugu afgarto ayaa fulintooda lagu dhaqaaqi jiray. Laakiin, hadda waxaa dhaca dhacdooyin waaweyn oo qaarkood laga yaabo in aanay hore u dhicin, ka dibna waa laga gaabsadaa, iyada oo maxkamaddu go’aan ka soo saartay qofka denbiga galay. Waxaa aad u yar kalsoonida lagu qabo caddaaladda ka jirta guud ahaan dalka. In badan ayaynu aragnaa dhacdooyin waaweyn oo dadka oo dhammi u wada arkaan in ay yihiin xaalado adag oo u baahan in wax laga qabto, haddana laga tago iyada oo aan wax laga qaban. Maalmo gaaban ayaa la buunbuuniyaa, ka dibna waa la iska tagaa. Waxaa caqabad weyn ku ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed in ay hesho caddaalad loo wada dhanyahay oo ay maxkamadaha iyo garsooreyaashu madax bannaan yihiin. Waxaa jira sharci iyo dastuur loo sameeyay in dadka lagu kala saaro oo lagu kala siiyo xuquuqdooda iyo waajibaadkooda. Laakiin waxaa maqan in maxkamadaha iyo hay’adaha caddaaladdu ay u madax bannaanaadaan shuruucda iyo tallaabooyinka ay qaadayaan. Waxaa inta badan soo farageliya dawladda iyo nidaamkeeda, oo sida ay rabaan ayay wax uga dhigaan. Bulshada Soomaaliyeed, iyaga oo markii horaba aan haysan caddaalad dhammaystiran, haddana waxaa dhibaato kale ku sii noqday in ay dhexdooda iskala saaraan oo ay kala yihiin qabiillo kala sarreeya. Qabiillada qaar ayaa la takooraa, laga soo bilaabo nidaamka ay dawladdu ku dhisantahay ee 4.5, oo macnihiisu yahay in ay jiraan qabiillo aan dhammaystirnayn oo aan hal gaarin. Sidaas awgeed, qabiilladaas waxa ay la kulmaan caddaalad darro dhinacyo badan leh, haddii ay noqon lahayd dhinaca waxbarashada, helidda shaqooyinka iyo guud ahaan ka qaybgalka arrimaha siyaasadeed. Sida ay diinteenna na fartay, caddaaladdu waa udubdhexaadka nolosheenna. Eebbe iyo Rasuulkiisa SCW waxa ay na fareen in aan adkayno caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta . Ma jiro qof ka sarreeya qof kale, Eebbana ummaddiisa oo dhan way u simanyihiin, laakiin waxa ay ugu kala dhowyihiin sida ay ugu kala cibaado iyo taqwo badanyihiin. Soomaalidii hore waxaa halkudheg u ahaa, marka ay geedka hoos fadhiyaan oo ay laba qof u kala garqaadayaan, in ay yiraahdaan: “Gari Allay taqaan.” Oraahdaas oo ahayd mid muujinaysa in Alle-Weyne ma ahane aan cid kale looga waabanin sheegidda xaqa iyo ka-hortagidda dulmiga. Bulsho kastaa waxa ay caddaalad iyo sinnaan ku heli kartaa in garsoorkeedu madaxbannaan yahay, sharciguna ka sarreeyo wax kasta oo kale. Sidoo kale, waa in hay’adaha fulinta aysan wax faragelin iyo saamayn ah ku yeelanin hay’adaha garsoorka. Sharciga sidiisaba waxaa loo samaystay in bulshadu ku kala nabad hesho oo ay ku kala badbaaddo. Sidaas darteed, caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta bulsheed waa kuwo lamataabtaan ah oo ay bulshadu ku wada noolaan karto, kuna horumari karto.

items.title: PSF Withdraws from Galkayo Base, Relocates to Galmudug
items.description: Galkayo (WDN) – In a dramatic development underscoring the deepening security and political rift between Puntland and Somalia’s Federal Government, soldiers affiliated with the Puntland Security Force (PSF) have vacated one of their key positions in Galkayo, relocating across the administrative boundary into Baraxley, an area under neighboring Galmudug administration. The withdrawal comes amid escalating tensions following recent clashes between Puntland forces and PSF units, marking another significant shift in the increasingly volatile security landscape of northeastern Somalia. According to local sources, the PSF abandoned its base near Galkayo Airport, one of its principal operational positions in Puntland, after large numbers of Puntland security forces were deployed around the facility in what appeared to be a show of overwhelming force. Witnesses reported that PSF personnel departed the compound with five military vehicles, crossing into Galmudug-controlled territory. Shortly afterward, municipal authorities in Galkayo reportedly dug trenches around the vacated base, a move widely interpreted as an effort to prevent the fighters from returning or re-establishing a presence there. The relocation follows last week’s confrontation in Laag, in Puntland’s Bari region, where fighting between Puntland forces and PSF units resulted in the reported seizure of eight military vehicles from commanders aligned with the force. Those officers are now said to be serving within Somalia’s Federal Government security structure. The latest developments come just days after Puntland’s Presidency issued a strongly worded statement declaring that no force known as the PSF legally exists within Puntland’s defense establishment. The regional administration further asserted that it does not recognize the presence of any Federal Government military units operating inside Puntland without its authorization. The declaration represents a significant escalation in Puntland’s longstanding dispute with the Federal Government over security authority, command structures, and constitutional powers. Political analysts warn that the relocation of PSF personnel into neighboring Galmudug could further complicate relations between Puntland, Galmudug, and Mogadishu at a time when Somalia is already grappling with a constitutional impasse, electoral uncertainty, and mounting security challenges. For many observers, the withdrawal from Galkayo is more than a tactical military repositioning. It reflects the widening fragmentation of Somalia’s security architecture, where competing claims over the legitimacy and command of armed forces increasingly mirror the country’s broader political divisions. Whether the relocation helps ease immediate tensions or merely shifts the confrontation across an administrative boundary remains uncertain. What is clear is that the dispute over the PSF has evolved into one of the most sensitive security issues confronting Puntland and the Federal Government, with potentially far-reaching implications for stability across northeastern Somalia. items.title: Wasaaradda Hawl Guud Somaliland  oo ka hadashay dhul laga raray dad shicib ah
items.description: Wasaaradda hawlaha guud ee Somaliland ayaa soo bandhigtay caddaymo muuqda oo ay doonayso in lagu soo afjaro arrinka la xidhiidha qoysas laga raray agagarka guriga Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro, kaas oo hadal hayn dhaliyey maalmihii la soo dhaafay. Agaasimaha waaxda dhulka ee Wasaaradda Hawl Guud Somaliland Xamse Maxamed Faarax ayaa Warbaahinta la wadaagay dhammaanba xogta la xidhiidha arrimaha dhulka dadka laga raray sida uu soo bandhiggay. Ugu horrayn agaasimuhu waxa uu sheegay in dadkaas dhulka ka hor intaan laga rarin lala wadaagay xogta dhulka oo markiii horeba ahaa dhul dawladeed, ka dibna la siiyey dhul ay iyagu lee yihiin sidoo kalena loogu daray 30 kun oo Dollar oo guuritaan ah. Sababo la xidhiidha amniga madaxweynaha ayaa dadkan looga beddelay halkii ay degganayeen waxana agaasimuhu caddeeyey in dadkaas la siiyey dhulkii ay xaqa u lahaayeen.

items.title: Somalia’s Future Council Urges Regional Leaders to Back Transitional Authority
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s opposition Future Council has called on regional leaders meeting in Uganda to support the creation of a transitional governing authority, arguing that the country’s federal institutions have lost their political legitimacy and that the current leadership has failed to pursue an inclusive political settlement. In a formal letter addressed to the heads of state of countries contributing troops to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), whose leaders are meeting in Kampala, the opposition coalition contended that Somalia’s political crisis has reached a critical stage. According to the Future Council, the Federal Government has lost the legitimacy that was originally founded on political consensus and has rejected efforts to reach a broad-based national agreement on the country’s constitutional and electoral future. The opposition coalition argued that restoring constitutional order requires the establishment of a Transitional National Council that would temporarily assume responsibility for guiding the country through the current political impasse. Under the proposal outlined in the letter, the transitional body would be created through an inclusive political agreement involving all major Somali stakeholders. The council would oversee the constitutional review process, manage preparations for national elections, and supervise the rebuilding of legitimate state institutions. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo beegsaday warshad shidaal oo ku taala Bariga Sacuudiga
items.description: Waxaa gubaneysa warshadda shidaalka sifeysa ee ku taala Magaalada Abqaiq ee Bariga Sacuudiga, ka dib weerar ay maanta ku qaadeen Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ee dagaalka kula jira boqortooyada dalkaasi. Ururka Xuutiyiinta oo sheegtay masuuliyadda weerarka ayaa sheegay in diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ay ku weerareen dhowr meelood oo xasaasi ah oo ku yaala waddada keenista iyo wareejinta saliidda ka timaada Bariga Sacuudiga ee laga dhoofiyo Dekedda Yanbu ee saaran Badda Cas. Tallaabadan ayaa timid, iyadoo laga jawaabayo buu ururku yiri xadgudubyada ay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee cadowga Sacuudiga ku sameeyeen hawada Yemen. Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay inay soo rideen diyaarado drones ah, oo sida ay sheegtay ka yimid jihada Ciraaq, isla-markaana ay adeegsadeen maleeshiyaad xiriir la leh Iran. Wakaaladda Wararka Fars ee laga leeyahay Iran ayaa sheegtay in weeraro loo adeegsaday diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaalo ay dab ka dhaliyeen xarunta saliidda ee Abqaiq, taas oo ay leedahay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco. Wakaaladda Wararka Fars oo soo xiganeysa Sarkaal ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa ku warantay in la beegsaday xarumo lagu dejiyo saliidda ceyriin si halkaasi loogu sifeeyo, ka hor inta aan loo soo rarin Dekedda Yanbu, oo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee laga dhoofiyo tamarta Sacuudiga. Abqaiq waa xarunta ugu weyn adduunka ee xasillinta saliidda ceyriin, iyadoo farsameysa 5-7% ee sahayda tamarta adduunka. Xarunta Shirkadda Aramco ee Abqaiq waxay gacan ka gaysataa dhaqaalaha iyo deganaanshaha suuqyada tamarta adduunka. Is bedel kasta oo ku yimaada wax soosaarka Abqaiq ayaa si toos ah u bedeleysa qiimaha fuustada shidaalka ee suuqyada caalamka.

items.title: Kadib dalabkii Golaha Mustaqbalka, Guddoomiyaha Midowga Afrika oo…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Midowga Afrika ayaa xaqiijiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay in mas’uuliyadda amniga Soomaaliya si buuxda loogu wareejiyo ciidamada ammaanka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, taas oo lagu tilmaamay tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee qorshaha kala guurka ee howl-galka AUSSOM. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf ayaa maanta magaalada Addis Ababa kulan gaar ah kula yeeshay Ergeyga Gaarka ah ee Midowga Afrika u qaabilsan Soomaaliya ahna Madaxa howl-galka AUSSOM, Danjire El Hadji Ibrahima Diene. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray hirgelinta waajibaadka howl-galka AUSSOM iyo qiimeynta xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee amniga Soomaaliya. Labada mas’uul ayaa la sheegay inay isla soo qaadeen horumarka laga sameeyay taageerada ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, dadaallada lagu xasilinayo dalka iyo qorshaha lagu xaqiijinayo in ciidamada qaranka ay si tartiib tartiib ah ula wareegaan masuuliyadda sugidda amniga. Guddoomiye Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf ayaa bogaadiyay ciidamada ka socda dalalka Afrika ee qeybta ka ahaa howl-galadii nabad ilaalinta Soomaaliya tan iyo sanadkii 2007-dii, isagoo ku ammaanay naf-hurnimada iyo kaalintii ay ka qaateen la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo xasilinta dalka. Sidoo kale wuxuu xusay in howl-galka AUSSOM uu haatan diiradda saarayo diyaarinta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed si ay u hantaan awoodda amniga dalka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Midowga Afrika uu sii wadi doono taageerada uu siiyo Soomaaliya, ilaa laga xaqiijinayo nabad waarta, xasillooni siyaasadeed iyo isku-filnaansho amni oo ay hoggaaminayaan hay’adaha amniga ee Soomaaliya. Kulankan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli uu howl-galka AUSSOM wajahayo caqabado dhinaca maalgelinta ah, kadib markii Mareykanku uu hakiyay dhaqaalihii uu ku taageeri jiray howlgalka, taas oo sare u qaaday doodaha mustaqbalka howl-galka iyo sida loo hirgelin doono qorshaha bixitaanka tartiib-tartiibka ah ee ciidamada Midowga Afrika, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ay ku adkeysanayaan in kala guurka amniga uu u dhici doono si qorsheysan. Si kastaba, arrintaan ayaa imaneysa xilli uu maanta Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed warqad furan u diray waddamada ay ciidamada ka joogaan Soomaaliya, iyagoo soo jeediyay in loo baahan yahay dhismaha Gole KMG ah, si loo badbaadiyo sharciyadda iyo kalsoonida. Golaha ayaa waxay ka codsadeen dalalka Afrikaanka ee ciidamada ku taageeray howl-galka AUSSOM in ay sii wadaan taageeradooda inta laga helayo xal siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro khilaafka ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Golaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamadaas ay kaalin weyn ka qaateen amniga dalka iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada, isla markaana ay muujiyeen muhiimadda iskaashiga Afrika, waxayna sidoo kale uga mahadceliyeen dadaalkooda naf-hurnimada ah oo muddo ku dhow 20 sano ay ku bixiyeen dalka Soomaaliya. “Heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay uu noqdo saldhigga iyo shuruudda ugu weyn ee lagu sii wadi karo taageerada amniga Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda furan ee loo diray waddamada ciidamada usoo diray Soomaaliya. Waxaa kale oo uu goluhu xusay in Soomaaliya aysan si guul leh ula dagaalami karin kooxaha hubeysan, iyadoo dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu ay is khilaafsan yihiin, maadaama weli uu muran ka taagan yahay hannaanka doorashada iyo wax ka beddelka lagu sameeyay dastuurkii KMG ahaa. Warqaddu waxay intaas ku dartay in caqabadaha haysta maalgelinta AUSSOM iyo UNSOS ay ka dhasheen qalalaasaha siyaasadeed ee gudaha, isla markaana khatarta ugu weyn aysan ahayn dhaqaale la’aan, balse ay tahay dowlad aan haysan kalsoonida shacabka iyo sidoo kale saaxiibbada caalamka. Sidoo kale waxay madaxda dalalka ciidamada ay ka joogaan Soomaaliya ka codsadeen inay taageeraan dadaal kasta oo horseedaya heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, iyagoo sheegay in heshiiskaas uu yahay shuruudda ugu muhiimsan ee guusha howlgal kasta oo amni iyo xasilin ee ka socda gudaha Soomaaliya. items.title: Maxaa ka Jira Dilka Macallin Jinoow?
items.description: MUQDISHO, Soomaaliya — Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ee Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqday in hawlgal qorshaysan oo ay fuliyeen Ciidamada Qaranka iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ahi lagu dilay Macallin Jinoow Ibraahin, oo ahaa sarkaal miisaan culus ku lahaa hoggaanka sare iyo maamulka maaliyadeed ee kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo qabtay shir jaraa’id, ayaa xaqiijiyay in sarkaalkan, oo lagu sheegay ninka sagaalaad ee ugu sarreeya kooxda AS, si dhowna ula shaqayn jiray Amiirka Guud ee Al-Shabaab, argaggaxiye Axmed Diiriye, isla markaasna xubin ka ahaa Golaha Shuurada, lagu dilay duqayn ka dhacday degaanka Sabyo oo u dhexeeya degmooyinka Afgooye iyo Basra ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Inkastoo Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ay sheegtay in hawlgalka ay kala qaybqaateen dalal saaxiib la ah Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo inta badan lagu tuhmo Maraykanka ama Turkiga, haddana waxa jira jahawareer dhinaca xaqiijinta ah. Taliska Maraykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa xaqiijiyay duqayn dhacday isla maalintaas, balse wuxuu sheegay in hawlgalka laga fuliyay goob 75 kiiloomitir waqooyi-galbeed ka xigta magaalada Kismaayo, taas oo ka duwan goobta ay Dawladda Soomaaliya sheegtay. Dhinaca kale, kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin geerida sarkaalkan. Falanqeeyayaasha amniga ayaa tilmaamaya in kooxdu inta badan qariso dilalka hoggaamiyayaasheeda sare, si ay u ilaaliso nidaamkeeda gudaha iyo niyadda dagaalyahannadeeda. Tusaale ahaan, Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa hore u sheegtay inay dishay hoggaamiyayaal sare oo ka tirsanaa AS, kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Ismaaciil Injineer, oo ahaa madaxii qaraxyada iyo warbaahinta kooxda, laguna dhawaaqay geeridiisa bishii Diseembar 2025; iyo Maxamuud Cabdi Xamuud, oo loo yaqaannay Jacfar Guureey, kana mid ahaa aasaasayaashii kooxda, xilalna ka soo qabtay qaybteeda sirdoonka, kaas oo la sheegay in la dilay bishii Oktoobar 2025. Hasayeeshee, al-Shabaab marna si rasmi ah uma qiran geeridooda. Hoggaamiyihii ugu danbeeyay ee ay argaggaxisadu si rasmi ah u qiratay geeridiisa wuxuu ahaa argaggaxiye Maxamed Mire, oo ahaa Madaxii Arrimaha Gudaha ee Al-Shabaab, kaas oo lagu dilay duqayn uu Maraykanku fuliyay dhammaadkii 2024. Macallin Jinoow wuxuu ahaa Madaxii Lacagaha iyo Canshuuraha Sharcidarrada ah ee kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab ka ururin jirtay gobollada Shabeellaha Hoose, Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo caasimadda Muqdisho. Geeridiisa, haddii si madaxbannaan loo xaqiijiyo, waxa lagu tilmaami karaa dhabarjab weyn oo ku yimid maamulka maaliyadeed iyo qorshaynta dagaalka ee AS. Hasayeeshee, khubarrada amniga ayaa aaminsan in al-Shabaab ay leedahay hannaan ay si degdeg ah ugu beddesho hoggaamiyayaasha laga dilo, taas oo marar badan u suurtagelisay inay sii waddo hawlaheeda kaddib marka laga dilo saraakiil sare.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Lugta ee XDS oo gaaray Dhuusamareeb
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Lugta ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Markii uu gaaray magaalada, Taliye Sahal waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha kusoo dhaweeyay Saraakiisha Qeybta 21-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Intaas kadib, wuxuu u gudbay xarunta taliska halkaas oo uu kulan muhiim ah kula yeeshay saraakiisha qaybta. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dardargelinta hawlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab, xoojinta wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda ciidamada, iyo sare u qaadidda hufnaanta howlaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda hawlgallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, iyadoo la xoojinayo dadaallada lagu ciribtirayo kooxaha Khawaarijta, si loo ilaaliyo guulaha laga gaaray dagaallada socda.

items.title: Somalia opposition urges AUSSOM TCC leaders to back transitional council at Uganda Summit
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s opposition National Future Council on Monday called on the heads of state of countries contributing troops and police to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) to use their upcoming summit in Uganda to press for an inclusive political transition, arguing that the country’s unresolved election dispute has become the principal obstacle to national stability, counterterrorism efforts and continued international support. In an open letter addressed to leaders expected to attend the Kampala summit later this month, the council said Somalia has entered “the most dangerous phase of its politics” following the expiry of the constitutional mandates of both the presidency and parliament without an agreed political framework to manage the transition. The opposition argued that resolving the country’s political crisis should be the foundation of any future international engagement with Somalia. “Your Excellencies, you meet this month to consider the future of AUSSOM at a perilous moment for our country. The President’s constitutional term expired on 15 May 2026. The term of Parliament lapsed on 14 April 2026. There is still no political agreement in place to manage the transition that must follow. Somalia is now in the most dangerous phase of its politics, without a legitimate, agreed framework for who governs, and how,” the council said. The National Future Council argued that Somalia’s current political deadlock has undermined years of security gains achieved with the support and sacrifice of African troop-contributing countries, saying the country’s internal divisions are weakening the national campaign against Al-Shabaab and Da’esh. “The political fragmentation now unfolding in Somalia is the direct product of the mismanagement of a government whose mandate has expired. The Somali National Army, built with the support and sacrifice of African partners to defeat al-Shabaab and Da’esh, has been diverted from its constitutional mission of protecting the Somali people. Instead, growing political polarization has weakened national cohesion, sidetracked the common fight against terrorism, and eroded the unified national effort upon which lasting security depends. A fragmented state cannot successfully wage a unified campaign against transnational terrorism,” the letter said. The council, whose members include former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, former prime ministers, former federal government officials and the leaders of Puntland and Jubaland, also warned that deteriorating relations between Mogadishu and the two federal member states are further weakening Somalia’s fight against militant groups. According to the letter, Puntland and Jubaland continue to maintain forces actively engaged against Al-Shabaab and Da’esh while controlling territories that remain on the front lines of the conflict. However, the council said those forces have been marginalized, denied support and directly targeted by the federal government despite carrying a substantial share of the country’s security burden. “The forces most committed to the fight against terror are being weakened by Mogadishu, with the united national front this war demands being prevented from forming. Somalia cannot defeat two insurgencies while its government fights its own frontline states,” the council said. The opposition coalition also linked Somalia’s political crisis to growing uncertainty surrounding the future of AUSSOM and the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS), saying the funding challenges facing the missions coincide with increasing hesitation among international partners. “It is in this context that the funding crisis surrounding UNSOS and AUSSOM, and the growing hesitation of international donors is occurring. These challenges do not have their root in Africa’s commitment or in the design of the mission. The greatest challenge is the absence of a legitimate government the world can trust and engage with. No mission can substitute for a state, and no measure of foreign sacrifice can secure a country whose own leadership has forfeited its legitimacy,” the council said. Presenting what it described as a peaceful and Somali-led solution, the National Future Council reaffirmed its commitment to dialogue and compromise, proposing a comprehensive political agreement establishing an inclusive Transitional Council to oversee Somalia’s constitutional and electoral transition until legitimate national institutions are peacefully renewed. The council said such a body would restore political legitimacy, rebuild public confidence, safeguard the neutrality of the Somali National Army and other state institutions, and ensure that the constitutional transition is conducted through an inclusive, transparent and credible process. “The Somali Future Council wishes to assure that we remain fully committed to a peaceful, negotiated, and Somali-owned settlement, reached through dialogue and compromise rather than unilateral action. In that spirit, we submit that Somalia’s immediate priority is a comprehensive political agreement establishing an inclusive Transitional Council to provide collective oversight of the constitutional and electoral transition until legitimate national institutions are peacefully renewed. Such a body would restore political legitimacy, rebuild national confidence, safeguard the neutrality of the Somali National Army and all state institutions, and ensure the transition is managed in an inclusive, transparent, and credible manner,” the letter said. Concluding its appeal, the National Future Council urged the heads of state and government of AUSSOM troop- and police-contributing countries to make political legitimacy and national consensus central to discussions at the Kampala summit, arguing that an inclusive political settlement is essential to restoring constitutional order and creating the conditions for sustainable security. “We therefore respectfully urge the Heads of States and Governments of the Troop and Police Contributing Countries to use the Kampala Summit to encourage and support a political settlement that restores legitimacy, rebuilds national consensus, and establishes the conditions for a peaceful constitutional transition. Somalia urgently needs an inclusive political settlement, and this should be the condition and foundation of any continued engagement,” the council said. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: DF oo u yeertay safiirka Kenya kadib bahdilkii wasiirrada
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa u yeertay safiirka Kenya u fadhiya magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo lagu wado inuu maanta oo Isniin ah hortago Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online. Yeerista safiirka ayaa u daaran si looga wada-hadlo arrinta wasiirro ka tirsan xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo la sheegay in laga hor istaagay inay galaan magaalada Nairobi, isla markaana laga soo celiyay Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA). Ilo ku dhow Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay safiirka Kenya ka dalban doonto sharaxaad rasmi ah oo ku saabsan dhacdada iyo sababaha keenay in mas’uuliyiin Soomaaliyeed oo xilal sare haya loo diido gelitaanka dalka Kenya, iyadoo arrintan loo arko mid saameyn ku yeelan karta xiriirka labada dal. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa weli soo saarin war-saxaafadeed faah-faahsan oo ku saabsan dhacdadan, halka dowladda Kenya ay sidoo kale ka aamusan tahay wararka la xiriira in wasiirrada Soomaaliyeed laga celiyay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Nairobi. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya uu wajahayo marxalad xasaasi ah, iyadoo labada dal ay ka wada shaqeynayaan arrimo la xiriira amniga, ganacsiga iyo iskaashiga gobolka, balse ay mararka qaar soo kala dhex galaan khilaafaad siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Waxaa la filayaa in kulanka maanta dhexmaraya Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya iyo Safiirka Kenya uu door muhiim ah ka ciyaaro caddeynta dhacdadan iyo dejinta xiisadda ka dhalatay, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo tallaabooyinka ay labada dowladood qaadi doonaan saacadaha iyo maalmaha soo socda. Dowladda Kenya ayaa Axaddii dalkeeda kasoo celisay Wasiiru-dowlaha Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, Abshir Maxamed Axmed (Bukhaari) oo ka dagay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Nairobi. Wasiirka ayaa lagu soo warramayaa ‘in Kenya ay u diiday inuu gudaha u galo caasimada dalkaas’ waxaana dib loogu soo celiyay Soomaaliya, taas oo dhalisay hadal-heyn xooggan. Warar kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxaya sababta ka dambeysa go’aankan, waxaana wararka qaar ay sheegayaan in Abshir Bukhaari uu watay baasaboorka Kenya, isla markaana loo arkay inuu ku qaatay qaab shari darro ah, halka kuwa kalena ay sheegayaan inuu baalmaray nidaamka waaxda socdaalka ee dalkaasi, sidaas daraadeedna looga soo masaafuriyay Kenya. Dhacdadan ayaa si weyn u qabsatay baraha bulshada iyo warbaahinta, kuwaas oo falalqeynaya soo celinta Wasiiru-dowlaha Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, Abshir Bukhaari oo aad ugu dhow Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Si kastaba, horay waxaa marar kala duwan dalka Kenya looga soo celiyay mas’uuliyiin Soomaaliyeed oo qaarkood xilal ka haya Dowladda Federaalka, iyadoo dowladda Kenya ay sababo kala duwan dalkeeda ugu diiday mas’uuliyiintaas. items.title: Dawladda Kiiniya oo baadhaysa suda uu Xasan Sheekh ku qaatay Baaaaboorka dalkeeda
items.description: Dowladda Kenya oo muddo ogeyd in Xasan Sheekh uu haysto baasaboorkeeda, ayaa haatan la sheegayaa inay amartay saraakiisha dabagalka musuqa ee laanta socdaalka inay baaraan sida uu ku heley baasaboorka iyo qofkii kala shaqeeyay. Baasaboorka Xasan waxaa ugu qoran inuu ku dhashay gobolka Waqooyi Bari Kenya, uuna yahay muwaadin Kenyan ah. Tani waxay khilaafsan tahay baasaboorka Soomaaliya iyo CVgiisa oo ay ku qoran tahay inuu ku dhashay magaalada Jalalaqsi ee gobolka Hiiraan, Soomaaliya. Ilo wareedyada aan la hadalnay ayaa sheegaya in Xasan Sheekh uu qaatay baasaboorkan xilligii uu la shaqeynayay hay’adda CRD ee cilmi-baarista. Qof ku dhow laanta socdaalka ayaa noo sheegay in baasaboorka uu Xasan haysto uu yahay noocii hore ee ay Kenya bedeshay 2017, balse weli xogtiisa ay taallo laanta socdaalka Kenya. Fatxiya Axmed

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo gaaray Magaalada Dhuusamareeb (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa Isniintan gaaray Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Taliyaha oo lagu soo dhaweeyay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Ugaas Nuur ayaa loo gelbiyay Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 21aad, halkaas oo la sheegay in uu kula kulmay Saraakiisha Ciidamada. “Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dardargelinta hawlgalada lagu ciribtirayo Khawaarijta, xoojinta isku-duwidda ciidamada iyo sare u qaadidda waajibaadka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, si loo adkeeyo amniga, loona xaqiijiyo guulaha laga gaarayo hawlgalada socda.” Ayaa lagu yiri qoraal lagu daabacay bogga Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Dhuusamareeb ayaa waxay talis u tahay Saddexda Guuto ee Qaybta 21aad ee Militariga Somaliya, waxaana sidoo kale degan Ururka 163aad, Guutada 16aad ee Kumaandooska Danab. Guutooyinka 15aad, 24aad iyo 27aad ee Qaybta 21aad oo lagu daray Ururka 163aad ee Kumaandooska Danab ayaa ka hawlgala deegaanada Galmudug, waxayna safka hore kaga jiraan sugidda amniga iyo la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo u yeertay Safiirkeedii u fadhiyay Kenya
items.description: Nairobi (Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa u yeertay safiirkeedi Kenya, kaddib markii la sheegay in Wasiiru Dowladaha Madaxtooyada, Abshir Bukhaari, laga hor istaagay inuu galo Kenya, isla markaana dib loogu celiyay Muqdisho, sababo la xiriira su’aalo laga keenay baasaboor Kenyan ah oo lagu eedeeyay inuu watay. Sida ay sheegtay Warbaahinta kenya iyo DW. Dhacdadan ayaa laga yaaba inay sii kordhiso khilaafka diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhexeeya labada dal ee deriska ah. Sidoo kale tallabadaan ayaa timid bil kadib markii sidoo kale la sheegay in Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Soomaaliya, Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji, laga hor istaagay inuu galo Kenya, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay inuu si sharci darro ah ku helay baasaboor dalka Kenya. Ilaa iyo hadda, dowladda Kenya iyo dowladda Soomaaliya midkoodna kama aysan hadlin wararkan ay baahinayaan qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta gudaha. Siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliya ayaa inta qaata Baasaboorada dalalka Kenya, Ethiopia, iyo Dhammaan Dalalka Reer galbeedka. items.title: Aljeeriya oo Dib u Furatay Safaaraddeedii Soomaaliya Kaddib 41 Sano
items.description: Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay Safiirka cusub ee Dowladda Aljeeriya u soo magacowday Soomaaliya, Maxamed Xaliim. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya labada dal. Soo magacaabista Safiirka cusub ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Dowladda Aljeeriya ay dib u soo nooleynayso joogitaankeeda diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya, kaddib in ka badan afartan sano. Safaaradda Aljeeriya ee Muqdisho ayaa la sheegay inay ugu dambeysay inay si rasmi ah u shaqeyso sanadkii 1985, taasoo ka dhigeysa dib u furitaankeeda tallaabo muhiim ah oo muujinaysa sii xoogeynta xiriirka labada dowladood. Waxaa la filayaa in dib u howlgelinta Safaaradda Aljeeriya ee Soomaaliya ay door weyn ka qaadato xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo horumarinta xiriirka shacabka labada dal, iyadoo sidoo kale fududeyn doonta wada shaqeynta diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga heer gobol iyo mid caalami ah.

items.title: Khilaafka Buntilaan iyo Galmudug iyo Saamaynta uu ku Yeelan Karo Nabadda Gaalkacyo
items.description: Buntilaan waxay digniin u dirtay Galmudug, iyada oo ugu baaqday inay ka waantoowdo in ciidamada federaalka ahi ay degaannada Galmudug uga soo gudbaan dhinaca Buntilaan. Galmudug ayaa, dhankeeda, iska fogeysay eedaha loo jeediyay, waxayna Buntilaan ugu baaqday inay xaliso caqabadaha gudaha ka haysta, oo aanay dusha ka saarin Galmudug. Sidoo kale, waxay sheegtay in Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya aanay u baahnayn inay soo marto degaannada Galmudug si ay Buntilaan u gaarto, maaddaama ay diyaarado ku degi karto garoomo ku yaalla gudaha Buntilaan. Wadashaqaynta labadan maamul waxay muhiim u tahay amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ahaan gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaanna magaalada Gaalkacyo oo soo martay marxalado adag. Waxa jirtay xilli bulshada ku dhaqan labada dhinac ee Buntilaan iyo Galmudug la dhex dhigay xayndaab cas oo aan cidina ka tallaabi karin. Madaxweynayaashii hore ee Buntilaan iyo Galmudug, Cabdiweli Cali Gaas iyo Cabdikariin Xuseen Guuleed, oo dhowaan hadlay, waxay si isku mid ah uga qoomameeyeen dagaalladii qaraaraa ee lagu riiqday ee ka dhacay Gaalkacyo, kuwaas oo laga baaqsan karay, gadaalna ay ka riixayeen dhinacyo aanay garanayn. Gaalkacyo maanta waa nabad. Ma jiro wax xayndaab ah oo u dhexeeya bulshada, waxayna magaaladu ku tallaabsatay horumar ballaaran muddadii ay nabaddani jirtay. Khilaafka ka soo cusboonaaday labada maamul ayaa durba laga dareemayaa saamayntiisa. Xiisad colaadeed iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan ayaa laga soo sheegayaa Gaalkacyo. Haddaba, hoggaamiyayaasha hadda jooga ma ka hortegi doonaan colaad ka dhacda Gaalkacyo, mise sannado kaddib ayay dib uga qoomamayn doonaan sida madaxdii ka horraysay?

items.title: Dp world completes dredging ahead at Senegal’s port of Ndayane
items.description: DAKAR, SENEGAL – 27 JULY 2026: DP World has reached a major construction milestone at the Port of Ndayane with the completion of major dredging works 13 months ahead of schedule, marking one of the most significant engineering milestones in development of Senegal’s future deep-water port. More than 1,000 people are currently employed directly on the project as construction activity accelerates. The early completion of the major dredging work ahead allows quay construction and other critical marine works to begin earlier, supporting momentum towards the port’s planned completion in 2028. Once operational, the Port of Ndayane will serve as Senegal’s principal deep-water container gateway, increasing capacity for international trade and strengthening the country’s role as a logistics hub for West Africa. The works included dredging a 5-km navigation channel, turning basin and berth pocket capable of accommodating the world’s largest container vessels. It was carried out using two of the world’s largest suction dredgers, underscoring the scale and technical complexity of the project. More than 95% of the material removed was solid rock, including formations with compressive strength exceeding 100 megapascals, far harder than those typically encountered in large-scale port developments. Despite these challenging geological conditions, the works were completed without blasting, reducing environmental impacts and allowing construction to progress safely. Mohammed Akoojee, CEO and Managing Director for Africa at DP World , said: “Completing major dredging works 13 months ahead of schedule is a significant milestone for the Port of Ndayane and a testament to the expertise, commitment and collaboration of everyone involved in delivering this project safely. This achievement allows us to accelerate the next phase of construction toward the port’s completion in 2028, while reinforcing our long-term commitment to Senegal and our confidence in Africa’s future as a growing force in global supply chains. As Senegal’s largest single private investment, this USD 1.2 billion project will create lasting economic value by strengthening trade, supporting jobs, improving connectivity and unlocking future growth opportunities across the region.” Clarence Rodrigues, CEO of DP World Dakar, said: “This achievement represents a pivotal moment in delivering transformational infrastructure for Senegal. The Port of Ndayane will enhance national competitiveness, unlock opportunities for local businesses, and drive sustainable job creation and skills development, supporting 2.3 million jobs through trade and improving access to critical goods and staples for 7.8 million people. We are proud to partner with the Government of Senegal and local stakeholders to establish a gateway for West Africa that positions Senegal as a premier logistics and trade hub, while delivering meaningful economic benefits to communities nationwide.” Construction is now focused on the next phase of marine and civil works as the project progresses towards completion in 2028. Since taking over operations in 2008, DP World has invested approximately US$ 340 million to modernise Senegal’s Port of Dakar terminal and expand its capacity. Container throughput has increased from 265,000 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs) in 2008 to 850,000 TEUs in 2025, while vessel waiting times have been reduced from 35 hours to near zero. It is now the highest-ranked port in Sub-Saharan Africa for efficiency, according to the World Bank’s Container Port Performance Index. With the Port of Dakar operating close to its physical limits, DP World and the Government of Senegal launched the Port of Ndayane project to create the country’s next-generation deep-water gateway for international trade. Located approximately 50 km from Dakar, the new port will enable future capacity expansion and more efficient inland logistics. Project Snapshot Originally scheduled for completion in September 2027, the dredging works concluded following the early mobilisation in December 2024, enabling critical civil works to begin significantly ahead of schedule. “Capital dredging is one of the most technically demanding phases of any port development,” said Juan Carlos Sahdala, Group Chief Planning & Project Officer . “Completing these works ahead of schedule reflects meticulous planning, outstanding execution and strong collaboration, enabling us to accelerate the marine and civil works that will bring the Port of Ndayane into operation in 2028.” The programme delivered a 5km access channel dredged to 20 metres, a 600m turning basin and an 875m berth pocket capable of accommodating two Triple E-class container vessels. Despite more than 95% of the dredged material being rock, the works were completed without blasting using advanced cutter suction dredging techniques. The project has also maintained rigorous environmental and social standards through continuous monitoring and stakeholder engagement, with 1,043 people currently employed on site.   DP World

items.title: Soccer stars find ‘a magical connection’ in the U.S.
items.description: During a match in Kansas City, Missouri, Algerian soccer fans show their appreciation for city of Lawrence, Kansas, where Algeria’s National Team practiced. (© Scott Winters/Icon Sportswire/Getty Images)   The dozens of international soccer teams that visited the United States this summer found more than just competition. U.S. cities that served as training camps for visiting teams rolled out the red carpet for the world’s best players and their traveling fans. Algeria’s National Team chose Lawrence, Kansas, for its base camp — the place it would live and train before and during the tournament — because of the college town’s outstanding facilities and proximity to Kansas City, where the team played two of its matches. As team members rolled into town, they heard their country’s national anthem thanks to Sharon Toulouse, director of athletic bands at the University of Kansas. She had recruited members of the university’s Marching Jayhawks band to rehearse the anthem and play it upon the Algerian team’s arrival. University of Kansas band members show their support for Algeria’s National Team. (© Sharon L. Toulouse/KU School of Music) Toulouse, who served in the U.S. military, tracked down a copy of the sheet music from the U.S. Army Band “Pershing’s Own.” Students wore Algerian scarves while playing the anthem for the Algerian players, and fans of the team who had come to watch practice sang along. “Any time I hear our national anthem, it means so much. I know it meant so much to them,” Toulouse said. “Our town just accepted them as their own.” Restaurants in Lawrence offered mint tea, an Algerian staple. And a local tourism bureau, eXplore Lawrence, hosted watch parties for Algeria’s matches. Ruth DeWitt, director of community relations at eXplore Lawrence, and her husband hosted a fan of the Algerian team who visited from Minnesota. Meanwhile, Algeria’s fans showed their gratitude with a banner displayed at one of the team’s matches. “It was a magical connection,” DeWitt says, adding that Lawrence is now looking to form a sister city relationship with a town in Algeria to continue the connection. “The joy and love between these communities has been valuable beyond any price tag.” Belgium National Team fans rally outside the stadium before a June 15 match in Seattle. (© Blake Dahlin/Imagn Images/Reuters) Some of the outpouring of hospitality came from fans with connections to visiting teams. Ferdane Bekmezci, of Bellevue, Washington, was so “jazzed up” when she learned her native Belgium’s national team would train near her adopted Seattle-area hometown that she organized a watch party and march to the stadium on match day. Fans of Team Belgium flocked together wearing matching face paint, jerseys and hats, she says, because soccer “is in the backbone of people” in Belgium. Bekmezci says she was also happy to see soccer gaining popularity in the United States, where she is now a citizen, and that before watching the two teams square off, she believed she would win either way. items.title: Sanctioning an Iranian Financial Evasion Network
items.description: Sanctioning an Iranian Financial Evasion Network Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson The United States is holding Babak Zanjani and his sprawling network accountable for enabling the Iranian regime to evade sanctions and finance its destabilizing activities, including supporting the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. This action applies further pressure on the Iranian regime following its attacks on commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz and regional neighbors. Today’s action targets four individuals and nine entities tied to Zanjani’s operations. Zanjani’s re-emergence as a regime-linked financier—despite previously receiving a death sentence in Iran for embezzlement—demonstrates the lengths to which Iranian state-affiliated elites will go to preserve access to the international financial system so that they can enrich themselves, even as they mismanage the Iranian economy. The United States calls on governments and financial institutions worldwide not to engage with entities connected to Zanjani or the broader networks that prop up Iran’s security apparatus. The Iranian regime is the world’s leading state sponsor of terror, and for more than 40 years has used the IRGC to foment instability in the region and beyond. We will continue to expose and disrupt networks that provide the regime and its proxies with the resources they use to undermine U.S. national security interests. Today’s action is being taken pursuant to Executive Order 13902, which targets Iran’s financial, petroleum, and petrochemical sectors to restrict revenue that could fund Iran’s nuclear, missile and terrorist activities. For more information on today’s action, please see the Department of the Treasury’s press release .

items.title: Somalia Summons Kenyan Ambassador Over Reported Entry Denial of Cabinet Ministers
items.description: MOGADISHU — The Federal Government of Somalia has summoned Kenya’s ambassador to Mogadishu following reports that several Somali cabinet ministers were denied entry into Kenya. The ambassador is expected to appear before Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday to provide clarification regarding the reported incident, according to official sources. The incident allegedly occurred at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, where several senior Somali government officials were reportedly prevented from entering the country upon arrival. Sources close to Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said the Kenyan ambassador had been formally summoned to explain the circumstances surrounding the incident and the reasons behind the decision to deny the Somali officials entry. The Somali government has not yet released the names of the ministers involved or disclosed the official purpose of their visit to Kenya. The development comes at a sensitive moment in relations between Somalia and Kenya, two neighbouring countries that maintain close political, economic and security ties despite periodic diplomatic tensions. Monday’s meeting is expected to focus on establishing the facts surrounding the incident, easing emerging tensions and determining the appropriate diplomatic steps to be taken by both governments. Kenyan authorities have not yet issued an official public statement regarding the reported denial of entry. items.title: Beesha caalamka oo digniin kama dambeys ah u dirtay Xasan Sheekh iyo mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa isa soo taraya walaaca ay qaar ka mid ah saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ka qabaan ismari-waaga siyaasadeed ee muddada dheer ka taagan Soomaaliya, iyadoo beesha caalamka ay farriin digniin ah gaarsiisay madaxda dowladda iyo mucaaradka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa loo gudbiyay farriintan oo ku saabsan muhiimadda ay leedahay in la gaaro heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay ka hor dhammaadka bisha August, sida ay sheegayaan ilo diblomaasiyadeed. Farriinta ayaa markii hore la gaarsiiyay mas’uul sare oo ka tirsan Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, ka hor inta aan si rasmi ah loogu gudbin Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Ilo-wareedyadu waxay tilmaameen in fariintaasi ay ka timid mid ka mid ah dalalka sida dhow u taageera Soomaaliya dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta iyo dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha dowladda. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in farriintu ay si cad u muujineyso walaaca sii kordhaya ee ay qabaan qaar ka mid ah dalalka taageera Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo aaminsan in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee daba dheeraaday uu wiiqi karo horumarka laga sameeyay dowlad-dhiska, dib-u-habeynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xasilloonida dalka. Sidoo kale, fariinta ayaa lagu sheegay in haddii madaxda Soomaalida ay ku guul-dareystaan inay toddobaadyada soo socda gaaraan heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, dib loo qiimeyn karo heerka taageerada caalamiga ah, oo ay ku jiraan maalgelinta mashaariicda horumarinta, iskaashiga siyaasadeed iyo barnaamijyada ay taageeraan deeq-bixiyeyaasha caalamiga ah. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in haddii ismari-waaga siyaasadeed uu sii socdo, dib loo eegi karo heerka xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee ay Soomaaliya la leedahay qaar ka mid ah saaxiibbadeeda caalamiga ah. Inkasta oo aan weli la shaacin tallaabooyin rasmi ah, haddana xogaha la helayo ayaa muujinaya in beesha caalamku ay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay weli ka taagan yihiin muranno la xiriira wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, kuwaas oo noqday qodobada ugu waaweyn ee hortaagan in la gaaro is-afgarad siyaasadeed oo ballaaran. Khilaafaadkaasi ayaa dib u dhigay dadaalladii lagu doonayay in la helo heshiis siyaasadeed oo saldhig u noqda geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka, dhameystirka dastuurka iyo dib-u-habeynta hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo dhinacyada siyaasadda ay weli ku kala aragti duwan yihiin qaabka loo wajahayo arrimahaasi. Muddooyinkii dambe, saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ayaa si isdaba joog ah ugu baaqayay madaxda iyo saamileyda siyaasadda Soomaaliya inay khilaafaadkooda ku xalliyaan wada-hadal iyo tanaasul, iyagoo ku adkeysanaya in heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay uu lama huraan u yahay xasilloonida dalka, hannaanka dowlad-dhiska iyo sii socoshada taageerada caalamiga ah. Suurtagalnimada in dib loo eego taageerada dibadda, la hakiyo gargaarka, ama la dhimo maalgelinta haddii aan xal siyaasadeed la helin ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan karta Soomaaliya oo inta badan ku tiirsan taageerada caalamiga ah. items.title: Wasiirka warfaafinta Somaliland oo beeniyay in la sii daayay maxaabiis
items.description: Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa beenisay wararka maalmihii u dambeeyay la isla dhexmarayay, ee sheegaayay in xukuumaddu ay sii daysay ama qorshaynayso inay sii dayso qaar ka mid ah maxaabiistii lagu kala qabsaday dagaalladii ka dhacay bari gobolka Sool sanadkii 2023. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Somaliland, Barkhad Jaamac Batuun, ayaa sheegay in aanay jirin wax maxaabiis ah oo la wareejiyay ama la qorsheynayo in la wareejiyo, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in arrinta maxaabiistu ay tahay go’aan u yaalla xukuumadda Somaliland. “Qadiyadda maxaabiista waa arrin u yaalla Xukuumadda Somaliland, meel maxaabiis lagu wareejiyey, haddana lagu wareejinayo, laguna wareejin doono ma jirto, ilaa iyo amar dowladeed iyo talo madaxweyne,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Barkhad. Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), uu wado qorshe lagu wajahayo xaaladda gobolka Sool oo ku saleysan nabad, wadahadal iyo xal u helidda tabashooyinka jira, halkii laga adeegsan lahaa waddooyin kale. “Xalinta howlaha gobolka Sool ka jira siyaasadda madaxweynaha iyo xukuumaduba waa in lagu wajaho hab nabadeed, wadahadal, xal raadin wixii tabasho ah ee jirta” ayuu sii raaciyey hadalkiisa. Hadalkan ayaa ku soo aadayaa iyadoo dhowaan ay soo baxeen warar sheegaya in Somaliland siidaysay ama qorshaynayso inay siidayso qaar ka mid ah maxaabiistii lagu kala qabsaday dagaaladii ka dhacay gobolka Sool

items.title: Waddani Party Chairman Meets Michael Rubin, Commends His Support for Somaliland
items.description: Chairman of the Republic of Somaliland’s ruling Waddani Party, Hon. Hersi Ali Hassan, yesterday, welcomed prominent American historian and foreign policy analyst Michael Rubin to his office, where the two held discussions on Somaliland and regional affairs. According to Chairman Hersi, Michael Rubin is a distinguished historian, a respected expert on the Middle East, the Horn of Africa, and international security affairs, as well as a longstanding friend of Somaliland. During the meeting, Chairman Hersi expressed his sincere appreciation for Rubin’s steadfast support for Somaliland and his continued efforts to strengthen international understanding of Somaliland’s case for re-recognition. He praised Rubin’s consistent advocacy and his valuable contributions to informed policy dialogue and international engagement on Somaliland, noting that his efforts have helped bring greater global attention to Somaliland’s democratic progress and aspirations for international recognition. The meeting reflects the ruling Waddani Party’s continued engagement with influential international policy experts and supporters as Somaliland advances its diplomatic outreach and pursuit of broader international recognition.

items.title: Buunbuuninta Al-Shabaab: Dano Dhaqaale, Siyaasadeed iyo Dagaal Nafsi ah
items.description: Muddo ka badan toban sano, qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha amniga ee ku kala sugan dibadda iyo gudaha dalka waxay si joogto ah u dhayalsanayeen adkaysiga shacabka iyo kartida Ciidamada Amniga Soomaaliyeed. Waxay qaadanayeen, qaybna ka ahaayeen, kas iyo kama’ba, sheekada kooxda al-Shabaab (AS), iyaga oo dhawr jeer saadaaliyay in caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho ay ku dhacayso gacanta kooxda. Tusaalaha ugu weyn waxa aynu u soo qaadan karnaa warbixinnadii la daabacay iyo warbaahintii faafisay xilligii uu socday dagaalkii caanka ahaa ee ay kooxda AS soo qaaday Ramadaankii 2010. Subaxnimadii 23kii Agoosto 2010, kooxda AS waxay soo qaaday duullaan ballaadhan oo ay ugu magacdartay “Nihaayatul Muctadiin”, dadkuse waxay u yaqaannaan Dagaalkii Ramadaanka, sababtoo ah bishii Ramadaan ayaa maraysay 12keedii. Boqolkiiba toddobaatan Muqdisho waxa gacanta ku haysay kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee AS, halka Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ee uu Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed madaxweyne ka ahaa ay keliya joogtay Madaxtooyada, gegida diyaaradaha iyo waddada isku xidha labadaas goobood. Haddaba, warbaahinta iyo xarumaha falanqaynta ee reer Galbeedku waxay soo saareen warbixinno iyo saadaallo isdabajoog ah oo u janjeeray dhinaca argaggaxisada, kuna doodayay in dawladda Soomaaliya ay ku dhowdahay inay gebi ahaanba meesha ka baxdo. Wargeyska caanka ah ee The New York Times ayaa 24kii Agoosto 2010 baahiyay warbixin aad u faaftay oo uu qoray suxufiga caanka ah ee Jeffrey Gettleman. Warbixintaas waxa cinwaan looga dhigay: “At Least 30 Killed in Attack on Hotel in Somalia”. Jeffrey wuxuu warbixintiisa ku falanqeeyay weerarkii khasaaraha badan dhaliyay ee ay laba ka mid ah inqimaasiyiinta kooxdu ku qaadeen Huteel Muna oo ku dhowaa xarunta Madaxtooyada. Jeffrey wuxuu si toos ah u sheegay in weerarkaas huteelku bannaanka keenay masiirka dhabta ah ee magaalada iyo sida ay u nugushahay dawladda Soomaaliya, isaga oo xilligaas ku sifeeyay in dawladda daciifka ahi ay dhawr tallaabo oo keliya u jirto inay gebi ahaanba burburto. Jeffrey wuxuu ka mid ahaa suxufiyiinta iyo saadaaliyayaasha rumaystay sheekadii kooxda ee ahayd in al-Shabaab, si ay ula wareegto Muqdisho, ay u baahan tahay muddo hal toddobaad ah oo keliya. Sidoo kale, wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters iyo telefishinka BBC-da ayaa baahiyay warbixinno dhawr ah oo ay ku sheegeen in Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ay ku go’doonsanayd dhawr goobood. Waxay adeegsanayeen falanqayntii hay’adda caalamiga ah ee International Crisis Group (ICG), taas oo saadaalisay in caasimaddu ku dhowdahay inay si buuxda u gasho gacanta kooxda. Sidoo kale, shirkadda falanqaynta sirdoonka ee Stratfor ayaa soo saartay qiimayn amni oo ay ku sheegtay in istiraatiijiyadda kooxda ee duullaanka Nihaayatul Muctadiin ay ahayd dharbaaxadii ugu dambaysay ee meesha ka saari lahayd dawladda fadhigeedu ahaa Villa Somalia. Haddaba, kaddib sannad xidhiidh ah oo uu dagaal ba’ani socday, 6dii Agoosto 2011, warbaahintii reer Galbeedka iyo wariyayaashii afkooda ku saadaalinayay in Muqdisho lala wareegayo, oo Jeffrey ugu horreeyay, ayaa qoray in kooxda AS gebi ahaanba laga saaray caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho. Tan iyo xilligaas, waxa muuqata in aanay cashar ka qaadan dhacdadaas, welina ay ku taagan yihiin dhabbadii khaldanayd. Falanqeeyayaashu waxay weli dhawrkii sannadoodba mar saadaaliyaan in kooxdu la wareegayso dalka. Tusaale ahaan, bishii Agoosto 2021, markii Daalibaan si buuxda ula wareegtay dalka Afgaanistaan, waxa soo baxay maqaallo dhawr ah oo ay qoreen xarumaha falanqaynta iyo warbaahinta caalamiga ahi, kuwaas oo si toos ah isugu barbardhigay Kaabul iyo Muqdisho. Warbixinnadaasi waxay saadaalinayeen in burburkii ku dhacay dawladdii Afgaanistaan uu si la mid ah ugu dhici karo dawladda Soomaaliya haddii ciidamada caalamiga ahi ay dalka ka baxaan. Mar kale, dhicitaankii dawladdii Bashaar Al-Asad ee dalka Suuriya bishii Diseembar 2024 wuxuu sababay in xarumo falanqayneed oo reer Galbeed ah, sida The Horn Institute, ay soo saaraan warbixinno ay isku dayayaan inay Soomaaliya la barbardhigaan Suuriya. Warbixinnadaasi waxay ku doodeen in, haddii ciidamada caalamiga ahi dalka ka baxaan, dawladdu u burburi karto si la mid ah sidii nidaamkii Dimishiq ugu burburay dhawr maalmood gudahood. Mar kalana, duullaankii ay kooxda AS soo qaadday horraantii 2025, ee ay ku qabsatay Aadanyabaal, ayaa haddana si la mid ah loo saadaaliyay in sannadkaas aanay dawladda Soomaaliya sii jiri karin. Caadi ahaan, sheekada ah in ciidamada shisheeye haddii ay baxaan ay kooxdu dalka maalmo gudahood ku qabsan karto, muddo badan waxa iibinaysay argaggaxisada, waxaana sii buunbuuninayay warbaahinta reer Galbeedka. Hasayeeshee, sheekadaas waxa buriyay oo beeniyay duullaankii ay dawladdu ku qaadday kooxda AS sannadihii 2022–2023 ee gobollada dhexe, kaas oo aanu la socon hal askari oo AMISOM ahi. In kasta oo duullaankaasi wax badan ka qaldanaayeen istiraatiijiyad ahaan iyo nidaam ahaanba, haddana jug culus ayuu arggaxisada gaarsiiyay; dhul badan ayaa laga qabsaday, saraakiil badanna waa looga dilay. Guusha ugu weynina waxay noqotay burinta sheekadii muddada dheer lagu celcelinayay ee ahayd in dawladdani aanay ka dambayn doonin bixitaanka AMISOM, iyo jebinta darbigii weynaa ee cabsida ahaa ee lagu sheegay in kooxda AS aan la iska dhicin karin. Haddaba, weydiinta mudan in la istoydo waxay tahay: waa ayo cidda ay saadaashani anfacayso, yayse faa’iido u tahay? Waxaa iska cad in saadaashani u adeegayso dano dhaqaale iyo kuwo siyaasadeed oo keliya ku sii jiri kara jiritaanka kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab. Marka kowaad, waxay u adeegaysaa mashaariicda amniga ee lagu soo qaato magaca ah in argaggixiso lala dagaallamayo. Xarumaha falanqaynta iyo qandaraaslayaasha amniga ee reer Galbeedku waxay u baahan yihiin in khatarta al-Shabaab had iyo jeer la weyneeyo, laguna sifeeyo mid maalin kasta caasimadda qabsan karta, si ay u sii socoto helitaanka maalgelinta iyo miisaaniyado malaayiin doollar ah oo lagu bixiyo barnaamijyada “ladagaallanka argaggixisada”. Marka labaad, saadaashani waxay si toos ah ugu adeegaysaa kooxda AS oo u adeegsata borobagaando iyo dagaal nafsi ah. Kooxdu waxay soo xigataa qoraallada iyo saadaalaha fashilma ee reer Galbeedka, si ay u wiiqdo kalsoonida shacabka, cabsi ugu geliso bulshada, una disho niyadda askarta geesiyaasha ah ee ku jira furimaha dagaalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, masiirka iyo amniga Soomaaliya kuma xidhna saadaalaha miisaska dushooda lagu qoro ee danaha dhaqaale laga leeyahay, waxayse ku xiran yihiin dhiigga iyo geesinimada Ciidamada Amniga Qaranka iyo go’aanka aan la loodin karin ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Somaliland oo shaacisay sida lagu sii deyn karo maxaabiista ay ka hayso Waqooyi Bari
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Somaliland, Barkhad Jaamac Batuun oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Hargeysa ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan xaaladda Gobolka Sool iyo maxaabiista lagu qabtay dagaalkii Laascaanood ee weli ku jira gacantooda. Barkhad Jaamac Batuun ayaa marka hore beeniyay in ay jiraan maxaabiis lasii daayay, wuxuuna sheegay in arrintaas ay u taallo xukuumadda oo kaliya, isla markaana iyada uun wax laga waydiin doono. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in hadda qorshaha aysan ugu jirin sii deynta maxaabiista, balse wuxuu shaaciyay in lagu fasixi karo oo kaliya go’aan dowladeed iyo talo Madaxweyne, maadaama dagaal lagu soo qabtay. “Arrinka maxaabiistu waa arrin u yaalla xukuumadda oo aan u oolin cid kale siyaasadda xukuumadduna waa mid cad meel maxaabiis lagu wareejiyay, haddana lagu wareejinaayo ama lagu wareejin doono ma jirto, illaa la helo amar dowladeed iyo talo Madaxweyne,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale shacabka Somaliland ugu baaqay inay ka feejignaadaan wararka been abuurka ah iyo wax kasta oo wax u dhimi kara wadajirkooda iyo deganaashahooda. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in siyaasadda xukuumadda Somaliland ee gobolka Sool ay tahay in lagu wajaho nabad, isla markaana uu garwadeen ka yahay Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullahi (Cirro). “Xukuumadda Somaliland siyaasadda uu Madxweynuhu ku hoggaaminayo ee garwadeenka ugu yahay gobolka Sool waxa ay tahay in Madaxweynaha arrintaas uu ku wajaho hab nabad ah,” ayuu markale yiri Barkhaad Baatuun. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo shalay xubnaha Golaha Wakiilada Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ay qaraar kasoo saareen maxaabiista Somaliland ee ku xiran Laascaanood, iyaga oo Madaxweynaha ka dalbaday inuu dhiso Maxkamadda Ciidan, si maxaabiista loo saaro, looguna xisaabtamo dambiyada ay galeen. The post Somaliland oo shaacisay sida lagu sii deyn karo maxaabiista ay ka hayso Waqooyi Bari appeared first on Caasimada Online .
