items.title: US and Iran pause their attacks after days of escalation
items.description: CAIRO (AP) — The United States and  Iran  paused their attacks for a second straight day Sunday, as efforts continued to bring them back to negotiations on an  interim ceasefire deal  largely undermined by recent exchanges of fire. It was not clear  why the U.S. has paused  after targeting Iranian coastal areas and infrastructure in a nearly two-week escalation sparked by Iran’s firing at ships trying to transit the Strait of Hormuz. The Pentagon did not respond to questions. U.S. President Donald Trump is “giving talks some space. He’s giving it a little bit of room,” Mike Waltz, the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, told Fox News. “We’ve had both Oman and Iran, and a number of our other negotiators, engaged at every level, from the most senior levels all the way down to the technical level over the past few weeks, and particularly in the past few days.” Waltz dismissed the idea that the U.S. stockpile of interceptors crucial in defending against Iranian attacks is running low, but experts have questioned how long both the U.S. and Iran can afford to keep up attacks. Since the U.S. has halted attacks for the past two nights, Iran has as well, its army spokesperson told Iran’s state TV on Sunday. Tehran in recent days has counterattacked against countries in the region hosting U.S. military forces, killing at least three  service members  at a base in Jordan and one in Iraq. A regional official calls the pause a ‘positive signal’ The 60-day period that began when the interim deal was signed by both countries in mid-June is now well into its second half, and major issues that were meant to be negotiated -– notably  Iran’s nuclear program  at the heart of tensions -– remain set aside as mediators try to keep both sides talking. A regional official involved in mediation efforts said diplomacy was underway and that a pause in U.S. and Iranian strikes was a “positive signal that helps their efforts to de-escalate.” The official said both countries want to return to the interim ceasefire deal and that a compromise being negotiated centers on having Iran run vessel transit through the Strait of Hormuz with fewer restrictions on ships. The official was not authorized to discuss the matter and spoke on condition of anonymity. Shipping traffic on the strait is at a 3-week low Concerns continued about shipping on the strait and now on another crucial waterway in the region, the  Bab al-Mandeb strait  to the Red Sea. Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen last week threatened a blockade of Saudi shipping there. Global energy supplies and the economy remain in the balance as  gasoline prices have risen again . Commercial shipping traffic on the Strait of Hormuz was at a three-week low, a maritime body overseen by the U.S. Navy said Sunday, adding that no new attacks had been confirmed in the past 72 hours. It said traffic remained steady through the Bab el-Mandeb. Iran on Sunday said it continued to speak with Oman about managing the safe passage of ships on the Strait of Hormuz, which passes between the countries. Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Esmail Baghaei, said talks had made progress and continued. Baghaei also said the strait’s status remained unchanged. Tehran has asserted that the interim deal with the U.S. allows it to manage shipping on the waterway for now, and it has objected to U.S. efforts to support a route through the strait that passes close to Oman instead. The strait was considered an international waterway before the war. The U.S. military on Saturday said its recently reimposed naval blockade against Iran continued, with a dozen commercial ships redirected, two disabled and two boarded. U.S. forces “remain highly vigilant, focused, lethal, and ready,” it added. Netanyahu says he ‘fully’ backs Trump’s efforts Meanwhile, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to travel to the United States and meet with Trump in Washington on Tuesday, his office has said. They last met in Washington in February, weeks before they  launched the war  on Iran that killed senior leaders including Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The Iranian-backed Hezbollah fired at Israel two days after the war began, and Israel responded with airstrikes and ground forces in southern Lebanon. Since then, the U.S. has supported landmark direct talks between Lebanon and Israel to try to calm that front and find a way to disarm Hezbollah. Netanyahu on Sunday told Fox News he “fully” backs Trump’s efforts to weaken Iran and press it to end its nuclear program, adding: “If he can do so without returning to intense military fighting, that’s fine. Why not?” The prime minister indicated he would not present new information to “our good friend” Trump and instead would listen to “what he has in mind, because I think in many ways, it’s his decision.” But Netanyahu warned that if Iran again attacks Israel, directly or with armed proxies, “it will make a terrible mistake.” Source: AP The post US and Iran pause their attacks after days of escalation appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay xiisadda Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Indhaha dunida ayaa waxay ku sii jeedaan Badda Cas, ka dib markii ay dib u bilowdeen, isla-markaana ay cirka isku shareereen xiisadaha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga iyo Ururka Xuutiyiinta ee ka arrimiya inta badan dhulka Yemen. Xaaladdan cusub ayaa timid, ka dib markii Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay go’doomin badeed ku soo rogeen Dekedaha Sacuudiga, isla-markaana ay maraakiibta boqortooyada ka mamnuuceen inay adeegsadaan Badda Cas iyo marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab El-Mandeb, iyadoona Sacuudigu uu sheegay inay qaadayaan dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah, si loo ilaaliyo maaakiibta ganacsiga. Xiisadda labada dhinac ayaa cirka isku shareertay, ka dib duqaymihii ay diyaaradaha dagaalka Sacuudiga habeenkii Jimcaha ka gaysteen Magaalada Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran ee Galbeedka Yemen iyo weeraradii daba socday ee ay Xuutiyiinta Sabtidii ku qaadeen xarumaha ay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ku leedahay Magaalooyinka Jizan iyo Yanbu ee dalkaasi Sacuudiga. Weeraradan ugu dambeeyay ayaa ka dhigan ballaaran cusub oo ku aaddan dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo weerarada Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta ay carqaladeynayaan isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo saamayn togan ku leh Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ayaa 20-kii bishan ka mamnuucay inay maraan maraakiibta Sacuudiga, taas oo Sacuudigu uu sheegay inaysan ogolaan doonin. Xiisaddan ayaa waxaa sal u ah weerar 13-kii bishan lagu qaaday Garoonka Diyaaradaha Sanca, taasoo ay Xuutiyiinta ku eedeeyeen inuu gaystay Sacuudiga. Duqayntan ayaa lagu hor istaagay diyaarad ay Iran leedahay oo ka degan rabtay garoonkaasi. Toddobaadkii xigay, taariikhdu markay ahayd 20-kii July, Xuutiyiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay cunaqabatayn ka dhan ah Sacuudiga, oo lagu hor istaagayo maraakiibta ku sii jeeda dekedaha dalkaasi iyo kuwa kale ee ka imanaya. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in Ciidamada Yemen ay Arbacadii Badda Cas ku gubeen laba markab oo nooca shidaalka qaada ah, isla-markaana laga leeyahay Sacuudiga, wuxuuna sababta weerarka ku sheegay inay ku xadgudbeen cunaqabataynta badda ee ay ku soo rogeen dekedaha dalkaasi, tanina waxay keentay in Sacuudigu uu weerar xagga cirka ah ku qaado Magaalada Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran. Afhayeenka Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen, General Turki Al Maliki ayaa sheegay in duqaymahaasi lagu beegsaday kaabeyaasha militari ee Xuutiyiinta ku leeyihiin Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran, kuwaas oo uu sheegay in loo adeegsanayay in lagu khatar geliyo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ku gooshaya Badda Cas. General Turki Al Maliki ayaa Xuutiyiinta ugu yeeray inay joojiyaan weerarada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta, haddii kalena ay kala kulmi doonaan cawaaqib daran. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo aan dhageysanin digniintaasi ayaa saacado ka dib garaacay warshadaha wax soosaarka tamarta ee ku yaala Jizan iyo Yanbu. General Yahya Saree, Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Yemen ay bartilmaameedsadeen ilaha dhaqaalaha ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyadoo laga jawaabayo gardarrada Riyadh, oo uu ula jeedo duqaymihii laga gaystay Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran. General Yahya Saree ayaa ku hanjabay inay sii wadi doonaan weerarada ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga, illaa iyo inta uu ka joojinayo xadgudubyada ka dhanka ah muwaadiniinta Yemen iyo madaxbannaanida dalkaasi. Lama oga tallaabooyinka xiga ee Sacuudigu uu qaadi doono, oo noqon kara jawaab adag oo militari, xoojinta difaaca shidaalka iyo taageerada Dowladda Yemen amaba in ay heshiis nabadeed la galaan Xuutiyiinta. Khubarada dhanka militariga ayaa qaba in Sacuudigu uu noqon doono kan khasaaraha ugu weyn uu soo gaari doono, haddii uu go’aansado in dagaal buuxa lala galo Xuutiyiinta.

items.title: Puntland Accuses President Hassan Sheikh of Destabilization as Rift with Mogadishu Deepens
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – Puntland has sharply escalated its confrontation with Somalia’s Federal Government, accusing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of pursuing military activities that it says threaten the security, stability, and constitutional autonomy of the Puntland State. In a strongly worded statement issued, the Puntland administration alleged that the Federal Government is orchestrating military deployments inside Puntland without the consent of regional authorities, describing the moves as a direct challenge to Puntland’s governance and security institutions. The administration further declared that it does not recognize any security forces registered by the Federal Government within Puntland’s territory, insisting that no force identified as the Puntland Security Force (PSF) forms part of Puntland’s legally recognized security apparatus. The statement reflects the growing distrust that has come to define relations between Garowe and Mogadishu, with Puntland accusing the Federal Government of attempting to establish parallel military structures inside the state. Puntland also issued a warning to neighboring Galmudug State, urging its authorities not to allow their territory or airports to be used for the transfer of weapons, armed personnel, or militia forces that could contribute to the escalating tensions. As of publication, neither Somalia’s Federal Government nor the Galmudug administration had publicly responded to Puntland’s allegations. The latest accusations come in the aftermath of recent armed clashes in the Laag area between Puntland forces and fighters associated with the PSF, an incident that further exposed the increasingly fragile security environment in northeastern Somalia. The dispute unfolds against a backdrop of a much broader political crisis between Puntland and Mogadishu. items.title: Golaha Wakiillada Waqooyi Bari oo amray in maxkamad la horkeeno xubnaha xiran ee kasoo jeddda Somaliland
items.description: Golaha Wakiillada Dowladda Waqooyi Bari ee Soomaaliya ayaa soo saaray go’aan rasmi ah oo ku taariikhaysan 26-ka Luulyo 2026, kaas oo ku saabsan habraaca sharci ee dadka u xiran dowladda. Goluhu wuxuu faray Xukuumadda Dowladda Waqooyi Bari inay si degdeg ah maxkamad awood u leh u horkeento dhammaan dadka ku xiran xabsiyada dowladda ee lagu eedeeyay dambiyada la xiriira amniga, argagixisada iyo dambiyada kale, si dacwadahooda loogu qaado si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo shuruucda dalka. Sidoo kale, Golaha Wakiilladu wuxuu adkeeyay in dacwadahaasi loo fuliyo si hufan, caddaalad ah, lana dhowro dhammaan xuquuqaha uu sharcigu dammaanad qaaday eedeysanayaasha inta uu socdo habraaca garsoorka. Golaha ayaa sheegay in go’aankan uu salka ku hayo ilaalinta caddaaladda, sareynta sharciga iyo dhowrista xuquuqda shacabka.

items.title: Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Saciid Deni waxaan leeyahay ha ku daba dhiman Imaaraadka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Sheekh Cali Maxamuud Xasan (Wajiis) oo kamid ah culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan xaaladda Puntland oo haatan laga dareemayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeedo. Ugu horreyn Sheekh Cali Wajiis ayaa weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweyne Saciid Deni, isaga oo ugu baaqay inuu ka haro Imaaraadka Carabta oo uu weli la leeyahay xiriir xooggan, xilli ay horay dalka uga cayrisay dowladda dhexe. Sheekha ayaa sheegay in Imaaraadka uu kusoo fashilmay dowladihii iyo ururradii uu horay xiriirka ula yeeshay, isla markaana siyaasad ahaan looga adkaaday dhammaan waddamadii uu ka howlgalay. “Walaalkey Saciid Deni waxaan leeyahay ha ku daba dhiman Imaaraad oo gabalkiisu dhacay oo Suudaan laga saaray, Liibiya laga saaray, Yemen laga saaray oo Suuriya laga saaray. Soomaaliyana waa laga saaraa,” ayuu wareysiga ku yiri Sheekha. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday dhaq-dhaqaaqa ciidan ee haatan u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka, isaga oo xusay in Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay xaq u leeyihiin inay ka howlgalaan magaalooyinka waa wayn maamulkaas iyo guud ahaan dalka. “Milatariga Soomaaliya Gaalkacyo ha joogaano ama Garoowe, Boosaaso iyo Xaafuun ha joogaane xaq waa u leeyihiin in dowladda Soomaaliya u tegto hub iyo rasaas siiso, ilaaliso jiritaankooda,” ayuu mar kale yiri Sheekh Cali Wajiis. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay “Yaan la weerarin milatariga yaan hub laga qaadanin oo dhibaato la gelin haloo aqoonsado ciidan qaran oo meesha jooga inuu yahay, wada-hadalkana hala galo oo siyaasiyiinta Garoowe ha’isugu tagaano ama Xamar ha isugu yimaadaano”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo goor sii horreysay oo maanta ah ay Puntland soo saartay warsaxaafadeed ay ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, sidoo kalena loogu digay maamulka ay dariska yihiin ee Galmudug. Puntland ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu wado dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo lagu hurinayo colaado, laguna wiiqayo nidaamka dowladnimo ee Puntland, halka ay Galmudug ygu baaqday in aysan garoomadeeda diyaaradaha iyo dhulka ay maamusho u oggolaan in laga soo gudbiyo saanad ciidan, hub iyo maleeshiyaad ay Puntland sheegtay in loo adeegsan karo weerarro ama qalqal-gelin ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda. The post Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Saciid Deni waxaan leeyahay ha ku daba dhiman Imaaraadka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Waqooyi Bari oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta maxaabiista Somaliland iyo xildhibaanadi…
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa maanta qaaday tallaabo culus oo la xiriirta maxaabiista Somaliland ee weli ku xiran magaalada Laascaanood iyo Xildhibaannadii xalay iska casilay Baarlamaanka maamulkaas, kadib warsaxaafadeed ay soo saareen. Xildhibaannadaas oo kala ah 1-Makhtal Siciid Maxamuud 2-Cabdisalaan Cabdillaahi Cabdiraxmaan 3-Sidiiq Jaamac Muuse 4-Axmed Cali Maxamed 5-Axmed Caabi Xasan, ayaa sheegay in maamulka uu ka leexday ujeeddooyinkii loo aasaasay, sidaas darteedna ay isaga casileen xububinnimadii golaha. Baarlamaanka Waqooyi Bari ayaa maanta kulan aan caadi ahayn ka yeeshay arrinta 5-ta Xildhibaan oo lagu eedeeyay qiyaano qaran, iyaga oo kadib ku sameeyay maamuus ka xayuubin, waxaana ogolaaday 57 Mudane oo ka tirsan Golaha, sida uu ku dhawaaqay guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka, Mudane Aadan Cabdullaahi Aw-Xasan. Sidoo kale, Xildhibaannada ayaa ka shiray sida laga yeelayo maxaabiista gacanta ku jirta ee laga qabtay Somaliland, intii uu socday dagaalkii ka dhacay magaalada Laascaanood ee uu dhiigga faraha badan ku daatay. Xildhibaan Maxamed Nuur oo ka tirsan Golaha Wakiilada Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa wareysi uu siiyay Telefishinka Universal ku faah-faahiyay kalankooda, wuxuuna farriin u diray shacabka oo uu ugu baaqay inay ilaashadaan midnimadooda, ayna muujiyaan feejignaan dheeri ah. “Waxaa saaka halkan ka dhacay kulan aan caadi ahayn oo ku saabsan Xildhibaanno aan saaxib ahayn oo hadda aaday dhankaas waqooyi galbeed (Somaliland) sida ay xoguhu sheegayaan, waxaan bulshada halkan uga soo jeedineynaa in Xildhibaan tegay labo iyo saddex aysan macno lahayn, laakiin bulshada ay muujiyaan feejignaan iyo deganaan,” ayuu yiri Maxamed Nuur. Sidoo kale, wuxuu Madaxweyne Firdhiye ugu baaqay inuu soo dhiso Maxkamadda Ciidamada, si maxaabiista loo soo saaro, looguna xisaabtamo dambiga ay galeen. “Maxaabiistu waa maxaabiis dagaal lagu qabtay, waana maxaabiistii magaaladan dhibaateysay oo wixii la ogaa gaystay. Madaxweynaha waxaan ugu baaqeynaa in Maxkamadda Ciidamada uu soo dhiso, si loo maxkamadeeyo ragga xiran,” ayuu mar kale yiri Xildhibaanku. Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa haatan waxaa kala furfur ku haysa Somaliland, iyada oo dhawaan ay tegtay Xildhibaan Fahiima Yuusuf Quuje oo maalmo kahor lagu soo dhaweeyay magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimada maamulkaasi.   The post Waqooyi Bari oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta maxaabiista Somaliland iyo xildhibaanadi… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: John Cena oo u tartamaya siduu u helo qaraxa nukliyeerka ee ‘Matchbox’
items.description: John Cena ayaa ku soo baxay filimkiisa cusub ee ‘Matchbox The Movie’ isagoo ah wakiil sir ah oo CIA ah, kaas oo saaxiibadiis ku tuulaya halis caalami ah kadib markii qarax nukliyeer uu lumo. Filimkan oo ay soo saartay Apple TV+, waxaa lagu soo bandhigay muqaalkiisa ugu horreeyay shirkii San Diego Comic-Con ee maalintii Sabtida, waxaanu si rasmi ah uga furmi doonaa Adeegga Apple TV+ bisha Oktoobar 9, 2026 . Filimkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah wuxuu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Mattel Studios uga sii dhowaanayso soo saarista filimaan ku saleysan alaabteeda caanka ah, iyadoo la raacayo guushii weyneyd ee ‘Barbie’ ee 2023 . Filimkan waxaa agaasimay Sam Hargrave, oo caan ku ah filimada ‘Extraction’, waxaana qoray David Coggeshall . Sheekada filimku waxay ku saabsan tahay koox asxaab ah oo ku soo koraay wada ciyaarka baabuurta yaryar ee Matchbox, kuwaas oo markay weynaadaan ay ogaadaan in hoggaamiyihii hore, Sean (Cena), uu yahay wakiil sir ah oo CIA ah. Noloshiisa qarsoon ayaa kooxda ku tuulaysa howl caalami ah oo ay ku doonayaan inay badbaadiyaan adduunka kadib markii qarax nukliyeer uu lumo . Cena ayaa ku yidhi muqaalka: “Qarax nukliyeer ayaa lumay. CIA waxay u maleynaysaa inay aniga ihaayey – ama innaga.” Jessica Biel, oo jilaysa saaxiibadii hore, ayaa soo jeedisay qorshe aan fududayn: “Waxaan u baahanahay inaan dib u xanno bambaanada si aan u soo celinno nololihiinna” . Filimkan waxaa jilaya jilayaal caan ah oo ay ka mid yihiin Jessica Biel, Arturo Castro, Sam Richardson, Teyonah Parris, Danai Gurira, Golshifteh Farahani, Corey Stoll iyo Bill Camp . Waxaa soo saaray Skydance Media iyo Mattel Studios, waxaana soo saareyaal ka mid ah David Ellison, Dana Goldberg, Don Granger, Robbie Brenner, Ynon Kreiz iyo Jules Daly . The post John Cena oo u tartamaya siduu u helo qaraxa nukliyeerka ee ‘Matchbox’ first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Ukraine oo daandaansi ku bilowday Iraan kadibna…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Ukraine ayaa saacadihii dambe ee Sabtidii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerartay markab ganacsi oo ay leedahay Iiraan oo marayay biyaha xiran ee Caspian, wuxuuna weerarkan dhaliyay dhimashada hal badmaax ,halka mid kalena uu ku dhaawacmay, iyadoo weerarkan uu ka caraysiiyay Iiraan. Weerarka ka dib, Iiraan ayaa si adag u cambaaraysay. Waxaa lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed maanta ka soo baxay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Iiraan inaysan Iiraan gacmaha laaban doonin oo ay ka jawaabi doonto. Sidoo kale, waxay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Iiraan u yeertay madaxa ergada siyaasadeed ee Ukraine u fadhiya Tehran. Illaa hadda Ukraine kama aysan hadlin sababta ay u fulisay weerarkan. Muxuu muhiim ugu yahay Iiraan marinka Caspian? Badda Caspian waa biyaha ugu waaweyn adduunka ee xiran oo aan bad kale ku xirnayn. Inkastoo loogu yeero bad, hadana waxaa loo aqoonsanyahay haro aad u weyn oo cusbo leh. Waxay ku taallaa inta u dhaxaysa Yurub iyo Aasiya, waxaana ku hareeraysan shan dal, Ruushka oo kaga yeel jihada waqooyi-galbeed, Kazakhstan (waqooyi-bari),Turkmenistan (koonfur-bari) ,Iiraan (koonfur) iyo Azerbaijan (galbeed). Badda Caspian waxay leedahay muhiimad istiraatiiji ah oo aad u weyn,sababtoo ah waa marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga u dhexeeya Ruushka, Bartamaha Aasiya iyo Iiraan. Waxay noqotay marin ay Iiraan ku hesho ganacsi iyo saadka dhinaca waqooyi,halkaa oo ah marinka sida tooska ah Iiraan ugu xira Ruushka, waxaana loo arkaa sirta ka dambeysa adkaysiga Iiraan ee cunaqabateynta saaran muddada 45 sanno ah,maaddama aysan saameyn ku lahayn Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa reer galbeedka,xilligaana in carqalad ay kala kulanto Iiraan waxaa loo arkaa jiho kale oo dagaal loogu furayo, iyadoo weerarka hadda dhacay uu muujinayo inay Ukraine isku dayayso saameyn inay ku yeelato cadaadiska la saarayo Iiraan , si ay taageerro uga hesho Mareykanka oo ku dhibtoonaya dagaalka Iiraan uu kula jiro. Waxayna Ukraine u diraysa Mareykanka farriin ay ugu sheegayso; haddii aad ku dhibtoonayso marinnada ay xirtay Iiraan , waxaan kuu haya xal lagu daciifin karo Iiraan oo keliya Ukraine ay sameyn karto! Iiraan waxay marinnada badda cas u adeegsataa Xuutiyiinta, isla sidoo kale ayay Ukraine isugu soo bandhigaysa inay u sameyn karto Mareykanka oo ay heli karto goob ay Iiraan ku cadaadiso. Iska horimaad kasta oo dhexmara Iiraan iyo Ukraine, sidoo kale wuxuu quseeyaa Ruushka , maaddama Iiraan ay Ruushka ka taageerto dagaalka uu kula jiro Ukraine ,taasoo dhalisay marar badan inay Ukraine ku eedeyso Iiraan inay si toos ah ugu lug leedahay dagaalka oo agabkeeda militari lagu soo weerarro dhulka Ukraine. Iiraan ma awoodda inay weerartay gudaha Ukraine? Haddii biyaha Caspian, lagu sheegi karo wadnaha ganacsiga iyo sahayda Iiraan , waxa la is waydiin karo ayaa ah inay tallaabo aargoosi ah Iiraan qaadi doonto iyo in kale. Masuuliyiinta Iiraan ayaa sida maanta ay baahisay Al Jazeera, waxay sheegayaan in taasi farsamo ahaan ay suurtagal tahay, maadaama masaafada u dhexeysa caasimadda Iiraan ee Tehran iyo caasimadda Ukraine ee Kyiv ay ka yar tahay 2,000 km, taasoo ay sheegeen inay tahay masaafo ay gaari karaan gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iiraan Xigasho; Iman Jama The post Ukraine oo daandaansi ku bilowday Iraan kadibna… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland Declares PSF Has No Legal Status as Rift Over Security Forces Deepens
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – Puntland’s Presidency has issued a categorical declaration that no security force operating under the name Puntland Security Force (PSF) has any legal status within the state’s official defense structure, underscoring the widening political and military rift over competing chains of command inside the region. In a statement released late Tuesday, the Puntland administration sought to end growing public debate over the force’s legal standing. “The Puntland Government clarifies that there is no force known as the PSF that legally forms part of Puntland’s defense forces,” the presidential statement said. The declaration comes amid heightened tensions following recent armed confrontations between Puntland security forces and fighters identifying themselves as PSF, the latest of which erupted last week in the Laag area near Bosaso. Contradicting Local Elders The Presidency’s statement directly contradicts a declaration issued a day earlier by several respected elders from Mudug, Galkacyo region (the Osman Mahmoud clan), who insisted that the PSF remains a legitimate component of Puntland’s security institutions. The elders also announced that they were mediating between President Said Abdullahi Deni and the PSF leadership in an effort to prevent further clashes and restore dialogue. The conflicting statements have highlighted the deep divisions surrounding the future of the force and the broader security architecture of Puntland. The controversy dates back to November 24, 2021, when President Deni dismissed then-PSF commander Gen. Mohamud Osman Diyaano following a bitter power struggle that triggered one of Puntland’s most serious internal security crises. Several months later, in March 2022, Deni reorganized the force by appointing Diyaano to lead the newly established Puntland Security Commando Forces (PSCF) while restructuring the broader security apparatus into separate formations, including the Puntland Intelligence and Special Forces (PISF). Despite those reforms, disagreements over command, legitimacy, and operational authority have continued to fuel recurring confrontations. Security Tensions Escalate The Puntland government and fighters operating under the PSF banner have clashed on multiple occasions over the past several years. Their latest confrontation in Laag once again exposed the fragile security environment and the unresolved dispute over who has the legal authority to command armed forces within Puntland. Political observers warn that the Presidency’s latest declaration is likely to deepen an already polarized debate, particularly as influential clan elders continue to advocate dialogue while government officials insist that only state-recognized security institutions can legally operate inside Puntland. With trust between the rival sides deteriorating and security tensions remaining high, analysts caution that resolving the dispute will require more than military measures. A lasting settlement, they argue, will depend on a political agreement capable of addressing the competing claims of legitimacy that continue to divide Puntland’s security establishment. items.title: Renewed Clan Fighting Erupts in Sanaag as Peace Efforts Continue to Falter
items.description: Erigavo (WDN) – Fresh clan fighting erupted on Tuesday in the Laashimo area near Erigavo in Somalia’s Sanaag region, underscoring the persistence of a conflict that has repeatedly defied mediation efforts and left communities trapped in an apparently endless cycle of violence. According to local reports, the latest clashes resulted in deaths and injuries, although the exact casualty figures have not yet been independently verified. The renewed fighting comes only days after Puntland authorities withdrew security forces that had been stationed in the area, where they had been positioned between militias from the two rival clans in an effort to prevent further bloodshed. The timing of the withdrawal has raised fresh concerns about the fragile security situation in the region, with fears that the absence of a neutral security presence may have contributed to the rapid resurgence of hostilities. A member of the Puntland Parliament appealed to both sides to immediately halt the fighting and embrace dialogue, warning that continued violence would only deepen the suffering of local communities and further destabilize the region. The conflict in Laashimo is the latest chapter in a long-running series of clan confrontations that have repeatedly erupted despite numerous reconciliation initiatives. Residents say each new outbreak not only claims lives but also displaces families, disrupts livelihoods, and deepens mistrust between neighboring communities. Puntland authorities and traditional elders have increasingly faced criticism from local residents and community leaders, who argue that efforts to secure a lasting political and traditional settlement have fallen short. Critics say temporary ceasefires have repeatedly collapsed because the underlying grievances driving the conflict remain unresolved. As the latest violence unfolds, many residents fear that without a comprehensive reconciliation process backed by sustained security guarantees, the cycle of retaliation will continue, leaving the Sanaag region vulnerable to further instability. With no confirmed breakthrough in mediation efforts and both communities remaining heavily armed, the prospects for lasting peace remain uncertain, reinforcing concerns that one of Puntland’s most persistent clan conflicts is far from over. items.title: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Ilaalinta Nidaamdegaaneedka Mangaroofka
items.description: Sannad kasta 26ka Luulyo, dunidu waxay xustaa Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Ilaalinta Nidaamdegaaneedka Mangaroofka . Maalintan waxaa sannadkii 2015 si rasmi ah u ansixisay hay’adda UNESCO, si kor loogu qaado wacyiga caalamiga ah ee ku saabsan muhiimadda kaymaha mangaroofka iyo baahida loo qabo ilaalintooda. Mangaroofku wuxuu ka mid yahay nidaamdegaaneedyada xeebaha ugu qiimaha badan dunida. Inkasta oo kaymahani ay daboolaan qeyb yar oo ka mid ah oogada dhulka, haddana doorka ay ku leeyihiin ilaalinta xeebaha, kaydinta kaarboonka, kobcinta noolaha badda iyo taageeridda nololmaalmeedka bulshooyinka xeebaha waa mid aad u ballaaran. Dhanka kale, mangaroofku wuxuu ka mid yahay nidaamdegaaneedyada sida weyn khatarta u wajahaya, maadaama jarista dhirta, ballaarinta magaalooyinka xeebaha, wasakhowga hawada, daaqsinka xoolaha iyo isbeddelka cimiladu ay faro ba’an ku hayaan. Waa maxay mangaroofku? Mangaroofku waa geedo iyo dhir gaagaaban oo ka baxa xeebaha ku yaalla dhulka kulaylaha iyo kulaylxigeenka ah. Waxaa badanaa laga helaa dhulka dhoobada ah ee ay biyaha baddu ku soo noqnoqdaan iyo meelaha ay ku kulmaan biyaha macaan iyo biyaha cusbadu. Soomaalidu mangaroofka waxay mararka qaarkood u taqaannaa geedaha badda ama kaymaha xeebaha . Dhirtaasi waxay leedahay astaamo gaar ah oo u suurageliya inay ku noolaato biyaha cusbada leh, dhulka jilicsan iyo ciidda ay ogsajiintu ku yar tahay. Qaar ka mid ah geedaha mangaroofku waxay leeyihiin xididdo ciidda kor uga soo baxa, kuwaas oo geedka ka caawiya inuu hawada ka helo ogsajiin. Xididdadaas waxaa cilmi ahaan loo yaqaannaa pneumatophores , waxaana af Soomaali ahaan lagu tilmaami karaa xididdidda neefsashada . Xididdadu waxay sidoo kale geedka ku sugaan dhulka dhoobada ah ee jilicsan, waxayna qabtaan ciidda iyo walxaha biyuhu sidaan. Sidaas awgeed, mangaroofku wuxuu yareeyaa nabaadguurka xeebaha, wuxuuna ka qeybqaataa samaysanka iyo xasilloonida dhulka xeebaha. Sida mangaroofku ula qabsado biyaha cusbada leh Astaamaha ugu muhiimsan ee mangaroofka waxaa ka mid ah awoodda uu ugu adkaysto cusbada biyaha badda. Noocyada qaar waxay cusbada ka reebaan biyaha inta aysan xididdadu nuugin, halka kuwo kalena ay cusbada caleemaha ka saaraan. Hababkaas dabiiciga ahi waxay dhirta u suurageliyaan inay ku noolaato meelo aysan dhirta badankeedu ku kori karin. Noocyada mangaroofka ee laga helo xeebaha Bariga Afrika waxaa ka mid ah: Avicennia marina ; Rhizophora mucronata ; Ceriops tagal ; Sonneratia alba . Noocyadani waxay ku kala duwan yihiin qaabka xididdada, heerka ay cusbada ugu adkaysan karaan iyo goobaha ay kaga baxaan xeebaha. Hoyga iyo goobta taranka noolaha badda Kaymaha mangaroofku waa hoy, goob taran iyo meel ay ku koraan noocyo badan oo kalluun, carsaanyo, haley, shimbiro iyo nooleyaal kale. Xididdada isku dhex yaacsan ee geeduhu waxay kalluunka yaryar iyo noolaha kale ka ilaaliyaan ugaarsadayaasha, waxayna siiyaan meel ammaan ah oo ay ku koraan inta aysan u gudbin biyaha furan. Caleemaha iyo laamaha mangaroofka ee dhaca waxaa burburiya bakteeriyo, fangas iyo nooleyaal kale oo aad u yaryar. Walxahaas burburay waxay isu beddelaan nafaqo ay ka faa’iidaystaan kalluunka iyo noolaha kale ee badda. Sidaas awgeed, mangaroofku wuxuu qeyb weyn ka qaataa silsiladda cuntada ee degaannada xeebaha, wuxuuna taageeraa waxsoosaarka kalluumaysiga. Burburka kaymaha mangaroofku wuxuu keeni karaa yaraanshaha kalluunka, hoos u dhaca kala-duwanaanta noolaha iyo dhaawac ku yimaadda nololmaalmeedka bulshooyinka ku tiirsan kheyraadka badda. Gaashaanka dabiiciga ah ee xeebaha Faa’iidooyinka ugu waaweyn ee mangaroofka waxaa ka mid ah ilaalinta xeebaha. Xididdada, jirridda iyo laamaha cufan ee dhirtu waxay yareeyaan xoogga hirarka, waxay qabtaan ciidda, waxayna hoos u dhigaan nabaadguurka xeebaha. Kaymaha mangaroofku waxay sidoo kale yareyn karaan saamaynta duufaannada, daadadka xeebaha iyo hirarka xooggan. Mangaroofku si buuxda uma joojin karo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, hasayeeshee wuxuu si weyn u dhimi karaa awoodda biyaha iyo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara. Bulshooyinka deggan xeebaha ay kaymahani ku dhow yihiin waxay ka helaan difaac dabiici ah oo yareeya halista ku timaadda guryaha, kaabayaasha dhaqaale iyo beeraha ku dhow xeebaha. Kaydka Kaarboonka Buluugga ah Mangaroofku wuxuu ka mid yahay nidaamdegaaneedyada sida weyn u kaydiya kaarboonka. Kaarboonka ku kaydsan dhirta, xididdada iyo ciidda xeebaha waxaa loo yaqaannaa Kaarboonka Buluugga ah ama Blue Carbon . Qeybta ugu badan ee kaarboonka mangaroofku waxay ku kaydsan tahay ciidda qoyan ee ka hoosaysa dhirta. Ciiddaas waxaa ku urura caleemo, laamo iyo walxo dabiici ah oo si gaabis ah u burbura. Marka kaymaha mangaroofka la jaro ama la burburiyo, kaarboonkii ku kaydsanaa dhirta iyo ciidda ayaa hawada ku sii dayn kara gaasaska kululeeya cimilada. Sidaas darteed, ilaalinta mangaroofku waxay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada lagu yareynayo saamaynta isbeddelka cimilada. Khataraha haysta mangaroofka Tobannaankii sano ee u dambeeyay, kaymaha mangaroofka ee dunidu waxay wajahayeen xaalufin iyo hoos u dhac ka dhashay hawlaha aadanaha iyo isbeddellada dabiiciga ah. Waxyaabaha ugu waaweyn ee khatarta ku haya waxaa ka mid ah: jarista dhirta si looga dhigto dhuxul, xaabo iyo qalabka dhismaha; ballaarinta magaalooyinka iyo dhismayaasha xeebaha; beddelidda kaymaha oo laga sameeyo beero ama xarumo ganacsi; wasakhowga badda iyo daadinta qashinka; qodista ciidda iyo burburinta dhulka xeebaha; daaqsinka xoolaha; kor u kaca heerka badda; abaaraha iyo isbeddelka cimilada. Marka mangaroofka la waayo, xeebuhu waxay u nuglaadaan nabaadguur, daadad iyo hirar xooggan, halka kalluunka iyo noolaha kale ee badduna ay waayaan goobihii ay ku tarmeen kuna koreen. Muhiimadda dhaqaale iyo bulsho Faa’iidooyinka mangaroofku kuma koobna ilaalinta degaanka oo keliya. Kaymahani waxay si toos iyo si dadbanba u taageeraan dhaqaalaha bulshooyinka xeebaha. Kalluumaysatada waxay ka faa’iidaystaan kalluunka iyo noolaha kale ee ku tarma mangaroofka. Bulshooyinka qaarkoodna waxay kaymaha ka helaan malab, dawooyin dhaqameed iyo kheyraad kale oo dabiici ah. Mangaroofku wuxuu sidoo kale dhiirrigelin karaa dalxiiska dabiiciga ah, daawashada shimbiraha, cilmibaarista iyo waxbarashada ku saabsan noolaha badda. Hasayeeshee, ka faa’iidaysiga kheyraadka mangaroofka waa inuu noqdaa mid qorshaysan oo waara, si aan loo dhaawicin awoodda uu nidaamku isku cusboonaysiin karo. Mangaroofka Soomaaliya Soomaaliya waxay leedahay xeebta ugu dheer dhulweynaha Afrika, taas oo ku teedsan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Qeybo ka mid ah xeebahaas waxaa laga helaa kaymo mangaroof ah. Degaannada ugu waaweyn ee mangaroofka Soomaaliya laga helo waxaa ka mid ah Jubbada Hoose, gaar ahaan aagga Jasiiradaha Bajuni, Kismaayo iyo afka Wabiga Jubba. Degaannadaas waxaa laga helaa kaymo cufan oo qaarkood gaara dherer u dhexeeya 10 iyo 15 mitir. Mangaroofka waxaa sidoo kale laga helaa qeybo ka mid ah xeebaha waqooyi iyo waqooyigalbeed, sida: Saylac iyo Jasiiradaha Sacadadiin; Berbera; Caluula; Xaabo; Boosaaso; qeybo kale oo ka tirsan xeebaha Gacanka Cadmeed. Burburkii dawladdii dhexe ka dib, awooddii lagu ilaalin lahaa kheyraadka dabiiciga ah way daciiftay, taas oo sahashay jarista sharcidarrada ah iyo ka faa’iidaysiga aan qorshaysnayn ee kaymaha xeebaha. Hasayeeshee, dadaalladaasi waxay u baahan yihiin sharciyo cad, dhaqaale, shaqaale tababaran iyo kaqeybgal joogto ah oo bulshada degaanka ah. Maxaa la gudboon Soomaaliya? Waa ilaalinta kalluunka, noolaha badda, dhaqaalaha bulshooyinka xeebaha, badqabka magaalooyinka iyo awoodda Soomaaliya ay ugu adkaysan karto isbeddelka cimilada. Waxay xoojiyaan xeebaha, kaydiyaan kaarboonka, hoy u noqdaan nooleyaal badan, waxayna taageeraan nololmaalmeedka kumannaan qof. Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Ilaalinta Nidaamdegaaneedka Mangaroofku waxay ina xusuusinaysaa in ilaalinta kaymahani ay tahay masuuliyad wada saaran dawladda, bulshada, ganacsatada iyo jiil kasta oo Soomaaliyeed. Qaar ka mid ah geedaha mangaroofku waxay leeyihiin xididdo ciidda kor uga soo baxa, kuwaas oo geedka ka caawiya inuu hawada ka helo ogsajiin. items.title: Confusion Deepens as Five Lawmakers Resign from Northeast Parliament Amid Mystery Over Missing Legislators
items.description: LasAnod (WDN) – Political uncertainty has deepened inside the Parliament of the Northeast administration after five lawmakers announced their resignation following hours of confusion surrounding the whereabouts of several members of the regional legislature. In a joint statement released after prolonged uncertainty gripped the parliament, the five legislators confirmed they had resigned from their parliamentary seats. However, they did not disclose their next political destination or clarify whether they intended to align themselves with either Puntland or Somaliland, leaving observers speculating about the motives behind their decision. The resignations came against the backdrop of an extraordinary situation inside the regional assembly. Earlier, the leadership of the House issued a public notice seeking information on the whereabouts of several lawmakers whose locations and means of contact had reportedly become unknown. The parliamentary leadership called on the missing members to make contact and disclose their whereabouts within 12 hours. The unusual appeal underscored the level of uncertainty engulfing the legislature, raising fresh questions about internal divisions and the cohesion of the fledgling administration. Political observers say the simultaneous disappearance of several lawmakers and the resignation of others points to growing instability within the Northeast political leadership at a time when the administration continues to navigate complex relations with both Puntland and Somaliland. Neither the parliamentary leadership nor the departing lawmakers have publicly explained the circumstances surrounding the disappearances or the reasons behind the resignations. As speculation intensifies, analysts warn that the episode could signal a broader political realignment within the region, although the ultimate destination and political intentions of the departing legislators remain unclear. For now, the unexplained resignations and the search for missing lawmakers have added another layer of uncertainty to an already fragile political landscape, leaving many unanswered questions about the future direction of the Northeast administration. items.description: Tartanka loogu jiro xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa galay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii ay kusoo hareen laba musharrax oo kala ah Wasiiru Dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Sadaad Caliyow iyo Wasiirka Dekeddaha Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur Jaamac. items.title: South West’s Political Gamble: Can Reconciliation Succeed While an Insurgency Continues?
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) – South West State news President Aden Mohamed Nur (Aden Madoobe) has launched what appears to be a broad political reconciliation initiative aimed at easing divisions in the region. However, critics argue that the effort overlooks a central reality: military control alone has not ended the insurgency that has repeatedly challenged government authority around Baidoa. Since federal-backed forces assumed control of South West State in May 2026, fighters aligned with former President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen have mounted repeated attacks on Baidoa and surrounding areas, underscoring the resilience of the armed movement despite the government’s military presence. The latest reconciliation initiative seeks to bring together traditional elders, politicians, and community representatives from across South West State. Officials say the goal is to reduce political tensions, promote dialogue among rival clans, and bridge differences over the contentious political transition that brought the current administration to power. Supporters view the initiative as an opportunity to foster unity and stabilize the region. Critics, however, question whether meaningful reconciliation is possible if key political stakeholders remain absent from the process. Opponents argue that many of the figures expected to participate do not represent the principal political forces challenging the current administration. Without the participation of influential opposition leaders and those aligned with Laftagareen, they contend, the dialogue risks being viewed as symbolic rather than genuinely inclusive. The continuing insurgency has reinforced those concerns. Despite repeated military operations and the deployment of federal forces, Laftagareen-aligned fighters have continued launching attacks on Baidoa since the conflict escalated earlier this year. Analysts note that the persistence of these operations suggests the movement retains both operational capability and local support in parts of the region. For many observers, this illustrates a broader lesson drawn from insurgencies around the world: military superiority does not necessarily translate into lasting political control. While conventional forces may secure towns and strategic installations, insurgent movements often adapt by relying on mobility, local networks, and prolonged campaigns of attrition. That reality has become increasingly apparent in Bay Region, where recurring attacks continue despite the government’s efforts to consolidate its authority. Political analysts argue that lasting stability is unlikely to be achieved through security measures alone. Instead, they say, any durable settlement will require a political process that is widely regarded as inclusive, credible, and capable of addressing the grievances driving the conflict. As South West State embarks on its latest reconciliation initiative, the central question remains whether dialogue can succeed without the participation of the movement that continues to challenge government authority on the battlefield. Until that question is answered, many observers believe the conflict is likely to remain both a political and military contest—one in which control of territory alone may not determine the ultimate outcome. items.title: Trumpfying the World: A Critical Look at Global Politics and American Influence
items.description: By Awes Osman Throughout history, humanity’s pursuit of survival has often driven conflict and power struggles. Wars are rarely accidental; they are meticulously planned and executed, with nations vying for dominance and resources. Each century leaves its mark through its unique geopolitical struggles. In the 19th century, Europe underwent a significant transformation. The continent capitalized on the industrial revolution, expanding aggressively through colonization and exploiting the resources and labor of other nations. Colonial powers competed fiercely for territories, leading to conflicts over the control of colonies. The 1884 Berlin Conference marked a pivotal moment with the partition of Africa, where European nations agreed to divide the continent among themselves. However, this agreement was short-lived as greed and ambition fueled subsequent conflicts over territorial disputes, igniting wars among colonial powers. These divisions and conflicts inspired African nations to question their subjugation. The fight for independence gained momentum in the mid-20th century, culminating in the decolonization wave of the 1960s. African leaders and martyrs fought not only for sovereignty but also for the right to harness their natural resources and improve their peoples’ lives. In every nation, groups vying for power seek control to achieve better living conditions. Similarly, U.S. President Donald Trump’s “America First” policy underscores a focus on national interests, emphasizing economic strength and superiority. His approach marked a departure from traditional diplomatic norms, making it clear that he prioritized American interests—often intertwined with his personal business ventures—above global or moral considerations. This shift has significant implications. Trump’s policies have fostered a more materialistic and less humanitarian approach to international relations. His administration’s withdrawal from global aid agencies like UNICEF, UNDP, and UNHCR, coupled with reduced contributions to international organizations, threatens to destabilize global cooperation and potentially spark new conflicts. Furthermore, Trump’s background as a businessman raises concerns about conflicts of interest, where personal financial gains may influence national policy. Such a focus on economic and financial interests, often at the expense of humanitarian and environmental issues, marks a stark contrast to previous American administrations that balanced national priorities with global responsibility. This new approach has profound consequences. It risks undermining long-term American influence and damaging international relations. The rise of nationalist and far-right movements in Europe, emboldened by similar policies, has led to increased hostility toward refugees and minority groups. If this trend continues, the world edges closer to a potential new global conflict. The danger lies in allowing these policies—what some might call “trumpfying”—to escalate unchecked. To avoid a future marked by increased conflict and global instability, it is crucial to reconsider the balance between national interests and global humanitarian responsibilities. The world must act swiftly to prevent the destructive path of “trumpfying” from leading us into another devastating world war. Only through renewed commitment to diplomacy, cooperation, and moral responsibility can we hope to build a more stable and equitable future for all. items.title: Turkey Launches a Fisheries Project at the Port of Mogadishu
items.description: The Mogadishu Port Authority has held a meeting with a delegation from the Turkish government and major fishing companies to discuss accelerating the implementation of the fisheries project previously agreed upon by the two countries. The delegation also toured various sections of the Mogadishu Port to assess the infrastructure needed for this project, which is crucial for the country’s economic development. This meeting is significant as it represents a new step by the Somali government toward implementing previously signed agreements between the two nations. The delegation visited the Mogadishu Port to evaluate existing infrastructure and identify requirements for the project’s implementation. The meeting was attended by officials from the Port Authority and fishing companies. Although further details about the discussions have not been disclosed, the project is expected to significantly boost Somalia’s economy, particularly in the fisheries sector one of the country’s most important natural resources. The delegation’s visit is part of Turkey’s ongoing efforts to strengthen cooperation with Somalia across various sectors, including economy, security, and infrastructure development. items.title: Turkiga oo Dekedda Muqdisho kawada mashruuca kalluumeysi
items.description: Maamulka Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa kulan la yeeshay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Turkiga iyo shirkado waaweyn oo ka shaqeeya kalluumeysiga, iyagoo ka wadahadlay sidii loo dardargelin lahaa hirgelinta mashruuca kalluumeysiga ee ay hore ugu heshiiyeen labada dal. Wafdiga ayaa sidoo kale booqday qaybaha kala duwan ee Dekedda Muqdisho si ay u qiimeeyaan kaabeyaasha lagu fulin doono mashruucan muhiimka u ah horumarka dhaqaalaha dalka. Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Dowladda Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso dhaqangelinta heshiisyadii horay looga soo saaray iskaashiga labada dal. Wafdigan ayaa booqday Dekedda Muqdisho si ay u qiimeeyaan kaabayaasha jira iyo waxyaabaha looga baahan yahay si loo hirgeliyo mashruuca, waxaana kulanka ka soo qaybgalay mas’uuliyiin ka socota Maamulka Dekedda iyo shirkadaha kalluumeysiga. Inkasta oo aan la helin faahfaahin dheeri ah oo ku saabsan waxyaabaha laga wadahadlay kulanka, haddana waxaa la filayaa in mashruucani uu kaalmo weyn ku yeesho horumarinta dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinaca kalluumeysiga oo ah mid ka mid ah khayraadka ugu muhiimsan ee dalka. Booqashada wafdiga ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Turkiga ee lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga ay la leedahay Soomaaliya dhinacyada kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan dhaqaalaha, amniga, iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha. The post Turkiga oo Dekedda Muqdisho kawada mashruuca kalluumeysi first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Qaali Cali Shire: Nabadda Gaalkacyo DENI uma taallo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xidhibaan Qaali Cali Shire oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa ka jawaabtay warsaxaafadeedka kasoo baxay Puntland ee lagu eedeeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sidoo kalena loogu digay maamulka ay dariska yihiin ee Galmudug. Puntland ayaa ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu wado dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo lagu hurinayo colaado, laguna wiiqayo nidaamka dowladnimo ee Puntland, iyadoo sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo maalmihii u dambeeyey ka socday qaybo ka mid ah deegaannadeeda iyo meelaha ku dhow. Sidoo kale, Puntland a yaa digniin gaar ah u dirtay maamulka Galmudug, oo ay xuduud dheer la wadaagto, gaar ahaan gobolka Mudug oo magaalada Gaalkacyo ay labada maamul kala maamulaan. Waxay Galmudug ugu baaqday in aysan garoomadeeda diyaaradaha iyo dhulka ay maamusho u oggolaan in laga soo gudbiyo saanad ciidan, hub iyo maleeshiyaad ay Puntland sheegtay in loo adeegsan karo weerarro ama qalqal-gelin ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda. Intaas kadib waxaa iyana qoraal soo saartay Xildhibaan Qaali Cali Shire oo laga soo doortay Galmudug, waxaana ay jawaab siisay Puntland, iyada oo sheegtay in nabadda Gaalkacyo uusan shaqo ku lahayn Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullahi Maxamed (Deni), isla markaana aan waxba laga waydiin doonin. “Nabadda Gaalkacyo ma aha arrin laga waraysanayo Madaxweyne Dani iyo cid kasta oo la halmaasha, ee waa mid u taalla dadka degaanka wadaagga ah ee reer Gaalkacyo. Sidoo kale, ma aha mid si gaar ah ay uga shaqeeyeen Galmudug iyo Puntland, balse waa guul ka dhalatay dadaalka iyo is-afgaradka ay muujiyeen beelaha walaalaha ah ee deegaanka wada dega,” ayay tiri Qaali. Sidoo kale waxa ay beenisay eedda kasoo yeertay Puntland ee ku aadan hubka ay sheegtay in lasoo dhex-mariyo deegaannada Galmudug. “Dhanka kale, diyaaraddii caanaha booraha noo keeni jirtay ayaad xitaa ku tilmaantay inay rasaas waddo. Fadhiyadii iyo alaabtii aan Jawaanada ku keenayna waxeey kuula ekadeen rasaas. Arrintaasi ma waafaqsana xaqiiqada,” ayay mar kale tiri Xildhibaannaddu. Waxaa kale oo ay sii raacisay “Waxa halkaas ka muuqda inuu ku dhibayo waa in doorasho heer federaal ah lagu qabto deegaankaas. Hase yeeshee, waxa maanta ka jira waa isfahan iyo wadajir, ee ku soco”. Ugu dambeyn waxay qoraalkeeda kusoo gabagabeysay farriin ay dirtay shacabka Galmudug oo ay ugu baaqday inay gacmaha is qabsadaan. “Dadka degaankaas gacmaha ayay is haystaan. Sidaas darteed, hadallo horseedi kara colaad ama kala fogeyn looma baahna. Dabadeedna in la yiraahdo “hawiyaa igu soo duulay” wax xal ah ma keenayso, ee waxay sii fogeynaysaa isfahamka. Nabaddaa naas la nuugo leh; ilaalinteeduna waa waajib qof walba saaran”. The post Qaali Cali Shire: Nabadda Gaalkacyo DENI uma taallo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Fadhiyadii iyo alaabtii aan Jawaanada ku keenayna waxeey kuula ekadeen rasaas. Arrintaasi ma waafaqsana xaqiiqada,” ayay mar kale tiri Xildhibaannaddu. Waxaa kale oo ay sii raacisay “Waxa halkaas ka muuqda inuu ku dhibayo waa in doorasho heer federaal ah lagu qabto deegaankaas. Hase yeeshee, waxa maanta ka jira waa isfahan iyo wadajir, ee ku soco”. Ugu dambeyn waxay qoraalkeeda kusoo gabagabeysay farriin ay dirtay shacabka Galmudug oo ay ugu baaqday inay gacmaha is qabsadaan. “Dadka degaankaas gacmaha ayay is haystaan. Sidaas darteed, hadallo horseedi kara colaad ama kala fogeyn looma baahna. Dabadeedna in la yiraahdo “hawiyaa igu soo duulay” wax xal ah ma keenayso, ee waxay sii fogeynaysaa isfahamka. Nabaddaa naas la nuugo leh; ilaalinteeduna waa waajib qof walba saaran”. The post Qaali Cali Shire: Nabadda Gaalkacyo DENI uma taallo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Afrika oo wajahaysa khasaare dhaqaale oo gaaraya $10–20 bilyan sababo la xiriira El Niño xooggan
items.description: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika (AfDB) ayaa ka digay in ifafaalaha cimilo ee loo yaqaan “Super El Niño” uu sababi karo khasaare dhaqaale oo u dhexeeya $10 bilyan illaa $20 bilyan dalalka Afrika ee sida weyn u saameyn doona, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inuu horseedo barakac ballaaran iyo dhibaatooyin bani’aadamnimo. Agaasimaha Isbeddelka Cimilada iyo Kobaca Cagaaran ee AfDB, Anthony Nyong, ayaa sheegay in dalalka ugu daran ay waxyeelladu ku dhici doonto ay celcelis ahaan lumin karaan 1% ilaa 2% wax-soo-saarkooda guud (GDP). Wuxuu xusay in abaarta, fatahaadaha iyo duufaannada la xiriira El Niño ay sii wiiqi doonaan sugnaanta cuntada iyo biyaha, isla markaana dhaawici doonaan kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha. Nyong ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in dalal ay ka mid yihiin Soomaaliya, Suudaan, Koonfurta Suudaan, Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, Mali, Burundi iyo Nigeria ay wajihi karaan saameyn aad u daran, taasoo keeni karta barakac ballaaran iyo tartan ku saabsan biyaha iyo dhulka daaqsinka. AfDB waxay sheegtay in beeraleyda Afrika ay sanadkan hore u wajahayaan khasaare lagu qiyaasay $330 milyan, halka waaxda kalluumeysigana ay saameyn ku yeelan doonaan kuleylka badda iyo duufaannada. Bangigu wuxuu intaa ku daray in baahida maalgelinta la-qabsiga isbeddelka cimilada ee Afrika ay hadda gaari karto $100 bilyan sanadkan, si loo yareeyo saameynta El Niño ee la filayo.

items.title: Wareysiyada Wadajirka ah ee Siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed: Faa’iido mise Khatar?
items.description: B y Dr. Abukar Yusuf Warsame Hordhac Wareysiyada Wadajirka ah Warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed waxay soo martay isbeddel weyn siiba labaatankii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Muddo dheer wareysiyada siyaasaddeed waxaa lagu qaban jiray idaacado iyo telefishanno leh hal wareyste. Wareysiyadaasi waxay badanaa ku koobnaayeen waqti kooban iyo arrimaha siyaasadeed ee ugu kulul waqtigaas. Idaacadihii iyo telefishannadii ayaa maanta waxaa barbar socda YouTube, Podcast-yo, Facebook, iyo aalado kale. Isbeddelkan ayaa horseeday in suxufiyiin madaxbannaan iyo madallo cusub ay helaan dhagaystayaal aad u ballaaran. Markii ay soo baxeen warbaahinta bulshada iyo podcast-yadu, waxaa kordhay fursadda dooddaha dheer iyo falanqaynta qotada dheer. Dadku waxay bilaabeen inay door bidaan doodaha dhaadheer ee sharraxaya sababaha iyo saameynta arrimaha siyaasadeed. Dhinaca kale siyaasiyiintuna waxay doonayaan inay gaaraan dhagaystayaal badan halka warbaahintuna ay rabto inay isu geyso aqoon, waayo-aragnimo iyo dhagaystayaal mug leh. Dhamaan arrimahan ayaa horseeday kororka wareysiyada wadajirka ah. Mid ka mid ah isbeddellada ugu xiisaha badan ayaa ah soo ifbaxa wareysiyada wadajirka ah ee ay sameeyaan/u wada qabtaan/qaadaan laba ama in ka badan oo warbaahin ama suxufiyiin ah. Dalal badan ayaa hore u isticmaalay habkan. Wareysiyada kooxeed, dooddaha siyaasaddeed iyo podcast-yada wadajirka ah ayaa noqday hab caan ah oo lagu xoojiyo doodaha dadweynaha. Khibradahaasi waxay muujinayaan in guusha lagu gaaro diyaar-garow wanaagsan, anshax saxaafadeed iyo xaqiiqo ku saleynta doodaha. Haddaba habkan cusub ma mudan yahay in si qoto dheer loo falanqeeyo maadaama uu saameyn ku yeelan karo isla-xisaabtanka siyaasiyiinta, tayada saxaafadda, iyo fahamka bulshadeenna Soomaaliyeed? Faa’iidooyinka iyo khataraha wareysiyada wadajirka ah Wareysiyada wadajirka ahi waxay kordhin karaan isla-xisaabtanka iyo tayada saxaafadda, balse sidoo kale waxay la yimaadaan khataro ay ka mid yihiin koox-fikir, eex siyaasadeed iyo hoos u dhac ku yimaada madaxbannaanida warbaahinta. Faa’iidooyinka Dhinaca Isla-Xisaabtanka: Marka laba ama in ka badan oo wareyste ay su’aalayaan hal siyaasi, way adkaanaysaa in laga baxsado su’aalaha adag. Hal wareyste ayaa weydiin kara su’aal, halka kan kalena uu daba geli karo jawaabta ama tilmaami karo meelaha ay jawaabtu iska hor imanayso ama aysan waafaqsanayn xaqiiqooyinka jira. Habkan ayaa sare u qaadaya isla-xisaabtanka, wuxuuna bulshada ka caawinayaa inay hesho sawir dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan mowduuca laga hadlayo. Dhinaca Warbaahinta: Iskaashiga warbaahintu wuxuu sare u qaadaa tayada shaqada suxufiyiinta. Waxay wadaagi karaan cilmi-baaris, dukumeenti, xog ururin iyo khibrado kala duwan. Waxa kale oo ay isku baran karaan farsamooyinka wareysiga iyo hababka su’aalaha loo dhiso, taasoo kor u qaadaysa xirfadda guud ee saxaafadda Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, wada-shaqeyntu waxay yareyn kartaa kharashaadka soo saarista barnaamijyada waaweyn, iyadoo la isku darsanayo agab, waqti iyo khubaro. Dhinaca Bulshada: Bulshadu waa dhinaca ugu faa’iidada badan wareysiyadan wadajirka ah. Daawadayaashu waxay helayaan su’aalo badan, aragtiyo kala duwan iyo faham qoto dheer oo ku saabsan arrimaha laga doodayo. Habkani wuxuu sidoo kale mideyn karaa dhagaystayaal kala duwan oo hore ugu kala xirnaa warbaahino kala duwan, taas oo kordhinaysa wadaagga xogta iyo doodda bulshada. Intaa waxaa dheer, wuxuu sare u qaadi karaa kalsoonida dadweynaha haddii bulshada ay dareento in su’aalaha muhiimka ah aan laga tagayn. Khataraha Inkasta oo faa’iidooyinkaasi jiraan, haddana waxaa jira khataro dhowr ah oo dhinac socda wareysiyada wadajirka ah. Dhinaca Koox-Fikirka : Waxaa xaqiiqo ah in suxufi kasta uu leeyahay aragtiyo iyo fikirro u gaar ah. Xirfadda saxaafaddu waxay ku dhisan tahay caddaalad, xaqiiqo iyo dhexdhexaadnimo. Wareysiyada wadajirka ahi waxay kor u qaadi karaan dhexdhexaadnimada haddii ay kulmiyaan suxufiyiin leh aragtiyo kala duwan. Hase yeeshee, haddii dhammaan wareystayaashu ay ka yimaadaan hal aragti siyaasadeed ama hal jiho fikir, wareysigu wuxuu noqon karaa mid aan dheellitirnayn oo dhinac ka raran. Taasi waxay dhaawici kartaa kalsoonida bulshada ee warbaahinta. Dhinaca Madaxbannaanida: Khatar kale waa in madaxbannaanida warbaahintu yaraato, maadaama wada-shaqeyntu mararka qaarkood u baahan karto tanaasul ku saabsan su’aalaha la weydiinayo, habka loo maamulayo wareysiga ama mowduucyada mudnaanta la siinayo. Haddii tanaasulkaasi bato, waxaa dhici karta in xorriyadda tifaftirka (editorial independence) ay hoos u dhacdo. Dhinaca Mas’uuliyadda : Waxaa dhici karta inay adkaato in la ogaado cidda mas’uulka ka ah khaladaadka, xogta aan saxda ahayn ama hab-maamuuska khaldan ee wareysiga. Taasi waxay keeni kartaa in khaladaadka aan si degdeg ah loo sixin ama aan si cad loo ogeyn cidda laga rabo inay bulshada u sharaxdo wixii dhacay. Dhinaca Caannimo Raadiska iyo Is-Muujinta : Mararka qaarkood waxaa dhici karta in qaar ka mid ah wareystayaashu ay xoogga saaraan sidii ay u kordhin lahaayeen caannimadooda ama u noqon lahaayeen qofka ugu hadal-heynta badan baraha bulshada oo wariyuhu ulakac war/faalo dareen-kicis ah u abuuro isagoo caan raadis ah, halkii ay mudnaanta siin lahaayeen helitaanka xogta iyo isla-xisaabtanka siyaasiga. Haddii wareysigu isu beddelo tartan u dhexeeya wariyeyaasha halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa dood bulshada anfaceysa, waxaa dhaawacmi kara tayada iyo ujeeddadii wareysiga. Dhinaca Xulashada Martida: Waxaa sidoo kale jiri karta khatar ah in siyaasiyiintu ay doortaan oo keliya barnaamijyada ama kooxaha wariyeyaasha ee ay u arkaan kuwo dabacsan ama saaxiibtinimo ula dhaqmaya. Sidoo kale waxa meesha ka baxaysa kala-duwanaanshihii (diversity) oo haddii isku-darsigu bato ay ku soo ururureyso dhawr warbaahin (oligopoly). Haddii arrintaasi dhacdo, waxay yareyn kartaa sinnaanta fursadaha iyo kalsoonida lagu qabo in warbaahintu si madax-bannaan u gudato waajibaadkeeda. Dhinaca Tartanka iyo Tirada Daawadayaasha: In kasta oo iskaashigu kordhin karo tirada daawadayaasha, haddana waxaa jiri karta cadaadis ah in mudnaanta la siiyo mowduucyada soo jiidanaya daawasho badan halkii laga dooran lahaa arrimaha bulshada ugu muhiimsan. Taasi waxay horseedi kartaa in tayada doodda lagu beddelo raadinta daawasho iyo faafin (viral content), taas oo dhaawici karta doorka warbaahinta ee u adeegga bulshada. Gunaanad Soo ifbaxa wareysiyada wadajirka ah waa tallaabo cusub oo muhiim u ah horumarka warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed. Waxay muujinayaan biseylka warbaahinta casriga ah ee ku saleysan dijitaalka iyo rabitaanka bulshada ee dood qoto dheer. Guushoodu kuma xirnaan doonto tirada daawadayaasha ama sumcadda martigeliyayaasha, balse waxay ku xirnaan doontaa inta ay bulshada ka caawinayaan fahamka arrimaha saameynaya mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. Waxaan ku soo gunaanadayaa talooyin ku socda warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed siiba qolada qabata wareysiyada wadajirka ah: Ilaaliya madaxbannaanida tifaftirka wareysiyada. Ka fogaada eexda siyaasadeed, magacyada qabiilka adeegsigooda, iyo kaftanka xanafta reebi kara ama fasiraad qaldan keeni kara. U adeegsada wareysiyadiinna caddeymo iyo xaqiiqooyin. Si siman ula macaamila dhammaan siyaasiyiinta. Saxa khaladaadka marka ay dhacaan. Ka hormariya danta guud danaha gaarka ah. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo soo riday diyaaradda Bayraktar Akinci
items.description: Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Yemen ay Axaddan soo rideen diyaarad aan duuliyaha lahayn oo nooceedu yahay Bayraktar Akinci. Diyaaraddan ayaa ka mid ah drones-ka uu Turkigu sameeyo, waana mid ka mid ah diyaaradaha drones-ka ee ugu casrisan ee maanta dunida yaala, waxaana la sheegay in muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ay isticmaalayeen Ciidamada Sacuudiga. Diyaaraddan ayaa waxaa loo adeegsadaa hawlgalada sahanka iyo burburinta hadafka militari ama bartilmaameedyada cadowga, waana mid ka mid ah diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ugu awoodda badan dunida casriga ah. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in diyaaradda lagu soo riday hawada Gobolka Al-Jawf ee Waqooyiga Yemen, ka dib markii uu sheegay inay wadday hawlgalo cadowtinimo ah. Afhayeenka ayaa intaasi ku daray in diyaaradda lagu soo riday hub ku habboon, oo uu ula jeedo in loo adeegsaday gantaal laga tuuray dhulka. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa ku hubeysan gantaalo casri ah, oo ay ku jiraan gantaalada ballaastikada iyo kuwa kale ee cruise-ka. Tallaabada lagu soo riday diyaaraddan ayaa waxay qayb ka tahay xiisadda sii kordheysa ee Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga oo gaartay meeshii ugu sarreysay. Xiisadda labada dhinac ayaa habeenkii Jimcaha cirka isku shareertay, ka dib markii Sacuudigu uu garaacay Magaalada Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran ee Galbeedka Yemen, taas oo keentay in Xuutiyiinta ay iyaguna Sabtidii weeraraan xarumaha ay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ay ku leedahay Magaalooyinka Jizan iyo Yanbu ee dalkaasi Sacuudiga.

items.description: Munaasabadda 61-guurada ka soo wareegtay Xorriyadda Jamhuuriyadda Maldives awgeed, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay hambalyo diirran u dirtay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Maldives, Mudane Dr Mohamed Muizzu , dowladda, iyo shacabka walaalaha ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Maldives. items.title: Sirdoonka Mareykanka oo wixii ay ka cabsi qabeen ka ogaaday Mojtaba Khamenei
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa rumeysan in hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Iran, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, uu aabbihii uga furfuran yahay in Tehran ay sameysato hub nukliyeer ah, taasi oo ah wax laga cabsi qabay kahor dilkii aabihiis. Qiimeyn cusub oo sirdoon, oo ay heleen mas’uuliyiin Mareykan ah, ayaa muujineysa in Mojtaba Khamenei iyo dowladda mayalka adag ee ka dhalatay dilkii hoggaamiyayaashii hore ee Iran ay daneynayaan horumarinta hub nukliyeer oo casri ah. Wargeyska New York Times , oo soo xigtay saraakiil lagu wargeliyey qiimeynta, ayaa sheegay in hoggaamiyaha cusub uusan weligiis si furan ugu baaqin in Iran ay sameysato bam nukliyeer ah. Hase yeeshee, wada-hadallo ay sirdoonku dhexda ka qabteen iyo mowqifyo uu muujiyey dagaalka ka hor ayaa saraakiisha Mareykanka ku qanciyey inuusan Mojtaba la wadaagin taxaddarkii aabbihii, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Ali Khamenei, oo Iran hoggaaminayey in ka badan 36 sano, ayaa lagu dilay weerar ay Israel billowgii dagaalka fulisay, kaas oo la sheegay inay gacan ka geysteen xogaha sirdoonka Mareykanka. Hoggaamiyihii hore ayaa muddo dheer diidanaa in Iran ay sameysato ama adeegsato hub nukliyeer ah, inkasta oo Washington ay aaminsaneyd in Tehran ay dooneysay awood ay si degdeg ah ugu sameysan karto hubkaas haddii ay go’aansato. Dowladda cusub ee Iran ayaa sidoo kale adkeysay dadaallada ay ku doonayso inay saameyn weyn ugu yeelato marin-biyoodka Hormuz, iyadoo isla markaana noqotay dhinac ay Washington ku adkaatay inay heshiis la gaarto. Haddii dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israel uu Iran ku riixay inay hub nukliyeer sameysato halkii uu ka hor istaagi lahaa, arrintaas waxay noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah cawaaqibta ugu khatarta badan ee ka dhashay dilkii hoggaamiyihii hore iyo isku daygii maamulka Donald Trump ee ahaa in la beddelo nidaamka Tehran. Awood aan la mid ahayn tii aabbihii Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ka digaya in xogta ugu badan ee laga hayo aragtida Mojtaba Khamenei la ururiyey dagaalka ka hor. Hoggaamiyaha cusub ayaa si xun ugu dhaawacmay wejigii hore ee dagaalka, waxaana tan iyo markaas yaraaday isgaarsiintiisa iyo kasoo muuqashadiisa fagaarayaasha. Saraakiisha ayaa sheegay inuu arrintaas u sameynayo dhaawaciisa awgiis iyo cabsi uu ka qabo in lagu beegsado weerar cirka ah. Qiimeynta Mareykanka ayaa muujineysa inuu weli gacanta ku hayo dowladda, balse uusan lahayn awooddii buuxda iyo saameyntii uu aabbihii ku dhex lahaa nidaamka siyaasadeed, militariga iyo hay’adaha diinta ee Iran. Qiimeyntan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli madaxweyne Trump uu ka fiirsanayo inuu sii ballaariyo ololaha militari ee ka dhanka ah Iran. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in hoggaamiyaha cusub uu taageersan yahay sameysashada hub nukliyeer ah, arrintaas ayaa maamulka Trump siin karta sabab kale oo uu ku xoojiyo weerarrada. Si kastaba, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegaya in Tehran aysan weli qaadin tallaabo cad oo ay dib ugu bilaabeyso kobcinta uranium-ka ama howlaha kale ee muhiimka u ah sameynta hub nukliyeer. Waxayse Iran qaaday tallaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo qalabkeeda nukliyeerka kadib weerarradii Mareykanka ee sanadkii hore iyo xilliyadii dagaalka hadda socda uu yara hakaday. Qalab loo raray buur dhulka hoostiisa ah Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Iran ay ugu yaraan qaar ka mid ah qalabka centrifuges-ka u rartay xarun si weyn loo adkeeyey oo ku taalla bartamaha dalka, taas oo Washington ay ugu yeerto “Buurta Pickaxe”. Centrifuges-ku waa mashiinnada lagu kobciyo uranium-ka, waxaana dhaqdhaqaaqooda markii ugu horreysay toddobaadkan baahisay Wall Street Journal , oo sheegtay in sirdoonka Israel uu la socday raristooda. Tallaabadaas waxay noqon kartaa bilowga dib-u-dhiska awoodda kobcinta uranium-ka. Hase yeeshee, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa rumeysan in Iran ay hadda diiradda saareyso badbaadinta qalabka, iyadoo u rareysa meel ka baxsan awoodda bambooyinka Mareykanka. Bishii June 2025, Trump ayaa amray in ciidamada Mareykanka ay weeraraan saddex ka mid ah xarumaha ugu muhiimsan barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. Diyaaradaha qarsoon ee B-2 ayaa bambooyinka caadiga ah ee ugu waaweyn ee Mareykanku haysto ku garaacay xarumaha Fordo iyo Natanz, halka xarunta Isfahan lagu dhuftay gantaallada Tomahawk. Trump ayaa markiiba sheegay in howlgalka lagu “baabi’iyey” xarumahaas, balse qiimeyntii hore ee sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa ka taxaddar badneyd hadalkaas, iyadoo sheegtay in barnaamijka dib loo dhigay dhowr bilood oo keliya. Buurta Pickaxe laguma darin weerarradaas, waxaana xaruntaasi ay ciidamada Mareykanka u tahay bartilmaameed aad uga adag kuwii hore. Dhismayaasha gudaha xarunta ayaa si qoto dheer uga hooseeya buur, waxaana saraakiil Mareykan ah ay sheegeen inay ka baxsan yihiin awoodda bambooyinka caadiga ah ee ugu xooggan ee Washington hayso. Iran ayaa la sheegay inay baaritaan ku sameysay burburkii Fordo si ay u ogaato heerka ay gaareen bambooyinka Mareykanka, kadibna ay ku qanacday in godadka Buurta Pickaxe oo ka sii qoto dheer ay ka badbaadi karaan weerar cirka ah. Si kastaba, Tehran waxay ka walaacsan tahay in Mareykanku fuliyo weerar kumaandoos ah oo ciidamada dhulka ay gudaha ugu galaan xarunta, qalabkana halkaas ku burburiyaan. Sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Iran ay ciidamo dhulka ah geysay agagaarka Buurta Pickaxe si ay uga hortagto weerar noocaas ah. Trump ayaa toddobaadkan ku hanjabay inuu weerari karo xarunta, isaga oo ku tilmaamay “bartilmaameed suurtagal ah oo lagu dhufan karo jug weyn oo albaabkeeda hore ah”. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Mareykanku uusan halkaas ku arag wax howl nukliyeer ah, taas oo saraakiishu ku fasireen in Iran aysan weli dib u bilaabin kobcinta uranium-ka, inkasta oo ay qalab u rartay xarunta. Kaydka uranium-ka oo weli jira Weerarradii Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa ugu yaraan hakiyey horumarkii barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. Hay’adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa markii hore qiyaasay in burburka xarumaha uu barnaamijka dib u dhigi lahaa lix bilood oo keliya haddii Tehran ay si degdeg ah u dayactiri lahayd centrifuges-ka ama ay kobcinta uranium-ka ka bilaabi lahayd xarumo kale. Laakiin saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in Iran aysan isla markiiba qodin xarumihii burburay, isla markaana aysan howlaha kobcinta ka bilaabin goobo kale. Hase yeeshee, waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu sameyn karo bamka, gaar ahaan kaydka uranium-ka heerka sare loo kobciyey, ayaa weli jira, waxaana la rumeysan yahay in Tehran ay heli karto. Ali Khamenei ayaa hore u soo saaray fatwo diimeed uu ku mamnuucayo adeegsiga hubka nukliyeerka. Mowqifkaas ayaa si rasmi ah loogu gudbiyey Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Tamarta Nukliyeerka sanadkii 2005. Fatwadaas ma aysan joojin Iran inay horumariso barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka ama ay qaaddo tallaabooyin farsamo oo u dhow sameynta hub. Kooxo mayal adag oo dowladda ka tirsan ayaa xitaa xilligii Ali Khamenei doonayey in Iran ay yeelato awood ay si degdeg ah hub ugu sameysan karto. Sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa hadda rumeysan in Mojtaba Khamenei uu xiiseynayo hub ka casrisan bamka fudud ee Iran ay sahamineysay dhammaadkii maamulkii Joe Biden. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Tehran waqtigaas baareysay suurtagalnimada sameynta bam u eg kuwii hore ee nukliyeerka, kaas oo adkaan lahaa in lagu rakibo gantaal balse loo adeegsan karay cabsi-gelin iyo ka-hortag weerar. Mojtaba ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuusan hub noocaas ah u arkin mid faa’iido badan leh, balse uu taageersan yahay horumarinta madax dagaal thermonuclear ah oo mustaqbalka la yareyn karo laguna rakibi karo gantaallada riddada dheer. Khudbadihiisa fagaare, hoggaamiyaha cusub wuxuu ku ballanqaaday inuu ilaalinayo awoodda nukliyeerka Iran, balse si toos ah ugama uusan hadlin sameysashada hub. Wuxuu sidoo kale iska fogeeyey heshiis ay Mareykanka iyo Iran saxiixeen bishii June, kaas oo Tehran ku ballanqaadday inaysan raadin doonin hub nukliyeer. Mojtaba ayaa sheegay inuu oggolaaday in heshiiska la saxiixo, balse uusan mabda’ ahaan ku qanacsaneyn. Rosemary Kelanic, oo madax ka ah barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe ee machadka Defense Priorities, ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka iyo qorshaha Mareykanka ee lagu taageerayo Sacuudi Carabiya inay yeelato xarumo lagu kobciyo uranium-ka ay kordhinayaan fursadda Iran ay hub nukliyeer ku raadiso. “Iran waxay hadda haysataa sabab aad uga weyn oo ay hub nukliyeer u sameysato, si ay uga hortagto isku dayo kale oo Mareykanka ama Israel ay ku doonayaan inay ku burburiyaan nidaamka ama dowladda Iran,” ayay tiri. Waxay intaas ku dartay in dagaalku sidaas darteed kasoo horjeedo hadafkii loo sheegay ee ahaa in Iran laga hor istaago faafinta hubka nukliyeerka. Saraakiil Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in mas’uuliyiin Iranian ah oo muddo dheer ku doodayey in hub nukliyeer oo keliya uu dalkooda ka difaaci karo weerar ay qaadaan Israel ama Mareykanka ay hadda rumeysan yihiin in dagaalku xoojiyey doodooda. Sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa hadda rumeysan in Mojtaba Khamenei uu xiiseynayo hub ka casrisan bamka fudud ee Iran ay sahamineysay dhammaadkii maamulkii Joe Biden. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Tehran waqtigaas baareysay suurtagalnimada sameynta bam u eg kuwii hore ee nukliyeerka, kaas oo adkaan lahaa in lagu rakibo gantaal balse loo adeegsan karay cabsi-gelin iyo ka-hortag weerar. Mojtaba ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuusan hub noocaas ah u arkin mid faa’iido badan leh, balse uu taageersan yahay horumarinta madax dagaal thermonuclear ah oo mustaqbalka la yareyn karo laguna rakibi karo gantaallada riddada dheer. Khudbadihiisa fagaare, hoggaamiyaha cusub wuxuu ku ballanqaaday inuu ilaalinayo awoodda nukliyeerka Iran, balse si toos ah ugama uusan hadlin sameysashada hub. Wuxuu sidoo kale iska fogeeyey heshiis ay Mareykanka iyo Iran saxiixeen bishii June, kaas oo Tehran ku ballanqaadday inaysan raadin doonin hub nukliyeer. Mojtaba ayaa sheegay inuu oggolaaday in heshiiska la saxiixo, balse uusan mabda’ ahaan ku qanacsaneyn. Rosemary Kelanic, oo madax ka ah barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe ee machadka Defense Priorities, ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka iyo qorshaha Mareykanka ee lagu taageerayo Sacuudi Carabiya inay yeelato xarumo lagu kobciyo uranium-ka ay kordhinayaan fursadda Iran ay hub nukliyeer ku raadiso. “Iran waxay hadda haysataa sabab aad uga weyn oo ay hub nukliyeer u sameysato, si ay uga hortagto isku dayo kale oo Mareykanka ama Israel ay ku doonayaan inay ku burburiyaan nidaamka ama dowladda Iran,” ayay tiri. Waxay intaas ku dartay in dagaalku sidaas darteed kasoo horjeedo hadafkii loo sheegay ee ahaa in Iran laga hor istaago faafinta hubka nukliyeerka. Saraakiil Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in mas’uuliyiin Iranian ah oo muddo dheer ku doodayey in hub nukliyeer oo keliya uu dalkooda ka difaaci karo weerar ay qaadaan Israel ama Mareykanka ay hadda rumeysan yihiin in dagaalku xoojiyey doodooda. items.title: Puntland oo digniin u dirtay Galmudug iyo madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh kadib markii…
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Puntland ayaa soo saartay war-saxaafadeed ay ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu wado dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo lagu hurinayo colaado, laguna wiiqayo nidaamka dowladnimo ee Puntland. Warsaxaafadeedka oo ku taariikheysan 25-ka July 2026 ayaa Puntland waxay Xasan Sheekh ku tilmaantay “madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday”, iyadoo sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo maalmihii u dambeeyey ka socday qaybo ka mid ah deegaannadeeda iyo meelaha ku dhow. Puntland ma aysan soo bandhigin faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan ciidamada ay sheegtay in la abaabulayo, cidda hoggaamineysa iyo goobaha ay ku wajahan yihiin, balse waxay ku adkeysatay inay arrintan u aragto qorshe lagu dhaawacayo ammaankeeda iyo hay’adaha maamulkeeda. “Dowladda Puntland waxay caddeyneysaa inaysan jirin ciidan la yiraahdo PSF oo si sharci ah uga tirsan ciidamada Difaaca Dowladda Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuusan aqoonsaneyn ciidamo ay Dowladda Federaalka diiwaangelisay oo gudaha Puntland ka sameynaya dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan oggolaansho ka haysan hay’adaha ammaanka ee maamulka. Digniin loo diray Galmudug Puntland ayaa digniin gaar ah u dirtay dowladda Galmudug, oo xuduud dheer la wadaagta, gaar ahaan gobolka Mudug oo magaalada Gaalkacyo ay labada maamul kala maamulaan. Waxay Galmudug ugu baaqday in aysan garoomadeeda diyaaradaha iyo dhulka ay maamusho u oggolaan in laga soo gudbiyo saanad ciidan, hub iyo maleeshiyaad ay Puntland sheegtay in loo adeegsan karo weerarro ama qalqal-gelin ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda. Puntland waxay ku doodday in labada maamul ay muddo dheer lahaayeen derisnimo wanaagsan, iskaashi amni iyo nabadgelyo ay bulshooyinka ku nool Mudug ku wada noolaayeen. “Puntland waxay Galmudug ugu baaqaysaa inay ka waantoowdo in saanad ciidan iyo maleeshiyaad la soo mariyo garoomada iyo dhulka ay maamusho, kuwaas oo looga dan leeyahay in lagu dhibaateeyo shacabka reer Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Dowladda Galmudug iyo Dowladda Federaalka weli si rasmi ah ugama aysan jawaabin warsaxaafadeedkan iyo eedeymaha cusub ee Puntland. Digniintan ayaa timid laba maalmood kaddib markii wasiir ku-xigeenka amniga Puntland, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujaana, uu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay hub soo gelisay magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaas oo uu sheegay inuu yaallo dhinaca ay maamusho Galmudug. Dujaana wuxuu sheegay in Puntland ay hayso caddeymo ku saabsan hubka, isla markaana ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin ay ku difaaceyso ammaankeeda. Dowladda Federaalka kama aysan jawaabin sheegashadaas, mana jirto cid madax-bannaan oo xaqiijisay hubka la sheegay in la geeyay Gaalkacyo. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale maalmihii ugu dambeeyey ciidamo dheeraad ah geysay gobolka Mudug, iyadoo isbeddel ku sameysay hoggaanka cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Daraawiishta ee halkaas ka howlgala. Tallaabadaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in xiisadda siyaasadeed ay isu beddesho isku dhac ciidan. Dagaalkii Laag War-saxaafadeedka cusub ayaa sidoo kale daba socda dagaal 20-kii July deegaanka Laag ee duleedka Boosaaso ku dhexmaray ciidamada Daraawiishta Puntland iyo ciidamo ka tirsan PSF. Iska horimaadka ayaa qarxay markii ciidamada Puntland ay joojiyeen kolonyo PSF ah oo ka soo baxday Boosaaso, xilli maamulka uu horey u mamnuucay dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada aan ka amar qaadan hay’adihiisa. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa markii dambe la wareegay gaadiid dagaal, hub iyo askar ka tirsan PSF, halka ciidamadii kale ay lug kaga baxeen goobta. Wararka maxalliga ah ayaa tirooyin kala duwan ka bixiyey askarta la qabtay ama isa soo dhiibtay, balse Puntland waxay sheegtay inay si buuxda ula wareegtay deegaanka Laag. PSF ayaa markii hore ahaa ciidan la-dagaallama argagixisada oo Mareykanku tababar iyo taageero siin jiray, balse xiriirka ciidankaas iyo maamulka Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa xumaaday tan iyo khilaafkii hubeysnaa ee Boosaaso ka dhacay dabayaaqadii 2021. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay markii mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka ay PSF ku dareen cutub cusub oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, arrintaas oo Puntland si adag u diidday, kuna tilmaantay faragelin lagu sameynayo nidaamkeeda amni. Khilaafka amni wuxuu qayb ka yahay muran siyaasadeed oo ballaaran oo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka, kaas oo salka ku haya wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, nidaamka doorashada, awood-qaybsiga iyo maamulka ciidamada federaalka ee ku sugan Puntland. Puntland ayaa ugu dambeyn shacabka deegaannadeeda ugu baaqday inay ilaashadaan dhulkooda iyo dowladnimadooda, iyadoo ka digtay dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo ay ku tilmaantay mid lagu qalqal-gelinayo ammaanka iyo xasilloonida maamulka.
