items.title: Jadwalka doorashada HirShabelle oo la shaaciyay – Goorma ayey dhaceysa?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u shaaciyay jadwalka guud ee hawlaha doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabeelle. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay guddiga ayaa lagu sheegay in jadwalkan uu yahay hagaha rasmiga ah ee dhammaan hawlaha doorashada, laga bilaabo diiwaan-gelinta iyo ansixinta musharraxiinta illaa maalinta codbixinta. Sida ku cad jadwalka, diiwaan-gelinta iyo qaybinta foomamka codbixiyeyaasha ayaa dhammaan doonta 5-ta August, halka 7-da August la asteyn doono laguna dhawaaqi doono xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta ee doorashadu ka dhici doonto. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale shaaciyay in 8-da August la soo bandhigi doono liiska hordhaca ah ee diiwaanka codbixiyeyaasha. Intaas kaddib, 11-ka August ayay ururrada siyaasaddu soo gudbin doonaan liiska wakiilladooda ee goobaha codbixinta. Sidoo kale, 15-ka August ayaa loo asteeyay soo gudbinta iyo xaqiijinta liiska musharraxiinta u tartamaya Golaha Wakiillada iyo goleyaasha deegaanka, halka 16-ka August la shaacin doono liiska kama dambaysta ah ee codbixiyeyaasha. Jadwalku wuxuu kaloo tilmaamaya in 18-ka August la soo bandhigi doono liiska musharraxiinta ururrada siyaasadda, ka hor inta aan la gaarin maalinta codbixinta oo si rasmi ah loogu asteeyay 20-ka August 2026. War-saxaafadeedka guddiga ayaa lagu adkeeyay in dhammaan ururrada siyaasadda, musharraxiinta iyo hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso doorashadu ay u hoggaansamaan jadwalka iyo tilmaamaha uu guddigu soo saaray. Waxa kale oo guddigu ugu baaqay shacabka HirShabeelle inay si nabad ah uga qayb qaataan geeddi-socodka doorashada, iyagoo dhowraya shuruucda iyo nidaamyada u yaalla. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in jadwalku ujeeddadiisu tahay in doorashadu u dhacdo si hufan, daah-furan, isla markaana waafaqsan shuruucda dalka. Si kastaba, shaacinta jadwalkan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli doorashada HirShabeelle ay si weyn isha ugu hayaan dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Doorashadan ayaa noqon doonta tijaabo muhiim ah oo lagu qiimeeyo hirgelinta nidaamka doorashooyinka isku sidkan, iyadoo la filayo in maalmaha soo socda ay dardar galaan diyaar-garowga ururrada siyaasadda iyo musharraxiinta ka qaybgalaya tartanka. items.title: Somalia’s Turkish Illusion
items.description: By Isha Qarsoon Every Somali understands that Ethiopia pursues Ethiopian interests. Nobody is surprised when Kenya advances Kenyan interests. No one expects the United States, China, the United Arab Emirates, or Britain to place Somalia’s interests above their own. That is the nature of international politics. States exist to advance the welfare, security, and prosperity of their own people. Their generosity may be genuine, their partnerships sincere, but their foreign policy ultimately serves their national interest. Yet somehow Turkey escaped this basic rule in the Somali imagination. It became the one foreign power that many Somalis stopped analyzing as a foreign power. Instead, it came to be viewed as a brother, a friend, an exception to the normal rules of statecraft. That perception, more than any agreement or investment, may prove to be Turkey’s greatest achievement in Somalia. To say this is not to deny Turkey’s contribution. It arrived when many others stayed away. President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan visited Mogadishu at a time when such visits were politically risky. Turkish hospitals treated Somali patients. Roads were built. Scholarships were awarded. Businesses invested. Military officers were trained. Turkish officials spoke a language of partnership and dignity rather than charity or tutelage. These are facts, not propaganda, and Somalis had every reason to welcome them. Gratitude was entirely appropriate. But gratitude and strategic judgment are not the same thing. The mistake was not embracing Turkey as a partner. The mistake was concluding that Turkey, unlike every other state, had somehow ceased to pursue Turkish interests. That conclusion has shaped Somali politics in ways that few people appreciate. The greatest influence is often the influence that no longer appears to be influence. Once a foreign government acquires a reputation for exceptional goodwill, scrutiny fades. Agreements that would provoke fierce national debate if signed with another country are accepted with little discussion because they involve the trusted friend. Skepticism is dismissed as ingratitude. Questions become politically awkward. Slowly, almost imperceptibly, a foreign state’s intentions cease to be examined with the same discipline applied to everyone else. This is not because Turkey deceived Somalis. Rather, Somalis gradually stopped asking the questions that every sovereign nation should ask of every foreign government. What does this country seek? How does this agreement advance its interests? What are the long-term consequences for ours? These are not hostile questions. They are the ordinary questions of a politically mature society. Friendship does not eliminate the need to ask them. If anything, friendship makes them more important, because trust has a way of lowering our guard. Seen through this lens, Turkey’s expanding role in Somalia appears less as a series of unrelated developments and more as a coherent progression. It began with humanitarian engagement and public goodwill. It expanded into infrastructure and commerce. From there it moved naturally into military cooperation and institutional presence. Turkey became a principal security partner, trained elite Somali forces, assumed important operational responsibilities, and steadily deepened its relationship with the presidency. None of these developments, viewed in isolation, seemed alarming. Each could be defended on its own merits. Yet foreign influence is rarely accumulated in a single dramatic step. It grows incrementally, each stage making the next appear entirely reasonable. The pattern became clearer as Turkey’s role expanded beyond traditional cooperation into sectors that will shape Somalia’s future prosperity. The hydrocarbons agreement was not simply another investment contract. It placed Turkey in a privileged position within Somalia’s emerging petroleum sector. More recently, attention has turned to cooperation in the country’s mineral resources, suggesting that petroleum may represent the beginning rather than the culmination of a broader economic relationship. Again, each agreement can be defended individually. Collectively, however, they reveal a foreign partner whose influence now extends across security, infrastructure, diplomacy, and strategic natural resources. That combination deserves careful examination, not because Turkey is uniquely malevolent, but because no foreign state should occupy such a broad position in another country’s affairs without rigorous public scrutiny. Perhaps the clearest illustration of this changing relationship came during the crisis triggered by Ethiopia’s memorandum of understanding with Somaliland. At one of the most difficult diplomatic moments faced by the Federal Government, Turkey emerged as the indispensable intermediary. It possessed the relationships, credibility, and access necessary to engage both Mogadishu and Addis Ababa. Somalia needed Turkey’s diplomatic support. Turkey, by contrast, did not depend upon Somalia in the same way. That imbalance should have prompted a national conversation about the implications of relying so heavily upon one external partner while simultaneously negotiating agreements affecting the country’s strategic resources. Instead, the two developments were largely discussed as though they existed in separate worlds. International politics does not work that way. States accumulate political capital over many years and deploy it when opportunities arise. There is nothing unusual about this. The United States does it. China does it. The Gulf states do it. Turkey does it. Successful governments convert goodwill into influence, influence into access, and access into opportunities that advance their national interests. The remarkable aspect of Somalia’s experience is not that Turkey has behaved like a state. It is that so many Somalis continue to discuss Turkey as though it were something other than a state. This is where the focus must shift from Ankara to Mogadishu. The central question is not whether Turkey is pursuing Turkish interests. Of course it is. Every responsible government should. The real question is why Somali institutions have become so willing to concentrate political, security, economic, and diplomatic relationships in a single foreign partner without developing equally strong mechanisms of constitutional oversight and public accountability. Every major agreement bears Somali signatures. Every concession is approved by Somali officials. Every expansion of foreign influence reflects a decision taken within Somali institutions. Foreign governments cannot surrender powers that do not belong to them. Only Somalis can do that. For too long we have explained Somalia’s difficulties by pointing outward. Foreign interference has become the default explanation for nearly every political failure. There is truth in that accusation, but it is only half the story. External actors can exploit weaknesses that already exist; they cannot create constitutional indifference, institutional fragility, or executive overreach on their own. Those are domestic failures. When foreign governments discover that important decisions can be negotiated through a narrow circle of political actors rather than through resilient institutions, they naturally adapt their diplomacy to that reality. The responsibility for changing it lies not with Ankara, Abu Dhabi, Addis Ababa, Washington, or Beijing. It lies with us. This is why the debate over Turkey should not become an exercise in resentment. Turkey owes its first duty to the Turkish people. No one should expect otherwise. The burden of protecting Somalia’s sovereignty rests entirely upon Somali shoulders. That protection does not require rejecting foreign investment or abandoning international partnerships. It requires something much more difficult: the discipline to distinguish gratitude from judgment and friendship from permanent alignment of interests. Nations that fail to make that distinction eventually discover that they have confused trust with strategy. The greatest natural resource Turkey has acquired in Somalia may not be oil or minerals. It is trust. Trust is what allowed Turkey to become the one foreign power that many Somalis stopped questioning. Trust reduced the political cost of expanding influence into ever more strategic sectors. Trust made extraordinary agreements appear ordinary because they were concluded with an extraordinary friend. Yet trust, however well deserved, can never substitute for constitutional safeguards, institutional balance, or vigilant public scrutiny. A sovereign nation does not suspend critical judgment because it admires a partner. It applies the same standards to every foreign government precisely because it values that partnership enough to place it on a durable and transparent foundation. Somalia does not need fewer friends. It needs a clearer understanding of what friendship means in international politics. A true partner should welcome transparent institutions, constitutional procedures, parliamentary oversight, and informed public debate because those are the foundations of legitimate and enduring cooperation. Relationships that depend upon unquestioning trust are inherently fragile. Relationships that survive rigorous scrutiny are the ones that endure. History will not judge Turkey harshly for advancing Turkish interests. That is what governments exist to do. History will judge Somalia by a different standard. It will ask whether Somali leaders and Somali citizens remembered that protecting Somalia’s interests is their responsibility alone. The day a nation stops asking what another state wants is the day it begins to lose something more valuable than territory or natural resources. It begins to lose the habit of thinking like a sovereign people. items.title: Bosaso Port Dispute Reignites as Traders Say DP World Failed to Honor Fee Agreement
items.description: Bosaso (WDN) – Just days after authorities announced a breakthrough in the long-running dispute over port charges at Bosaso Port, the controversy has unexpectedly flared up again, with traders accusing DP World of failing to implement the agreement that many believed had finally brought the crisis to an end. The renewed disagreement has come as a surprise to the business community, which had welcomed last week’s announcement as a significant step toward restoring confidence and stability at Puntland’s principal commercial gateway. However, several Bosaso traders now insist that the underlying dispute remains unresolved. In a joint statement, representatives of the business community alleged that DP World has continued to impose the same disputed MT/CBM port handling charges despite the recently announced agreement with the Puntland government. They claim they have effectively been compelled to pay the very fees they had challenged throughout the dispute. The traders argued that the agreement has yet to be reflected in practice, raising fresh questions about its implementation and enforcement. Seeking greater transparency, the business community called for an immediate review of the MT/CBM tariff system introduced by DP World at Bosaso Port. They also urged Puntland authorities to require the company to publicly explain the basis, methodology, and justification for the new fee structure. In addition, the traders requested an official comparative assessment of port charges at Bosaso, Berbera, and Mogadishu, arguing that the fees imposed at Bosaso appear significantly higher than those charged at competing ports in the region. They contend that the disparity risks undermining Bosaso’s competitiveness as a major commercial hub and increasing costs for importers, exporters, and ultimately consumers. The renewed dispute has prompted traders to appeal directly to Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, urging him to personally intervene and ensure that the commitments announced during last week’s negotiations are fully implemented. The disagreement had previously disrupted commercial activity in Bosaso and contributed to rising prices of essential goods across Puntland before a settlement was announced. The latest developments have therefore revived concerns that the dispute could once again affect trade, supply chains, and business confidence if a durable resolution is not reached. As of publication, neither DP World nor the Puntland government had publicly responded to the traders’ latest allegations or clarified whether additional negotiations are planned to resolve the renewed impasse. items.title: Somali Pirates Seize Fourth Vessel in Three Months as Maritime Security Fears Grow
items.description: EYL (WDN) – Somali piracy appears to be making a troubling comeback after another commercial vessel hijacked off the coast of Yemen was brought to the Puntland coastline, underscoring growing concerns that pirate networks are once again expanding their operations across the western Indian Ocean. The cargo vessel Asana, sailing under the Tanzanian flag, arrived off the coast of Eyl district in Somalia’s Nugaal region after being seized by armed pirates last Friday in waters off Yemen. According to a resident in the nearby community of Maraya, food supplies and weapons were delivered overnight to the armed group holding the vessel, suggesting the hijackers are preparing for a potentially prolonged standoff while awaiting ransom negotiations. The Asana is carrying 20 crew members, including eight German nationals and ten Filipino nationals, while the nationalities of the remaining crew members have not been disclosed. The hijacking marks the fourth commercial vessel captured by Somali pirates in just three months, signaling what maritime security experts fear could be the beginning of a broader resurgence in piracy after years of relative calm. Three other vessels remain anchored off the Puntland coast in the Bari and Mudug regions, where pirate groups are reportedly demanding substantial ransom payments for the release of the ships, their cargo, and their crews. The growing number of hijackings is fueling renewed concern among shipping companies, insurers, and regional governments that pirate networks are rebuilding the operational capabilities they once used to terrorize one of the world’s busiest maritime corridors. Between 2008 and 2018, Somali pirates disrupted global shipping, seized dozens of commercial vessels, and extracted millions of dollars in ransom, prompting an unprecedented international naval response in the Gulf of Aden and the western Indian Ocean. Although piracy declined sharply following coordinated international anti-piracy operations and improved onboard security measures, attacks began resurfacing in late 2023. The latest hijacking suggests that the threat is no longer isolated. With multiple vessels now being held simultaneously and pirate groups appearing increasingly organized, observers warn that maritime insecurity is once again spreading its wings, threatening international trade routes, increasing shipping costs, and making life considerably more dangerous for seafarers navigating the waters around the Horn of Africa. Unless regional authorities and international naval forces strengthen coordinated maritime security efforts, analysts caution that Somali piracy could once again evolve from a sporadic criminal enterprise into a major threat to global commerce. items.title: Kenyan Minister’s Remarks on Historical Discrimination Against Somali Community Spark National Backlash
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — Remarks by Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Health, Aden Barre Duale, have ignited a fierce political debate, drawing strong reactions across the country—particularly among members of the Kikuyu community—after he accused previous Kenyan administrations of systematically discriminating against ethnic Somalis. Speaking at a public event, Duale alleged that successive governments led by former Presidents Jomo Kenyatta and Mwai Kibaki deliberately denied thousands of young Kenyan Somalis access to national identity cards, effectively limiting their ability to fully participate in the country’s civic and economic life. “Previous governments intentionally discriminated against Somalis by denying our youth national identity cards,” Duale said. “They should remember that Somalis are a nation of nearly 40 million people across the region, while they number only around three million and are confined within Kenya.” The comments immediately triggered widespread criticism and intense public debate, with many Kenyans arguing that references to ethnic population size risk inflaming longstanding sensitivities surrounding identity and national cohesion. Political observers noted that while historical grievances over citizenship documentation in Kenya’s North Eastern region have long been documented and debated, Duale’s choice of language has shifted attention away from the policy issue itself toward concerns over ethnic rhetoric. The remarks have also prompted unease within sections of Kenya’s Somali community. Some community leaders warned that statements framed in ethnic terms could unintentionally expose Somali-owned businesses and communities to heightened political tensions at a time when national unity remains a sensitive issue. Meanwhile, several traditional elders from Kenya’s North Eastern region echoed Duale’s broader criticism of past administrations, arguing that previous governments under Jomo Kenyatta, Daniel arap Moi, and Mwai Kibaki pursued policies that marginalized Kenyan Somalis because of their perceived political affinity with neighboring Somalia. One elder claimed that during the Moi administration, local communities were warned that continued expressions of support for Somalia would invite severe government retaliation. According to the elder, officials even threatened to poison community water wells if such sentiments persisted—a claim that has not been independently verified. The controversy has reopened discussion over one of Kenya’s most contentious historical issues: the long-standing complaints by many residents of the North Eastern region regarding delays and obstacles in obtaining national identity cards, a prerequisite for voting, employment, education, banking, and other public services. Although recent governments have introduced reforms aimed at improving access to identity documents, the issue continues to resonate politically among many Kenyan Somalis, who view it as part of a broader legacy of historical exclusion. As public debate intensifies, analysts caution that discussions about historical injustices require careful handling. While acknowledging legitimate grievances, they warn that framing such issues through ethnic comparisons risks deepening divisions rather than fostering reconciliation. The Kenyan government has not issued an official statement addressing the controversy surrounding Duale’s remarks, but the comments have already become one of the country’s most widely discussed political issues, underscoring the enduring sensitivity of questions surrounding citizenship, equality, and national identity. items.title: Somali-American Extradited from Somalia Faces Murder Charges in Ohio
items.description: Columbus, Ohio (WDN) – A 23-year-old Somali-American who was extradited from Somalia has appeared before a court in Ohio to face murder and aggravated robbery charges stemming from a fatal shooting that occurred in 2021. The defendant, Hanut Abdulle, is accused in connection with the killing of Bryce Persang, who was fatally shot during an alleged armed robbery in Columbus on September 16, 2021. During his initial court appearance, the judge set bail at $2 million. If released pending trial, Abdulle would be required to surrender his passport and wear a GPS electronic monitoring device to track his movements. According to investigators, Abdulle and a second suspect, Tahir Said, 24, are believed to have been involved in the fatal incident. Authorities say both men left the United States shortly after the shooting. Abdulle was later located in Somalia and extradited to the United States through cooperation between Somali and U.S. law enforcement agencies. The second suspect, Tahir Said, remains at large, and authorities continue efforts to locate and apprehend him. The case has drawn attention not only because of the international manhunt and extradition but also because it underscores the enduring grief surrounding violent crime. For the victim’s family, the return of a suspect to face justice represents an important step in a case that has remained unresolved for nearly four years. Abdulle is currently facing criminal charges, but no verdict has been reached. Under the U.S. legal system, he is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in a court of law. items.title: Guddiga doorashooyinka oo shaacisay jadwalka doorashada Hirshabeelle
items.description: Muqdisho – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay jadwalka doorashada Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle, isagoo gudanaya waajibaadkiisa shaqo ee ku xusan Qodobka 10-aad ee Sharciga Dhismaha GMDQS iyo Qodobka 18-aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. Jadwalka uu guddigu soo saaray ayaa muujinaya in diiwaangelinta iyo qaybinta kaararka codbixiyeyaasha ay bilaaban doonto 5-ta Agoosto, halka 7-da Agoosto la shaacin doono xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta. Sidoo kale, 8-da Agoosto waxaa la soo bandhigi doonaa liiska hordhaca ah ee codbixiyeyaasha, iyadoo maalmaha xiga la dhammaystiri doono gudbinta iyo xaqiijinta liisaska musharraxiinta iyo wakiillada ururrada siyaasadda. GMDQS ayaa sidoo kale shaacisay in 16-ka Agoosto la soo saari doono liiska kama dambaysta ah ee codbixiyeyaasha, halka 18-ka Agoosto la daabici doono liiska kama dambaysta ah ee musharraxiinta ururrada siyaasadda. Sida jadwalku tilmaamayo, doorashada Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle ayaa si rasmi ah u dhici doonta 20-ka Agoosto.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee dagaalka Sanaag iyo DF oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horeysay ka hadashay dagaal beeleedka mar kale dib uga qarxay degaanno ka tirsan gobolka Sool ee Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya, iyada oo baaq nabeed u dirtay beelo walaalo ah oo ku dagaalamaya halkaasi. Wasiirka Ganacsiga Soomaaliya, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan oo kasoo jeedo gobolkaas ayaa nasiib darro ku tilmaamay dagaalkan, wuxuuna ugu baaqay beelaha walaalaha inay xabadda joojiyaan, isa markaana ay xalka ku raadiyaan wada-hadal iyo deganaan. Sidoo kale wuxuu guud ahaan bulshada deegaanka ka dalbaday inay nabadda ka shaqeeyaan, ayna u istaagaan sidii loo joojiyaan colaadda qabaa’ilka. “Waa nasiib-darro weyn in shacabka gobolka Sanaag ay wakhtigan dib ugu laabtaan dagaal sokeeye iyo aanooyinkii Soomaali curyaamiyay, balse ay iyagu ka nabad-galeen xilliyadii ugu adkaa ee dalkani soo maray. Waxaan si adag ugu baaqayaa joojinta colaadda ka soo cusboonaatay deegaanka Dawaco ee gobolka Sanaag, aniga oo labada dhinac ku boorrinaya inay si degdeg ah oo bilaa shuruud ah u joojiyaan dagaalka,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Jamaal Maxamed Xasan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu farriin u diray Maamul-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari oo uu ka socday inuu qaado tallaabo looga hortagayo dagaal beeleedka goboka Sanaag. “Waxaan ku boorrinayaa Maamulka Waqooyi Bari, culimada, haweenka, guurtida, dhallinyarada, iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada inay si degdeg ah uga hawlgaan daminta colaaddaas, isla markaana kala dhex-galaan walaalaha dhiiggoodu daadanayo,” ayuu mar kale yiri Wasiirku. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay “Ugu dambayntii, colaaddu ma istaagayso haddaan labada dhinac si caddaalad ah loogu kala-garqaadin, nabad waartana la dhex-dhigin. Sidaasi awgeed, guurtida iyo odayaasha dhaqanka waxa saaran masuuliyad culus oo ay tahay inay si dhakhso ah u gutaan,” Dagaalka ka socda gudaha gobolka Sanaag ayaa dhaliyay khasaare isugu jiro dhimasho iyo dhaawac, iyada oo weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid kacsan. Si kastaba, soo noqoshada dagaalkan ayaa sababtay kadib markii ay Puntland halkaas kasoo saartay ciidamadii horay loo kala dhex-galay labada beelood, waxaana kadib sidaas ku bilowday dagaalka, waxaana weli is horfadhiya labada dhinac. items.title: General Yahya Saree oo ka hadlay laba weerar oo Xuutiyiinta ka fuliyeen gudaha Sacuudiga
items.description: Ururka Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay ciidamadoodu beegsadeen xarumaha ay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ku leedahay Magaalooyinka Jizan iyo Yanbu oo saaran xeebaha Badda Cas. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in Sabtidan ay gantaalo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyadoo laga jawaabayo gardarrada Riyadh. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga uu xalay weeraro xagga cirka ah ka gaystay Dekedda Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran oo ku taal xeebta galbeed ee Yemen. items.title: Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan hay’adaha dawladda oo casho-sharaf u sameeyey qurbejoog ka
items.description: Hargeysa – Xubno ka tirsan masuuliyiinta hay’adaha kala duwan ee dawladda Somaliland ayaa magaalada Hargeysa ku qabtay munaasibad casho-sharaf ah oo lagu maamuusay qaar ka mid ah qurbejoogta Somaliland ee ka yimid dalalka Yurub, taas oo lagu xoojiyey xidhiidhka u dhexeeya qurbejoogta iyo hay’adaha dawladda. Masuuliyiinta soo qabanqaabiyey munaasibadda ayaa kala ahaa Maareeyaha Hay’adda Horumarinta Waddooyinka Somaliland, Mudane Maxamed Faarax Cabdi, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland, Mudane Xamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, Agaasimaha Waaxda Maamulka iyo Xisaabaadka ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Mudane Shabac Cabdi Maxamed, iyo Maareeyaha Kaydka Haamaha Shiidaalka Somaliland, Mudane Maxamed Sidiiq Dhamme. Kulankaas waxaa ka qaybgalay oo kale aqoonyahanno iyo xubno ka tirsan qurbejoogta Somaliland ee dalalka Yurub, iyadoo diiradda lagu saaray adkaynta wada shaqaynta, midnimada iyo doorka qurbejoogtu ku leeyihiin horumarka iyo dhismaha qaranka. Maareeyaha Hay’adda Horumarinta Waddooyinka Somaliland, Mudane Maxamed Faarax Cabdi, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland, Mudane Xamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, Agaasimaha Waaxda Maamulka iyo Xisaabaadka ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Mudane Shabac Cabdi Maxamed oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa sheegay in socdaallo shaqo oo ay dhawaan ku tageen dalal ka tirsan Yurub ay kaga qaybgaleen munaasibadihii loo dabaaldegayey xuska maalinta qaranimada Somaliland ee 18-ka May 2026, halkaas oo ay kula kulmeen jaaliyadaha Somaliland ee ku dhaqan waddamadaas. Mas’uuliyiintaas ayaa si weyn u ammaanay isku-duubnida, wadajirka iyo sida hufan ee jaaliyaduhu u soo agaasimeen munaasibadaha xuska 18-ka May, iyagoo tilmaamay in arrintaasi ay muujinayso dareenka waddaniyadeed iyo taageerada joogtada ah ee qurbejoogtu u hayaan dalkooda. Masuuliyiintu waxay ugu baaqeen jaaliyadaha Somaliland ee ku nool dalalka Yurub inay sii xoojiyaan midnimadooda iyo wada shaqayntooda, isla markaana ay sii laba jibbaaraan kaalinta ay ka qaataan horumarka, maalgashiga iyo taageerada ay u fidiyaan dalkooda. Waxa kale oo ay madasha ku soo bandhigeen warbixin ku saabsan xaaladda guud ee dalka, horumarka ay xukuumaddu ka waddo dhinacyada kala duwan iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in qurbejoogtu sii xoojiso xidhiidhka iyo wada shaqaynta ay la leeyihiin hay’adaha qaranka. Dhinaca kale, xubno ka mid ah qurbejoogtii ka soo qaybgashay munaasibadda ayaa halkaas ka hadlay, iyagoo uga mahadceliyey masuuliyiinta dawladda qabanqaabada casho-sharafta iyo sida ay u muujiyeen qiimaha ay xukuumaddu siinayso qurbejoogta Somaliland, Waxay sidoo kale caddeeyeen inay sii wadi doonaan taageerada ay u hayaan dalkooda, isla markaana ay ka qayb qaadan doonaan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo Somaliland.

items.title: Sacuudiga oo tallaabo qaaday kadib gantaallo lagu weeraray
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Nidaamka difaaca cirka ee ay isticmaalaan militariga Giriigga ee Sacuudi Carabiya yaalla ayaa maanta qabtay laba gantaal oo nuuca ballistic-ga ah oo laga soo riday gudaha dalka Yemen. Gantaallada laga hortegay ayaa ujeedkooda ahaa in lagu bartilmaameedsado warshadaha saliidda ee Yanbu, sida ay ilo-wareedyo amni oo Giriig ah u sheegeen Reuters. Sidoo kale, saacado ka hor, Ururka Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la baabi’iyay khatarta weerar ka dhici kara gobolka Yanbu. Digniintan ayaa timid saacado ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku dhawaaqeen inay qaadi doonaan tallaabo aargoosi ah oo ay kaga jawaabayaan weerarrada isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudigu uu ku qaaday goobaha kooxda ee Hodeidah. Horay waxay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee taageerada ka hesha Iran ugu dhawaaqeen inay xannibaad badeed kusoo rogtay Sacuudi Carabiya, taas oo loo arkay tallaabo sii ballaarin karta dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana halis cusub gelinaysa maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sahayda shidaalka caalamka. “Waxaan ku dhawaaqeynaa xannibaad badeed oo ka dhan ah cadowga Sacuudiga, annaga oo ku dhaqmeyna mabda’a ah il ka il,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Xuutiyiinta. Tallaabadan ayaa furtay jiho cusub oo dagaal xilli Mareykanka iyo Iran ay wel is weydaarsanayaan weerarro culus, kuwaas oo ku fiday dalal dhowr ah oo ku yaalla Bariga Dhexe. Bab al-Mandab waa marin istaraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaana mara qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah shidaalka iyo badeecadaha u kala goosha Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Haddii marinka si buuxda loo xiro, waxaa hakad geli kara shidaal u dhigma ku dhowaad toddoba boqolkiiba sahayda caalamka, iyadoo inta badan dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee dhinaca Badda Cas ay ku adkaan karto inay gaarto suuqyada caalamka. Dagaalka ka socda Gacanka ayaa durba hoos u dhigay qulqulka shidaalka caalamka qiyaastii 10 boqolkiiba, taas oo sare u qaadday qiimaha tamarta, gaadiidka iyo badeecadaha kale. Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa markii hore kor u kacay kadib ku dhawaaqista Xuutiyiinta, balse dib ayuu hoos ugu soo laabtay markii suuqyadu rajo ka muujiyeen dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed. The post Sacuudiga oo tallaabo qaaday kadib gantaallo lagu weeraray appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Kenya oo Dhistay Cutub Gaar ah oo La Dagaallama Ka Ganacsiga Dadka iyo Dambiyada Xuduudaha Ka Gudba
items.description: Nairobi – Dowladda Kenya ayaa hawlgelisay cutub boolis oo khaas ah oo loogu talagalay la dagaallanka ka ganacsiga dadka, tahriibinta muhaajiriinta iyo dambiyada abaabulan ee la xiriira socdaalka. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in uu yahay cutubkii ugu horreeyay ee noociisa ah Bariga Afrika. Cutubkan oo ka kooban 29 sarkaal, laguna magacaabo Counter-Organised Immigration Crime Team (COICT), ayaa ka shaqeyn doona baaritaanka shabakadaha dambiyada ee ka faa’iideysta xuduudaha iyo nidaamka socdaalka Kenya. Waxaa la geyn doonaa goobaha muhiimka ah ee xuduudaha dalka. Saraakiisha ayaa tababar heer sare ah ku qaatay baaritaannada ku saleysan xog sirdoon, falanqaynta caddeymaha dijitaalka iyo maaliyadda, maamulka goobaha dambiyada, iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda dhibbanayaasha. Agaasimaha Waaxda Dambi-baarista Kenya (DCI), Mohamed Amin, ayaa sheegay in cutubkan uu diiradda saari doono burburinta shabakadaha dambiyada abaabulan iyadoo isla markaana la dhowrayo xuquuqda iyo karaamada dadka ay dhibaatadu soo gaarto. Mashruucan waxaa taageeray Barnaamijka Amniga Xuduudaha Bariga Afrika, iyadoo ay gacan ka geysteen Dowladda Boqortooyada Midowday (UK), hay’adaha VALAR iyo HAART Kenya. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada ay dalalka Bariga Afrika ku xoojinayaan iskaashiga amniga si loola dagaallamo ka ganacsiga dadka, tahriibinta muhaajiriinta, maalgelinta argagixisada iyo been-abuurka dukumentiyada safarka.

items.title: Midowga Afrika oo wada-tashi ka billaabay mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Qeybta Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika (African Union Peace Support Operations Division) ayaa 24-kii Luulyo qabatay shir heer khubaro ah oo lagu falanqeeyay mustaqbalka ka-qaybgalka Midowga Afrika ee arrimaha amniga iyo nabadeynta Soomaaliya. Shirka, oo uu guddoominayay Agaasimaha Qeybta Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika, Jeneraal Cheick Dembele, ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay wakiillo ka socday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), dalalka ciidamada iyo booliiska ku biiriya howlgalka, Guddiga Saraakiisha Militariga ee Midowga Afrika, kooxda A3 ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Qaramada Midoobay. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray is-weydaarsiga aragtiyo iyo talooyin ku saabsan jihada uu qaadan doono howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo la eegayo xaaladda amni, dadaallada dowlad-dhisidda iyo qorshaha kala-guurka ee lagu wareejinayo mas’uuliyadda amniga ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Mas’uuliyiinta ka qeyb gashay ayaa sidoo kale falanqeeyay sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah, si loo xaqiijiyo nabad waarta, xasillooni iyo horumar laga gaaro la dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada. Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegay in shirkan uu qeyb ka yahay geeddi-socod istaraatiiji ah oo wada-tashi joogto ah, kaas oo lagu taageerayo go’aan ka gaarista qaabka iyo doorka uu Midowga Afrika mustaqbalka uga sii shaqeyn doono Soomaaliya, iyadoo la tixgelinayo baahiyaha dalka iyo xaaladaha amni ee isbeddelaya. Kulankan ayaa imanaya xilli ay socdaan dadaallo lagu qiimeynayo mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM iyo sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa in Soomaaliya ay si tartiib tartiib ah ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, iyadoo taageero ka helaysa Midowga Afrika iyo beesha caalamka.

items.title: Turkey cannot commercially drill Somalia’s offshore oil: ex-Puntland minister
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former Puntland minister and Somali political commentator Ali Haji Warsame has questioned Turkey’s ability to commercially develop Somalia’s offshore oil resources, arguing that Ankara’s current operations in Somali waters are limited to exploration and fall far short of full-scale oil production. Speaking in a recent interview, Warsame said the Turkish exploration vessel operating off central Somalia is carrying out what he described as test drilling and exploration activities, not commercial drilling or oil extraction. He argued that Turkey does not currently possess the capability to independently develop the offshore blocks awarded under its hydrocarbons agreement with Somalia’s federal government and would ultimately require partnerships with major international energy companies before any commercial production could begin. Warsame further claimed that the development process could take years, saying Somalia is unlikely to see commercially produced offshore oil before 2034, even if exploration proves successful and future investment moves ahead. The former Puntland minister also criticized the terms of the Somalia-Turkey petroleum agreement, alleging that Ankara is seeking a 90% share of profits under what he described as an opaque and unfavorable deal negotiated with the current federal administration. He argued that the Somali public has not been fully informed about the agreement and accused officials of creating unrealistic expectations by suggesting the country is on the verge of producing offshore oil. “The public is being led to believe commercial oil production is imminent when the process remains years away,” Warsame said. Warsame joins a growing number of Somali academics, politicians and public figures who have publicly questioned the transparency and legal basis of Somalia’s petroleum partnership with Turkey. Among the most prominent critics is Somali scholar Professor Abdi Ismail Samatar, who has repeatedly argued that the agreement lacks sufficient transparency and should have undergone broader legal and institutional scrutiny before implementation. In recent social media posts, Samatar accused Turkey of pursuing Somalia’s natural resources through what he characterized as an improperly negotiated agreement with the federal government. He also alleged that Ankara’s military support for Mogadishu – including drones, air support and other security assistance – is intended to safeguard its strategic and economic interests in Somalia. Those allegations have not been independently verified, and neither the Turkish nor Somali governments have accepted such claims. Turkey has significantly expanded its presence in Somalia in recent years through cooperation in defense, infrastructure, humanitarian assistance and energy development. Under a hydrocarbons agreement signed with Somalia’s federal government, Turkish exploration vessels have begun offshore operations aimed at assessing the country’s oil and natural gas potential. Somalia’s federal government has consistently defended the partnership, saying the agreement is intended to unlock the country’s offshore energy resources, attract foreign investment and strengthen long-term economic development. Officials maintain that exploration activities are being conducted in accordance with Somali law and are designed to benefit the country’s future energy sector. Turkey has likewise described its energy cooperation with Somalia as part of a broader strategic partnership focused on supporting Somalia’s development while exploring the commercial potential of its offshore hydrocarbon resources. items.title: Ruushka oo saraakiil cusub usoo tababaray Soomaaliya
items.description: Moscow (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Ruushka ayaa haatan saraakiil cusub usoo tababartay Booliska Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo Jimcihii si rasmi ah uga qalinjabiyay Akadeemiyadda Maamulka ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha dalkaas, iyagoo ku guuleystay shahaadada heerka labaad ee Jaamacadda (Master Degree). Saraakiishan oo afar ah ayaa si gaar ah ugu takhasusay maamulka guud iyo qorshaynta istaraatiijiga ah, oo ah aqoon muhiim u ah hoggaaminta hay’adaha amniga, horumarinta maamulka, dejinta siyaasadaha, iyo qorsheynta istaraatiijiyadda lagu xoojinayo tayada adeegyada Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Qalin-jebinta afarta sarkaal ayaa loo arkaa guul weyn oo u soo hoyatay Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo guud ahaan dalka, maadaama ay sare u qaadayso aqoonta iyo xirfadaha hoggaamineed ee saraakiisha loo diyaarinayo inay door muuqda ka qaataan dib-u-dhiska iyo casriyeynta hay’adaha amniga. Sidoo kale, dhacdadani waxay leedahay muhiimad taariikhi ah, iyadoo ay tahay markii ugu horreysay muddo ku dhow 40 sano oo saraakiil Soomaaliyeed ay kasoo qalinjebiyaan Jaamacad ku taalla dalka Ruushka. Tani waxay ka tarjumaysaa inuu dib u soo noolaanayo iskaashiga waxbarasho iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya dalalka Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarka, aqoon-is-weydaarsiga, iyo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha dowladda. Waxaa la filayaa in aqoonta iyo waayo-aragnimada ay saraakiishan cusub kasoo kororsadeen waxbarashadooda ay door weyn ka qaadato horumarinta Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, kor u qaadista hufnaanta shaqada, iyo xoojinta qorsheynta istaraatiijiga ah ee lagu horumarinayo amniga iyo adeegyada bulshada. Guushan ayaa sidoo kale dhiirrigelin u noqonaysa saraakiisha kale ee Soomaaliyeed ee doonaya inay sii wataan waxbarashadooda sare iyo kobcinta xirfadooda hoggaamineed. The post Ruushka oo saraakiil cusub usoo tababaray Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Gaadhsiinta biyaha ee dalka oo dhami waa qorshaha xukuumadda
items.description: Wasaaradda Qorshaynta iyo Horumarinta Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Marwo Kaltuun Sheekh Xasan, ayaa sheegtay in biyuhu yihiin mudnaanta koowaad ee Xukuumadda wadajir iyo waxqabad, iyadoo xustay in qorshuhu yahay in la gaadhsiiyo deegaan kasta oo dalka ah. Wasiir Kaltuun ayaa tilmaantay in Madaxweynaha Qaranka Jamhuuiryadda Somaliland Mudane Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro mudnaan gaar ah siiyay sidii degmo kasta oo laga heli karo biyo loogu hirgelin lahaa mashaariic biyo-gelin ah, iyadoo Wasaaradda Horumarinta Biyuhuna ay si joogto ah uga shaqayso sidii bulshada loo gaadhsiin lahaa adeegga biyaha. “Biyuhu waa mudnaanta koowaad ee Madaxweynaha Qaranka, waxaana mudnaan la siiyay in degmo kasta oo biyo laga heli karo laga hirgeliyo mashaariic biyo-gelin ah, Qorshaha Xukuumaddu Waa In Biyaha La Gaadhsiiyo Deegaan Kasta” ayay tidhi Wasiir Kaltuun Sheekh Xasan.

items.title: Maayarkii ugu wax qabadka badnaa Berbera iyo ku xigeenkiisii oo is casilay
items.description: Cabdishakuur Maxamed Cidin, Maayarkii magaalada Berbera oo xilkan hayey muddo 14 sano ah, ayaa si rasmi ah uga dhawaaqay inuu guud ahaanba iska casilay xilkii Maayirnimo ee degmada, waxaana sidoo kale isna is casilay maayar ku xigeenkiisii Nuur Jaamac Jaamac (Nuur Cad). Maayar Cidin waxa lagu xasuustaa wax qabad karti, hawl karnimo, daacadnuu dalkiisa iyo dagmadiisba u ahaa iyo waliba dad isku wad.

items.title: Laba ka mid ah dalalka Khaliijka oo weerar toos ah ku qaaday Iiraan kuna biiray dagaalka
items.description: Manama (Caasimada Online) – Baxreyn iyo Kuwait ayaa si qarsoodi ah diyaarado dagaal ugu diray gudaha Iran, iyagoo duqeeyay goobo militari oo ku yaalla dalkaas, sida ay sheegeen ilo xog-ogaal ah. Weerarradan, oo dhacay horraantii bishan, ayaa noqonaya tallaabadii ugu horreysay ee ay labada dal si toos ah uga qaadaan Iran, xilli dagaalka gobolka uu sii daba-dheeraanayo, dowladaha Carabtuna ay wajahaan xaalad amni iyo dhaqaale oo aad u adag. Duqeymaha ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday bakhaarro lagu keydiyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaallada, iyo sidoo kale xarumo kale oo militari, sida ay ilo xog-ogaal ah u sheegeen wargeyska Wall Street Journal. Imaaraadka Carabta, oo dhowr jeer weerarro ka fuliyay Iran bilowgii dagaalka, ayaa labada dal siiyay xog sirdoon oo ku saabsan bartilmaameedyada, iyo difaac cirka ah oo lagu ilaalinayay diyaaradaha fulinayay weerarrada. Tallaabadan ayaa muujineysa bilowga iskaashi militari oo sii xoogeysanaya oo u dhexeeya qaar ka mid ah dalalka Carabta, kuwaas oo doonaya inay si wadajir ah uga hortagaan weerarrada Iran. Iran ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay inta badan weerarradeeda aargoosiga ah ku bartilmaameedsatay Baxreyn iyo Kuwait, oo labaduba martigeliya saldhigyo militari oo Mareykanku leeyahay. Labada dal waxay leeyihiin ciidamo cirka oo tiro ahaan kooban, kuwaas oo ku hubeysan diyaarado ay sameeyeen Mareykanka iyo dalal Yurub ah. Hase yeeshee, waxay go’aansadeen inaysan Iran u oggolaan inay sii waddo weerarrada iyada oo aan wax jawaab ah la siin, sida ay sheegeen dadka xogta u leh arrintan. Dowladda Imaaraadka ayaa sheegtay inay taageersan tahay dadaallada lagu dhimayo xiisadda gobolka, oo ay ku jirto in si buuxda dib loogu furo marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta saliidda dalalka Khaliijka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadka ayaa sidoo kale cambaareysay weerarrada lagu qaaday Kuwait iyo Baxreyn, waxayna sheegtay inay “si buuxda ula garab taagan tahay dalalkaas, ayna taageersan tahay dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagu ilaalinayo ammaankooda iyo xasilloonidooda”. Afhayeenno u hadlay dowladaha Kuwait iyo Baxreyn kama aysan jawaabin codsiyo loo diray oo ku saabsanaa inay faallo ka bixiyaan duqeymaha. Dalalka Carabta ee Khaliijka ayaa hadda ku dhex jira dagaal aysan dooneyn, iyagoo dhinaca kalena deris la ah Iran oo ka weyn, awood badanna leh, isla markaana u aragta in si weyn loo dhibaateeyay. Dalalkan ayaa si wadajir ah u qaaday qeybta ugu badan ee weerarradii Iran ay fulisay intii uu dagaalku socday. Waxay hadda la tacaalayaan suuragalnimada in colaadda iyo is-horfadhigu sii dheeraadaan, taas oo khatar ku ah ammaankooda iyo dhaqaalahooda. “Dagaalka oo sidan hadda uu ku socdo kusii socda waa xaaladda ugu xun ee ay wajihi karaan,” ayay tiri Dina Esfandiary, oo ah khabiir ku takhasustay Bariga Dhexe kana tirsan Bloomberg Economics. Waxay sheegtay in dagaalku uusan dalalka Khaliijka siin fursad ay dib ugu dhistaan sawirkooda ah inay yihiin meel xasilloon oo ku dhex taalla gobol qalalaase badan, isla markaana uu saameynayo qaab-dhismeedka dhaqaalahooda. Imaaraadka ayaa dagaalka ku lug yeeshay xilli hore, isagoo tobannaan duqeymo ah ka fuliyay Iran tan iyo bilowgii colaadda, weerarradana sii waday ilaa maalintii ka dambeysay markii xabbad-joojin lagu dhawaaqay bishii April. Iran ayaa toddobaadyadii dambe inta badan ka gaabsatay inay weerarto Imaaraadka, inkastoo horraantii bishan ay duqeysay laba markab oo shidaal oo laga leeyahay dalkaas. Kuwait iyo Baxreyn ayaa wajahaya xaalad ka sii adag. Labada dal muddo tobannaan sano ah xiriir wanaagsan lama lahayn Iran, waxayna noqdeen bartilmaameedyada ugu waaweyn ee weerarradii ugu dambeeyay. Iran ayaa hadda kordhisay weerarrada ay ku beegsaneyso kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Kuwait ayaa Axaddii sheegtay in Iran ay weerartay warshad koronto iyo xarun biyaha badda looga dhigo kuwo la cabbi karo. Kuwait waxay weerarka ku tilmaantay khatar ka dhan ah muwaadiniinteeda iyo tallaabo si weyn u sii hurineysa xiisadda gobolka. Dalalka Oman iyo Qatar ayaa muddo dheer isku dheellitirayay xiriirkooda Iran iyo reer Galbeedka, mana muujin rabitaan weyn oo ay Tehran si toos ah ula galaan dagaal. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa bilowgii dagaalka Imaaraadka kala qeyb qaadatay weerarrada Iran, balse hadda waxay dib u qiimeyneysaa mowqifkeeda, sida ay sheegeen ilo xog-ogaal ah. Dowladaha Carabta ayaa markii hore rajeynayay in dagaalku si degdeg ah ku dhammaado, si ay dib ugu laabtaan qorshayaashooda dhaqaale. items.title: Mareykanka oo wada-hadallo culus la billaabay Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea kadib markii ay…
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa sare u qaaday wada-hadallada ay la leedahay Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea, xilli weerarrada sii kordhaya ee lagu beegsanayo maraakiibta ganacsiga ay walaac cusub ka abuureen ammaanka Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Tallaabadan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa timid kaddib kulamo 19-kii July magaalada Qaahira ku dhexmaray Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha sare ee madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ee arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika, iyo wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea. Kulamada, oo ay sidoo kale qeyb ka ahaayeen mas’uuliyiin Masaari ah, ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amni ee Geeska Afrika, xasilloonida Badda Cas iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dalalka gobolka. Mas’uuliyiintu ma shaacin wax heshiis ah oo ku saabsan saldhigyo ciidan ama marin-badeed uu Mareykanku ka heli doono Soomaaliya ama Eritrea. Si kastaba, kulamadan ayaa dhaliyay su’aalo ku saabsan in Washington ay dooneyso inay dhisto qorshe amni oo ballaaran oo ka hanaqaada xeebaha Afrika ee Badda Cas. Boulos ayaa sheegay inuu wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, kala hadlay “arrimo muhiim ah oo la xiriira ammaanka iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika”, oo ay ku jiraan iskaashiga gobolka iyo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya. Kaddib kulankii uu la yeeshay wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Eritrea, Osman Saleh, Boulos wuxuu sheegay in labada dhinac ay ka wada-hadleen sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga ganacsiga, horumarinta dhaqaalaha gobolka iyo arrimaha amniga. “Xilli dadaallada wadajirka ahi ay ka muhiimsan yihiin sidii hore, waxaan adkeynay baahida loo qabo inaan si wax-ku-ool ah uga wada shaqeyno xalinta khilaafaadka gobolka iyo horumarinta nabad, xasillooni iyo barwaaqo waarta oo ka hanaqaada Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika,” ayuu yiri Boulos. Halisaha maraakiibta Wada-hadalladan ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay kordhisay hanjabaadaha iyo weerarrada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo kala qeybiya Yemen, Jabuuti iyo Eritrea. Weerarrada lagu qaaday maraakiibta shidaalka iyo digniinaha la xiriira xannibaad ballaaran ayaa ku qasbay shirkado badan inay beddelaan marinadii ay isticmaali jireen. Xiisadda ka taagan marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa sidoo kale kordhisay cabsida laga qabo in carqalad ay ku timaado labada dhinac ee marinka muhiimka u ah dhoofinta shidaalka dalalka Khaliijka. Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa sare u kacay, iyadoo suuqyada caalamka ay si dhow ula socdaan weerarrada maraakiibta iyo suuragalnimada in sahayda tamarta ay hakad gasho. Mareykanka ayaa horey uga digay in maraakiibta xiriirka la leh Washington, Britain ama Israel ay wajahaan halis sare marka ay marayaan koonfurta Badda Cas, Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Bab al-Mandab wuxuu isku xiraa Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isaga oo maraakiibta u sii gudbiya Kanaalka Suweys, waxaana uu kamid yahay marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga iyo tamarta caalamka. Weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ayaa horey hoos ugu dhigay tirada maraakiibta isticmaasha marinkan, waxaana shirkado badan lagu qasbay inay qaataan jidka dheer ee ku wareega koonfurta Afrika. Cameron Hudson, oo horey uga tirsanaa Aqalka Cad xilligii madaxweyne George W. Bush, ayaa sheegay in Washington ay dooneyso in dalalka ku yaalla xeebaha Afrika aysan noqon ilo cusub oo xasillooni-darro ah. “Mareykanku wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu leeyahay, ‘Haddii aydnaan naga caawin karin Badda Cas, ugu yaraan ha noqonina dhinac xaaladda sii xumeeya,’” ayuu yiri Hudson. Muhiimadda xeebaha Dhaqdhaqaaqan cusub ee Mareykanka ayaa Eritrea siinaya miisaan istaraatiiji ah oo sii kordhaya. Eritrea waxay leedahay dekedaha Massawa iyo Assab iyo xeeb dheer oo ku teedsan mid kamid ah marinnada ganacsi ee ugu mashquulka badan dunida. Xiriirka Washington iyo Asmara ayaa muddo dheer xumaa, balse maamulka Trump ayaa muujiyay inuu daneynayo dib-u-soo-celinta xiriirka, maadaama ammaanka Badda Cas uu noqday arrin muhiim ah. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale leh xeeb istaraatiiji ah oo ka bilaabata Gacanka Cadmeed kuna fidsan Badweynta Hindiya, waxayna Mareykanka kala shaqeysaa la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. Bishii March 2025, madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Mareykanka u soo bandhigay inuu isticmaalo garoomo diyaaradeed iyo dekedo ay ku jiraan Baledogle, Berbera iyo Boosaaso. Qorshahaas ayaa lagu sheegay inuu Mareykanka siin karo marin milatari iyo mid sahay oo joogto ah, isla markaana ka hortagi karo in dalal ay Washington tartan kula jirto ay saameyn xooggan ku yeeshaan gobolka. Si kastaba, ku darista Berbera ayaa muran dhalisay, maadaama ay ku taallo Somaliland, oo Soomaaliya ay u aqoonsan tahay qeyb kamid ah dhulkeeda. Mareykanka ayaa hadda saldhiggiisa ugu weyn ee gobolka ee Camp Lemonnier ku leh dalka Jabuuti, wuxuuna sidoo kale sii wadaa duqeymaha uu Soomaaliya kula beegsanayo Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Falanqeeye amni oo lagu magacaabo Mubarak Aliyu ayaa sheegay in iskaashiga Masar iyo Mareykanka uu muujinayo in dhibaatooyinka Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas aan hadda si kala gooni ah loo wajihi karin. “Iskaashiga Masar iyo Mareykanka wuxuu caddeynayaa in dhibaatooyinka Geeska Afrika ay isku xiran yihiin, ayna u baahan yihiin diblomaasiyad isku dheellitirta awood-celinta, iskaashiga gobolka iyo xasilloonida muddada dheer,” ayuu yiri. Inkasta oo Washington aysan weli si cad u shaacin qorshaheeda, haddana kororka halisaha Bab al-Mandab ayaa Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea siinaya muhiimad diblomaasiyadeed iyo mid amni oo cusub, iyadoo xeebaha Afrika ee Badda Cas ay sii galayaan xisaabta istaraatiijiyadda Mareykanka. items.title: Somali President Plans Frontline Visit as Anti-Al-Shabaab Offensive Gathers Pace
items.description: MOGADISHU— Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud is expected to visit frontline areas in the Middle Shabelle and Galgaduud regions in the coming days, as the Federal Government intensifies preparations for a renewed military offensive against Al-Shabaab, according to informed sources. The sources said several units of the Somali security forces have been deployed to the coastal town of Adale in Middle Shabelle to reinforce security and prepare for the president’s anticipated visit. Senior commanders of the Somali National Army have also recently held meetings in Adale, focusing on security arrangements and operational plans for a new military campaign targeting Al-Shabaab positions across the region. President Mohamud is also expected to travel to El Dheer in the Galgaduud region, where he is reportedly scheduled to meet senior military commanders, local authorities and officials involved in operations along the frontlines. The anticipated visits come amid growing indications that the Federal Government is preparing to reinvigorate its campaign against Al-Shabaab. Military mobilisation and operational preparations are already underway in several areas of Hirshabelle State, where government forces and allied local fighters are seeking to increase pressure on the militant group. The planned offensive is understood to form part of the government’s broader strategy to weaken Al-Shabaab’s presence, disrupt its operational networks and regain control of areas where the group remains active. However, the Somali presidency and other government institutions have not formally confirmed the visits, and no official timetable for the president’s travel has been announced. items.title: Juventus Eyeing Manchester United Captain Bruno Fernandes
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Juventus have been linked with a ambitious move for Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes, as Luciano Spalletti looks to add more creativity and leadership to his squad. The 31-year-old’s Serie A experience and technical quality have caught the attention of Juve’s hierarchy, who are keen to restore the club to the top of European competition. Juventus’ interest comes at a time when contract extension talks with Fernandes are progressing slowly. While the Italian club have made contact with the player’s representatives to assess the market value, any potential transfer appears difficult on multiple fronts. Manchester United are reportedly demanding a fee between €50 million and €75 million , which alone presents a significant financial challenge for the Turin-based club. Another obstacle is Fernandes’ high salary. He currently earns around £375,000 per week, and a new contract is expected to push that figure to £400,000 , making him United’s highest earner. This wage level is far above what Juventus currently pay, with their top earner on approximately €6 million per year. Furthermore, recent reports suggest Fernandes is not ready to leave Old Trafford. Contract negotiations are said to be ongoing, with the Portuguese international fully committed to staying at United, having already rejected approaches from clubs in Saudi Arabia . There is also an option to extend his current deal by a further year. Juventus would need to make a substantial financial outlay and match high salary demands to lure the Portuguese star away from Manchester. However, almost all indications point towards him remaining at United, where he remains a key figure in attack and the club’s captain. The post Juventus Eyeing Manchester United Captain Bruno Fernandes first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Kooxda Juventus oo soo gashay tartanka kaptanka kooxda Manchester United ee Bruno Fernandes
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala wariye katirsan Radio Dalsan Tv Juventus ayaa la sheegay inay sahaminayso u dhaqaaqis hami leh oo ay ku doonayso kabtanka Manchester United Bruno Fernandes, iyadoo Luciano Spalletti uu doonayo inuu hal-abuur iyo hoggaan dheeri ah ku daro kooxdiisa. Khibradda 31-jirka ee Serie A iyo tayadiisa farsamo ayaa ka dhigaysa mid si weyn u soo jiidatay maamulka Juve, kuwaasoo raba in kooxdu mar kale u tartanto tartamada waaweyn . Xiisaha Juventus ayaa yimid xilli ay wada-hadallada kordhinta qandaraaska Fernandes ay si tartiib ah u socdaan. Inkasta oo kooxda Talyaaniga ay xiriir la samaysay wakiilada ciyaaryahanka si ay u ogaadaan qiimaha suuqa , wareegiddani waxay u muuqataa mid dhib badan dhinacyo badan . Ilo wareeg ah ayaa sheegaya in Manchester United ay dalban karto lacag u dhaxaysa €50 milyan iyo €75 milyan , taasoo iyadu keligeed ah caqabad weyn oo Juventus hortaagan. Dhibaato kale ayaa ah mushaharka sare ee Fernandes. Wuxuu hadda ku qaataa qiyaastii £375,000 usbuucii , waxaana la filayaa in qandaraas cusub uu kor u qaadi karo ilaa £400,000 , taasoo ka dhigaysa ciyaaryahanka ugu mushaharka badan United . Heerkan mushaharku wuu ka sarreeyaa waxa Juve hadda bixiso, iyadoo mushaharka ugu sareeya uu yahay 6 milyan oo Yuuro sannadkiiba . Waxa intaa dheer, warbixinno dhow ayaa sheegaya in Fernandes uusan diyaar u ahayn inuu ka tago Old Trafford. Wada-hadallada qandaraaska cusub ayaa la sheegay inay sii socdaan , iyadoo Fernandes uu si buuxda uga go’an yahay sii joogista kooxda, isagoo hore u diiday dalabyo ka yimid kooxaha Carabta . Sidoo kale, waxaa jira ikhtiyaar ah in qandaraaskiisa lagu kordhiyo xilli ciyaareed kale . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, haddii ay jirto ikhtiyaar dhinaca Juventus , waxay u baahan doontaa inay bixiso lacag cusub oo ay la jaanqaadaan mushahar aad u sarreeya si ay u soo jiitaan xiddigan reer Portugal. Balse ku dhawaad dhammaan calaamaduhu waxay tilmaamayaan in uu sii joogi doono Manchester United , isagoo yahay halbeeg muhiim u ah howlaha weerarka iyo kabtanka kooxda . The post Kooxda Juventus oo soo gashay tartanka kaptanka kooxda Manchester United ee Bruno Fernandes first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Daawo: Trump oo markale weeraray Ilhaan: Waa inay ka baxdaa dalkeenna
items.description: Washigton (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maraykanka, Donald Trump ayaa maanta mar kale weerar culus oo afka ah ku qaaday X ildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar oo ka tirsan Golaha Congresska, isla markaana ay si wen isugu hayaan siyaasadda dalkaasi. Donald Trump ayaa Ilhaan ku tilmaamay qof aan caad ahayn, wxuuna amray inay ka baxdo dalka Mareykanka, sida uu ku dooday. Trump oo sidoo kale aflagaadeynaya Ilhaan Cumar ayaa yiri “Ilhan Omar Waa qof caqli ahaan liita, sidoo kalena waa qof aan daacad ahayn. Waa inay dalkeenna ka baxdaa, ma ahan inay sii joogto”. Trump, oo horey u weeraray asalka Soomaalinimo ee Ilhaan Cumar ayaa sidoo kale si adag u dhaleeceeyay Soomaaliya oo uu xitaa u gefay dhowr jeer oo hore. H adallada Trump ee ku saabsan Ilhaan, oo ku dhalatay Soomaaliya ka hor inta aysan qoyskeedu imaan Mareykanka sannadihii 1990-meeyadii, ayaa marar badan soo noq-noqday, isaga oo sidoo kale u gefay dalka ay asal ahaan kasoo jeedo. Ilhaan Cumar, weli dhankeeda kama jawaabin weerarkan cusub ee Trump, balse horey ayay uga falcelisay weerarradiisa, iyadoo ku sheegtay inay tahay astaan u taagan halganka muhaajiriinta iyo dadka laga tirada badan yahay ee Mareykanka. Si kastaba, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka oo caan ku ah hadallo soo noq-noqda iyo jees-jees, ayaa muddo dheer ku celinayay kaftan uu ka sheegay Ilhaan, isagoo xittaa mar shaaciyay inuu Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh weydiiyay in “dib loogu celin karo” dalkii ay asal ahaan ka soo jeeday. items.title: Dagaal culus oo dhexmaray Al-Shabaab iyo ciidanka Kenya
items.description: Mandera (Caasimada Online) – Warar kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxaya dagaal culus oo maanta ka dhacay deegaanno hoostaga magaalada Mandera ee Gobolka Waqooyi Bari, kaas oo u dhexeeyay maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamada dowladda Kenya. Dagaalka oo laba goobood ka kala dhacay ayaa yimid, kadib markii maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ay weerareen fariisimo ay ciidamada Kenya ku leeyihiin duleedka magaalada, waxaana kadib xigay dagaal toos ah. Weerarka koowaad ayay maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ku qaadeen deegaanka lagu magacaabo Fino, iyaga oo beegsaday saldhig ciidamada Kenya ku leeyihiin halkaasi, waxaana kadib la maqlay rasaas ay is waydaarsanayaan labada dhinac. Sidoo kale, weerarka labaad ayaa ka dhacay deegaanka Carabiya oo isna hoostaga Mandera, halkaas oo ay beegsadeen maleeshiyaad kale oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo deegaanka ah. Illaa iyo hadda ma cadda khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee ka dhashay weerarradan iyo dagaallada xigay, maadaama goobaha la beegsaday ay yihiin saldhigyo ay dagan yihiin ciidamada dalka Kenya. Dhanka kale, ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay saraakiisha laamaha ammaanka Kenya oo ku aadan weerarradaas iyo haddii ay jiraan howlgallo ay sameeyeen ciidamada kadib dagaalka. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo laga dareemayaa qaybo badan oo kamid ah xadka dheer ee ay wadaagaan dalalka Soomaaliya iyo Kenya, halkaas oo ay dhuumaaleysi uga gudbaan xubnaha Shabaab ee weerarada ka fuliya Gobolka Waqooyi Bari. Inta badan maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab ayaa weeraro ku dhufo oo ka dhaqaaq ah ku qaada xarumaha ciidamada Kenya ku yaalla halkaasi, maadaama ay weli kooxda si weyn ugu xoogan tahay gobollada Jubbooyinka ee koonfurta dalka Soomaaliya. items.description: Washington ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqay in ra’iisul wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu uu booqan doono Mareykanka toddobaadka soo socda. Mr. Trump ayaa warkan ku dhawaaqay shalay khudbad uu ka jeediyay casho sharafta ururka saxafiyiinta ee Aqalka Cad. items.title: Kooxda AS oo weerar ka geystay Ismaamulka Mandheera
items.description: Mandheera ( Raxanreeb Online) Faah faahino dheeraad ah ayaa laga kasoo baxaya weeraro kala duwan oo kooxda Al-shabaab, ay ka geystay magaalooyinka Arabia iyo Fino ee ismaamulka Mandheera ee dalka Kenya. Weeraradan ayaa la sheegay in ay dhaceen sacaadihii lasoo dhaafay waxaana ka dhashay dhaawaca 1 qof oo shacab ah, sida ay sheegeen laamaha amniga. Saraakiisha amniga ee Mandheera, ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamada ay ka jawaabeen weerarka, isla markaana ay ku raad jogaan xubnihii weerarka fuliyay oo ay shegeen in ay yihiin maleeshiyaad katirsan Al-shabaab. Sidoo kale xubnaha weerarka geystay ayaa la tilmaamay in ay gaarayeen 10 ruux, isla markaana hadda uu socdo howlgallo lagu raadinayo sidii gacanta loogu soo dhigi lahaa. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in dagaalka uu dhacay xiliga Salaada Maqrib la galayay. Sikastaba, dowladda Kenya ayaa todobaadkii lasoo dhaafay waxa ay ciidamo dheeraad ah geysay xadka ay la wadaagto Soomaaliya, waxaana ujeedka ciidamada loo geeyay halkaasi ay tahay inay ka hor tagaan weerarada mararka qaar ay Al-shabaab ka geystay gobolka Waqooyi Bari ee dalka Kenya. Sikastaba, dowladda Kenya ayaa todobaadkii lasoo dhaafay waxa ay ciidamo dheeraad ah geysay xadka ay la wadaagto Soomaaliya, waxaana ujeedka ciidamada loo geeyay halkaasi ay tahay inay ka hor tagaan weerarada mararka qaar ay Al-shabaab ka geystay gobolka Waqooyi Bari ee dalka Kenya. items.title: Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo gubay warshadda shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Jizan
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa waaberigii saaka weeraray warshad saliidda sifeysa oo ku taala magaalada dekedda leh ee Jizan (Jazan) ee Koonfur Galbeed Sacuudiga. Warshaddan oo ay leedahay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ayaa gubatay, ka dib weerarka ay ku qaadeen Xuutiyiinta oo loo adeegsaday gantaal nooca ballaastikada iyo drones. Muuqaalo la soo dhigay barraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya goobta la beegsaday oo gubaneysa iyo dadaalo lagu deminayo dabka oo socda. Muuqaalada ayaa laga arki karaa qiiq cirka isku shareeray hawada magaalada iyo xarunta sifeynta shidaalka ee Saudi Aramco ee Jazan oo dab weyn uu qabsaday. Hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ee Sacuudiga ayaa goor sii horreysay dadka degan Magaalooyinka Yanbu iyo Jizan u jeedisay digniino ku saabsan halis iman karta, iyadoo aan sharaxaad badan ka bixin nooca khatartaasi. Warbaahinta gobolka oo soo xiganeysa ilo dadka deegaanka ah ayaa sheegtay in dhowr qarax ay ka dhaceen magaalada, lana hakiyay duulimaadyadii ganacsiga ee ku socday magaaladaasi. Ururka Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegtay masuuliyadda weerarka, waxayna sheegeen inay bartilmaameedsadeen goobo muhiim ah oo ku yaala magaalada saaran Badda Cas, isla-markaana ku taala xuduudda Sacuudiga iyo Yemen. Xuutiyiinta ayaa bayaan ay soo saareen ku sheegay in weerarka uu jawaab u yahay duqaymihii uu xalay Sacuudiga ka gaystay Dekedda Hodeidah ee Galbeedka Yemen. Dagaalka Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sii xoogeystay, kaas oo isku bedelay weji cusub oo ka mid ah colaadda ku sii baaheysa Gobolka Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: Baarlamanka K/Galbeed oo qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaannada Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya oo maanta yeeshay kulankoodii 6-aad ee kalfadhiga 1-aad ayaa qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo ku aadan dhismaha guddiyada golaha. Kulanka oo ahaa mid xasaasi ah ayaa waxaa guddoomiyay Mudane Mudane Mahad Maxamed Sheekh Xasan oo ah Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo si buuxda ay uga soo qayb-galeen mudanayaasha golaha. Xildhibaannada Golaha Wakiillada ayaa cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyay Guddiyada iyo hab-dhowreyaasha Golaha si loo dardar geliyo howlaha hortabinta u leh Dowladda Koofur galbeed Soomaaliya. Guddiyada la dhisay oo ka kooban illaa 8 Guddi ayaa kala ah:- 1-Guddiga-Xeer-Hoosaadka, Anshaxa, Xasaanadda, Daryeelka Xildhibaannada iyo Dastuurka. 2-Guddiga Garsoorka, Arrimaha Diinta iyo Awqaafta. 3-Guddiga Amniga, Arrimaha Gudaha, Maamulka Gobolada, Degmooyinka, Dib-uheshiisiinta iyo Horumarinta Reer Miyiga. 4-Guddiga Arrimaha Bulshada, Shaqada, Shaqaalaha, Dhalinyarada, Isboortiga, Isgaarsiinta, Warfaafinta iyo Wacyigelinta. 5-Guddiga Horumarinta Kheyraadka. 6-Guddiga Maaliyadda, Ganacsiga, Warshadaha, Qorsheynta iyo Tira koobka. 7-Guddiga Haweenka, Xuquuqul Insaanka, Gargaarka, iyo Maaraynta Musiibooyinka. 8-Guddiga Howlaha Guud, Dib-udhiska Dalka, Dekadaha iyo Gaadiidka. Sidoo kale Hab-dhowreyaasha ay meel mariyeen Xildhibaannada Koonfur galbeed Soomaaliya oo ka kooban saddex Hab-dhowre ayaa kala ah:- 1-Idiris Axmed Yacquub ( Guddoomiye ). 2-Maxamed Mucaawiye Ibraahim ( ku xigeenka 1aad ). 3-Maxaad Maxamed Ciise ( ku xigeenka 2aad ). Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Maamulka Koofur galbeed Soomaaliya Mahad Maxamed Sheekh Xasan oo natiijada codaynta ku dhawaaqay ayaa Xildhibaannada ugu mahadceliyay gudashada waajibaadkooda iyo ka shaqaynta howlaha hortabinta u leh Dowlad dhiskeenna. The post Baarlamanka K/Galbeed oo qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Siciid Deni oo u safray dalka Imaaraatka Carabta
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Hoggaamiyaha dowlad goboleedka Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa u amba-baxay magaalada Abu-dhabi ee dalka isu-tagga Imaaraatka Carabta. Deni ayaa la sheegay in gelinkii dambe ee shalay ay diyaarad ka qaaday magaalada Garoowe, isla markaana uu sii maray magaalada Addis Ababa ee caasimada dalka Itoobiya. Madaxtooyada maamulka Puntland, kama aysan hadlin safarka uu Siciid Deni ku aaday Imaaraatka Carabta, iyo waxa uu ku qotomo. Socdaalka hoggaamiyaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa imaanaya xili xiriirka diblumaasiyadeed  ee dowladda federaalka iyo Imaaraatka Carabta uu yahay mid aan wanaagsaneen muddooyinkii dambe. Ma ahan markii ugu horeeysay oo uu hoggaamiyaha Puntland safar aan la ogeyn waxa uu salka ku hayo uu ku tago dalka Imaaraatka Carabta. The post Siciid Deni oo u safray dalka Imaaraatka Carabta appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somaliland’s Buurmadow says he would support reunification with Somalia if Hargeisa became Capital
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Veteran Somaliland traditional leader Osman Aw Mohamud, widely known as Buurmadow, has proposed that Somaliland should consider reunification with Somalia if a political settlement designates Hargeisa as the national capital, marking one of the clearest public endorsements of conditional unity by a prominent Somaliland figure since the region declared independence in 1991. Buurmadow said reunification would, in his view, represent a more favourable outcome than pursuing international recognition if the settlement placed Hargeisa at the centre of a unified Somali state, allowed the Somali national flag to fly over the city and established a single national government. He also urged Somaliland’s leadership to open negotiations with Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, arguing that the current administration presents the best opportunity in years to reach a durable political agreement between Hargeisa and Mogadishu. He described Hassan Sheikh as more receptive to dialogue with Somaliland than previous Somali presidents and said any agreement should include relocating the national capital to Hargeisa. The remarks represent a notable departure from Somaliland’s longstanding political position, which has centred on seeking international recognition rather than reunification with Somalia. Since declaring independence in 1991, Somaliland has maintained its own government, legislature, security institutions and currency while operating separately from the federal authorities in Mogadishu, although it remains internationally recognised by the vast majority of states as part of Somalia. Buurmadow’s proposal has generated significant discussion across Somaliland and Somalia because senior political and traditional leaders in Somaliland have rarely advocated reunification publicly, even on a conditional basis, during more than three decades of self-rule. Neither Somaliland’s government nor leading traditional institutions have publicly responded to the remarks at the time of publication. The comments come at a time of renewed debate over Somaliland’s political future and its relationship with Somalia, with both sides continuing to hold fundamentally different positions on the territory’s constitutional status. While Somaliland maintains that its sovereignty is non-negotiable, Somalia’s federal government continues to regard the region as an integral part of the Somali state. Although Buurmadow’s proposal does not constitute an official policy shift, his intervention introduces an influential voice into one of the Horn of Africa’s most consequential political questions and is likely to intensify debate over whether future dialogue should focus on recognition, reunification or an alternative political settlement. items.title: UK oo Shaaciyay Sababta Geerida Amiir Sacuudiyaan ah oo meydkiisa laga Hoteel ku Yaalla London
items.description: Maxkamad baaritaan oo ku taalla magaalada London ayaa soo saartay natiijada baaritaanka geerida Amiir Cabdullaahi bin Fahad bin Cabdullaahi bin Cabdulcasiis bin Jalawi Al Saud , iyadoo lagu sheegay inuu u geeriyooday isku-darka khamri iyo maandooriye kale, halka aan la helin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaysa is dilid ama fal-dambiyeed. Amiirka oo 29 jir ahaa kana tirsanaa qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa meydkiisa laga helay 25-kii November 2025 gudaha musqusha qolkiisa oo ku yaallay hoteelka Marriott Hotel ee degmada Kensington, galbeedka magaalada London. Baaritaanka maxkamadda ayaa lagu sheegay in amiirku uu dhiiggiisa ku jiray heer khamri ah oo ku dhowaad saddex jibbaar ka sarreeyay xadka sharciga ee loo oggol yahay darawallada England. Sidoo kale waxaa laga helay maandooriyaha GHB , oo loo yaqaan “party drug”, xashiishad iyo dawooyinka dejinta ee ay ka mid yihiin Xanax (alprazolam) iyo dawooyin kale oo loo isticmaalo welwelka. Dhakhaatiirta baaritaanka sameeyay ayaa sheegay in isku-darka walxahaasi uu sababay wadne istaag, k taasoo ugu dambeyn sababay geeridiisa. Warbixinta maxkamadda ayaa sidoo kale xustay in amiirku muddo bilo ah ka hor geeridiisa uu ku jiray xarumo caafimaad oo gaar loo leeyahay oo lagu daweeyo dadka la tacaalaya balwadda khamriga iyo dawooyinka dejinta. Waxaa lagu daaweeyay xarunta caanka ah ee Priory Clinic ee London iyo xarun kale oo ku taalla gobolka Merseyside, halkaas oo la sheegay inuu si wanaagsan uga qaatay daaweynta. Dhakhaatiirta cilmi-nafsiga ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in amiirku uusan muujin wax calaamado ah oo la xiriira ismiidaamin, isla markaana uu si wanaagsan uga qayb qaatay daaweynta intii uu ku jiray xarumaha caafimaadka. Kaamirooyinka amniga (CCTV) ayaa muujiyay in habeenkii ka horreeyay geeridiisa uu keligiis ka baxay hoteelka si uu sigaar u cabo, kadibna uu kaligiis ugu soo laabtay qolkiisa, baarayaashuna ma helin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaysa in qof kale ku lug lahaa geeridiisa. Kaaliyaha baaraha geerida ee UK, Jean Harkin , ayaa warbixinta ku soo gabagabeysay in geeridu ahayd shil ka dhashay isticmaalka isku-darka maandooriyaha iyo khamriga, iyadoo aan jirin wax tilmaamaya ismiidaamin ama faragelin qof kale. Waxay sidoo kale tacsi u dirtay qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Kiiskan ayaana si weyn u soo jiitay warbaahinta caalamka, maadaama uu khuseeyo xubin ka tirsan qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga.

items.title: DF oo ka farxisay ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee Kenya
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Dalka Kenya oo maalmahan ku howlanayd sidii looga gudbi lahaa caqabadaha ka haysta ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee dalka Kenya u yimaada waxbarashada heerarkeeda kala duwan, ayaa sii xoojisay dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo aqoonsiga iyo isu-ekeysiinta shahaadooyinka dugsiyada sare ee Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Kenya. Dadaalladan oo uu hormuud ka yahay Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle iyo diblomaasiyiinta, howlwadeenada, ayaa lagu doonayaa in ardayda Soomaaliyeed loo fududeeyo helitaanka fursadaha waxbarasho ee jaamacadaha iyo machadyada kala duwan ee ku yaala dalkanKenya, iyadoo meesha laga saarayo caqabadihii muddooyinka soo jiitamayay ee la xiriiray aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka. Iyadoo arrintaasi ay qayb katahay qorshaha Safaaradda ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada ay u hayso muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, ayaa Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle iyo mas’uuliyiin ka socota Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo Taclinta sare ee Soomaaliya ay kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay Agaasimaha Guud ee Golaha Imtixaanaadka Qaranka Kenya (KNEC), Dr. David Njengere, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray horumarka laga sameeyay geeddi-socodka aqoonsiga iyo isu-ekeysiinta shahaadooyinka dugsiyada sare ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Kulanka intii uu socday, Danjiruhu wuxuu Agaasimaha Guud ee hay’adda KNEC la wadaagay horumarka laga gaaray soo ururinta iyo diyaarinta dukumiintiyada looga baahan yahay dalka Soomaaliya, isagoo caddeeyay in Safaaraddu ay si dhow ula shaqaynayso hay’adaha ay khusayso si loo dhammaystiro dukumiintiyada harsan loona soo gudbiyo waqtiga ugu dhow. Dhankiisa, Agaasimaha Guud ee KNEC, Dr. David Njengere, ayaa soo dhaweeyay dadaalka iyo horumarka ay Safaaraddu ku tallaabsatay, isagoo xaqiijiyay in hay’adda KNEC ay diyaar u tahay inay si degdeg ah u guda gasho qiimeynta farsamo ee shahaadooyinka marka la helo dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay. Wuxuu sidoo kale muujiyay sida ay hay’addu uga go’an tahay inay ka shaqeyso xal waara oo dan u ah ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Lataliyaha wasiirka Waxbarashada Soomaaliya Mudane Cabdullahi Sujuu ayaa is a dhankiisa ka cadeeyay in Wasaaradda Soomaaliyeed ay taabagalinayso codsiyadda ka yimid hay’adaha Waxbarashada dalka Kenya. Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle, oo kulanka ka hadlay, ayaa sheegay in Safaaradda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee Dalka Kenya ay mudnaan gaar ah siisay xallinta caqabadaha waxbarasho ee haysta ardayda Soomaaliyeed, maadaama ay si toos ah u saameynayaan mustaqbalka kumannaan dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed oo doonaya inay sii wataan waxbarashadooda. “Waxaa naga go’an inaan xaqiijinno in arday kasta oo Soomaaliyeed uu helo fursad waxbarasho oo caddaalad iyo sinaan ku dhisan. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay waxaan dadaal xooggan aan gelinnay sidii looga gudbi lahaa caqabadaha la xiriira aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka, annagoo si joogto ah ula shaqaynaynay hay’adaha ay khusayso ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Horumarka maanta la gaaray waa mid dhiirrigelin leh, waxaana rajaynaynaa in tallaabooyinka harsan si degdeg ah loo dhammaystiro, si ardaydeennu aysan mar dambe ula kulmin dib u dhac ku yimaada waxbarashadooda ama fursadahooda mustaqbalka. Safaaraddu waxay sii wadi doontaa dadaal kasta oo lagu difaacayo laguna horumarinayo danaha muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool ama wax ku barta dalka Kenya,” ayuu yiri Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim. Si kastaba, Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee Safaaradda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee Dalka Kenya ay ku xoojinayso adeegyada ay u hayso muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada waxbarashada, horumarinta aqoonta iyo fududeynta fursadaha ay ka faa’iideysanayaan ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee waxbarashada u jooga dalka Kenya. Labada dhinac ayaa ugu dambayn isku raacay in la dhiso guddi farsamo oo wadajir ah, kaas oo si dhow ula socon doona dhammaystirka geeddi-socodka isu-ekeysiinta shahaadooyinka, isla markaana dardargelin doona tallaabooyinka farsamo ee harsan si arrintan loo soo gabagabeeyo. Waxaana la isla qaatay in bisha Sabtembar la soo afjaro qorshaha Qiimeybta shahaadooyinka si ay Ardeyda soomaliyeed ula jaan -qaadaan bilowga sanad- jamavadeedka ee bilaabano sandakan. Talabadaan ayaa ah mid farxad-gelinaysa ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee danaynaysa in ay waxbarashadooda sare ku qaataan dalka kenya iyo guud ahaan geedisocdka wabarashada Soomaaliya.   The post DF oo ka farxisay ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee Kenya appeared first on Caasimada Online .
