items.title: Tahriibayaal Soomaali ah oo qaab yaab leh loo qariyay oo lagu qabtay dalka…
items.description: Lusaka (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Zambia ayaa gacanta ku dhigtay toddoba muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed oo si qarsoodi ah loogu tahriibinayay gaari noociisu yahay Toyota Probox. Tahriibayaashan ayaa lagu hoos qariyey jawaano bariis ah, waxaana la qabtay xilli gaarigii ay la socdeen uu ku sii jeeday xadka u dhexeeya Zambia iyo Zimbabwe. Hay’adda dakhliga Zambia ayaa war ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in gaariga lagu qabtay howlgal kormeer oo ay ciidamada ammaanku ka sameeyeen deegaanka Kapiri Mposhi ee gobolka Bartamaha, ka hor intii uusan gaarin marinka xuduudda ee Chirundu, oo ah marin muhiim u ah isu socodka Zambia iyo Zimbabwe. Afhayeenka hay’adda dakhliga Zambia, Oliver Nzala ayaa sheegay in toddobada tahriibe iyo darawalkii gaariga, oo u dhashay Zambia, lagu wareejiyey Waaxda Socdaalka, si loo aqoonsado loogana qaado tallaabooyinka waafaqsan shuruucda socdaalka iyo masaafurinta ee dalkaas. Mas’uuliyiinta Zambia ayaa sheegay inay tuhunsan yihiin in Soomaalidaasi loo tahriibinayay Zimbabwe, ka hor inta aan loo sii gudbin Koonfur Afrika, oo ah dalka ay inta badan hiigsadaan tahriibayaasha ka imanaya Geeska Afrika iyagoo raadinaya fursado nololeed iyo kuwo dhaqaale. Sawirro ay baahiyeen hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa muujinaya sida dadkaasi loogu qariyey gudaha gaariga, iyadoo dushooda lagu raray jawaano bariis ah si looga qariyo ciidamada ilaalada waddooyinka iyo kuwa xuduudaha. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in dhacdadan ay mar kale muujinayso xeeladaha ay adeegsadaan shabakadaha ka ganacsada tahriibinta dadka, kuwaas oo inta badan isticmaala gaadiidka ganacsiga si ay uga baxsadaan baaritaannada ay sameeyaan ciidamada ammaanka. Ugu dambeyn, hay’adda dakhliga Zambia ayaa sheegtay inay sii xoojin doonto howl-gallada lagula dagaallamayo tahriibka dadka iyo jebinta shuruucda socdaalka. Zambia ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyey noqotay marin muhiim ah oo ay maraan tahriibayaasha ka imanaya Geeska Afrika, iyadoo dalkaasi uu ka mid yahay waddooyinka ay adeegsadaan shabakadaha tahriibinta si dadka loogu gudbiyo dalalka ku yaalla koonfurta qaaradda Afrika. items.title: Laftagareen Spokesman Downplays Defections as Government Claims Major Blow to Rebel Forces
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) – A spokesman for forces loyal to former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen has dismissed the latest defections from the movement as insignificant, while Somalia’s Federal Government says the surrender of a senior commander and scores of fighters marks a major setback for the insurgency. Speaking in a video statement, Ugaas Hassan Abdi, a former spokesman for the South West administration who now represents the Laftagareen-aligned movement, sought to minimize the impact of the reported defections. “South West State is bigger than individuals who have been misled or those who have betrayed their own people,” he said. Despite the reported losses, Hassan insisted the movement remained intact and vowed that Laftagareen’s forces would continue their offensive until they captured Baidoa, the regional capital. Ugaas Hassan His remarks came after the group launched a series of attacks on Baidoa in recent weeks as part of its campaign against the South West State administration and Federal Government forces. Meanwhile, Somalia’s Ministry of Defense announced what it described as a significant breakthrough, claiming that Ibrahim Kalaay, the former commissioner of Awdiinle district in Bay Region and a senior commander within the Laftagareen-aligned forces, had surrendered to government troops operating in South West State. According to the ministry, Kalaay arrived in Baidoa accompanied by approximately 150 fighters, who handed over a cache of weapons and three armed military vehicles after renouncing the insurgency. The ministry said the group voluntarily abandoned the armed campaign, declaring they no longer wished to continue fighting against their own communities. Government officials further stated that negotiations remain underway with additional fighters still aligned with the insurgency and expressed confidence that more defections could follow in the coming days. In its statement, the Ministry of Defense described the surrender as a serious blow to the armed movement and reiterated that the Federal Government would not tolerate the use of illegal armed groups to undermine public security or political stability. items.title: Mareykanka iyo Sacuudiga oo ku heshiiyay Barnaamij Tamarta Nukliyeerka Rayidka ah
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa sheegay in Washington iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ay gaareen heshiis ku saabsan horumarinta tamarta nukliyeerka ee rayidka ah. Sida uu sheegay Trump, heshiiska ayaa la mid ah heshiisyadii noocan oo kale ahaa ee lala galay dalal kale, wuxuuna si cad u mamnuucayaa hodominta uranium-ka (uranium enrichment). Wuxuu xusay in barnaamijku uu ku koobnaan doono isticmaalka nabadeed oo keliya, iyadoo maamulka iyo kormeerkaba ay yeelan doonto Waaxda Tamarta ee Mareykanka. Trump ayaa sidoo kale caddeeyay in dhaqan-galka heshiiskan uu ku xirnaan doono in Sacuudi Carabiya ay ku biirto Heshiisyada Abraham Accords isla markaana ay caadiyeyso xiriirka ay la leedahay Israa’iil. Haddii heshiiskan la hirgeliyo, waxaa la filayaa inuu saameyn weyn ku yeesho isu-dheellitirka siyaasadda iyo amniga Bariga Dhexe, maadaama uu xiriir cusub u abuuri karo Mareykanka, Sacuudiga iyo Israa’iil, isla markaana uu beddeli karo loollanka istiraatiijiyadeed ee gobolka.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo Ansixiyay Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika, Fursado Cusubna u Furaya Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u ansixiyay Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika (African Youth Charter), tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo awood-siinta dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, kor u qaadidda shaqo-abuurka, iyo ballaarinta doorkooda hoggaamineed ee horumarinta dalka. Ansixinta axdigan ayaa la filayaa inay dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed u horseeddo fursado badan oo dhinacyada shaqada, waxbarashada, iyo ka qeybgalka hoggaanka ah. Qodobada ugu muhiimsan ee ay ansixintani xambaarsan tahay waxaa ka mid ah: Shaqo-abuur iyo Hal-abuur: Taageeridda mashaariicda horumarineed, kobcinta hal-abuurka, iyo abuurista fursado shaqo oo cusub oo loogu talagalay dhallinyarada. Ka Qaybgalka Hoggaanka: Xoojinta doorka dhallinyarada ee go’aan qaadashada siyaasadeed, maamulka, iyo dib u dhiska qaranka iskuxirka Afrika: U fududeynta dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed inay ka faa’iideystaan deeqaha waxbarasho, tababarrada, iyo barnaamijyada khibrad-isweydaarsiga ee Midowga Afrika (AU). Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in ansixinta Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika ay ka tarjumeyso sida ay uga go’an tahay maalgelinta awoodda dhallinyarada, maadaama ay yihiin laf-dhabarta horumarka iyo mustaqbalka dalka. Horumarka dhallinyaradu waa horumarka qaranka, ayay Xukuumaddu ku adkeysatay, iyadoo xustay in dadaallada lagu dhisayo mustaqbal ifaya oo ay dhallinyaradu hormuud ka yihiin ay sii socon doonaan.

items.title: Prominent Somali poet and songwriter Aden Tarabi Jama dies in Somaliland
items.description: Prominent Somali poet and songwriter Aden Tarabi Jama, one of the best-known figures in Somali literature and music, has died in Hargeisa, his family announced Tuesday. Tarabi leaves behind a literary and artistic legacy that shaped generations of Somali poetry, songwriting and theatre. He was born in Aynabo in Sool region in 1948 and began his Quranic and basic education in Burao before turning to literary and artistic work. Tarabi composed many songs that became widely known and were performed by major Somali artists. His songs include “Goor iyo Ayaan,” “Bal Dawooy,” “Gacan Saydh,” “Yufloo” and “Dar Allaad u Hurudaa,” which are remembered as important works in the history of Somali music. He also wrote plays, including the well-known series “Ma Ogthay,” which featured prominent Somali actors and artists. Tarabi was among the leading poets who took part in the Deelley literary chain, a major Somali poetic debate in 1979 and 1980 that included criticism of Somalia’s military government. The Deelley chain, initiated by poet Mohamed Hashi Dhamac, known as Gaarriye, brought together more than 40 poets whose verses all followed the alliterative letter “D.” It began as a poetic exchange on tribalism but later became a powerful critique of corruption, economic hardship and the rule of Mohamed Siad Barre’s government. Tarabi also played a role in reconstruction efforts in Somaliland. Former Somaliland President Muse Bihi Abdi paid tribute to Tarabi, describing him as a poet who served society through his talent and creativity. Bihi said Tarabi left a major mark on Somali literature, heritage and culture, and prayed for God to grant him mercy and give patience and faith to his family and the Somali people. Tarabi’s death has saddened Somalia’s literary community and the wider Somali public. He will be remembered for his contribution to Somali art, literature and culture.

items.title: Xiisadda Bariga Dhexe oo soo gaartay Badda Cas – Maxaa dhacay maanta?
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee ay taageerto Iran ayaa sheegtay inay maanta weerar ku qaadday laba markab oo shidaal oo uu leeyahay Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo marayay Badda Cas. Tani waxay muujineysaa in xiisadda gobolka Bariga Dhexe ay gaartay heer aad u khatar badan. Weerarkan ayaa imanaya iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanka ay habeenkii 12-aad oo xiriir ah duqeymo ka wadaan gudaha Iran. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale ku hanjabay inay xannibi doonaan marin kale oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka, xilli dhaqaalaha dunidu uu wajahayo saameynta ka dhalatay xiritaanka Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ee Iran. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay cabsi laga qabo in furin cusub ay ka furanto xiisadda sii xoogeysaneysa ee u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran. Dhinaca kale, Iran iyo Mareykanka ayaa sii kordhiyay weerarrada ay isku qaadayaan, iyagoo ku loollamaya gacan ku haynta marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo xilliyada nabadda ay mari jireen ku dhowaad shan-meelood meel shidaalka iyo gaaska adduunka. Xiisaddan ayaa dalal badan ku khasabtay inay raadiyaan marinno ganacsi oo beddel u noqda Hormuz. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa ku hanjabay inuu qaadi doono “ciqaab milatari oo aad u culus” haddii Xuuthiyiintu sii wadaan weerarrada ay ku beegsanayaan maraakiibta. “Haddii ay mar kale sidan sameeyaan, Mareykanku wuxuu Iran ula xisaabtami doonaa, maadaama Xuutiyiintu yihiin wakiillo iyo garab ay Iran adeegsato. Ciqaab milatari oo aad u culus ayaa lagu qaadi doonaa Iran iyo sidoo kale Xuuthiyiinta laftooda,” ayuu Trump ku qoray baraha bulshada. Iyadoo hadallada kulul ay sii xoogeysanayaan, ayaa sidoo kale waxaa isa soo taraya saameynta dhaqaale ee ka dhalatay xiisadda. Qiimaha halkii foosto ee shidaalka Brent ayaa Khamiistii kor u kacay 4.3 boqolkiiba, isagoo gaaray 98.16 doolar. Waa heerkii ugu sarreeyay tan iyo horraantii bishii Juun, ka hor heshiis nabadeed hordhac ah oo labada dhinac gaareen, kaas oo markii dambe burburay. Dhanka diblomaasiyadda, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq, Cali Al-Zaidi, oo dalkiisu xiriir dhow la leeyahay Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa Khamiistii gaaray magaalada Tehran si uu ugu baaqo nabad iyo wada-hadal, sida uu sheegay afhayeen u hadlay xukuumaddiisa. Al-Zaidi ayaa horraantii bishan kula kulmay Madaxweyne Trump magaalada Washington. Dalalka Khaliijka ayaa sii luminaya rajadii laga qabay xal lagu dejiyo xiisadda, sababo la xiriira xasaasiyadda xaaladda taagan, sida uu shaaciyay diblomaasi Carbeed oo codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dalalka gobolka iyo sidoo kale Pakistan iyo Turkiga ay weli wadaan dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in lagu yareeyo xiisadda sii kordheysa. items.title: Lamine Yamal & Kylian Mbappé oo noqday xidigaha ugu qaalisan taariikhda Shirkadda Transfermarkt.
items.description: BY: Saleeymaan Alcadaala Iyadoo uu dhawaan soo idlaaday Koobka Adduunka 2026, shirkadda caanka ah ee qiimeynta ciyaartoyda ee Transfermarkt ayaa soo saartay qiimeynteedii ugu dambeysay, iyadoo dib u eegis ku sameysay qiimaha suuqa ee xiddigihii ka qeyb galay tartanka. Xiddiga reer Spain ee Barcelona, Lamine Yamal, ayaa noqday ciyaaryahanka ugu qaalisan taariikhda Transfermarkt, isagoo qiimihiisu gaaray 220 milyan oo Yuuro, kadib kaalintii muhiimka ahayd ee uu ku lahaa guushii Spain ee Koobka Adduunka. Qiimeyntan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay muujinaysaa sida Koobka Adduunku u saameeyo qiimaha ciyaartoyda iyo sumcaddooda, iyadoo bandhigyada cajiibka ah ee tartanku ay sababeen in ciyaartoy badan qiimahoodu kor u kaco. Lamine Yamal, oo 19 jir ah, ayaa ka mid ahaa ciyaartoydii ugu wanaagsanayd tartanka, isagoo door muhiim ah ka qaatay guushii Spain . Kaalinta koowaad waxaa la wadaagaya weeraryahanka Manchester City iyo Norway, Erling Haaland, oo isna gaaray 220 milyan oo Yuuro, kadib toddobadii gool ee uu ka dhaliyay tartanka. Haaland ayaa sii waday qaabkiisii hore, isagoo noqday mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu halista badan adduunka . Xiddiga Real Madrid, Kylian Mbappé, ayaa galay kaalinta saddexaad isagoo qiimihiisu gaaray 200 milyan oo Yuuro, kadib markii uu ku guuleystay Kabta Dahabka ah ee tartanka. Mbappé ayaa sidoo kale ku guulaystay abaalmarinta Golden Ball, kaas oo la siiyo ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican tartanka . Michael Olise ayaa galay kaalinta afraad isagoo gaaray 170 milyan oo Yuuro , halka Jude Bellingham uu noqday shanaad isagoo qiimihiisu yahay 160 milyan oo Yuuro. Pedri ayaa isna gaaray 150 milyan oo Yuuro , waxaana ku xiga João Neves, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Vitinha iyo Vinícius Júnior oo dhammaantood lagu qiimeeyay 140 milyan oo Yuuro . Liiska ayaa sidoo kale waxaa ku jira Julián Álvarez , Declan Rice, Bukayo Saka iyo Morgan Rogers , halka Pau Cubarsí uu noqday daafaca ugu qaalisan kubadda cagta adduunka isagoo qiimihiisu gaaray 100 milyan oo Yuuro. items.title: South West State’s New Cabinet Faces Accountability Test
items.description: BAIDOA— South West State President Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur Madobe chaired the first meeting of the newly appointed Council of Ministers, with discussions focusing on improving public service delivery, strengthening accountability and accelerating the implementation of development programmes. President Madobe instructed cabinet members to prioritise essential public services, promote genuine reconciliation, enhance administrative transparency and ensure effective coordination among government institutions. During the meeting, ministers presented the initial plans and priorities of their respective ministries and pledged to work collectively in implementing the policies and strategic objectives of the South West State administration. The cabinet also discussed measures to improve cooperation among ministries, raise the quality of government services and expedite development projects aimed at improving the lives of communities across South West State. The Council of Ministers received a detailed briefing from the South West State Auditor General on government-owned assets, including their management, documentation and oversight. President Madobe urged cabinet members to serve the public with integrity, unity and responsibility. He said strong institutional cooperation was essential to achieving sustainable development, improving security and strengthening effective governance throughout South West State. items.title: Cumaan oo sheegtay inay isku dubbaridayso dadaallo
items.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Cumaan ayaa sheegtay inay isku dubbaridayso dadaallo ay kala kaashanayso Sacuudi Carabiya, dhinacyada Yemen iyo Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Yemen, si dib loogu bilaabo hannaanka siyaasadeed ee looga golleeyahay in lagu gaadho amni iyo xasillooni gobolka. Iyo si ay u nabdoonaato ganacsiga isaga gudbaaya marinka bada cas gaar ahaan Baabul mandab oo dhawaanahan laga dayrinaayay in ay xidhanto ama ay ka dhacaan weeraro ay ku hanjabeen Xuutiyiinta Yemen.

items.title: Maxaa ka jira inuu is casilayo wasiirka arrimaha gudaha DF?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) oo qoraal soo saaray ayaa beeniyay warara sheegay inuu is casilayo, kadib markii si weyn loogu faafiyay baraha bulshada. Wasiirka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay waxba kama jiraan yihiin wararka la faafiyay ee lagu sheegay inuu iska casilayo xilka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, wuxuuna tilmaamay inuu ku guda jiro gudashada waajibaadka loo igmaday. “Wararka lagu faafiyey baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in aan masuuliyada aan qaranka u hayo iska casilayo waa been abuur, sal iyo raad toona ma leh. Waxaan ku gudo jiraa gudashada waajibaadkeyga qaran, kuwaasi oo aan ugu adeegayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Wasiirku. Cali Xoosh ayaa tilmaamay in wararka been abuurka ah ay ka faafiyeen shaqsiyaad leh dano gaar ah oo isku ekeysiiyay Wariyeyaal, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ka digay wararka been abuurka ah ee lagu jahwareerinayo bulshada Soomaaliyeed, si loo marin habaabiyo shacabka. “Been abuurkaas waxaana sameeyey shaqsiyaad isu ekaysiinaya wariyayaal, oo ku shaqeysta wararka been abuurka iyo marin habaabinta bulshada. Waa yadaan danbe, xogaha khaldan (misinformation) iyo xogaha been abuurka ah (disinformation) waa khataraha waaweyn ee lagu jahwareeriyo bulshooyinka,” ayuu mar kale yiri Cali Xoosh. Ugu dambeyn wuxuu ugu baaqay shacabka Soomaaliyeed inay xogaha ay kala socdaan ilaha rasmiga ah ee hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka, si looga hortago been abuurka. “Sidaas darteed, waxaa muhiim ah in markasta la yeesho dhaqanka ah hubinta xogta. Shacabkana waxaan ka codsanayaa in ay xogta rasmiga ah ka qaataan wararka kasoo baxa akoonadayda rasmiga ah iyo hay’adaha rasmiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka,” ayuu Wasiirku kusoo gabagabeeyay qoraalkiisa. The post Maxaa ka jira inuu is casilayo wasiirka arrimaha gudaha DF? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Shaqo la’aan ku dhacday dad xeryaha Gaalkacyo ka samayn jiray wacy-galin bulsho
items.description: (ERGO) – Wuxuu noqday guri-joog aan wax shaqo qaban tan iyo billowgii sanadkan Xasan Xuseen Noor, kaas oo cunno xumo ay wajahayaan qoyskiisa oo barakac ku ah Gaalkacyo. Wuxuu ku dabari jiray howl samafal oo si madax-bannaan uu ugu qaban jiray hay’ad gargaar. Waxaa la mid ah ku dhawaad 100 dhallinyaro, kuwaas oo kala shaqayn jiray dhinaca wacyi-galinta iyo faya-dhowrka hay’ado ay ka mid yihiin CARE, DRC iyo Kuwo kale oo gargaarka gaarsiin jiray kaamamka. Waxay ka howl-gali jireen xeryaha ay ku nool yihiin iyagoo ku shaqayn jiray mushahar ay si bille ah u heli jireen. Xasan oo ay ka istaagtay $200 oo ahayd isha dhaqaale ee qoyskiisa wuxuu la daalaadhacaya duruuf nolol xumo oo ka dhalatay xaaladdaas. Toddobaadkii labo maalin oo ka mid ah ayay helaan cunno 2 waqti ay dabka saartan. Waxaa soo dhicisa xaaskiisa oo shaqo xoogsi ah qabata. Bishii labaad ee sanadkan ayay ku qasbanaatay in ay ku wareegto gudaha iyo daafaha magaalada si ay u soo aruuriso biraha macdanka ah, kuwaas oo asbuucii labo mar oo ka mid ah ay ka iibsadaan raga biraha tuma. Waxay ka heshaa lacag aan joogto ahayn oo u dhacaysa $3-5. Dhaqaalahan oo aan ku filnayn ayaa ku riixay in ay dayn ku kaalmaystaan. Xasan wuxuu gocanayaan shaqadii uu ka helayay mushaharka joogtada ahaa. “Xaga dab-shidka culay baa ka jiro. $200 ciyaalkayga waa ku filnaa jirtay. Saddexda waqti raashinkooda way ku filnayd. Hadda ma haysano wixii dhan. Rajo ayaa nagu jirta. Hay’ada markay soo laabayo daynta iska mag.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in muddo Afar sano ah uu qoyskiisu ku tiirsanaa dhaqaalaha ay siinaysay hay’adda DRC oo uu u shaqayanayay. Wuxuu u qaabilsanaa wacyi-galinta, ilaalinta nadaafadda iyo xog aruurinta la xariirta tacadiyada ka dhaca xeradiisa Samawade 1. Wuxuu sheegay in uu ahaa adeeg bulsho oo marna uu ka faa’iideysanayay shaqada uu yahay, marna uu ugu shaqaynayay dadkiisa nugul, taas oo hadda meesha ka baxday, markii hay’addu ay fasaxday. Waxaa lagu war-galiyay in shaqo joojintan ay la xariirto dhaqaale xumo. Ka hor shaqadan wuxuu ahaa farsamo yaqaan qaabilsanaa dhismaha guryaha, balse fursad tababar oo uu ka helay hay’adda uu u shaqaynayay ayaa siisay in uu si madax-bannaan ugu biiro kooxaha ka howl-galayay xertaha. Xasan ayaa sheegay in uu jeclaan lahaa dib ugu laabashada xirfaddiisii hore, balse qiimayn uu ku sameeyay uu ogaaday in heliddeedu ay adag tahay xilligan. “Farsamadii aan ku shaqayn jiray waanba ilaawayba. Macaamiishii aan la shaqaynayey dad kalaa u shaqaynaya. In aan doon doono nambarada aan wacdo mooyee dadkii niman kalaa u shaqeeya. Qof cusub baa magaalada ka noqday. Hay’ada Ilaahay wax iigu soo dhiibi jiray meelba ma aadin shaqada, shaqadii horana waan iska illaaway oo faryaamo ayaan qandaraas ka qaadanayay. Hadda magaalada iyadaaba iska xiran. Wax laga shaqeeyo malahan.” Wuxuu rajo xumo ka muujiyay saamaynta sii wiiqmaysa ee hay’adaha samafalka, kuwaas oo sidoo kale xeradiisa ka bixiya raashin, kaas oo hadda aan joogto ahayn. Wuxuu xusay in mararka qaar la helo, inta badana la waayo. Waa culays kale si guud looga cabanayo. Duruufaha kale ee haysta Xasan waxaa ka mid ah dayn uu qaadanayay tan bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan oo dadka ku leh ay ku qasbanayaan in uu bixiyo. Wuxuu sheegay in uusan awoodin lacagtaas oo ah $350 oo raashin uu ku qaatay. Intaas wuxuu ku daray in sidoo kale lagu leeyahay $120 oo ah lacag ay waxbarashada ku dhiganayeen afar ilmood oo uu dhalay. Wuxuu xusay in uu ku sii faro adaygayo si aysan waxbarashada iskuulkooda uga harin duruufta haysa awgeed. Afartan iyo shan xero oo ku yaalla Gaalkacyo ayay ka howl-galayeen dhallinyarada shaqo la’aanta noqday. Xero kasta waxaa ka shaqaynayay 2 qof xirfad u leh iskudubbaridka arrimaha wacy-galinta bulshada, faya-dhowrka iyo qaar kale sida ay inoo sheegeen horjoogayaasha xerayaha. Xirsi Jaamac Baadi oo ah guddoomiyaha xerada Danwadaag ayaa ka mid ah masuuliyiinta culays soo kordhay ku tilmaamay howlaha samafal ee meesha ka baxaya iyo dhallinyarada shaqo la’aanta noqday. Wuxuu tilmaamay in kaalin wayn ay uga jireen baraarugga bulshada barakaca ah iyo xitaa dhaqaalaha ka soo galayay hay’adaha oo ku dhex-wareegi jiray xeryaha gaar ahaan ganacsiyada ay wax ka iibsanayeen. Taakuladii gargaar iyo tii wacyi-galin ayuu xusay in ay waayeen dadka xeradiisa iyo kuwa la mid ka ah, taas oo rajadooda nololeed sii adkaysay. “Dadkaas hoy ma haystaan, caafimaad ma haystaan iyo waxbarasho ma haystaan. Quutul duruurigii cuni lahaayeen ma haystaan. Wax Allaale oo aasaasi ah oo qofka bani’aadamka u baahan yahay bay u baahan yihiin. Raashin hadii nala siiyo waan qaadan lahayd waa na anfacaysaa. Wax aan diidayno ma jirto.” Sacdiyo Cabdi Axmed oo ah hooyo kaligeed korisa sagaal carruur ah waxay ka soo kaban la’dahay shaqo la’aan ku dhacday. Waxay ahayd xariiriyaha hay’adaha, bulshada iyo maamulka xerada Danwadaag. Waxay sheegtay in shaqadaasi ay ahayd isha keliya ee dhaqaale ee qoyskeeda ku tiirsana ilaa 2023, isla markaana ay ka dabooli jirtay baahiyaha cunto ee qoyskeeda iyo tan waxbarasho ee carruurteeda. Waxay ka dayrisay xaaladda qoyskeeda ay ku jireen lixdii bil ee u danbeeyay. 24 ba mar ayay xustay in ay dabka saartaan cunno aan ku filnay. Waxay ka heshaa shaqo xoogsi ah oo aan joogto ahayn. “Waxaan ku maareeyaa noloshayda inaan shaax kariyo iyo inaan meelo soo xaaqo. Meeshay noloshayda ku jirto ayaan wax ama bariiskayga aan kala soo baxaa, kaamkayaga wax yaala malahan waa xero cayr ah. Aniga oo mar $50 ama $100 isoo dhici jirtay ayaa ugu wacnaa.” Sacdiyo Waxay Shaaxa ku karisaa gurigeeda iyadoo ka dibna ku wareejisa suuqyada iyo goobaha ganacsiga, Iyadoo koobka shaxaa ay ku iibiso $0.2. Haweenaydan Waxay xustay in dhowr hay’adood in ay si madax-bannaan ay u la shaqayn jirtay, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin. Waxay si bille ah ugu heli jirtay lacag cadad ahaan kala duwan. Waxay ku xirnayd shaqooyinka ay qabato bilaha qaar ayay xustay in ay shaqaysan jirtay $150, taas oo ku filnayd nolol ahaan, balse la’aanteed waxay qoyskeedu galeen xaalado nolol xumo oo isbarkan. Waxay sheegtay in daymihii ay heli jirtay in hadda ay gabaabi noqdeen sabab la xariirta lacag badan oo lagu yeeshay. $440 ayay ku leeyihiin ganacsato iyo xarumo waxbarasho oo 4 carruur ah u dhigtaan. “Maalintay iga go’day lacagtaas nolo mugdi ah oo waxaan galay. Dhaqaale daro darteed caruurtayda dugsiga waa ka hareen, Iskuuladiina waa ka hareen.” Sacdiyo iyo qoyskeeda waxay sanadkii 2018 ka soo barakaceen deegaanka Buursaalax ee gobolka Mudug, markii abaar ay dhaafisay xoolo ay dhaqanayeen oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale. Waxay isku martay dhowr xero, balse sadddexdii sano ee u danbeeyay waxay ku nagaatay xerada lagu barakacay ee Danwadaag, halkaas oo ay uga howl-galaysay hay’adaha gargaarka bixiya. Dadka soo barakacay waa kuwa ugu badan ee saamaynta ay ku yeelatay hoos u dhaca dhaqaale ee ku dhacay hay’ado cunno iyo shaqo abuur siinayay dadka ku jira xeryaha. Hay’ada Ilaahay wax iigu soo dhiibi jiray meelba ma aadin shaqada, shaqadii horana waan iska illaaway oo faryaamo ayaan qandaraas ka qaadanayay. Hadda magaalada iyadaaba iska xiran. Wax laga shaqeeyo malahan.” Wuxuu rajo xumo ka muujiyay saamaynta sii wiiqmaysa ee hay’adaha samafalka, kuwaas oo sidoo kale xeradiisa ka bixiya raashin, kaas oo hadda aan joogto ahayn. Wuxuu xusay in mararka qaar la helo, inta badana la waayo. Waa culays kale si guud looga cabanayo. Duruufaha kale ee haysta Xasan waxaa ka mid ah dayn uu qaadanayay tan bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan oo dadka ku leh ay ku qasbanayaan in uu bixiyo. Wuxuu sheegay in uusan awoodin lacagtaas oo ah $350 oo raashin uu ku qaatay. Intaas wuxuu ku daray in sidoo kale lagu leeyahay $120 oo ah lacag ay waxbarashada ku dhiganayeen afar ilmood oo uu dhalay. Wuxuu xusay in uu ku sii faro adaygayo si aysan waxbarashada iskuulkooda uga harin duruufta haysa awgeed. Afartan iyo shan xero oo ku yaalla Gaalkacyo ayay ka howl-galayeen dhallinyarada shaqo la’aanta noqday. Xero kasta waxaa ka shaqaynayay 2 qof xirfad u leh iskudubbaridka arrimaha wacy-galinta bulshada, faya-dhowrka iyo qaar kale sida ay inoo sheegeen horjoogayaasha xerayaha. Xirsi Jaamac Baadi oo ah guddoomiyaha xerada Danwadaag ayaa ka mid ah masuuliyiinta culays soo kordhay ku tilmaamay howlaha samafal ee meesha ka baxaya iyo dhallinyarada shaqo la’aanta noqday. Wuxuu tilmaamay in kaalin wayn ay uga jireen baraarugga bulshada barakaca ah iyo xitaa dhaqaalaha ka soo galayay hay’adaha oo ku dhex-wareegi jiray xeryaha gaar ahaan ganacsiyada ay wax ka iibsanayeen. Taakuladii gargaar iyo tii wacyi-galin ayuu xusay in ay waayeen dadka xeradiisa iyo kuwa la mid ka ah, taas oo rajadooda nololeed sii adkaysay. “Dadkaas hoy ma haystaan, caafimaad ma haystaan iyo waxbarasho ma haystaan. Quutul duruurigii cuni lahaayeen ma haystaan. Wax Allaale oo aasaasi ah oo qofka bani’aadamka u baahan yahay bay u baahan yihiin. Raashin hadii nala siiyo waan qaadan lahayd waa na anfacaysaa. Wax aan diidayno ma jirto.” Sacdiyo Cabdi Axmed oo ah hooyo kaligeed korisa sagaal carruur ah waxay ka soo kaban la’dahay shaqo la’aan ku dhacday. Waxay ahayd xariiriyaha hay’adaha, bulshada iyo maamulka xerada Danwadaag. Waxay sheegtay in shaqadaasi ay ahayd isha keliya ee dhaqaale ee qoyskeeda ku tiirsana ilaa 2023, isla markaana ay ka dabooli jirtay baahiyaha cunto ee qoyskeeda iyo tan waxbarasho ee carruurteeda. Waxay ka dayrisay xaaladda qoyskeeda ay ku jireen lixdii bil ee u danbeeyay. 24 ba mar ayay xustay in ay dabka saartaan cunno aan ku filnay. Waxay ka heshaa shaqo xoogsi ah oo aan joogto ahayn. “Waxaan ku maareeyaa noloshayda inaan shaax kariyo iyo inaan meelo soo xaaqo. Meeshay noloshayda ku jirto ayaan wax ama bariiskayga aan kala soo baxaa, kaamkayaga wax yaala malahan waa xero cayr ah. Aniga oo mar $50 ama $100 isoo dhici jirtay ayaa ugu wacnaa.” Sacdiyo Waxay Shaaxa ku karisaa gurigeeda iyadoo ka dibna ku wareejisa suuqyada iyo goobaha ganacsiga, Iyadoo koobka shaxaa ay ku iibiso $0.2. Haweenaydan Waxay xustay in dhowr hay’adood in ay si madax-bannaan ay u la shaqayn jirtay, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin. Waxay si bille ah ugu heli jirtay lacag cadad ahaan kala duwan. Waxay ku xirnayd shaqooyinka ay qabato bilaha qaar ayay xustay in ay shaqaysan jirtay $150, taas oo ku filnayd nolol ahaan, balse la’aanteed waxay qoyskeedu galeen xaalado nolol xumo oo isbarkan. Waxay sheegtay in daymihii ay heli jirtay in hadda ay gabaabi noqdeen sabab la xariirta lacag badan oo lagu yeeshay. $440 ayay ku leeyihiin ganacsato iyo xarumo waxbarasho oo 4 carruur ah u dhigtaan. “Maalintay iga go’day lacagtaas nolo mugdi ah oo waxaan galay. Dhaqaale daro darteed caruurtayda dugsiga waa ka hareen, Iskuuladiina waa ka hareen.” Sacdiyo iyo qoyskeeda waxay sanadkii 2018 ka soo barakaceen deegaanka Buursaalax ee gobolka Mudug, markii abaar ay dhaafisay xoolo ay dhaqanayeen oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale. Waxay isku martay dhowr xero, balse sadddexdii sano ee u danbeeyay waxay ku nagaatay xerada lagu barakacay ee Danwadaag, halkaas oo ay uga howl-galaysay hay’adaha gargaarka bixiya. Dadka soo barakacay waa kuwa ugu badan ee saamaynta ay ku yeelatay hoos u dhaca dhaqaale ee ku dhacay hay’ado cunno iyo shaqo abuur siinayay dadka ku jira xeryaha. items.description: Somalia has launched a new border security partnership with the United Kingdom and the International Organization for Migration (IOM), aiming to modernize airport security, enhance border management, and strengthen the country's capacity to combat transnational threats.

items.title: Ciidanka daacadda u ah Lafta-gareen oo hanjaabaad culus soo diray kadib markii…
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo ah Afhayeenka Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo muuqaal soo duubay ayaa ka hadlay xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay, gaar ahaan ciidamadii shalay kasoo goostay dhankooda ee lagu soo dhaweeyay gudaha magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Ugaas Xasan oo hadda ku sugan bannaanka magaalada ayaa sheegay inuu qiyaano sameeyay Guddoomiyihii hore ee deegaanka Awdiinle Ibraahim Kalaay, isla markaana uu lasoo goostay saddex gaari, kana iibsaday maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in Kalaay uu ahaa sarkaal muddo dheer lasoo dhaweeyay Lafta-gareen, balse hadda loo ballan qaaday xil cusub, sidaasna uu ku qiyaameeyay saaxibadiisa. “Askari kamid ah ciidamada Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed oo muddadii aan halganka ku jirnay intaba la shaqeynayay ciidamada oo la yiraahdo Kalaay ayaa sameeyay qiyaano qaran oo ah in hubkii Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed laba baabuur illaa saddex baabuur uu iibsado, una geeyo cadowgii Ummadda Soomaaliyeed kuwii shalay kusoo duulay shacabka,” ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in aysan niyad-jebin doonin arrintan, isaga diray hanjabaad culus, kuna dhaartay in dagaalka ay sii wadi doonaan, isla markaana ay xoreyn doonaan magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. “Waxaan u sheegeynaa shacbigeenna intii hore waan ka fiicanahay waan ka diyaarsanahay Wallaahi Baydhaba waan xoreyneynaa ciddii been moodeysow waan isku imaan doonaan,” ayuu mar kale yiri Afhayeenka Lafta-gareen. Dhanka kale, wuxuu farriin u diray shacabka, isaga oo yiri “Shacabka waxaan leenahay ha niyad-jebina taageeradiina waa innoo muhiim una diyaar garooba qabashada magaalada Baydhaba, maalmaa soo socda haddii Ilaahey idmo”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo shalay dowadda Soomaaliya ay sheegtay in ay isa soo dhiibeen illaa 150 akari oo ay maleeshiyaad ku sheegtay, kuwaas oo kamid ahaa ciidamada daacadda u ah Lafta-gareen “Guddoomiyihii hore ee deegaanka Awdiinle ee Gobolka Baay, Ibraahim Kalaay, oo ay la socdaan qiyaastii 150 maleeshiyaad ah, ayaa waqtiyo kala duwan oo maanta ah isku soo dhiibay Ciidamada Qaranka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ka hawlgala Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, kaddib markii ay si cad uga soo goosteen maleeshiyaadkii uu marin-habaabiyay Cabdicasiis Laftagareen, kuwaas oo maalmihii u dambeeyay falal amni-darro ah ka geysanayay deegaannadaas” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Tallaabadan ayaa dhabar-jab ku ah kooxda Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee horay looga saaray magaalada Baydhaba, kadib isbeddalkii ka dhacay magaaladaas oo uu kusoo baxay hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. The post Ciidanka daacadda u ah Lafta-gareen oo hanjaabaad culus soo diray kadib markii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley oo culeys saaraya Shabaabka Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Xoogaga Macawiisleyda Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa kordhiyay dhaqdhaqaaqyada ay ka wadaan deegaanada qaar ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan, gaar ahaan deegaanada hoostaga Degmada Maxaas. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ayaa kordhay toddobaadkan, xilli ay soo dhow yihiin Doorashooyinka Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle. Xoogaga Macawiisleyda ayaa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ku garab siinaya in maleeshiyada Al Shabaab laga fogeeyo magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada Hirshabelle ee laga qabanayo doorashada qof iyo codka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Macawiisleyda oo sidoo kale loo yaqaano (Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka) ay culeys saarayaan deegaanka Suullaay (Suulaaye) oo hoostaga Degmada Maxaas. Deegaankan oo ku yaala meel istiraatiiji ah ayaa isku xira Maxaas, Teedaan iyo Waabweyn, waana deegaan muhiim u ah isu socodka dadka ee bartamaha dalka. Diyaaradaha dagaalka ee saaxiibada caalamiga ah ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Talaadadii duqeeyay goobo ay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab kaga sugnaayeen deegaanka Suullaay, si looga hortago Shabaabka isku uruursanaya duleedyada Maxaas. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa xalay warsaxaafadeed ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in duqayntaasi lagu dilay 18 nin oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, halka 21 kalena lagu gaarsiiyay dhaawacyo culus. “Waxaa la burburiyay hal gaari oo dagaal oo ay kooxda adeegsaneysay, fariisimo iyo dhufeysyo ay ka sameysteen deegaanka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. 17-kii bishan ayaa sidoo kale xagga cirka laga garaacay Shabaabka ku sugan deegaankaasi, waxaana xusid mudan in 13-kii bishan la duqeeyay difaac ay Al Shabaab ka sameysatay deegaanka Goobo oo 15km u jira Degmada Maxaas, kaas oo ah deegaanka ugu weyn ee ay ka ilaaliyaan amniga degmadaasi. Weerarada lagu hayo Shabaabka ku sugan duleedyada Degmada Maxaas ayaa yareynaya isu socodka iyo gurmadka maleeshiyada, waxayna ciidamada ka taageerayaan in ay horumar ka sameeyaan hawlgalada. Joojinta gurmadka Shabaabka ayaa ka hortagaya in maleeshiyadu ay hesho xoojin iyo raashiin soo gaara, waxayna ciidamada siineysaa fursad ay ku qabsadaan deegaano cusub. Dhanka kale Kumaandooska Gorgor oo garabsanaya Macawiisleyda ayaa hawlgal ka dhan ah Al Shabaab ka wada deegaanka Yasooman oo hoostaga Degmada Buuloburde. Ciidamada ayaa doonaya in ay maleeshiyada ka saaraan Yasooman oo dhul buuraley ah, waxaana ku taala waddo xiriirisa Buuloburde iyo Maxaas. Waddada Yasooman ayaa sidoo kale isku xirto Degmooyinka Buuloburde, Moqokori iyo Maxaas. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) ayaa Axaddii shacabka ku dhaqan deegaanada ay ciidamada ka hawlgelayaan ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan goobaha buu yiri ay cadowga joogaan. “Yuunan cadowgu ku dhuumanin aqalkaaga iyo buushkaaga, yaanu cadowga ku dhuumanin booyadaha oo yuusan hub ku dhex qarsanin, qulqulka waddooyinkana ha la yareeyo. Waxaan leenahay cadowga isma haynayno, haddii uu Ilaahay yiraahdo, gabalkoodaa dhacay.” Ayuu yiri Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad.

items.title: Xildhibaan Xaadoole: Waxaa Muqdisho ka dhacay oo aan goob joog u ahaa in nin loo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cusmaan Xaadoole oo ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho ay sameysay isbeddel ballaaran oo dhinacyo kala duwan leh tan iyo markii uu xilka qabtay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir u magacaabay Xasan Maxamed Xuseen “Muungaab”. Xildhibaan Xaadoole ayaa sheegay in magaalada Muqdisho ay horumar ka sameysay dhinacyada amniga, bilicda, ganacsiga iyo dhismayaasha, isaga oo arrintaas ku ammaanay dadaallada maamulka Gobolka Banaadir iyo siyaasadda fog ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee ku wajahan amniga iyo horumarka dalka. “In dalkani horumaray waxaa lagu garan karaa in maanta la joogo heer nadaafadda iyo qashinka sharci laga soo saaro, qofkii lagu arko isagoo ku xadgudbayna maxkamad la soo taago. Guddoomiyaha gobolka arrintaas waa ku mahadsan yahay. Anigu waxaan goob-joog u ahaa xilli qof qashin hor yaallay uu oran jiray, ‘Qashinkayga igama qaadi kartid haddii aadan lacag i siin.’ Xitaa nin ayaa arrintaas xabbad lagula dhuftay. Maantana waxaa la joogaa heer qofka qashinka daadiya maxkamad la soo taago,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Xaadoole. Xildhibaanka ayaa sheegay in tallaabadaasi ay tahay guul u soo hoyatay bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu sheegay in horumarkaasi iyo fahamka ay bulshadu ka heshay muhiimadda nadaafadda aysan si iska timid ku imaan, balse ay yihiin natiijada dadaal iyo wacyigelin muddo socday. Waxa uu bulshada Gobolka Banaadir ugu baaqay inay dowladda ku garab istaagaan dadaallada horumarineed. “Dalku wuxuu gacanta u galay madaxweyne leh qorshe fog oo garanaya halka uu u socdo. Bulshadana waxaa looga baahan yahay inay garab siiso. Waxaa la gaari doonaa in dhallinyarada la marin-habaabiyay ee Al-Shabaab ku jira ay kasoo baxaan, dadkoodana dib ugu soo biiraan, isla markaana ay fahmaan halka dalku u socdo,” ayuu yiri. items.title: Maxaa looga hadlay kulanka maanta golaha wasiirrada ay ku yesheen Muqdisho?
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, ayaa maanta kulankoodi todobaadlaha ahaa ku yeeshay magaalada Muqdisho. Kulanka golaha ayaa cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansxiyay xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya ee golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, sida uu dhigayo Qodobka 145aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya 2026, kaddib soo jeedinta Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka. Golaha Wasiirradu oo uu shir guddoomiyanayay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku Xigeenka Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa meelmariyay xubnaha soo socda oo kala ah laba (2) Qareen Sare iyo laba (2) Xeeldheere Sharci oo uu xilkooduna noqonayo shan (5) sano, ka dib marka ay dhammeystiranto habraaca ansixintooda: 1. Maxamed-deeq Macalllin Aadan 2. Maryan Sheekh Cismaan 3. Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil 4. Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin Xubnahan ayaa ah kuwa keliya ee magacaabis ku imaanaya, halka xubnaha kale ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka ay ku imaanayaan xilkooda (Hadba Mas’uulka xilkaas haya uu ka mid noqonayo golahan), waxayna xilalkan kala yihiin: 1. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare 2. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka 3. Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka 4. Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Kore ee Dowlad goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda 5. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Sidoo kale golaha ayaa xilkii ka qaaday guddoomiyihii Golaha Tacliinta Sare, waxayna xilkaas u magacaabeen Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. Ugu dambayn Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda, ayaa meel-mariyey Hindise-sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farxashanka iyo Heshiis u dhexeeya Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Cummaan kaasi oo diirrada saaraya iskaashiga Gaadiidka Cirka. Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika kaasi oo awoodda saaraya in dhallinyarada laga qaybgaliyo go’aannada siyaasadda iyo doorka dowladaha ee horumarinta dhallinyarada Afrika. items.title: DFS oo Daah-furtay Barnaamijka Xoojinta Amniga Xuduudaha iyo Garoomada Diyaaradaha
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Janaraal Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daah-furay Barnaamijka Iskaashiga Dhismaha iyo Xoojinta Amniga Xuduudaha Garoomada Diyaaradaha ee Soomaaliya. Barnaamijkan ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo awoodda hay’adaha ka shaqeeya sugidda amniga xuduudaha, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo horumarinta tayada shaqaalaha, casriyeynta hababka maamulka xuduudaha, adkaynta amniga garoomada diyaaradaha iyo kobcinta iskaashiga dowladda Soomaaliya ay la leedahay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah. Wasiir Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag) ayaa sheegay in sugidda amniga xuduudaha iyo garoomada diyaaradaha ay tahay tiir muhiim u ah amniga qaranka iyo la dagaallanka khataraha ka gudba xuduudaha. Wuxuu xusay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dhismaha hay’ado amni oo leh aqoon, xirfad iyo awood ay kula tacaalaan caqabadaha amni ee dalka ka jira. Sidoo kale, Wasiirka ayaa tilmaamay in barnaamijkani uu door weyn ka qaadan doono tayeynta shaqaalaha amniga, xoojinta maamulka xuduudaha, fududeynta isu-socodka sharciga ah iyo sare u qaadidda wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha amniga, iyadoo la waafajinayo heerarka iyo habraacyada caalamiga ah. Mas’uuliyiin ka socotay hay’adaha amniga iyo wakiillo ka socday saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ayaa ka qeyb galay munaasabadda daah-furka, iyagoo muujiyey taageeradooda ku aaddan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo amniga xuduudaha iyo garoomada diyaaradaha ee Soomaaliya.

items.title: Golaha wasiirrada XFS oo Dr. Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale u Magacaabay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Tacliinta Sare
items.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta xilkii ka qaaday Guddoomiyihii Guddiga Tacliinta Sare, Dr. Cabdinuur Sheekh Maxamed, oo hore sidoo kale u soo noqday Wasiirka Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Soomaaliya. Kulanka Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa sidoo kale lagu magacaabay Dr. Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale inuu noqdo Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Guddiga Tacliinta Sare, isagoo beddelaya Dr. Cabdinuur Sheekh Maxamed. Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ayaa soo dhoweysay magacaabistan, waxayna u rajeysay Guddoomiyaha cusub inuu ku guuleysto gudashada waajibaadka loo igmaday, isla markaana door muuqda ka qaato horumarinta tayada waxbarashada sare, maamulka jaamacadaha iyo kor u qaadista nidaamka tacliinta sare ee dalka. Magacaabistan ayaa qeyb ka ah isbeddellada iyo dib-u-habeynta ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka waddo hay’adaha waxbarashada, iyadoo la doonayo in la xoojiyo tayada adeegyada tacliinta sare iyo hufnaanta maamulka hay’adaha waxbarashada dalka.

items.title: Ethiopian Police Arrest 17 Suspects Over Human Smuggling
items.description: Ethiopian federal police arrested 17 suspects accused of operating a human trafficking network linked to the deaths of more than 60 migrants and the sexual assault of multiple women, authorities announced. The arrests highlight the severe humanitarian and security crisis plaguing Horn of Africa migration routes, where organized syndicates exploit vulnerable individuals attempting to reach Saudi Arabia through Djibouti and war-torn Yemen. According to federal police, the syndicate was led by Mohammed Tahir Aden, also known as Werdi. Investigators state that the network illegally smuggled more than 40,000 people and extorted over 1 billion birr from victims. Migrants were reportedly gathered from various regions across Ethiopia through brokers, promised a better life, and directed through eastern Ethiopia into Yemen. Once across the border, victims were allegedly detained in specialized warehouses and subjected to severe abuses. Jaylan Abdi, head of the Federal Police Media and Communication Division, told the BBC that the operation to apprehend the suspects spanned the previous 15 days. The arrests were conducted across multiple locations, including Addis Ababa and the Harari region, following joint investigations involving the Ministry of Justice and the National Intelligence and Security Agency. Police stated that the operation relied on documentary evidence, witness testimonies, and video footage provided by witnesses in both Ethiopia and Saudi Arabia. Case files for the 17 suspects have been compiled and transferred to the Ministry of Justice for prosecution. items.title: Somalia presses Meta for safeguards before WhatsApp username rollout
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia has raised concerns over WhatsApp’s planned introduction of usernames, warning that the privacy-focused feature could complicate efforts to investigate terrorism, financial fraud and cybercrime unless adequate safeguards are put in place. The Somali government says it has opened discussions with Meta, the parent company of WhatsApp, seeking assurances that the new system will preserve the ability of law enforcement agencies to identify criminal actors while protecting users’ privacy. The feature, expected to be introduced globally in the coming months, will allow WhatsApp users to communicate using unique usernames instead of sharing their phone numbers with other users. Although intended to strengthen privacy, Somali officials argue that the change presents distinct challenges for a country confronting persistent security threats and an economy heavily dependent on mobile financial services. Communications and Technology Minister Ahmed Osman Dirie said Somalia’s concerns stem from the country’s unique security environment, where authorities rely on registered mobile numbers to investigate crimes, trace suspects and disrupt networks involved in terrorism, extortion and online fraud. Officials fear that if usernames become the primary public identity on WhatsApp, malicious actors could find it easier to conceal their identities while targeting victims or coordinating criminal activity. Somalia has spent more than two decades battling Al-Shabab, the Al-Qaeda-linked militant group responsible for deadly attacks across the Horn of Africa. Authorities say the organization has exploited digital platforms for propaganda and intimidation, making online communications an increasingly important front in the country’s counterterrorism efforts. Government officials also point to Somalia’s widespread use of mobile money, which has become the backbone of everyday commerce. They warn that anonymous or frequently changing usernames could create new opportunities for impersonation scams and financial fraud unless strong verification measures accompany the rollout. According to the government, linking WhatsApp accounts to registered phone numbers has provided investigators with an important avenue for tracing criminal activity. Officials are now seeking detailed explanations from Meta on how digital accountability will be maintained after usernames become available. Somalia says it is not opposed to technological innovation but wants evidence that the new feature will not weaken existing security mechanisms. Authorities have requested information on how users will be verified, how fraudulent accounts will be detected and how law enforcement agencies will be able to identify individuals involved in serious criminal investigations while respecting legitimate privacy rights. Meta has emphasized that the feature has not yet been launched and that users will continue to register WhatsApp accounts using valid phone numbers. The company also says it is building safeguards designed to reduce impersonation, scams and abuse while giving users greater control over how they present themselves on the platform. The debate reflects a broader global discussion over balancing digital privacy with public safety. India, WhatsApp’s largest market, has also expressed concerns that usernames could increase the risk of online fraud and impersonation if implemented without sufficient protections. Indian authorities have urged Meta to continue consultations before introducing the feature. Technology analysts say the update represents another step in WhatsApp’s evolution toward a broader digital identity model similar to other social platforms, where usernames rather than phone numbers become the public-facing identity. Supporters argue that hiding phone numbers will better protect users from harassment, unwanted contact and the misuse of personal information, particularly in large public groups and community forums. Critics, however, contend that stronger privacy tools should not come at the expense of accountability, especially in countries facing organized crime, terrorism or widespread digital fraud. Cybersecurity experts say the challenge lies in striking a balance between two legitimate objectives: protecting individual privacy while ensuring authorities retain lawful means to investigate serious crimes. They argue that the success of WhatsApp’s new system will ultimately depend on the strength of its identity verification, abuse detection and cooperation with regulators where legally required. For Somalia, the discussions with Meta are expected to continue as the company prepares one of WhatsApp’s most significant privacy updates in recent years. Government officials say they remain open to the feature but want clear assurances that enhanced privacy will not inadvertently provide greater cover for criminals operating online. The outcome could influence how the feature is received not only in Somalia but also in other countries weighing the benefits of stronger user privacy against the practical demands of law enforcement and national security. Technology analysts say the update represents another step in WhatsApp’s evolution toward a broader digital identity model similar to other social platforms, where usernames rather than phone numbers become the public-facing identity. Supporters argue that hiding phone numbers will better protect users from harassment, unwanted contact and the misuse of personal information, particularly in large public groups and community forums. Critics, however, contend that stronger privacy tools should not come at the expense of accountability, especially in countries facing organized crime, terrorism or widespread digital fraud. Cybersecurity experts say the challenge lies in striking a balance between two legitimate objectives: protecting individual privacy while ensuring authorities retain lawful means to investigate serious crimes. They argue that the success of WhatsApp’s new system will ultimately depend on the strength of its identity verification, abuse detection and cooperation with regulators where legally required. For Somalia, the discussions with Meta are expected to continue as the company prepares one of WhatsApp’s most significant privacy updates in recent years. Government officials say they remain open to the feature but want clear assurances that enhanced privacy will not inadvertently provide greater cover for criminals operating online. The outcome could influence how the feature is received not only in Somalia but also in other countries weighing the benefits of stronger user privacy against the practical demands of law enforcement and national security. items.title: Somalia Cabinet Approves New Members of Supreme Judicial Council
items.description: Somalia's Council of Ministers has approved four new members to serve on the Supreme Judicial Council, while also endorsing a series of legislative and administrative decisions, including a new higher education leadership appointment, an aviation cooperation agreement with Oman, and the African Youth Charter.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirada oo cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyay dhismaha Golaha Sare ee Adeegga Garsoorka
items.description: Golaha Wasiirada Somaliya ayaa Khamiistan ansixiyay dhismaha Golaha Sare ee Adeegga Garsoorka, iyagoo ka duulaya soo jeedinta Wasaaradda Caddaaladda & Arrimaha Garsoorka, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed ka soo baxay Xafiiska Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda, Xamse Cabdi Barre. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in Golaha Wasiirada ay cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyeen magacaabista Xubnaha Golaha Sare ee Adeegga Garsoorka. “Golaha Wasiiradu oo uu shir guddoominayay Raysal Wasaare Kuxigeenka Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa meelmariyay xubnaha soo socda oo kala ah laba (2) Qareen Sare iyo laba (2) Xeeldheere Sharci oo uu xilkooduna noqonayo shan (5) sano, ka dib marka ay dhameystiranto habraaca ansixintooda.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Xubnaha la magacaabay ayaa kala ah:- 1. Maxamed-deeq Macalllin Aadan 2. Maryan Sheekh Cismaan 3. Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil 4. Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin. Xubnahan ayaa ah kuwa keliya ee magacaabis ku imaanaya, halka xubnaha kale ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka ay ku imaanayaan xilkooda (Hadba Masuulka xilkaas haya uu ka mid noqonayo golahan), waxayna xilalkan kala yihiin:- 1. Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare 2. Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka 3. Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka 4. Gudoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Sare ee Dowlad Goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda 5. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Dhanka kale Golaha Wasiirada ayaa xilka ka qaaday Gudoomiyihii Guddiga Tacliinta Sare ee Qaranka, Dr. Cabdinuur Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo booskiisa loo magacaabay Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. “Ugu dambayn Golaha Wasiirada XFS ayaa meel-mariyay Hindise Sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farxashanka iyo heshiis u dhaxeeya Dowladaha Somaliya iyo Cumaan, kaasi oo diirrada saaraya iskaashiga Gaadiidka Cirka. Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika kaasi oo awoodda saaraya in dhallinyarada laga qaybgeliyo go’aanada siyaasadda iyo doorka dowladaha ee horumarinta dhallinyarada Afrika.” Ayaa lagu soo geba-gabeeyay warsaxaafadeedka.

items.title: Iiraan oo weerartay xarumo ay leedahay CIA-da iyo dal la ogaaday inuu ka caawiyey
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa baaraya suurta-galnimada in Ruushka uu Iran ka caawiyay xogta bartilmaameedyada ama farsamada diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee loo adeegsaday weerarro lagu qaaday xarumo ay CIA-du ku leedahay dalalka Khaliijka, sida ay sheegeen afar qof oo xog-ogaal u ah qiimeynta sirdoonka Mareykanka. Ilaha, oo codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin maadaama ay ka hadlayeen arrimo xasaasi ah oo amniga qaranka la xiriira, ayaa sheegay in saraakiisha sirdoonka Mareykanka aysan weli gaarin gunaanad rasmi ah oo ku saabsan kaalinta Ruushka. Hase yeeshee, saxnaanta iyo waxtarka weerarrada, iyo sidoo kale taageerada farsamo ee Moscow ay muddooyinkii dambe siisay Tehran, ayaa sare u qaaday shakiga ah in Iran ay heshay caawimaad dibadeed. Warbaahinta caalamiga ah ayaa horay u sheegtay, saraakiil Mareykan ahna way xaqiijiyeen, in Ruushka uu Iran siiyay xog iyo taageero kale oo ay u adeegsatay weerarrada ka dhanka ah bartilmaameedyada Mareykanka ee gobolka Khaliijka. Si kastaba, baaritaanka gaarka ah ee ku saabsan in Moscow ay gacan ka geysatay weerarrada lagu qaaday xarumaha CIA-da ayaan horey loo shaacin. Xarumaha CIA-da ee la beegsaday Ugu yaraan laba xarumood oo CIA-da ay isticmaasho ayaa la weeraray bishii Maarso, sida ay horay u sheegeen Reuters iyo warbaahin kale. Mid ka mid ah xarumahaas wuxuu ahaa saldhigga CIA-da ee Sacuudi Carabiya, kaas oo ku dhex yaalla safaaradda Mareykanka ee magaalada Riyadh. Xarun kale ayaa ku taallay bariga dalka Ciraaq. Qaar ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in xarumo kale oo CIA-da ah sidoo kale la weeraray, balse waxay ka gaabsadeen inay bixiyaan faahfaahin ku saabsan goobahooda ama tiradooda. Mid ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in tirada xarumaha la beegsaday ay ahayd “in ka badan hal, balse ka yar 12”, halka il kale uu sheegay in dhowr xarumood la weeraray. Xarumaha CIA-da ee dibadda waxaa ka mid ah xafiisyada ugu muhiimsan ee hay’addu ku leedahay dalalka kala duwan, kuwaas oo inta badan ku dhex yaalla safaaradaha Mareykanka, loona yaqaan “stations”. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale leedahay xafiisyo qarsoodi ah, guryo ammaan ah, xarumo saadka iyo goobo lagu fuliyo howlgallada dabagalka iyo sirdoonka. Goobaha xarumahaas waxaa loo ilaaliyaa si aad u adag. Xog sirdoon oo farta ku fiiqday Ruushka Qoraal gudaha ah oo ay diyaarisay hay’ad sirdoon oo reer Galbeed ah ayaa lagu sheegay in Ruushka ay u badan tahay inuu kaalin ka qaatay bartilmaameedsiga xarumaha CIA-da ee gobolka. Sarkaal ka tirsan gobolka oo arkay qoraalkaas ayaa sheegay in qiimeynta sirdoonku ay farta ku fiiqeyso kaalinta Moscow, balse wuxuu codsaday inaan la shaacin hay’adda sida gaarka ah u diyaarisay warbixinta. Laba sarkaal oo reer Galbeed ah oo ku sugan Khaliijka, kuwaas oo la socodsiiyay warbixinnada sirdoonka, ayaa sheegay in weerarkii Sacuudi Carabiya loo adeegsaday laba diyaaradood oo nooca Shahed ah oo Iran leedahay, kuwaas oo la rumeysan yahay in Ruushku farsamo ahaan horumariyay. Sida ay saraakiishu sheegeen, diyaaraddii koowaad ayaa dalool ka sameysay qeyb nugul oo ka mid ah gidaarka bannaanka ee safaaradda, halka diyaaraddii labaad ay daloolkaas ka dhex gudubtay ka hor inta aysan qarxin. Weerarka laguma soo warramin inuu sababay wax dhimasho ama dhaawac ah. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in Ruushka uu si gaar ah uga qeyb qaatay bartilmaameedsiga xarumaha CIA-da, waxay taasi muujin kartaa in Moscow ay diyaar u tahay inay sare u qaaddo dadaalladeeda lagu carqaladeynayo howlgallada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Shakiga laga qabo in Ruushka uu Iran siinayo xogta bartilmaameedyada ayaa sii xoogaystay kaddib weerarro lagu qaaday saldhig Mareykanku ku leeyahay Jordan, halkaas oo gantaallo ballistic ah lagu beegsaday xeryo ay ciidamada ku sugnaayeen, laguna dilay laba askari. Aqalka Cad ayaa codsi faallo ah u gudbiyay CIA-da, balse hay’addu way ka gaabsatay inay ka hadasho arrinta. Sidoo kale, wakiillada Iran ee Qaramada Midoobay, Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka iyo dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya kama jawaabin codsiyo faallo ah. Teknoolajiyada Ruushka oo gaartay Iran Saraakiisha reer Galbeedka ayaa sheegay in Ruushka uu Iran ka caawiyay sidii ay u horumarin lahayd awoodda diyaaradaha Shahed ee lagu gaari karo laguna beegsan karo bartilmaameedyada. Il kale ayaa sheegay in Moscow ay Tehran siisay nidaam hagidda dayax-gacmeedka ku shaqeeya oo lagu magacaabo Kometa-M, kaas oo loo adeegsaday in lagu kordhiyo saxnaanta diyaaradaha Shahed-136. Khubarada ayaa sheegaya in nidaamka Kometa-M uu ka saxnaan badan yahay nidaamyada ay Iran soo saarto, sidoo kalena ay adag tahay in la carqaladeeyo ama la marin-habaabiyo. Wargeyska Wall Street Journal ayaa bishii Maarso markii ugu horreysay sheegay in Ruushku uu nidaamka Kometa-M siiyay Iran. Kremlin-ka ayaa markaas beeniyay warka, isaga oo ku tilmaamay “war been abuur ah”. Baarayaasha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa hadda isku dayaya inay ogaadaan in Iran ay xog bartilmaameed oo Ruushku bixiyay u adeegsatay weerarkii safaaradda Mareykanka ee Riyadh. Si kastaba, weli waxaa jira shaki ku saabsan in qeybta CIA-da si ula kac ah loo beegsaday. Qaar ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay inay suurtagal tahay in Iran ay weerarka ula jeedday guud ahaan safaaradda Mareykanka, balse diyaaradaha ay si kadis ah ugu dhaceen qeybta ay CIA-du isticmaasho. Hase yeeshee, falanqeeyayaasha qaar ayaa rumeysan in dalal yar oo aan Ruushka ahayn ay awood iyo danba u leeyihiin inay helaan xog sidaas u xasaasi ah, kaddibna u adeegsadaan weerarro ka dhan ah Mareykanka. Daniel Hoffman, oo horay madax uga soo noqday xarun CIA-da ah isla markaana ka tirsanaa saraakiisha howlgallada qarsoon, ayaa sheegay in aysan la yaab noqon doonin haddii Moscow ay Tehran ka caawisay beegsiga xarumaha CIA-da. “Waxay wadaagaan dan ah inay yareeyaan ama gebi ahaanba meesha ka saaraan saameynta Mareykanka ee deegaannada ay iyagu u arkaan inay yihiin goobahooda saameynta,” ayuu yiri Hoffman. The post Iiraan oo weerartay xarumo ay leedahay CIA-da iyo dal la ogaaday inuu ka caawiyey appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo Ansixiyey Xubnaha Magacaabista Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka
items.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ansixiyey xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, kadib shir uu guddoomiyay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka dalka, Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac. Go’aanka Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa yimid kaddib soo jeedin ay gudbisay Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, iyadoo magacaabista lagu saleeyey Qodobka 145-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee 2026. Xubnaha la ansixiyey ayaa isugu jira laba qareen sare iyo laba xeeldheere sharci, kuwaas oo muddo shan sano ah ka mid noqon doona Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka marka la dhammaystiro habraacyada sharci ee ansixintooda. Xubnaha la magacaabay ayaa kala ah: 1) Maxamed-deeq Macallin Aadan 2) Maryan Sheekh Cismaan 3) Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil 4) Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka waxaa sidoo kale ka mid noqonaya masuuliyiin xilalkooda ku matalaya, sida Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka, Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka, Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Sare ee Dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda, iyo Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Dhanka kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa xilkii ka qaaday Guddoomiyihii Golaha Tacliinta Sare, waxaana xilkaas loo magacaabay Mudane Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa meel mariyey Hindise-sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farshaxanka, heshiis iskaashi oo dhinaca gaadiidka cirka ah oo dhex maraya Soomaaliya iyo Cummaan, iyo Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika oo lagu xoojinayo ka qaybgalka dhallinyarada ee go’aannada siyaasadda iyo horumarinta qaaradda Afrika.

items.title: Iran oo ka hadashay tirada dadkii ku dhintay weeraradii ugu dambeeyey ee Mareykanka
items.description: Tehran ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Iiraan: 53 qof ayaa ku dhintay weerarradii ugu dambeeyay ee Maraykanka. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Iiraan, illaa 53 qof ayaa ku dhintay meertadii ugu dambaysay ee weerarrada Maraykanku ku qaaday Iiraan. Sida ku xusan xogta ay soo saartay wasaaraddu, dhimashadan ayaa dhacday muddadii u dhaxeysay 27-kii Juun illaa subaxnimadii 22-ka July. Agaasimaha Xidhiidhka Dadweynaha iyo Xogta ee Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Iiraan, Hossein Kermanpour, oo xogtan ku baahiyay barta X, ayaa sheegay in 592 qof ay sidoo kale ku dhaawacmeen weerarrada Maraykanka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma aanu caddayn inta ay le’eg tahay tirada dadka dhintay ee millatariga ah iyo inta ay le’eg tahay tirada rayidka ah. Sida ay sheegayaan warbixinnada warbaahinta Maraykanka, ugu yaraan 18 askari oo milatariga Maraykanka ah ayaa ku dhintay tan iyo markii uu bilowday Dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan bishii March ee sannadkii hore. The post Iran oo ka hadashay tirada dadkii ku dhintay weeraradii ugu dambeeyey ee Mareykanka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyay magacaabista 4 xubnood oo Garsoorka Sare
items.description: Muqdisho – Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo uu shir guddoomiyanayay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Mudane Saalax Jaamac , ayaa si aqlabiyad ah u ansixiyay xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, sida uu dhigayo Qodobka 145aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya 2026. Ansixintani waxay timid kadib soo jeedin ay soo bandhigtay Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka. Ansixintani ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo madaxbannaanida garsoorka iyo dhisidda hay’adaha caddaaladda ee dalka. Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka wuxuu ka kooban yahay xubno ka kala socda maxkamadaha sare, dastuurka, xeer-ilaalinta, iyo xuquuqda aadanaha, kuwaas oo wadajir u xaqiijinaya caddaaladda dalka . Xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya waxaa ka mid ah: Maxamed-deeq Macallin Aadan Maryan Sheekh Cismaan Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin Kuwani waxay noqon doonaan kuwa keliya ee magacaabis ku imaanaya Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, halka xubnaha kale ay ku imaanayaan xilkooda, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka, Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka, Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Sare ee Dowlad-goboleedyada, iyo Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha . Sidoo kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa xilkii ka qaaday Guddoomiyihii Golaha Tacliinta Sare, waxayna xilkaas u magacaabeen Mudane Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah dib-u-habeynta hay’adaha waxbarashada sare ee dalka. Intaa waxaa dheer, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa meel-mariyay Hindise-sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farxashanka, iyo Heshiis u dhexeeya Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Cummaan kaasi oo diiradda saaraya iskaashiga Gaadiidka Cirka. Sidoo kale, waxaa la meel-mariyay Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika, kaasi oo awoodda saaraya in dhallinyarada laga qaybgaliyo go’aannada siyaasadda iyo doorka dowladaha ee horumarinta dhallinyarada Afrika. The post Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyay magacaabista 4 xubnood oo Garsoorka Sare first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Rubik’s Cube: The Tiny Puzzle That Shaped Millions of Minds
items.description: There are countless games that have gained worldwide fame, but few can simultaneously serve as entertainment, competition, and mental training. One of them is the Rubik’s Cube – the six-sided puzzle that has captivated children, teenagers, and adults for over forty years. The first time someone holds a Rubik’s Cube, it can appear to be an unsolvable enigma, with colors scattered in disarray and each side seeming far from being aligned. However, those who learn the correct methods discover that this cube follows a structured system with clear rules that can be mastered. This puzzle matters because it is not merely a toy but a powerful tool for enhancing cognitive skills such as memory, focus, problem-solving, and logical thinking. Various studies have shown that repeatedly solving the Rubik’s Cube can help individuals develop these abilities, making it a valuable educational resource. Many people assume that solving the Rubik’s Cube is simply about matching colors. But the reality is far more profound. Each piece of the cube has its own unique position. Corner pieces carry three colors, while edge pieces have two. These pieces move in predictable patterns, meaning that solving is not based on luck but on understanding how each component interacts and shifts. When it comes to speedcubing competitions, the most popular method used is known as CFOP. This system, employed by most professional cubers worldwide, consists of four stages: Cross, F2L (First Two Layers) , OLL (Orientation of Last Layer), and PLL (Permutation of Last Layer). To achieve high speeds, competitors memorize algorithms – specific sequences of moves that rearrange particular pieces without disrupting what has already been solved. Although a speed cube may look identical to a standard Rubik’s Cube from the outside, its internal design is significantly different. Its components are engineered to create low friction, resulting in smooth and rapid rotations. Advanced models even incorporate Maglev (Magnetic Levitation) technology, where magnets replace traditional springs to reduce internal friction and create a quieter, smoother experience. As a result, many schools and educational institutions have adopted the Rubik’s Cube as a tool to strengthen students’ mental skills. It is not just a game; it is a puzzle that combines science, mathematics, patience, and skill. Anyone who learns the proper method discovers that what initially seemed impossible can become a challenge solved through strategy and consistent practice. That is why the Rubik’s Cube remains one of the world’s most beloved puzzles, continuing to inspire millions of people to learn a new skill that enhances their cognitive abilities. items.title: Rubik’s Cube oo malaayiin maskax ku xoojiyay xirfadaha hal-abuurka ah
items.description: Waxaa jira ciyaaro badan oo dunida caan ka noqday, balse kuwo yar ayaa isku mar noqon kara madadaalo, tartan, iyo tababar maskaxeed. Mid ka mid ah waa Rubik’s Cube – halxiraalaha lixda weji leh ee muddo ka badan afartan sano soo jiitay carruur, dhalinyaro iyo dadka waaweyn. Marka ugu horreysa ee qof gacanta ku dhigo Rubik’s Cube , waxa uu u muuqan karaa halxiraale aan xal lahayn, balse dadka barta habka saxda ah waxay ogaadaan in cube-kan uu leeyahay nidaam iyo xeerar cad oo lagu xallin karo. Halxiraalahan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah ma aha oo keliya ciyaar lagu madadaasho, balse waa qalab lagu horumariyo xirfadaha maskaxeed sida xusuusta, feejignaanta, xallinta dhibaatooyinka iyo fikirka nidaamsan. Cilmi-baarisyo kala duwan ayaa muujiyey in ku celcelinta xallinta Rubik’s Cube ay ka caawin karto qofka horumarinta xirfadahan. Dad badan waxay u maleeyaan in xallinta Rubik’s Cube ay tahay in la isku keeno midab kasta, laakiin xaqiiqdu waa mid ka qoto dheer. Qayb kasta oo cube-ka ka mid ahi waxay leedahay meel u gaar ah. Geesaha (corner pieces) waxay wataan saddex midab, halka qaybaha dhexe ( edge pieces ) ay leeyihiin laba midab. Qaybahani mar walba way isla socdaan, taasoo ka dhigaysa in xallintu aysan ku salaysnayn nasiib, balse ay ku salaysan tahay fahamka sida qaybuhu u dhaqaaqaan. Marka laga hadlayo tartamada xawaaraha, habka ugu caansan ee lagu xalliyo cube-ka waxaa loo yaqaan CFOP. Waa nidaam ay isticmaalaan inta badan ciyaartoyda heerka caalami, kuna kala baxa afar marxaladood: Cross, F2L, OLL, iyo PLL. Si loo gaaro xawaare sare, ciyaartoydu waxay bartaan algorithms, oo ah taxane dhaqdhaqaaqyo gaar ah oo lagu beddelo qaybo cayiman iyadoo aan la burburin wixii hore loo xalliyey. Inkasta oo uu dibadda uga ekaan karo Rubik’s Cube-ka caadiga ah, speed cube-ku gudaha ayuu kaga duwan yahay. Qaybihiisa waxaa loo naqshadeeyey si ay u yeeshaan isqabqabsi yar, taasoo ka dhigaysa in leexashadu noqoto mid siman oo degdeg ah. Noocyo casri ah ayaa sidoo kale isticmaala Maglev (Magnetic Levitation), halkaas oo magnets-ku beddelaan ilihii dhaqanka ahaa. Sababtaas awgeed, dugsiyo iyo xarumo waxbarasho oo badan ayaa u adeegsada Rubik’s Cube qalab lagu kobciyo xirfadaha maskaxeed ee ardayda. Rubik’s Cube ma aha oo keliya ciyaar lagu madadaasho. Waa halxiraale isku dara saynis, xisaab, dulqaad iyo xirfad. Qof kasta oo barta habka saxda ah wuxuu ogaanayaa in waxa markii hore u muuqday wax aan suurtagal ahayn uu noqon karo caqabad lagu xallin karo qorshe iyo tababar joogto ah. Taasi waa sababta Rubik’s Cube uu maanta uga mid yahay halxiraalayaasha ugu caansan dunida, isla markaana uu weli u dhiirrigeliyo malaayiin qof inay bartaan xirfad cusub oo kobcisa maskaxdooda. The post Rubik’s Cube oo malaayiin maskax ku xoojiyay xirfadaha hal-abuurka ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Shirka oo uu guddoomiyanayay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku Xigeenka Dalka, Mudane Saalax Jaamac ayaa lagu meel-mariyay xubnaha soo socda oo kala ah laba (2) Qareen Sare iyo laba (2) Xeeldheere Sharci oo uu xilkooduna noqonayo shan (5) sano, ka dib marka ay dhammeystiranto habraaca ansixintooda: 1. Maxamed-deeq Macalllin Aadan 2. Maryan Sheekh Cismaan 3. Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil 4. Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin Sidoo kale bayaanka lagu sheegay in xubnahan ay yihiin kuwa keliya ee magacaabis ku imaanaya, halka xubnaha kale ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka ay ku imaanayaan xilkooda (Hadba Mas’uulka xilkaas haya uu ka mid noqonayo golahan), waxayna xilalkan kala yihiin: 1. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare 2. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka 3. Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka 4. Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Kore ee Dowlad goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda 5. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Dhanka kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa maanta xilkii ka qaaday guddoomiyihii Golaha Tacliinta Sare, waxayna xilkaas u magacaabeen Mudane Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. Ugu dambayn Golaha Wasiirrada XFS,ayaa meel-mariyey Hindise-sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farxashanka iyo Heshiis u dhexeeya Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Cummaan kaasi oo diirrada saaraya iskaashiga Gaadiidka Cirka. Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika kaasi oo awoodda saaraya in dhallinyarada laga qaybgaliyo go’aannada siyaasadda iyo doorka dowladaha ee horumarinta dhallinyarada Afrika. items.title: Gaari Sinotruk oo toddobo qof ku dilay Jigjiga
items.description: Ugu yaraan toddobo qof ayaa ku dhintay shil gaari oo xalay ka dhacay Magaalada Jigjiga ee Xarunta Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida. Laamaha amniga ayaa sheegay in gaariga oo xawaare ku socday uu ka baxay waddada, ka dibna uu jiiray dad fadhiyay goobo ganacsi oo ku yaala magaaladaasi. Sarkaal u hadlay Booliska Jigjiga ayaa sheegay in gaarigan oo noociisu ahaa Sinotruk oo kuwa dhagaxa qaada ah uu halkaasi ku dilay toddobo qof, oo isugu jira shan rag iyo laba dumar ah, halka ilmo yarna uu ku dhaawacmay shilkaasi. Maamulka ayaa magacaabay guddi uu hoggaaminayo Kuxigeenka Duqa Jigjiga oo ka shaqeeya masiibada shilka gaariga, si ay u fududeeyaan qaban-qaabada iyo diyaarinta ee aaska dadkaasi, iyadoo la dhameystirayo caddeymaha sharciga ee loo baahan yahay, oo ay ku jirto xaqiijinta iyo in la helo ehelada dhibaneyaasha. Shilkan ayaa noqonaya midkii labaad ee ugu khasaaraha badnaa ee dhowr cisho gudahood ka dhaca Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida. Axaddii ayay ahayd, markii shil ay ku dhinteen in ka badan 10 qof uu ka dhacay waddada Jigjiga iyo Qabri-bayax, ka dib markii gaari qaad siday uu ku dhacay Mooto Bajaaj.

items.title: Seven Somalis intercepted in Zambia
items.description: Zambian authorities have intercepted seven Somali nationals who were concealed beneath bags of rice in a vehicle bound for Zimbabwe, in the latest crackdown on irregular migration along a key southern African smuggling corridor. The Zambia Revenue Authority (ZRA) stopped a Toyota Probox during a routine enforcement exercise near Kapiri Mposhi town in Central Province, which was heading towards the Chirundu border post linking Zambia and Zimbabwe. A search revealed the seven men, all Somali nationals, hidden in the rear cargo compartment under bags of rice and other goods. The Zambian driver was also detained. ZRA Public Relations Manager Oliver Nzala confirmed the interception, stating that the driver and the seven Somali nationals were handed over to the Department of Immigration for profiling and processing under the Immigration and Deportation Act. He said the authority remains committed to protecting Zambia’s borders and safeguarding national revenue. “During a recent enforcement exercise on the Kapiri Mposhi road leading to Chirundu One-Stop Border Post, our officers intercepted a Toyota Probox which had seven Somali nationals concealed under bags of rice in the boot area,” Nzala said. “The driver and the illegal immigrants were handed over to the Department of Immigration for further action.” Authorities believe the migrants were being smuggled through Zimbabwe en route to South Africa, a common destination for Horn of Africa migrants seeking economic opportunities. Zambia has become a major transit route for irregular migrants from the Horn of Africa traveling south, with smugglers frequently using commercial vehicles to evade border controls. In a separate enforcement operation, the ZRA impounded a vehicle that had remained in Zambia illegally after its temporary import permit expired. The vehicle entered through the Kasumbalesa Border Post in December 2025 but was never re-exported, breaching customs regulations. The revenue authority used both incidents to remind motorists, importers and transport operators to comply with immigration and customs laws, warning that violations could result in enforcement action including seizure of vehicles and goods. The interception comes amid heightened enforcement along Zambia’s border routes as authorities seek to curb smuggling and irregular migration. Similar operations in recent months have netted dozens of Somali and Ethiopian nationals attempting to transit through the country. The seven men are currently in immigration custody awaiting further processing. The post Seven Somalis intercepted in Zambia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia, World Bank reaffirm economic reform partnership
items.description: Somalia and the World Bank have reaffirmed their commitment to deepening cooperation on economic reforms, institutional development and regional integration during high-level talks in Mogadishu on July 22, as the country pushes ahead with efforts to accelerate growth and strengthen public institutions. The discussions, which brought together State Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Ali Mohamed Omar, Permanent Secretary Hamza Adan Haadow and World Bank Country Manager Hideki Matsunaga, come at a pivotal moment for Somalia’s economic trajectory. The meeting reflects continued engagement between Mogadishu and international financial institutions as the country seeks to transition from humanitarian dependence towards long-term development, while addressing persistent challenges such as climate vulnerability, unemployment and limited infrastructure. According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the talks focused on aligning the World Bank’s support with the country’s development priorities, including strengthening government institutions, promoting regional integration and advancing economic diplomacy to attract investment and expand trade opportunities. The ministry thanked the World Bank for its longstanding partnership, highlighting its support for governance reforms, infrastructure development and efforts to improve public services. World Bank Country Manager Hideki Matsunaga acknowledged Somalia’s progress while underscoring the need for sustained reform. “Somalia has made important progress in strengthening macroeconomic management and institutions under difficult conditions,” Matsunaga said. “However, overlapping shocks are slowing growth and putting pressure on jobs and household livelihoods.” The meeting comes as Somalia seeks to consolidate gains made since reaching the completion point of the Heavily Indebted Poor Countries (HIPC) Initiative in December 2023, which resulted in the cancellation of more than $4.5 billion in external debt. Since then, the government has focused on maintaining economic reforms, strengthening domestic revenue collection and creating conditions to attract greater foreign investment. The World Bank has played a central role in supporting Somalia’s recovery through investments in transport, education, health, social protection, urban development and digital transformation. Earlier this year, the bank reiterated its support for the implementation of Somalia’s National Transformation Plan (2025–2029), which aims to drive inclusive economic growth, improve governance and reduce poverty. However, the economic outlook remains fragile. Somalia’s growth moderated to an estimated 3 percent in 2025, down from about 4 percent in 2023–24, as declining foreign aid, drought conditions, and rising living costs weighed on demand. Real GDP growth is projected at 2.8 percent in 2026 and 3.1 percent in 2027, constrained by continued aid reductions, climate variability, global price shocks, and limited productive capacity. Both sides said they remained committed to working together to support Somalia’s long-term development, economic resilience and sustainable growth. Sustained cooperation with development partners is seen as key to preserving reform momentum and unlocking investment needed to support Somalia’s economic recovery and state-building efforts. The post Somalia, World Bank reaffirm economic reform partnership first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
