items.title: African Union questions future of Somalia peace mission as AUSSOM funding crisis deepens
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The future of the African Union’s peace mission in Somalia has entered an increasingly uncertain phase after several member states openly questioned how much longer the continent can sustain the costly deployment, as shrinking international financial support intensifies pressure on the mission’s long-term viability, The East African reported on Tuesday. During an emergency meeting of military advisers to the African Union Peace and Security Council (PSC), Cameroon and Gabon cautioned that every peace support operation ultimately reaches an end, urging Somalia to accelerate the development of self-sustaining security institutions in preparation for the eventual departure of foreign troops. The unusually candid discussions highlight growing concern within the African Union over the sustainability of the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), which is confronting mounting financial and logistical uncertainty as key international funding streams come under increasing strain . For nearly two decades, AU peace operations in Somalia have depended heavily on external financial assistance. The European Union has contributed approximately €2.8 billion ($3.19 billion), while the United States has provided roughly $1.6 billion in bilateral support to troop-contributing countries and an additional $2 billion through the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS). The United Kingdom and several other international partners have also played significant roles in financing the mission. As donor support tightens, debate within the African Union is shifting from whether the mission should continue to how it can remain operational under rapidly changing financial realities. The uncertainty deepened earlier this month after the United States informed the African Union that it would no longer finance UNSOS – the logistical backbone supporting AUSSOM – beyond December 31, 2026. Minutes from the emergency PSC military advisers’ meeting indicate that the decision would leave the mission facing severe logistical constraints unless an alternative support mechanism is established. African Union officials warned that the withdrawal of UNSOS support would present major operational challenges if AUSSOM continues under its current mandate. AUSSOM, comprising 12,591 personnel, officially commenced operations on January 1, 2025, under a five-year mandate extending through the end of 2029, subject to annual authorisation by the United Nations Security Council. During the July 3 emergency meeting, Cameroon and Gabon argued that Somalia must intensify efforts to build capable and self-reliant national security institutions, stressing that African troop-contributing countries cannot indefinitely sustain an open-ended deployment. Their interventions reflect an evolving debate within the African Union, where attention is increasingly turning from extending the mission toward defining a responsible and sustainable end-state. Morocco informed the meeting that it would present its official position after consultations with its national authorities, while Ethiopia reaffirmed its continued support for Somalia. Questions over the mission’s future are also emerging among long-standing troop-contributing countries. Uganda, which has maintained the largest contingent since the AU first deployed forces to Somalia in 2007, has recently signalled that its military presence cannot continue indefinitely. Military advisers examined three broad scenarios for the mission’s future: a phased withdrawal of AU forces; maintaining the current deployment with bilateral partners replacing UNSOS logistical support; or establishing a smaller regional force financed through bilateral or hybrid funding arrangements. Diplomatic sources familiar with the discussions said the latter two options generated limited support because both would still require troop-contributing countries to finance an expensive military deployment at a time when external funding continues to decline. As a result, a carefully managed withdrawal – once regarded as the least attractive option – is increasingly viewed by many member states as the most realistic long-term outcome. Financial realities continue to reinforce that assessment. For the 2025/26 financial year, AUSSOM required approximately $190 million for troop reimbursements alone. However, confirmed pledges currently total only $120 million, leaving a significant financing gap. According to the African Union’s Peace Support Operations Division (PSOD), the only assured funding presently available remains the $502 million UNSOS logistics package. Officials also noted that the United States’ 25 percent contribution had already been withdrawn in October 2025 to address earlier funding shortfalls. Speaking during a recent town hall meeting in Mogadishu, United Nations Under-Secretary-General for Operational Support Atul Khare acknowledged an additional challenge, noting that the UN General Assembly-approved $481 million budget for UNSOS during the current financial year still requires full financing. The situation has become even more uncertain after Washington indicated it would oppose efforts within the United Nations Security Council to continue financing UNSOS beyond AUSSOM’s current authorisation, which expires at the end of 2026. Without an alternative donor prepared to bridge the funding gap, uncertainty surrounding the mission’s future continues to deepen. Mohamed Daud Ismail, senior research assistant with the conflict monitoring project ACLED, warned that without immediate alternative international financing, AUSSOM could face operational collapse as it enters 2027. He said such a scenario would carry wider implications for Somalia, where national security forces remain overstretched and lack the logistical capacity to independently sustain complex military operations across the country. UNSOS currently provides AUSSOM with fuel, food supplies, aviation support, medical and casualty evacuation services, strategic air mobility, and reimbursement for contingent-owned equipment lost or damaged during mission operations. African Union officials further cautioned that maintaining even a reduced military presence beyond the current arrangements would require hundreds of millions of dollars in additional logistical financing – resources that many member states acknowledge are beyond the organisation’s present financial capacity without substantial new donor commitments. The evolving debate marks a significant shift from previous years, when international discussions focused primarily on extending support for Somalia’s security transition. Increasingly, attention is turning toward how the mission can be responsibly concluded while avoiding a security vacuum and making clear that Somalia cannot depend indefinitely on African troops and international donors to guarantee its national security. The Peace Support Operations Division also warned that the withdrawal of UNSOS support could expose AUSSOM to heightened operational risks, including greater vulnerability of strategic towns and key supply corridors, diminished medical evacuation capability, and expanded opportunities for Al-Shabaab to exploit emerging operational gaps. items.fullContent: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The future of the African Union’s peace mission in Somalia has entered an increasingly uncertain phase after several member states openly questioned how much longer the continent can sustain the costly deployment, as shrinking international financial support intensifies pressure on the mission’s long-term viability, The East African reported on Tuesday. During an emergency meeting of military advisers to the African Union Peace and Security Council (PSC), Cameroon and Gabon cautioned that every peace support operation ultimately reaches an end, urging Somalia to accelerate the development of self-sustaining security institutions in preparation for the eventual departure of foreign troops. The unusually candid discussions highlight growing concern within the African Union over the sustainability of the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), which is confronting mounting financial and logistical uncertainty as key international funding streams come under increasing strain . For nearly two decades, AU peace operations in Somalia have depended heavily on external financial assistance. The European Union has contributed approximately €2.8 billion ($3.19 billion), while the United States has provided roughly $1.6 billion in bilateral support to troop-contributing countries and an additional $2 billion through the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS). The United Kingdom and several other international partners have also played significant roles in financing the mission. As donor support tightens, debate within the African Union is shifting from whether the mission should continue to how it can remain operational under rapidly changing financial realities. The uncertainty deepened earlier this month after the United States informed the African Union that it would no longer finance UNSOS – the logistical backbone supporting AUSSOM – beyond December 31, 2026. Minutes from the emergency PSC military advisers’ meeting indicate that the decision would leave the mission facing severe logistical constraints unless an alternative support mechanism is established. African Union officials warned that the withdrawal of UNSOS support would present major operational challenges if AUSSOM continues under its current mandate. AUSSOM, comprising 12,591 personnel, officially commenced operations on January 1, 2025, under a five-year mandate extending through the end of 2029, subject to annual authorisation by the United Nations Security Council. During the July 3 emergency meeting, Cameroon and Gabon argued that Somalia must intensify efforts to build capable and self-reliant national security institutions, stressing that African troop-contributing countries cannot indefinitely sustain an open-ended deployment. Their interventions reflect an evolving debate within the African Union, where attention is increasingly turning from extending the mission toward defining a responsible and sustainable end-state. Morocco informed the meeting that it would present its official position after consultations with its national authorities, while Ethiopia reaffirmed its continued support for Somalia. Questions over the mission’s future are also emerging among long-standing troop-contributing countries. Uganda, which has maintained the largest contingent since the AU first deployed forces to Somalia in 2007, has recently signalled that its military presence cannot continue indefinitely. Military advisers examined three broad scenarios for the mission’s future: a phased withdrawal of AU forces; maintaining the current deployment with bilateral partners replacing UNSOS logistical support; or establishing a smaller regional force financed through bilateral or hybrid funding arrangements. Diplomatic sources familiar with the discussions said the latter two options generated limited support because both would still require troop-contributing countries to finance an expensive military deployment at a time when external funding continues to decline. As a result, a carefully managed withdrawal – once regarded as the least attractive option – is increasingly viewed by many member states as the most realistic long-term outcome. Financial realities continue to reinforce that assessment. For the 2025/26 financial year, AUSSOM required approximately $190 million for troop reimbursements alone. However, confirmed pledges currently total only $120 million, leaving a significant financing gap. According to the African Union’s Peace Support Operations Division (PSOD), the only assured funding presently available remains the $502 million UNSOS logistics package. Officials also noted that the United States’ 25 percent contribution had already been withdrawn in October 2025 to address earlier funding shortfalls. Speaking during a recent town hall meeting in Mogadishu, United Nations Under-Secretary-General for Operational Support Atul Khare acknowledged an additional challenge, noting that the UN General Assembly-approved $481 million budget for UNSOS during the current financial year still requires full financing. The situation has become even more uncertain after Washington indicated it would oppose efforts within the United Nations Security Council to continue financing UNSOS beyond AUSSOM’s current authorisation, which expires at the end of 2026. Without an alternative donor prepared to bridge the funding gap, uncertainty surrounding the mission’s future continues to deepen. Mohamed Daud Ismail, senior research assistant with the conflict monitoring project ACLED, warned that without immediate alternative international financing, AUSSOM could face operational collapse as it enters 2027. He said such a scenario would carry wider implications for Somalia, where national security forces remain overstretched and lack the logistical capacity to independently sustain complex military operations across the country. UNSOS currently provides AUSSOM with fuel, food supplies, aviation support, medical and casualty evacuation services, strategic air mobility, and reimbursement for contingent-owned equipment lost or damaged during mission operations. African Union officials further cautioned that maintaining even a reduced military presence beyond the current arrangements would require hundreds of millions of dollars in additional logistical financing – resources that many member states acknowledge are beyond the organisation’s present financial capacity without substantial new donor commitments. The evolving debate marks a significant shift from previous years, when international discussions focused primarily on extending support for Somalia’s security transition. Increasingly, attention is turning toward how the mission can be responsibly concluded while avoiding a security vacuum and making clear that Somalia cannot depend indefinitely on African troops and international donors to guarantee its national security. The Peace Support Operations Division also warned that the withdrawal of UNSOS support could expose AUSSOM to heightened operational risks, including greater vulnerability of strategic towns and key supply corridors, diminished medical evacuation capability, and expanded opportunities for Al-Shabaab to exploit emerging operational gaps. items.title: Puntland, Somali Regional State Strengthen Security Cooperation with Suspect Extradition
items.description: Galdogob (WDN) – Puntland and Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State (DDS) marked another milestone in cross-border security cooperation on Tuesday after Puntland Police formally handed over a murder suspect to security authorities from the Somali Regional State, underscoring the growing partnership between the two neighboring administrations in combating cross-border crime. The suspect, Xiddig Siciid Sheekh Xirsi, is accused of involvement in the killing of Abdi Mahmoud Wayrah, an incident that occurred on October 8, 2018. The extradition ceremony took place in the border town of Galdogob and was led by the Commander of Puntland Police in Mudug Region, Colonel Mahmoud Muse Bille (Fardafuul). Receiving the suspect on behalf of Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State was Lieutenant Colonel Abdullahi Ibrahim Mahmoud, Commander of the Doolo Regional Police Command. Following the handover, the two commanders addressed a joint press conference attended by senior police officials, including the Acting Commander of the Galdogob Police Station. Both officials described the transfer as a practical demonstration of the increasingly close security partnership between Puntland and the Somali Regional State, emphasizing their shared commitment to ensuring that criminal suspects cannot evade justice by crossing international borders. They stressed the importance of maintaining continuous cooperation through intelligence sharing, coordinated law enforcement operations, and the mutual extradition of suspects wanted by either side. Officials noted that such collaboration is essential not only for bringing fugitives to justice but also for strengthening regional security and combating organized crime, human trafficking, arms smuggling, and other cross-border criminal activities that affect communities on both sides of the frontier. The successful extradition is being viewed as another encouraging sign of the growing trust between Puntland and Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State, whose security agencies have increasingly worked together to address common threats along their shared border. Security analysts say stronger institutional cooperation between neighboring administrations is critical to improving public safety, enhancing regional stability, and denying criminal networks safe havens across borders. The latest handover is expected to reinforce that partnership and sends a clear message that fugitives will find it increasingly difficult to escape justice by fleeing across the Puntland–Ethiopian border. Nevertheless, many have warned that security cooperation must be narrowly confined to combating criminal activities and should never be used as a tool to target political opponents. Such concerns are reinforced by allegations that, in recent years, Puntland authorities have transferred Ethiopian opposition members to Ethiopian authorities, fueling fears that cross-border security arrangements could be exploited for political purposes rather than legitimate law enforcement. items.title: Guddoomiyihii Hore ee Awdiinle iyo 150 Maleeshiyaad ah oo Isku Soo Dhiibay Ciidamada Qaranka
items.description: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay in Guddoomiyihii hore ee deegaanka Awdiinle ee Gobolka Baay, Ibraahim Kalaay, iyo ku dhowaad 150 maleeshiyaad ah ay maanta waqtiyo kala duwan isku soo dhiibeen Ciidamada Qaranka Soomaaliyeed ee ka hawlgala Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Sida ay Wasaaraddu sheegtay, kooxdaan ayaa si cad uga soo goostay maleeshiyaadkii uu hoggaaminayay Cabdicasiis Laftagareen, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay inay maalmihii u dambeeyay falal amni-darro ah ka wadeen deegaannada Gobolka Baay. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa tilmaamay in tallaabadan ay ka tarjumeyso kalsoonida sii kordheysa ee shacabka iyo kooxihii hubeysnaa ay ku qabaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Ciidamada Qaranka, kuwaas oo wada dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida dalka. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda ayaa sheegay in ay sii wadi doonaan dadaallada lagu dhiirrigelinayo cid kasta oo hubeysan inay ka tanaasusho colaadda, isla markaana ku biirto geeddi-socodka nabadda iyo dib u heshiisiinta.

items.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu weerari doono xarumaha nukliyeerka Iran + Jawaabta Tehran
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa ku hanjabay in Washington ay dhawaan beegsan doonto xarumaha nukliyeerka Iran, gaar ahaan xarun dhulka hoostiisa ku taalla oo ku dhow Natanz. Hanjabaadan ayaa imaneysa xilli Mareykanka uu habeenkii 11-aad oo xiriir ah duqeymo ka fuliyay gudaha Iran, iyadoo Tehran ay uga digtay Washington in ay beegsato xarumaheeda nukliyeerka. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in duqeymihii ugu dambeeyay ay qeyb ka ahaayeen howl-gallo loogu talagalay “in lagu sii wiiqo awoodda Iran ee ay ku halis gelin karto maraakiibta ganacsiga” ee mara marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee Gacanka Hormuz. Warbaahinta dowladda Iran ayaa sheegtay in nidaamyada difaaca cirka laga hawl-geliyay caasimadda Tehran, halka qaraxyo laga soo sheegay magaalada waqooyi-galbeed ku taalla ee Tabriz, dekedaha koonfur-bari ee Chabahar iyo Konarak iyo magaalada koonfureed ee Bushehr oo ay ku taallo warshadda keliya ee tamarta nukliyeerka ee Iran. Iran oo horay uga jawaabtay weerarrada Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa Bariga Dhexe ayaa sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin aargoosi ah kadib hanjabaadda madaxweyne Trump. Xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dal ayaa dib u soo cusboonaatay toddobaadkii hore kadib markii ay burbureen xabbad-joojin hore loo gaaray bishii April, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku hayaan gacan-ku-haynta marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Gacanka Hormuz. CENTCOM ayaa sheegay in ciidamadeeda ay bartilmaameedsadeen xarumaha hawl-gallada milatari ee Iran, awoodaha badda, hangarrada diyaaradaha, goobaha lagu kaydiyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) iyo kaabeyaasha saadka milatari. Taliska Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale Iran ku eedeeyay inay saddexdii bilood ee lasoo dhaafay weerarro ku qaaday in ka badan 30 markab ganacsi oo marayay Gacanka Hormuz. “Dhaq-dhaqaaqyadan aan loo meel dayin waxay halis geliyeen boqolaal badmaaxayaal aan waxba galabsan, waxayna wiiqeen xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta,” ayuu yiri CENTCOM, isagoo intaas ku daray in marin-biyoodku uu weli “u furan yahay isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga”. Dhanka kale, ciidamada Kuwait ayaa sheegay aroornimadii Arbacada inay hawl-geliyeen nidaamyada difaaca cirka kadib markii ay ka hortageen weerarro diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo laga soo qaaday Iran. Bahrain iyo Jordan ayaa iyaguna sheegay inay qabteen weerarro kale oo isugu jiray gantaallo iyo drones. Qiimaha shidaalka caalamka ayaa sare u kacay kadib sii xoogeysiga xiisadda, iyadoo foostada saliidda ay gaartay $94 Arbacadii. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa sheegay in Washington ay weli diyaar u tahay in ay wada-hadal diblomaasiyadeed la yeelato Tehran, balse uu sheegay in uusan aaminsanayn in Iran ay dhab ka tahay wadaxaajoodyada. items.title: Somalia Condemns Houthi Threats Against Saudi Arabia
items.description: MOGADISHU— The Federal Government of Somalia has strongly condemned threats made by Yemen’s Houthi group against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, describing them as a serious danger to regional peace, security and stability. In an official statement issued on Wednesday, 22 July 2026, Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation said the government was closely monitoring the situation and expressed deep concern over the threats attributed to the group. The ministry stressed that the Houthis’ actions pose a direct threat to the security of vital maritime routes, freedom of navigation and the safety of international trade passing through the Red Sea. Somalia reaffirmed its support for regional security and stability and called for respect for international law and the protection of maritime navigation and global commercial activity. The post Somalia Condemns Houthi Threats Against Saudi Arabia appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Shirkii golaha wasiirada ee Somaliland iyo wax yaabahii lagaga hadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 69-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-gudoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), isla markaana uu wehelinayey Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa waxa lagaga wada hadlay qodobbada soo socda: 𝟏. 𝐃𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐀𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐤𝐚 𝐌𝐚𝐱𝐣𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa dood qoto dheer ka yeeshay Muhiimadda Istaraatiijiga ah ee Xeerka Maxjarrada Dalka, iyaga oo adkeeyey doorka uu ku leeyahay ilaalinta Caafimaadka iyo Fayo-qabka Xoolaha, tayaynta nidaamka dhoofka xoolaha, u hoggaansanaanta Halbeegyada Caafimaadka ee Caalamiga ah, iyo xoojinta sumcadda xoolaha Somaliland ee suuqyada caalamka. Goluhu waxa uu xusay in Xeerkani uu laf-dhabar u yahay kobcinta dhaqaalaha Qaranka iyo joogtaynta kalsoonida ay suuqyada caalamku ay ku qabaan xoolaha Somaliland. Dood dheer kaddib, Golaha Wasiirradu waxa ay cod gacan-taag ah ku ansixiyeen Xeerka Maxjarrada Dalka, iyada oo aanay jirin cid diidday ama ka aamustay. 𝟐. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka, isaga oo sheegay in amniga dalku uu yahay mid sugan, isla markaana aanay jirin wax qalalaase ama xasillooni darro ah oo ka jirta gobollada dalka. Waxa uu xusay in Hay’adaha Amnigu sii wadaan dedaallada lagu ilaalinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida Qaranka JSL. 𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐅𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐒𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐪𝐨𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐆𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐢𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐐𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Horumarinta Jidadka JSL, Mudane Cismaan Ibraahim Nuur (Afgaab) ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey habraacyada cusub ee ay Wasaarradiisu dejisay ee lagu nidaaminayo adeegsiga Summadda Aqoonsiga Gaadiidka Dawladda (GT), isaga oo xusay in aan la oggolayn in Gaadiidka laga furo Summadda Aqoonsiga (plate number) uu baabuur kasta gaarka u leeyahay, laguna xidho Sumadda ay leeyihiin Gaadiidka Shicibku (private plate number). Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sheegay in Habraacyadan ujeeddadoodu tahay in la xoojiyo amniga iyo bedqabka Gaadiidka Dawladda, korna loo qaado hufnaanta adeegsiga Gaadiidka Dawladda, si loo xaqiijiyo in Gaadiidka Dawladda si masuuliyad leh loogu adeegsado gudashada waajibaadka Qaranka, maadaama uu yahay hanti Qaran oo u baahan ilaalin iyo maamul sugan. 𝟒. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu xusay in Gobolka Sool uu yahay gobol ka mid ah Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, bulshada reer Soolna ay yihiin walaalo reer Somaliland ah, isaga oo ku baaqay in lagu soo dhaweeyo gacmo furan, tabasho kasta oo jirtana lagu xalliyo wada hadal, is-afgarad, walaaltinimo iyo isku duubni Qaran.

items.title: Restoring Constitutional Legitimacy: Three Realistic Options for Somalia’s 2026 Elections
items.description: By Ogaal Party This non-paper is submitted as a constructive contribution to the ongoing national dialogue on Somalia’s 2026 elections. Its purpose is to help identify the most practical path to restoring constitutional legitimacy. Introduction Somalia has reached another critical moment. The constitutional mandates of the federal institutions have expired, agreement on the electoral framework remains elusive, and political tensions have already led to armed confrontation. At the same time, the country continues to face insecurity, humanitarian challenges, economic hardship, and persistent threats to its sovereignty. In these circumstances, Somalia needs compromise rather than political brinkmanship. The priority should be to restore constitutional legitimacy through an electoral process that is realistic, peaceful, and broadly accepted. The ongoing negotiations provide an important opportunity to reach agreement. But experience shows that negotiations rarely end exactly where they begin. Responsible leadership therefore requires considering not only preferred outcomes, but also practical alternatives if consensus proves difficult. For that reason, we have presented three realistic constitutional options. Each offers a peaceful path to restoring constitutional legitimacy and establishing a legitimate Parliament. The Ogaal Party is prepared to compete under any peaceful, constitutional, and nationally agreed electoral framework. Our objective is not to promote one proposal over another, but to help Somalia restore legitimate institutions and continue its democratic transition. The Ogaal Party is a non-violent political movement. We believe politics exists to serve the people, leadership is a public trust, and better leadership can change Somalia. These principles require us to place the national interest above political advantage and practical solutions above political rhetoric. Every proposal should answer three simple questions: * Can it be implemented within the available time? * Will it command broad public and political confidence? * Will it help Somalia continue its democratic transition? Viewed through that lens, Somalia today has three realistic constitutional options. items.title: Ciidamo taabacsanaa Lafta-gareen oo isa soo dhiibay maanta
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Baay ayaa sheegaya in qaar kamid ah ciidamada daacadda u ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ay maanta soo goosteen, isla markaana ay isku soo dhiibeen ciidamada dowladda ee ku sugan Baydhaba. Ciidamadan oo wata gaadiidka dagaalka ayaa lagu soo dhaweeyay magaalada, waxaana hoggaaminayo sarkaal kamid ah saaxiibadii Lafta-gareen. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in ragga soo goostay uu ku jiro gudoomiyihii hore ee deegaanka Awdiinle Ibraahim Kalaay, kaas oo kamid ahaa mas’uuliyiinta muddooyinkan ku sugnaa duleedka Baydhaba oo fadhi u ah ciidanka Lafta-gareen. Muuqaallo lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayo ciidamada oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeynayo bartamaha magaalada, waxaana u mahad-celiyeen saraakiisha ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed. Arrintan ayaa loo arkaa mid saameyn ku yeelan karta dhaq-dhaqaaqa ay weli kooxda Lafta-gareen ka wado deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan aagga magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, halkaas oo ay saldhigyo ku leeyihiin. Ciidamadan ayaa marar kala duwan soo weeraray magaalada, waxaase ka hortegay ciidamada ammaanka oo ku guuleystay inay si nabad u dhacdo doorashada, kadibna loo dhiso dhammaan hay’adaha kale ee maamulka. Koonfur Galbeed ayaa muddooyinkan wajaheysay xaalado amni oo ka dhashay kadib tallaabadii dowladda dhexe ee meesha looga saaray maamulkii hore. The post Ciidamo taabacsanaa Lafta-gareen oo isa soo dhiibay maanta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

United States-Republic of Korea (ROK)-Japan Trilateral Foreign Ministers’ Meeting
items.description: United States-Republic of Korea (ROK)-Japan Trilateral Foreign Ministers’ Meeting Office of the Spokesperson July 22, 2026 The below is attributable to Spokesperson Tommy Pigott: Secretary of State Marco Rubio met today with ROK Foreign Minister Cho Hyun and Japanese Foreign Minister Motegi Toshimitsu on the margins of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers Meetings in Manila. The Secretary and his counterparts emphasized the importance of working with ASEAN on issues of mutual interest, including strengthening defense cooperation and maritime security, advancing energy security, combatting cyber threats, and promoting peace and stability across Southeast Asia and the broader Indo-Pacific. The Secretary and Foreign Ministers committed to intensifying joint efforts targeting transnational criminal organizations, including networks operating scam centers that defraud and endanger citizens across the region. They committed to expanding trilateral discussions on Arctic issues, recognizing the region’s growing strategic importance. They also reaffirmed commitments to defense cooperation, maritime security, and upholding freedom of navigation, and pledged continued trilateral consultations at all levels. The Secretary and Foreign Ministers reaffirmed the importance of maintaining a unified approach toward the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK), underscoring their shared commitment to the complete denuclearization of the DPRK and continued coordination to counter DPRK cyber threats and illicit activity as well as to the immediate resolution of the abductions issue. They also emphasized the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. The Secretary and Foreign Ministers noted with concern China’s lack of sufficient notification of their recent intercontinental ballistic missile launch into the Pacific Ocean. The Secretary and Foreign Ministers discussed next steps to implement the trilateral Memorandum of Cooperation on Small Modular Reactor Deployments in Other Countries signed in Ankara and to start deployment in the Indo-Pacific to advance energy diversification and technology cooperation. They also underscored the importance of economic security, reaffirmed shared opposition to economic coercion and the weaponization of supply chains, and committed to derisking and diversifying critical supply chains and to further trusted technology cooperation.

items.title: Maxay Soomaaliya ka tiri hanjabaadda Xuutiyiinta ee Sacuudiga?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta si kulul uga hadashay hanjabaadda ay Xuutiyiinta u direen Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya oo horay weerarro uga fulisay gudaha dalka Yemen. Bayaan kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa lagu cambaareeyay tallaabooyinka Xuutiyiinta ay ku qaadeen xiritaanka Baabul-Mandab iyo hanjabaadda ay u jeediyeen dowladda Sacuudiga. Sidoo kale, Soomaaliya ayaa luqad adag ku diiday falalka wax u dhimaya amniga marin biyoodka, xorriyadda isu socodka maraakiibta, iyo badqabka ganacsiga caalamiga ah. “Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si adag u cambaareyneysaa hanjabaadaha ay kooxda Xuuthiyiintu u jeediyeen Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, iyo sidoo kale falalka wax u dhimaya amniga marin biyoodka, xorriyadda isu socodka maraakiibta, iyo badqabka ganacsiga caalamiga ah,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa dhanka kale shaaca ka qaaday in ay ka go’aan tahay ilaalinta madaxbanaanida dowladaha iyo sharciga caalamiga ah oo ah arrin muhiim ah oo mudan in la ixtiraamo. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay mar kale carabka ku adkeeneysaa sida ay uga go’an tahay ilaalinta madaxbannaanida, amniga, iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dowladaha, iyo ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah,” ayaa lasii raaciyay Bayaanka. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqday in xallinta khilaafaadka loo maro wada-hadal iyo waddooyin diblomaasiyadeed, halkii laga adeegsan lahaa hanjabaado iyo falal hubeysan. Bayaanka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay isa soo tarayaan walaacyada la xiriira amniga marin-biyoodka Baabul-Mandab iyo saameynta ay colaadaha ka socda Bariga Dhexe ku yeelan karaan ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo xasilloonida gobolka. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Cambaareysay Hanjabaadaha Xuutiyiinta ee ka dhanka ah Sacuudi Carabiya
items.description: Muqdisho, 22 Luulyo 2026 – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaareysay hanjabaadaha ay kooxda Xuutiyiintu u jeedisay Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo sidoo kale walaac ka muujisay falalka khatar gelinaya amniga maraakiibta, xorriyadda isu-socodka badda, iyo badqabka ganacsiga caalamiga ah. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay si buuxda uga go’an tahay ilaalinta madaxbannaanida, amniga, iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka, isla markaana ay ixtiraamayso sharciga caalamiga ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku celisay mowqifkeeda ah in la dhowro nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka, iyadoo cambaareysay tallaabo kasta oo halis gelin karta marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah iyo ganacsiga adduunka.

items.title: Cunno xumo ka dhalatay ayax burburiyay dalag u beernaa beeraleyda Mudug
items.description: ERGO) – In ka badan 80 beeraley ah ayaa xaalado adag oo dhanka nolosha ah ku wajahaya deegaanka Xero-dhagaxley ee gobolka Mudug tan iyo bishii April. Ayax ka cunay dalagyo ay goosasho ku dawaa iyo waraab yari isku raacay ayaa meesha ka saaray tacabkoodii. Waxay dabooli la’yihiin baahiyahooda aas-aasiga ah, iyadoo daymo loo haysto. Ceelkii ay ka cabi jireen ayaa cilladoobay 4 bil ka hor, mana helin dayac-tir. Waxay iibsan la’yihiin biyo qaali ah oo laga keeno mid gaar ah oo tuulada u jira qiyaasti 10 km. Cabdimaciin Axmed Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Ayaxu ka baabi’iyay yaanyo, basal, karooto, barbarooni, liin, saytuun iyo noocyo kale oo khudaar ah. Wuxuu xusay in ay ka gashay $1,300 oo inta badan uu amaahday. “Tacab iska daaye geedihii ayaa qallalay. Ayaxa waa mid geedi ah oo ilmo meesha uga tagay iyo mid dhirta isaga jira oo waxkasta ku dagaya. Baaga-muudo ayaan u noqnonay.” Deegaanka Xero-dhagaxley oo dhaca bariga fog ee gobolka Mudug dadka ku nool waxay ku tiirsan yihiin wax soo saarka. Caqabadahaan isku biirsaday ayaa saamayn weyn ku yeeshay noloshooda. Xaaladan ka hor waxay dalagyadooda u iib gayn jireen magaalooyinka Hobyo, Wisil iyo meelo kale. Cabdimaciin ayaa sheegay in dalagyadii ay dhamaadkii Fabraayo galiyeen beerahooda aysan waxba uga badbaadin. Dadkaan oo u badan danyar wuxuu sheegay in aysan u sahlanayn fursad kale oo ay noloshooda ku maareeyaan. Ninkan ayaa tilmaamay in 3 bil ee ugu danbaysay ay ku adkaatay in uu qoyskiisa u helo cunno ku filan. Hal mar ayay dabka ku shitaan kiilooyin raashin ah oo dayn ay uga soo qaataan dukaamo tuulada ku yaalla oo mararka qaar looga diido. “Wax badan ayaa isbeddelay nolosha, waa garan kartaa qoyska biyo, cunno, daawo iyo waxbarasho ayuu u baahan yahay. Casho kali ah ayaa la helaa. Maalinba qof ayaa dayn laga soo qaadaa.” Cabdimaciin ayaa sheegay in beertiisa oo 2 hektar ah uu ka heli jiray bishii ugu yaraan $700. Sanadkii 2023 ayuu ku billaabay $500 oo ahayd dayn uu dib ka guday. Tacbashada ayuu doortay, markii saamaynta abaarta ay ku dhaafeen labo boqol oo neef oo ari iyo geel isugu jira oo miyig ay ku dhaqanayeen. Qoyskiis oo 10 qof ah iyo shan neef oo ari ah oo u joogta ayuu u iibin la’yahay biyo halkii fuusto la siiyo $5. Dadka awooda ayuu sheegay in ay hal caag ka soo baryaan maalintii, kaas oo aan ku filnayn. Waxaa ka waxbarasho beelay labo carruurtiisa ah oo dugsi Qur’aan iyo iskuul hoose deegaanka uga dhiganayay. Labo kale oo dugsi sare ku jira wuxuu u geeyay walalkiis Gaalkacyo degan oo bishii ka bixiya min $10, maaddaama uusan isagu u awoodin. Dhanka kale Xaafid Cabdi Siyaad oo dadkaaan ka mid ah ayaa sheegay in nacfi beelka ku dhacay beertiisa oo 1.5 ah ay dhan dhaqaale iyo nololeed ka saamaysay qoyskiisa oo 7 qof ah. Dalagyo isugu jiray raashin iyo khudaar dhowr nooc ah oo bishii labaad uu abuurtay ayuusan waxba ka faa’iidin. Waxaa kaga baxday $1,200 oo $800 ay dayn ahayd, taas oo ku sii kordhisay culaysyada haysta. Xaaladahan isku biirsaday dartood wuxuu qoyskiisa u la’yahay cunno joogto ah iyo baahiyahooda kale ee nolosha. “Dhaqaalaha xagiisa ayay iga saamaysay oo nolol-maalmeedka reerka ayaa iigu daran. Meeshii aan wax ka helaynay waa joogsatay, baahiyah waa badan yihiin abaarta ayaa biyo la’aan na dhigtay.” Xaafid ayaa sheegay in qoyskiisa ay ku tiirsan yihiin kaalmo aan joogto ahayn oo marmar ay siiyaan ehelkooda degan Gaalkacyo iyo Hobyo oo ay u dan sheegtaan. Waxay ugu badnaan ka helaan hal ama labo dollar oo hal mar ay dabka ku shitaan, maaddaama aysan doorasho kale haysan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dukaamo deegaanka ku yaalla oo macaamiil uu ka ahaa ay buugiisa xireen, markii ay ku yeeshaan in ka badan $300 oo uusan awoodin bixinteeda. Waxaa intaas u dheer qarashkii uu beerta galiyay oo dadkii ku lahaa ay ka doonayaan. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in tacabka meesha ka baxay uu ahaa isha ugu muhiimsan ee uu qoyskiisa ku maarayn jiray. Waxay ku tiirsanaayeen in ka badan 8 sano, mana jirto meel kale oo dhaqaale uu ka soo galo. Wuxuu xusay in ay beertiisa isugu darsameen ayax, cayayaan kale iyo biyo la’aanta. “Wuu tiro badan yahay kama jafi kartid habeen iyo maalin isku si waaye. Biyo yarida darteeda geedo badan ayaa ku dhintay. Daawada cayayaanka iyo abuurna ma haysano.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in aysan ood iyo silig midna lahayn oo xooluhu ay dhex marayaan, taas oo sababaysa in xitaa haddii uu biyo helo uusan waxba beeran karin illaa si guud loo dayac-tiro. Wuxu shaqooyin xamaal ah ka raadiyaa meelaha dhagax laga guro. Toddobaadka dhan $3 ayuu ka helaa ama wuu soo waayaa. Wuxuu xusay in beerta ka xumaatay ay ahayd waxa kali ah ee uu yaqaanay ayna isku maaraynayeen muddo dheer. Intii ay caqabadan dhaqaale haysay waxaa waxbarashada ka haray saddex carruur ah oo dhiganayay iskuul hoose. sheegay inuusan afar bil bixin min $10 oo laga qaadi jiray, taas oo isku gaartay $160. Dhamaadkii bishii May ayaa laga soo eryay. “Bishii markii ay dhamaato oo lacagta keen la I dhaho anna aanan waxba hayn oo hala I sugu aan iri. Dhowr bil markii ay isku gaartay waxna aan keeni waayay waa la soo diray oo guriga ha kuu joogaan ayaa la I dhahay.” Guddoomiye ku xigeenka iskaashatada beeraleyda Xero-dhagaxley Liibaan Siciid Siyaad ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in wax-soosaarka beeraha oo hoos u dhacay uu ku sababay nolol xumo iyo dhaqaale burbur. Dadkaan oo horay u ahaa danyar ayuu xusay in ay xaaladu ku adag tahay. “Waa dareemi kartaa dad muruq-maal ah oo subaxdii beerahooda falan jiray wixii ay ka soo gurtaana suuqa gaysan jiray oo aysan waxba u soo go’in. Dhibaato, burbur iyo barakac ayaa ka dhashay. Masaaariiftii qoysku heli jiray ma jirto hadda, taasna waa dhibaato weyn.” Beeraleyda deegaanka Xero-dhagaxley waxay wajahayaan xaalado isbiirsaday oo ay ku adag tahay ka soo kabashadoodu. Culaysyadaan ayaa ku sababay in ay ka niyad jabaan tacabka oo sanooyin badan ay ku soo jireen saldhigna u ahaa noloshooda. items.title: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Soomaaliya iyo Safiirka Koonfurta Kuuriya oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga amniga
items.description: Muqdisho – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Jeneraal Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), ayaa maanta xarunta Wasaaradda kulan kula yeeshay Safiirka Dowladda Koonfurta Kuuriya ee Soomaaliya, Kang Hyung-shik. Kulanka waxaa Wasiirka ku weheliyay Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha, Jeneraal Sulub Axmed Firin, iyo Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda, Maxamed Shire. Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac waxay diiradda saareen xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Koonfurta Kuuriya ee dhinacyada amniga badaha, horumarinta hay’adaha amniga, la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda, iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Ciidanka Ilaalada Xeebaha iyo Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga wada hadlay sidii loo ballaarin lahaa tababarrada, is-dhaafsiga khibradaha iyo taageerada farsamo ee lagu horumarinayo awoodda hay’adaha amniga. Wasiir Fartaag ayaa Dowladda Koonfurta Kuuriya uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isagoo xusay in sii xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal ay muhiim u tahay horumarinta amniga, nabadda iyo xasilloonida dalka.

items.title: Turkey extends Somalia military deployment for 2 years
items.description: Turkey’s parliament late Tuesday approved a presidential motion extending the deployment of Turkish troops in Somalia for two years from July 27. Turkey says it is providing support for Somalia’s fight against terrorism, piracy, illegal fishing, smuggling and other security threats. The motion allows President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan to determine the size, scope, timing and rules of the deployment. Turkish Armed Forces units may serve in areas jointly selected by the two countries, including Somalia’s maritime jurisdiction zones, and may cooperate with third countries and international organizations, according to the text published by the Turkish Parliament . The measure extends an authorization granted by parliament in July 2024 and will remain in effect until July 27, 2028. The Turkish government said Somalia requested military assistance under a defense and economic cooperation agreement between the two countries. Turkey has been expanding its role in Somalia since 2011 through diplomatic, development and security programs. Ankara opened a military training academy in Mogadishu in 2017 and has trained and advised Somali troops. The extension comes as Turkey’s military involvement in Somalia has moved beyond training, equipment and advisory support. Turkey deployed F-16 fighter jets to Mogadishu in January, and Somalia’s defense ministry initially announced on June 30 that Turkish F-16s had struck al-Shabaab positions in the Lower Shabelle region. The ministry claimed that approximately 35 militants were killed and more than 20 wounded, although the figures could not be independently verified. A later version of the announcement referred only to support from “international partners,” and Turkish authorities have not publicly confirmed that the jets took part in the operation. Turkey’s expanding military role also comes amid a dispute over Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, the self-governing region that Somalia considers part of its territory. Israel became the first United Nations member state to recognize Somaliland in December 2025, a decision Ankara condemned as interference in Somalia’s internal affairs. Somaliland’s defense minister said in June that Israel was training the region’s police and military but denied negotiations over an Israeli military base. Turkey has presented its presence in Somalia as support for the federal government’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. Opposition lawmakers questioned the lack of information about the mission during the parliamentary debate. Nationalist opposition İYİ (Good) Party parliamentary group deputy chair Turhan Çömez asked how many troops and what equipment would be sent, how much previous missions had cost and whether Turkish forces could be drawn into direct fighting with al-Shabaab militants. Çömez said his party would not support the motion without answers. Pro-Kurdish opposition Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) lawmaker Sevilay Çelenk also opposed the extension, arguing that security should be pursued through diplomacy and democratic institutions rather than military deployments. Main opposition Republican People’s Party (CHP) lawmaker Namık Tan said his party did not oppose training Somalia’s recognized armed forces but objected to parliament being asked to approve a deployment based on an agreement whose full contents had not been disclosed. He warned that support for Somalia should not make Turkey a party to internal fighting or disputes involving neighboring countries. Lawmakers from the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) and its ally, the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP), backed the motion. The authorization is separate from Turkey’s naval mission in the Gulf of Aden, Somali waters, the Arabian Sea and nearby areas. Parliament extended that mission for one year in January . Turkishminute.

items.title: PSF Accuses Puntland of Drone Attacks as Bosaso Security Rift Deepens
items.description: BOSASO — The Puntland Security Forces (PSF) have publicly commented for the first time on the recent fighting in Laag, on the outskirts of Bosaso, accusing the Puntland administration of deploying drones during an operation against their forces. A senior PSF official told the BBC that the force is formally part of the Somali National Army and operates under the authority of Somalia’s Federal Government. The official maintained that responsibility for national defence rests with the Federal Government, while federal member states are primarily mandated to maintain regional police forces. Puntland’s security command had earlier announced that it had concluded a military operation against PSF units, accusing them of undermining security and stability in the region. Puntland authorities subsequently displayed military vehicles, weapons and detainees they said had been captured during the operation. The competing accounts highlight the deepening dispute between the Puntland administration and the PSF over command, authority and control of security forces in the region. Tensions remain high following the clashes in Laag, while neither side has released a comprehensive and independently verified casualty figure. items.title: Muxuu yahay ninka ay Puntland ku wareejisay DDS?
items.description: Galdogob (Caasimada Online) – Ciidanka Booliska Puntland ayaa maanta laamaha amniga ee Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida (DDS) ku wareejiyay Xiddig Siciid Sheekh Xirsi oo ku eedeysan dilka Marxuum Cabdi Maxamuud Wayrax, kaas oo dhacay 8-dii Oktoobar 2018. Wareejinta ayaa la sheegay inay qayb ka tahay iskaashiga amni ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac ee la-dagaallanka dambiyada ka gudba xuduudaha. Munaasabadda wareejinta oo ka dhacday degmada Galdogob ee gobolka Mudug ayaa waxaa hoggaaminayay Taliyaha Qeybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug, Gaashaanle Sare Maxamuud Muuse Bille (Fardafuul). Dhinaca Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida waxaa eedeysanaha kala wareegay Taliyaha Komaandhiska booliska gobolka Doolo, Gaashaanle Dhexe Cabdullaahi Ibraahim Maxamuud. Kadib wareejinta eedeysanaha, labada taliye ayaa si wadajir ah u qabtay shir jaraa’id oo ay kaga hadleen muhiimadda ay leedahay iskaashiga amniga ee labada dhinac. Waxaa sidoo kale goob joog ka ahaa Ku-simaha Taliyaha Saldhigga Booliska degmada Galdogob, Xiddigle Cabdiraxmaan Yaasiin Xasan (Qoodaar) iyo saraakiil kale oo ka tirsan ciidamada. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in wareejinta eedeysanaha ay muujineyso wada-shaqeynta sii xoogeysaneysa ee u dhexeysa ciidanka booliska Puntland iyo laamaha amniga ee dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida. Waxay tilmaameen in iskaashiga noocan ahi uu muhiim u yahay xaqiijinta caddaaladda iyo in eedeysanayaashu aysan ka baxsan sharciga iyagoo u gudbaya dhinaca kale ee xadka. Sidoo kale waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay is-weydaarsiga xogaha amniga, dabagalka dadka lagu tuhunsan yahay dambiyada iyo isu-gudbinta eedeysanayaasha ka baxsada labada dhinac. Sida ay sheegeen, tallaabooyinkaasi waxay door weyn ka qaadanayaan xoojinta amniga iyo la-dagaallanka dambiyada abaabulan. Saraakiisha ayaa xusay in iskaashiga joogtada ah ee hay’adaha amniga uu sare u qaadayo kalsoonida shacabka, isla markaana uu fududeynayo in si degdeg ah looga jawaabo falalka amni-darrada ah iyo dambiyada ka gudba xuduudaha Soomaaliya iyo dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida. Wareejintan ayaa ku soo aadeysa xilli ay Puntland iyo dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida sii xoojinayaan iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo la-dagaallanka dambiyada, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ku cel-celiyeen inay sii wadi doonaan wada-shaqeynta lagu xaqiijinayo caddaaladda, xasilloonida iyo nabadgelyada shacabka ku nool deegaannada xuduudda. items.title: Wasiirka arimaha dibada ee Suciidiga oo sheegay in xiisada gobolku aynanu baahnayn xoog
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Sacuudiga Amiir Faisal ayaa sheegay in xasilloonida gobolku ay u baahan tahay diblomaasiyadeed, ee aysan u baahnayn awood milatari Wuxuu ka digay in xiisadaha gobolku ay saameyn ku leeyihiin amniga adduunka, suuqyada tamarta iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha Wuxuu carabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in la ixtiraamo madaxbannaanida, xorriyadda marin-biyoodyada iyo sharciga caalamiga ah. Hadalkan ka doo yerdhay wasiirka arimaha dibada ee dalka Sacuudiga waxa la sheegayaa in uu salka ku hayo ama jawaab u yahay hadalo hanjabaad ahaa oo ka soo jeedhay Xuutiyiinta Yemen kuwaasi oo sheegay in joojin doonaan ama xanibi doonaan Maraakiibta iyo dhaq dhaqaaqa xaga ganacsiga ee bada cas ee ku socda ama baxaaya dalka Sucuudiga.

items.title: Sidee loo soo afjaray xiisaddii ka taagneyd inta u dhexeysa Marka iyo Janaale?
items.description: Marka (Caasimada Online) – Cutubyo ka tirsan guutada 14-ka Oktoobar ee ciidanka dhulka xoogga dalka ayaa ku guuleystay inay soo afjaraan xiisad saacadihii la soo dhaafay ka taagneyd dhul beereed u dhexeeya magaalada Marka iyo deegaanka Janaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, taas oo laga cabsi qabay inay isu beddesho iska horimaad hubeysan. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha ciidamada, cutubyada ka tirsan Ururrada 141-aad, 144-aad iyo 145-aad ayaa si degdeg ah loogu diray goobta markii ay soo baxeen wararka ku saabsan xiisadda. Ciidamada ayaa kala dhex-galay dhinacyadii u dhexeeyay muranka, iyagoo ku guuleystay inay dejiyaan xaaladda, isla markaana ka hortagaan inuu dagaal ka qarxo deegaanka. Taliyaha guutada 14-ka Oktoobar, Gaashaanle Cismaan Muuse Maxamed ayaa sheegay in howl-galka uu u dhacay sidii loo qorsheeyay, isla markaana ciidamada ay si nabad ah ku soo afjareen khilaafkii ka taagnaa deegaanka. Wuxuu xusay in dadaallada ciidamadu ay suurta-geliyeen in xaaladdu dib ugu soo laabato deganaansho. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada ay dib u fureen kanaal biyood u xirmay sababo la xiriiray xiisadda, si biyuhu mar kale u gaaraan dhulkii beeraha, taas oo uu tilmaamay inay muhiim u tahay sii socoshada wax-soo-saarka beeraha iyo nolosha dadka deegaanka oo ku tiirsan waraabka. Gaashaanle Cismaan Muuse ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay inaan la aqbali doonin dhiig ku daata khilaafyo aan waxba tarayn, isagoo ugu baaqay bulshada deegaanka inay ku xalliyaan wixii tabashooyin ah wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, halkii ay u adeegsan lahaayeen xoog. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in sugidda xasilloonida deegaannada ay muhiim u tahay sii wadidda howlaha amniga iyo dagaalka lagula jiro kooxda Al-Shabaab, isagoo xusay in kooxdu marar badan isku daydo inay ka faa’iideysato khilaafaadka bulshada si ay u carqaladeyso amniga. Ugu dambeyntiina, taliyaha ayaa xaqiijiyay inay sii wadi doonaan how-lgallada lagu ilaalinayo amniga, laguna xallinayo khilaafaadka ka dhasha deegaannada ay ka howl-galaan, si loo xaqiijiyo nabadda, isu socodka bulshada iyo horumarka gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. items.title: BEESHA JAREER WEYN DAWLADDA SOOMAALIYA WAY DUUDSIDAY XAQOODII

items.title: Ciidanka Booliska degmada Galdogob oo gacanta ku dhigay nin dilay xaaskiisa
items.description: Galdogob ( Raxanreeb Online) Taliyaha Booliska degmada Galdogob ee maamulka Puntland, ayaa faah faahin ka bixiyay nin xaaskiisa dilay oo ay gacanta kusoo dhigeen. Taliyaha ayaa sheegay in eedeeysanaha uu dilka xaaskiisa u adeegsaday Mindi ( Toreey), isla markaana uu ka baxsaday balse howlgal kaddib ay gacanta kusoo dhigeen. Taliyaha ayaa sheegay in gacan ku dhiiglaha lagu magacaabo Cabdihodan Axmed Cabdinuur, isla markaana xaaskiisa Falis ay u dhashay 8 carruur ah. “7 KM meel u jirta oo la yiraahdo Taaloole, baan gacanta ku dhignay, isaga oo meeshii dilka ka geystay ilaa halkaas ordaya gabadhii dhimatay waa la aasay Ehelladii labada dhinac wey hehiyeen Mididii uu gabadha ku dilay waa taas iyada oo dhiig weli leh Eedeysanihii waa kaas halkaa ku xiran, Taliye gabadhaas waxey u baahan tahay cadaalad” ayuu yiri taliyaha Booliska degmada Galdogob. Sidoo kale Taliyaha oo sii hadlayay ayaa tilmaamay in Eedeysanaha kaliyaha uu maqalka la’yahay, balse inta kale uu ka caafimaad qabo. Ugu dambeyn Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug ee Puntland, G/Sare Maxamuud Muuse Bille Farda-fuul, oo booqday Saldhigga Booliska degmada Galdogob, ayaa sheegay in eedeysanaha lagu hayo xabsiga sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badana maxkamad loo horkeeni doono. The post Ciidanka Booliska degmada Galdogob oo gacanta ku dhigay nin dilay xaaskiisa appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Doorashada Galmudug oo dib loo dhigay + Sababta
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa dib u dhigay doorashada isku-sidkan ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Guddiga ayaa war-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray ku dhawaaqay in haatan doorashada maamulka Galmudug loo asteeyay 30-ka Luulyo 2026, taas oo markii hore loo qorsheeyey inay qabsoonto 25-ka bishaan. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in go’aankan uu yimid kadib markii uu qiimeeyey baaxadda howlaha horyaalla ee la xiriira hirgelinta doorashada, isla markaana uu tixgeliyey codsi iyo soo jeedin uga timid ururrada siyaasadda ee ka qeybgalaya doorashada. Sidoo kale, guddigu wuxuu sheegay inuu garwaaqsaday in ururrada siyaasaddu u baahan yihiin waqti dheeraad ah si ay ugu diyaar garoobaan doorashada, maadaama ay yihiin tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee laf-dhabarta u ah hirgelinta doorasho loo dhan yahay oo hufan. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu caddeeyey in dib u dhigidda doorashada ay waafaqsan tahay qodobka 18-aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka, kaas oo khuseeya awoodda lagu cayimayo maalinta doorashada. Guddigu wuxuu ugu baaqay dhammaan ururrada siyaasadda ee ka qeybgalaya doorashada inay ka faa’iideystaan muddada dheeriga ah ee la siiyey, si ay u dhammeystiraan diyaar-garowgooda kahor maalinta cusub ee loo asteeyey codbixinta. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyey dhammaan daneeyeyaasha doorashada inay sii wadaan wada-shaqeynta iyo taageerada geeddi-socodka doorashada, si ay u qabsoonto doorasho xor, xalaal ah oo hufan. “Guddigu waxa u caddaynayaa dhammaan daneeyeyaasha doorashada in uu fududayn doono turxaan bixin doono waxa kasta oo khuseeya hawlaha doorashada oo ay soo jeediyaan saamileyda doorashada,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka guddiga. Si kastaba, dib u dhigista doorashooyinka Galmudug ayaa imanaya xilli ay socdaan wada-hadallo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka, oo qaarkood si adag uga soo horjeedaan sii socoshada doorashooyinka maamul-goboleedyada. The post Doorashada Galmudug oo dib loo dhigay + Sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Shaacisay Dib-u-habayn Ballaaran oo Lagu Samaynayo Waxbarashada Islaamiga Ah
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa dhowaan shaaciyay qorshe ka kooban dib-u-habayn ballaaran oo lagu samaynayo waxbarashada Islaamiga ah, dhiirrigelinta hay’adaha diinta, iyo casriyeinta maamulka danta guud. Isaga oo hadal kajeedinayay munaasabadda qalin-jabinta dufcaddii ugu horreysay ee heerka Master-ka ee kuliyadda Dacwadda iyo Garsoorka ee Jaamacadda Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu tilmaamay in markii ugu horreysay taariikhda Soomaaliya hab cusub oo qaran loo sameeyay waxbarashada Islaamiga ah, iyadoo dugsiyada qur’aanka (duqsiyada) si buuxda loogu dhex-galinayo nidaamka waxbarashada rasmiga ah ee dalka. Sida uu sheegay Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa, mas’uuliyadda dugsiyada qur’aanka ayaa si rasmi ah looga wareejiyay Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Diinta, waxaana loo wareejiyay Wasaaradda Waxbarashada. Tallaabadan ayaa u go’aaminaysa dugsiyada qur’aanka inay noqdaan hay’ado waxbarasho oo rasmi ah, kuwaas oo lahaan doona manhaj waafaqsan heerarka qaranka, aqoonsi rasmi ah, iyo kormeer dowladeed. Waxaa kale oo qorshaha qayb ka ah in macallimiinta dugsiyada qur’aanka ay helaan tababarro rasmi ah iyo shahaadooyin la aqoonsan yahay si loo baahiyo heerka tayada maamul iyo mid waxfundis. Majliska Sare ee Culumada iyo Nidaamka Dijitaalka Ah Dowladda waxay sidoo kale ka shaqaynaysaa dhisidda Majliska Sare ee Culumada Soomaaliyeed, oo mas’uul ka noqon doona soo saarida fataawada diiniga ah oo mideysan. Tani waxay beddeli doontaa tafsiirradii kala duwanaa ee horey uga soo bixi jiray sheekh kasta. Sharciga majliskan lagu dhisayo ayaa horey loogu ansixiyay Golaha Wasiirrada, wuxuuna hadda ka dhowrayaa ansixinta Baarlamaanka. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale xarun rasmi ah oo maamul iyo maktabado leh u dhisaysa culumada. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu shaaciyay in la samaynayo nidaam dijitaal ah oo lagu diiwaangelinayo dugsiyada qur’aanka, maahadada Islaamiga ah, iyo jaamacadaha, si loo xaqiijiyo xaqiiqada shahaadooyinka iyo diiwaannada aqooneed ee ardayda, taas oo kor u qaadi doonta hufnaanta nidaamka waxbarashada. Dhisidda Aqoon-yahanno Daboola Baahiyaha Cusub ee Dalka Ugu dambeyntii, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ugu baaqay jaamacadaha dalka inay soo saaraan aqoon-yahanno awood u leh inay ka jawaabaan baahiyaha maamul ee dalka ka jira, sida garsoorayaal ku takhasusay sharciga baddaha, khilaafaadka batroolka, dambiyada maaliyadda, hantidhawrka, iyo fiqhiga Islaamka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa ku soo gaba gabeeyay in dib-u-habayntan ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada ballaaran ee dhismaha dowladda iyo xaqiijinta xasiloonida muddada dheer.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Puntland oo la kulmay wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Puntland Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid, ayaa maanta la kulmay wafdi uu hoggaaminayay wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha dibadda dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya Cabdisalaam Hadliye Cumar oo booqasho ku jooga Puntland. Intii uu kulanku socday waxaa la sheegay in looga hadlay horumarinta waxbarashada sare ee Puntland, kor u qaadidda tayada tacliinta, iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya hay’adaha dowladda iyo xarumaha tacliinta sare, si loo kobciyo aqoonta iyo horumarka bulshada. Wafdiga Cabdisalaam Hadliye waxaa ka mid ahaa Guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Puntland State University, Prof. Maxamuud Sheekh Xaamud. Ambassador Cabdisalaam Hadliye wuxuu Garoowe u yimid casuumaad uu ka helay Jaamacadda Puntland State University. items.title: Khaalid Kaamil oo xabsiga laga siidaayay
items.description: Hargeysa ( Raxanreeb Online) Wararka ka imanaya magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimada Somaliland, ayaa sheegaya in xabsiga laga siidaayay fannaanka Khaalid Kaamil. Maxkamad ayaa xoriyadiisa dib u siisay Khaalid oo todobaadyadii u dambeeyay ku xirnaa xabsi ku yaala magaalada Hargeysa sida ay Ehelkiisa xaqiijiyeen. Inkastoo hay’adaha ammaanka Somaliland aysan weli si rasmi ah u shaacin sababta Khaalid loo xiray, haddana ehellada fannaanku waxay sheegeen in uu eersaday hees uu u qaaday magaalada Barakeysan ee Qudus. Somaliland ayaa ka furtay safaarad magaalada Qudus (Jerusalem) bishii lasoo dhaafay, lix bilood ka dib markii Israa’iil noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland inay tahay dal madax-bannaan, taas oo keentay cambaareyn ballaaran. Heesta fannaanka loo haysto oo aan weli si rasmi ah u soo bixin, balse maqal ahaan loo geliyey baraha bulshada, ayaa waxaa loogu qareemayaa magaalada barakeysan ee Qudus, halkaas oo uu ku yaallo masaajidka Al-Aqsa oo Muslimiintu aaminsan yihiin in uu barakeysan yahay. The post Khaalid Kaamil oo xabsiga laga siidaayay appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: DF oo wajahaysa imtixaan adag kadib culeys weyn oo la saaray howl-galka AUSSOM
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Qaar ka mid ah dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegay in howl-galka taageerada iyo xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) uusan sii socon karin muddo aan xad lahayn. Xubnahan ayaa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku booriyay inay dardar-geliso dhismaha iyo tayeynta ciidamada qaranka si ay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Sida lagu sheegay warbixin uu daabacay The East African, dalalka Cameroon iyo Gabon ayaa muujiyay in howlgal kasta oo nabad-ilaalin ahi uu leeyahay waqti uu ku egyahay, ayna muhiim tahay in Soomaaliya isu diyaariso maalinta ay ciidamada shisheeye ka baxayaan dalka. Labada dal ayaa ku adkeystay in la dejiyo qorshe cad oo lagu xaqiijinayo kala-guurka mas’uuliyadda amniga. Dooddan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada ku saabsan maalgelinta howl-galka AUSSOM, kadib markii Mareykanku muujiyay inuu ka soo horjeedo sii wadista taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee howl-galka laga bilaabo sanadka 2027. Arrintan ayaa abuurtay shaki cusub oo ku saabsan sida loo maalgelin doono howl-galka iyo mustaqbalkiisa. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale xustay in dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika ay haatan ka doodayaan sidii loo dejin lahaa qorshe mideysan oo Soomaaliya loogu wareejinayo mas’uuliyadda amniga, iyadoo la tixgelinayo caqabadaha dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, tababarka ciidamada iyo xaaladda amni ee weli ka jirta qaybo badan oo dalka ah. Mas’uuliyiinta ka qeyb-galay doodaha ayaa aaminsan in guusha qorshaha kala-guurka ay ku xirnaan doonto awoodda ay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed u yeeshaan inay si madax-bannaan u sugaan amniga, u ilaaliyaan goobaha muhiimka ah, isla markaana ay sii wadaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab marka taageerada ciidamada shisheeye ay yaraato. Howl-galka AUSSOM ayaa si rasmi ah u billowday sanadkii 2025, isagoo beddelay howl-galka ATMIS. Ujeeddadiisu waa taageeridda ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya, xasilinta deegaannada laga saaray Al-Shabaab iyo dhisidda awoodda hay’adaha amniga, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay in mas’uuliyadda amniga si tartiib tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Doodaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka AUSSOM ayaa imanaya xilli Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku celcelisay inay ka go’an tahay dhismaha ciidan qaran oo awood u leh inuu si buuxda u sugo amniga dalka. Si kastaba, caqabadaha dhinaca maalgelinta, qalabaynta iyo khatarta Al-Shabaab ayaa weli ka mid ah arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee saameynaya geeddi-socodka la wareegidda amniga dalka. items.title: Xogta xiisad sababtay dhimasho iyo dhaawac oo ka taagan Caabudwaaq
items.description: Caabudwaaq (Caasimada Online) – Xiisad xooggan ayaa ka tagaan magaalada Caabudwaaq ee gobolka Galgaduud kadib markii ciidamada ilaalada u ah musharraxa Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Liibaan Axmed ay rasaas ku fureen dad shacab ah oo ku sugnaa goob ay ka socotay munaasabad soo dhaweyn ah. Ugu yaraan laba qof oo rayid ah ayaa ku dhintay, tiro kalena way ku dhaawacmeen falkaask. Dhacdadan ayaa dhacday xilli magaalada uu ka socday isu-soobax ballaaran oo lagu soo dhoweynayay musharraxa, kaas oo booqasho ku jooga Caabudwaaq. Boqolaal qof ayaa isugu soo baxay waddooyinka magaalada si ay uga qeyb qaataan soo dhaweynta, hase yeeshee munaasabadda ayaa isu beddeshay fowdo iyo rasaas. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo deegaanka ah oo xog-ogaal u ah dhacdada, rabshaddu waxay bilaabatay kadib markii qaar ka mid ah dhallinyaradii ka qeyb-galaysay isu-soobaxa ay sameeyeen buuq iyo fooddo. Arrintaas ayaa la sheegay inay dhalisay jahwareer, taas oo ugu dambeyn sababtay in ciidamada ilaalada ay adeegsadaan rasaas nool. Goobjoogayaal ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ay rasaas toos ah ku fureen dadkii goobta ku sugnaa, taasoo sababtay dhimashada ugu yaraan laba qof oo rayid ah. Sidoo kale, waxaa jira dhaawacyo soo gaaray dad kale, kuwaas oo qaarkood loo qaaday xarumaha caafimaadka ee magaalada si loogu daweeyo. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa tilmaamaya in khasaaraha dhimashada iyo dhaawacu uu isbeddeli karo, maadaama weli la ururinayo xogta rasmiga ah ee ku saabsan tirada dadka ay rasaastu saameysay. Ma jiraan illaa hadda warar faah-faahsan oo laga helay xaaladda caafimaad ee dadka dhaawacmay. Dhacdadan ayaa xiisad ka abuurtay magaalada Caabudwaaq, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka iyo mas’uuliyiinta deegaanka ay wadaan dadaallo lagu dejinayo xaaladda. Ganacsiyo iyo isu-socodka dadka ayaa la sheegay inay si ku-meel-gaar ah u saameeyeen rasaasta ka dhacday goobta. Ilaa iyo hadda, ma jiro wax war ah oo si rasmi ah uga soo baxay musharrax Liibaan Axmed ama maamulka degmada Caabudwaaq oo ku saabsan dhacdada iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay. Dhacdadan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli ay Galmudug ka socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed iyo ololayaal la xiriira doorashada maamulka, iyadoo bulshada ay walaac ka muujinayaan in tartanka siyaasadeed uusan horseedin falal amni-darro oo khatar gelin kara shacabka rayidka ah. items.title: IOM Flies 56 Migrants Back to Ethiopia
items.description: It was a sombre scene at the Bosaso port on Wednesday as 56 Ethiopian nationals, including 10 young children travelling completely alone, were bundled into waiting vehicles and driven away from the coast – their dreams of a better life in the Gulf crushed in a single, swift operation by the International Organization for Migration. The repatriation, carried out in coordination with Somali authorities, has once again exposed the raw desperation driving thousands of Horn of Africa youth to risk death on the treacherous Gulf of Aden, only to end up back where they started – poorer, traumatised, and in many cases, orphaned in all but name. According to an IOM statement seen by our reporter, the 56 individuals were intercepted in Bosaso – the bustling port city that has become a launchpad for smugglers ferrying migrants to Yemen. Among them were 10 minors with no parent or guardian in sight, prompting immediate humanitarian concern. “This is the painful reality we deal with daily,” said an IOM protection officer who spoke to our newsroom from the scene. “These children were just days away from boarding a rickety boat that could have easily capsized. We saved their lives today, but the question remains – who will save their futures?” The operation, described as “smooth and peaceful” by officials, saw the Ethiopians handed over to their home country’s authorities, where they will now face an uncertain reintegration. items.title: Turkey renews Somalia military deployment for two more years
items.description: Turkey’s parliament has approved a two-year extension of its military mission in Somalia, a move set to take effect on July 27 that reaffirms Ankara’s continued backing of Somali security institutions. The decision allows Turkish forces to keep providing training, advisory support and technical assistance to Somalia’s National Army. The extension matters now because it comes at a critical juncture for Somalia’s security landscape. The Somali government is in the midst of active military operations against Al-Shabaab while also working to strengthen its national forces and protect its coastline and maritime resources, making sustained foreign support a key factor in the campaign’s trajectory. The renewed mission’s mandate covers a broad range of security challenges facing Somalia. It includes participation in efforts against Al-Shabaab, as well as combating piracy, illegal fishing, arms trafficking and other threats present in Somali waters. The extension document, submitted by the Turkish government and signed by President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, was presented to parliament as essential for reinforcing the capacity of Somalia’s security institutions and preserving stability across the Horn of Africa region. Turkey has positioned itself as one of Somalia’s closest security partners in recent years. In 2017, Ankara established the TURKSOM training facility in Mogadishu, where thousands of Somali soldiers have since been trained. The base has become a cornerstone of bilateral cooperation spanning defence, maritime security and force development. The timing of the extension underscores the interconnected nature of Somalia’s security priorities. As Somali forces press their offensive against Al-Shabaab, the government is simultaneously working to build up national military capacity and secure economic assets at sea, an effort in which Turkish support has played a recurring role since 2017. items.title: 44 Somali Pirates Sentenced to Life in India
items.description: A special court in Mumbai has sentenced 44 Somali nationals to life imprisonment for hijacking two vessels off Somalia’s coast and taking their crews hostage, in verdicts delivered on Monday. The rulings mark India’s first convictions under its Maritime Anti-Piracy Act of 2022, closing a case that began with dramatic naval rescues in 2024. The sentencing carries significance beyond the courtroom. It signals India’s growing resolve to prosecute maritime crime under its own laws rather than repatriate suspects, at a time when piracy has resurfaced off East Africa after nearly a decade of relative calm, and as global shipping lanes near the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden face renewed security threats. The case stemmed from two separate incidents. In December 2023, 35 pirates hijacked the Maltese-flagged bulk carrier MV Ruen, the first successful boarding of a cargo vessel by Somali pirates since 2017. Indian commandos boarded the vessel some 260 nautical miles off Somalia’s coast in a 40-hour operation, parachuting from a military C-17 aircraft to corner and coerce the pirates into surrendering. In March 2024, nine other men hijacked the Iranian-flagged fishing vessel Al-Kambar 786. Indian naval ships Trishul and Sumedha, deployed in the Gulf of Aden on an anti-piracy mission, responded to a hijacking alert and arrested the nine Somali nationals. Prosecutors said the pirates held the crew hostage for about three days for ransom and threatened them with weapons including AK-47 rifles and hand grenades. Delivering the verdict, Special Judge S B Dige said the acts of piracy were serious offences involving hostage-taking and human shields that “cannot be taken casually.” Judge Dige described the crimes as extremely grave, saying hijacking ships, taking crew members hostage for ransom, attempting to kill them, and using them as human shields deserved the strictest punishment. All 44 defendants pleaded guilty during the trial. Despite advice from a lawyer linked to the Somali embassy not to plead guilty, the accused proceeded voluntarily, citing hardships in prison. Defence submissions noted the men had rejected embassy-appointed counsel, saying they had no faith in that representation. The convicted men, held at Taloja Jail in Navi Mumbai since their arrest, were present in court for the verdict. They had asked to be sent back to Somalia to face trial there, but the request was denied. India’s navy has patrolled waters off Somalia since 2008 and intensified anti-piracy operations in 2023 following a spike in attacks across the Arabian Sea and Red Sea corridor. items.title: Xiisaddii Imaaraadka iyo Sacuudiga oo gashay xaalad lama filaan ah kadib wasiiro…
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa Talaadadii si isku mar ah u baahiyay farriimo ay ku adkeynayaan xiriirka taariikhiga ah, walaaltinimada iyo iskaashiga labada dal, kadib bilo ay soo baxayeen khilaafaad siyaasadeed iyo kuwo dhaqaale oo u dhexeeya labada quwadood ee Khaliijka. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Sacuudiga, Salmaan Al-Dosary, iyo guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Warbaahinta Qaranka Imaaraadka, Cabdullaahi bin Maxamed Alhamed, ayaa farriimaha ku baahiyay barta X saacaddu markii ay ahayd 7:00 fiidnimo waqtiga Riyadh. Isku ekaanshaha waqtiga iyo nuxurka farriimaha ayaa loo arkay tallaabo la isku dubbariday oo lagu doonayo in lagu dejiyo hadalladii kululaa ee bilihii lasoo dhaafay dhex marayay warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada ee labada dal. “Xiriirka Imaaraadka iyo Sacuudiga wuxuu sii ambaqaadayaa taariikh wadaag ah iyo xiriir walaaltinimo oo qoto dheer oo ka dhexeeya laba shacab oo walaalo ah, kuwaas oo ay mideyso masiir isku mid ah,” ayuu Alhamed ku yiri qoraalkiisa. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Sacuudiga ayaa isna sheegay in xiriirka boqortooyada iyo Imaaraadka uu yahay mid ka dhexeeya laba shacab oo wadaaga taariikh, dhaqan iyo hoggaan uu ku tilmaamay mid caqli badan. Labada mas’uul ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in warbaahinta labada dal ay ka shaqeyso muujinta xiriirkaas iyo qodobbada mideeya, kana fogaato wax kasta oo dhaawici kara iskaashiga iyo walaaltinimada u dhexeysa Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi. Khilaaf bannaanka usoo baxay Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Imaaraadka ayaa muddo dheer ahaa xulafo dhow, hase yeeshee danahooda ayaa sanadihii dambe ku kala fogaaday arrimo ay ka mid yihiin siyaasadda shidaalka, tartanka dhaqaale, saameynta gobolka iyo dagaalka Yemen. Khilaafka labada dal ayaa si gaar ah bannaanka usoo baxay dabayaaqadii sanadkii hore, markii Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi lagu eedeeyay inay kala taageerayaan dhinacyo iska soo horjeeda oo ku lug leh dagaalka Yemen. Xiisadda ayaa gaartay heer ciidamada Sacuudiga ay duqeyn ku qaadeen shixnad ay Riyadh sheegtay inay ahayd qalab militari oo Imaaraadku u waday koox Yemeni ah oo ay Abu Dhabi taageerto. Wixii xilligaas ka dambeeyay, akoonno saameyn leh oo Sacuudi iyo Imaaraati ah, falanqeeyayaal iyo qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta labada dal ayaa si aan horay loo arag isku dhaafsaday dhaliilo iyo eedeymo furan. Bishii Maarso, Imaaraadka ayaa xannibay akoonnada barta X ee telefishinka Al-Arabiya, oo ah warbaahin Sacuudigu leeyahay, tallaabadaas oo muujisay heerka uu khilaafku gaaray. Kala duwanaanshaha labada dal ayaa sidoo kale muuqday intii uu socday dagaalkii Iran, kaas oo khatar geliyay ammaanka dalalka Khaliijka. Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi ayaa marar badan ku kala aragti duwanaaday jawaabta ku habboon ee laga bixin karo colaaddaas. Bishii May, Imaaraadka ayaa ka baxay ururka dalalka shidaalka dhoofiya ee OPEC, oo Sacuudi Carabiya ay hoggaamiso, tallaabadaas oo loo arkay mid sii xoojisay kala fogaanshaha labada dal. Si kastaba, Maxamed Baharoon, oo ah agaasimaha guud ee Xarunta Cilmi-baarista Siyaasadda Dadweynaha ee Dubai, ayaa sheegay in khilaafka labada dal aan loo arki karin mid istaraatiiji ah oo gebi ahaanba burburinaya xiriirkooda. “Waxaan u maleynayaa in wixii dhacay ay ahaayeen duufaan koob dhexdiis ka dhacday. Waxaan horay u aragnay xaalado ka daran, balse waligood ma aysan noqon khilaaf istaraatiiji ah,” ayuu yiri Baharoon. “Waxaan hubaa in labada dhinac ay sameeyeen la-qabsi, laakiin xaqiiqadu waxay tahay in waxyaabaha naga dhexeeya ay aad uga badan yihiin meelaha aan ku kala duwan nahay,” ayuu raaciyay. Astaamo isu-soo-dhawaansho Saacad ka hor inta aysan mas’uuliyiinta warbaahinta labada dal baahin farriimahooda, Turki Alalshikh, oo ka mid ah dadka sida dhow ugu dhow dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan, ayaa barta X soo dhigay sawir uu sheegay in maalmo ka hor la qaaday. Sawirka ayaa muujinayay wasiirka difaaca Sacuudiga, Khaalid bin Salmaan, oo la dhashay dhaxal-sugaha, iyo madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Imaaraadka, Sheekh Mansuur bin Zayed Al Nahyan, iyagoo gacmaha isa saaraya isla markaana dhoolla-caddeynaya. Alalshikh ayaa sawirka ku dul qoray: “Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Imaaraadka: sheeko walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi xididdo qoto dheer leh.” La-taliyaha diblomaasiyadda madaxweynaha Imaaraadka, Anwar Gargash, ayaa isna sawirka ka falceliyay, isagoo adeegsaday oraah tilmaameysa in xooggu ku jiro midnimada. “Warmaha marka ay wada jiraan way diidaan in la jebiyo, balse way jabaan haddii ay kala tagaan,” ayuu Gargash yiri. Farriimahan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli mas’uuliyiinta Khaliijka ay toddobaadyadii dambe ku baaqayeen in la xoojiyo midnimada lixda dal ee Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka, iyadoo ay jiraan weerarro ka imanaya Iran iyo hanjabaado cusub oo kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay u jeedisay maraakiibta ku safarta Badda Cas. items.title: Maraykanka ayaa weerarro ku qaaday Iiraan maalintii 11-aad oo xidhiidh
items.description: Mareykanka oo weeraro fuliyay maalintii 11aad; difaacyada cirka ee qeybo badan oo Maraykanka ayaa weerarro ku qaaday Iiraan habeenkii 11-aad oo xidhiidh ah, iyadoo Tehran ay uga digtay Maraykanka inuusan bartilmaameedsan xarumaheeda nukliyeerka. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Maraykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay, in mowjadan weerarrada ah loo qorsheeyay “in lagu sii wiiqo awoodda Iiraan ee ay ku halis gelin karto maraakiibta ganacsiga” ee marinka Hormuz. Warbaahinta dowladda Iiraan ayaa sheegtay, in nidaamyada difaaca cirka la hawlgeliyay caasimadda Tehran. Qaraxyo ayaa sidoo kale laga soo sheegay Tabriz, Chabahar, Konarak, iyo Bushehr, oo ay ku taallo warshadda keliya ee tamarta nukliyeerka ee Iiraan. Iiraan, oo weerarro aargoosi ah ku qaaday Maraykanka iyo xulafadiisa Bariga Dhexe, ayaa ka digtay tallaabooyin jawaab celin ah kadib markii Donald Trump uu sheegay in Maraykanku dhawaan weerari doono xarun nukliyeer oo dhulka hoostiisa ku taalla oo u dhow Natanz. Iiraan iyo Maraykanku waxay bishii Abriil ku heshiiyeen xabbad-joojin, balse dagaalladu waxay dib u billowdeen toddobaadkii hore iyadoo labada dal ay ku loollamayeen gacan ku haynta marinka istaraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz.
