items.title: Madaxweyne Erdogan oo Dalbaday in Loo Kordhiyo Muddada Ciidamada Turkiga ee Jooga Soomaaliya
items.description: Madaxweynaha dalka Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, ayaa si rasmi ah uga codsaday Baarlamaanka dalkiisa in labo sano oo dheeri ah loo kordhiyo muddada hawlgalka ciidamada Turkiga ee ka howlgala gudaha dalka Soomaaliya. Codsigan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee dowladda Ankara ay ku taageerayso amniga iyo xasiloonida dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya.  Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee kordhinta muddadan ayaa salka ku haysa sii guda-galka iyo xoojinta hawlgallada tababarrada iyo taageerada milateri ee Turkigu siiyo Ciidanka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Ciidamada Turkiga ee ku sugan saldhigga weyn ee TURKSOM ee magaalada Muqdisho ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaata dhismaha iyo tayeynta guutooyinka sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Gorgor, kuwaas oo safka hore ka ah dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada. Xiriirka milateri iyo kan diblomaasiyadeed ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa guurtay marxalad cusub oo iskaashi aad u qoto dheer dhowrkii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Isbahaysigan xooggan ma ahan oo kaliya mid ku kooban tababarka ciidanka dhulka, baddana waxaa dhowaan lagu daray heshiisyo dhanka difaaca baddaha iyo khayraadka ah, taas oo muujinaysa muhiimadda xeeladeed ee ay dowladda Turkiga u leedahay badbaadada marinnada biyaha Soomaaliya. Haddii uu baarlamaanka dalka Turkiga ansixiyo codsigan uga yimid Madaxweyne Erdogan, waxay taasi ka dhignaan doontaa in howlgalka milateri ee Ankara ee Geeska Afrika uu sii socon doono ilaa laga gaarayo sanadka 2028. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli xasaasi ah oo ay Soomaaliya ku guda jirto qorshayaal ay si buuxda ugula wareegayso amniga guud ee dalka, ka dib marka ay baxaan ciidamada caalamiga ah ee ATMIS. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa horay u bogaadisay taageerada hagar-la’aneed ee ay ka hesho dalka Turkiga, taas oo loo arko mid wax weyn ka beddeshay awoodda iyo tayada ciidamada qalabka sida. Kordhinta muddada ciidamada Turkiga ayaa dhabaha u xaari doonta in la sii amba-qaado mashaariicda iskaashi ee dhanka difaaca, ammaanka qaranka, iyo xasilinta deegaannada laga xoreeyo kooxaha nabad-diidka ah.

Isbahaysigan xooggan ma ahan oo kaliya mid ku kooban tababarka ciidanka dhulka, baddana waxaa dhowaan lagu daray heshiisyo dhanka difaaca baddaha iyo khayraadka ah, taas oo muujinaysa muhiimadda xeeladeed ee ay dowladda Turkiga u leedahay badbaadada marinnada biyaha Soomaaliya. Haddii uu baarlamaanka dalka Turkiga ansixiyo codsigan uga yimid Madaxweyne Erdogan, waxay taasi ka dhignaan doontaa in howlgalka milateri ee Ankara ee Geeska Afrika uu sii socon doono ilaa laga gaarayo sanadka 2028. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli xasaasi ah oo ay Soomaaliya ku guda jirto qorshayaal ay si buuxda ugula wareegayso amniga guud ee dalka, ka dib marka ay baxaan ciidamada caalamiga ah ee ATMIS. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa horay u bogaadisay taageerada hagar-la’aneed ee ay ka hesho dalka Turkiga, taas oo loo arko mid wax weyn ka beddeshay awoodda iyo tayada ciidamada qalabka sida. Kordhinta muddada ciidamada Turkiga ayaa dhabaha u xaari doonta in la sii amba-qaado mashaariicda iskaashi ee dhanka difaaca, ammaanka qaranka, iyo xasilinta deegaannada laga xoreeyo kooxaha nabad-diidka ah.

items.title: Hay’adda UKMTO oo Xaqiijisay in Markab Laga Afduubtay Gacanka Cadmeed loo soo Jiheeyay Biyaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Hay’adda Badbaadada Ganacsiga Baddaha ee Boqortooyada Midowday (UKMTO) ayaa xaqiijisay in markab ganacsi oo dhowaan lagu afduubtay biyaha Guba Khaliijka Cadmeed loo leexiyay dhanka biyaha dalka Soomaaliya. Dhacdadani ayaa dhalisay walaac cusub oo la xiriira amniga marin-badeedyada muhiimka ah ee gobolka iyo suurtagalnimada inay dib u soo labakacleeyaan kooxaha burcad-badeedda ah. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha amniga baddaha, koox hubeysan ayaa dusha u fuushay markabka xilli uu marayay meel ka baxsan xeebaha gobolka, iyaga oo ku qasbay shaqaalihii saarnaa inay u weiciyaan dhanka xudud-badeedka Soomaaliya. Hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee dusha kala socda amniga badaha ayaa bilaabay baaritaanno iyo daba-gal xooggan oo ku saabsan aqoonsiga markabka iyo tirada shaqaalaha ku go’doonsan. Guba Khaliijka Cadmeed iyo guud ahaan badweynta Hindiya ayaa dhowrkii sano ee la soo dhaafay deganaa ka dib markii hawlgallo caalami ah oo ay hoggaaminayaan ciidamada isbahaysiga baddaha ay hoos u dhigeen weerarada burcad-badeedda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhacdadani cusub ayaa muujinaysa in khatarta ammaan-darro ee haysata maraakiibta ganacsiga ay weli tahay mid taagan, taasoo u baahan feejignaan dheeri ah oo laga muujiyo marin-badeedyada Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Erdogan oo baarlamaanka u gudbiyey qaraar muhiim ah oo ku saabsan Soomaaliya
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa baarlamaanka dalkiisa ka codsaday inuu laba sano oo kale kordhiyo muddada ay ciidamada Turkiga uga howlgalayaan Soomaaliya, si ay usii wadaan taageerada dhinacyada amniga, tababarka ciidamada iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Mooshin loo gudbiyay Golaha Qaranka Turkiga ayaa lagu sheegay in ammaanka iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya ay muhiim u yihiin nabadda guud ee Geeska Afrika, isla markaana sii joogitaanka ciidamada Turkiga uu Ankara u oggolaanayo inay joogteyso taageerada ay siiso hay’adaha difaaca iyo amniga Soomaaliya. Haddii baarlamaanku ansixiyo codsiga, ciidamada Turkiga ayaa sii wadi doona tababarrada militariga, la-talinta, taageerada farsamo iyo iskaashiga kale ee difaaca ee ku saleysan heshiisyada ay kala saxiixdeen Ankara iyo Muqdisho. Codsigan ayaa daba socda oggolaanshihii laba sano ahaa ee baarlamaanka Turkiga ansixiyay bishii July 2024. Mooshinka ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay si rasmi ah uga codsatay Turkiga inuu sii wado taageerada militari ee uu ku bixiyo heshiiska iskaashiga difaaca iyo dhaqaalaha ee labada dal. Heshiiskaas ayaa Turkiga siinaya door ballaaran oo ku saabsan dib-u-dhiska ciidamada Soomaaliya, horumarinta awoodda difaaca badda iyo ilaalinta xeebaha dheer ee dalka. Saameyn dhaqaale xumo Qoraalka loo gudbiyay baarlamaanka Turkiga ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamada difaaca iyo amniga Soomaaliya ay haystaan ciidamo iyo qalab, balse caqabadaha dhaqaale ay weli saameyn ku leeyihiin awooddooda howlgaleed. Turkiga ayaa sheegay in kordhinta muddada ciidamadiisu ay muhiim u tahay sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa in tababarrada, la-talinta iyo taageerada farsamo aysan hakad u gelin, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay weli dagaal kula jirto kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ankara ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in taageeradeedu aysan ku koobneyn la-dagaallanka argagixisada, balse ay qeyb ka tahay qorshe lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha difaaca Soomaaliya, si ciidamada qaranku mustaqbalka si madax-bannaan ugu sugi karaan ammaanka dalka. Mooshinka ayaa xusay in taageerada Turkiga ay Soomaaliya ka caawin doonto wax ka qabashada argagixisada, burcad-badeedda, kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah, tahriibinta dadka iyo khataraha kale ee ka jira berriga iyo badda. Waxa kale oo lagu sheegay in joogitaanka Turkiga uu gacan ka geysanayo ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga ee muhiimka ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed, Badda Carabta iyo biyaha ku dhow xeebaha Soomaaliya. Deegaannadaas ayaa ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee isku xira Badweynta Hindiya, Badda Cas iyo Kanaalka Suweys, waxaana mara qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah ganacsiga caalamka. Xiriir soo bilowday 2011 Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya ayaa si weyn isugu soo dhowaaday tan iyo 2011, markaas oo Erdogan, oo xilligaas ahaa ra’iisul-wasaare, uu booqasho ku yimid Muqdisho xilli dalka ay ka jirtay abaar daran. Tan iyo waqtigaas, Ankara ayaa ballaarisay joogitaankeeda Soomaaliya, iyadoo maalgelisay mashaariic caafimaad, waxbarasho, kaabayaal dhaqaale, gargaar bani’aadannimo iyo tababarka ciidamada. Turkiga ayaa Muqdisho ku leh saldhigga TURKSOM, oo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee tababarka ciidamada Turkiga ku leeyahay meel ka baxsan dalkiisa. Saldhiggaas ayaa lagu tababaray kumannaan askari oo Soomaali ah, oo ay ku jiraan ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Gorgor. Ankara ayaa sidoo kale tababar iyo taageero siisay ciidamada booliska Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan cutubyada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad. Iskaashiga labada dal ayaa si gaar ah u ballaartay sanadihii ugu dambeeyay, kaddib markii bishii February 2024 la saxiixay heshiis toban sano soconaya oo ku saabsan difaaca iyo dhaqaalaha. Heshiiskaas waxaa ka mid ah taageerada Turkiga ee dhismaha awoodda ciidamada badda Soomaaliya iyo ilaalinta kheyraadka ku jira biyaha dalka, xilli ay dowladda Soomaaliya la tacaaleyso kalluumeysi sharci-darro ah iyo khataro kale oo ka jira xeebaha. Baarlamaanka Turkiga ayaa bishii July 2024 ansixiyay in ciidamada Turkiga loo diro Soomaaliya iyo biyaheeda, si ay uga taageeraan sugidda amniga iyo fulinta heshiiska difaaca. Qaraarka Golaha Ammaanka Mooshinka Erdogan ayaa sidoo kale tixraacay qaraar uu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ansixiyay 1-dii December 2023, kaas oo meesha looga qaaday cunaqabateyntii hubka ee muddada dheer saarneyd dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Qaraarka 2714 ayaa dowladda Soomaaliya u fududeeyay inay si sharci ah u hesho hub iyo qalab ay ku dhisto ciidamadeeda, inkasta oo beesha caalamku ay ku baaqday in la xoojiyo nidaamka maamulka iyo ilaalinta hubka. Turkiga ayaa sheegay in taageeradiisu ay gacan ka geysan doonto xasilloonida muddada dheer ee Soomaaliya, awoodda ay ku ilaalin karto kheyraadkeeda iyo dhismaha hay’ado difaac oo shaqeyn kara. Codsiga cusub ayaa muujinaya in Ankara ay doonayso inay sii xoojiso kaalinteeda Soomaaliya, xilli labada dal ay sidoo kale ballaarinayaan iskaashiga dhinacyada tamarta, dhaqaalaha iyo ilaalinta badda. Baarlamaanka Turkiga ayaa la filayaa inuu ka doodo mooshinka, hase yeeshee ansixintiisa ayaa loo arkaa mid aad u badan, maadaama xisbiga Erdogan iyo xulafadiisu ay aqlabiyad ku leeyihiin golaha. items.title: US applauds Somalia after extradition of Abdikerm Eidle in alleged $250 million Feeding Our Future fraud case
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United States on Sunday praised Somalia’s federal government for its continued law enforcement cooperation after Mogadishu extradited Somali American Abdikerm Eidle, 42, who is wanted by U.S. authorities over an alleged $250 million pandemic-era fraud scheme involving the theft of federal child nutrition funds. The public expression of appreciation from Washington came days after Somali authorities handed over Eidle , a fugitive who had been sought for four years in connection with the sprawling “Feeding Our Future” investigation, one of the largest alleged COVID-19 relief fraud cases in the United States. In a statement posted on X, the U.S. Embassy in Mogadishu said the latest cooperation underscored the strength of bilateral law enforcement coordination and its role in combating transnational crime. “The United States appreciates continued law enforcement cooperation with the Federal Government of Somalia. Recent coordination demonstrates how close partnerships, grounded in respect for each country’s laws and practices, can enhance security, deny safe haven to criminals, and help keep Americans and Somali citizens safe,” the embassy said.”We hope this cooperation sets a strong standard for future efforts.” The statement marked Washington’s first public response since Somali authorities arrested and extradited Eidle, highlighting U.S. appreciation for Mogadishu’s role in a case that has drawn significant attention in both countries. The extradition, however, has generated mixed reactions inside Somalia. While it earned praise from the United States, many Somalis questioned the legal basis for transferring a suspect to U.S. custody, arguing that no publicly known extradition agreement exists between the two countries. Despite the domestic criticism, Somalia’s cooperation has strengthened its law enforcement partnership with Washington as Mogadishu continues to seek sustained U.S. security assistance in its campaign against Al-Shabaab amid relations that have remained under strain. Eidle was arrested in Mogadishu on June 25 during a joint operation coordinated by the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA). He had allegedly remained a fugitive for four years and is accused of being one of the alleged ringleaders of the “Feeding Our Future” scheme, which U.S. prosecutors say fraudulently diverted approximately $250 million intended to provide meals for children during the COVID-19 pandemic. Somali government officials, who faced widespread criticism on social media following the operation, have yet to publicly comment on Eidle’s arrest or his extradition to the United States. This latest episode underscores the growing operational cooperation between Somalia and the United States on cross-border law enforcement while also exposing the domestic political sensitivities surrounding high-profile extraditions, an issue that has fueled debate among Somalis even as Washington publicly commended Mogadishu’s cooperation. items.title: Parliament set to reopen as fight for speaker post heats up
items.description: Somalia’s federal parliament will reopen on August 1 with a battle for the vacant Speaker post already dominating the agenda, as lawmakers from both houses are summoned back to Mogadishu for the start of the 8th session. The contest was triggered when Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur Madobe stepped down as Speaker of the House of the People to become President of South West State. Several candidates, including sitting federal ministers and lawmakers from South West constituencies, are now jockeying for one of the most powerful offices in the country. The stakes go well beyond who chairs debates. Under Somalia’s power-sharing arrangement, the Speaker’s post is traditionally reserved for South West State and ranks second only to the presidency in the federal hierarchy. The outcome will shape the balance of power inside parliament at a moment when the Federal Government is already at odds with opposition figures and some member states over the country’s electoral roadmap, making this contest a proxy for wider tensions rather than a routine internal vote. The seat has sat empty since Madobe’s June 10 election as South West State president, a vote that went ahead in Baidoa after his leading rival withdrew, alleging irregularities. In the interim, First Deputy Speaker Sadiya Yasin Haji has held the position on an acting basis. According to sources close to parliament, the field of candidates remains fluid, with no clear frontrunner yet declared and campaigning largely happening behind closed doors ahead of the reopening. A statement from Parliament’s leadership, announcing the August 1 date, urged all MPs and senators to travel to Mogadishu without delay so the session can begin work immediately, though it stopped short of setting a firm date for the Speaker vote itself. Political observers say the contest will be an early test of how much influence the Federal Government can exert over the selection, at a time when relations between Mogadishu and opposition-aligned regions remain strained over broader questions of electoral legitimacy. The seat has sat empty since Madobe’s June 10 election as South West State president, a vote that went ahead in Baidoa after his leading rival withdrew, alleging irregularities. In the interim, First Deputy Speaker Sadiya Yasin Haji has held the position on an acting basis. According to sources close to parliament, the field of candidates remains fluid, with no clear frontrunner yet declared and campaigning largely happening behind closed doors ahead of the reopening. A statement from Parliament’s leadership, announcing the August 1 date, urged all MPs and senators to travel to Mogadishu without delay so the session can begin work immediately, though it stopped short of setting a firm date for the Speaker vote itself. Political observers say the contest will be an early test of how much influence the Federal Government can exert over the selection, at a time when relations between Mogadishu and opposition-aligned regions remain strained over broader questions of electoral legitimacy. items.title: Xog: Maxaa looga hadlayaa wada-hadallada berri ee DF Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa berri oo Isniin ah, kuna beegan 20-ka July, markale ka furmaya wareeg cusub oo ka mid ah wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo uu garwadeen ka yahay Turkiga. Shirkan ayaa lagu wadaa inuu noqdo mid sii amba-qaadaya dadaallada lagu raadinayo is-afgarad siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. Kulankan ayaa qorshuhu yahay inay isku hor fariistaan wakiillada Dowladda Federaalka iyo saddexda garab ee mucaaradka, kuwaas oo kala ah Golaha Mustaqbalka, Golaha Midnimo Qaran iyo Isbaheysiga Nabad iyo Nolol. Ujeeddada ugu weyn ayaa ah in xal looga gaaro arrimaha la xiriira nooca doorasho ee Soomaaliya ay yeelan doonto iyo qodobbada weli la isku mari la’yahay. Waxaa la filayaa in kulanka berri si qoto dheer loogu guda galo doodihii ka bilowday shirkii dhacay 9-kii Luulyo, kaas oo labada dhinac ay ku soo bandhigeen aragtiyahooda ku aaddan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Inkastoo kulankaasi uu horseeday isku soo dhawaansho ballaaran, haddana ma uusan dhalin heshiis rasmi ah oo laga gaaro qodobbadii ugu adkaa ee la isku hayay. Wararka laga helayo wadaxaajoodyada ayaa sheegaya in dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay weli ku kala aragti duwan yihiin dhowr arrimood oo muhiim ah, inkastoo labada dhinacba ay muujiyeen inay diyaar u yihiin sii wadista wada hadallada si loo gaaro is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Mas’uul ka tirsan wafdiga dowladda Federaalka ee ku jira wadaxaajoodyadan ayaa xaqiijiyay in dhankooda ay diyaar u yihiin qabsoomidda shirka berri. Mas’uulkan ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay ka go’an tahay in wada-hadalladu miro-dhalaan, balse aysan marnaba gorgortan ka geli doonin waxa uu ku tilmaamay masiirka iyo rabitaanka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Mas’uulkaasi oo la hadlay warbaahinta Mustaqbal ayaa sidoo kale rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyay in wejigan cusub ee wada-hadallada lagu gaaro natiijo wax ku ool ah, isagoo xusay inay hadda sugayaan oo keliya in dhinaca mucaaradku uu si buuxda uga soo qeyb-galo kulanka si wadaxaajoodyadu u bilaabmaan. Qodobka ugu weyn ee miiska saaran ayaa ah hannaanka doorashooyinka, iyadoo mucaaradku aysan weli si rasmi ah uga doodin ama uga hadlin hannaanka dhammaystirka Dastuurka ee ay dowladda Federaalka ansixisay bishii Maarso. Arrintan ayaa kamid ah qodobbada weli u baahan in labada dhinac ay ka yeeshaan aragti mideysan. Sidoo kale, waxaa jira kala aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan goobaha ay doorashooyinku ka dhici doonaan. Qaar kamid ah mucaaradka ayaa qaba in doorashada lagu koobo magaalooyin cayiman, halka dowladda Federaalka iyo xubno kale oo mucaaradka ka tirsan ay ku doodayaan in doorasho qof iyo cod ah laga qabto guud ahaan dalka. Qodob kale oo xasaasi ah ayaa ah qaab-dhismeedka guddiga doorashooyinka. Mucaaradka ayaa soo jeediyay in la sameeyo laba heer oo guddiyo ah, kuwaas oo kala ah heer federaal iyo heer dowlad-goboleed, halka dowladda iyo qayb ka mid ah mucaaradkuba ay taageersan yihiin in la dhiso hal guddi doorasho oo heer qaran ah. Si kastaba, kulanka berri ayaa la filayaa in diiradda lagu saaro sidii la isugu soo dhaweyn lahaa aragtiyahaas kala duwan, loona soo saari lahaa hal qorshe oo ay ku mideysan yihiin dowladda iyo mucaaradka. items.title: Guryo iyo ganacsi oo laga dhisayo Tarabuunka
items.description: Mashruuc Cusub oo Laga Hirgeliyay Deegaanka Tarabuunka ee Muqdisho Guryo cusub, goobo ganacsi, iyo adeegyo bulsho ayaa ka mid ah waxyaabaha uu ka kooban yahay mashruucan. Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – Maamulka gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta khaati u taagay hirgelinta mashruuc horumarineed oo cusub oo laga dhisayo deegaanka Tarabuunka ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo loogu magac daray Beerta Dream. Mashruucan ayaa ka mid ah hindisayaasha ugu waaweyn ee laga hirgeliyo caasimadda dalka, waxaanu ka koobnaan doonaa guryo cusub, goobo ganacsi, iskuulo, xarumo caafimaad, iyo waddooyin laami ah. Horumar Cusub oo Muqdisho Hirgelinta Beerta Dream ayaa imaanaysa iyadoo magaalada Muqdisho ay marayso heer cusub oo dib u dhis iyo horumar ah, kaas oo ay dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka gobolka Banaadir si wada jir ah uga shaqaynayaan sidii loo soo celin lahaa amniga iyo kalsoonida bulshada. Mashruucan ayaa loo arkayaa inuu yahay mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka muhiimka ah ee lagu xoojinayo horumarka magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan deegaannada dhexe ee magaalada. Maxay Ka Kooban Tahay Beerta Dream? Beerta Dream waxay noqon doontaa meel isku dhafan oo ay ku yaalaan: Qaybta Sharaxaad Guryo cusub Guryo loogu talagalay dadweynaha deegaanka Goobo ganacsi Dukaamo, makhaayado, iyo xarumo ganacsi oo kale Adeegyo bulsho Iskuulo, xarumo caafimaad, iyo goobo madadaalo Kaabayaal Waddooyin cusub oo laami ah iyo adeegyo kale Mashruucan ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga iyo bulshada ee magaalada Muqdisho, taasoo keenta inuu soo jiito maalgashadayaal badan oo kaga yimaada dalka iyo dibaddaba.   Hadal Ka Soo Yeeray Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir Maamulka gobolka Banaadir ayaa ku tilmaamay mashruucan mid muhiim u ah horumarka magaalada Muqdisho. “Beerta Dream waxay ka mid tahay qorshaha guud ee dib u dhiska magaalada Muqdisho. Waxaan ugu talagalnay inay noqoto meel ay bulshadu ku heli karto adeegyo tayo leh, isla markaana ay ka qayb qaadato kobcinta dhaqaalaha deegaanka.” Waa Maxay Mustaqbalka Beerta Dream? Mashruuca Beerta Dream ayaa la filayaa inuu dhammaado muddo laba sano gudahood, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay inay maalgashato mashruucyo kale oo noocaan ah si loo xoojiyo horumarka magaalada Muqdisho. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in Beerta Dream ay noqoto mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga iyo bulshada ee magaalada Muqdisho, taasoo keenta inay soo jiidato maalgashadayaal badan oo kaga yimaada dalka iyo dibaddaba. The post Guryo iyo ganacsi oo laga dhisayo Tarabuunka first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somaliland oo noqotay bogcad mihiim ah oo leh muhiimad sii kordheysa
items.description: Warbaahinta caalamiga ah ee The Jerusalem Post ayaa tilmaantay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay noqotay meel istaraatiiji ah oo leh muhiimad sii kordheysa, taas oo ay sabab u yihiin goobteedda juqraafiyeed, xasilloonideeda siyaasadeed iyo muhiimadda ballaadhan ee dekedda Berbera oo ku taalla marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo isku xidhka suuqyada caalamiga ah. Warbixintu waxay xustay in Somaliland, tan iyo markii ay dib ula soo noqotay madaxbannaanideeda sannadkii 1991, ay dhistay hay’ado dowladeed, nidaam doorashooyin, ciidamo amni iyo hannaan maamul oo u gaar ah. Arrimahaas ayaa, sida lagu sheegay warbixinta ay Somaliland ku kasbatay taageerayaal caalami ah oo u arka in ay muujisay awood ay si amni iyo xasillooni ah ugu maamusho dhulkeeda, isla markaana ay dhistay nidaam siyaasadeed oo deggan marka loo eego xaalado badan oo ka jira gobolka. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay dekedda Berbera waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah hantida ugu muhiimsan ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, iyadoo soo jiidatay maalgashi caalami ah. Iyada oo maalgashiga ballaadhan ee ay ku samaysay shirkadda DP World uu kor u qaaday awoodda dekedda, tayada adeegyada ay bixiso iyo doorkeeda ganacsi ee gobolka. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale tilmaantay in Berbera ay muhiim u tahay Itoobiya oo ah dal aan lahayn xeeb, maadaama ay siin karto marin ganacsi oo isku xidha Geeska Afrika iyo suuqyada caalamka. Sidoo kale warbixinta ayaa lagu sheegay in goobta ay ku taallo ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ay ka dhigeen Somaliland meel muhiim u ah amniga maraakiibta iyo ilaalinta isu socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, warbixintu waxay sheegtay in taageerayaasha caalamiga ah ee Somaliland ay aaminsan yihiin in aqoonsi buuxa oo ay hesho Somaliland uu noqon karo tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo nabadda, maalgashiga iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Warbixinta ayaa ku dooday in Somaliland ay leedahay astaamo badan oo dowladnimo, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin dhul ay si wax ku ool ah u maamusho, shacab leh aqoonsi siyaasadeed, hay’ado dowladeed oo shaqeynaya, ciidamo amni oo ilaaliya xasilloonida, iyo doorashooyin xor ah iyo hannaan siyaasadeed oo u gaar ah. Warbixintu waxay intaas ku dartay in Somaliland ay waddo dadaallo ay ku dhiseyso xidhiidho caalami ah oo kala duwan si ay u horumariso danahaheeda dhaqaale iyo amni. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa ka mid ah dalalka maalgashiga ku sameeyay dekedda Berbera, halka xidhiidhada cusub ee Somaliland la yeelatay dalal kale ay abuureen fursado muujinaya doorka ay Somaliland ka qaadan karto amniga Badda Cas iyo ganacsiga gobolka. Ugu dambayn, warbixintu waxay ku soo gabagabaysay in korodhka xiisaha caalamiga ah ee Geeska Afrika uu Somaliland siinayo fursad ay ku muujiso muhiimaddeeda istiraatiijiga ah. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta muhiimadda Dekedda Berbera, xasilloonida maxaliga ah iyo goobta juqraafiyeed ayaa Somaliland ka dhigaya lamaane muhiim ah oo ka mid ah gobolka Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Somalia, UK deepen military ties in Mogadishu talks
items.description: Somali National Army (SNA) Commander Brigadier General Ibrahim Mohamed Mohamud met with Colonel Andy Seddon, Commander of United Kingdom Operations in Somalia, in Mogadishu this week to discuss strengthening defence, security and military cooperation between the two nations. The talks focused on advancing bilateral military relations and reaffirmed joint efforts to support the training and development of Somali forces. The meeting comes as Somalia continues its offensive against al-Shabaab militants while working to rebuild its security institutions. The discussion is the latest in a series of high-level engagements Mogadishu has held with foreign partners in recent months, as Somalia races to professionalize its armed forces ahead of the planned handover of security responsibilities from African Union troops to national forces. Britain has been among Somalia’s principal security partners for over a decade, providing training, mentoring and logistical support to the SNA as part of a broader Western-backed effort to stabilize the country. The UK also contributes personnel to international missions operating alongside Somali forces. Officials on both sides described Thursday’s meeting as part of ongoing efforts to reinforce the security and defence partnership between Mogadishu and London, at a time when Somalia is simultaneously battling militant groups and working to rebuild its security architecture from the ground up. items.title: Sting Balls Fired as Protesters Block Chicago ICE Entrance
items.description: Protesters Clash With ICE Outside Chicago Facility, Multiple Arrests Made Protester learns costly lesson after attempting to block ICE facility entrance. BROADVIEW, Illinois – A confrontation between demonstrators and law enforcement outside an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) facility in suburban Chicago escalated on September 26, 2025, resulting in multiple arrests and injuries. The protest unfolded at the Broadview facility as officers used crowd-control measures including tear gas and sting ball grenades to disperse demonstrators who had blocked the entrance . Protesters had gathered to oppose immigration enforcement operations, with some physically attempting to prevent ICE vehicles from entering the facility . The demonstration quickly turned volatile when officers in riot gear deployed canisters of tear gas to push back the crowd . Illinois State Police later declared an unlawful assembly, leading to additional detentions . Sting Balls Fired as Protesters Block Chicago ICE Entrance “One protester appeared to believe she could act with impunity, blocking the entrance without consequence,” a law enforcement source told reporters. Officers ultimately deployed sting ball grenades—non-lethal munitions that release rubber pellets—to clear the blockade, striking several demonstrators. Emergency personnel treated multiple individuals at the scene for tear gas inhalation . Photographs from the site showed one protester being helped away after inhaling tear gas, while others continued throwing canisters back at officers . Tear gas deployed and multiple arrests made after confrontation outside Illinois immigration facility The Broadview facility has become a flashpoint in the ongoing national debate over immigration enforcement. Saturday’s clash followed similar confrontations reported in previous weeks, with officers forming barricaded perimeters to maintain access to the facility . Police confirmed several arrests were made during the confrontation, though exact numbers were not immediately released . The scene underscores the heightened tensions surrounding ICE operations in Chicago and reflects broader national divisions over immigration policy. items.title: Iran oo ka hadashay weerarka uu Mareykanka uu ka fuliyay dalkeeda
items.description: Tehran ( Raxanreeb Online) Mas’uuliyiinta maxalliga ah iyo warbaahinta Iiraan ayaa sheegay in Maraykanku uu qaaday weerarro cusub oo lagu beegsaday goobo ku yaalla gobollada Khuzestan iyo Hormozgan. Ku-xigeenka mas’uulka amniga ee xafiiska guddoomiyaha gobolka Khuzestan ayaa sheegay in diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Maraykanka ay saacaddu markay ahayd 5:55 subaxnimo gantaallo ku garaaceen goob ku dhow magaalada Shadegan. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada hawlgalka ay ku sugan yihiin goobta, isla markaana faahfaahinta khasaaraha la shaacin doono mar dambe. Sidoo kale, Wakaaladda Wararka Tasnim ayaa sheegtay in qiyaastii 6:10 subaxnimo, diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Maraykanku ay mar kale duqeeyeen goobo ku yaalla Jasiiradda Qeshm, halkaas oo laga maqlay ugu yaraan laba qarax. Sida ay wakaaladdu sheegtay, baaritaan ayaa weli socda si loo ogaado meelaha saxda ah ee la beegsaday iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay weerarrada. Tasnim waxay intaas ku dartay in saacadihii ka horreeyay weerarkan sidoo kale gantaallo dhowr ah lagu garaacay goobo kale oo ku yaalla Jasiiradda Qeshm. Sikastaba, saraakiisha Maraykanka ayaan weli wax faallo ah ka bixin wararkan, waxaana faahfaahinta weerarrada aan weli si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. The post Iran oo ka hadashay weerarka uu Mareykanka uu ka fuliyay dalkeeda appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Maamulka Waqooyi Bari oo shacabka uga digay inay faafiyaan warar been abuur ah
items.description: Laascaanood ( Raxanreeb Online) Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa soo saaray digniin ku socota shaqsiyaad iyo kooxo uu ku eedeeyay inay bulshada ku faafinayaan warar been abuur ah oo keeni kara jahawareer iyo xasilooni darro. Qoraal kasoo baxay wasaaradda warfaafinta maamulka Waqooyi Bari, ayaa lagu sheegay in dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada in si mas’uuliyad leh u adeegsadaan kana fogaadaan faafinta xog aan la hubin oo bulshada kicin kara. Waxa kale oo uu xusay in tallaabo sharci ah laga qaadi karo cid kasta oo lagu helo inay si ula kac ah u baahiso warar been abuur ah oo dhaawacaya nabadda iyo kala dambeynta. Dhanka kale, Maamulka ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka inay xogta ka helaan ilo rasmi ah, isla markaana ay ka fogaadaan faafinta wararka aan la xaqiijin. Qaar ka mid ah bulshada ayaa soo dhaweeyay digniinta, iyagoo sheegay in loo baahan yahay in laga hortago xogaha marin habaabinta ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa sidoo kale la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in tallaabooyinka la qaadayo ay ixtiraamaan xorriyadda hadalka iyo helitaanka macluumaadka saxda ah. items.title: Hoggaamiyaha IRAN oo war cusub ka soo saaray dagaalka Mareykanka
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyaha Sare ee Iran, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei ayaa ku eedeeyay Mareykanka inuu jebiyay dhammaan heshiisyadii xabbad-joojinta, isagoo sheegay in Iran ay xaq u leedahay inay iska difaacdo waxa uu ku tilmaamay gardarro joogto ah oo uga imaaneysa Washington. Bayaan qoraal ah oo laga akhriyay telefishinka dowladda Iran ayaa lagu sheegay in hoggaanka dalkaasi uu ku adkeysanayo in Iran aysan ka tanaasuli doonin difaaca madax-bannaanideeda, isla markaana ay qaadi doonto tallaabo kasta oo lagama maarmaan u ah sugidda amniga dalka. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in Tehran ay xoojin doonto iskaashiga ay la leedahay saaxiibadeeda caalamiga ah, si wadajir ahna ay uga hortagaan waxa ay ku tilmaantay gardarrada Mareykanka iyo tallaabooyinka sii hurinaya xiisadda gobolka. Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei ayaa intaas ku daray in siyaasadda ku dhisan awood sheegashada iyo cadaadiska aysan hadda ka sii shaqeyn karin dunida, isagoo sheegay in Iran iyo xulafadeedu ay ka hortagi doonaan isku day kasta oo lagu caburinayo. Hadalladan adag ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Mareykanka uu toddobaadkan sare u qaaday weerarrada uu ku hayo Iran, kuwaas oo sii kordhiyay xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dal, isla markaana walaac ka abuuray gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Dowladda Iran ayaa ku eedeysay Mareykanka in weerarradiisa ay si toos ah u bartilmaameedsadeen goobo rayid ah, iyadoo sheegtay in waxyeello loo geystay dadka shacabka ah iyo kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee dalka. Iran ayaa sidoo kale ku doodday in weerarradaasi ay saameeyeen buundooyin, khadadka tareennada iyo ceelasha biyaha, kuwaas oo kamid ah adeegyada aas-aasiga u ah nolosha shacabka, inkastoo Mareykanka uusan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin eedeymahaas. Si kastaba, xiisadda sii xoogeysaneysa ee u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo inay colaaddu kasii ballaarato gobolka, iyadoo hadallada kulul iyo is eedeyntu ay sii adkeynayaan rajada laga qabo in labada dhinac ay dib ugu laabtaan wadahadal ama heshiis lagu dejinayo xaaladda. The post Hoggaamiyaha IRAN oo war cusub ka soo saaray dagaalka Mareykanka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Mamdani oo qorsheynaya in uu xiro Netanyahu marka uu yimaado magaalada New York
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Duqa magaalada New York, Zohran Mamdani, ayaa sheegay in maamulkiisu uu baarayo awoodda sharci ee uu u leeyahay in la xiro ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu, marka uu magaalada yimaado bisha September si uu uga qeyb-galo shirarka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Mamdani ayaa sheegay in wada-hadallo sharci oo arrintan ku saabsan ay hadda u socdaan maamulka magaalada iyo waaxda sharciga ee New York, inkasta oo aan weli la caddeyn in duqa magaalo uu amri karo booliska inay xiraan hoggaamiye shisheeye oo dalka u yimid arrimo diblomaasiyadeed. “Waxaan aaminsanahay in ra’iisul wasaare Netanyahu uu ka tirsan yahay dadka ay tahay inay hor-tagaan maxkamadda Hague,” ayuu Mamdani ku yiri barnaamijka “The Interview” ee wargeyska The New York Times. “Waa qof lagu eedeeyay dambiyo dagaal oo ay waaran xarig u jartay Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah,” ayuu yiri Mamdani, oo ka tirsan garabka dimoqraadiyiinta hantiwadaagga ah ee Mareykanka. Mamdani ayaa intaas ku daray in aragtida uu qabo ay la qabaan dad badan oo ka careysan khasaaraha iyo burburka ka dhashay howlgallada milatari ee Israel ka waddo Marinka Gaza. Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah ee ICC ayaa November 2024 waaran xarig u jartay Netanyahu iyo wasiirkiisii hore ee gaashaandhigga Yoav Gallant. Garsoorayaasha maxkamadda ayaa sheegay inay heleen sababo macquul ah oo lagu rumeysan karo in labada mas’uul ay mas’uuliyad ka qaadi karaan dambiga dagaal ee gaajeysiinta shacabka loogu adeegsaday hab dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada, oo ay ku jiraan dil iyo cadaadis. Netanyahu iyo dowladda Israel ayaa si adag u diiday eedeymaha, iyaga oo ku doodaya in maxkamaddu aysan awood sharci u lahayn inay baaritaan ku sameyso ama amar kasoo saarto madaxda Israel. Netanyahu weli ma uusan hor-tegin ICC, lagumana xukumin eedeymaha loo haysto. Mamdani wuxuu qiray in su’aalo waaweyn ay ka taagan yihiin awoodda uu duqa New York u leeyahay inuu Booliska New York, ee NYPD, ku amro fulinta waaran ay soo saartay maxkamad aanay dowladda Mareykanku aqoonsaneyn awooddeeda. “Wax kasta oo sharcigu ii oggol yahay inaan ka sameeyo magaalada New York, waan sameyn doonnaa,” ayuu yiri. “Laakiin ma qori doonno sharciyo noo gaar ah si aan u gaarno ujeeddadaas.” Duqa magaalada ayaa sheegay in maamulkiisu uu arrintan kala tashanayo Waaxda Sharciga ee New York, si loo ogaado tallaabooyinka ay qaadi karaan hay’adaha magaalada haddii Netanyahu uu yimaado Manhattan. Caqabado sharci Hase yeeshee, isku day kasta oo lagu doonayo in lagu xiro Netanyahu ayaa la filayaa inuu dhaliyo iska hor-imaad sharci iyo mid siyaasadeed oo dhex mara maamulka New York iyo dowladda federaalka Mareykanka. Mareykanka iyo Israel kama mid aha dalalka ansixiyay heshiiska Rome ee lagu dhisay ICC, halka siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda, xiriirka dowladaha iyo xasaanadda hoggaamiyeyaasha shisheeye ay inta badan hoos tagaan awoodda dowladda federaalka. Sidoo kale, madaxda shisheeye ee u socda xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ayaa heli kara ilaalin iyo xasaanad la xiriirta safarradooda rasmiga ah. Khubaro sharci ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay u badan tahay inay Netanyahu u aqoonsato hoggaamiye leh xasaanad, taas oo si weyn u adkeyn karta tallaabo kasta oo ay qaadaan mas’uuliyiinta magaalada. Netanyahu ayaa la filayaa inuu ka qeyb-galo doodda guud ee kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ka furmi doonta New York 22-ka September 2026. Mamdani ayaa intii uu ku jiray ololihii doorashada duqa magaalada sannadkii hore ballan-qaaday inuu NYPD ku amri doono inay fuliso waaranka ICC haddii Netanyahu uu yimaado New York. Hadalkiisa cusub ayaa muujinaya inuu weli ku adkeysanayo ballan-qaadkaas, balse uu hadda xoogga saarayo in tallaabo kasta lagu saleeyo sharciga jira. Netanyahu ayaa dhankiisa ku eedeeyay Mamdani inuu la safan yahay ururka Xamaas, oo weerarkii 7-dii October 2023 ku qaaday Israel uu horseeday dagaalka Gaza. “Waa inuu fiiriyaa cidda uu cambaareynayo iyo cidda uu taageerayo,” ayuu Netanyahu ku yiri wareysi uu siiyay weriyaha idaacadda New York Sid Rosenberg. “Wuxuu cambaareynayaa Israel, oo ah dimoqraadiyadda garab taagan qiyamka Mareykanka. Yuu taageerayaa? Xamaas,” ayuu raaciyay Netanyahu, oo sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Mamdani inuu si qarsoon u neceb yahay Mareykanka. Mamdani ayaa marar badan cambaareeyay weerarkii Xamaas ee 7-dii October, balse xuquuqda Falastiiniyiinta iyo dhaleeceynta ololaha milatari ee Israel ayaa noqday qeyb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah mowqifkiisa siyaasadeed. Wuxuu howlgallada Israel ee Gaza ku tilmaamay xasuuq, eedeyn ay dowladda Israel si adag u diidday. Guddi madax-bannaan oo baaritaan oo ay Qaramada Midoobay leedahay ayaa September 2025 soo gabagabeeyay in Israel ay xasuuq ka geysatay Gaza, halka Israel ay warbixintaas ku tilmaantay mid qalloocan oo dano siyaasadeed laga leeyahay. Danjiraha Israel u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay, Danny Danon, ayaa sheegay in hadalka Mamdani uusan waxba ka beddeli doonin qorshaha Netanyahu. “Ra’iisul wasaare Netanyahu wuxuu imaan doonaa New York, wuxuuna si sharaf leh ula hadli doonaa Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay,” ayuu Danon yiri. “Wuxuu dunida hor-tegi doonaa xaqiiqada Israel iyo xaqa aan laga tanaasuli karin ee ay u leedahay inay difaacdo muwaadiniinteeda.” Muranka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli taageerada xisbiga Dimoqraadiga ee Israel ay si muuqata u wiiqmeyso, kadib ku dhowaad saddex sano oo dagaal ah oo ka socda Gaza. Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa toddobaadkan codad gaaraya 314-104 ku diiday soo-jeedin lagu joojin lahaa $3.3 bilyan oo Mareykanku sannad kasta gargaar milatari ahaan u siiyo Israel. Inkastoo soo-jeedinta la diiday, 103 mudane oo Dimuqraadiyiin ah ayaa taageeray, taas oo muujisay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid mowqifka xisbiga ee ku aaddan Israel, oo muddo dheer loo arkayay mid ka mid ah xulafada ugu dhow Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. “Way adag tahay in la helo siyaasad ka sii fashilan habka uu dalkeennu ula dhaqmay Gaza iyo Falastiin,” ayuu Mamdani yiri. items.fullContent: New York (Caasimada Online) – Duqa magaalada New York, Zohran Mamdani, ayaa sheegay in maamulkiisu uu baarayo awoodda sharci ee uu u leeyahay in la xiro ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu, marka uu magaalada yimaado bisha September si uu uga qeyb-galo shirarka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Mamdani ayaa sheegay in wada-hadallo sharci oo arrintan ku saabsan ay hadda u socdaan maamulka magaalada iyo waaxda sharciga ee New York, inkasta oo aan weli la caddeyn in duqa magaalo uu amri karo booliska inay xiraan hoggaamiye shisheeye oo dalka u yimid arrimo diblomaasiyadeed. “Waxaan aaminsanahay in ra’iisul wasaare Netanyahu uu ka tirsan yahay dadka ay tahay inay hor-tagaan maxkamadda Hague,” ayuu Mamdani ku yiri barnaamijka “The Interview” ee wargeyska The New York Times. “Waa qof lagu eedeeyay dambiyo dagaal oo ay waaran xarig u jartay Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah,” ayuu yiri Mamdani, oo ka tirsan garabka dimoqraadiyiinta hantiwadaagga ah ee Mareykanka. Mamdani ayaa intaas ku daray in aragtida uu qabo ay la qabaan dad badan oo ka careysan khasaaraha iyo burburka ka dhashay howlgallada milatari ee Israel ka waddo Marinka Gaza. Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah ee ICC ayaa November 2024 waaran xarig u jartay Netanyahu iyo wasiirkiisii hore ee gaashaandhigga Yoav Gallant. Garsoorayaasha maxkamadda ayaa sheegay inay heleen sababo macquul ah oo lagu rumeysan karo in labada mas’uul ay mas’uuliyad ka qaadi karaan dambiga dagaal ee gaajeysiinta shacabka loogu adeegsaday hab dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada, oo ay ku jiraan dil iyo cadaadis. Netanyahu iyo dowladda Israel ayaa si adag u diiday eedeymaha, iyaga oo ku doodaya in maxkamaddu aysan awood sharci u lahayn inay baaritaan ku sameyso ama amar kasoo saarto madaxda Israel. Netanyahu weli ma uusan hor-tegin ICC, lagumana xukumin eedeymaha loo haysto. Mamdani wuxuu qiray in su’aalo waaweyn ay ka taagan yihiin awoodda uu duqa New York u leeyahay inuu Booliska New York, ee NYPD, ku amro fulinta waaran ay soo saartay maxkamad aanay dowladda Mareykanku aqoonsaneyn awooddeeda. “Wax kasta oo sharcigu ii oggol yahay inaan ka sameeyo magaalada New York, waan sameyn doonnaa,” ayuu yiri. “Laakiin ma qori doonno sharciyo noo gaar ah si aan u gaarno ujeeddadaas.” Duqa magaalada ayaa sheegay in maamulkiisu uu arrintan kala tashanayo Waaxda Sharciga ee New York, si loo ogaado tallaabooyinka ay qaadi karaan hay’adaha magaalada haddii Netanyahu uu yimaado Manhattan. Caqabado sharci Hase yeeshee, isku day kasta oo lagu doonayo in lagu xiro Netanyahu ayaa la filayaa inuu dhaliyo iska hor-imaad sharci iyo mid siyaasadeed oo dhex mara maamulka New York iyo dowladda federaalka Mareykanka. Mareykanka iyo Israel kama mid aha dalalka ansixiyay heshiiska Rome ee lagu dhisay ICC, halka siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda, xiriirka dowladaha iyo xasaanadda hoggaamiyeyaasha shisheeye ay inta badan hoos tagaan awoodda dowladda federaalka. Sidoo kale, madaxda shisheeye ee u socda xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ayaa heli kara ilaalin iyo xasaanad la xiriirta safarradooda rasmiga ah. Khubaro sharci ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay u badan tahay inay Netanyahu u aqoonsato hoggaamiye leh xasaanad, taas oo si weyn u adkeyn karta tallaabo kasta oo ay qaadaan mas’uuliyiinta magaalada. Hadalkiisa cusub ayaa muujinaya inuu weli ku adkeysanayo ballan-qaadkaas, balse uu hadda xoogga saarayo in tallaabo kasta lagu saleeyo sharciga jira. Netanyahu ayaa dhankiisa ku eedeeyay Mamdani inuu la safan yahay ururka Xamaas, oo weerarkii 7-dii October 2023 ku qaaday Israel uu horseeday dagaalka Gaza. “Waa inuu fiiriyaa cidda uu cambaareynayo iyo cidda uu taageerayo,” ayuu Netanyahu ku yiri wareysi uu siiyay weriyaha idaacadda New York Sid Rosenberg. “Wuxuu cambaareynayaa Israel, oo ah dimoqraadiyadda garab taagan qiyamka Mareykanka. Yuu taageerayaa? Xamaas,” ayuu raaciyay Netanyahu, oo sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Mamdani inuu si qarsoon u neceb yahay Mareykanka. items.title: Askar Mareykan ah oo lagu dilay Jordan
items.description: Jordan ( Raxanreeb Online) Laba askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa la dilay, halka mid kalena weli la la’yahay, kadib weerarro ay Iiraan ay u adeegsatay gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo ka dhacay Jordan maalintii Jimcaha, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha milatariga. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in afar askari oo Mareykan ah loo qaaday isbitaallo ku yaalla Jordan si loogu daweeyo dhaawacyo soo gaaray, balse hadda dhammaantood waa laga saaray isbitaalka. Askar kale oo dhaawacyo fudud qabayna waxay dib ugu laabteen shaqadoodii. Saraakiisha milatariga Mareykanka ma shaacin magacyada askarta la dilay, mana aysan bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan sida ay dhacdadu u dhacday ama goobta saxda ah ee ay ka dhacday. Dhacdadan ayaa timid kadib toddobaad ay colaaddu dib u qaraxday, iyadoo Washington ay dib u soo rogtay xannibaaddii dekedaha Iiraan, halka Tehran ay ku dhawaaqday in marinka muhiimka ah ee Hormuz la xiray. Tani waxay dhacday kadib markii heshiis xabbad-joojin oo horudhac ahaa uu burburay wax ka yar bil markii uu dhaqan galay. The post Askar Mareykan ah oo lagu dilay Jordan appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somalia unveils National Cybersecurity Risk Management Framework
items.description: Somalia Launches National Cybersecurity Risk Management Framework to Protect Critical Infrastructure Mogadishu, Somalia – The National Communications Authority (NCA) has officially unveiled the National Cybersecurity Risk Management Framework, a landmark initiative designed to strengthen the country’s digital security and protect Critical Infrastructure (CI) that is vital to national security, economic stability, and public services. The Framework, which was finalized in June 2026, establishes a formal, standardized methodology for identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and managing cybersecurity risks across all sectors. It is aligned with international standards including ISO/IEC 27005 and ISO/IEC 27001 , ensuring that Somalia’s approach to cyber risk management meets global best practices. Why This Framework Matters Somalia has made significant strides in digital transformation over the past few years, including the modernization of government services, expansion of telecommunications infrastructure, growth of financial technology, and the digitization of essential public services. However, this rapid digital expansion has also introduced new and evolving cyber threats that could compromise: Confidentiality of sensitive data Integrity of information systems Availability of critical services The new Framework addresses these challenges by providing a clear and structured approach to risk management, helping organizations understand their vulnerabilities and take proactive steps to mitigate potential threats. Who Must Comply? The Framework applies to all government institutions and private sector operators that manage or operate Critical Infrastructure in Somalia. This includes: Telecommunications and network providers Financial institutions and banks Energy and utilities companies Healthcare and emergency services Transportation and logistics systems Government data centers and digital service platforms Under the Somalia Cybersecurity Law , all designated Critical Infrastructure operators are legally required to: Implement the Framework in full Conduct regular risk assessments Submit annual compliance reports to the National Communications Authority (NCA) Key Components of the Framework The Framework is built around a comprehensive risk management lifecycle, which includes: 1. Asset Identification and Classification Organizations must identify all digital and physical assets, classify them based on their importance, and assign ownership and accountability. 2. Threat Source Identification The Framework requires organizations to identify and evaluate potential threat sources, including: Threat Source Description Foreign Intelligence State-sponsored espionage and cyber operations Organized Crime Financially motivated cybercriminal groups Hacktivists Politically or socially motivated hackers Insider Threats Employees with malicious intent or negligence Extremist Organizations Groups targeting critical infrastructure Natural Disasters Fires, floods, earthquakes affecting digital systems 3. Risk Assessment Methodology The Framework uses a qualitative risk assessment approach, evaluating risks based on: Likelihood of occurrence Business Impact (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability – CIA) Risk Levels ranging from Trivial to Catastrophic 4. Risk Treatment Options Organizations must choose one of four risk treatment strategies: Strategy Description Avoidance Cease activities that introduce unacceptable risk Mitigation Implement controls to reduce risk to acceptable levels Transfer Shift risk to third-party providers or insurers Acceptance Accept risk when it falls within established tolerance levels 5. Monitoring and Reporting Continuous monitoring and annual reporting to the NCA are mandatory. Organizations must maintain documented evidence of: Risk assessments and findings Control implementation and testing Incident response and resolution Risk acceptance decisions Business Impact Classification The Framework introduces a four-level classification system to assess the business impact of cybersecurity incidents: Classification Level Impact Level Examples UNCLASSIFIED 0 – Trivial General information with no impact OFFICIAL 1 – Low Routine administrative data SECRET 2 – High Sensitive government or financial data TOP SECRET 3 – Extreme National security or strategic information CATASTROPHIC 4 – Critical Information that could cause national crisis What This Means for Somalia The launch of the National Cybersecurity Risk Management Framework marks a significant milestone in Somalia’s journey toward a secure and resilient digital future. Key benefits include: Strengthened national security posture Enhanced protection of critical services and infrastructure Increased public trust in digital government services Alignment with international cybersecurity standards Clear legal and regulatory compliance requirements Improved capacity to prevent, detect, and respond to cyber threats Statement from NCA Leadership “This Framework is not just a document – it is a commitment. It represents our determination to protect Somalia’s digital assets, safeguard our people’s data, and ensure that our critical infrastructure remains secure in the face of evolving cyber threats. We call upon all stakeholders to embrace this Framework and work with us to build a safer, more resilient digital Somalia.” National Communications Authority (NCA) Spokesperson Looking Ahead The NCA has announced that it will provide: Training and capacity-building programs for Critical Infrastructure operators Technical guidance and support for Framework implementation Regular updates and revisions to the Framework as threats evolve Organizations are encouraged to begin implementation immediately and are required to submit their first annual compliance reports by June 2027 . For More Information Website: https://nca.gov.so Document: National Cybersecurity Risk Management Framework – June 2026 The post Somalia unveils National Cybersecurity Risk Management Framework first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Wasiir Roobow oo looga yeeray baarlamaanka kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Garsoorka, Cadaaladda, Arrimaha Diinta iyo Awqaafta ee Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah ugu yeeray Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ee Soomaaliya, Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, si uu uga hor yimaado guddiga. Guddiga ayaa wasiir Roobow ugu yeeray si uu uga jawaabo su’aalo la xiriira arrimaha Xajka ee sanadkan. U yeeritaanka wasiirka ayaa timid kadib markii guddiga ay soo gaareen cabashooyin ay gudbiyeen qaar kamid ah muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo walaac ka muujiyay hannaanka maamulka adeegyada iyo sida loo agaasimay arrimaha Xajka. Cabashooyinkan ayaa la sheegay inay salka ku hayaan habraacyada iyo maamulka adeegyada la siiyay xujaajta Soomaaliyeed. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in waajibaadkiisa kormeer iyo la-xisaabtan uu ku qasbayo inuu si toos ah u dhageysto Wasiirka Awqaafta, si loo helo faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan cabashooyinka jira, loona caddeeyo sida ay wasaaraddu u maareysay howlaha la xiriira Xajka. Sida lagu sheegay qoraal rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay guddiga u yeerista Wasiir Mukhtaar Roobow waa mid waafaqsan awoodaha dastuuriga ah ee uu leeyahay Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan doorka uu ku leeyahay la-xisaabtanka hay’adaha fulinta. Qoraalka ayaa lagu caddeeyay in tallaabadan ay ku saleysan tahay qodobbada 95-aad, 81-aad iyo 82-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo sidoo kale Xeer-hoosaadka Aqalka Sare, kuwaas oo siinaya guddiyada baarlamaanka awood ay ku kormeeraan uguna yeeraan mas’uuliyiinta dowladda si ay uga jawaabaan arrimaha khuseeya shaqadooda. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee wasaaradda inay kasoo qeyb-galaan kulanka waqtiga loo asteeyay, iyagoo wata dhammaan xogaha iyo faahfaahinta lagama maarmaanka u ah in guddiga lala wadaago. Kulankan ayaa la filayaa inuu diiradda saaro jawaabaha ay wasaaraddu ka bixin doonto cabashooyinka shacabka iyo sida loo maareeyay adeegyada Xajka, iyadoo guddigu uu doonayo inuu helo sawir dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan arrintaasi. Si kastaba, ilaa iyo hadda Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ee Soomaaliya, Mukhtaar Roobow Cali weli kama uusan jawaabin u yeerista rasmiga ah ee Guddiga Garsoorka, Cadaaladda, Arrimaha Diinta iyo Awqaafta ee Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. The post Wasiir Roobow oo looga yeeray baarlamaanka kadib markii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Guddiga ayaa sheegay in waajibaadkiisa kormeer iyo la-xisaabtan uu ku qasbayo inuu si toos ah u dhageysto Wasiirka Awqaafta, si loo helo faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan cabashooyinka jira, loona caddeeyo sida ay wasaaraddu u maareysay howlaha la xiriira Xajka. Sida lagu sheegay qoraal rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay guddiga u yeerista Wasiir Mukhtaar Roobow waa mid waafaqsan awoodaha dastuuriga ah ee uu leeyahay Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan doorka uu ku leeyahay la-xisaabtanka hay’adaha fulinta. Qoraalka ayaa lagu caddeeyay in tallaabadan ay ku saleysan tahay qodobbada 95-aad, 81-aad iyo 82-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo sidoo kale Xeer-hoosaadka Aqalka Sare, kuwaas oo siinaya guddiyada baarlamaanka awood ay ku kormeeraan uguna yeeraan mas’uuliyiinta dowladda si ay uga jawaabaan arrimaha khuseeya shaqadooda. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee wasaaradda inay kasoo qeyb-galaan kulanka waqtiga loo asteeyay, iyagoo wata dhammaan xogaha iyo faahfaahinta lagama maarmaanka u ah in guddiga lala wadaago. Kulankan ayaa la filayaa inuu diiradda saaro jawaabaha ay wasaaraddu ka bixin doonto cabashooyinka shacabka iyo sida loo maareeyay adeegyada Xajka, iyadoo guddigu uu doonayo inuu helo sawir dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan arrintaasi. Si kastaba, ilaa iyo hadda Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ee Soomaaliya, Mukhtaar Roobow Cali weli kama uusan jawaabin u yeerista rasmiga ah ee Guddiga Garsoorka, Cadaaladda, Arrimaha Diinta iyo Awqaafta ee Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. items.title: NCA oo digniin u dirtay hawl-wadeennada Kaabayaasha Muhiimka ah
items.description: Madaxda NCA oo ansixisay Hannaanka Qaran ee Maareynta Khataraha Amniga Saaybarka – tallaabo lagu xoojinayo amniga dhijitaalka Soomaaliya Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka (NCA) ayaa shaacisay Hannaanka Qaran ee Maareynta Khataraha Amniga Saaybarka, kaas oo looga gol leeyahay in lagu xoojiyo amniga dhijitaalka dalka, laguna ilaaliyo Kaabayaasha Muhiimka ah (Critical Infrastructure) ee saameyn ku leh amniga qaranka, dhaqaalaha, iyo adeegyada bulshada. Hannaankan cusub, oo la diyaariyay bisha Juun 2026, wuxuu noqonayaa qaab-dhismeedka rasmiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku maareynayso khataraha amniga saaybarka, waxaanu ku dhisan yahay halbeegyada caalamiga ah ee ISO/IEC 27005 iyo ISO/IEC 27001. Maxay tahay muhiimadda Hannaankan? Soomaaliya waxay horumar balaadhan ka samaysay dhanka dhijitaalka, oo ay ku jiraan casriyeynta adeegyada dowladda, ballaarinta kaabeyaasha isgaarsiinta, iyo kobcinta adeegyada maaliyadeed. Si kastaba, horumarkan ayaa kordhiyey khataraha amniga saaybarka, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeelan kara xogta, nidaamyada, iyo kalsoonida bulshada. Hannaankan cusub wuxuu qeexayaa habka ay hay’aduhu u aqoonsadaan, u qiimeeyaan, una kala hormariyaan khataraha amniga saaybarka, iyagoo adeegsanaya hab tayo leh (qualitative assessment) oo ku saleysan saameynta ganacsi (Business Impact Levels). Yaa ay khuseysaa? Dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay ee maamula Kaabayaasha Muhiimka ah waxaa ku waajib ah hirgelinta Hannaankan, iyagoo u soo gudbinaya warbixin sanadle ah Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka. Sharciga Amniga Saaybarka Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale caddaynaya mas’uuliyaddan. Sidee loo maareynayaa khataraha? Hannaanku wuxuu soo bandhigayaa afar hab oo lagu daweeyo khataraha: Iska-fogeyn Khatar (Avoidance) – joojinta hawl ama adeeg keena khatar. Yarayn Khatar (Mitigation) – hirgelinta xakameyn lagu yareeyo khatarta. Wareejinta Khatar (Transfer) – u wareejinta adeeg-bixiye ama dhinac seddexad. Aqbalid Khatar (Acceptance) – aqbalida khatarta haddii ay ka yar tahay heerka la aqbali karo. Waa maxay saameynta guud? Hannaankani wuxuu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo istiraatiiji ah oo lagu xoojinayo adkeysiga amniga saaybarka dalka, ilaalinta xogta, iyo joogteynta adeegyada muhiimka ah. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu sare u qaado kalsoonida bulshada iyo amniga qaranka guud ahaan. Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka waxay ku baaqaysa dhammaan hawl-wadeennada inay si dhab ah u hirgeliyaan Hannaankan, kuna soo gudbiyaan warbixinnadooda sanadlaha ah si looga midho dhaliyo dadaallada amniga dhijitaalka Soomaaliya. Wixii faahfaahin ah, booqo: https://nca.gov.so The post NCA oo digniin u dirtay hawl-wadeennada Kaabayaasha Muhiimka ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Khad Tareen oo isku xidhi doona  Itoobiya iyo Somaliland
items.description: Warbixinno caalami ah oo ay daabaceen qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta adduunka oo ay ka mid yihiin Ethiopian Daily News, Feta Daily World iyo AfriNews 24, ayaa lagu sheegay in dhawaan la filayo in si rasmi ah loo bilaabo mashruuc ballaadhan oo lagu dhisayo khad tareen casri ah oo koronto ku shaqeeya, kaas oo isku xidhi doona Itoobiya iyo Dekedda Berbera ee Somaliland. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinnadaas, kharashka mashruucan ayaa lagu qiyaasay inuu gaadhayo 3.47 bilyan oo doollar, waxaana lagu tilmaamay inuu qayb ka yahay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo isku xidhka gaadiidka, ganacsiga iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee Geeska Afrika. Warbixinahan caalamiga ah oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay waxa kale oo lagu sheegay in mashruucan ballaadhan ay maalgelinayaan dawladdaha Imaaraadka Carabta (UAE) iyo Itoobiya, kaas oo ujeedadiisu tahay in la xoojiyo isku xidhka iyo horumarinta ganacsiga, hagaajinta isu socodka gaadiidka iyo saadka ee gobolka, isla markaana Itoobiya loo fududeeyo marin degdeg ah oo ay ku gaadho Dekedda Berbera. Warbixinta AfriNews 24 ayaa lagu sheegay, “Dawladda UAE ayaa bixinaya maalgelin iyo khibrad farsamo oo lagu hirgelinayo mashaariicdan waaweyn, maadaama uu yahay mid ka mid ah maalgashadayaasha ugu waaweyn ee Geeska Afrika.| Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, ballaadhinta wajiga labaad ee Dekedda, xoojinta isku xidhka aagga Dhaqaalaha Berbera iyo Waddada Berbera Corridor ayaa lagu tilmaamay inay ka tarjumayaan kalsoonida lagu qabo dekedda iyo himilada ah in laga dhigo xarunta ganacsiga iyo saadka (logistics) oo heer caalami ah. Sidoo kale waxa lagu xusay in marka mashruucani dhammaado la filayo in Berbera ay yeelato kaabayaal casri ah iyo awood ay ku noqoto xarun isku xidha adeegyada dekedaha, warshadaha iyo gaadiidka, taas oo si gaar ah u fududayn doonta ganacsiga iyo isu socodka badeecadaha u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo suuqyada caalamka. Warbixinta AfriNews 24, waxa kale oo lagu sheegay “Dekedda Berbera ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay noqotay mid ka mid ah mashaariicda ugu muhiimsan ee horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee Geeska Afrika. Iyada oo hadda la qorsheynayo in la ballaadhiyo wajiga labaad ee dekedda, lana xoojiyo isku xidhka Aagga Dhaqaalaha ee Berbera, Waddada Berbera (Berbera Corridor) iyo khad tareen oo gaadhi doona gudaha Itoobiya.” Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale arrintan ku tilmaamay dhacdo taariikhi ah oo ay ku faani doonaan shacabka Somaliland. Waxa kale oo lagu xusay warbixinta in horumarinta dekedda iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee la xidhiidhaa ay kor u qaadayaan ganacsiga gobolka, soo jiidashada maalgashi cusub, isla markaana ay si weyn u xoojinayaan doorka Berbera ee isu socodka ganacsiga Geeska Afrika. Warbixinta ayaa intaas raacisay “Dowladda Itoobiya waxay sii xoojinaysaa iskaashigeeda istaraatiijiga ah ee ay la leedahay Somaliland iyo Imaaraadka Carabta (UAE), si loo horumariyo kaabeyaasha ganacsiga Geeska Afrika.” Dhinaca kale, warbixin ay daabacday Ethiopian Daily News ayaa lagu sheegay in dhawaan la bilaabi doono dhismaha khad tareen koronto ku shaqeeya oo casri ah, kaas oo isku xidhaya Itoobiya iyo Dekedda Berbera ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, mashruucan ayaa lagu qiyaasay inuu ku kacayo 3.47 bilyan oo doollar, iyadoo la sheegay in kharashkiisa ay wada maalgelin doonaan Itoobiya iyo dawladda Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta (UAE). Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in khadka tareenka cusub uu qayb ka noqon doono dadaallada lagu horumarinayo isku xidhka gaadiidka iyo ganacsiga gobolka, isla markaana uu Itoobiya u fududayn doono marin dheeraad ah oo ay ku gaadho Dekedda Berbera. Intaa waxaa dheer, waxaa lagu xusay in mashruucan la filayo inuu kor u qaado ganacsiga, gaadiidka iyo isku xidhnaanta dhaqaale ee Geeska Afrika. Warbixinta, ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay hal-ku-dhig Afka-Amxaariga ah “የኢትዮጵያ የድል ዘመን ከፊታችን ነው!!”, oo macnihiisu yahay: “Xilligii guusha Itoobiya ayaa soo dhow.” Sidoo kale, warbixinta lagu daabacay warbaahinta Feta daily world ayaa lagu sheegay “Dhismaha tareen koronto oo xawaare sare leh oo casri ah oo isku xicha Itoobiya iyo dekedda Berbera ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa dhawaan bilaaban doona. Wadarta kharashka dhismaha ayaa ah maalgelin dhan $3.47 bilyan oo dollar, kharashkana waxaa dabooli doona Itoobiya iyo Imaaraadka.”

items.title: Dhulgariir Xooggan oo Ku Dhuftay Gobolka Khuzestan ee Dalka Iiraan
items.description: Dhulgariir xooggan oo cabirkiisa lagu qiyaasay 5.0 magnitude ayaa maanta ku dhuftay deegaanka Saland ee gobolka Khuzestan , oo ku yaalla koonfur-galbeed ee dalka Iiraan. Warbaahinta dowladda Iiraan ee IRIB ayaa sheegtay in dhulgariirka laga dareemay deegaanno dhowr ah, iyadoo xuduntiisa lagu sheegay inay ahayd qoto dheer oo gaaraysa 12 kiiloomitir . Ururka Bisha Cas ee Iiraan ayaa xaqiijiyay in kooxo gurmad iyo samatabbixin ah si degdeg ah loogu diray goobaha uu saameeyay dhulgariirku. Ugu yaraan laba kooxood ayaa gaaray tuulooyinka ku dhow halka uu dhulgariirku ka dhacay si ay u qiimeeyaan xaaladda iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay. Ilaa iyo hadda, mas’uuliyiintu ma shaacin wax khasaare naf ama hanti ah oo ka dhashay dhulgariirka, hase yeeshee baaritaanno iyo qiimeyn ayaa weli socda. Iiraan waxay ka mid tahay dalalka dunida ee sida joogtada ah ay u saameeyaan dhulgariirrada, maadaama ay ku taallo aag ay ku kulmaan dhowr saxan oo dhulka hoostiisa ah, taasoo kordhisa halista musiibooyinka noocan oo kale ah. Mas’uuliyiinta gurmadka ayaa sheegay in wixii warar cusub ee ku saabsan khasaaraha ama saameynta dhulgariirka la shaacin doono marka ay soo dhammaadaan qiimeynta ay wadaan kooxaha gurmadka.

items.title: Iran waxa ay rabtaa in ay xidho marin biyoodka Baabul mandab ee Bada cas
items.description: Wargeyska The Telegraph ee kasoo baxa dalka Britain ayaa qoray warbixin cinwaankeedu yahay: “Xuutiyiintu waxay qorshaynayaan inay furaan jiid cusub oo ka tirsan dagaalka Iran, isla markaana xidhaan marin-biyood labaad.” Warbixinta waxaa qoray wariyaha arrimaha dibadda, Akhtar Makoi. Qoraagu wuxuu sheegayaa in Xuutiyiinta, oo hadda loo arko wakiilka gobolka ee ugu awoodda badan Iran, ay isu diyaarinayaan inay xiraan Marinka Bab al-Mandab iyagoo matalaya Iran, si ay u kordhiyaan cadaadiska lagu saarayo Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump, iyagoo dhaawac dheeraad ah gaarsiinaya dhaqaalaha caalamka. Sida maqaalka lagu sheegay, waxaa jira iskaashi u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo kooxda Al-Shabaab ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo lagu doonayo in lagu xakameeyo labada dhinac ee Marinka Bab al-Mandab, isla markaana la xiro marka Iran go’aansato. Warbixintu waxay soo xiganaysaa ilo xog-ogaal ah oo sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay kooxda Soomaaliyeed u gudbinayaan tiknoolajiyadda diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iran, iyagoo ka amar qaadanaya Tehran. Ujeeddaduna waa in laga abuuro Bab al-Mandab xaalad la mid ah tan ka jirta Marinka Hormuz. Qoraagu wuxuu xusay in qiyaastii 10 ilaa 12 boqolkiiba ganacsiga adduunku uu maro Marinka Bab al-Mandab, kaas oo ku xirma Kanaalka Suweys. Wuxuu ka digay in haddii marinkan la xiro, maraakiibtu ay ku qasbanaan doonaan inay maraan waddo kale oo toddobaadyo dheeraad ah ku wareegta cirifka koonfureed ee qaaradda Afrika, taas oo kordhin doonta kharashaadka gaadiidka. Warbixintu sidoo kale waxay xustay in ciidamada Maraykanku ay bilaabeen mowjado cusub oo duqeymo ah oo ka dhan ah Iran, iyadoo ay jiraan warar sheegaya in Tehran ay ku hanjabtay xiritaanka Marinka Bab al-Mandab. Waxaa kale oo lagu xusay in Hormuz iyo Kanaalka Suweys ay ka mid yihiin marin-biyoodka iyo kanaallada ugu muhiimsan adduunka. Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters Qoraalka sawirka, Laba doon oo ku sugan meel ka baxsan xeebta Yemen ee ku teedsan Marinka Bab al-Mandab Sida uu qoruhu sheegay, weligeed hore uma dhicin in Marinka Hormuz iyo Marinka Bab al-Mandab isku mar la xiro. Wuxuu xusay in Xuutiyiintu ay hore u muujiyeen awood ay ku xannibi karaan Marinka Bab al-Mandab intii uu socday dagaalkii Qasa, markaas oo ay bilooyin badan beegsadeen maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraysay Badda Cas, kuna khasbeen inay maraan waddooyin kale, inkastoo isbahaysi ciidan badeed oo uu hoggaaminayay Maraykanku loo diray gobolka. Qoraagu wuxuu aaminsan yahay in xiritaanka Marinka Bab al-Mandab uu dan u yahay Tehran, isla markaana uu Xuutiyiinta siinayo fursad ay ku cadaadiyaan Sacuudi Carabiya oo ay u arkaan cadowgoodii hore. Waxaa kale oo uu sheegay in arrintaasi ay xoojinayso hamiga gobolka ee kooxda Xuutiyiinta, taasoo la macno noqon karta inay mararka qaarkood u dhaqaaqaan si ay u gaaraan danahooda gaarka ah, xitaa haddii ay taasi ka hor imanayso xisaabaadka Iran. Qoraagu wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in ujeeddooyinka Xuutiyiintu aanay gebi ahaanba la mid ahayn kuwa Iran, isagoo yiri: “Xuutiyiintu waa saaxiibbo iyo xulafo ay leeyihiin Iiraaniyiintu, balse ma aha wax lagu ciyaaro ama lagu maamulo sida caruusado.” Waxaa kale oo uu sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay isu diyaariyeen dagaal muddo dheer socon kara. Sida maqaalka lagu sheegay, waxay cashar ka qaateen waayo-aragnimada Iran ee la xiriirta dilalka lagu beegsado hoggaamiyeyaasha, sidaas darteedna waxay u magacaabeen hoggaamiye kasta oo hadda jooga in ka badan hal ku-xigeen, iyagoo adeegsanaya nidaam u eg “hoggaamiyeyaal kayd ah” oo beddeli kara kuwa la waayo.

items.title: Mareykanka oo habeenkii siddeedaad oo xiriir ah duqeymo ka wada Iiraan
items.description: Dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanku ay habeenkii siddeedaad oo xiriir ah duqeymo cusub ka fuliyeen gudaha Iiraan. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in weerarradan lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarumo ciidan, goobaha difaaca cirka, xarumaha lagu kaydiyo gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, iyo sidoo kale awoodaha badda ee Iiraan. Mareykanku wuxuu sheegay in ujeeddadu tahay in la wiiqo awoodda Iiraan ee ay ku carqaladeyn karto maraakiibta ganacsiga ee marinka muhiimka ah ee Hormuz. Mareykanku wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in duqeymahan ay jawaab u yihiin weerar ay Iiraan ku qaaday saldhig ciidan oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay dalka Urdun, kaas oo lagu dilay laba askari oo Mareykan ah, halka kuwo kalena lagu dhaawacay. Warbaahinta Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in duqeymuhu ay ka dhaceen deegaanno ay ka mid yihiin Sirik, Jasiiradda Qeshm, iyo meel u dhow Shadegan ee gobolka Khuzestan. Dhanka kale, ciidamada Iiraan ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay weerarro ku qaadeen saldhigyo ay ciidamada Mareykanku ku leeyihiin dalka Kuwait, iyagoo sheegay inay bartilmaameedsadeen bakhaarro rasaas iyo nidaamyada difaaca cirka ee saldhigyadaas. Hoggaamiyaha Sare ee Iiraan ayaa mar kale uga digay Mareykanka inuu la kulmi doono casharro aan la ilaawi karin haddii uu sii wado weerarrada. Sidoo kale, dowladda Iiraan ayaa ku eedeysay Mareykanka inuu beegsaday kaabayaal rayid ah, sida buundooyin iyo warshado biyaha macaan laga sameeyo, taasoo sababtay in kumannaan qof ay waayaan biyo nadiif ah. Saraakiisha Iiraan ayaa sheegay in saddexdii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay ay duqeymaha Mareykanka ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 50 qof, halka in ka badan 500 oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Dhinaca kale, dadka ku nool Iiraan ayaa walaac weyn ka muujinaya sii socoshada dagaalka, iyagoo rajeynaya in xal diblomaasiyadeed lagu soo afjaro colaaddan sii fidaysa.

items.title: Dalalka Yurub oo Billaabay Tallaabooyin Ka Dhan Ah Soo Dejinta Alaabta Shirkadaha Israa’iil ee ka Howlgala Daanta Galbeed
items.description: Wararka ka imaanaya qaaradda Yurub ayaa sheegaya in dowladda Biljamka (Belgium) ay si rasmi ah u ansixisay go’aan lagu mamnuucayo soo iibsashada iyo soo dhoofsashada alaabada ka timaada deegaannada sharci-darrada ah ee Israa’iil ay ka dhex dhistay dhulka gumeysiga ee Falastiin. Go’aankan oo uu qaatay Golaha Wasiirada ee dowladda Federaalka Biljamka, ayaa daba socda dadaallo caalami ah iyo kuwo gobolka ah oo lagu cadaadinayo maamulka Tel Aviv. Inkastoo go’aanka la meelmariyay, haddana dowladda Biljamka weli si rasmi ah uma qeexin habka farsamo iyo xilliga saxda ah ee uu dhaqangali doono xayiraaddan ganacsi. go’aankan cusub ayaa xorriyad iyo awood sharci u helay ra’yigii latalinta ahaa ee ka soo baxay Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Caddaaladda (ICJ). Maxkamadda ayaa dhowaan xaqiijisay in joogitaanka Israa’iil iyo dhismaha deegaannada Yahuudda ee Daanta Galbeed ay yihiin kuwo sharci-darro ah. ICJ ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqday dhammaan dowlada caalamka inay qaadaan tillaabooyin dhab ah oo lagu hakinayo xiriirada ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee gacan ka geysanaya sii jiritaanka iyo ballaarinta dhulka la haysto ee Falastiin. Tallaabadan oo ay hormuudka u tahay Biljamka ayaa dhalisay xarakaad iyo guux weyn oo ka dhex bilowday Midowga Yurub, dalalka Biljamka, Nederland (Netherlands), iyo Isbayn (Spain) ayaa hadda si wadajir ah u hoggaaminaya isbahaysi dalal Yurub ah oo daraasad ku samaynaya doorashooyin dhowr ah oo lagu xaddidayo ganacsiga lala leeyahay deegaannadaas sharci-darrada ah. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa ku soo aadaya iyadoo ay jiraan cadaadisyo xooggan oo kaga imaanaya bulshada rayidka ah ee reer Yurub iyo ururada u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha, kuwaas oo dalbanaya in Midowga Yurub uu joojiyo maalgelinta iyo gadashada waxyaabaha ay Israa’iil ka soo saarto dhulka ay xoogga ku haysato.

items.title: The World Cup final will be played on turf with mixed reviews. Rain might help
items.description: (AP)- Players and coaches have fielded a lot of questions about the pitch in East Rutherford, New Jersey, before and after World Cup games there. Opinions have varied. Brazil’s Vinicius Junior was not a fan. France coach Didier Deschamps called it special — and not in a good way. Norway’s Ståle Solbakken was asked several times about the surface before coaching his first game on it and came away more pleased about it than he expected. While entirely different than the turf surface at the stadium that has been  maligned by NFL players , the grass field with synthetic fibers stitched in to reduce the risk of divots and tears has drawn mixed reviews through the first seven games of the tournament there. After a nearly two-week break for staff to get it in the best condition possible, the most important game takes place there Sunday when Argentina and Spain meet in the final. Neither team has played at the Meadowlands stadium yet, adding another element of uncertainty to the matchup. Players and coaches say the turf plays fast — and better when it’s wet Before Norway faced Senegal in New Jersey, Solbakken compared the Meadowlands pitch to AstroTurf. He said the short, firm grass could be good for teams who like to possess the ball. Torrential rain fell before and during the game on June 22, changing the complexion of how it played. “The pitch was much better because of the rain, because the rain made it (so) that the ball doesn’t hang on your foot,” Solbakken said. “It’s going faster, smoother, and that made two good teams could play to their strength, so the pitch, due to the rain, was better. I’m more suspicious if there’s no rain because then it’s dry and short and then it could be more difficult, but with the rain today it made the pitch much, much better.” It was dry when England met Panama in each team’s final group play game. England coach Thomas Tuchel also likened it to artificial turf for the shortness of the blades of grass — very different from the field in Foxborough, Massachusetts. “It’s a very fast pitch,” Tuchel said. “It’s very short and a bit uneven because you see still the different layers of the grass and not fully even. So, it’s quite active. It is quite bouncy. … This one was very hard and very fast but was good, playable, and no one complained.” Vinicius after Brazil opened there against Morocco  and scoring  on June 13 said, “The field is not helping.” Rabiot, who  played there  against Senegal three days later, called it hard and rigid. “In Europe, we play on pitches that are in a better condition,” Rabiot said through an interpreter. “The pitch was not in a good condition, in my mind. I saw that there has been also a lot of criticism, so I’m not the only one criticizing the state of it.” Deschamps called it tough and said the pitch “took a lot out of the players’ muscles.” By the time France returned to open the knockout stage against Sweden on June 30, Rabiot said he believed there had been a slight improvement and the grass was longer. FIFA spent more than 5 years on the turf and made adjustments during the World Cup FIFA said the preparations included testing and collaboration with turf experts and stadium operators. The pitch, with grass from the Carolina Green Sod Farm, got installed in early May. After the hybrid fibers were added, workers followed a continuous cycle of top dressing, aeration, mowing and what FIFA called carefully managed irrigation. The surface was monitored and tested throughout the process of five group play and two knockout stage games taking place there, including checks on moisture levels, firmness and overall playability. Norway versus Senegal showed officials just how much water the surface could hold and led to maximizing the irrigation hours before and during games, at halftime and hydration breaks. “The objective throughout has been to deliver a surface that meets the highest possible standards for performance, consistency and player safety,” FIFA said in a statement to The Associated Press. A 13-day window between Norway and Brazil meeting in the round of 16 and the final was by design, with FIFA aiming to optimize the conditions. The aim was to give the pitch a chance to recover and get prepared and hold ceremony rehearsals. It’s not clear how the turf will play during the World Cup final That is anyone’s guess, though heavy rain expected to hit the area Saturday could make it more like Norway’s first game at the stadium. While  smoke from Canadian wildfires  leaves questions about the air quality, the weather outside of that is set to be picture perfect: sunny and 82 degrees Fahrenheit (27.78 degrees Celsius). When the World Cup ends, the grass will be removed and artificial turf reinstalled at MetLife Stadium before the Giants’ first exhibition game on Aug. 15. That process got underway at other stadiums across the U.S. after the final games there finished. The NFL Players Association opposes that, saying 92% of its membership prefers playing on natural grass. Several players have posted on social media in recent weeks in favor of grass over turf. Washington offensive lineman  Laremy Tunsil posted  Friday, “If stadiums can make grass work for the World Cup, they can make it work for NFL players.” Source: AP The post The World Cup final will be played on turf with mixed reviews.
