items.title: Iiraan oo Sheegatay inay gebi ahaanba burburisay nidaamka difaaca cirka ee saldhigyada Mareykanku ku leeyahay Baxreyn iyo Kuweyd
items.description: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay gebi ahaanba burburiyeen nidaamyada difaaca Patriot iyo bakhaarro shidaal ee ku yaalla saldhigyo Mareykanka ee dalalka Kuwait iyo Baxrayn. Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay inay qaadeen weerarro cusub oo ay ku beegsadeen saldhigyo ciidan oo ku yaalla dalalka Kuwait iyo Baxrayn, iyadoo ku daray inay gebi ahaanba burburiyeen bakhaarro shidaal, nidaamyada difaaca cirka ee Patriot iyo nidaam radar oo istaraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla laba saldhig oo ciidan oo Kuwait ah. Sida ay Iiraan sheegtay, weerarrada ayaa sidoo kale lala beegsaday xarumo ku yaalla saldhigga Sheikh Isa Air Base ee dalka Baxrayn, waxaana ka mid ahaa goobo dayactirka diyaaradaha, hangarro iyo xarumo lagu hago diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones). Weerarradan ayaa lagu sheegay inay qayb ka yihiin howlgalka aargoosiga ah ee Iran ay ugu magacdartay “Isha-Isha”, kaas oo jawaab u ah duqeymo cusub oo Mareykanku ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo militari oo gudaha Iran ah. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Tehran iyo Washington ayaa sii xoogeysanaysa, iyadoo is-weydaarsiga weerarrada uu ku fiday dalal badan oo Khaliijka ah.

items.title: Qiimaha Shidaalka Adduunka oo Sare u Kacay Kadib Weerarrada Maraykanka iyo Iiraan ee Marinka Hormuz
items.description: Qiimaha shidaalka caalamka ayaa si weyn kor ugu kacay, kadib markii ay cirka isku shareertay xiisadda u dhexeysa Maraykanka iyo Iiraan ee ka taagan Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu daabulo shidaalka dunida. Shidaalka nooca Brent Crude ayaa Isniintii kor u kacay in ka badan 4%, isagoo gaaray ku dhowaad 79.29 doollar halkii foosto, taasoo ah heerkii ugu sarreeyay tan iyo dabayaaqadii bishii Juun. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Maraykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay inuu duqeymo is daba joog ah ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla Iiraan, isagoo sheegay in ujeeddadu ahayd in la wiiqo awoodda Iiraan ee weerarrada maraakiibta isticmaasha Marinka Hormuz. Dhinaca kale, Iiraan ayaa weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaaday dalal ay ka mid yihiin Imaaraadka Carabta, Qatar, Kuwait, Cumaan iyo Baxreyn, iyadoo tallaabadaas ku sheegtay jawaab ay ka bixisay duqeymaha Maraykanka. Mas’uuliyiinta Iiraan ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in maraakiibta aan raacin waddooyinka ay iyagu tilmaameen aysan heli doonin dammaanad amni, arrintaas oo sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in tirada maraakiibta mara Marinka Hormuz ay si weyn hoos ugu dhacday maalmahan, halka marinkan uu caadi ahaan maro ku dhowaad shan meelood meel shidaalka adduunka laga dhoofiyo. Khubarada dhaqaalaha ayaa sheegaya in haddii xiisaddan sii socoto, qiimaha shidaalka uu sii ahaan karo mid sareeya bilaha soo socda, inkasta oo aan la filayn inuu gaaro heerarkii ugu sarreeyay ee hore loo arkay. Sidoo kale, suuqyada saamiyada ee qaaradda Aasiya ayaa hoos u dhacay, iyadoo maalgashadayaashu ay ka walaacsan yihiin saameynta dagaalka iyo khatarta uu ku yeelan karo dhaqaalaha caalamka. Xiisadda Marinka Hormuz ayaa weli ah mid si dhow isha loogu hayo, maadaama marin-biyoodkan uu door muhiim ah ku leeyahay ganacsiga shidaalka iyo xasilloonida dhaqaalaha adduunka.

items.title: Qatar Awarded Contract to Drill Somalia’s Second Oil Well in Nugaal Basin
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s Ministry of Petroleum has announced that Qatar has been awarded the contract to drill what is expected to become the country’s second oil production well, located in the hydrocarbon-rich Nugaal Basin in the Northeastern Regional Administration. According to the Ministry, the project will focus on the Holhol prospect near the town of Hudun, an area long regarded by geologists as one of Somalia’s most promising petroleum reserves. Nevertheless, the minister’s statement provided no detail regarding the scope or terms of the agreement, leaving key aspects of the contract unclear. It also did not specify whether the Government of Qatar is serving as an intermediary, with the intention of subcontracting petroleum exploration and drilling activities to major international oil and gas companies. The Nugaal Basin has attracted interest for decades. Initial geological surveys were conducted during the administration of the late President Mohamed Siad Barre, when the Holhol prospect was first identified as a potential oil-bearing structure. Those early exploration efforts laid the groundwork for subsequent assessments of the basin’s commercial potential. The Federal Government said the Holhol well is expected to become Somalia’s second major oil development project, following the Curad well, where exploration and development activities are currently being undertaken by Turkey under an existing agreement with Mogadishu. If the project proceeds as planned, Holhol would represent another significant milestone in Somalia’s long-awaited effort to develop its petroleum sector after decades of conflict and limited exploration. The announcement has renewed optimism among many Somalis, who view the country’s untapped oil and gas resources as a potential catalyst for economic transformation. Many political and economic observers believe that responsible exploitation of Somalia’s hydrocarbon reserves could generate substantial government revenue, create employment opportunities, and finance critical investments in infrastructure, education, healthcare, and public services. At the same time, analysts emphasize that the ultimate benefits of oil production will depend on transparent governance, sound management of natural resources, and broad political consensus. They argue that ensuring an equitable sharing of petroleum revenues among Somalia’s federal institutions and regional administrations will be essential if the country’s natural wealth is to contribute to long-term stability and national development rather than deepen political disputes. The planned drilling at Holhol is therefore expected to be closely watched as Somalia seeks to transform its vast petroleum potential into sustainable economic growth. items.title: DF oo war kasoo saartay duqeyn lagu laayay Shabaab badan kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya duqeyn ay iska kaashadeen Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah, taas oo ka dhacday gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, isla markaana lagu beesaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab. Duqeynta oo ahayd bartilmaameed ayaa si gaar ah uga dhacday deegaannada Cadow Jilib, Gayfo iyo Qordheere ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, iyada oo khasaare lagu gaarsiiyay Khawaarijta, sida ay sheegtay dowladda Soomaaliya. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarka lagu dilay ugu yaraan illaa 26 ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, sidoo kalena lagu burburiyay gaari Cabdi Bile ah iyo booyad shidaal u waday kooxda. “Duqeymaha ayaa lagu dilay 26 dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, waxaa lagu burburiyay gaari Cabdibile ah iyo booyad shidaal oo ay Khawaarijtu u adeegsanayeen dhaqdhaqaaqyadooda iyo fulinta falalka argagixisanimo,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga. Sidoo kale, Wasaaradda ayaa si weyn ugu mahadcelisay saaxiibada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya kala shaqeeya la-dagaallanka iyo ciribtirka argagixisada, maadaama ay ciidamada dowladda ka gacan siiyeen weerarkaasi. Howlgalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay ku baacsanayaan horjoogayaasha iyo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, laguna wiiqayo awooddooda abaabul iyo fulinta weerarrada argagixisanimo. Dhanka kale, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in ay sii wadi doonaan howlgallada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo horjoogayaasha iyo maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab, ilaa laga ciribtiro khatarta ay ku hayaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Maalmihii u dambeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kordhisay weerarrada ka dhanka ah argagixisada, waxaana sidoo kale socda diyaar garow ku aaddan dagaal cusub oo uu iclaamiyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. items.title: Red-Clad Protesters Take to Mogadishu Streets for Second Day, Demand Release of Jailed Activist Sacdiya Bajaj
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Small groups of demonstrators returned to the streets of Mogadishu for a second consecutive day on Sunday, protesting against the Federal Government and demanding the release of activist Sacdiya Bajaj, who was recently sentenced to three years in prison. The protesters, many of them young women, gathered in several neighborhoods across the Somali capital dressed in red clothing as a symbol of solidarity with Bajaj. They carried banners and chanted slogans condemning the government while calling for her immediate release. In one of the day’s most striking scenes, several demonstrators tore apart photographs of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud in front of television cameras, signaling growing public frustration over the government’s handling of the case. The crowd repeatedly chanted slogans accusing the administration of corruption and rejecting its policies, with cries of, “We don’t want thieves,” and “We will not accept this,” echoing through the protest sites. Many of the young men participating in the demonstrations concealed their faces with scarves or masks, apparently out of concern that they could later be identified and arrested by security forces. The precaution underscored the tense atmosphere surrounding the protests and fears of possible crackdowns on dissent. Despite the symbolic displays, the turnout remained relatively modest, with videos circulating on social media showing only small groups of protesters assembled in different parts of the city. Sacdiya Bajaj’s imprisonment has become an increasingly controversial issue, drawing criticism from activists and sections of the public who argue that the case raises broader questions about freedom of expression and the government’s tolerance of dissent. Supporters have portrayed her conviction as politically motivated, while authorities have maintained that legal proceedings were conducted in accordance with the law. The demonstrations come at a politically sensitive time, as Somalia continues to grapple with deep political divisions over governance, constitutional reforms, and the country’s electoral process. Whether the growing campaign for Bajaj’s release gathers wider public support remains uncertain, but the second consecutive day of protests suggests that her case is evolving into a broader rallying point for critics of the Federal Government. So far, the Federal Government has not issued a new statement in response to Sunday’s demonstrations or renewed calls for Bajaj’s release. Sacdiya Bajaj’s imprisonment has become an increasingly controversial issue, drawing criticism from activists and sections of the public who argue that the case raises broader questions about freedom of expression and the government’s tolerance of dissent. Supporters have portrayed her conviction as politically motivated, while authorities have maintained that legal proceedings were conducted in accordance with the law. The demonstrations come at a politically sensitive time, as Somalia continues to grapple with deep political divisions over governance, constitutional reforms, and the country’s electoral process. Whether the growing campaign for Bajaj’s release gathers wider public support remains uncertain, but the second consecutive day of protests suggests that her case is evolving into a broader rallying point for critics of the Federal Government. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo Duqeymo Ku Dilay 26 Xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, iyagoo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamiga ah, ay fuliyeen duqeymo lagu bartilmaameedsaday fariisimo iyo goobo ay ku sugnaayeen Al-Shabaab ee ku yaalla deegaannada Cadow Jilib, Gayfo iyo Qordheere ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga, howlgalkaasi waxaa lagu dilay 26 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, halka sidoo kale lagu burburiyay gaadiid dagaal iyo doonyo ay kooxdaasi u adeegsan jirtay dhaqdhaqaaqyadeeda iyo fulinta falalka argagixisanimo. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in howlgalka uu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay ku baacsanayaan Al-Shabaab, si loo wiiqo awoodda kooxda loogana hortago weerarro ay qorsheynayeen. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadcelisay saaxiibada caalamka taageerada ay siiyaan howlgalada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo dadaallada lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa xaqiijiyay in ay sii wadi doonaan howlgalada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ilaa laga ciribtiro khatarta ay ku hayaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Somalia Cannot Be Governed by an Expired Mandate
items.description: By Abdelkarim A. Haji Hassan Somalia has entered a period of political uncertainty since the end of the transitional period. The country is confronting a deepening constitutional and governance impasse, driven by an increasingly entrenched confrontation between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and the opposition. At the core of this deadlock are two unresolved and closely intertwined issues: 1) the framework for the national elections and 2) the unilateral constitutional changes being pushed forward without broad national consensus. President Hassan Sheikh’s constitutional term ended on 15 May 2026 , yet he continues to exercise presidential powers as though he has received a new mandate from the Somali people.  These actions have deepened political divisions and eroded trust between the Federal Government, opposition leaders, and Federal Member States. Repeated attempts to reach a political settlement have produced no meaningful progress. President Hassan repeatedly proclaims his commitment to dialogue, consensus, and inclusive politics. Yet his actions consistently contradict those assurances. While publicly calling for negotiations, he has continued to unilaterally advance his political agenda without broad national agreement, reducing dialogue to a political exercise while pressing ahead with predetermined decisions. The clearest example is the purported one-person, one-vote (1P1V) initiative. In principle, every Somali supports the right of citizens to elect their leaders directly. The problem is not the slogan; the problem is the way it is being implemented. Adan Madobe and Liban Ahmed (Shuluq) The current process is not about building an independent electoral system capable of delivering free and fair elections. It is about controlling the political outcome. The objective is to install loyal allies in the leadership of the Federal Member States, influence the results of future parliaments, and ultimately secure another presidential term through a legislature shaped by executive power rather than the genuine will of the Somali people. South West State has already demonstrated how this strategy operates. A political ally of the President emerged through a heavily managed political process. The same blueprint is now unfolding in Galmudug, where plans are underway to position Libaan Ahmed (Shuluq) as the successor. These developments are not isolated events; they form part of a broader political strategy to consolidate power across Somalia’s federal institutions. This exposes the fundamental contradiction at the center of the Hassan Sheikh’s narrative. How can an election be called “one person, one vote” when the winners are chosen before the people are allowed to vote? Democracy is not measured by slogans, campaign banners, or political speeches. It is measured by whether elections are genuinely competitive, independently administered, transparent, and accepted by both winners and losers. Without those conditions, “one person, one vote” becomes nothing more than a political label attached to a predetermined outcome. The Somali public is no longer persuaded by rhetoric alone. People increasingly recognize that the current 1P1V process is being used to manufacture political legitimacy rather than strengthen democratic institutions. Its planned to produce a Parliament selected through executive influence instead of one elected through an open, credible, and nationally accepted process. Somalia has paid an enormous price for constitutional crises, disputed elections, and political exclusion. The country cannot afford to repeat those mistakes. No president whose constitutional mandate has expired should attempt to reshape the Constitution, redesign the electoral system, or determine the country’s political future without a broad national agreement. The way out of the current crisis is neither complicated nor controversial. Somalia needs an inclusive political settlement that restores constitutional legitimacy, respects the federal system, and produces a genuinely independent electoral framework accepted by all major political stakeholders and Somali people. Anything short of that risks pushing the country into a deeper political confrontation, undermining national unity, and jeopardizing the democratic progress that Somalis have struggled for decades to achieve. items.title: Muxuu Mareykanka ka yiri xadgudubka calankiisa loogu gaystay Soomaaliya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka hadashay rag watay dareeska Ciidamada Qalabka Sida Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo la arkay iyaga oo ku xadgudbaya calanka Mareykanka. Bayaan kasoo baxay safaaradda Mareykanka ee magaalada Muqdisho ayaa waxaa lagu bogaadiyay tallaabada deg-degga ah ee ay qaaday dowladda Soomaaliya oo durbaba lagu soo xiray eedeysanayaal loo haysto falkaasi. “Shakhsiyaadka falalkaas ku lugta leh ee isku dayaya inay dhaawacaan xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka waxay dhibaato u geysanayaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waana in lala xisaabtamaa,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka Mareykanka. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusay in Mareykanka uu dhaqaale badan ku bixiyay dib u dhiska Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan sidii Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka usoo kaban lahaayeen. Hadalka kasoo yeeray Mareykanka ayaa kusoo aadaya, iyada oo maanta Dowladda Federaalka ay soo bandhigtay afar eedeysane oo loo haysto inay ku xadgudbeen calanka Mareykanka, iyaga oo xiran dareeska Ciidamada Xoogga. Raggaas ayaa muuqaal ku baahiyay baraha bulshada, iyaga oo ku istaagayo calanka Mareykanka, taas oo ay ka dhalatay falcelin aan caadi aheyn. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in eedeysanayaasha ay gacanta ku jiraan, isla markaana laga qaadi doono tallaabo adag oo sharciga waafaqsan, waxayna kala yihiin;- 1-Cabdikhadar Mahad Cumar oo 22 sano jir ah, 2-Maxamed Raage Xuseen oo 16 sano jir ah, 3-Muudey Faysal Muudey oo 17 sano jir ah iyo 4-Maxamed Amiin Qaasim Muuse oo 15 sano jir ah. “Dhammaan shakhsiyaadkii ku lugta lahaa falkii lagu xadgudbay dareyska Ciidanka Qaranka iyo calanka Mareykanka ayaa gacanta lagu soo dhigay. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxay ka digaysaa in aan loo dulqaadan doonin fal kasta oo lagu dhaawacayo sharafta iyo sumcadda Ciidanka Qaranka,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda ayaa shaacisay in aan loo dulqaadan doonin fal kasta oo lagu dhaawacayo sharafta iyo sumcadda Ciidamada, isla markaana lala xisaabtami doono cid kasta oo sameysa xadgudub noocaan oo kale ah. items.title: Somaliland Guurti Speaker Steps Down After More Than Two Decades, Citing Age and Fatigue
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) – Somaliland’s long-serving Speaker of the House of Elders (Guurti), Saleebaan Maxamuud Aadan, has formally announced his resignation, bringing to a close more than two decades at the helm of one of Somaliland’s most influential institutions. The announcement came during an extraordinary session of the Guurti on Sunday, where the 92-year-old veteran politician said advancing age and declining physical strength had convinced him it was time to relinquish office. “I am tired; age has caught up with me,” Saleebaan told members of the House. “Even if my mind remains sharp, my physical strength is no longer what it was, and my steps have become slower. While my memory is still intact, I want to hand over this responsibility. Elders, I ask you today to accept my resignation, and I am signing it.” Saleebaan, who has served as Speaker of the Guurti since 2004, is widely regarded as one of Somaliland’s longest-serving senior political figures. Throughout his tenure, he played a central role in mediating political disputes and facilitating dialogue between rival political factions during periods of heightened tension. Supporters credit him with helping preserve Somaliland’s relative political stability through traditional conflict-resolution mechanisms, arguing that his leadership of the Guurti was instrumental in defusing recurring political crises. However, his lengthy tenure was not without controversy. Both Saleebaan and the House of Elders faced sustained criticism from opposition parties, civil society organizations, and political analysts, particularly over the chamber’s repeated extensions of the terms of key government institutions. Critics argued that the Guurti had, at times, exceeded its constitutional mandate by approving term extensions that delayed scheduled elections and prolonged the tenure of elected officials. His resignation therefore marks the end of a significant chapter in Somaliland’s political history. As one of the country’s most enduring political figures, Saleebaan’s departure closes an era that shaped Somaliland’s governance through both traditional authority and modern political institutions. Attention now turns to the process of selecting his successor, a decision expected to carry considerable political significance as Somaliland navigates its next phase of institutional and democratic development. items.title: Puntland’s Main Gateway Falls Silent: Bosaso Port Crisis Sparks Public Anger and Business Boycott
items.description: Bosaso (WDN)– Puntland’s most important commercial hub has remained at a standstill, with port operations and business activities suspended after a dispute over increased port charges forced traders to halt operations. The shutdown has also sparked growing public protests across the coastal city of Bosaso, raising concerns about the broader economic impact on Puntland and central Somalia. According to local sources, commercial activity across Bosaso has slowed dramatically after the company managing Bosaso Port introduced what traders describe as a substantial increase in taxes and handling fees on imported goods destined for Somali businesses, particularly those operating in Puntland. The dispute has now entered its 12th consecutive day, with reports indicating that no commercial cargo has been unloaded at the port since the standoff began. The prolonged shutdown has raised concerns about potential shortages of imported goods and the wider economic impact on Puntland’s business community. As tensions mounted, hundreds of residents took to the streets of Bosaso to protest both the port management company and the Puntland administration, accusing authorities of failing to intervene and resolve a crisis that is increasingly affecting livelihoods and local commerce. Protesters argued that importing goods through Bosaso has become significantly more expensive than using the ports of Mogadishu or Berbera. They maintained that the higher fees are undermining Bosaso’s competitiveness as Puntland’s principal gateway for international trade and placing an unfair burden on businesses already grappling with rising operating costs. One Bosaso-based businessman said traders would not accept the additional charges, arguing that the increased costs cannot be justified given what he described as limited public services provided by the Puntland administration. “The government does not cover healthcare, education, or water services, yet businesses are being asked to shoulder even higher taxes,” the trader said, expressing frustration over the growing financial pressures facing the private sector. The closure of commercial operations at Bosaso Port has intensified concerns among economists and business leaders, who warn that if the dispute continues unresolved, it could disrupt supply chains, drive up consumer prices, and weaken one of Puntland’s most important economic lifelines. Neither the Puntland government nor the company managing Bosaso Port had issued a comprehensive public response to the latest protests at the time of publication, leaving uncertainty over when negotiations might resume and commercial activity at the port return to normal. items.title: Muxuu Muungaab kala hadlay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa maanta xafiiska ku qaabilay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park, Gobolka Minnesota ee dalka Maraykanka, Marwo Nadia Mohamed oo haatan booqasho ku joogta dalka. Labada mas’uul ayaa kulankooda diiradda ku saaray xoojinta xiriirka iskaashi ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo St. Louis Park, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha maamulka dowladaha hoose, horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, iyo kobcinta wada-shaqeynta. Guddoomiye Muungaab oo si diirran u soo dhaweeyay Nadia Mohamed, ayaa ku bogaadiyay guusha taariikhiga ah ee ay gaartay, taas oo ka dhigtay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee Soomaaliyeed, Muslimad iyo Madow ah ee loo doorto xilka Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park. Sidoo kale Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu sheegay in guushaasi ay tahay mid dhiirrigelin u ah dhammaan bulshada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhalinyarada iyo haweenka, isla markaana ay muujinayso kartida iyo kaalinta sii kordheysa ee ay Soomaalidu ku leeyihiin hoggaaminta iyo adeegga bulshada. Dhankeeda, Marwo Nadia ayaa uga mahadcelisay Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho soo dhaweynta iyo martigelinta uu u sameeyay, iyadoo bogaadisay dadaallada ay Dowladda Hoose ee Muqdisho ku horumarinayso adeegyada bulshada, bilicda magaalada iyo dib-u-dhiska Caasimadda. Waxaa kale oo ay muujisay sida ay uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada magaalo. Nadia Mohamed ayaa horay ula kulantay madaxda sare, gaar ahaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ay u sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka, dhiirrigelinta iskaashiga iyo taageeridda dadaallada lagu horumarinayo Soomaaliya, iyada oo tilmaantay in ay lama filaan ku noqotay amniga iyo horumarka ka socda caasimadda dalka ee magaalada Muqdisho. Si kastaba, Nadia ayaa sidoo kale kulamo dadweyne ka wadda caasimada, iyadoo la kulmeyso qaybaha kala bulshada, sida ardeyda jaamacadaha.   The post Muxuu Muungaab kala hadlay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: England’s resilience faces ultimate test against Argentina in World Cup semi-final
items.description: KANSAS CITY, Missouri, (Reuters) – England’s reward for another display of resilience at the  World Cup  is ​a semi-final against old rivals  Argentina , a fixture laden with history and one that offers Thomas Tuchel’s side the chance to move within one ‌game of ending a 60-year wait. A day after  overcoming Norway 2-1 in extra time  to reach the last four, England found themselves preparing for a meeting with the reigning champions, adding another chapter to one of the World Cup’s most enduring rivalries. England have reached the semi-finals for the second time in the last three tournaments, having fallen to Croatia in extra time at Russia ​2018. Their only appearance in a World Cup final came in 1966, when they lifted the trophy on home soil. Tuchel’s side have forged their ​run through a blend of star quality and sheer determination, twice coming from behind in the knockout phase to keep their ⁠tournament alive. The coach believes this has become a defining trait of his team. “They just refuse to give in. They just refuse to accept a defeat,” ​Tuchel said. “They overcome setbacks. They put a shift in. There is not one 1% complaint about that.” Yet Tuchel tempered the celebrations with a warning that England have room ​for improvement. “To overcome adversity and find ways to win is on the absolutely highest level,” he said. “We found a way, we’re in the last four, which is the most important thing. But I still think we can and have to play better football.” England’s progress has been driven largely by the partnership of captain Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham. The two have each scored ​six of England’s 13 goals at the tournament — the first pair of teammates to net that many goals at a World Cup. Bellingham heads to Atlanta ​in ominous form after scoring four goals in his last two matches. “World-class performance from a world-class player in big, big moments,” Tuchel said. “Absolute top class.” England forward Noni Madueke suggested such displays ‌have become ⁠routine for the Real Madrid man. “It’s unbelievable what he’s doing,” Madueke said. “It’s very normal though for him.” The squad were pushed to their limits by Norway, with players suffering cramp and illness in searing conditions. Tuchel revealed that midfielder Declan Rice, who did not play the second half on Saturday, had spent most of the previous three days in bed ill. Madueke said results were all that mattered, however. “Listen, if we play like this and win the next two games, I don’t mind. I’m ​not bothered,” he said. History provides ample evidence ​of the challenge ahead. The teams ⁠have met five times previously at World Cups: England beat Argentina in 1962 and 1966 before Diego Maradona’s infamous “Hand of God” goal and brilliant solo effort inspired Argentina’s victory at Mexico 1986. Argentina edged a last-16 tie on penalties in 1998 — ​remembered for Michael Owen’s wonder goal and David Beckham’s red card — before Beckham gained revenge by scoring the winner ​in England’s 1-0 group-stage ⁠triumph in 2002 in Japan. England’s most recent major tournament semi-final ended more happily, with Ollie Watkins’ late winner securing a 2-1 victory over the Netherlands at Euro 2024 to send England into the final. Now they face another formidable test against Lionel Scaloni’s world champions, with a place in the 2026 final at stake. Tuchel admitted the emotional demands ⁠of tournament ​football are unlike anything he has experienced as a club manager, but said there was nowhere ​else he would rather be. “I feel very alive in these moments,” he said. “This is where I want to be. I don’t want to be anywhere else in the world.” England, carried by the brilliance of ​Kane and Bellingham and a growing belief they can survive anything, will hope that feeling lasts at least one game longer. items.title: Somalia Arrests Soldiers as U.S. Warns Anti-American Acts Could Damage Strategic Ties
items.description: MOGADISHU — The Federal Government of Somalia has arrested several individuals accused of appearing in a video wearing Somali military uniforms and stepping on the United States flag. Somalia’s Ministry of Defence said the suspects had been identified and taken into custody after the video circulated widely on social media. The ministry also released their names and confirmed that the relevant authorities had launched an investigation into the incident. The United States Embassy in Mogadishu welcomed the Somali Government’s swift response and called for all those involved to be held accountable. “The U.S. Embassy appreciates the swift response of the Federal Government of Somalia and the decisive actions taken following the circulation of a video showing individuals disrespecting the American flag,” the embassy said. The embassy warned that such actions could undermine the longstanding relationship between Somalia and the United States. It noted that Washington has provided Somalia with billions of dollars in humanitarian, security and development assistance over the years. The United States has also supported Somalia’s fight against Al-Shabaab and ISIS, strengthened national security institutions and contributed to efforts aimed at promoting stability. The embassy said individuals seeking to damage relations between the two countries were acting against the interests of the Somali people and stressed the importance of protecting the strategic partnership between Mogadishu and Washington. items.title: Senator Lindsay Graham: Taageerihii xasuuqa Gaza iyo saaxibkii Israel oo geeriyooday
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Senator-ka Mareykanka Lindsey Graham, oo ka mid ahaa siyaasiyiinta Washington sida weyn ugu ololeeya Israel, isla markaana muddo dheer ku baaqayay in awood militari loo adeegsado Iran, ayaa geeriyooday kaddib xanuun kooban oo kedis ah, sida uu xafiiskiisu sheegay Axaddii. Graham, oo 71 jir ahaa, ayaa geeriyooday habeenkii Sabtida, 11-kii July, wax yar kaddib markii uu kasoo laabtay Ukraine, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelensky. Waxay ahayd booqashadiisii tobnaad ee uu ku tago Ukraine tan iyo markii Ruushku qaaday duullaankiisa ballaaran sannadkii 2022. Xafiiskiisa ma uusan shaacin nooca xanuunka sababay geeridiisa. “Qoyska Senator Graham waxay ka mahadcelinayaan ducooyinka, waxayna codsanayaan in loo tixgeliyo gaar ahaanshahooda xilligan aadka u adag,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Graham ku tilmaamay qof “la mid ah xubin qoyska ka tirsan”, isaga oo sheegay in senator-ku uu telefoon kula hadlay markii uu kasoo laabtay Ukraine. “Wuxuu u muuqday in yar oo daallan, laakiin xaaladdiisu waxay u muuqatay mid wanaagsan,” ayuu Trump u sheegay barnaamijka Meet the Press ee NBC. Taageerid Israel oo aan shuruud lahayn Graham wuxuu Congress-ka Mareykanka ka tirsanaa in ka badan 30 sano, balse sanadihii ugu dambeeyay waxaa sumcaddiisa si gaar ah u qeexay taageerada aan shuruudda lahayn ee uu siin jiray Israel iyo hawlgalladeeda militari ee Gaza iyo Iran. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa Graham ku tilmaamay “mid ka mid ah saaxiibbadii ugu waaweynaa ee Israel”, hadalkaas oo muujinaya xiriirka dhow ee ka dhexeeyay senator-ka iyo dowladda Israel. Kaddib weerarkii Xamaas hoggaamineysay ee 7-dii October 2023, Graham wuxuu si joogto ah u difaacay dagaalka Israel ka wadday Gaza, xilli ay kordhayeen dhimashada rayidka, barakaca iyo burburka baaxadda leh ee dhulka Falastiiniyiinta. Markii la weydiiyay dhammaadkii 2023 in ay jirto tiro dhimasho rayid ah oo ku qasbi karta Mareykanka inuu dib uga fiirsado taageeradiisa Israel, Graham wuxuu ku jawaabay in aysan jirin “xad”, inkastoo uu sheegay in Israel ay ku dadaasho yareynta khasaaraha rayidka. Wuxuu sidoo kale si adag uga hor yimid go’aankii maamulkii Madaxweyne Joe Biden uu muddo kooban ku hakiyay qaar ka mid ah hubka culus, sababo la xiriiray walaaca laga qabay weerar ballaaran oo Israel ku qaaddo magaalada Rafah. Graham wuxuu ku dooday in Israel la siiyo bambooyinka ay dalbaneyso, isaga oo dagaalka Gaza barbar dhigay duqeymihii nukliyeerka ahaa ee Mareykanku ku burburiyay magaalooyinka Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki dhammaadkii Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka, islamarkaana sidaas oo kale la yeelo Gaza. “Markii dalkeenna uu wajahay burbur kaddib Pearl Harbor, waxaan go’aansannay inaan dagaalka kusoo afjarno duqeyntii Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki,” ayuu yiri wareysi uu bixiyay bishii May 2024. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Israel loo oggolaado inay sameyso wax kasta oo ay u aragto inay lagama maarmaan u yihiin badbaadadeeda, isaga oo ku baaqay in Washington ay siiso “bambooyinka ay u baahan tahay”. Hadalladaas waxay dhaliyeen cambaareyn xooggan, waxaana dadka dhaliilay ay ku eedeeyeen inuu caadiyeynayo burburinta baaxadda leh ee rayidka. Graham wuxuu sidoo kale saadaaliyay in Israel ay Gaza xoog kula wareegi doonto, isaga oo ololahaas la barbar dhigay burburintii iyo qabsashadii Jarmalka iyo Japan ee xulafadu sameeyeen Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka. Waxa uu hormuud ka ahaa dadaalladii lagu ciqaabayay Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah, markii dacwad-oogaha maxkamaddu uu tallaabooyin ka qaaday Netanyahu iyo saraakiil kale oo Israel ah oo loo haystay dambiyo dagaal. Graham wuxuu sidoo kale ka hor yimid hindisayaal Senate-ka la horgeeyay oo lagu doonayay in lagu hakiyo hubka Mareykanku u diro Israel. Bishii September 2025, guddiga madaxa-bannaan ee baaritaanka Qaramada Midoobay wuxuu ku soo gabagabeeyay in Israel ay xasuuq ka geysatay Gaza. Amnesty International ayaa horey u gaartay gunaanad la mid ah. Israel waxay eedeymahaas ku tilmaantay kuwo been ah oo siyaasadeysan, halka dacwadda xasuuqa ee Koonfur Afrika ka gudbisay Israel ay weli hortaallo Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Caddaaladda, oo aan weli gaarin xukun kama dambeys ah. Inkastoo eedeymahaas iyo khasaaraha rayidka ay sii kordhayeen, Graham wuxuu sii ahaa mid ka mid ah difaacayaasha ugu codka dheer ee Israel ku lahayd Washington. U ololeeyihii ugu weynaa dagaalka Iran Senator-ka ayaa sidoo kale caan ku ahaa mowqifkiisa adag ee Iran. Muddo sanado ah wuxuu ku doodayay in wada-hadalka iyo cunaqabateynta dhaqaale aysan ku filneyn joojinta barnaamijka nukliyeerka Tehran. Wuxuu taageeray weerarradii Israel iyo Mareykanka ku qaadeen xarumaha nukliyeerka iyo militariga Iran, wuxuuna Congress-ka ka noqday mid ka mid ah dadka ugu xooggan ee taageera fidinta dagaalka intii lagu jiray muddo-xileedkii labaad ee Trump. Graham wuxuu ku tilmaamay qalalaasaha siyaasadeed ee Iran “xilligii Darbiga Berlin”, isaga oo ku baaqay in Mareykanku gacan ka geysto ridista nidaamka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah. Wuxuu mar dambe soo jeediyay in hub la siiyo shacabka Iran, qorshahaas oo uu ku tilmaamay “xalka Qodobka Labaad”, isaga oo ula jeeday qodobka dastuurka Mareykanka ee ilaalinaya xaqa hub-qaadashada. Mowqifyadaas waxay Graham nacayb xooggan uga abuureen Iran iyo qaybo badan oo Bariga Dhexe ah, laakiin waxay sii xoojiyeen xiriirkii uu la lahaa Netanyahu iyo madaxda kale ee Israel oo u arkayay saaxiibkooda ugu kalsoonida badan ee Washington. Dhaliile Trump oo noqday saaxiib dhow Graham wuxuu Senate-ka galay sannadkii 2003, kaddib siddeed sano oo uu xubin ka ahaa Aqalka Wakiillada. Wuxuu ahaa qareen hore oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada cirka Mareykanka, waxaana siyaasaddiisa dibadda saldhig u ahaa taageerada faragelinta militari iyo xulafada Mareykanka, gaar ahaan Israel, NATO iyo Ukraine. Intii lagu jiray tartankii madaxtinimada Jamhuuriga ee 2016, Graham wuxuu si adag u dhaliilay Trump, isaga oo ku tilmaamay inuusan u qalmin xilka madaxweynaha, kuna cambaareeyay weerarradii uu ku qaaday saaxiibkiis Senator John McCain. Hase yeeshee, markii Trump uu ku guuleystay madaxtinimada, Graham wuxuu isu beddelay mid ka mid ah difaacayaashiisa ugu daacadsan. Wuxuu garab istaagay Trump labadii dacwadood ee xil-ka-qaadista, wuxuuna dib ugu laabtay taageeradiisa kaddib markii uu muddo kooban uga fogaaday weerarkii 6-dii January 2021 lagu qaaday xarunta Congress-ka. Muddadii labaad ee Trump, Graham wuxuu noqday la-taliye joogto ah oo arrimaha Israel, Iran, Ruushka iyo Ukraine ah, isaga oo kamid ahaa siyaasiyiinta Mareykanka ee sida ugu xooggan ugu ololeeya adeegsiga awoodda militari ee dibadda. Geeridiisu waxay bannaaneeysay kursiga South Carolina xilli uu isu diyaarinayay inuu markale u tartamo doorashada November, waxayna Washington ka saartay mid ka mid ah siyaasiyiintii ugu saameynta badnaa ee taageeri jiray dagaallada iyo faragelinta militari ee Mareykanka. Graham wuxuu ku dooday in Israel la siiyo bambooyinka ay dalbaneyso, isaga oo dagaalka Gaza barbar dhigay duqeymihii nukliyeerka ahaa ee Mareykanku ku burburiyay magaalooyinka Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki dhammaadkii Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka, islamarkaana sidaas oo kale la yeelo Gaza. “Markii dalkeenna uu wajahay burbur kaddib Pearl Harbor, waxaan go’aansannay inaan dagaalka kusoo afjarno duqeyntii Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki,” ayuu yiri wareysi uu bixiyay bishii May 2024. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Israel loo oggolaado inay sameyso wax kasta oo ay u aragto inay lagama maarmaan u yihiin badbaadadeeda, isaga oo ku baaqay in Washington ay siiso “bambooyinka ay u baahan tahay”. Hadalladaas waxay dhaliyeen cambaareyn xooggan, waxaana dadka dhaliilay ay ku eedeeyeen inuu caadiyeynayo burburinta baaxadda leh ee rayidka. Graham wuxuu sidoo kale saadaaliyay in Israel ay Gaza xoog kula wareegi doonto, isaga oo ololahaas la barbar dhigay burburintii iyo qabsashadii Jarmalka iyo Japan ee xulafadu sameeyeen Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka. Waxa uu hormuud ka ahaa dadaalladii lagu ciqaabayay Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah, markii dacwad-oogaha maxkamaddu uu tallaabooyin ka qaaday Netanyahu iyo saraakiil kale oo Israel ah oo loo haystay dambiyo dagaal. Graham wuxuu sidoo kale ka hor yimid hindisayaal Senate-ka la horgeeyay oo lagu doonayay in lagu hakiyo hubka Mareykanku u diro Israel. Bishii September 2025, guddiga madaxa-bannaan ee baaritaanka Qaramada Midoobay wuxuu ku soo gabagabeeyay in Israel ay xasuuq ka geysatay Gaza. Amnesty International ayaa horey u gaartay gunaanad la mid ah. Israel waxay eedeymahaas ku tilmaantay kuwo been ah oo siyaasadeysan, halka dacwadda xasuuqa ee Koonfur Afrika ka gudbisay Israel ay weli hortaallo Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Caddaaladda, oo aan weli gaarin xukun kama dambeys ah. Inkastoo eedeymahaas iyo khasaaraha rayidka ay sii kordhayeen, Graham wuxuu sii ahaa mid ka mid ah difaacayaasha ugu codka dheer ee Israel ku lahayd Washington. U ololeeyihii ugu weynaa dagaalka Iran Senator-ka ayaa sidoo kale caan ku ahaa mowqifkiisa adag ee Iran. Muddo sanado ah wuxuu ku doodayay in wada-hadalka iyo cunaqabateynta dhaqaale aysan ku filneyn joojinta barnaamijka nukliyeerka Tehran. Wuxuu taageeray weerarradii Israel iyo Mareykanka ku qaadeen xarumaha nukliyeerka iyo militariga Iran, wuxuuna Congress-ka ka noqday mid ka mid ah dadka ugu xooggan ee taageera fidinta dagaalka intii lagu jiray muddo-xileedkii labaad ee Trump. Graham wuxuu ku tilmaamay qalalaasaha siyaasadeed ee Iran “xilligii Darbiga Berlin”, isaga oo ku baaqay in Mareykanku gacan ka geysto ridista nidaamka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah. Wuxuu mar dambe soo jeediyay in hub la siiyo shacabka Iran, qorshahaas oo uu ku tilmaamay “xalka Qodobka Labaad”, isaga oo ula jeeday qodobka dastuurka Mareykanka ee ilaalinaya xaqa hub-qaadashada. Mowqifyadaas waxay Graham nacayb xooggan uga abuureen Iran iyo qaybo badan oo Bariga Dhexe ah, laakiin waxay sii xoojiyeen xiriirkii uu la lahaa Netanyahu iyo madaxda kale ee Israel oo u arkayay saaxiibkooda ugu kalsoonida badan ee Washington. Dhaliile Trump oo noqday saaxiib dhow Graham wuxuu Senate-ka galay sannadkii 2003, kaddib siddeed sano oo uu xubin ka ahaa Aqalka Wakiillada. Wuxuu ahaa qareen hore oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada cirka Mareykanka, waxaana siyaasaddiisa dibadda saldhig u ahaa taageerada faragelinta militari iyo xulafada Mareykanka, gaar ahaan Israel, NATO iyo Ukraine. Intii lagu jiray tartankii madaxtinimada Jamhuuriga ee 2016, Graham wuxuu si adag u dhaliilay Trump, isaga oo ku tilmaamay inuusan u qalmin xilka madaxweynaha, kuna cambaareeyay weerarradii uu ku qaaday saaxiibkiis Senator John McCain. Hase yeeshee, markii Trump uu ku guuleystay madaxtinimada, Graham wuxuu isu beddelay mid ka mid ah difaacayaashiisa ugu daacadsan. Wuxuu garab istaagay Trump labadii dacwadood ee xil-ka-qaadista, wuxuuna dib ugu laabtay taageeradiisa kaddib markii uu muddo kooban uga fogaaday weerarkii 6-dii January 2021 lagu qaaday xarunta Congress-ka. Muddadii labaad ee Trump, Graham wuxuu noqday la-taliye joogto ah oo arrimaha Israel, Iran, Ruushka iyo Ukraine ah, isaga oo kamid ahaa siyaasiyiinta Mareykanka ee sida ugu xooggan ugu ololeeya adeegsiga awoodda militari ee dibadda. Geeridiisu waxay bannaaneeysay kursiga South Carolina xilli uu isu diyaarinayay inuu markale u tartamo doorashada November, waxayna Washington ka saartay mid ka mid ah siyaasiyiintii ugu saameynta badnaa ee taageeri jiray dagaallada iyo faragelinta militari ee Mareykanka. items.title: Qatar Mourns the Death of Former Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani
items.description: Doha (WDN) – Qatar is mourning the passing of its former ruler, Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, the Father Emir and architect of modern Qatar, who died on Sunday at the age of 74. His death was officially announced by the Amiri Diwan, the Emir’s office, marking the end of a transformative era in the Gulf state’s history. Sheikh Hamad served as Emir of Qatar from 1995 to 2013, overseeing one of the most remarkable national transformations in the modern Middle East. Under his leadership, the once modest Gulf nation emerged as a global economic powerhouse, diplomatic player, and influential media hub. His tenure was defined by the rapid expansion of Qatar’s liquefied natural gas industry, which propelled the country to become one of the world’s wealthiest nations on a per-capita basis. He also championed ambitious infrastructure projects, expanded Qatar Airways into a leading international airline, and launched Al Jazeera in 1996, a news network that reshaped the Arab media landscape and significantly increased Qatar’s global influence Among his most enduring legacies was Qatar’s successful bid to host the 2022 FIFA World Cup, a landmark achievement that placed the small Gulf nation at the center of global attention and showcased decades of investment in infrastructure and international engagement. In a rare and widely praised move for the Gulf region, Sheikh Hamad voluntarily abdicated the throne in 2013, peacefully transferring power to his son, the current Emir, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani. The orderly succession was viewed as an unprecedented example of planned leadership transition in the Arab world. His death comes at a time of heightened regional security tensions, prompting an outpouring of condolences from leaders and citizens across Qatar and beyond. Tributes have highlighted his pivotal role in transforming Qatar from a relatively small Gulf state into a country with outsized influence in global diplomacy, energy markets, international investment, and media. For many Qataris, Sheikh Hamad’s legacy will be remembered not only for the nation’s extraordinary economic growth but also for laying the foundations of the modern Qatari state—one that became a prominent voice in regional affairs and an increasingly influential actor on the world stage. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo soo bandhigtay raggii calanka Mareykanka ku xadgudbay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta soo bandhigtay afar eedeysane oo loo haysto inay ku xadgudbeen calanka Mareykanka, iyaga oo xiran dareeska Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka. Raggan ayaa muuqaal ku baahiyay baraha bulshada, iyaga oo ku istaagayo calanka Mareykanka, taas oo ay ka dhalatay falcelin aan caadi aheyn. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in falkaas uu ka hor imaanayo anshaxa iyo xifradda ciidamada, sidoo kalena uusan ka tarjumeyn aragtideeda, maadaama haatan ay xiriir wanaagsan la leedahay dowladda Mareykanka. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in eedeysanayaasha ay gacanta ku jiraan, isla markaana laga qaadi doono tallaabo adag oo sharciga waafaqsan, waxayna kala yihiin;- 1-Cabdikhadar Mahad Cumar oo 22 sano jir ah, 2-Maxamed Raage Xuseen oo 16 sano jir ah, 3-Muudey Faysal Muudey oo 17 sano jir ah iyo 4-Maxamed Amiin Qaasim Muuse oo 15 sano jir ah. Sidoo kale, Wasaaradda ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in aan loo dulqaadan doonin fal kasta oo lagu dhaawacayo sharafta iyo sumcadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. “Dhammaan shakhsiyaadkii ku lugta lahaa falkii lagu xadgudbay dareyska Ciidanka Qaranka iyo calanka Mareykanka ayaa gacanta lagu soo dhigay. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxay ka digaysaa in aan loo dulqaadan doonin fal kasta oo lagu dhaawacayo sharafta iyo sumcadda Ciidanka Qaranka,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Bayaankan waxaa ka horreeyay mid kale oo ay Sabtidii dowladda Soomaaliya ku sheegtay inay aad uga xun tahay dhacdada, iyada oo tilmaantay in ay si weyn u qadarinayso iskaashiga muddada dheer kala dhexeeya Maraykanka, ayna ilaalineyso xiriirka ka dhexeeya xukuumadaha Muqdisho iyo Washington. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dalalka waa wayn ee taageerada siiya Soomaaliya, iyada oo bayaanka lagu xusay doorkiisa ku aadan la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. “Wadashaqeyntaas ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaadatay la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish (ISIS), iyo xoojinta hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiggu waxay mar kale caddeynaysaa ixtiraamka ay u hayso shacabka iyo calanka Maraykanka, iyo sidoo kale iskaashiga waara ee ka dhexeeya labada dal” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal ay shalay soo saartay dowladda. items.title: Laamaha Amniga oo Xiray Dhallinyaro loo Heysto Muuqaalkii Calanka Mareykanka ee lagu Baahiyay Baraha Bulshada
items.description: MUQDISHO, Soomaaliya — Hey’adaha amniga dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku guuleystay inay gacanta ku soo dhigaan dhammaan shakhsiyaadkii ku labisnaa dharka ciidanka qaranka, kuwaas oo dhawaan ka soo muuqday muuqaal aad loogu baahiyay baraha bulshada. Dhallinyaradan ayaa muuqaalka lagu arkay iyagoo si anshax-darro ah ugu istaagaya calanka dalka Mareykanka, isla markaana ku xadgudbaya magaca, qiimaha, iyo anshaxa suubban ee ciidamada qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Qoraal rasmi ah oo weheliya sawirrada eedaysanayaasha ayaa lagu caddeeyay in si toos ah u bilowdeen baaritaannada rasmiga ah ee lagu samaynayo afartan dhallinyarada ah ee kiiskan loo soo qabtay, kuwaas oo magacyadooda lagu kala sheegay Cabdikhadar Mahad Cumar Cosoble oo 22 sano jir ah, Maxamed Raage Xuseen Maxamed oo 16 sano jir ah, Muudey Faysal Muudey Aways oo 17 sano jir ah, iyo Maxamed Amiin Qaasim Muuse oo 15 sano jir ah. Laamaha amniga ayaa ku tilmaamay falka ay ku kaceen mid dhaawacaya sharafta iyo sumcadda ciidanka qalabka sida oo astaan u ah madaxbannaanida dalka. Eedaysanayaasha sharciga la horkeenay oo da’doodu ay aad u yar tahay ayaa hadda wajahaya su’aalo weyn oo ku saabsan baraha bulshada ee loo adeegsaday baahinta muuqaalkan iyo cidda ka dambeysay abaabulkiisa.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo la kulmay guddoomiyaha cusub ee  golaha guuttida
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta Xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Guurtida Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Muuse Xaaji Cabdi Ducaale iyo Guddoomiyihii hore ee Golaha, Mudane Saleebaan Maxamuud Aadan oo maanta xilka banneeyey. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu Guddoomiyaha cusub ugu hambalyeeyey kalsoonida ay Golaha Guurtidu ugu doorteen hoggaaminta Golaha, isaga oo u rajeeyey in Alle SWT ku asturo masuuliyadda culus ee loo igmaday, kuna guulaysto xoojinta doorka Golaha Guurtida ee ilaalinta nabadda, xasilloonida, wadajirka iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadeed ee Qaranka. Sida oo kale, Madaxweynuhu waxa uu Guddoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Guurtida, Mudane Saleebaan Maxamuud Aadan si qoto dheer ugaga mahad naqay muddada dheer ee uu u soo adeegayey dalka iyo dadka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu Guddoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Guurtida ku bogaadiyey hoggaamintiisii iyo sida hagar la’aanta iyo xikmadda lahayd ee uu ugu soo adeegayey Qaranka JSL, isaga oo ku tilmaamay Oday Qaran oo mudan qaddarin iyo abaal Qaran.

items.title: Itoobiya iyo Kenya oo Kala Saxeexday Heshiis Cusub oo Dhinaca Korontada ah
items.description: Shirkadda Adeegga Korontada Itoobiya (EEU) iyo Shirkadda Korontada ee Kenya (Kenya Power) ayaa magaalada Addis Ababa ku kala saxeexday heshiis cusub oo la xiriira dhoofinta korontada Itoobiya ay u iibinayso Kenya. Sida ku cad heshiiska, Itoobiya ayaa Kenya ku siin doonta koronto qiimaheedu yahay 0.15 doolar halkii kilowatt-saacba (kWh), taas oo u dhiganta qiyaastii 24.07 birr. Heshiiskan ayaa la filayaa inuu xoojiyo iskaashiga tamarta ee labada waddan, isla markaana kor u qaado helitaanka koronto lagu kalsoonaan karo, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku dhow xuduudaha labada dal. Sidoo kale, waxaa la rumeysan yahay inuu dhiirrigelin doono kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo isdhexgalka gobolka Bariga Afrika. Dhanka kale, Itoobiya ayaa si weyn u kordhisay awooddeeda wax-soo-saarka korontada toddobadii sano ee la soo dhaafay, iyadoo korontada ay dhaliso ay ka korortay 4,462 megawatt ilaa 9,752 megawatt. Kororkaasi waxaa door weyn ku leh mashaariic waaweyn oo dalkaas laga hirgeliyey, gaar ahaan Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya ee GERD, kaas oo ah mashruuca ugu weyn ee korontada biyaha laga dhaliyo ee qaaradda Afrika. Itoobiya ayaa hadda koronto u dhoofisa dalalka Kenya, Jabuuti, Tansaaniya iyo Suudaan, iyadoo sidoo kale wadahadallo cusub kula jirta Suudaanta Koonfureed. Soomaaliya ayaa iyaduna muujisay xiisaha ay u qabto inay mustaqbalka ka faa’iidaysato korontada Itoobiya.

items.title: Somaliya iyo Mareykanka oo si adag uga falceliyay muuqaalka ragga ku istaagay Calanka Mareykanka
items.description: Dowladaha Somaliya iyo Mareykanka ayaa si adag uga falceliyay muuqaal toddobaadkan barraha bulshada qabsaday oo muujnaya rag xiran dareyska Ciidamada Dowladda Somaliya oo ku dul taagan Calanka Mareykanka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga Somaliya ayaa maanta sheegtay in gacanta lagu soo dhigay dhammaan shakhsiyaadkii ku xadgudbay dareyska Ciidanka Qaranka iyo Calanka Mareykanka Wasaaradda ayaa waxay ka digtay inaanan la aqbali doonin fal kasta oo lagu dhaawacayo sharafka iyo sumcadda Ciidanka Qaranka. “Dhammaan shakhsiyaadkii ku lugta lahaa falkii lagu xadgudbay dareyska Ciidanka Qaranka iyo Calanka Mareykanka ayaa gacanta lagu soo dhigay. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga waxay ka digaysaa in aan loo dulqaadan doonin fal kasta oo lagu dhaawacayo sharafta iyo sumcadda Ciidanka Qaranka.” Ayaa lagu yiri qoraal lagu daabacay bogga wasaaradda oo lagu lifaaqay sawirrada afar nin oo dhallinyaro ah. Dusha sare ee sawirrada raggan ayaa lagu qoray “Waxaa lagu guuleystay in dhammaan la soo wada qabtay shakhsiyaadkii dharka ciidamada ku labisnaa ee ku jiray muuqaalka barraha bulshada lagu faafiyay, ayagoo Calanka Mareykanka si anshax darro ah ugu istaagaya, isla-markaana ku xadgudbaya magaca, qiyamka iyo anshaxa Ciidamada Qaranka, waxaana si toos ah u bilowday baaritaanka eedeysaneyaasha kiiskaas loo soo qabtay.” Dhanka kale Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ayaa Axaddan sheegtay in falalka ka dhanka ah Mareykanka ay wax u dhimayaan xiriirka labada dal. “Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ballaayiin dollar oo canshuur bixiyeyaasha ah ugu deeqday Somaliya.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ay safaaradda soo saartay oo lagu xusay “Waxa ugu muhiimsan, niyad wanaagga dadka Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer taageerayay tallaabo militari oo ka dhan ah ururada argagixisada, kuwaas oo halis gelinaya Mareykanka, si toos ahna u bartilmaameedsada dadka Soomaaliyeed.” Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ayaa Dowladda Federaalka uga mahadcelisay tallaabada degdegga ah ee lagu soo xiray shakhsiyaadkii ka soo muuqday muuqaalka sida weyn ugu baahay internet-ka ee muujinayay, iyagoo xadgudub ku gaysanaya dareyska askarta. Safaaradda ayaa sheegtay in dadka ku kaca falalka noocani oo kale ah ay dhaawacayaan xiriirka Somaliya iyo Mareykanka, ayna tahay in lala xisaabtamo. Nuxurka hadalka Safaaradda Mareykanka ayaa ah in shakhsiyaadka sida ula kaca ah u waxyeeleeya xiriirka labada dal ay wiiqayaan taageerada muhiimka ah ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada, bani’aadantinimada iyo dhaqaalaha uu Mareykanku ku bixiyo arrimaha doorashooyinka dalka. Mareykanka ayaa Somaliya siiya gargaar bani’aadantinimo iyo kaalmo militari, isagoona Dowladda Federaalka u tababara mid ka mid ah Ciidamada Gaarka ee Somaliya, waana Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Shaacisay Qorshaha Qodista Ceelka Holhol iyo Wejiga Cusub ee Sahminta Shidaalka Berriga
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhowaqday tallaabo weyn oo loo qaaday dhanka soo saarista kheyraadka dabiiciga ah, ka dib markii ay shaacisay in dhowaan la bilaabi doono qodista ceel shidaal oo lagu magacaabo Holhol, kaas oo ku yaalla degmada Xudun ee gobolka Sool. Mashruucan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada is-daba-joogga ah ee ay dowladda ku dardargelinayso sahminta iyo horumarinta khayraadka shidaalka iyo tamarta ee dalka. Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Batroolka iyo Macdanta, Maxamed Xaashi Carabeey, ayaa xaqiijiyay in ceelka Holhol uu ka mid yahay saddex ceel oo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay sanadkii 2024 ku wareejisay shirkadda Golfsom, oo ay wada leeyihiin maalgashadeyaal Soomaaliyeed iyo Qatariyiin. Agaasimaha ayaa xaqiijiyay in heshiiskaas ka dib ay hadda dowladda iyo shirkaddu isku diyaarinayaan in si dhowaan ah loo bilaabo qodista rasmiga ah. Ceelka Holhol ayaan ahayn goob ku cusub khariidadda tamarta dalka, balse wuxuu ka mid yahay goobihii shidaalka ee hore loogu sameeyay sahanno kala duwan xilligii dowladihii hore ee dalka. Qorshaha hadda dib loo bilaabay ayaa ujeedkiisu yahay in lagu xaqiijiyo baaxadda keydka shidaal ee deegaankaas ku jira iyo fursadaha dhaqaale ee ka dhalan kara. Haddii qorshahan uu u hirgalo siday madaxtooyada iyo wasaaraddu u muddeeyeen, Holhol wuxuu noqon doonaa ceelkii labaad ee ay Dowladda Soomaaliya si rasmi ah u guda gasho qodistiisa. Tallaabadan ayaa daba-socota ceelka Curad-1, oo ah mashruuca ugu horreeya ee qodista shidaalka badda Soomaaliya, kaas oo ku yaalla biyaha u dhexeeya magaalooyinka Mareeg iyo Xarardheere ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Isku-dhafka qodista shidaalka badda iyo berriga ayaa loo arkaa weji cusub oo dhabaha u xaaraya isbeddel ballaaran oo ku yimaada ilaha dhaqaalaha iyo iskufilnaanshaha maaliyadeed ee dalka.

items.title: Hoos u dhac ku yimid shirkada korantada ee Iran kadib markii la duqeeyay
items.description: Awoodda shabakadda korontada ee Iran ayaa hoos u dhacday “4,200 oo megawatt” kadib weerarro ay geysteen Mareykanka. Shirkadda Tavanir waxay sheegtay in weerarrada Mareykanka ay waxyeello u geysteen shabakadda korontada ee Iiraan, taasoo hoos u dhigtay awooddeeda “qiyaastii 4,200 oo megawatts.” Mohammad El-Dad, oo ah madaxa shirkadda Tavanir, ayaa sheegay in “in ka badan laba kun oo dhibcood oo shabakadda ah ay waxyeello soo gaartay.” Sida uu sheegay Mr. Elhadad, “Dhaawaca soo gaaray shabakadda iyo qalabka warshadaha korontada ayaa dhaafay 60 tirilyan oo tomans ah.” Maamulaha shirkadda Tavanir ayaa ka digay in, marka la eego cadaadiska sii kordhaya ee shabakadda xilliga xagaaga, “in maalmaha soo socda aan lala kulmi doonin wax caqabado ah.”

Agaasime Carabeey ayaa tilmaamay in bulshada deegaanka ay si toos ah uga faa’iideysan doonto mashruuca, isaga oo sheegay in la abuuri doono fursado shaqo iyo koboc dhaqaale oo la xiriira howlaha sahminta iyo qodista shidaalka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in gobollada Sool iyo Sanaag ay ka mid yihiin meelaha ugu qanisan macdanta Soomaaliya, balse ay ka jirto qodis sharci-darro ah oo loo baahan yahay in lagu beddelo nidaam sharciyeysan oo lagu maamulo kheyraadka dalka. Carabeey ayaa xusay in Wasaaradda Batroolka iyo Macdanta ay diyaarisay hindise sharciyeed lagu maamulayo macdanta, kaas oo la horgeyn doono Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya marka uu dib u furmo, si loo helo hannaan sharci oo mideysan. Si kastaba, haddii lagu guuleysto in si hufan loo maamulo soo saarista kheyraadka dabiiciga ah, Soomaaliya waxay fursad u heli kartaa inay ka gudubto caqabadaha dhaqaale iyo horumar la’aanta. Hase yeeshee, haddii lagu guuldarraysto maamul wanaaggiisa, waxaa suuragal ah in dalku wajaho khilaafyo iyo colaad kheyraad oo hor leh. items.title: Carruur Soomaali ah oo halis ku wajahaya Minnesota kadib muuqaal uu baahiyey Trump
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida, Muslimiinta iyo ururrada xuquuqda madaniga ah ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyey muuqaal uu madaxweyne Donald Trump ku faafiyey bartiisa Truth Social, kaas oo muujinaya carruur Soomaali iyo Muslimiin ah oo u dabaaldegaya qalin-jabintooda fasalka xannaanada. Muuqaalka oo soconaya 14 ilbiriqsi ayaa laga duubay munaasabad ka dhacday Gateway STEM Academy, oo ah dugsi charter ah oo ku yaalla magaalada St. Paul. Carruurta ayaa xirnaa koofiyado iyo khamiisyo buluug ah oo qalin-jabin, halka gabdhaha qaarkood ay xijaab xirnaayeen. Muuqaalka waxaa markii hore baahiyey Somali TV of Minnesota, oo tabinayey xafladaha dhammaadka sannad-dugsiyeedka ee dugsiyada ay dhigtaan carruurta Soomaalida. Trump ayaa muuqaalka laba jeer ku baahiyey Truth Social Isniintii. Markii hore wax faallo ah kuma uusan darin, balse markii labaad wuxuu raaciyey qoraal ka yimid akoon lagu magacaabo “End Wokeness”, kaas oo yiri: “Dugsi dadweyne oo ku yaalla St. Paul, Minnesota. Gabadh kasta waxay xiran tahay xijaab — iyaga oo weliba ku jira fasalka xannaanada.” Inkasta oo Trump uusan si toos ah u sharxin sababta uu muuqaalka u faafiyey, hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada ayaa sheegay in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu awooddiisa iyo taageerayaashiisa u adeegsaday inuu carruur yar yar ka dhigo bartilmaameed dood siyaasadeed iyo naceyb diimeed. Golaha Xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Islaamka ee CAIR iyo laantiisa Minnesota ayaa sheegay in tallaabada Trump ay halis gelin karto carruurta muuqaalka ka soo muuqatay iyo guud ahaan dugsigooda. “Madaxweyne Trump wuxuu madashiisa caalamiga ah u adeegsaday inuu sii faafiyo naceybka Muslimiinta, isaga oo bartilmaameedsanaya carruur dhigata dugsi hoose,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan ay soo saareen labada hay’adood. CAIR waxay sheegtay in hadallada ama fariimaha naceybka ah ee ka yimaada hoggaamiye siyaasadeed ay dhiirrigelin karaan dadka doonaya inay weeraraan bulshooyinka laga tirada badan yahay. Ururka Somali American Partnership ayaa isna sheegay in carruurta Soomaalida aan loo adeegsan karin hurinta cabsi iyo kala-qeybsanaan. “Soomaali-Mareykanku waxay qeyb muhiim ah ka yihiin taariikhda, nolosha maanta iyo mustaqbalka Minnesota,” ayuu ururku yiri. “Carruurteennu waxay mudan yihiin in lagu aqoonsado kartidooda, halkii loo adeegsan lahaa hurinta naceybka Muslimiinta iyo dadka soo-galootiga ah.” Guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota Tim Walz ayaa sidoo kale Trump ku eedeeyey inuu weeraray carruurta sababo la xiriira dharkooda. “Madaxweynaha Mareykanka wuxuu weerarayaa koox carruur ah oo ku jirta fasalka xannaanada, sababtoo ah dharka ay dugsiga u xirnaayeen,” ayuu Walz ku qoray barta X. ‘Carruurta waa khad cas’ Hoggaamiyeyaal Muslimiin, Masiixiyiin iyo Yuhuud ah ayaa Arbacadii shir jaraa’id ku qabtay xarunta ganacsiga Karmel Mall ee Minneapolis, halkaas oo ay kaga digeen saameynta ay hadallada noocan ahi ku yeelan karaan carruurta iyo amniga bulshada. Imaam Yuusuf Cabdulle, oo ah agaasimaha Islamic Association of North America, ayaa sheegay in carruurta Muslimiinta ahi ay xaq u leeyihiin inay ogaadaan inay si buuxda uga tirsan yihiin Minnesota iyo Mareykanka. “Waa inaan carruurteenna loo sheegin inaysan dalkooda ka tirsaneyn dharka ay xiran yihiin awgiis,” ayuu yiri. Malika Dahir, oo hoggaamisa ururka Reviving Sisterhood, ayaa sheegtay in carruurtu aysan ahayn calaamado ay siyaasiyiintu u adeegsan karaan doodahooda. “Carruurtu waa inay noqdaan khadkeenna cas. Ma aha astaamo la adeegsan karo; waa carruur u baahan in lagu ilaaliyo hadalladeenna iyo ficilladeenna,” ayay tiri. Maamulka Gateway STEM Academy ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu si toos ah uga jawaabo Trump, balse agaasimaha dugsiga Mohamed Ahmed wuxuu sheegay in mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay daryeelka iyo badqabka ardayda, qoysaskooda iyo shaqaalaha. Wuxuu sheegay in dugsigu sii wadi doono abuurista jawi waxbarasho oo ammaan ah, ardaydana ku dhiirrigeliya kalsooni, iskaashi iyo inay gaaraan awooddooda buuxda. Cabsi soo noqnoqotay Murankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Soomaalida Minnesota ay muddooyinkii dambe sheegeen inay wajahayaan hadallo siyaasadeed oo isa soo taraya, kuwaas oo la xiriirinaya Soomaalida dembiyo, musuq iyo soo-galooti sharci-darro ah. Trump ayaa bishii December Soomaalida ku tilmaamay “qashin”, isagoo sidoo kale sheegay in Minnesota ay Soomaalidu ka dhigeen “meel halaag ah”. Hadalladaas ayaa markaas cambaareyn kala kulmay Walz, ururrada xuquuqda iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida. Deegaanka Minneapolis–St. Paul waxaa ku nool tobannaan kun oo qof oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah, kuwaas oo muddo dheer qeyb muhiim ah ka ahaa dhaqaalaha, siyaasadda iyo nolosha bulshada Minnesota. Hoggaamiyeyaasha Muslimiinta ayaa sheegay in cabsidoodu aysan ku salaysneyn hadallo keliya. Bishii May, nin ay boolisku sheegeen inuu watay laba mindi ayaa lagu xiray bannaanka masaajid ku yaalla Lakeville, kaddib markii shaqaalaha masaajidku sheegeen inuu dhaqmayey si laga shakiyey. Dhacdadaas ayaa timid xilli ay bulshooyinka Muslimiinta Mareykanka ka walaacsanaayeen weerarro iyo hanjabaado ka dhan ah masaajidda iyo xarumaha Islaamiga ah. Jaylani Hussein, agaasimaha CAIR-Minnesota, ayaa hore u sheegay in muddo saddex sano ah gobolka laga diiwaangeliyey in ka badan 40 dhacdo oo isugu jira gubid, burburin iyo qalqal lagu sameeyey masaajidda, kuwaas oo sababay khasaare ka badan saddex milyan oo dollar. Hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada ayaa hadda ku baaqaya in carruurta laga fogeeyo dagaallada siyaasadda, iyaga oo sheegay in qof kasta oo haysta madal dadweyne, gaar ahaan madaxweynaha dalka, ay waajib ku tahay inuu carruurta ilaaliyo halkii uu khatar gelin lahaa. items.title: Cabsi weyn oo soo wajahday Al-Shabaab kadib amarkii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Al-Shabaab ee ka dagaalanta gudaha Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa haatan soo wajahday cabsi xooggan, kadib amarkii kasoo baxay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo maalmo kahor ku dhawaaqay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ay qaadayaan dagaal kama dambeys ah oo dalka looga ciribtirayo cadowga Khawaarijta ah. Maleeshiyaada kooxda oo culays badan wajahaya ayaa haatan bilaabay inay isku soo dhiibaan Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka ee ku sugan furimaha dagaalka. Maalmihii lasoo dhaafay dhowr Horjooge oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta ayaa isku soo dhiibay dowladda, iyagoo sheegay inay soo wajahday cabsi badan, sida ay shaacisay warbaahinta ku hadasha afka dowladda. Sidoo kale, waxay xubnaha soo goostay sheegeen in markii horaba ay la kulmi jiray weerarrada iyo duqeymaha Ciidamada Qaranka iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah oo ay u dheeraayeen duruufaha adag ee duurka ku heysta Khawaarijta. Meelaha ay iska soo dhiibeen xubnaha soo gacan galay ayaa waxaa kamid ah deegaanada Mubaarak, Buulomareer iyo Jilib-marka ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, halkaas oo ay sidoo kale gaabiga ku hayaan ciidamada dowladda. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya uu Toddobaadkii Xoriyadda markale cafis u fidiyey qofkii kasoo hara fikirka guracan ee argagixisada ee isku soo dhiiba dowladda, dibna ugu soo laabta dadkiisa, isaga oo mar kale iclaamiyay dagaal kama dambeys ah. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay qaadi doontaa guluf dagaal oo kama dambeys ah, kaas oo dalka looga saarayo Khawaarijta, dadka Soomaaliyeedna dhawaan ayaan la wadaagi doonnaa qorshahaas,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Tan iyo markii uu soo baxay amarka Madaxweynaha waxaa sidoo kale dhaq-dhaqaaq cidian iyo isku dabarid bilaabay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka oo tegay furimaha hore ee dagaalka. The post Cabsi weyn oo soo wajahday Al-Shabaab kadib amarkii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland Forces Block Key Road Near Bosaso Over Unpaid Salaries
items.description: BOSASO— Puntland security forces protesting several months of unpaid salaries have blocked a major road in the Faluuja area of Carmo district, bringing public and commercial transport to a halt. The road serves as a key link between the port city of Bosaso and other regions of Puntland. An eyewitness told Raxanreeb Online that the protesting soldiers identified themselves as members of the Afmeer Brigade of the Puntland forces. The troops reportedly returned from front-line positions in the Calmiskaad mountains about a week ago after failing to receive their salaries and other financial entitlements. The soldiers said the road would remain closed until the Puntland administration addressed their complaints over unpaid wages, which they said had continued for several months. Local sources reported that the troops were stationed along the road with military vehicles, heavy weapons and other equipment, raising concerns about further disruption to travel and trade. The blockade has affected the movement of passengers, traders and goods between Bosaso and surrounding regions. Puntland’s senior military commanders and government officials have not yet issued a public statement regarding the protest or the closure of the road. Similar incidents have occurred in Puntland in the past, with security personnel blocking roads and government facilities to demand the payment of delayed salaries. The blockade has affected the movement of passengers, traders and goods between Bosaso and surrounding regions. Puntland’s senior military commanders and government officials have not yet issued a public statement regarding the protest or the closure of the road. Similar incidents have occurred in Puntland in the past, with security personnel blocking roads and government facilities to demand the payment of delayed salaries. items.title: U.S. embassy in Mogadishu says American flag desecration by Somali security forces harms U.S.-Somalia relations
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United States Embassy in Mogadishu on Sunday said the desecration of the American flag by members of Somalia’s security forces harms relations between the United States and Somalia, while praising the Somali federal government for its swift response and accountability measures. In a statement, the embassy said anti-American acts undermine the longstanding partnership between the two countries, noting that the United States has provided billions of dollars in assistance to Somalia and has long supported military operations against terrorist organizations that threaten both American and Somali interests. “Anti-American acts harm our bilateral relationship. The United States has provided billions of taxpayer dollars in assistance to Somalia. Most notably, the good faith of the American people has long supported military action against terrorist organizations which threaten the United States and, most directly, target the Somali people,” the embassy said. The embassy also welcomed the Federal Government of Somalia’s prompt response after a video circulated widely online showing individuals identified as members of the Somali Security Forces standing on and desecrating the American national flag. “The U.S. Embassy appreciates the Federal Government of Somalia’s quick response and decisive actions following a video of individuals in the Somali Security Forces desecrating the American flag. Malfeasant actors who seek to tarnish Somalia’s relationship with the United States harm the Somali people and must continue to be held accountable,” the statement added. The embassy’s remarks came days after the video emerged and spread widely on social media, drawing attention at a sensitive moment in U.S.-Somalia relations. The incident comes as the United States has recently informed the African Union that it intends to end its support for United Nations logistical assistance to the peacekeeping mission in Somalia. Washington cited a lack of sufficient progress by Somali authorities on security, political stability and the transition of Somalia’s security forces to assume full responsibility for the country’s security. On Friday, Somalia’s federal government announced that it had arrested the soldiers seen in the video, saying they would face disciplinary measures as well as legal action over their conduct. The government said the actions captured in the footage were unacceptable, reaffirming its commitment to holding those responsible accountable. The incident has renewed attention on the importance both governments attach to preserving their longstanding partnership as Somalia and the United States continue cooperating on counterterrorism efforts and broader initiatives aimed at strengthening Somalia’s security and stability. items.title: Amiir Hamad Bin Khaliifa oo lagu ammaanay inuu ahaa hoggaamiyaha keliya ee booqday Gaza taniyo markii la go’doomiyay
items.description: Madaxa Xamaas ee dibadda, Khaalid Mashal, ayaa sheegay in Amiirkii hore ee Dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, uu ahaa hoggaamiyihii ugu horreeyay ee Carbeed ee booqda Marinka Gaza tan iyo markii go’doominta lagu soo rogay. Mashal ayaa sheegay in booqashadaas ay ahayd mid taariikhi ah oo astaan u noqotay taageerada Qatar ay u muujisay shacabka reer Gaza, isaga oo xusay in ay jebisay go’doomintii siyaasadeed ee lagu hayay deegaankaas. Hadalkan ayuu jeediyay xilli ka tacsiyeeyay geerida amiirka oo dhowaan la shaaciyay, wuxuuna si faahfaahsan uga hadlay kaalinta Qatar ee arrimaha Falastiin. Amiir Sheekh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani ayaa booqday Gaza bishii Oktoobar 2012, isagoo noqday madaxii ugu horreeyay ee dowlad Carbeed oo si rasmi ah u taga Gaza tan iyo markii go’doominta la adkeeyay sannadkii 2007. Intii uu halkaas joogay wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taageero dhaqaale oo ballaaran oo loogu talagalay dib-u-dhiska kaabeyaasha iyo adeegyada bulshada, wixii xilligaas ka dambeeyayna Qatar waxay si joogto ah u difaacaysay dadka reer Falastiin. Amiirka ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusuustaa inuu xilka wareejiyay asagoo caafimaad qaba, culayso kalena aysan haysan, taas oo ah mid aan looga baran hoggaamiyaasha dalalka Carabta, gaar ahaan kuwa Khaliijka.

items.title: Cali Siciid reer Xaaji Saalax Cabashadooda Oodweyne  hoos ha loo dhegaysto
items.description: CALI SICIID REER XAAJI SAALAX CABASHADOODA OODWEYNE HOOS HALLOO EEGO. Waxaan warbaahinta ka daawaday maayarkii oodweyne oo tirsanaya in laysugu tegay LA MUQUUNIYAY oo mooshin xilkii lagaga qaaday arrinkaas oo u cuntamiwaayay umadda reer somaliland inta aqoonta u leh oodweyne iyo dhaqamada Habaryoonis. Qabiilka cali siciid waa jifo (ardaa) ka mida Habaryoonis oo leh maamuus gaar ah oo lagu xasuusto, waa ardaa miisaan culus ku leh h. Yoonis oo ay tahay in saamigooda hoos loo eego. Waxa habboon dadka in taariikhda lagu qaddariyo, waa jifadii muj. Maxamad cali,muj.saleebaan baylot (duuliye sare) Dr. Saleebaan reer xaaji Cabdillaahi shiikh muxumad carab, xaaji axmad qulunbbe iwm oo dhammaantood Habaryoonis iyo isaaqba xusuus kaga tegay, maayarka waxay walaalo ahaayeen mujaahid Cabdillaahi qasaal oo ahaa sarkaal geesi ilaahaya, waxa ka mida khadar ambasador iyo rag la mida oo dalka wax weyn ku soo kordhiyay sidaas awgeed maskabkooda hallagu ixtiraamo. MAHADSANID. CABDI BACAW. GUUL ALLE. LONDON.

items.title: Hoggaamiyihii Dhisay Qatar-ta Casriga ah oo geeriyooday
items.description: Sheekh Xamad Bin Khaliifa Aal Thaani, Amiirkii hore ee Dowladda Qatar iyo Amiirka Aabbaha, ayaa geeriyooday maanta oo ku beegan 12-ka Luulyo 2026, isagoo jiray 74 sano. Dowladda Qatar ayaa si rasmi ah u shaacisay geeridiisa, hase yeeshee ma aysan faahfaahin sababta dhimashada. Sheekh Xamad wuxuu ku dhashay magaalada Doha sanadkii 1952, wuxuuna waxbarasho ciidan ku soo qaatay kulliyadda caanka ah ee Royal Military Academy Sandhurst ee dalka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska. Ka dib wuxuu ku biiray ciidamada Qatar isaga oo qabtay xilal kala duwan oo ciidan iyo dowladeed. 27-kii Juun 1995 ayuu noqday Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, isagoo hoggaamiyay dalka muddo 18 sano ah ilaa uu xilka si iskiis ah ugu wareejiyay wiilkiisa, Amiirka hadda talada haya ee Sheekh Tamiim Bin Xamad Aal Thaani, sanadkii 2013. Tallaabadan ayaa ahayd mid aan caadi ka ahayn dalalka Khaliijka, maadaama uu si nabad ah awoodda ugu wareejiyay jiilka xiga. Intii uu talada hayay, Sheekh Xamad wuxuu Qatar ka dhigay mid ka mid ah dalalka ugu dhaqaalaha badan dunida, isaga oo si weyn u maalgeliyay gaaska dabiiciga ah, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada iyo caafimaadka. Waxa kale oo lagu xusuustaa aasaaska warbaahinta caalamiga ah ee Al Jazeera, ballaarinta Qatar Airways iyo dejinta himilada horumarineed ee 2030. Dadka reer Qatar iyo madaxda caalamka ayaa ku tilmaamay Sheekh Xamad inuu ahaa hoggaamiye aragti dheer leh oo door weyn ku lahaa kor u qaadista magaca iyo saameynta Qatar ee gobolka iyo caalamka. Geeridiisa ayaa lagu tilmaamay dhammaadka xilli muhiim ah oo ka mid ahaa taariikhda casriga ah ee dalka Qatar. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa tacsi tiiraanyo leh u diray Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Tamiim Bin Xamad Aal Thaani, qoyska reer Aal Thaani iyo guud ahaan shacabka walaalaha ah ee Qatar. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay la wadaagayso Dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar murugada ka dhalatay geerida hoggaamiyihii hore ee dalkaasi, isagoo xusay doorkii weynaa ee uu ku lahaa horumarka iyo casriyeynta Qatar. “Waxaan tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, qoyska boqortooyada iyo shacabka Qatar geerida ku timid Sheekh Xamad Bin Khaliifa Aal Thaani. Waxaan Alle uga baryayaa marxuumka inuu ku mannaysto naxariistiisa janno, qoyskiisa iyo shacabka Qatarna uu siiyo samir iyo iimaan,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo dalal dhowr ah oo dhambaal u direy amiirka Qatar kadib geeridii ku timid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka tacsiyeysay geerida amiirkii hore ee dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani oo maanta geeriyooday. Dhambaalka tacsida ayaa si gaar ah loogu diray Amiirka Qatar, Sheekh Tamim Bin Hamad Al Thani oo uu ahaa aabbihii. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Villa Soomaaliya ayaa lagu ammaanay kaalintii uu Sheekh Hamad ka qaatay horumarinta Qatar iyo taageerada uu u fidiyay dalal badan oo caalamka ah. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa tacsi iyo samir u rajeysay qoyska, shacabka iyo dowladda Qatar. Geerida Sheekh Hamad kadib, waxaa isa soo tarayay dhambaallada tacsida ee ka imanayay madaxda caalamka, iyadoo hoggaamiyeyaal badan ay farriimo tacsi ah u direen dowladda Qatar. Waxa kale oo la filayaa in madax kala duwan ay u safraan magaalada Dooxa si ay uga qayb-galaan aaska iyo saxiixa buugga tacsida ee loo furayo marxuumka. Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani ayaa Qatar hoggaaminayay intii u dhexeysay 1995 illaa 2013. Intii uu talada hayay, wuxuu hormuud ka noqday isbeddello waaweyn oo dalkaas ka hirgalay, kuwaas oo sare u qaaday doorka Qatar ee gobolka iyo caalamkaba. Sannadkii 2013 ayuu si iskiis ah xilka ugu wareejiyay wiilkiisa, Amiir Tamim Bin Hamad Al Thani. Dhanka kale, dowladda Qatar ayaa ku dhawaaqday afar maalmood oo baroordiiq qaran ah oo ka bilaabanaysa maanta, iyadoo calanka dalka hoos loo dhigay. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale wada qaban-qaabada aaska rasmiga ah ee loo sameynayo amiirkii hore. Waxaa la filayaa in maalmaha soo socda magaalada Doha ay gaaraan madax iyo wufuud ka kala socota dalal badan oo caalamka ah, kuwaas oo ka qayb-geli doona aaska Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani, isla markaana tacsi u gudbin doona hoggaanka iyo shacabka Qatar. items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka digtay halis weyn oo soo wajahday nus milyan qof oo ku sugan magaalada El-Obeid ee Suudaan
items.description: Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Carruurta (UNICEF) ayaa ka digtay in ku dhowaad 500,000 oo rayid ah oo ku nool magaalada El-Obeid ay halis weyn ku jiraan, xilli gobolka Waqooyiga Kordofan ee Suudaan ay dagaallo culus weli ka socdaan. Hay’adda UNICEF ayaa sheegtay in dagaallada sii xoogeysanaya ay ku qasbayaan carruur iyo qoysas badan inay ka barakacaan guryahooda, iyagoo raadinaya goobo ay gabaad ka helaan, xilli ay sii xumaanayso xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee magaalada.
