items.title: Heshiiska ay kala saxeexdeen Masar iyo Muqdisho
items.description: Turjimaanid Heshiis Ay Shalay Oo Taariikh-du Ahayd 10/07/2026 Wadda Galeen Al-Shababland Iyo Masar. “𝐇𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐢𝐬𝐤𝐚 𝐈𝐬𝐤𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐐𝐚𝐚𝐡𝐢𝐫𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐌𝐮𝐪𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐨: 𝐌𝐮𝐱𝐮𝐮 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐮𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐚𝐧 𝐘𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐲? Golaha Wasiiradda ee Muqdisho ayaa shalay oo taariikhdu hayd 09-07-2026 ansixiyey Heshiis-is-fagarad oo ay kala saxeexdeen Soomaaliya iyo Masar (𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐚–𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐏𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐬 𝐌𝐨𝐔). Sida labada dhinac sheegeen heshiiskani waxa uu ku saabsan yahay maamulka badda iyo gaadiidka mara, horumarinta dekedaha, tababarro farsamo la iswayraadsado. Heshiisku waxa uu u muuqdaa in uu yahay mid ganacsi iyo farsamo (𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥). Hase yeeshee, marka aad u fiirsato waxa kuu soo baxaya in ujeeddada laga leeyahay ay ka ballaadhan tahay, lana doonayo in Somaliland la saaro culays diblumaasi iyo mid siyaadeed ee lagu hor istaaggayo danaha Istiraatiijayadeed ee Somaliland (𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐜 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞). Heshiiskan MOU-da ahi waxa uu keeni karaa: 𝟏. 𝐌𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐁𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐋𝐚 𝐅𝐚𝐫𝐨-𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐲𝐨 (𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞): Heshiiskan waa isku day kale oo xukuumadda Muqdisho ku doonayso in ay ku soo faro-galiso biyaha badda, xeebaha, dekedaha iyo khayraadka badda ee Somaliland leedahay iyada oo adeegsanaysa waddamo kale. Waxa jiray heshiis hore oo ay Soomaaliya la gashay Turkiga ee loogu magac daray 𝐃𝐢𝐟𝐚𝐚𝐜𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐌𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 (𝐓𝐮̈𝐫𝐤𝐢𝐲𝐞–𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐚 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐟𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐀𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭), sida muuqatana labada heshiis waa isku ujeeddo. 𝟐. 𝐃𝐮𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐮 𝐒𝐨𝐜𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐞𝐤𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐁𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐚: Masar iyo Turkey-ga oo cadow ku ah jiritaanka Somaliland waxa ay doonayaan in ay wiiqaan ganacsiga ka socda Dekedda Berbera oo halbowle u ah dhaqaalaha Somaliland. 𝟑. 𝐓𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐬 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐆𝐚𝐜𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐝𝐦𝐞𝐞𝐝 (𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐜 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐞𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐨𝐧): Heshiiskani wuxuu qayb ka yahay tartanka sii xoogaysanaya ee ka jira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed oo ah marin istiraatiiji ah oo saamayn wayn ku leh ganacsiga aduunka, Somaliland-na ay kaga taalla goob istiraatiiji ah oo saamayn wayn ku leh. 𝟒. 𝐇𝐢𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐈𝐬𝐛𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐲𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐤𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝: Isbahaysigan oo ka kooban Somaliya, Turkey-ga, Masar iyo waddamo kale ayaa ujeeddada ugu wayna ee ay u socdaan ay tahay in Somaliland go’doon la galiyo gaar ahaan dhinaca badda si culays loo saaro xeebaha iyo dekedaha Somaliland leedahay. Jawaabta Somaliland ay kaga jawaabayso waa in uu noqdaa adkaynta, isla markaana ay xoojiso xidhiidhka diblumaasi iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥, 𝐀𝐔𝐄, 𝐄𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐨𝐩𝐢𝐚, 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐰𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐤𝐚𝐥𝐞 ee ay saaxiibada yihiin, awooddana la saaro sidii looga gaashaaman lahaa duulaanada kala duwan ee dalkeenna ku socda.”

items.title: Xarunta dhexe ee xisbiga Waddani oo lagu qabtay kulan mihiim ah
items.description: Xarunta Dhexe ee Xisbiga WADDANI waxa maanta lagu qabtay kulan muhiim ah oo ay yeesheen Wasiirrada Wasaaradaha Horumarinta Caafimaadka, Waxbarashada iyo Sayniska iyo Shaqada, Shaqada, Arrimaha Bulshada & Qoyska, iyaga oo la kulmay guddida uu Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga WADDANI u magacaabay isku-xidhka iyo la-shaqaynta Wasaaradaha Waxbarashada & Sayniska, Horumarinta Caafimaadka, iyo Shaqada, Arrimaha Bulshada & Qoyska. items.title: DF oo xirtay askar ku xadgudubtay calanka Mareykanka kadib markii..
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo bayaan soo saartay ayaa hadashay dhacdo la xiriirta muuqaal lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada oo muujinayo askar la sheegay inay ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ku xadgudbaya calanka Mareykanka, iyada oo muuqaalka laga arkay askarta oo ku istaagaya calanka. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in falkaas uu ka hor imaanato anshaxa iyo xifradda ciidanka, waxayna Wasaaraddu sheegtay in uusan ka tarjumeyn aragtida Dowladda Federaalka oo haatan xiriir wanaagsan la leh Mareykanka. “Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa ogaatay muuqaal lagu faafiyey baraha bulshada oo muujinaya shaqsiyaad xiran dareyska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyagoo ku kacaya fal aan la aqbali karin oo la xiriira calanka Maraykanka. Falkaasi wuxuu ka hor imanayaa qiyamka, anshaxa iyo xirfadda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, mana matalayo aragtida Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ama Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri qiraalka. items.title: Somalia detains soldiers after viral US flag desecration video
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A viral video showing Somali federal government soldiers apparently stepping on and desecrating the United States national flag has ignited widespread debate on social media, with analysts warning the incident could place fresh strain on already delicate relations between Mogadishu and Washington. The footage, which has spread widely across multiple social media platforms, has drawn sharp criticism and raised questions over how the United States – which has invested billions of dollars over decades in supporting Somalia’s security forces and state-building efforts – could see its national flag treated in such a manner by members of the very military it has helped train and sustain. Somalia’s Ministry of Defence said it had reviewed the video and described the conduct as unacceptable. “The Ministry of Defence has taken note of a video circulating on social media showing individuals wearing Somali military uniforms engaging in unacceptable conduct involving the flag of the United States,” the ministry said in a statement. “Such behaviour is inconsistent with the values, discipline and professionalism of the Somali National Army and does not reflect the views of the Ministry of Defence or the Federal Government of Somalia. The individuals concerned have been detained, and an investigation is underway to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident and determine appropriate disciplinary and legal action,” it added. The ministry also reaffirmed Somalia’s commitment to its longstanding security partnership with the United States. “Somalia greatly values its longstanding security partnership with the United States. Our cooperation has been instrumental in the fight against Al-Shabaab and ISIS and in strengthening Somalia’s security institutions. The Ministry of Defence reaffirms its respect for the people and flag of the United States and for the enduring partnership between our two nations,” the statement said. The incident comes at a time when relations between Mogadishu and Washington have already faced a series of challenges, leading many analysts to argue that the episode could add another source of friction to an already sensitive partnership. The concerns follow Washington’s recent decision to inform the African Union that it would end support for the United Nations logistical assistance to the AU peacekeeping mission in Somalia after December , raising fears over the future of the peacekeeping operation that has for decades served as a key bulwark against the militant group Al-Shabaab. In January, Washington also announced it had suspended assistance to Somalia’s federal government, alleging that officials destroyed a United Nations World Food Programme warehouse and seized donor-funded food aid. In June last year, the United States likewise suspended support for Somalia’s elite Danab Special Forces , which it had trained and equipped for more than a decade, after allegedly uncovering widespread corruption, including the theft of military rations and what it said was a failure by Somali leaders to take corrective action. It remains unclear how Washington will respond to the latest incident involving Somali soldiers and the desecration of the American flag. The episode comes at a particularly sensitive moment for bilateral ties, as both countries continue to cooperate on counterterrorism operations against Al-Shabaab and ISIS while navigating broader security and assistance challenges. items.title: Uu is bixiyay qarankeenu …… Gudoomiye Maxamuud Xaashi
Taariikh Nololeedka G/le Sare Shiikh Cali Cabdille Fiixiye (Cali Shucaac)
items.description: Alle ha u naxariistee waxaa saacado ka hor magaalada Nairobi ee caasimadda dalka Kenya ku geeriyooday shiikh Cali Cabdille Fiixiye ” Cali Shucaac” oo ahaa caalim Soomaaliyeed iyo halgamaa ka tirsanaa ka jabhaddii xoraynta Soomaali galbeed iyo ciidanka ciidanka xoogga dalka labadaba. G/le Sare Cali Cabdille Fiixiye, oo loo yiqiin Cali Shucaac, wuxuu ka mid ahaa saraakiishii ugu magaca dheeraa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ahaa qoraa, hal-abuur iyo aqoonyahan door muuqda ku lahaa bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Marxuumku wuxuu muddo dheer u soo adeegay Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, isagoo kaalin muhiim ah ka qaatay difaaca dalka. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa saraakiishii geesinimada lagu xusuusto ee ka qayb galay Dagaalkii 1977, iyo halganno kale oo lagu difaacayay gobannimada, midnimada iyo karaamada Soomaaliya. Inta uu ku jiray adeegga ciidanka, Cali Shucaac wuxuu ku suntanaa waddaniyad, daacadnimo iyo karti hoggaamineed, taasoo sababtay inuu ka mid noqdo saraakiishii taariikhda baalka dahabka ah ka galay ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Marka laga soo tago waajibaadkiisii ciidan, wuxuu ahaa qoraa iyo aqoonyahan si joogto ah uga hadli jiray taariikhda Soomaaliya, qadiyadda Soomaaliyeed, ilaalinta midnimada dalka iyo horumarinta wacyiga bulshada. Wuxuu bulshada uga tegay dhaxal aqooneed oo ay ka mid yihiin qoraallo iyo buugaag ka hadlaya taariikhda, dhaqanka iyo halganka ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Geeridiisa waxaa si weyn uga tacsiyeeyay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada, iyagoo ku tilmaamay halyey qaran oo dalkiisa u soo adeegay si geesinimo, daacadnimo iyo naf-hurnimo leh. Marxuumku wuxuu ka tegay dhaxal sharaf iyo taariikh ay jiilasha Soomaaliyeed ka baran doonaan waddaniyadda, adeegga qaranka iyo jacaylka dalka.

items.title: Puntland Silent as Bosaso Port Dispute Deepens
items.description: BOSASO — Businesses across Bosaso remained closed on Saturday as the shutdown of the city’s port entered its 11th consecutive day amid a dispute over newly introduced charges. Local traders closed their shops in protest after rejecting additional fees imposed by DP World, the company managing Bosaso Port. Business owners say the charges could increase operating costs, disrupt trade and place further pressure on Puntland’s economy. Bosaso Port is Puntland’s main commercial gateway and handles imports of food, fuel, medicine, construction materials and other essential goods. The prolonged closure has disrupted the movement of cargo, leaving hundreds of trucks stranded and delaying the loading and unloading of shipments from vessels using the port. Traders and residents have warned that continued disruption could result in shortages and higher prices for essential commodities, further increasing the cost of living. The Puntland administration, led by President Said Abdullahi Deni, has not yet issued a formal statement on the prolonged closure or announced measures to resolve the dispute. Meanwhile, preparations are reportedly under way for demonstrations in Bosaso against the new charges imposed on vehicles and goods passing through the port. items.title: Bog Cusub oo u Furmay Diblomaasiyadda Soomaaliya iyo Mauritania iyo Heshiis Muhiim Ah oo Lagu Kala Saxiixday
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Mauritania ayaa si rasmi ah u unkay weji cusub oo  is dhexgal diblomaasiyadeed ah, ka ka dib markii ay magaalada Nouakchott ku kala saxiixdeen heshiis taariikhi ah oo dhabaha u xaaraya dhismaha Guddi Wadajir ah oo Iskaashi (Joint Cooperation Committee). Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshaha ballaaran ee dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku xoojineyso xiriirka laba geesoodka ah iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiyadeed ee ay la leedahay dalalka qaaradda Afrika. Heshiiskan dhaxal-galka ah waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa mas’uuliyiin sare oo labada dhinac ah, waxaana dowladda Soomaaliya u saxiixay Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad), halka dhanka Mauritania uu u saxiixay dhiggiisa Maxamed Saalim Walad Marzuuq. Ka sokow guddiga iskaashiga, labada mas’uul waxay si wadajir ah u kala saxiixdeen laba is-afgarad (MoUs) oo kale, kuwaas oo si gaar ah diiradda u saaraya dardargelinta wada-tashiyada siyaasadeed iyo casriyeynta tababarrada saraakiisha diblomaasiyadda. Guddiga Wadajirka ah ee la dhisay ayaa noqon doona bar-bilow rasmi ah iyo marin joogto ah oo loo maro qorsheynta, dabba-galka, iyo meel-marinta mashaariicda muhiimka ah ee labada qaran ay wadaagaan. Suxufiyiinta la socota dhaqdhaqaaqyadan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa tilmaamaya in iskaashigan cusub uu albaabada u furi doono xiriir qoto dheer oo ku aaddan amniga, la dagaallanka falalka argagixisada, maalgashiga tamarta, batroolka, iyo ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka badaha sida kalluumeysiga. Booqashadan oo noqotay tii ugu horreysay ee wafdi heer wasiir ah oo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku tagaan dalka Mauritania, ayaa loo arkaa guul muhiim ah oo u soo hoyatay diblomaasiyadda rasmiga ah ee dalka. Wasiiru-dowle Cali Balcad ayaa muujiyay rajo muhiim ah oo ku aaddan natiijada kulamada, isagoo hoosta ka adkeeyay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay in heshiisyadan loo beddelo barnaamijyo dhab ah oo laga dareemo nolosha labada shacab ee walaalaha ah. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Mauritania, Maxamed Saalim Walad Marzuuq, ayaa isna bogaadiyay go’aanka geesinnimada leh ee labada dhinac, isagoo xusay in Soomaaliya iyo Mauritania ay leeyihiin fursado aad u ballaaran oo dhanka ganacsiga iyo dhaqaalaha ah. Wuxuu tilmaamay in xilligan la joogo waqtigii si wadajir ah looga faa’iideysan lahaa kartida iyo kheyraadka labada dal si loo gaaro horumar isku-dhafan oo waara.

items.title: Liiska Golihiisa Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed oo la shaaciyay + Magacyada
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) Ayaa xalay magacaabay Golihiisa Wasiirrada cusub, kadib wareegto uu soo saaray. Golaha Wasiirrada cusub Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ka kooban 26 wasiir, 3 wasiiru dowle iyo 22 wasiir ku xigeen, sida ku cad liiska uu shaaciyay Aadan Madoobe. Xubnaha la soo magacaabay waxaa u badan Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Wakiilada Koonfur Galbeed, halka tiro kalena laga keenay bannaanka. Sidoo kale, xubnaha kusoo baxay liiska la shaaciyay ayaa ah dhalinyaro, qaarkood shaqooyin kala duwan kasoo qabtay Dowladda Federaalka iyo Koonfur Galbed. Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa wasiirada uu soo magacaabay kula dardaarmay inay si daacadnimo leh u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday, maadaama ay horyaallaan shaqooyin adag, lagana rabo isbeddal dhab ah. Tallaabadan ayaa noqoneysa tii ugu dambeysay ee lagu soo dhammaystirayo hay’adaha Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii uu isbeddal ka dhacay Baydhaba, kaas oo meesha looga saaray maamulkii uu hoggaaminayay Lafta-gareen. Horay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa usoo magacaabay saraakiisha amniga ee maamulkiisa, si wax looga qabto xaaladaha ammaan ee ka jira halkaasi. Golaha Wasiirrada cusub Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ka kooban 26 wasiir, 3 wasiiru dowle iyo 22 wasiir ku xigeen, sida ku cad liiska uu shaaciyay Aadan Madoobe. Xubnaha la soo magacaabay waxaa u badan Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Wakiilada Koonfur Galbeed, halka tiro kalena laga keenay bannaanka. Sidoo kale, xubnaha kusoo baxay liiska la shaaciyay ayaa ah dhalinyaro, qaarkood shaqooyin kala duwan kasoo qabtay Dowladda Federaalka iyo Koonfur Galbed. Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa wasiirada uu soo magacaabay kula dardaarmay inay si daacadnimo leh u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday, maadaama ay horyaallaan shaqooyin adag, lagana rabo isbeddal dhab ah. Tallaabadan ayaa noqoneysa tii ugu dambeysay ee lagu soo dhammaystirayo hay’adaha Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii uu isbeddal ka dhacay Baydhaba, kaas oo meesha looga saaray maamulkii uu hoggaaminayay Lafta-gareen. Horay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa usoo magacaabay saraakiisha amniga ee maamulkiisa, si wax looga qabto xaaladaha ammaan ee ka jira halkaasi. items.title: Xogta heshiiska cusub ee Masar iyo Soomaaliya galeen ee ka caraysiin kara Itoobiya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ansixisay heshiis is-afgarad ah oo ay la gashay Masar, kaas oo lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada dekedaha iyo gaadiidka badda, xilli Qaahira ay sii xoojinayso xiriirkeeda dalalka ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Heshiiska, oo golaha wasiirrada Soomaaliya uu ansixiyey Khamiistii, ayaa dejinaya qaab ay si toos ah ugu wada shaqeynayaan Wasaaradda Gaadiidka Masar iyo Wasaaradda Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur, ayaa sheegay in heshiisku uu qeyb ka yahay dadaalka dowladda ee lagu horumarinayo dekedaha dalka, laguna ballaarinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya ay la leedahay dalalka iyo hay’adaha ka shaqeeya gaadiidka badda. “Heshiiskani wuxuu xoojinayaa iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee gaadiidka badda iyo dekedaha, wuxuu horumarinayaa mudnaanta istaraatiijiyadeed ee dalka, wuxuuna taageerayaa Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in heshiisku uu sare u qaadayo kaalinta Soomaaliya ee ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka badda ee gobolka iyo caalamka, isla markaana uu gacan ka geysan karo casriyeynta kaabayaasha dekedaha dalka. Xiriir ka gudbaya ganacsiga Inkastoo heshiiska cusub si rasmi ah loogu soo bandhigay mid diiradda saaraya gaadiidka badda, dekedaha iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha, haddana wuxuu kusoo beegmay xilli Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Eritrea ay si weyn isugu soo dhowaanayaan dhinacyada siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha iyo amniga. Qiyaastii laba bilood ka hor heshiiska Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Eritrea ayaa iyaguna kala saxiixday heshiis gaadiidka badda ah oo lagu xirayo dekedaha labada dal, laguna sameynayo khadad toos ah oo maraakiibta xamuulka ah. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty ayaa xilligaas sheegay in heshiiska Eritrea uu bilow u noqonayo isku xirnaanta dekedaha labada dal iyo furitaanka marinno cusub oo ganacsi. Masar ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in qorshayaashu aysan ku koobneyn maraakiibta iyo badeecadaha oo keliya, balse ay qeyb ka yihiin iskaashi ballaaran oo ay ku jiraan maalgashi, tamar, dhismooyin, macdan iyo tababarrada farsamada. Isku soo dhowaanshahan waxaa saldhig u ah aragti ay Masar iyo Eritrea wadaagaan, taas oo ah in amniga iyo maamulka Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay masuuliyaddiisu gaar u tahay dalalka xeebaha ku leh marin-biyoodkaas. Qaahira iyo Asmara ayaa si cad uga soo horjeestay in dalal aan xeeb ku lahayn Badda Cas ay door rasmi ah ku yeeshaan nidaamka amni iyo maamul ee halkaas laga hirgelinayo. Mowqifkaas ayaa si gaar ah u taabanaya Itoobiya, oo ah dal aan bad lahayn, balse sanadihii dambe si xooggan u raadineysay marin toos ah oo ay ku gaarto Badda Cas. Ra’iisul wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa marin-badeedka ku tilmaamay arrin “jiritaanka Itoobiya muhiim u ah”, inkastoo uu marar badan sheegay in dowladdiisu ay ku raadineyso wada-hadal iyo hannaan nabadeed. Itoobiya ayaa marin-badeedkeedii lumisay markii Eritrea ay xorriyaddeeda qaadatay 1993-kii, waxaana inta badan ganacsigeeda dibadda uu hadda maraa dekedaha Jabuuti. Falcelinta Itoobiya Dowladda Itoobiya ayaan si wanaagsan u arag dhaqdhaqaaqyada sii kordhaya ee Masar ka waddo dalalka ku hareereysan. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Itoobiya ayaa bishii May ku eedeysay Masar inay waddo siyaasad lagu carqaladeynayo himilooyinka istaraatiijiyadeed ee Addis Ababa, gaar ahaan dadaalkeeda ku aaddan helitaanka marin toos ah oo badeed. Afhayeen u hadlay wasaaradda ayaa sheegay in Itoobiya aysan ka laaban doonin raadinta marin-badeed, isaga oo ku adkeystay in ujeeddada Addis Ababa ay tahay mid nabadeed oo lagu doonayo iskaashi dhaqaale iyo horumar wadajir ah. Masar ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysaneysa in dal aan xeeb lahayn uusan xaq u lahayn inuu ku lug yeesho maamulka ama ammaanka Badda Cas, inkastoo aysan kasoo horjeedin in Itoobiya ay dekedaha dalalka deriska ah u adeegsato ganacsi, haddii arrintaas lagu gaaro heshiis sharci ah. Isku soo dhowaanshaha Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Eritrea ayaa si weyn u bilowday kaddib markii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ay Janaayo 2024 kala saxiixdeen heshiis is-afgarad ah oo la xiriiray marin-badeed ganacsi iyo saldhig ciidan. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa heshiiskaas ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimada dhulkeeda, waxayna billowday olole diblomaasiyadeed oo ay taageero uga raadineysay dalalka gobolka iyo beesha caalamka. Bishii October 2024, madaxweynayaasha Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Eritrea ayaa shir saddex geesood ah ku yeeshay magaalada Asmara, halkaas oo ay ku adkeeyeen in la ixtiraamo madax-bannaanida, midnimada dhuleed iyo xuduudaha dalalka gobolka. Waxay sidoo kale isku raaceen xoojinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya, ilaalinta xuduudaha berriga iyo badda, iyo sameynta guddi ay hoggaaminayaan wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee saddexda dal. Inkastoo Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ay dabayaaqadii 2024 heshiis dhexdhexaadin ah ku gaareen Ankara, haddana tartanka ku saabsan marin-badeedka Itoobiya iyo saameynta dalalka kale ku leeyihiin Geeska Afrika weli ma dhammaan. Suweys ilaa Gacanka Cadmeed Heshiiska dekedaha ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar wuxuu muujinayaa in xiriirka Qaahira, Asmara iyo Muqdisho uu hadda ku fidayo marin istaraatiiji ah oo ka bilaabma Gacanka Suweys kuna dhammaada Gacanka Cadmeed. Saddexda dal ma aysan ku dhawaaqin isbahaysi rasmi ah, balse wada-shaqeyntooda sii kordheysa ayaa siinaysa awood ay si wadajir ah ugu saameyn karaan arrimaha amniga, ganacsiga, dekedaha iyo siyaasadda gobolka. Masar waxay sidoo kale ballaarisay joogitaankeeda militari ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidamo iyo qalab u dirtay howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, isla markaana tababar iyo taageero siisa ciidamada Soomaaliya. Xiriirkaas wuxuu ku soo beegmayaa iyadoo Masar iyo Itoobiya uu weli ka dhexeeyo khilaafka biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ka dhistay webiga Nile, halka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ay iyaguna isku hayaan arrimaha xuduudaha iyo marin-badeedka. Sidaas darteed, heshiiska cusub ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar ma aha oo keliya qorshe lagu horumarinayo dekedaha. Wuxuu sidoo kale qeyb ka yahay isbeddel ballaaran oo ka socda Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas, halkaas oo dekedaha, maraakiibta, ciidamada iyo marin-biyoodyadu ay noqdeen aalado muhiim u ah loolanka awoodda gobolka. items.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu Iran “bur-buriyo” haddii la dilo
items.description: Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa ku hanjabay inuu weerar ciidan oo ballaaran ku qaadi doono Iran haddii ay isku daydo in ay dilaan. Trump ayaa sheegay in 1,000 oo gantaal oo diyaar ah lagu beegsaday Iran, isagoona ku celiyay in ciidamada Maraykanku ay diyaar u yihiin in ay “si buuxda u baabi’iyaan oo u burburiyaan” dhammaan aagagga Iran . Han-jabaaddan ayaa timi kadib markii ay soo baxeen warar sheegaya in sirdoonka Israel ay la wadaageen Washington in Iran ay soo diyaarisay qorshe cusub oo ay ku doonayso in ay disho Trump . Waxay sidoo kale soo beegantay iyadoo dad badan oo ka soo qeyb galay aaskii hogaamiyihii hore ee Iran Ayatullah Cali Khamenei ay kor u qaadeen calaamooyin kuwaas oo ku baaqaya dilka Trump . Trump ayaa ku qoray bartiisa Truth Social in uu “tilmaamo” ka tagay si looga aargoosto Iran heer ay waligood arag, isagoo sheegay in amarro hore loo siiyay ciidamada Maraykanka si looga jawaabo haddii weerar noocaas ah la fuliyo . Wuxuu intaas ku daray in “1,000 Gantaal oo la beegsaday Jamhuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran” ay diyaar u yihiin, “oo ay ku xigaan kumanaan kale” . Wuxuu yidhi: “Amarro hore loo siiyay, ciidanka Maraykankuna waa diyaar, oo awood u leh, in muddo hal sano ah, oo la kordhin karo, ay gebi ahaan baabi’iyaan oo burburiyaan dhammaan aagagga Iran – PRAISE BE TO ALLAH! Madaxweyne DONALD J. TRUMP” . Han-jabaaddan ayaa soo kordhaysa xiisadda u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran, kuwaas oo dagaal kujira tan iyo Febraayo 2026 kadib markii Iran ay weerartay markabbo saliid ah oo ku sugnaa Gacanka Hormuz . Trump ayaa sheegay in xabbad-joojinta ay dhammaatay, isagoona sii waday inuu han-jabiyo Iran haddii aysan wax ka baran . Waxaa soo baxay warar sheegaya in ciidamada Maraykanku ay weerar ku qaadeen jasiiradda Kharg ee Iran, taasoo ay ku yiraahdeen “gabi ahaan baabi’iyay” bartilmaameedyadii militari ee ku yiilay jasiiradda . Iran ayaa ka jawaabtay iyadoo ay sii wadaan xannibaadda Gacanka Hormuz . The post Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu Iran “bur-buriyo” haddii la dilo first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Han-jabaaddan ayaa soo kordhaysa xiisadda u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran, kuwaas oo dagaal kujira tan iyo Febraayo 2026 kadib markii Iran ay weerartay markabbo saliid ah oo ku sugnaa Gacanka Hormuz . Trump ayaa sheegay in xabbad-joojinta ay dhammaatay, isagoona sii waday inuu han-jabiyo Iran haddii aysan wax ka baran . Waxaa soo baxay warar sheegaya in ciidamada Maraykanku ay weerar ku qaadeen jasiiradda Kharg ee Iran, taasoo ay ku yiraahdeen “gabi ahaan baabi’iyay” bartilmaameedyadii militari ee ku yiilay jasiiradda . Iran ayaa ka jawaabtay iyadoo ay sii wadaan xannibaadda Gacanka Hormuz . The post Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu Iran “bur-buriyo” haddii la dilo first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Iran iyo Cummaan oo kawada hadlay marinka Hormuz
items.description: Muscat ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Cabbaas Caraqji ayaa wadahadallo la yeelan doona mas’uuliyiinta Cumaan kaddib markii uu gaaray Muscat. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo wareedyo, booqashadan waxay qayb ka tahay wadatashiyada laba geesoodka ah ee u dhexeeya Iran iyo Cumaan, kuwaas oo looga hadlay arrimaha ka taagan gobolka, gaar ahaan xaaladda marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Iran iyo Cumaan ayaa la filayaa inay ka wada hadlaan “dejinta habab ku habboon oo lagu xaqiijinayo marinka ammaankiisa ee maraakiibta dhex marta Marin-biyoodka Hormuz, iyadoo lagu salaynayo Qodobka 5-aad ee Is-afgaradkii Islamabad,” isla markaana ay is dhaafsadaan aragtiyo ku saabsan arrimahaas. Booqashadan waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli xiisadaha ka taagan Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay kordheen maalmihii la soo dhaafay, kaddib weerarro is-daba-joog ah oo ay isku qaadeen Mareykanka iyo Iran. Dhanka kale, wafdi ka socda Qadar oo wada dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu bilaabo wadaxaajoodyada u dhexeeya Iran iyo Mareykanka, isla markaana lagu yareeyo xiisadda labada dhinac, ayaa u safray Iran. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo dhagax-dhigay Dib-u-dhiska Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa dhagax-dhigay xarunta dhexe ee Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha oo dib-u-dhis lagu sameynayo, taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada Xukuumadda DanQaran ay ku horumarinayso hey’adaha muhiimka u ah adeegyada bulshada iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshaduhu ay laf-dhabar u tahay horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka, maadaama ay door muhiim ah ka qaadato kobcinta ganacsiga, horumarinta wax-soo-saarka, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga iyo abuurista jawi ganacsi oo hufan. “Xarunta Wasaaradda oo muddo 50 sano ah dhisnayd, kana muuqatay duugnimo, dib-u-dhiskeedu waa tallaabo muhiim ah. Wasaaraddani waxa ay kamid tahay wasaaradaha laf-dhabarta u ah Qaranka, waana albaabka loo maro ganacsiga iyo horumarinta wax-soo-saarka dalkeenna.” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul wasaare Xamsa Xamsa ayaa xusay in dowladda ay ka go’an tahay tayeynta kaabeyaasha hey’adaha Qaranka, si loo dardargeliyo adeegyada ay shacabka u hayaan, loona xoojiyo fursadaha ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee dalka. “Dalkeennu wuxuu u jihaystay dhanka horumarka iyo kobcinta wax-soo-saarka, waxaana la filayaa in dhawaan ay dalka ka hirgalaan warshado badan oo ay leeyihiin maalgashadeyaal Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwo ajnabi ah oo dalka maalgashanaya.”Ayuu yiri R/Wasaare Xamsa. Ugu dambeyn, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ku bogaadiyay Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Mudane Jamaal Maxamed Xasan hirgelinta mashruucan dib-u-dhiska ah, isaga oo ku tilmaamay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo awoodda hey’adda iyo adeegyada ay u hayso shacabka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Sacuudiga oo tababaraya 5,000 oo askar Soomaali ah
items.description: Guriceel (Caasimada Online) – Wafdi militari oo ka socda dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa booqday laba xero oo ku yaalla magaalada Guriceel ee gobolka Galgaduud, kuwaas oo lagu tababarayo ciidamo hoos taga dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Booqashada ayaa qeyb ka ah barnaamij ay maalgelinayso dowladda Sacuudiga, kaas oo lagu tababarayo cutubyo cusub oo la qorsheynayo inay ku biiraan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Xogaha la helayo ayaa sheegaya in barnaamijku uu gaarsiisan yahay tababarka 5,107 askari, kuwaas oo ku kala sugan labada xero ee uu wafdiga Sacuudigu booqday. Askartaas waxaa la sheegay inay ku jiraan ku dhowaad 2,000 oo dhalinyaro ah oo laga soo qoray deegaannada Puntland, halka ciidamada kale laga soo ururiyey gobollo kala duwan oo dalka ah. Tababarka ayaa la qorsheeyey inuu socdo muddo sagaal bilood ah, si ciidamada loo siiyo xirfadaha aasaasiga ah ee militariga, nidaamka hawlgallada iyo tababarrada la xiriira dagaalka. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in tababarka ay bixinayaan macallimiin militari oo ajaanib ah, kuwaas oo ka kala socda dalalka Romania, Ukraine, Koonfur Afrika iyo Colombia. Dowladda Soomaaliya weli si faahfaahsan ugama hadlin qaabka loo soo xulay tababarayaasha iyo nooca tababarka ay ciidamada siinayaan. Heshiiska Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga Booqashada wafdiga ayaa ku soo aadeysa dhowr bilood kaddib markii Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ay kala saxiixdeen heshiis ku saabsan iskaashiga difaaca iyo militariga. Heshiiskaas oo 9-kii Febraayo 2026 lagu saxiixay magaalada Riyadh ayaa lagu sheegay inuu xoojinayo xiriirka difaaca, tababarka ciidamada iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada ay labada dal danaha wadaagga ah ka leeyihiin. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa heshiiska la saxiixday dhiggiisa Sacuudiga, Amiir Khalid bin Salman, inkasta oo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin dhammaan qodobbada uu ka kooban yahay. Barnaamijka ka socda Guriceel ayaa u muuqda mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya ee la xiriira hirgelinta iskaashigaas, iyadoo Sacuudigu doonayo inuu ballaariyo kaalintiisa dhinaca amniga Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan gobolka Geeska Afrika. Dowladda federaalka ayaa sannadihii lasoo dhaafay heshiisyo tababar iyo taageero militari la gashay dalal dhowr ah, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Turkiga, Mareykanka, Imaaraadka Carabta, Masar, Eritrea iyo Uganda. Dalalkan ayaa tababara cutubyo kala duwan oo ka tirsan ciidamada Soomaaliya, balse marar badan waxaa soo baxa walaac ku saabsan isku-dubarid la’aanta barnaamijyada, kala duwanaanshaha habka tababarka iyo cidda amar siineysa ciidamada marka ay dhameystaan koorsooyinka. Loollanka saameynta gobolka Ballaarinta taageerada militari ee Sacuudiga ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay sii kordhayso tartanka dalalka gobolka iyo quwadaha caalamka ugu jiraan saameynta Soomaaliya. Soomaaliya waxay ku taallaa goob istaraatiiji ah oo isku xirta Badweynta Hindiya, Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaana xeebteeda dheer muhiimad gaar ah siinaya dalalka doonaya inay ilaashadaan marinnada ganacsiga iyo amniga badda. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa aaminsan in tababarrada ciidamada iyo maalgelinta mashaariicda amniga aysan ku koobneyn oo keliya dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab, balse ay sidoo kale qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada dalalka shisheeye ku doonayaan inay xiriir dhow kula yeeshaan dowladda Soomaaliya. Barnaamijkan ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadaya xilli dowladda federaalka ay wajahayo caqabado amni iyo khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo xiriirka kala dhexeeya qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada. Ka mid noqoshada dhalinyaro laga soo qoray Puntland ayaa si gaar ah isha loogu hayaa, maadaama uu weli jiro khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya maamulka Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka. Ma cadda in ciidamadaas ay dowladda federaalku si toos ah uga qoratay Puntland iyo in deegaankaas ay tegi doonaan kadib tababarka, mana jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay maamulka Puntland oo ku saabsan askarta la sheegay inay qeybta ka yihiin tababarka Guriceel. The post Sacuudiga oo tababaraya 5,000 oo askar Soomaali ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Trump oo Iiraan ugu hanjabay tallaabo militari oo adag, ka dib aaska Khamenei
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa si adag ugu hanjabay dowladda Iran, kaddib markii intii lagu jiray aaska Hoggaamiyihii Sare ee Iiraan, Ayatollah Cali Khamenei, ay soo baxeen baaqyo lagu dalbanayay dilkiisa. Trump ayaa qoraal uu ku baahiyay bartiisa Truth Social ku sheegay in Mareykanku diyaar u yahay jawaab militari oo xooggan haddii Iran ama cid la xiriirta ay isku daydo inay beegsato Madaxweynaha Mareykanka. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanka la siiyay amarro ay kaga jawaabayaan hanjabaad kasta oo noocaas ah, ayadoo Warbaahinta Mareykanku ay sidoo kale werisay in Israa’iil ay Washington la wadaagtay xog sirdoon oo la xiriirta qorshe la sheegay in Iiraan ay ku doonayso inay ku disho Trump. Wararka ayaa tilmaamay in hanjabaaddan cusub ay keentay in hay’adaha ammaanka Mareykanka ay adkeeyaan ilaalinta madaxweynaha. Dhanka kale, inkastoo hadallada adag ay isa soo tarayaan, Trump wuxuu sheegay in wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran ay weli socdaan, isagoo xusay in Iran ay codsatay in la sii wado wada-xaajoodyada, balse uu ku adkaystay in xabbad-joojintii ku-meelgaarka ahayd ay dhammaatay. Iiraan ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inaanay isu dhiibi doonin cadaadiska Mareykanka, ayadoo Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka dalkaas Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, uu sheegay in dalkiisu si buuxda ugu diyaar garoobay difaaca qaranka haddii Mareykanku ka baxo heshiisyadii hore loo gaaray. Dhanka kale waxaa socda dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu dejinayo xiisadda gobolka, waxaana wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, uu booqday magaalada Muscat ee dalka Cumaan si uu wada-hadallo uga yeesho ammaanka marin-biyoodka Hormuz, halka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif, uu ugu baaqay Mareykanka iyo Iran inay is xakameeyaan oo ay sii wadaan wada-hadallada. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran ayaa sii xoogeysatay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, iyadoo ay barbar socdaan weerarro militari, hanjabaado is-daba joog ah iyo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in lagu xalliyo khilaafka labada dhinac.

Trump ayaa qoraal uu ku baahiyay bartiisa Truth Social ku sheegay in Mareykanku diyaar u yahay jawaab militari oo xooggan haddii Iran ama cid la xiriirta ay isku daydo inay beegsato Madaxweynaha Mareykanka. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanka la siiyay amarro ay kaga jawaabayaan hanjabaad kasta oo noocaas ah, ayadoo Warbaahinta Mareykanku ay sidoo kale werisay in Israa’iil ay Washington la wadaagtay xog sirdoon oo la xiriirta qorshe la sheegay in Iiraan ay ku doonayso inay ku disho Trump. Wararka ayaa tilmaamay in hanjabaaddan cusub ay keentay in hay’adaha ammaanka Mareykanka ay adkeeyaan ilaalinta madaxweynaha. Dhanka kale, inkastoo hadallada adag ay isa soo tarayaan, Trump wuxuu sheegay in wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran ay weli socdaan, isagoo xusay in Iran ay codsatay in la sii wado wada-xaajoodyada, balse uu ku adkaystay in xabbad-joojintii ku-meelgaarka ahayd ay dhammaatay. Iiraan ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inaanay isu dhiibi doonin cadaadiska Mareykanka, ayadoo Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka dalkaas Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, uu sheegay in dalkiisu si buuxda ugu diyaar garoobay difaaca qaranka haddii Mareykanku ka baxo heshiisyadii hore loo gaaray. Dhanka kale waxaa socda dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu dejinayo xiisadda gobolka, waxaana wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, uu booqday magaalada Muscat ee dalka Cumaan si uu wada-hadallo uga yeesho ammaanka marin-biyoodka Hormuz, halka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif, uu ugu baaqay Mareykanka iyo Iran inay is xakameeyaan oo ay sii wadaan wada-hadallada. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran ayaa sii xoogeysatay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, iyadoo ay barbar socdaan weerarro militari, hanjabaado is-daba joog ah iyo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in lagu xalliyo khilaafka labada dhinac.

items.title: Dekadda Boosaaso oo Xiran in ka Badan 10 Maalmood, iyo Ganacsatada oo ka Gadoodsan Canshuur Kordhinta Maamulka Puntland
items.description: Inta badan xarumaha ganacsiga ee magaalada Boosaaso ayaa maanta albaabada loo laabay, kaddib markii ganacsatadu ay bilaabeen mudaharaad ay uga soo horjeedaan xirnaanshaha dekedda Boosaaso iyo cashuur kordhin ay sheegeen inay Puntland ku soo rogtay badeecadaha. Sida ay sheegeen ganacsatada, dekedda Boosaaso ayaa xiran muddo ka badan toban maalmood, arrintaas oo saameyn ballaaran ku yeelatay isu socodka badeecadaha iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqa ganacsiga guud ahaan Puntland iyo gobollada dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Ganacsatadu waxay ku doodayaan in cashuurta cusub ee lagu soo rogay badeecadaha ay afar-jibbaar ka badan tahay tii hore, taas oo ay ku tilmaameen culays dheeraad ah oo kusoo beegmay xilli ay shacabka Soomaaliyeed horeyba u wajahayeen dhaqaale-xumo iyo sicir-barar. Ganacsatada ayaa ugu baaqey masuuliyiinta maamulka Puntland inay si degdeg ah u furaan dekedda Boosaaso isla markaana dib u eegaan go’aanka la xiriira cashuur kordhinta, si loo yareeyo saameynta dhaqaale ee ku dhacaysa ganacsatada iyo bulshada inteeda kale.

items.title: Markii lacagta caddaanka ah ay fashilantay, isku-xirka ayaa noqday lacag
items.description: Sida lacagta mobilada ah ay uga caawisay Soomaaliya inay dib u dhiso kalsoonida, helitaanka, iyo adkeysiga maaliyadeed Qoraal: Cabdikaafi Faarax Markii ay burburtay dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya sanadkii 1991, hay’adaha dawladda way daciifeen, kaabayaasha qaranku si xun ayuu u dhaawacmay, nidaamka bangiyada rasmiga ahi way daciifay, kalsoonidii nidaamyada maaliyadda qarankuna way yaraatay. Soomaalida badankood, lacagtu waxay noqotay shay jidhiidhi ah, jilicsan, adag oo la dhaqaajiyo, mararka qaarkoodna ay adag tahay in la kalsoonaado. Markii kalsoonidii shilling-ka Soomaaliyeed ay daciiftay, iyo macaamillo badan oo u beddelay doolarka Maraykanka, dadku waxay u baahdeen siyaabo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ay ku beddelaan qiimaha. Suuqyada, dukaamada, gaadiidka, taageerada qoyska, iyo macaamilka ganacsi, nolol maalinleyda maaliyadeed waxay u baahnayd nidaamyo ka shaqayn kara xitaa marka kaabayaasha rasmiga ay xaddidan yihiin. Laakiin Soomaaliya ma joogsan. Kalsooni ka hor Tiknoolajiyad Markii nidaamyada rasmigu daciifeen, dadku waxay abuureen waxyaabo kale. Kalsoonidu waxay noqotay kaabayaal. Nidaamyada Hawala waxay isku xireen qoysaska, ganacsatada, bulshooyinka qurbajoogta ah, iyo dadka xadka dhaafay. Nidaamyadani waxay ka badnaayeen qanalo maaliyadeed; waxay ahaayeen shabakado bulsho oo ku dhisan sumcad, kalsooni, iyo baahi. Kadib, isgaarsiinta mobilada ah waxay bilawday inay beddesho suurtogalnimada maaliyadeed ee dalka. Markii isku-xirku noqday helitaan maaliyadeed Markii isku-xirka mobilada uu balaadhay, isticmaalayaasha Soomaaliyeed waxay ka guureen isgaarsiinta aasaasiga ah una gudbeen adeegyo dijitaal ah oo taageera bixinta lacagta, ganacsiga isgaarsiinta, helitaanka macluumaadka, iyo macaamilka maalinleyda. Hormuud Telecom, oo hawlaheeda ka bilowday Soomaaliya 2002-dii, waxay qayb ka noqotay isbeddelkaas iyadoo la adeegsanayo adeegyada isgaarsiinta, shabakadaha mobilada, gelitaanka internetka, iyo markii dambena lacagta mobilada. Warbixinno ay dib u daabacay Reuters ayaa sheegaya taariikhda hawlgalka Hormuud ee 2002, iyo in shatigii ugu horreeyay ee lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya la siiyay Hormuud sanadkii 2021. [4] Dad badan oo isticmaala, qiimaha lacagta moobaylku waa mid fudud: Iyada oo loo marayo EVC Plus, isku-xirka mobilada wuxuu ka noqday wax ka badan isgaarsiin; waxa uu noqday qalab maaliyadeed oo wax ku ool ah oo loogu talagalay macaamilka maalinleyda. Markii lacagta mobilada ay ka guurtay inay noqoto mid ka mid ah astaamaha isgaarsiinta una noqoto qayb ka mid ah nolol maalinleyda maaliyadeed, ayaa isbedel weyn la sameeyay. EVC Plus ma aysan ahayn mid si fudud u soo bandhigtay hab lacag bixin oo cusub. Waxay ka caawisay wax ka qabashada mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee maaliyadda Soomaaliya: sida dadku u beddeli karaan qiimaha marka lacagta caddaanku aanay habboonayn, aanay ammaan ahayn, yar tahay, ama aanay la isku kalsoonaan karin. Iyadoo la adeegsanayo taleefan gacanta, hawlaha maaliyadeed hadda kuma xirna laan bangiga, lacag caddaan ah, ama isweydaarsiga wejiga-wejiga. EVC Plus waxay suurtogalisay in la diro oo la helo lacag, la bixiyo biilasha, la galo adeegyada bangiyada, iyo in la dhammeeyo macaamilka maalinleyda iyadoo la adeegsanayo isku-xirka mobilada ee fudud. Bogga Hormuud Telecom ee EVC Plus wuxuu sharxayaa astaamaha sida dirista iyo helista lacagta, bixinta biilasha, iyo galitaanka akoonnada bangiyada. [1] Tan waxay beddeshay doorkii taleefanka laftiisa. Ma ahayn oo keliya qalab isgaarsiin; waxa uu noqday qalab wax ku ool ah oo lagu dhaqaajiyo qiimaha, lagu yareeyo dib-u-dhacyada bixinta, laguna fududeeyo macaamilka maalinleyda dadka iyo ganacsiyada. Hadda, EVC Plus waa mid lacag la’aan ah marka la eego isticmaalka, taas oo ka caawinaysa yareynta caqabadaha kharashka iyo ballaarinta helitaanka bixinta dijitaalka ah ee isticmaalayaasha maalinleyda ah, ganacsiyada yaryar, iyo qoysaska. Tani waa sababta lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya aanay u ahayn oo keliya sheeko tiknoolajiyadeed. Waxay sidoo kale tahay sheeko ku saabsan la qabsiga dhaqaale, kalsoonida dadweynaha, iyo adkeysiga bulsho. Laga bilaabo fudayd ilaa kaabayaal maaliyadeed Suuqyada qaarkood, lacagta mobilada waxaa loo arkaa mid fudayd ah. Laakiin Soomaaliya, bulshooyin, ganacsiyo, iyo qoysas badan, waxay noqotay wax u dhow kaabayaal maaliyadeed. Sidee lacagta moobaylku uga caawisay Soomaaliya inay dib u dhisto kalsoonida dhaqaale? Muhiimada ay leedahay waxay ku jirtaa cabbirka iyo ku-tiirsanaanta. Lacagta mobilada waxay noqotay qayb ka mid ah sida qiimaha ugu dhaqaaqo suuqyada, guryaha, adeegyada, iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga. Halkii ay noqon lahayd qalab dijitaal oo ikhtiyaari ah, waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah nidaamyada ay dadku ku tiirsan yihiin si ay u sii wadaan nolol maalinleyda dhaqaale iyadoo kaabayaasha maaliyadeed ee rasmiga ah ay sii socdaan. Warbixinno dhow iyo tixraacyo suuq ayaa muujinaya in lacagta mobilada ay sii ahayd mid si qoto dheer ugu dhigan nolol maaliyadeed Soomaaliya. Hagaha dalka Soomaaliya ee U.S. International Trade Administration ee 2024 ayaa lacagta mobilada ku tilmaamay mid baahsan, iyadoo la qiyaasay in 73% dadku isticmaalaan. [5] Warbixinno 2026 ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay sida ay u jilicsan tahay dhaqaalaha lacagta caddaanka ah ee hadhay, ka dib markii diidmada lacagaha shilling-ka Soomaaliyeed ee duugga ah ay carqaladeeyeen ganacsatada, gaadiidka, iyo qoysaska dakhliga yar, iyadoo doolarka Maraykanka iyo wareegga taleefanka ay sii wadeen doorkooda muhiimka ah ee isweydaarsiga maalinleyda. [8] Cilmi-baaris dhow ayaa sidoo kale baartay lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya wax ka baxsan bixinta fudud, iyadoo lagu tilmaamay qayb ka mid ah la qabsiga dhaqaale iyo adkeysiga dalka, gaar ahaan jawi jilicsan oo cimiladu dhib badan tahay. [9] Si la taaban karo, lacagta mobilada waxay noqotay qayb ka mid ah laxanka dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya ee maalinleyda ah ee ka jira suuqyada, guryaha, goobaha shaqada, iyo shabakadaha taageerada. Saamaynta qoto dheer: Helitaanka maaliyadeed Cilmi-baarista tacliineed ee EVC Plus waxay baartay doorka ay ku leedahay helitaanka maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jiraan helitaanka, isticmaalka, tayada, iyo dhinacyada wanaagga ee adeegyada maaliyadeed. Tani way muhiim tahay sababtoo ah dad badan oo aan laga yaabin inay helaan bangiyada rasmiga ah waxay wali ka qayb qaadan karaan bixinta dijitaalka ah iyadoo la adeegsanayo lacagta mobilada. [2] Saamaynta bini’aadantinimo waxay ku muuqataa dadka ay lacagta mobilada ku keento nidaamka maaliyadeed: macaamiisha aan lahayn akoon bangiyo dhaqameed, ganacsatada yaryar ee u baahan bixin degdeg ah, qoysaska helaya taageero qaraabo, ardayda bixisa adeegyada, iyo hay’adaha samafalka ee gaarsiinaya dadka si degdeg ah oo la raadin karo. Isticmaalayaal badan, qiimaha lacagta mobilada waa mid fudud: waxay yareysaa masaafada, keydisaa wakhti, hoos u dhigeysa ku-tiirsanaanta lacagta caddaanka ah, waxayna suurtogalisaa ka qaybqaadashada maaliyadeed meelaha bangiyada dhaqameedku xaddidan yihiin. Nidaaminta, kalsoonida, iyo mas’uuliyadda Muhiimadda lacagta mobilada waxay sidoo kale muuqatay heerka sharciyeynta iyo heerarka caalamiga ah. Sharciga lacagta mobilada ee Baanka Dhexe ee Soomaaliya wuxuu daboollaa shatigaynta, hawlgalka, iyo kormeerka bixiyeyaasha adeegyada lacagta mobilada. Warbixinno dhow ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in baanka dhexe uu Hormuud Telecom siiyay shatigii ugu horreeyay ee lacagta mobilada ee Soomaaliya 2021, tallaabo looga gol lahaa in la qaabeeyo bixinta dijitaalka ah lana milmo nidaamka maaliyadeed ee ballaadhan. [3][4] Marka laga soo tago nidaaminta qaranka, EVC Plus waxaa sidoo kale lagu aqoonsaday shahaadada GSMA Mobile Money Certification, oo ah barnaamij shahaado oo caalami ah oo qiimeeya bixiyeyaasha lacagta mobilada iyadoo la eegayo heerarka caalamiga ah. Sida ay sheegtay GSMA, EVC Plus waxaa lagu qiimeeyay dhinacyo ay ka mid yihiin ilaalinta lacagta, ka hortagga khiyaanada, ammaanka nidaamka, iyo sirta xogta, iyadoo la adeegsanayo siddeed mabda’ oo aasaasi ah iyo ku dhawaad 300 oo shuruud. Hormuud waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in EVC Plus dib loo shahaadeeyay barnaamijka GSMA Mobile Money Certification 2025, taasoo caddaynaysa ka go’naanshaha heerarka caalamiga ah ee xuquuqda macaamiisha, ka hortagga dhaqidda lacagaha sharci-darrada ah, iyo bixinta adeegyo maaliyadeed oo adkeysi leh. [6][7] Kalsoonida maaliyadda dijitaalka ah waxay ku dhisantahay wax ka badan tiknoolajiyad. Waxay u baahan tahay kormeer wax ku ool ah, ilaalinta macaamiisha oo xooggan, adeeg la isku halayn karo, nidaamyo ammaan ah, sirta xogta, iyo kalsoonida dadweynaha ee ah in lacagtooda la ilaalinayo marxalad kasta. Sida nidaam kasta oo maaliyadeed oo dijitaal ah, lacagta mobilada waxay u baahan tahay sharciyeyn adag, amniga internetka, isku-halaynta wakiilada, ilaalinta macaamiisha, sirta xogta, iyo joogteynta adeegga. Ilaaladahani way muhiim yihiin sababtoo ah marka ay dadku ku tiirsanaadaan nidaamka bixinta dijitaalka ah, way sii muhiim u noqotaa xasiloonida, daah-furnaanta, iyo kalsoonida dadweynaha. Waxa lacagta mobilada suurtogalisay Lacagta mobilada la’aanteed, dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya si buuxda uma joogsan lahayn. Soomaalidu waa dad adkeysi leh oo had iyo jeer helay siyaabo ay ula qabsadaan – laakiin nolol maalinleyda waxay noqon lahayd mid ka sii gaabis ah, khatar badan, oo ka sii qaali ah. Ganacsiyadu waxay si weyn ugu tiirsanaan lahaayeen lacagta caddaanka ah. Macaamiisha waxay la kulmi lahaayeen caqabado badan. Gaarsiinta gargaarku way dhib badnaan lahayd. Macaamilka yaryar waxay noqon lahaayeen kuwo aan waxtar lahayn. Helitaanka maaliyadeed wuxuu yaraaan lahaa dad badan oo ka baxsan nidaamyada bangiyada dhaqameed. EVC Plus waxay ka dhigan tahay nooca hal-abuurnimada ka soo baxda baahi dhab ah. Lama abuurin oo kaliya raaxo. Waxay ka soo ifbaxday suuq u baahanay kalsooni, xawaare, helitaan, iyo isku-halayn. Waxay ka caawisay in taleefanka gacanta loo beddelo boorsa lacag, SIM-ka loo beddelo barta helitaanka maaliyadeed, iyo kalsoonida dijitaalka loo beddelo dhaqdhaqaaq dhaqaale. Marka Soomaaliya ay sii wado ballaarinta adeegyada dijitaalka, lacagta mobilada waxay muujinaysaa sida tiknoolajiyadu ugu noqoto tan ugu awoodda badan markay xalliso dhibaatooyinka dhabta ah ee nolol maalinleyda dadka. Taasi waa awoodda hal-abuurnimada Soomaaliyeed: marka nidaamyadu fashilmaan, dadku waxay dhistaan kuwo cusub. Oo Soomaaliya, lacagta mobilada kuma aysan beddelin oo kaliya sida dadku u bixiyaan. Waxay beddeshay sida dadku u noolaadaan, u ganacsadaan, midba midka kale u taageero, iyo sida ay u horey u socdaan. Tixraacyo [1] Hormuud Telecom — “EVC Plus.” Bogga adeegga rasmiga ah ee Hormuud oo sharxaya astaamaha EVC Plus, oo ay ku jiraan dirista iyo helista lacagta, bixinta biilasha, iyo galitaanka akoonnada bangiyada. [2] Abdiaziz Ali Mohamed — “Quantifying the Role of Mobile Money Services to Financial Inclusion: Evidence from EVC-PLUS in Somalia.” Waxaa lagu daabacay Global Social Welfare, Springer. Waxaa loo adeegsaday cilmi-baaris ku saabsan EVC Plus iyo helitaanka maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya. [3] Baanka Dhexe ee Soomaaliya — “Mobile Money Regulation 2020, amended 2021.” Dukumeenti sharci oo daboolla shatigaynta, hawlgalka, iyo kormeerka bixiyeyaasha adeegyada lacagta mobilada ee Soomaaliya. [4] Warbixin dib loo daabacay oo Reuters ah iyada oo loo marayo MarketScreener — “Hormuud Telecom awarded Somalia’s first mobile money licence.” Waxaa loo isticmaalay taariikhda hawlgalka Hormuud ee 2002 iyo shatigii ugu horreeyay ee lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya oo la siiyay Hormuud 2021. [5] U.S. International Trade Administration — “Somalia: Banking Services and the Financial Services.” Waxaa la daabacay Janaayo 22, 2024. Waxaa loo isticmaalay in lagu sheego in lacagta mobilada ay baahsan tahay Soomaaliya, iyadoo la qiyaasay 73% dadku isticmaalaan. [6] GSMA Mobile Money Certification — “Hormuud Telecom awarded GSMA mobile money certification.” Tixraac shahaado ah oo sharxaya Hormuud oo heshay shahaadada GSMA. [7] Hormuud Telecom — “Hormuud Telecom Receives GSMA Re-Certification for Secure Mobile Money Services.” Cusboonaysiintii Hormuud 2025 ee EVC Plus oo heshay dib-u-shahaadaynta GSMA. [8] The Guardian — “‘It’s like we went bankrupt overnight’: poorest Somalis suffer as piles of worthless shillings mount up.” Waxaa la daabacay May 11, 2026. Waxaa loo adeegsaday macnaha jilicsanaanta dhaqaalaha lacagta caddaanka ah Soomaaliya. [9] Frontiers — “Investigating the economic dynamics of mobile money in Somalia’s climate-stressed economy.” Waxaa la daabacay 2025. Waxaa loo adeegsaday cilmi-baaris dhow oo ku saabsan lacagta mobilada, la qabsiga dhaqaale, iyo adkeysiga Soomaaliya. Markii lacagta mobilada ay ka guurtay inay noqoto mid ka mid ah astaamaha isgaarsiinta una noqoto qayb ka mid ah nolol maalinleyda maaliyadeed, ayaa isbedel weyn la sameeyay. EVC Plus ma aysan ahayn mid si fudud u soo bandhigtay hab lacag bixin oo cusub. Waxay ka caawisay wax ka qabashada mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee maaliyadda Soomaaliya: sida dadku u beddeli karaan qiimaha marka lacagta caddaanku aanay habboonayn, aanay ammaan ahayn, yar tahay, ama aanay la isku kalsoonaan karin. Iyadoo la adeegsanayo taleefan gacanta, hawlaha maaliyadeed hadda kuma xirna laan bangiga, lacag caddaan ah, ama isweydaarsiga wejiga-wejiga. EVC Plus waxay suurtogalisay in la diro oo la helo lacag, la bixiyo biilasha, la galo adeegyada bangiyada, iyo in la dhammeeyo macaamilka maalinleyda iyadoo la adeegsanayo isku-xirka mobilada ee fudud. Bogga Hormuud Telecom ee EVC Plus wuxuu sharxayaa astaamaha sida dirista iyo helista lacagta, bixinta biilasha, iyo galitaanka akoonnada bangiyada. [1] Tan waxay beddeshay doorkii taleefanka laftiisa. Ma ahayn oo keliya qalab isgaarsiin; waxa uu noqday qalab wax ku ool ah oo lagu dhaqaajiyo qiimaha, lagu yareeyo dib-u-dhacyada bixinta, laguna fududeeyo macaamilka maalinleyda dadka iyo ganacsiyada. Hadda, EVC Plus waa mid lacag la’aan ah marka la eego isticmaalka, taas oo ka caawinaysa yareynta caqabadaha kharashka iyo ballaarinta helitaanka bixinta dijitaalka ah ee isticmaalayaasha maalinleyda ah, ganacsiyada yaryar, iyo qoysaska. Tani waa sababta lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya aanay u ahayn oo keliya sheeko tiknoolajiyadeed. Waxay sidoo kale tahay sheeko ku saabsan la qabsiga dhaqaale, kalsoonida dadweynaha, iyo adkeysiga bulsho. Laga bilaabo fudayd ilaa kaabayaal maaliyadeed Suuqyada qaarkood, lacagta mobilada waxaa loo arkaa mid fudayd ah. Laakiin Soomaaliya, bulshooyin, ganacsiyo, iyo qoysas badan, waxay noqotay wax u dhow kaabayaal maaliyadeed. Sidee lacagta moobaylku uga caawisay Soomaaliya inay dib u dhisto kalsoonida dhaqaale? Muhiimada ay leedahay waxay ku jirtaa cabbirka iyo ku-tiirsanaanta. Lacagta mobilada waxay noqotay qayb ka mid ah sida qiimaha ugu dhaqaaqo suuqyada, guryaha, adeegyada, iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga. Halkii ay noqon lahayd qalab dijitaal oo ikhtiyaari ah, waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah nidaamyada ay dadku ku tiirsan yihiin si ay u sii wadaan nolol maalinleyda dhaqaale iyadoo kaabayaasha maaliyadeed ee rasmiga ah ay sii socdaan. Warbixinno dhow iyo tixraacyo suuq ayaa muujinaya in lacagta mobilada ay sii ahayd mid si qoto dheer ugu dhigan nolol maaliyadeed Soomaaliya. Hagaha dalka Soomaaliya ee U.S. International Trade Administration ee 2024 ayaa lacagta mobilada ku tilmaamay mid baahsan, iyadoo la qiyaasay in 73% dadku isticmaalaan. [5] Warbixinno 2026 ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay sida ay u jilicsan tahay dhaqaalaha lacagta caddaanka ah ee hadhay, ka dib markii diidmada lacagaha shilling-ka Soomaaliyeed ee duugga ah ay carqaladeeyeen ganacsatada, gaadiidka, iyo qoysaska dakhliga yar, iyadoo doolarka Maraykanka iyo wareegga taleefanka ay sii wadeen doorkooda muhiimka ah ee isweydaarsiga maalinleyda. [8] Cilmi-baaris dhow ayaa sidoo kale baartay lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya wax ka baxsan bixinta fudud, iyadoo lagu tilmaamay qayb ka mid ah la qabsiga dhaqaale iyo adkeysiga dalka, gaar ahaan jawi jilicsan oo cimiladu dhib badan tahay. [9] Si la taaban karo, lacagta mobilada waxay noqotay qayb ka mid ah laxanka dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya ee maalinleyda ah ee ka jira suuqyada, guryaha, goobaha shaqada, iyo shabakadaha taageerada. Saamaynta qoto dheer: Helitaanka maaliyadeed Cilmi-baarista tacliineed ee EVC Plus waxay baartay doorka ay ku leedahay helitaanka maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jiraan helitaanka, isticmaalka, tayada, iyo dhinacyada wanaagga ee adeegyada maaliyadeed. Tani way muhiim tahay sababtoo ah dad badan oo aan laga yaabin inay helaan bangiyada rasmiga ah waxay wali ka qayb qaadan karaan bixinta dijitaalka ah iyadoo la adeegsanayo lacagta mobilada. [2] Saamaynta bini’aadantinimo waxay ku muuqataa dadka ay lacagta mobilada ku keento nidaamka maaliyadeed: macaamiisha aan lahayn akoon bangiyo dhaqameed, ganacsatada yaryar ee u baahan bixin degdeg ah, qoysaska helaya taageero qaraabo, ardayda bixisa adeegyada, iyo hay’adaha samafalka ee gaarsiinaya dadka si degdeg ah oo la raadin karo. Isticmaalayaal badan, qiimaha lacagta mobilada waa mid fudud: waxay yareysaa masaafada, keydisaa wakhti, hoos u dhigeysa ku-tiirsanaanta lacagta caddaanka ah, waxayna suurtogalisaa ka qaybqaadashada maaliyadeed meelaha bangiyada dhaqameedku xaddidan yihiin. Nidaaminta, kalsoonida, iyo mas’uuliyadda Muhiimadda lacagta mobilada waxay sidoo kale muuqatay heerka sharciyeynta iyo heerarka caalamiga ah. Sharciga lacagta mobilada ee Baanka Dhexe ee Soomaaliya wuxuu daboollaa shatigaynta, hawlgalka, iyo kormeerka bixiyeyaasha adeegyada lacagta mobilada. Warbixinno dhow ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in baanka dhexe uu Hormuud Telecom siiyay shatigii ugu horreeyay ee lacagta mobilada ee Soomaaliya 2021, tallaabo looga gol lahaa in la qaabeeyo bixinta dijitaalka ah lana milmo nidaamka maaliyadeed ee ballaadhan. [3][4] Marka laga soo tago nidaaminta qaranka, EVC Plus waxaa sidoo kale lagu aqoonsaday shahaadada GSMA Mobile Money Certification, oo ah barnaamij shahaado oo caalami ah oo qiimeeya bixiyeyaasha lacagta mobilada iyadoo la eegayo heerarka caalamiga ah. Sida ay sheegtay GSMA, EVC Plus waxaa lagu qiimeeyay dhinacyo ay ka mid yihiin ilaalinta lacagta, ka hortagga khiyaanada, ammaanka nidaamka, iyo sirta xogta, iyadoo la adeegsanayo siddeed mabda’ oo aasaasi ah iyo ku dhawaad 300 oo shuruud. Hormuud waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in EVC Plus dib loo shahaadeeyay barnaamijka GSMA Mobile Money Certification 2025, taasoo caddaynaysa ka go’naanshaha heerarka caalamiga ah ee xuquuqda macaamiisha, ka hortagga dhaqidda lacagaha sharci-darrada ah, iyo bixinta adeegyo maaliyadeed oo adkeysi leh. [6][7] Kalsoonida maaliyadda dijitaalka ah waxay ku dhisantahay wax ka badan tiknoolajiyad. Waxay u baahan tahay kormeer wax ku ool ah, ilaalinta macaamiisha oo xooggan, adeeg la isku halayn karo, nidaamyo ammaan ah, sirta xogta, iyo kalsoonida dadweynaha ee ah in lacagtooda la ilaalinayo marxalad kasta. Sida nidaam kasta oo maaliyadeed oo dijitaal ah, lacagta mobilada waxay u baahan tahay sharciyeyn adag, amniga internetka, isku-halaynta wakiilada, ilaalinta macaamiisha, sirta xogta, iyo joogteynta adeegga. Ilaaladahani way muhiim yihiin sababtoo ah marka ay dadku ku tiirsanaadaan nidaamka bixinta dijitaalka ah, way sii muhiim u noqotaa xasiloonida, daah-furnaanta, iyo kalsoonida dadweynaha. Waxa lacagta mobilada suurtogalisay Lacagta mobilada la’aanteed, dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya si buuxda uma joogsan lahayn. Soomaalidu waa dad adkeysi leh oo had iyo jeer helay siyaabo ay ula qabsadaan – laakiin nolol maalinleyda waxay noqon lahayd mid ka sii gaabis ah, khatar badan, oo ka sii qaali ah. Ganacsiyadu waxay si weyn ugu tiirsanaan lahaayeen lacagta caddaanka ah. Macaamiisha waxay la kulmi lahaayeen caqabado badan. Gaarsiinta gargaarku way dhib badnaan lahayd. Macaamilka yaryar waxay noqon lahaayeen kuwo aan waxtar lahayn. Helitaanka maaliyadeed wuxuu yaraaan lahaa dad badan oo ka baxsan nidaamyada bangiyada dhaqameed. EVC Plus waxay ka dhigan tahay nooca hal-abuurnimada ka soo baxda baahi dhab ah. Lama abuurin oo kaliya raaxo. Waxay ka soo ifbaxday suuq u baahanay kalsooni, xawaare, helitaan, iyo isku-halayn. Waxay ka caawisay in taleefanka gacanta loo beddelo boorsa lacag, SIM-ka loo beddelo barta helitaanka maaliyadeed, iyo kalsoonida dijitaalka loo beddelo dhaqdhaqaaq dhaqaale. Marka Soomaaliya ay sii wado ballaarinta adeegyada dijitaalka, lacagta mobilada waxay muujinaysaa sida tiknoolajiyadu ugu noqoto tan ugu awoodda badan markay xalliso dhibaatooyinka dhabta ah ee nolol maalinleyda dadka. Taasi waa awoodda hal-abuurnimada Soomaaliyeed: marka nidaamyadu fashilmaan, dadku waxay dhistaan kuwo cusub. Oo Soomaaliya, lacagta mobilada kuma aysan beddelin oo kaliya sida dadku u bixiyaan. Waxay beddeshay sida dadku u noolaadaan, u ganacsadaan, midba midka kale u taageero, iyo sida ay u horey u socdaan. Tixraacyo [1] Hormuud Telecom — “EVC Plus.” Bogga adeegga rasmiga ah ee Hormuud oo sharxaya astaamaha EVC Plus, oo ay ku jiraan dirista iyo helista lacagta, bixinta biilasha, iyo galitaanka akoonnada bangiyada. [2] Abdiaziz Ali Mohamed — “Quantifying the Role of Mobile Money Services to Financial Inclusion: Evidence from EVC-PLUS in Somalia.” Waxaa lagu daabacay Global Social Welfare, Springer. Waxaa loo adeegsaday cilmi-baaris ku saabsan EVC Plus iyo helitaanka maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya. [3] Baanka Dhexe ee Soomaaliya — “Mobile Money Regulation 2020, amended 2021.” Dukumeenti sharci oo daboolla shatigaynta, hawlgalka, iyo kormeerka bixiyeyaasha adeegyada lacagta mobilada ee Soomaaliya. [4] Warbixin dib loo daabacay oo Reuters ah iyada oo loo marayo MarketScreener — “Hormuud Telecom awarded Somalia’s first mobile money licence.” Waxaa loo isticmaalay taariikhda hawlgalka Hormuud ee 2002 iyo shatigii ugu horreeyay ee lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya oo la siiyay Hormuud 2021. [5] U.S. International Trade Administration — “Somalia: Banking Services and the Financial Services.” Waxaa la daabacay Janaayo 22, 2024. Waxaa loo isticmaalay in lagu sheego in lacagta mobilada ay baahsan tahay Soomaaliya, iyadoo la qiyaasay 73% dadku isticmaalaan. [6] GSMA Mobile Money Certification — “Hormuud Telecom awarded GSMA mobile money certification.” Tixraac shahaado ah oo sharxaya Hormuud oo heshay shahaadada GSMA. [7] Hormuud Telecom — “Hormuud Telecom Receives GSMA Re-Certification for Secure Mobile Money Services.” Cusboonaysiintii Hormuud 2025 ee EVC Plus oo heshay dib-u-shahaadaynta GSMA. [8] The Guardian — “‘It’s like we went bankrupt overnight’: poorest Somalis suffer as piles of worthless shillings mount up.” Waxaa la daabacay May 11, 2026. Waxaa loo adeegsaday macnaha jilicsanaanta dhaqaalaha lacagta caddaanka ah Soomaaliya. [9] Frontiers — “Investigating the economic dynamics of mobile money in Somalia’s climate-stressed economy.” Waxaa la daabacay 2025. Waxaa loo adeegsaday cilmi-baaris dhow oo ku saabsan lacagta mobilada, la qabsiga dhaqaale, iyo adkeysiga Soomaaliya. The post Markii lacagta caddaanka ah ay fashilantay, isku-xirka ayaa noqday lacag first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: When Cash Failed, Connection Became Currency
items.description: How mobile money helped Somalia rebuild everyday financial trust, access, and resilience By Abdikafi Farah When Somalia’s central government collapsed in 1991, public institutions weakened, national infrastructure was severely damaged, the formal banking system struggled, and confidence in national financial systems declined. For many Somalis, money became something physical, fragile, difficult to move, and sometimes difficult to trust. As confidence in the Somali shilling weakened and many transactions shifted toward the U.S. dollar, people needed more reliable ways to exchange value. In markets, shops, transport, family support, and business transactions, daily financial life required systems that could work even when formal infrastructure was limited. But Somalia did not stop. Trust Before Technology Where formal systems weakened, people created alternatives. Trust became infrastructure. Hawala networks connected families, traders, diaspora communities, and people across borders. These systems were more than financial channels; they were social networks built on reputation, trust, and necessity. Then telecommunications began to change the country’s financial possibilities. When Connectivity Became Financial Access As mobile connectivity expanded, Somali users moved from basic voice communication toward digital services that supported payments, business communication, information access, and everyday transactions. Hormuud Telecom, which began operating in Somalia in 2002, became part of that transformation through communication services, mobile networks, internet access, and later mobile money. Reuters-republished reporting notes Hormuud’s 2002 operating history and states that Somalia’s first mobile money license was awarded to Hormuud in 2021. [4] Trust Before Technology Through EVC Plus, mobile connectivity became more than communication; it became a practical financial tool for everyday transactions. A major turning point came when mobile money moved from being a telecom feature to becoming part of daily financial life. EVC Plus did not simply introduce a new payment method. It helped address one of Somalia’s most important financial challenges: how people could exchange value when physical cash was inconvenient, unsafe, scarce, or unreliable. With a mobile phone, financial activity no longer had to depend on a bank branch, physical cash, or face-to-face exchange. EVC Plus made it possible to send and receive money, pay bills, access bank-linked services, and complete daily transactions through a simple mobile connection. Hormuud’s official EVC Plus service page describes functions such as sending and receiving money, paying bills, and accessing bank accounts. [1] This changed the role of the phone itself. It was no longer only a communication device; it became a practical tool for moving value, reducing payment delays, and making everyday transactions easier for people and businesses. Currently, EVC Plus is free to use at the point of transaction, helping reduce cost barriers and expand access to digital payments for everyday users, small businesses, and families. This is why mobile money in Somalia is not only a technology story. It is also a story of economic adaptation, public trust, and social resilience. From Convenience to Financial Infrastructure In some markets, mobile money is seen mainly as a convenience. In Somalia, for many communities, businesses, and families, it has become something closer to financial infrastructure. Its importance lies in scale and dependency. Mobile money became part of how value moves across markets, households, services, and commercial activity. Instead of being an optional digital tool, it became one of the systems people rely on to keep daily economic life moving while formal financial infrastructure continues to develop. More recent reporting and market references show that mobile money remains deeply embedded in Somalia’s financial life. The U.S. International Trade Administration’s 2024 Somalia country guide describes mobile money as widespread, with an estimated 73% penetration in the country. [5] Public reporting in 2026 also showed how fragile the remaining cash economy can be, as the rejection of worn Somali shilling notes disrupted traders, transport, and low-income households, while U.S. dollars and phone-based transfers continued to play a central role in everyday exchange. [8] Recent research has also examined mobile money in Somalia beyond simple payments, describing it as part of the country’s economic adaptation and resilience, especially in a fragile and climate-stressed environment. [9] In practice, mobile money has become part of Somalia’s daily economic rhythm present in markets, households, workplaces, and support networks. The Deeper Impact: Financial Inclusion For many users, the value of mobile money is simple: Academic research on EVC Plus has examined its role in financial inclusion in Somalia, including access, usage, quality, and welfare dimensions of financial services. This matters because many people who may not have access to formal banking can still participate in digital payments through mobile money. [2] The human impact is visible in the people mobile money brings into the financial system: customers without traditional bank accounts, small traders who need faster payments, families receiving support from relatives, students paying for services, and humanitarian organizations reaching people with greater speed and traceability. For many users, the value of mobile money is simple: it reduces distance, saves time, lowers dependence on cash, and makes financial participation possible in places where traditional banking may be limited. Regulation, Trust, and Responsibility Its importance also became visible at the regulatory and international standards level. The Central Bank of Somalia’s mobile money regulation covers licensing, operation, and supervision of mobile money service providers. Public reporting also stated that Somalia’s central bank awarded Hormuud Telecom the country’s first mobile money license in 2021, a move aimed at formalizing digital payments and integrating them with the wider financial system. [3][4] How mobile money helped Somalia rebuild financial trust do you trust it? Beyond national regulation, EVC Plus has also been recognized through the GSMA Mobile Money Certification, an international certification programme that assesses mobile money providers against global standards. According to GSMA’s mobile money certification platform, Hormuud’s EVC Plus was assessed across areas including safeguarding of funds, fraud prevention, system security, and data privacy, using eight core principles and nearly 300 criteria. Hormuud also stated that EVC Plus was re-certified by the GSMA Mobile Money Certification programme in 2025, reaffirming its commitment to global best practices in consumer rights, anti-money laundering, and resilient financial service delivery. [6][7] Trust in digital finance is built on more than technology. It requires effective oversight, strong consumer protection, reliable service, secure systems, data privacy, and public confidence that users’ money is protected at every stage. Like any digital financial system, mobile money requires strong regulation, cybersecurity, agent reliability, consumer protection, data privacy, and service continuity. These safeguards are essential because the more people depend on a digital payment system, the more important its stability, transparency, and public trust become. What Mobile Money Made Possible Without mobile money, Somalia’s economy would not stop completely. Somalis are resilient and have always found ways to adapt but daily life would become slower, riskier, and more expensive. Businesses would depend more heavily on physical cash. Customers would face more barriers. Aid delivery would become more difficult. Small transactions would become less efficient. Financial access would shrink for many people outside traditional banking systems. EVC Plus represents the kind of innovation that grows from real need. It was not created only for comfort. It emerged in a market that needed trust, speed, access, and reliability. It helped turn the mobile phone into a wallet, the SIM card into a financial access point, and digital trust into economic movement. As Somalia continues to expand digital services, mobile money shows how technology becomes most powerful when it solves real problems in people’s daily lives. That is the power of Somali innovation: when systems fail, people build new ones. And in Somalia, mobile money did not only change how people pay. It changed how people live, trade, support one another, and move forward. References [1] Hormuud Telecom — “EVC Plus.” Official Hormuud Telecom service page describing EVC Plus features, including sending and receiving money, paying bills, and accessing bank accounts. [2] Abdiaziz Ali Mohamed — “Quantifying the Role of Mobile Money Services to Financial Inclusion: Evidence from EVC-PLUS in Somalia.” Published in Global Social Welfare, Springer. Used for research context on EVC Plus and financial inclusion in Somalia. [3] Central Bank of Somalia — “Mobile Money Regulation 2020, amended 2021.” Regulatory document covering licensing, operation, and supervision of mobile money service providers in Somalia. [4] Reuters-republished report via MarketScreener — “Hormuud Telecom awarded Somalia’s first mobile money licence.” Used for Hormuud’s 2002 operating history and Somalia’s first mobile money licence being awarded to Hormuud in 2021. [5] U.S. International Trade Administration — “Somalia: Banking Services and the Financial Services.” Published January 22, 2024. Used for the statement that mobile money is widespread in Somalia, with estimated penetration of 73%. [6] GSMA Mobile Money Certification — “Hormuud Telecom awarded GSMA mobile money certification.” Certification reference describing Hormuud’s GSMA Mobile Money Certification. [7] Hormuud Telecom — “Hormuud Telecom Receives GSMA Re-Certification for Secure Mobile Money Services.” Hormuud’s 2025 update on EVC Plus receiving GSMA Mobile Money re-certification. [8] The Guardian — “‘It’s like we went bankrupt overnight’: poorest Somalis suffer as piles of worthless shillings mount up.” Published May 11, 2026. Used for context on the fragility of Somalia’s remaining cash economy and continued reliance on dollars and phone-based transfers. [9] Frontiers — “Investigating the economic dynamics of mobile money in Somalia’s climate-stressed economy.” Published in 2025. Used for recent research context on mobile money, economic adaptation, and resilience in Somalia. The post When Cash Failed, Connection Became Currency first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

What Mobile Money Made Possible Without mobile money, Somalia’s economy would not stop completely. Somalis are resilient and have always found ways to adapt but daily life would become slower, riskier, and more expensive. Businesses would depend more heavily on physical cash. Customers would face more barriers. Aid delivery would become more difficult. Small transactions would become less efficient. Financial access would shrink for many people outside traditional banking systems. EVC Plus represents the kind of innovation that grows from real need. It was not created only for comfort. It emerged in a market that needed trust, speed, access, and reliability. It helped turn the mobile phone into a wallet, the SIM card into a financial access point, and digital trust into economic movement. As Somalia continues to expand digital services, mobile money shows how technology becomes most powerful when it solves real problems in people’s daily lives. That is the power of Somali innovation: when systems fail, people build new ones. And in Somalia, mobile money did not only change how people pay. It changed how people live, trade, support one another, and move forward. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse oo dhagax dhigay dhismaha Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo warshadaha
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse ayaa dhagax dhigay dhismaha Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo warshadaha oo dib u dhis lagu samaynayo. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ay ka mid tahay wasaaradaha ugu muhiimsan ee dowladda, maadaama ay door weyn ka qaadato horumarinta ganacsiga iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa xusay in dowladda ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga, si loo abuuro fursado shaqo loona xoojiyo kobaca dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya. “Wasaaraddan waxay ka mid tahay wasaaradaha muhiimka u ah Xukuumadda, maadaama ay door weyn ku leedahay horumarinta ganacsiga dalka,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay haatan qorshaynayso in dalka laga hirgeliyo warshado badan, isagoo tilmaamay in soo hagaagidda amniga iyo xasilloonida ay abuurtay jawi ku habboon maalgashiga iyo hirgelinta mashaariic waaweyn oo horumarineed.

items.title: Sawirro: Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo maanta dhagax dhigay xarunta dhexe…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta dhagax-dhigay xarunta dhexe ee Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha oo dib-u-dhis lagu sameynayo, taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada Xukuumadda DanQaran ay ku horumarinayso hey’adaha muhiimka u ah adeegga bulshada iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka. Xamza oo ka hadlay munaasabadda ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ay laf-dhabar u tahay horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka, maadaama ay door muhiim ah ka qaadato kobcinta ganacsiga, horumarinta wax-soo-saarka, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga iyo abuurista jawi ganacsi oo hufan. “Xarunta Wasaaradda oo muddo 50 sano ah dhisnayd, kana muuqatay duugnimo, dib-u-dhiskeedu waa tallaabo muhiim ah. Wasaaraddani waxa ay kamid tahay wasaaradaha laf-dhabarta u ah Qaranka, waana albaabka loo maro ganacsiga iyo horumarinta wax-soo-saarka dalkeenna,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul wasaaruhu. Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale xusay in Dowladda Federaalka ay ka go’an tahay tayeynta kaabeyaasha hey’adaha Qaranka, si loo dardargeliyo adeegyada ay shacabka u hayaan, loona xoojiyo fursadaha ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee dalka. Ra’iisul wasaaraha dalka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maalmaha soo socda dalka laga hirgelin doono warshado waa wayn, isla markaana fursadaas maalgashi ay u furan tahay ganacstada Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa ajaaniibta ah ee daneynaya inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha ka jira dalkeenna’. “Dalkeennu wuxuu u jihaystay dhanka horumarka iyo kobcinta wax-soo-saarka, waxaana la filayaa in dhawaan ay dalka ka hirgalaan warshado badan oo ay leeyihiin maalgashadeyaal Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwo ajnabi ah oo dalka maalgashanaya.” ayuu sii raaciyay Xamza. Ugu dambeyn, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ku bogaadiyay Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Mudane Jamaal Maxamed Xasan hirgelinta mashruucan dib-u-dhiska ah, isaga oo ku tilmaamay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo awoodda hey’adda iyo adeegyada ay u hayso shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Xukuumadda DanQaran ayaa bilihii ugu dambeeyay wadday dib u dhiska xarumaha wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda, waxaana ugu dambeeyay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha oo xarunteeda Degmada Boondheere dib loo dhisay, loona daah-furay maalmo kahor kadib munaasabad uu ka qayb-galay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. The post Sawirro: Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo maanta dhagax dhigay xarunta dhexe… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Qatar charity oo kala saxiixday heshiis Caafimaad oo ku Kacaya $1.46 Milyan oo doollar
items.description: Dawladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Qatar charity ayaa kala saxiixday heshiis Caafimaad oo ku Kacaya $1.46 oo ay ka faa’iideysan doonaan malaayiin Soomaali ahi. Xafiiska hay’adda Qatar Charity ee Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah magaalada Muqdisho uga dhawaaqay heshiis iskaashi oo muhiim ah, kaasi oo lagu hirgelinayo 39 mashruuc oo caafimaad. Mashaariicdan oo qiimahoodu uu ka badan yahay 5.3 milyan oo Riyaalka Qadar ah (qiyaastii 1.46 milyan oo Doollarka Mareykanka ah), ayaa qorshuhu yahay inay si toos ah u caawiyaan in ka badan 36 kun oo qof oo Soomaaliyeed inta lagu jiro sannadkan 2026. Agaasimaha Xafiiska Qatar Charity ee Soomaaliya, Ibraahim Cabdiraxmaan Janaaxi, oo faahfaahin ka bixiyay wejiyada kala duwan ee caawinaaddan, ayaa xaqiijiyay in lacagtan loo qaybin doona mashaariic si gaar ah diiradda u saaraya daaweynta nafaqo-darrada, daryeelka carruurta qaba xanuunnada wadnaha, qalliinnada biyaha indhaha (cataract), iyo daryeelka dadka qaba cudurrada daba-dheeraada. “Inta lagu jiro sannadka 2026, waxaa la maalgeliyay 39-kan mashruuc, waxaana Inshaa Allaah ka faa’iideysan doona in ka badan 36 kun oo qof oo Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Janaaxi. Agaasime Ibraahim Cabdiraxmaan Janaaxi ayaa sidoo kale hoosta ka xariiqay in Qatar Charity ay si adag u sii bixin doonto hirgelinta barnaamijyada caafimaad ee takhasuska leh, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu horumariyo tayada adeegyada caafimaadka ee dalka, lana ballaariyo gaarsiinta adeegyada bulshada danyarta ah iyo kuwa nugul ee baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba. Munaasabadda saxiixa heshiiskan oo ay goobjoog ka ahaayeen Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Dowladda Qatar iyo mas’uuliyiin kale, waxaa dhanka dowladda Soomaaliya ku matalayay Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada, Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan, kaasi oo isna dhankiisa aad uga mahadceliyay dowladda Qatar iyo hay’addaba taageerada joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan yihiin waaxda caafimaadka dalka, gaar ahaan xilli ay hoos u dhacday maalgelintii dibadda. Ugu dambeyntii, madaxda Qatar Charity ayaa xustay in iskaashigani uu qeyb ka yahay taageerada bini’aadanimo iyo midda horumarineed ee ay dowladda Qatar had iyo goor u fidinayso shacabka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo barnaamijyadan caafimaad ay si weyn gacan uga geysan doonaan dhimista dhimashada hooyooyinka iyo carruurta iyo kor u qaadista tayada nolosha ee bulshada dhexdeeda.

items.title: Goobaha ganacsiga magaalada Boosaaso oo maanta xiran
items.description: Boosaaso (Raxanreeb Online) Goobaha ganacsiga magaalada Boosaaso ee xarunta ganacsiga Puntland ayaa saaka xiran, taas oo ay sababtay dekedda oo xiran maalintii 11-aad. Ganacsatada ayaa ka biyo diiday khidmad cusub oo ay soo rogtay shirkadda maamusha dekedda magaalada Boosaaso ee DP World, taas oo keentay in maaanta in albaabada la isugu dhufto xarumaha ganacsiga. Shacabka ku nool deegaannada Puntland, ayay saameyn ku yeelatay xirnaanshaha dekedda Boosaaso, iyada oo maalmihii u dambayay ay kor u kacday maciishadda daruuriga ah. Dowladda uu hoggaamiyo hoggaamiye Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa weli ka hadlin muddada ka badan tobanka berri ee xiran tahay dekedda Boosaaso, taas oo keentay in uu istaago ganacsiga deegaanada mamaulka Puntland.
