items.title: Wasiir Fiqi iyo Taliyaha CXD oo laba arrimood u tegay Degmada Ceeldheer (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga Somaliya, Axmed Macalin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta safar dhinaca dhulka ah ku tegay Degmada Ceeldheer ee Gobolka Galgaduud. Booqashadoodan ayaa la xiriirta xoojinta mooralka ciidamada ee dagaalka kula jira maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo dib u soo celinta adeegyadii bulshada ee degmadaasi. “Wasiirka iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa u kuurgalay xaaladda ciidamada iyo hawlgalada ka socda jiidaha hore, iyagoo bogaadiyay geesinimada, naf-hurnimada iyo dadaalka ay ciidamada ugu jiraan difaaca dalka iyo ciribtirka kooxaha argagixisada.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga oo intaa ku daray “Booqashadan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada ay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay kor ugu qaadayaan niyadda ciidamada, isla-markaana lagu dardargelinayo gulufka lagu xoreynayo deegaanada ay weli ku dhuumaaleysanayaan kooxaha argagixisada.” Wasiir Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo xubno ka tirsan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa kormeeray Xarunta Maamulka Degmada Ceeldheer. Masuuliyiinta ayaa sidoo kale kormeeray goobta loogu talagalay inay dadkii deegaanka ee isku diiwaangeliyay Doorashooyinka Galmudug ay ka qaataan kaarka codbixinta. Masuuliyiintan oo la kulmay maamulka degmadaasi iyo odayaasha deegaanka qaarkood ayaa ugu baaqay inay dadka deegaanka ku jiheeyaan inay si mug leh uga qayb qaataan maalinta codbixinta ee Doorashooyinka Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka iyo Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Galmudug ee la qabanayo 25-ka bishan. Ceeldheer ayaa waxay ka mid tahay 11 magaalo oo Galmudug ah oo lagu wado in laga qabto doorasho qof iyo cod ah, taas oo noqoneyso doorashadii ugu horreysay ee toos ah ee ku dhawaad 58 sano ka dib laga qabto bartamaha dalka.

items.title: Siyaasiyiinta Somaliland, Ma Somaliland-buu xil ka saaranyahay mise dalal kale buu xil ka saran yahay?
items.description: Qaranimada Somaliland waxay buuxisay in ka badan toban mabda’ iyo shuruuc oo caalami ah oo la xidhiidha jiritaanka dawladnimo. Iyado sida tahay waxa jira dalal diidan (kaliya aan icitiraaf ku diidanayn) in Somaliland loo aqoonsado dal, inkasta oo ay buuxisay shuruudahaas. Haddaba, su’aasha hortaalla siyaasiyiinta Somaliland waa: Kee baa xil idinka saaran inaad ka shaqaysaan? – Shuruucda iyo mabaadi’da caalamiga ah ee Somaliland iyado buuxisay lo diiddan yahay inay dal noqoto ? – Mise shuruucda iyo arrimaha caalamiga ah ee khuseeya dalal kale? Maxay tahay Mawqifka kala duwan ee laga kala qabo dalalka diidan Shuruucda Somaliland buuxisay iyo dal kale shuruucdiisa u khaska arimo ku xidhan ?! List ka Shuruucda iyo Mabaadida caalamiga ee Somaliland buuxisay :- 1- Prior Sovereignty 2- Right to Self-Determination 3- Montevideo Convention Criteria for Statehood (1933) 4- Uti Possidetis Juris 5- Declaratory Theory of Statehood 6- Effectiveness Doctrine (Effective Government) 7- State Continuity (Restoration of Statehood) 8- Recognition of States (Customary International Law) 9- Territorial Integrity 10- UN Charter (Articles 1 & 2)     G. Guntigaab

items.title: Safiirka Midowga Yurub oo macasalaameynaysa Soomaaliya kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa kulan sagootin ah la yeeshay Safiirka Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya, Marwo Francesca Di Mauro oo soo gaba-gabeysay muddo-xileedkeedii diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka. Kulanka ayaa ku soo beegmay dhammaadka shaqadii Safiirka ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo wasiirka ay booqasho sagootin ah ugu timid ka hor inta aysan macasaalameyn magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda Soomaaliya. Wasiir Cabdisalaan ayaa ku ammaanay Safiirka doorkii ay ka qaadatay xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub, iyo dadaalladii ay ku bixisay horumarinta iskaashiga labada dhinac muddadii ay xilka haysay. Sidoo kale, wasiirka ayaa ugu hambalyeeyay Francesca Di Mauro magacaabisteeda cusub ee Agaasimaha Arrimaha Afrika ee Adeegga Hawlaha Dibadda ee Midowga Yurub (EEAS), isaga oo u rajeeyay guul iyo horumar ay ka gaarto xilkaas. Dhankiisa, wasiirku wuxuu uga mahadceliyay Midowga Yurub taageerada joogtada ah ee uu siiyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada horumarinta, amniga iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay xiriirka u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub, iyagoo muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga iyo wada-shaqeynta mustaqbalka. Gaba-gabadii, Wasiir Cabdisalaan ayaa Safiirka uga mahadceliyay muddadii ay ka soo shaqeysay Soomaaliya, wuxuuna u rajeeyay inay guulo ka soo hoyso mas’uuliyadda cusub ee loo igmaday, isaga oo xusay in Soomaaliya ay sii xoojin doonto xiriirka ay la leedahay Midowga Yurub. items.title: Cumar Cabdirashiid ma noqonayaa ra’iisul wasaare haddii heshiis la gaaro?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya Cumar Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo inuu u tartamo xilka madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, isaga oo meesha ka saaray inuu mar kale ra’iisul wasaare noqdo haddii ay dhacdo in la galo heshiis siyaasadeed ama xal laga gaaro khilaafaadka hadda taagan. Cumar Cabdirashiid, oo wareysi siiyey barnaamijka Mizan Podcast, ayaa sheegay inuu laba jeer hore u soo qabtay xilka ra’iisul wasaaraha, xilliyo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo adag oo dalka uu ku jiray marxalado siyaasadeed oo culus. “Xilka ra’iisul wasaaraha xirfad ma aha,” ayuu yiri Cumar Cabdirashiid. “Haddii qofkii mar kasta la soo celceliyo, markaas xirfad ayuu noqonayaa.” Hadalka Cumar Cabdirashiid ayaa imanaya xilli siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay gashay marxalad cusub oo xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan ka dib muranka ka dhashay hannaanka doorashooyinka, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka iyo khilaafka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. Sharmaarke ayaa wareysiga lagu weydiiyey haddii uu daneynayo inuu mar kale noqdo ra’iisul wasaare, haddii ay timaado xaalad siyaasadeed oo u baahan in la dhiso dowlad cusub ama xal laga gaaro khilaafka jira. Wuxuu sheegay inuusan arrintaas cidna kala hadlin, islamarkaana uusan raadin xilkaas. Wuxuu intaas ku daray inuu aaminsan yahay inuu intii uu awoodi karay ka qabtay xilka ra’iisul wasaaraha, islamarkaana haddii uu weli door ku leeyahay siyaasadda dalka, ay tahay inuu ka raadiyo dhinaca madaxtooyada. “Haddii wax iga harsan yihiin, waa inaan kursigaas u tartamo,” ayuu yiri, isagoo ula jeeday xilka madaxweynaha. “Kursigaas ayaan u tartamayaa.” Cumar Cabdirashiid ayaa laba jeer soo noqday ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya. Markii ugu horreysay wuxuu xilka qabtay sanadihii 2009 illaa 2010, xilligii dowladdii ku-meel-gaarka ahayd ee uu hoggaaminayey madaxweyne Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Markii labaadna wuxuu xilka qabtay dhammaadkii 2014 illaa 2017, xilligii dowladdii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee muddo-xileedkiisii koowaad. Labadaas marxaladoodba waxay ahaayeen xilliyo siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay ku jirtay kala-guur, iyadoo dowlad-dhiska federaalka, amniga, xiriirka maamul-goboleedyada iyo hannaanka doorashooyinka ay ahaayeen arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee horyaallay xukuumadaha dalka. Sharmaarke ayaa sheegay in qofka siyaasiga ah uu xitaa isagoo aan xil hayn ka qeyb qaadan karo xal u raadinta khilaafaadka dalka. Wuxuu ku adkeystay in xalinta murannada siyaasadeed aysan khasab ka dhigeyn inuu qofka dib ugu laabto xil uu hore u soo qabtay. Hadalkiisa ayaa u muuqda mid uu ku kala saarayo laba arrimood: inuu weli diyaar u yahay door siyaasadeed oo heer qaran ah, balse uusan daneynayn xilka ra’iisul wasaaraha oo uu sheegay inuu hore uga soo shaqeeyay. Shaacinta damaciisa madaxweynenimo waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli ay Soomaaliya wajaheyso hubanti la’aan siyaasadeed, muran la xiriira doorashooyinka soo socda iyo dood xooggan oo ka taagan qaabka awoodda dalka loo maamulayo. Inkasta oo uusan faahfaahin ka bixin barnaamijkiisa siyaasadeed, hadalka Cumar Cabdirashiid ayaa durba gelinaya safka siyaasiyiinta waaweyn ee laga yaabo inay door muuqda ka ciyaaraan loollanka hoggaanka Soomaaliya ee soo socda. items.title: Puntland oo si adag u diiday in Turkiga uu soo gaaro xeebaheeda kadib heshiiska DF
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland ayaa si adag uga horyimid in Turkiga uu xeebaheeda ka fuliyo howl-gallo la xiriira ilaalinta xeebaha iyo kalluumeysiga, xilli dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay gaareen heshiis la xiriira arrintaan. War-saxaafadeedka kasoo baxay maamulka ayaa lagu sheegay in Puntland ay dastuur ahaan iyo sharci ahaan u leedahay awoodda maamulka, ilaalinta, sahaminta iyo ka faa’iysiga dhammaan kheyraadka ku jira dhulkeeda iyo baddeeda. Waxay xustay in xeebaha Puntland oo dhererkoodu gaarayo ku dhowaad 1,600KM, kuna teedsan Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay yihiin hanti uu leeyahay shacabka Puntland. Maamulka ayaa si gaar ah u sheegtay inaysan oggolaan doonin in shirkadda laga leeyahay Turkiga ee SOMTURK ay ka fuliso xeebaheeda wax howlgallo ah oo la xiriira kalluumeysiga, ilaalada xeebaha ama adeegyo kale, iyadoo aan oggolaansho ka helin hay’adaha awoodda u leh ee Puntland. Waxay intaas ku dartay in go’aankan uu ku saleysan yahay qodobbada dastuurka federaalka KMG ah iyo dastuurka Puntland, kuwaas oo qeexaya in maamulka iyo ka faa’iysiga kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ay u baahan yihiin wadatashi iyo heshiis dhex mara Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, Puntland ayaa ku doodday in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya aysan sharci ahaan u lahayn inay bixiso rukhsado ama heshiisyo maalgashi oo khuseeya dhulkeeda ama baddeeda, iyadoo aan marka hore heshiis iyo wadatashi la yeelan maamulka Puntland. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo Puntland ku tilmaamtay in muddo-xileedkoodii sharciyeed uu dhammaaday, aysan lahayn awood ay heshiisyo ula galaan shirkado gudaha ama dibadda ah oo khuseeya kheyraadka ku jira deegaannada Puntland. Puntland ayaa farriin u dirtay beesha caalamka, dowladaha saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, iyadoo ku adkeysatay inaysan aqbali doonin wax faragelin ah oo lagu sameeyo xeebaha ku teedsan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya, haddii aan oggolaansho rasmi ah laga helin maamulka Puntland. Ugu dambeyntiina, maamulka Puntland ayaa ku hanjabay inuu tallaabo ka qaadi doono isku day kasta oo lagu fulinayo howlgallo ama lagu faragelinayo xeebaheeda iyadoo aan oggolaansho laga haysan, waxayna sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay ka hortagi doonaan ficil kasta oo ay ku tilmaamtay mid baal marsan sharciga iyo dastuurka. Go’aanka Puntland ayaa imanaya xilli uu meel sare marayo khilaafka kala dhexeeya dowladda dhexe, ayna geesta kale Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay leeyihiin heshiisyo dhinacyada difaaca iyo maalgashiga ah oo ay qeyb ka yihiin arrimaha la xiriira badaha Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Turkiga ayaa haatan wada dhismaha xarun hawada sare ah oo Soomaaliya laga hirgelinayo. items.title: Colaad nolol xumo galisay kumanaan qoys oo ku barakacay Shabeellaha hoose
items.description: (ERGO)– Kaltuumo Faarah Cusmaan, iyada iyo carruurteeda oo shan ah waxay duruufo is-biirsaday ku wajahayaan deegaanka Buufow-bacaad oo ay tageen 15 bishii May, iyagoo faro maran. Qoyskeeda ayaa ka soo barakacay dagaal u dhexeeya labo maleeshiyo beeleed, kaasi oo salka ku haya muranka dhul beereed ku yaalla deegaanka Beder ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Haweenaydan ayaa tilmaamtay inay ka fursan wayday inay albaabada u garaacdo dadka tuulada ay soo miciin bidden oo danyar ah. iyada oo waydiisanaysa inay raashin bisil siiyaan.  Marka ay soo wayso ayay xustay inay ku qasbanaadaan inay qatooyo ku joogaan. “Xaaladeena nololeed aad iyo aad ayay u liidataa. Waa iska rafaadsanahay wax la cunaayo meeshan ma yaalaan waala baahanyahay. 5 caruur agoon ah ayaan meeshaan ku heystaa. Wallaahii raashiin mar waala helaa mar waala waayaa. Hadda saan wax aan siiyo ma haayo inaan sidooda ku seexiyo ma ahane.” Haweeneydan ayaa keli ku ah maaraynta nolosheeda iyo midda carruurteeda oo ah yaryar aan ku kabi soo dhicinta biilka reerka. Saygeedii ayay xustay inuu cudurka macaanka u dhintay 2024. Wixii intaas ka dambeyay waxay keli ku ahayd. Kaltuumo ayaa intaas ku dartay inay xanuun ku hayso nolosha qoyska gaar ahaan xilligan oo ay ku jiraan xaalad hubanti la’aan ah. Gasiin xumada waxaa u dheer inaysan haysan gabbaad awood u leh inuu ka celiyo qorraxda iyo roobka xagaaga oo gobolka ka da’aya. Hoy xumada ayay xustay inay si gaar ah u saamaysay carruurteeda oo la qabsan la’ xaaladdan oo cusub.  “Meel ay ku hoydaan ma heysti. Maryahan ayaa meeshaan ku xirxirtay hadda roob haduu yimaado meel aan dhaxanta uga ilaaliyo ma haayo. Wallaahi xanuun saa’id dareemaa. Habeenkii ma hurdo.  Ma harsado. Fekerfaceyga uma eki. Waan dhibbanahay.” Kaltuumo ayaa sheegtay inay ka soo tageen guri ka kooban saddex qol, suuli iyo jiko oo ay ku lahaayeen tuulada Beder oo kaabiga ku heysa deegaanka Janaale. Waxay xustay inaysan waxba ka soo qaadan balse ay naftooda kala soo baxsadeen, markii maleeshiyo ay ku amartay inay banneeyaan gurigooda oo saaran beeraha Garshiine ee la isku haysto lahaanshahooda. Waxay sidoo kale ka soo tagtay 8 neef oo ari ah oo ay dheefsan jireen cadkooda iyo caanahooda. Qoyska kaltuumo ayaa la qabsan la’ nolosha barakaca maaddaama ay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee ay dibad joog ka noqdaan tuuladoodii. Kaltuumo ayaa xustay inay isku dayday marar badan inay shaqo ka raadiso deegaanka Shalaambood iyo magaalada Marka balse ay weysay cid ay u shaqeyso sabab la xiriirra deegaanka oo aysan aqoon u lahayn iyo fursadaha ka jira oo yar. Kaltuumo ayaa tilmaamtay inay ka waxbarasho beeleen saddex kamid ah carruurteeda oo dhiganayay dugsi Qur’aan. Waxay tilmaamtay in dugsigii tuuladoodii ay macalinka bishii siin jirtay hadba wixii ay u garato maaddaama uu yaqaannay.  Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay in soo gaarida deegaanka Buufow-bacaad ay ku qaadatay socod 11 saacadood ah maaddaama ay wayday dhaqaale ay gaadiid ugu kirayso ubadkeeda. Sida maamulka deegaanka aan ka soo xiganay tan horraantii May in ka badan kontan qoys ayaa barakac ku yimid kuwaas oo wajahaya xuno xumo, biyo yari iyo hoy la’aan. Waxaa ka mid ah qoyska Daahir Cabdi shakuur xuseen. Ninkan ayaa reerkiisa  oo 7 qof ah u awoodi la’yahay cunno, biyo iyo hoy ay gabaadsadaan. Xaaladan adag ayay wajahayaan tan iyo dhamaadkii bishii May oo uu ka soo barakacay tuulada Beder. Noloshooda ayaa ku tiirsan dawarsi ay dantu bidday. Wuxuu aroor walba u lugeeyaa magaalada Marka oo deegaanka u jirta qiyaastii 5 km. Wuxuu sheegay inuu kilo bariis uu soo helo, taas oo ay labo maalin tashiishaan. Wuxuu sheegay inay isku raacday gaajo iyo haraad ku haysta deegaankii ay u soo nolol doonteen. Ninkan ayaa sheegay in qiimaha biyaha deegaanka jirgaankii uu yahay $0.2, aysanna awoodin inay shubtaan dhaqaale xumada haysa awgeed. “Mararka qaar waaba la qadaa. wax la haayo malahan, dadka iyagaa wax heysanba. Culeysada noogu daran waa hoy la’aan. Baco ma heysano roob haduu yimaado.  biyaha horta $.20 waaye anagana ma awoodno nadiif maaha ilmahana way ku xanuusadaan.” Daahir ayaa xusay in noloshooda Beder ay ku tiirsanayd beeraha aseendooyinka oo uu caws ka fali jiray. Wuxuu tilmaamay in maalinkii uu ka helayay $4. Waxaa dugsi Qur’aan u dhiganayay 5 carruur ah, kuwaas oo uu bishii ka bixin jiray wadartooda $10. Ninkan ayaa tilmaamay in aysan marna ku tashanaynin inay guryahooda dibad yaal ka noqdaan. Wuxuu intaas raaciyay in xilli habeen ah mid kamid ah dhinacyada is haya ay u sheegeen inay guuraan. “Dagaal dhul beereed ka bilowday ayaan ka soo guurnay. Waxaa nalagu yiri meeshan ka taga noloshiina haDdii aad nabad u rabtaan. Annaga dad hubeysan manihi dad shacab ayaan iska ahayn meeshaasaa ka xamaalan jirnay guura ayaa nala dhahay sidii ayaana usoo qaxnay.” Daahir ayaa sanadkan isku diyaarinayay inuu dalagyo kala duwan uu saaro beer 5 hektar ah dhaxal ah balse maanta wuxuu doorbidday barakac inuu noqdo. Ninkan ayaa nolosha ka jooga quus. Dadka ay soo sal-kicisay colaadda ayaa ka siman hubanti la’aanta. Faadumo Cumar Xaaji oo ah hooyo lixdan jir ah iyada iyo qoyskeeda oo 6 ah waxay dulsaar ku yihiin qoys degan deegaanka Buufoo-bacaad.  Noloshooda ayaa ku tiirsan xaabo ay gabadheeda u doonto dhul kaymeed deegaanka ka baxsan. Waxay sheegtay in maalinkii ay ka soo hesho $0.5 oo aan ku goyn karin quud ku filan.   Saygeedii ayay tilmaamtay inay kala tageen isla markaana uusan ku daryeelin carruurta. Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in labo sanno ay madaxa ka xanuusaneyso. Waxay wayday dhaqaale ay dhakhtar ku tagto. “Jirro ayaa sidaan iyeeshay. Madaxaaan ayaan ka jiranahay. Madaxeyga wuu lulanayaa. Carafadan  carafadeedii ayaan isku arkay. Madaxa waxaana ku dhacay ma dhihi karo. habeen iyo maalin dhegteyda waxaa ka qeylinayo waxa ay yihiin ma ogi.” Inta aysan barakaca noqon noloshooda ayaa ku tiirsanayd caano ay ganacsato ugu iibin jirtay deegaanka Jannaale oo tuuladeedii u jira qiyaaskii 3 km. Waxaa maalinkii ka soo geli jiray saddex ilaa afar dollar oo ku filnayd. Waxay sidoo kale ka soo tageen beer labo haktar ah oo ay la tacban wayda colaadda markii laga aasasay kannaaladii u waraabin jiray. Qoysaskan  oo sanadkan isku diyaarinayay inay beerahooda tacbadaan si ay uga soo kabtaan biyo yari sanadihii la soo dhaafay saamaysay wax soo saarkooda ayaa hadda waxay galeen xaalad adag markii colaadda ay ceel ku riday hankoodii nolosha. items.title: Mogadishu and Puntland Clash Over Federal Troop Recruitment Powers
items.description: Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has issued one of his strongest statements yet on relations between the Federal Government and Puntland, saying there is currently no formal cooperation between the two sides beyond Puntland’s status as part of the Somali Republic. “Except for the fact that they are part of the Republic, today there is nothing between the Federal Government and Puntland,” President Hassan Sheikh said. The remarks underscore the deepening political dispute between the Federal Government and Puntland, which has escalated in recent months over constitutional changes, the electoral process and the division of powers between Mogadishu and federal member states. The latest disagreement centres on whether the Federal Government has the authority to deploy or recruit soldiers in areas under Puntland’s administration. Puntland has previously said it would reject what it describes as interference in its internal security affairs, accusing the Federal Government of attempting to destabilise the regional administration. Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, however, has maintained that the Federal Government is responsible for all national army personnel in Puntland and has the authority to recruit soldiers wherever needed. “We represent that young man, and we are the government in charge. It is our duty to provide his rights, whether you accept it or reject it. You may speak about one thousand; we are recruiting 30,000 and we will give them their rights. Do whatever you want,” Prime Minister Barre said. Barre also accused Puntland of obstructing federal government projects in the region, including road construction and the recruitment of teachers. The dispute reflects the wider breakdown in relations between Mogadishu and Garowe, with no immediate signs that the two sides are moving toward restoring formal cooperation. items.title: Khubarada Daryeelka Timaha oo Daaha Ka Rogay Sababaha Timaha u Kala Daataan Marka Hurdada Laga Soo Kaco
items.description: Daryeelka Saxda ah ee Timaha Habeenkii oo Door Muhiim ah Ka Qaata Ilaalinta Quruxda iyo Caafimaadka Timaha Muqdisho – Timaha oo kala daata ama isku dhex yaaca marka hurdada laga soo kaco waa xaalad ay la kulmaan dad badan, gaar ahaan dadka leh timo dhaadheer, qalloocan ama jilicsan. Inkastoo arrintan mararka qaar loo arko mid caadi ah ama lagu kaftamo baraha bulshada, khubarada daryeelka timaha ayaa sheegaya in ay jiraan sababo cilmiyeed oo keenaya isbeddelkan. Khubaradu waxay tilmaamayaan in barkimaha caadiga ah ee suufka laga sameeyo ay abuuraan khilaaf badan oo timaha saameeya, taas oo sababta in timuhu isku dhex yaacaan, jabaan ama lumiyaan qaabkoodii dabiiciga ahaa. Waxaa sidoo kale saameyn weyn leh timaha oo qoyan marka la seexanayo iyo qaabka qofku u jiifsado inta uu hurdo. Mowduucan ayaa si weyn loogu hadal hayaa baraha bulshada, halkaas oo dadka isticmaala ay timaha hurdada ka dib ugu bixiyaan magacyo kaftan ah. Qaar waxay ugu yeeraan “Baalasha Digaaga” , marka timuhu dhinac kasta u kala firdhaan, halka kuwo kalena ay ugu yeeraan “Buurta Sare” , marka timuhu kor uga soo taagnaadaan madaxa. Waxaa kale oo jira naanaysyo ay bulshada isticmaasho sida “Xayndaabka Isku Dhex Yaacsan” iyo “Ubax Furmay” , balse khubaradu waxay caddeeyeen in magacyadani yihiin kuwo madadaalo ah oo aan lahayn saldhig cilmiyeed. Si looga hortago in timuhu kala daataan ama dhaawacmaan inta lagu jiro hurdada, khubaradu waxay ku talinayaan in la isticmaalo barkimooyinka silk ama satin , kuwaas oo yareeya isku dhaca timaha. Waxa kale oo lagu boorriyay dadka inay xirtaan silk bonnet ama maro satin ah, isla markaana aysan ku seexan timaha oo qoyan. Intaa waxaa dheer, xirashada timaha qaab dabacsan iyo isticmaalka saliidaha ama serum-ka timaha ayaa lagu sheegay inay ka caawiyaan ilaalinta qoyaanka, yareynta jabka timaha iyo ilaalinta muuqaalka caafimaadka leh. Inkastoo timaha kala daata marka hurdada laga soo kaco ay noqdaan arrin lagu qoslo ama lagu wadaago baraha bulshada, khubaradu waxay ku boorinayaan bulshada in ay muhiimad siiyaan daryeelka timaha, maadaama tallaabooyin fudud ay wax weyn ka tari karaan caafimaadka iyo quruxda timaha. Masuuliyiinta ayaa kulamo la qaatay saraakiisha hoggaaminaysa ciidamada ku sugan aagga, kuwaas oo warbixin faahfaahsan ka bixiyay xaaladda amniga, guulaha laga gaaray howl-gallada socda iyo baahiyaha ay ciidamada qabaan si loo sii dardargeliyo howlgallada. Masuuliyiinta ayaa bogaadiyay geesinimada, naf-hurnimada iyo adkeysiga ay muujiyeen ciidamada, iyagoo ku dhiirrigeliyay inay sii laba jibbaaraan dadaalkooda ku aaddan ciribtirka kooxda Al-Shabaab iyo xaqiijinta amniga shacabka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo Bilowday Qorshe Ballaaran oo Looga Hortagayo Fatahaadaha
items.description: Wasaaradda Gargaarka iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda oo Isku Dubbariday Diyaargarowga Xilli Roobaadka Muqdisho – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay bilowday qorshe qaran oo lagu xoojinayo u diyaar garowga fatahaadaha la filayo xilliga roobaadka, iyadoo la dardargelinayo gurmadka degdegga ah iyo taageerada la gaarsiinayo bulshada nugul. Mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda oo booqasho ku tegay Wasaaradda Gargaarka iyo Maareynta Musiibooyinka ayaa sheegay inuu aad ugu faraxsan yahay shaqada ay wasaaraddu qabatay, isagoo ammaanay hoggaanka wasiirka, maamulka wasaaradda iyo kooxda farsamada (Technical Team) ee ka shaqeynaysa qorsheynta iyo ka hortagga musiibooyinka. Mas’uulka ayaa xusay in Soomaaliya ay soo martay xaalado adag oo isugu jiray abaaro iyo fatahaado, isla markaana saadaasha roobabka sanadkan ay muujinayso in meelaha qaar ay wajihi karaan daadad ka xooggan kuwii hore. Wuxuu tilmaamay in magaalooyin iyo deegaanno badan ay u baahan yihiin feejignaan iyo diyaargarow degdeg ah. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in qorshaha cusub uu diiradda saarayo yareynta khasaaraha ka dhalan kara fatahaadaha, diyaarinta agabka gurmadka, iyo gaarsiinta gargaar degdeg ah dadka ugu nugul ee ku nool goobaha halista badan. Sidoo kale waxaa la sheegay in gargaar iyo sahay horudhac ah loo qaybiyey degmooyin kala duwan si loo taageero qoysaska danyarta ah, loona hubiyo in dadka ay saamayntu gaarto ay helaan kaalmo waqtigeeda ku habboon. Qorshahan waxaa si wadajir ah uga shaqeynaya Wasaaradda Gargaarka iyo Maareynta Musiibooyinka, wasaarado kale oo dowladda ka tirsan, kooxaha farsamada, iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ka taageera ka hortagga iyo maareynta musiibooyinka. Mas’uulka ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in dowladda ay sii xoojin doonto iskaashiga ay la leedahay hay’adaha samafalka iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah si gargaar degdeg ah loo gaarsiiyo bulshada ku nool goobaha ay fatahaaduhu khatarta ku yihiin, isla markaana loo ilaaliyo nafaha iyo hantida shacabka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Puntland oo si adag uga hortimid heshiisyada kalluumaysiga ee dowladda federaalka
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Maamulka Puntland ayaa si adag uga horyimid heshiisyo la xiriira kalluumaysiga oo ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya la gashay shirkado shisheeye, isagoo sheegay in heshiisyadaasi aysan sharci ka noqon karin deegaannada Puntland. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Kalluumaysiga Puntland, ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladda federaalka aysan kaligeed go’aan uga gaari karin kheyraadka badda, isla markaana ay lagama maarmaan tahay in dowlad-goboleedyada lagala tashado heshiis kasta oo saameynaya khayraadka dabiiciga ah. Puntland waxay sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto ilaalinta xeebaha iyo kheyraadka badda, isla markaana aysan oggolaan doonin maraakiib ama shirkado ku shaqeynaya heshiisyo aysan maamulkaasi qayb ka ahayn. Waxay sidoo kale uga digtay shirkadaha shisheeye inay ka fogaadaan hawlgal kasta oo aan fasax ka haysan maamulka Puntland. Dhinaca kale, Dowladda Federaalka ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin eedeymaha iyo diidmada ay Puntland ka muujisay heshiisyadan. Arrintan ayaa sii xoojisay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac, kaas oo muddooyinkii dambe saameyn ku yeeshay wada-shaqeynta arrimaha amniga, dastuurka iyo maamulka kheyraadka dalka. Sidoo kale Khubarada siyaasadda ayaa aaminsan in murankan uu saameyn ku yeelan karo horumarinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah iyo dadaallada lagu doonayo in si hufan looga faa’iidaysto kheyraadka badda Soomaaliya, haddii aan xal wadahadal ku dhisan laga gaarin. items.title: 15 Heshiis Caalami ah oo Soomaaliya Hal Mar Ku Diiwaangelisay Arrimaha Badaha
items.description: Soomaaliya oo Guul Taariikhi ah Ka Gaartay Heshiisyada Caalamiga ah ee Arrimaha Badaha Muqdisho – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa gaartay guul muhiim ah oo dhanka horumarinta iyo dib-u-soo-celinta doorka dalka ee arrimaha badaha caalamka, kaddib safar shaqo oo heer sare ah oo lagu tegay magaalada London iyo Istanbul. Mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda Gaadiidka ayaa sheegay in intii lagu guda jiray safarkaas lagu guuleystay in Soomaaliya dib loogu diiwaangeliyo 15 heshiis oo caalami ah oo la xiriira badaha iyo gaadiidka badda. Tani waxay noqotay markii ugu horreysay ee taariikhda dalka hal mar lagu diiwaangeliyo heshiisyo intaas le’eg oo heer caalami ah. Tallaabadan ayaa lagu tilmaamay mid sare u qaadaysa sumcadda Soomaaliya ee hay’adaha caalamiga ah, isla markaana xoojinaysa ka qaybgalka dalka ee nidaamyada iyo heshiisyada muhiimka u ah amniga iyo horumarinta badaha. Intii uu safarku socday, wafdiga Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale ka qayb galay shir caalami ah oo ka dhacay Istanbul, halkaas oo ay kulamo miro-dhal ah la yeesheen hay’ado iyo daneeyayaal caalami ah. Kulamadaas ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga badda, badqabka maraakiibta, horumarinta dekedaha, iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen in Soomaaliya, oo leh xeebta ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika, ay leedahay fursado waaweyn oo dhinaca kalluumeysiga, gaadiidka badda, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Waxay sidoo kale xuseen muhiimadda ay leedahay in dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed loo abuuro fursado waxbarasho iyo xirfado la xiriira cilmiga badaha si ay uga faa’iideystaan khayraadka ballaaran ee dalka. Guushan cusub ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ugu sii dhawaaneyso dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha dowladda, xoojinta xiriirka caalamiga ah, iyo ka faa’iideysiga awoodda dhaqaale ee badaha dalka. The post 15 Heshiis Caalami ah oo Soomaaliya Hal Mar Ku Diiwaangelisay Arrimaha Badaha first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo ku hanjabay inay weerari doonaan Sacuudiga
items.description: Xudeyda ( Raxanreeb Online) Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay ka hortageen diyaarado dagaal oo Sacuudi ah oo ay ku eedeeyeen inay isku dayayeen inay hor istaagaan diyaarad rayid ah oo laga leeyahay Iran inay ka degto Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Sanca. Afhayeenka milateriga ee Xuutiyiinta, Yaxya Saree, ayaa uga digay in haddii Sacuudiga uu sii wado waxa uu ku tilmaamay “ku xadgudubka hawada Yemen”, kooxdu ay beegsan doonto “garoomada diyaaradaha ee Sacuudiga iyo goobo muhiim ah oo dhulka iyo baddaba ku yaalla.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in duullimaadyada u dhexeeya Sanca iyo Tehran ay sii socon doonaan, inkastoo uu sheegay inay jiraan “cawaaqib suurtagal ah.” Telefishinka Al-Masirah, oo xiriir la leh Xuutiyiinta, ayaa baahiyay in diyaarad laga leeyahay Iran ay Jimcihii gaartay magaalada Sanca, iyadoo sida wafdi rasmi ah oo ka socday Xuutiyiinta kuna sii jeeday Tehran si ay uga qaybgalaan aaska hoggaamiyihii hore ee Iran, Cali Khamenei. Sida uu sheegay warbixinta telefishinka, diyaaradda waxaa sidoo kale saarnaa in ka badan 200 oo bukaan. Dhanka kale, isbahaysiga milatari ee uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa subaxnimadii Sabtida ka jawaabay hadallada Xuutiyiinta, isagoo sheegay in hadalladaasi ay yihiin isku day lagu marin habaabinayo dareenka lagana leexinayo falalka ay kooxdu ka hayso shacabka Yemen. Isbahaysigu wuxuu ka digay in isku day kasta oo lagu beegsado Sacuudi Carabiya ama lagu xadgudbo madaxbannaanida qaranka Yemen looga jawaabi doono “awood xooggan oo aan kala go’ lahayn.” Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa hoggaaminaysay isbahaysi milatari oo ka dagaallamaya Yemen tan iyo sannadkii 2015, kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta, oo ay Iran taageerto, ay la wareegeen caasimadda Yemen ee Sanca. The post Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo ku hanjabay inay weerari doonaan Sacuudiga appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Dekedda Muqdisho oo Xoojinaysa Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah si Loo Casriyeeyo Adeegyada Dekedaha
items.description: Maamulka Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa wada dadaallo lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga caalamiga ah, kaddib booqasho uu Agaasimaha Guud ee Dekedda Muqdisho, Maxamed Cali Nuur, ku tagay Dekedda Seattle ee dalka Mareykanka. Booqashada oo lagu casuumay guddiga maamula Dekedda Seattle ayaa waxaa qeyb ka ahaa kulamo uu Agaasimuhu la yeeshay xubno ka tirsan guddiga dekedda, oo ay ku jiraan Hamdi Maxamed oo ah mas’uul Soomaali-Mareykan ah iyo Sam Cho. Kulamada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga labada dekedood, iyadoo maamulka Dekedda Muqdisho uu soo bandhigay isbeddellada iyo horumarrada lagu sameeyay howlaha dekedda, adeegyada iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha si loo daboolo kobaca ganacsiga Soomaaliya. Dhankooda, mas’uuliyiinta Dekedda Seattle ayaa la wadaagay waayo-aragnimadooda ku aaddan maamulka dekedaha casriga ah, nidaamyada saadka, maamulka xamuulka, horumarinta shaqaalaha iyo adeegsiga farsamooyinka cusub. Gabagabadii kulanka, labada dhinac ayaa isku afgartay inay ka shaqeeyaan dhismaha iskaashi loo yaqaan “Sister Ports”, kaas oo ujeeddadiisu tahay is-weydaarsiga khibradaha farsamo, tababarrada shaqaalaha dekedaha iyo xoojinta iskaashiga hay’adaha labada dekedood. Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa ah halbowlaha ganacsiga Soomaaliya, iyadoo laga soo dejiyo lagana dhoofiyo inta badan badeecadaha dalka, oo ay ku jiraan raashiinka, shidaalka, qalabka dhismaha iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay dadaal xooggan ku bixisay casriyeynta kaabeyaasha badda iyo kor u qaadista hufnaanta dekedaha, iyadoo iskaashiyada caalamiga ah loo arko tallaabo muhiim u ah horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo kobcinta awoodda shaqaalaha. Iskaashiga la qorsheynayo ee u dhexeeya Dekedaha Muqdisho iyo Seattle ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya doorka sii kordhaya ee qurba-joogta Soomaaliyeed ee xiriirinta Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, iyagoo gacan ka geysanaya horumarinta iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo kan hay’adeed.

items.title: Dhiirrigelin iyo Qiimeyn Amni oo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigu ku sameeyay Ceeldheer
items.description: (Ceeldheer, 05/07/2026) – Waxaan maanta halkaan ku joognaa degmada Ceeldheer ee gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo uu kormeer shaqo ku yimid Wasiirka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Axmed Macalin Fiqi, oo ay wehelinayeen Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud iyo saraakiil kale oo sare. Markii aan halkaan soo gaarnay saacadihii hore ee subaxnimo, waxaan goob joog ka noqday kulamo dhowr ah oo u dhexeeyay mas’uuliyiinta iyo saraakiisha ciidamada. Jawaabta su’aashayda ahayd “maxaa keenay booqashadan degdegga ah?”, waxaan ka helay Wasiirka in ay tahay qiimeyn toos ah oo lagu sameynayo xaaladda amniga iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada, gaar ahaan deegaannada ay ciidamadu haatan hore ugu socdaan dagaalka. Suxufi ahaan, waxaan arkay sida mas’uuliyiintu si dhow ula hadleen saraakiisha degmada, waxayna ka dhageysteen warbixinno faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan hawlgalladii ugu dambeeyay. Mid ka mid ah saraakiisha oo aan la hadlay ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu ay horumar muujinayaan, balse ay jiraan baahiyo saad iyo qalab ah oo wali jira. Wasiir Fiqi markii uu hadlaya ciidamada farta ku haysay oo dhowr jeer ku celiyay: “Waxaan idinku bogaadinayaa geesinimadiinna, waxaanna idinku dhiirrigelinayaa inay sii laba jibaartaan dadaalkiinna.” Erayadaasi waxay dareen gaar ah ka buuxiyeen ciidamadii halkaa taagnaa, gaar ahaan kuwa safka hore. Dhanka kale, Taliyaha Ciidanka S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed ayaa xaqiijiyay in ciidamadu ay sii wadi doonaan howlgalladii, isagoona sheegay in kormeerkani uu yahay mid dhiirigelin weyn u ah ciidanka, waxaanu cadeeyey in muddo aan fogeyn la ciribtirayo cadowga. Halkaan joogga ah waxaan ku arkay ciidamo diyaar ah oo ku sugan meelaha muhiimka ah, dadweynaha degmada oo dhawraya mas’uuliyiinta iyagoo muujinaya sida ay ugu faraxsan yihiin dadaallada amniga. Dowladda ayaa caddaynaysa in ay sii wadi doonto howlgallada ilaa laga helo xasiloon buuxda. Suxufi ahaan, waxaan u arkayaa booqashadan mid muhiim ah oo timi xilli ay ciidamadu u baahan yihiin dhiirigelin, waxayna muujinaysaa sida dowladda ay uga go’an tahay sugidda amniga shacabka. Warbixino dheeri ah baan idinku soo gudbin doonaa hadduu jiro horumar cusub. The post Dhiirrigelin iyo Qiimeyn Amni oo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigu ku sameeyay Ceeldheer first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Fannaankii caanka ahaa Cabdullaahi Boqol oo ku geeriyooday Muqdisho
items.description: Alle ha u naxariistee, waxaa magaalada Muqdisho ku geeriyooday fannaankii caanka ahaa ee Soomaaliyeed Cabdullaahi Maxamuud Cabdulle, oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn ugu taqaanay magaca Cabdullaahi Boqol. Marxuumka ayaa ka mid ahaa fannaaniintii muddada dheer ka soo dhex muuqanayay fanka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo caan ku ahaa heesihiisa iyo doorkii uu ku lahaa kobcinta hidaha iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed. Ninkaan oo sanadyaddii lasoo dhaafay kunoolaa dalka Mareykanka ayaa billihii lasoo dhaafay ku sugnaa Muqdisho. Geeridiisa ayaa murugo gelisay bahda fanka, qoyskiisa, asxaabtiisa iyo kumannaan qof oo taageerayaashiisa ahaa. Illaa iyo hadda si rasmi ah looma shaacin sababta geeridiisa, hase yeeshee waxaa isa soo taraya farriimaha tacsida ah ee ay dirayaan mas’uuliyiin, fanaaniin iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Cabdullaahi Boqol ayaa lagu xusuusan doonaa kaalintii uu ku lahaa fanka Soomaaliyeed iyo raadkii uu ku reebay suugaanta iyo madadaalada dalka. Alle ha u naxariisto Cabdullaahi Maxamuud Cabdulle (Cabdullaahi Boqol), samir iyo iimaanna haka siiyo qoyskiisa, ehelkiisa, bahda fanka iyo dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee geeridiisa ka murugooday.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo ku hanjabay inay weerari doonaan Sacuudiga
items.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay ka hortageen “diyaarado dagaal oo Sacuudi ah” oo ay ku eedeeyeen inay isku dayayeen inay hor istaagaan diyaarad rayid ah oo laga leeyahay Iran inay ka degto Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Sanca. Afhayeenka milateriga ee Xuutiyiinta, Yaxya Saree, ayaa uga digay in haddii Sacuudiga uu sii wado waxa uu ku tilmaamay “ku xadgudubka hawada Yemen”, kooxdu ay beegsan doonto “garoomada diyaaradaha ee Sacuudiga iyo goobo muhiim ah oo dhulka iyo baddaba ku yaalla.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in duullimaadyada u dhexeeya Sanca iyo Tehran ay sii socon doonaan, inkastoo uu sheegay inay jiraan “cawaaqib suurtagal ah.” Telefishinka Al-Masirah, oo xiriir la leh Xuutiyiinta, ayaa baahiyay in diyaarad laga leeyahay Iran ay Jimcihii gaartay magaalada Sanca, iyadoo sida wafdi rasmi ah oo ka socday Xuutiyiinta kuna sii jeeday Tehran si ay uga qaybgalaan aaska hoggaamiyihii hore ee Iran, Cali Khamenei. Sida uu sheegay warbixinta telefishinka, diyaaradda waxaa sidoo kale saarnaa in ka badan 200 oo bukaan. Dhanka kale, isbahaysiga milatari ee uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa subaxnimadii Sabtida ka jawaabay hadallada Xuutiyiinta, isagoo sheegay in hadalladaasi ay yihiin isku day lagu marin habaabinayo dareenka lagana leexinayo falalka ay kooxdu ka hayso shacabka Yemen. Isbahaysigu wuxuu ka digay in isku day kasta oo lagu beegsado Sacuudi Carabiya ama lagu xadgudbo madaxbannaanida qaranka Yemen looga jawaabi doono “awood xooggan oo aan kala go’ lahayn.” Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa hoggaaminaysay isbahaysi milatari oo ka dagaallamaya Yemen tan iyo sannadkii 2015, kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta, oo ay Iran taageerto, ay la wareegeen caasimadda Yemen ee Sanca. Maxay yihin koxda Xuutiyiinta? Sanadkii 2000, Xuutiyiinta waxay Yemen ka bilaabeen kacdoonno dhowr ah oo ka dhan ah madaxweynihii muddada dheer xukunka hayay, Cali Cabdullaahi Saalax. Waxay dalbanayeen madax-bannaani dheeraad ah oo ay ka helaan xukunkiisa adag, gaar ahaan gobolka ay ku xoogan yihiin ee waqooyiga Yemen. Sanadkii 2011, kacdoonnadii shacabka ee loo yaqaanay “Guga Carabta” ayaa ku qasbay Madaxweyne Saalax inuu xukunka ku wareejiyo ku-xigeenkiisa, Cabdi-Rabbu Mansuur Haadi. Intii uu Haadi xukunka hayay, Xuutiyiinta waxay heshiis la galeen Saalax oo xilka laga tuuray iyo qaar ka mid ah ciidamada ammaanka ee weli daacadda u ahaa. Waxay la wareegeen gobolka Sa’da ee waqooyiga Yemen, ka dibna waxay qabsadeen caasimadda Sanca. Sanadkii 2015, fallaagada ayaa qabsaday inta badan galbeedka Yemen, taas oo ku qasabtay madaxweynihii inuu dalka ka baxsado. Sacuudi Carabiya oo deris la ah Yemen ayaa ka baqday in Xuutiyiintu la wareegaan dalka oo dhan, isla markaana Yemen ay u beddelaan goob ay wakiil uga noqdaan Iran oo ay Sacuudiga u aragto cadow. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa markaas sameysay isbahaysi ka kooban dalal Carbeed, waxayna si rasmi ah u gashay dagaalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sanado duqeymo cirka ah iyo dagaallo dhulka ah ka dib, Xuutiyiinta weli lagama saarin deegaannadii ay horey u haysteen. Xuutiyiinta ayaa waxa kordhiyeen awoodooda islamarkana waxay sameeyeen iska caabin. Xuutiga ayaa waxay weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku qaadeen dhowr jeer gudaha Sacuudiga. Xuutiyintu waxay ka soo unkameen ururradii ku jiray colaadda ka dhanka ahayd dowladdii Yemen, balse waxay asaal ahan ku aroorayeen madhabta Zayd oo ka mida madhabyada Shiicada. Kooxda Zayd waxay tariikh ahaan ku xiriirsamayaan kacaankii Zayid bin Cali Al-Xuseen bin Cali Bin Abii Daalib kuwaas oo ka soo jeeday magaalada Kuufa kana hor yimid taliskii umawiyiinta qarnigii siddeedaad ee miilaadiyada iyo dhimashadiisa oo uu gacantiisa ku dilay guddoomiyihii Khaliifkii Umawiyiinta. Hishaam bin Cabdul Maalik . Arrimo badan ayaa ka qayb qaatay soo ifbaxa Xuutiyiinta, oo ay ka mid yihiin sababo fikir, siyaasad, taariikheed iyo juquraafi oo ay ku jiraan sheegashada xuquuqda dadka deggan goobaha ay ku badan yihiin Zaydiyiinta. Sannadkii 1990-kii ayay ahayd markii la abuuray dhaqdhaqaaqii ugu horreeyay ee loogu magac daray “Dhallinyarada Mu’miniinta ah”, taasoo ay dabada ka riixaysay xaqiiqada go’doonka ah ee deegaannada Zayd, oo ay ku nool yihiin ku dhawaad 35 illaa 40 boqolkiiba tirada guud ee dadka Yemen. Dhaqdhaqaaqa ayaa noqday mid aad loo xiiseeyo kadib markii ay kordheen dhalinyaro taageersan oo ka qayb qaadanaysa dhaq-dhaqaaqa kooxda. Waxay la koreen nacaybka Israa’iil iyo Maraykanka iyagoo saaladaha Jimacaha ka qaadayey nashiidooyin ka dhan a

items.title: Malaayiin Qof oo Ka Qayb Galaya Aaska Cali Khamenei, xilli Xiisadda Gobolka ay Weli Taagantahay
items.description: Magaalada Tehraan ayaa maanta martigelinaysa maalintii labaad ee munaasabadda tacsida Hoggaamiyihii Sare ee Iiraan, Ayatollah Cali Khamenei, iyadoo malaayiin qof ay isugu soo baxeen caasimadda si ay uga qayb-galaan aaska iyo ducada loo samaynayo. Mas’uuliyiinta gaadiidka magaalada ayaa sheegay in shabakadda tareennada dhulka hoostiisa mara (Metro-ga Tehraan) ay qaadeen in ka badan 7 milyan oo rakaab ah saacadihii u dhexeeyay fiidnimadii Sabtida iyo aroortii Axadda, taasoo ka tarjumaysa tirada aadka u badan ee dadka kasoo qaybgalaya munaasabadda. Gudaha goobta aaska, boqolaal kun oo qof ayaa ku dhawaaqayay hal-ku-dhegyo ka dhan ah Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil, iyagoo dalbanaya in laga aarguto dilkii Khamenei. Warbaahinta gudaha ayaa sidoo kale baahisay muuqaallo muujinaya salaadda janaasada oo loo tukaday Khamenei iyo afar xubnood oo qoyskiisa ka tirsan, kuwaas oo lagu dilay weerarkii dhacay 28-kii Febraayo. Madaxda sare ee dowladda Iiraan, oo ay ka mid yihiin Madaxweyne Masoud Pezeshkian, Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Taliyaha Ciidanka Quds Esmail Qaani, wufuud caalami ah,iyo saraakiil kale ayaa ka qayb galay salaadda janaasada. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in inta ay socdaan munaasabadaha aaska aanay labada dhinac is weerari doonin, isaga oo tilmaamay in wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ay dib u bilaaban doonaan marka ay munaasabadahaasi soo dhammaadaan. Qaban-qaabiyeyaasha ayaa sheegay in aaska Khamenei uu socon doono muddo toddobaad ah, isagoo ka dhici doona magaalooyin kala duwan oo ku yaalla Iiraan iyo Ciraaq. Meydka ayaa la filayaa in loo qaado magaalooyinka Najaf iyo Karbala, ka hor inta aan ugu dambayn lagu aasin magaalada Mashhad, oo ah halkii uu ku dhashay Khamenei. Munaasabaddan ayaa ka mid noqotay kuwii ugu waaweynaa ee Iiraan ka dhaca sannadihii u dambeeyay, iyadoo indhaha caalamku ay ku sii jeedaan sida ay u saameyn karto xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: Scared but staying: Some migrants dig in as South Africa turns hostile
items.description: DURBAN, South Africa (Reuters) – Ethiopian refugee Helana Wolde locked his home and watched on television as thousands of angry  demonstrators marched through South Africa  this week calling for foreigners like him to ​leave. His wife and their three South African-born children were terrified, he said in the shop in downtown Durban where he sells coffee ‌and lentils. While  thousands of immigrants packed up  and left South Africa ahead of the June 30 protests, many more feel their best option is to stay, even though the country has turned hostile. “I have no place, no property, no family” in Ethiopia, said Wolde, adding ​his brothers there had been jailed. He reopened his shop, which unlike others wasn’t looted, the morning after the protest and was hoping ​for the best. Although Tuesday’s nationwide marches were largely peaceful, there were several pockets of attacks on foreigners and looting of migrant-owned ⁠businesses. “We’re all extra-scared,” Wolde said. PROTESTERS BLAME IMMIGRANTS FOR ECONOMIC WOES South Africa hosts over 167,000 refugees and asylum-seekers, according to the United Nations, a small number compared ​to many African countries — Uganda has 1.8 million, according to the U.N. refugee agency; Chad has 1.2 million; Kenya, 850,000. The overall immigrant population in South Africa stands ​at about 3 million, or 4% of the total, low by global standards. The main group behind the protests, March and March, says it only objects to illegal immigration and is not xenophobic. But the vigilantes it has riled up often target foreigners indiscriminately, and their frequent demands that immigrants show their documents are themselves illegal — as the government has pointed out in several ​statements — as only police have the authority to ask for them. Several South African protesters said that what really bothered them was seeing foreign-owned shops on their ​streets, while they were struggling to make a living. “This economy belongs to our people and it has been hijacked,” the group’s leader, Jacinta Ngobese, a former radio presenter, said in ‌a speech ⁠on Tuesday. She has called for marches every Thursday until its demands — including mass deportation — are met. A third of South Africans are unemployed and frustration with overstretched public services and rampant crime has boiled over, although researchers say that immigration is not to blame for these problems. “Foreigners are not taking jobs from South Africans. We are starting some small jobs here in South Africa. We are paying rent,” said Daniel Abide, 33, whose small convenience store in Clermont, a township near Durban, ​was looted on Tuesday night. “If you want ​to open a shop, you must ⁠open a shop like us,” he said. BUSINESS DOWN FOR FOREIGN SHOP OWNERS Abide came from Ethiopia a decade ago and has two shops, one of which was not targeted. He hopes to eventually re-open the other one, which was broken into ​and emptied out by looters. He employs one South African in his small business. Other shops that were looted in ​Clermont were run by ⁠people from Somalia and Pakistan, locals told Reuters. Outside one, men were working to fix the broken doors before nightfall, when they were afraid looters might come back. Wolde keeps a laminated stack of documents — his refugee certificate, tax and bank statements — on hand to show anyone who questions his legal status. Sometimes he has to show them two or ⁠three times ​a day to police or other people who come into his shop, which is on a ​bustling street with mostly Ethiopian businesses. “Now business is no good,” Wolde said. “Everybody is scared to come here.” He has soured on South Africa. But having already survived a shooting in 2008, and xenophobic looting in ​2015 and 2021, he plans to stick it out anyway. “I make business here. I don’t know why they’re angry.” Source: Reuters The post Scared but staying: Some migrants dig in as South Africa turns hostile appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Congratulations to the United States on the 250th Anniversary of Independence
items.description: Congratulations to the United States on the 250th Anniversary of Independence On behalf of the Somaliland Intellectuals Organization (SIO), we extend our warmest congratulations to the Government and the people of the United States of America on the occasion of the 250th Anniversary of American Independence. This historic milestone is a testament to the enduring values of freedom, democracy, the rule of law, and national resilience that have shaped the United States over the past two and a half centuries. As you celebrate this remarkable occasion, we wish the American people continued peace, prosperity, and success. We also express our hope for stronger friendship and deeper cooperation between the United States and the Republic of Somaliland in the years ahead. Happy 250th Independence Anniversary! Somaliland Intellectuals Organization (SIO)

items.title: Turkey is Reportedly Set to Build Major Space and Long-Range Missile Testing Complex in Somalia
items.description: Paris/Mogadishu (WDN) – French newspaper Le Monde has reported that Turkey is constructing an ambitious aerospace and long-range missile testing complex in central Somalia, a project that, if completed as described, would mark one of Ankara’s most significant strategic investments in Africa and dramatically expand its technological and military footprint in the region. According to the report, the sprawling facility will serve a dual purpose: a satellite launch center supporting Turkey’s expanding space program and a long-range ballistic missile testing site, underscoring Ankara’s growing ambitions in both civilian space technology and advanced defense capabilities. Le Monde has reported that Turkey is constructing an ambitious aerospace and long-range missile testing complex in central Somalia, a project that, if completed as described, would mark one of Ankara’s most significant strategic investments in Africa and dramatically expand its technological and military footprint in the region. According to the report, the sprawling facility will serve a dual purpose: a satellite launch center supporting Turkey’s expanding space program and a long-range ballistic missile testing site, underscoring Ankara’s growing ambitions in both civilian space technology and advanced defense capabilities. Le Monde said the project was officially unveiled in December 2025 as a joint Somali-Turkish initiative focused on space technology and scientific cooperation. However, the newspaper argues that the facility represents the culmination of more than a decade of strategic planning aimed at transforming Somalia into a key hub for Turkey’s geopolitical and technological ambitions in the Horn of Africa. The report describes the complex as the product of more than 15 years of sustained political, military, and economic investment by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Somalia. It suggests the project could significantly strengthen Turkey’s ballistic missile program while potentially altering the strategic balance of power across the Middle East and parts of Africa. According to Le Monde, construction officially began in mid-October 2025 near the coastal town of Warsheekh, approximately 70 kilometers north of Mogadishu. Shortly after work commenced, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud signed a bilateral space cooperation agreement, a move the newspaper portrays as the latest milestone in the rapidly expanding strategic partnership between Ankara and Mogadishu. The report also cited a study published in May by the Middle East Forum, which argued that if the site is ultimately used for ballistic missile testing, much of Africa and the Middle East would fall within the potential range of missiles launched from the facility. According to that study, the site is likely designed to support missiles with ranges of up to 2,000 kilometers. While such a range would reportedly fall short of reaching Israel from Somalia, the study argues that it would nevertheless provide Turkey with substantially enhanced military reach across the wider region. Le Monde further noted that such capabilities could extend over large parts of East Africa and the Horn of Africa, including Somaliland, which the report claims has strengthened security ties with Israel. The newspaper also observed that President Erdoğan has recently intensified his criticism of Israel, issuing increasingly forceful public statements over the conflict in the Middle East and, on several occasions, raising the possibility of military action. Neither the Somali nor Turkish governments immediately responded to the claims outlined in the report. If confirmed, the project would represent one of the most ambitious aerospace and defense initiatives ever undertaken on Somali territory, highlighting the deepening strategic partnership between the two countries while raising fresh questions about its broader geopolitical implications for the Horn of Africa and the Middle East. items.title: ICG Warns Somalia’s War Against Al-Shabaab Has Reached a Stalemate
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – A new report by the International Crisis Group (ICG) has concluded that the war between the Federal Government of Somalia and the militant group Al-Shabaab has once again entered a state of stalemate, following a significant shift in control across territories that were previously recaptured from the group during major offensives in 2022 and 2023. According to the report, Al-Shabaab has managed to regain a foothold in several areas from which it had earlier been expelled, highlighting the group’s resilience and continued operational strength despite years of sustained military campaigns by Somali and allied forces. The report notes that while the Federal Government continues to maintain strong defensive positions around Mogadishu and other key strategic cities, mounting pressure on government forces has raised concerns about the sustainability of recent security gains. ICG identified several factors undermining the government’s efforts to decisively defeat the insurgency. These include shortcomings in military training and force development, persistent political divisions within Somalia’s leadership, and a decline in international support for the country’s security operations. The report also warns that Somalia’s security strategy requires urgent reassessment. It urges the Federal Government and its international partners to accelerate reforms within the security sector, improve coordination among military and security agencies, and strengthen institutional capacity to confront the evolving threat posed by Al-Shabaab. In a notable recommendation, the International Crisis Group argued that Somalia should begin considering the possibility of a future political dialogue aimed at ending the conflict, warning that a purely military approach is unlikely to deliver lasting stability. The report emphasized that while military pressure remains necessary, experience has shown that force alone may not be sufficient to bring an end to one of Africa’s longest-running insurgencies. ICG concluded that Somalia is entering a particularly sensitive period, one that demands stronger political cooperation, enhanced security coordination, and sustained international engagement. Without a more comprehensive strategy, the organization warned, the conflict could become further entrenched, prolonging instability and undermining prospects for long-term peace. The findings come at a critical moment as Somalia faces growing security challenges, political tensions, and uncertainty surrounding the future of international support for its counterterrorism efforts. items.title: Gaalkacyo oo lagu soo bandhigay ciidamo ku biiraya Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Ciidamo cusub oo ka mid noqonaya Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa maanta lagu soo bandhigay duleedka Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Gobolka Mudug, ka dib markii loo diiwaangeliyay in ay ku biiraan Militariga Somaliya. Cabdiraxmaan Jabiin Faarax oo ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta reer Puntland ayaa soo xiray diiwaangelinta ciidamadan, oo markii dambena lagu soo bandhigay Xerada Istanbul ee duleedka Gaalkacyo. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay ciidamo cusub ka qoraneysay Gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan Magaalooyinka Galdogob iyo Gaalkacyo, tani oo qayb ka ah qorshaha Villa Somalia ee diiwaangelinta Guutooyinka Qaybta 54aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, waana xilli bishii June General Jimcaale Jaamac Takar loo magacaabay in uu noqdo Taliyaha Qaybta 54aad. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada cusub ee laga qoray Gobolka Mudug loo bilaabay mushaar iyo xuquuq joogta ah, iyagoona si toos ah uga amar qaadanaya Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in dhallinyaro fara-badan oo ku sugan Gaalkacyo ay diyaar u yihiin in ay isku diiwaangeliyaan ka mid noqoshada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa habeenkii Khamiista xaqiijiyay bixinta mushaarka ciidamada ka tirsan Xoogga Dalka ee ku sugan gudaha Puntland. Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Deni) ayaa dhawaan Dowladda Federaalka ku eedeeyay inay ciidamo ka qoraneyso deegaanada Puntland, isla-markaana ay maamulka ku hayso fara-gelin amni. Puntland ayaa waxaa laga dareemay xiisadda ka dhalatay qorshaha Dowladda Somaliya ay ciidamada uga qoraneyso gudaha deegaanada Puntland. Khilaafka labada dhinac ayaad mooddaa in uu meeshii ugu sarreysay gaaray, xilli Villa Somalia iyo Madaxtooyada Puntland ay isku mari la’yihiin arrimaha doorashooyinka dalka.

Dowladda Federaalka ayaa toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay ciidamo cusub ka qoraneysay Gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan Magaalooyinka Galdogob iyo Gaalkacyo, tani oo qayb ka ah qorshaha Villa Somalia ee diiwaangelinta Guutooyinka Qaybta 54aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, waana xilli bishii June General Jimcaale Jaamac Takar loo magacaabay in uu noqdo Taliyaha Qaybta 54aad. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada cusub ee laga qoray Gobolka Mudug loo bilaabay mushaar iyo xuquuq joogta ah, iyagoona si toos ah uga amar qaadanaya Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in dhallinyaro fara-badan oo ku sugan Gaalkacyo ay diyaar u yihiin in ay isku diiwaangeliyaan ka mid noqoshada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa habeenkii Khamiista xaqiijiyay bixinta mushaarka ciidamada ka tirsan Xoogga Dalka ee ku sugan gudaha Puntland. Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Deni) ayaa dhawaan Dowladda Federaalka ku eedeeyay inay ciidamo ka qoraneyso deegaanada Puntland, isla-markaana ay maamulka ku hayso fara-gelin amni. Puntland ayaa waxaa laga dareemay xiisadda ka dhalatay qorshaha Dowladda Somaliya ay ciidamada uga qoraneyso gudaha deegaanada Puntland. Khilaafka labada dhinac ayaad mooddaa in uu meeshii ugu sarreysay gaaray, xilli Villa Somalia iyo Madaxtooyada Puntland ay isku mari la’yihiin arrimaha doorashooyinka dalka.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo dib u dhigay Doorashooyinka Galmudug
items.description: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa dhowr maalmood dib u dhigay Doorashooyinka Galmudug, ka dib markii guddigu uu maanta kulan la yeeshay Ururada Siyaasadda ee daneynaya doorashooyinka maamulkaasi. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan oo ay wehliyaan xubno ka tirsan guddiga iyo Ururada Siyaasadda ayaa si dhow uga wada hadlay geeddi-socodka doorashada iyo in dadka deegaanka loo diyaariyo, sidii ay uga qayb qaadan lahaayeen doorashada tooska ah ee laga qabanayo deegaanada Galmudug. Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka Urur Siyaasadeedka Qiimo Qaran, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Axmed oo ku hadlayay afka Ururada Siyaasadda ee la kulmay Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa sheegay inay ururadu codsadeen in maalmo dib loo dhigo doorashada, taasoo uu sheegay in guddigu uu aqbalay. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa Khamiistii muddeeyay waqtiga Doorashooyinka Galmudug, waxayna xilligaasi sheegeen in 20-ka bishan si isku sidkan loogu tartami doono Doorashooyinka Golaha Deegaanka iyo tan Golaha Wakiilada Galmudug. Guddiga Doorashooyinka iyo Ururada Siyaasadda ayaa hadda isku raacay in maalinta codbixinta laga dhigo 25-ka July, sida uu Warbaahinta u sheegay Xildhibaan Guuleed Biixi Cabdi oo ka tirsan Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka, xubina ka ah Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP, ka dib kulanka ay labada dhinac ku yeesheen Magaalada Muqdisho. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa isku diyaarinaya inay maamulaan Doorashooyinka Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka, Xildhibaanada Golaha Wakiilada iyo tan Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug, iyadoo dadweynuhu ay tahay inay codkooda ku soo doortaan Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug iyo weliba Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka, iyadoona Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka ay dooran doonaan Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug. Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug ayuu qorshuhu yahay in bisha August lagu doorto Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Doorashada qofka iyo codka ee Galmudug ayaa lagu wadaa inay ka qabsoomto 11 magaalo oo ka kala tirsan Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug, taas oo ay codayn doonaan dad gaaraya 215,860 qof oo isku diiwaangeliyay Doorashooyinka Galmudug.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Sabtidan Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park ee Gobolka Minnesota, Naadiya Maxamed oo gabar Soomaaliyeed ah, taas oo booqasho ku joogta Magaalada Muqdisho. “Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Gudoomiye Naadiya ku bogaadiyay guulaha iyo doorka muuqda ee ay ka gaartay hoggaaminta iyo ka qaybgalka siyaasadda dalka ay ku nooshahay, isaga oo tilmaamay in guulaha noocaas ahi ay ka tarjumayaan kartida, dadaalka iyo kaalinta wax-ku-oolka ah ee bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay ku leeyihiin horumarka caalamka.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Villa Somalia. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Madaxweynaha ayaa Gudoomiye Naadiya kula dardaarmay in ay xoogga saarto ka qayb qaadashada xoojinta xiriirka soo jireenka ee ay wadaagaan Somaliya iyo Mareykanka iyo sare u qaadidda kaalinta ay qurba-joogtu ku leeyihiin dib u dhiska dalka, horumarinta adeegyada bulshada iyo kobcinta maalgashiga.” Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Dhankeeda, Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park, Marwo Nadia Mohamed ayaa uga mahadcelisay Madaxweynaha soo dhoweynta diiran, waxayna adkaysay sida ay uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka, dhiirigelinta iskaashiga iyo taageeridda dadaalada lagu horumarinayo Somaliya, iyada oo tilmaamtay in ay lama filaan ku noqotay amniga iyo horumarka ka socda caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho.” Naadiya Maxamed oo haysata dhalashada Mareykanka ayaa bishii November ee sanadkii 2023 loo doortay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park, ka dib dhowr sano oo ay ka tirsaneyd Golaha Deegaanka ee magaaladaasi. Naadiya Maxamed ayaa xilka loo dhaariyay 2-dii bishii January ee sanadkii 2024, oo ka bilaabaneysay afar sano oo xilka loo doortay. Gabadhan Soomaaliyeed ayaa xilligaasi dhigtay taariikh cusub, ka dib markii ay noqotay qofkii ugu horreyay ee Muslim ama madow ah ee loo doorto xilka duq magaalo ee Gobolka Minnesota. Inkasta oo magaaladan ay ka mid tahay meelaha Soomaalida codeysa aysan ku badnayn, haddana Naadiya ayaa ku guuleysatay inay codka ka hesho codbixiyeyaasha kale ee degan St. Louis Park, iyadoona doorashada kaga adkaatay Dale Anderson, oo ah bare ka tirsan Jaamacadda Minnesota.

items.title: NISA oo Shabeellaha Dhexe ku dishay horjoogeyaal ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab
items.description: Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhacay duleedka deegaanka Basra ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ku khaarijiyay siddeed xubnood oo ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen horjoogeyaal muhiim u ahaa weerarrada kooxda. Howlgalka ayaa lagu beegsaday goob ay xubnaha Al-Shabaab ku shirayeen oo ku taalla hareeraha jiinka webiga ee duleedka Basra, halkaas oo lagu dilay horjoogihii kooxda u qaabilsanaa miinooyinka iyo horjoogihii fulinta weerarrada hoobiyeyaasha nooca 107mm, kaas oo lagu magacaabi jiray Axmed Eybka Caalim (Daqare), iyo lix xubnood oo kale oo ka tirsanaa kooxdiisa. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka NISA, howlgalka ayaa jab culus ku noqday shabakaddii kooxda u qaabilsaneyd qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarrada hoobiyeyaasha ah. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in xog sirdoon ay xaqiijisay in kooxda Al-Shabaab ay meydadka horjoogeyaashii lagu dilay ka qaadeen goobta, islamarkaana si qarsoodi ah ugu aaseen deegaan kale. NISA ayaa xustay in howlgaladan ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab iyo burburinta shabakadaha qorsheeya weerarrada argagixisada ee ka dhanka ah shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo ciidamada dowladda.

items.title: Horjoogayaal Shabaab ah oo lagu dilay duleedka Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Qaranka oo warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa faah-faahin ka bixisay howlgal culus oo ay maanta ka fulisay deegaanka Basra oo kamid ah deegaannada u dhow magaalada Muqdisho, isla markaana ay joogaan Al-Shabaab. NISA ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in howlgalka lagu beegsaday horjoogayaal iyo maleeshiyaad uu shir uga socday duleedka deegaanka Barsa ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, kuwaas oo lagu laayay goobta, sida lagu sheegay bayaanka. Ugu yaraan 8 xubnood oo ay ku jiraan horjoogayaal sar sare ayaa lagu dilay howlgalka, sida ay shaacisay Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda Soomaaliya. Horjoogayaasha la dilay oo laba ah ayaa qaabisanaaa qaybta qaraxyada miinooyinka iyo weerarrada hoobiyeyaasha, iyada oo lala dilay lix xubnood oo kale. “Bartilmaameedka howlgalka oo ahaa goob ay Khawaarijta ku shiraayeen oo ku taalla hareeraha jiinka webiga ee duleedka Basra ayaa lagu dilay horjoogihii kooxda u qaabilsanaa dhagaraha miinooyinka iyo horjoogihii kooxda fulisa weerarrada argagixiso ee loo adeegsado hoobiyeyaasha nooca 107mm, kaas oo lagu magacaabi jiray Axmed Eybka Caalim (Daqare) iyo lix xubnood oo kale oo ka tirsanaa kooxdiisa,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay Hay’adda NISA. Hay’addu waxa ay intaas ku dartay in maydadka xubnaha la laayay ay qaadatay kooxda, kadibna ay si qarsoodi ah ugu aastay deegaan kae. “Xog Sirdoon ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in cadowgu maydadka horjoogayaashii lagu dilay ka qaadeen goobta howlgalka, iyaga oo si qarsoodi ah ugu aasay deegaan kale,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Dhanka kale NISA ayaa sheegtay in ay sii wadi doonto beegsiga kooxda, isla markaana ay ka hortageyso isku day kasto oo ay kooxda ku dooneyso inay kusoo abaabusho weerarro ay ku carqaladeyneyso amniga iyo xasiloonida dalka. Maalmihii u dambeeyay ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah ayaa kordhiyay howlgallada iyo duqeymaha lagu beegsanayo maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab ee weli ku sugan qaybo badan oo kamid ah dalka. Dhanka kale NISA ayaa sheegtay in ay sii wadi doonto beegsiga kooxda, isla markaana ay ka hortageyso isku day kasto oo ay kooxda ku dooneyso inay kusoo abaabusho weerarro ay ku carqaladeyneyso amniga iyo xasiloonida dalka. Maalmihii u dambeeyay ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah ayaa kordhiyay howlgallada iyo duqeymaha lagu beegsanayo maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab ee weli ku sugan qaybo badan oo kamid ah dalka. items.title: Al-Shabaab patrols Mogadishu outskirts at night as Somalia’s government touts improved security
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Residents on the western outskirts of Mogadishu say heavily armed Al-Shabaab militants have been openly patrolling populated neighborhoods after sunset in recent nights, raising fresh security concerns despite repeated claims by Somalia’s federal government that security in the capital has improved dramatically and that the insurgent threat has been reduced to zero, Caasimada Online news website reported on Friday. Residents of Elasha Biyaha and Ma’aane, located about 10 to 15 kilometers west of Mogadishu, told local media that groups of Al-Shabaab militants enter the neighborhoods every evening after dark in Toyota Noah and other vehicles before moving through residential streets. According to residents, the militants sometimes knock on the doors of homes and question occupants about activities in the neighborhoods, including whether anyone is cooperating with Somalia’s security forces. Residents said the nighttime patrols have become a routine occurrence. Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) and police maintain bases in both Elasha Biyaha and Ma’aane. The installations are intended to strengthen security around Mogadishu and monitor the movement of people and vehicles entering and leaving the capital. Residents, however, say the situation changes after sunset. According to residents, security personnel retreat into their bases at night while Al-Shabaab militants move through the neighborhoods freely and without fear. Residents said the militants routinely arrive in Toyota Noah and other vehicles, describing their presence as part of nightly life in the two neighborhoods and nearby settlements. Some residents also said they no longer report militant movements to security agencies because previous calls and messages allegedly received no response. According to the residents, repeated failures by security agencies to respond to information about Al-Shabaab movements have discouraged people from contacting the authorities with intelligence about militant activity. The reported patrols come as attacks have become increasingly common in the western outskirts of Mogadishu. Local news outlet Caasimada Online reported that roadside explosions and other militant attacks have become frequent in Elasha Biyaha and Ma’aane, with the latest incident involving a roadside bomb targeting security forces in Ma’aane. Somalia’s federal government and the country’s security agencies have not publicly addressed the reported nighttime militant presence in the neighborhoods. The reports contrast with repeated statements by Somali authorities that Mogadishu is experiencing its strongest security environment in more than two decades following operations by the country’s security forces. The reports from residents of Elasha Biyaha and Ma’aane, however, point to continuing security concerns on the western edge of Mogadishu as heavily armed Al-Shabaab militants are reported to be moving through populated neighborhoods under the cover of darkness. items.title: Mowqifka xildhibaanada Puntland laga soo doorto ee qorshaha Xasan ee Puntland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaannada Labada Gole ee laga soo doorto Puntland oo bayaan culus soo saaray ayaa si kulul uga hadlay xaaladda kasoo cusboonaatay deegaannada maamulkaas, gaar ahaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidan ee ay dowladda dhexe ka bilowday gudaha Puntland. Illaa 30 Mudane oo ka kala tirsan labada Aqal, kana soo jeedo Puntland ayaa saxiixay warsaxaafadeedkan oo ay ku eedeeyeen Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, iyaga oo sheegay inuu burburin ku hayo nidaamka federaalka. Bayaanka ayaa lagu soo qaaday ciidamo la sheegay in dowladdu ay ka qortay gudaha Puntland, waxayna tilmaameen u jeedadu tahay in colaad laga huriyo gobollada maamulkaasi. “Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday waxa uu ku tuntay dastuurka, isaga oo u bareeray hurinta colaado sokeeye iyo maal-galinta maleeshiyaad beeleedyo lagu wiiqayo nidaamka federaalka, iyadoo si qaldanna loo isticmaalayo magaca Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, si bulshada loo marin habaabiyo,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka xildhibaannada Puntland. Sidoo kale waxa ay farriin u direen hoggaanka sare ee Puntland iyo shacabka oo ay ugu baaqeen in si mideysan ay uga hortagaan waxa ay ku tilmaameen duullaan uu ka hayo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. “Waxaan ugu baaqeynaa dadka reer Puntland dowlad iyo shacabba si isku duubni iyo midnimo leh uga falceliyaan tallaabo kasta oo wiiqeya hannaanka federaalka, nabadda iyo jiritaanka dowladda Puntland.” ayaa lasii raaciyay. Waxaa kale oo farriintaan la wadaageen beesha caalamka oo ay ka codsadeen inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda kasoo korortay deegaannada Puntland. Khilaafka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe ayaa mar kale cirka isku shareeray, kadib markii ay soo baxday in dowladdu ‘ciidamo ka qoratay’ maamulkaas, taas oo si weyn uga careysiisay Madaxweyne Saciid Deni. items.title: Xoogaga Alpha Group oo hawlgal ka fuliyay xadka ay wadaagaan Gobolada Shabellooyinka
items.description: Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA) ayaa maanta sheegtay in ciidamadeeda ay hawlgal ka fuliyeen deegaanka Basra, oo ku yaala xadka kala qaybiya Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe, isla-markaana ay halkaasi ku khaarijiyeen sideed xubnood oo ka tirsan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, isla-markaana ay horjoogeyaal ku jiraan. Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda ayaa waxay sheegtay in xubnaha hawlgalka lagu dilay ay ka kala tirsanaayeen qaybaha miinooyinka iyo fulinta weerarada hoobiyeyaasha ee Al Shabaab. “Bartilmaameedka hawlgalka oo ahaa goob ay Khawaarijtu ku shirayeen oo ku taala hareeraha jiinka webiga ee duleedka Basra ayaa lagu dilay horjoogihii kooxda u qaabilsanaa dhagaraha miinooyinka iyo horjoogihii kooxda fulisa weerarada argagixiso ee loo adeegsado hoobiyeyaasha nooca 107mm, kaas oo lagu magacaabi jiray Axmed Eybka Caalim (Daqare) iyo lix xubnood oo kale oo ka tirsanaa kooxdiisa.” Ayay Hay’adda NISA ku sheegtay warsaxaafadeedka. Hay’adda NISA ayaa waxay sheegtay in hawlgalkan uu jab culus ku noqday shabakaddii Al Shabaab u qaabilsaneyd qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarada hoobiyeyaasha ah. “Hawlgalkan ayaa jab culus ku noqday shabakaddii Khawaarijta u qaabilsaneyd qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarada hoobiyeyaasha ah. Xog sirdoon ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in cadowgu meydadka horjoogeyaashii lagu dilay ka qaadeen goobta hawlgalka, iyaga oo si qarsoodi ah ugu aasay deegaan kale.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. NISA ayaa warsaxaafadeedka ku sheegtay “Halwlgaladan waxay qayb ka yihiin dadaalada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda Khawaarijta iyo burburinta shabakadaha qorsheeya weerarada argagixisada.” Wararka ayaa sheegaya in hawlgalkan ay fuliyeen Ciidanka Gaarka ah ee Gaashaan (Alpha Group), waana ciidamo uu Mareykanku tababaro oo ka amar-qaata Taliska Hay’adda NISA, waana ciidan gaar ah oo ay leedahay Hay’adda NISA. Ciidanka Alpha Group ayaa mararka qaarkood hawlgalo gaar ah ka fuliya Magaalada Muqdisho iyo deegaanada Gobolada Shabellooyinka ee ku teedsan caasimadda, si loo soo qabto xubnaha argagixsada ee xogtooda la helo amaba looga hortago weerarada ay qorsheynayaan. Xoogagan ayaa waxay u tababaran yihiin hawlgalada gaarka ah ee la dagaalanka argagixisada, uruurinta xogaha iyo ku hawlgalkooda. Ciidanka Alpha Group ayaa waxay xirfad sare u leeyihiin inay beegsadaan horjoogeyaasha iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, burburinta shabakadaha argagixiso iyo ka hortagga qorsheyaashooda.

items.title: Puntland MPs Accuse Mogadishu of Waging a ‘Political and Military War’ Against Puntland
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Members of Somalia’s Federal Parliament representing Puntland have launched a blistering attack on the Federal Government, accusing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration of orchestrating what they described as a coordinated “political and military assault” aimed at undermining Puntland’s autonomy and destabilizing the federal state. In a strongly worded statement issued amid escalating tensions between Villa Somalia and Garowe, the lawmakers alleged that the Federal Government has deployed troops and intensified military activities in areas administered by Puntland while simultaneously interfering in the state’s internal affairs. The MPs condemned what they characterized as an attempt to impose Mogadishu’s political will on Puntland, warning that such actions threaten not only regional stability but also the very foundations of Somalia’s federal system. They demanded an immediate halt to what they called provocative military deployments and political interference, arguing that the Federal Government’s actions risk pushing the country toward a deeper constitutional and security crisis. “The current course is dangerous and unsustainable,” the lawmakers warned, cautioning that unless the dispute is resolved through genuine political dialogue, Somalia could face a further deterioration in both its security and political landscape. The Puntland delegation also appealed to Somalia’s international partners and domestic political stakeholders to intervene diplomatically and support an inclusive political settlement capable of defusing the escalating confrontation before it spirals beyond control. The Federal Government has repeatedly rejected similar accusations, insisting that its actions are intended to safeguard Somalia’s national unity, uphold the Constitution, and protect national security. Mogadishu has consistently denied claims that it is targeting Puntland or seeking to undermine the regional administration. Relations between the Federal Government and Puntland have steadily deteriorated since the dispute over constitutional amendments and the country’s electoral framework. Puntland has maintained that it suspended recognition of federal institutions until an inclusive political agreement is reached on Somalia’s constitutional future. The latest exchange of accusations underscores the widening political rift between Mogadishu and Garowe, raising fresh concerns that the prolonged constitutional dispute could evolve into a broader confrontation unless meaningful negotiations are launched. With both sides hardening their positions and public rhetoric becoming increasingly confrontational, fears are mounting that Somalia’s federal crisis is entering an even more volatile and unpredictable phase. items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda xukuumadda Soomaaliya, ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay qaraxii lala beegsaday maqaaxi ku taalla magaalada Dimishiq ee dalka Suuriya, kaas oo sababay dhimashada dad rayid ah oo aan waxba galabsan iyo dhaawaca tiro kale oo badan. “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh la wadaagaysaa Dowladda iyo shacabka Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Suuriya, gaar ahaan qoysaska iyo ehelada dadkii ku geeriyooday weerarkaas, waxayna u rajaynaysaa dhammaan dadka dhaawacmay in uu Alle siiyo caafimaad degdeg ah” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Hargeysa: Fanaan Khalid Kaamil oo loo Xiray Hees uu u Qaaday Magaalada Quddus
items.description: Fanaanka caanka ah ee da’da yar ee Soomaaliyeed, Khalid Kaamil, ayaa la sheegay inuu lix maalmood ku xiran yahay xabsiga Mandheera, ee magaalada Hargeysa kadib eedeyn la xiriirta heeso uu ku taageeray magaalada Quddus. Xariga fanaanka ayaa si weyn looga hadal hayaa baraha bulshada, iyadoo dad badan ay muujinayaan walaac ku saabsan xarigga loo geystay fanaanka dhalinyarada ah. Xildhibaan Cali Ileeye oo ka hadlay arrintan ayaa sheegay in xarigga Khalid Kaamil uu yahay mid ka dhan ah xorriyadda fikirka iyo hal-abuurka fanaaniinta Soomaaliyeed, wuxuuna ugu baaqay bulshada iyo masuuliyiinta inay ka shaqeeyaan sii deyntiisa. Kiiskan ayaa dhaliyay dood xooggan oo ku saabsan xorriyadda hadalka, doorka fanaaniinta iyo xaqa ay u leeyihiin muujinta aragtidooda shaqsiga ah.
