items.title: Qoysas ku nool Dhuusomareeb oo nolol xumo haysay uga baxay ka ganacsiga birta duugga ah
items.description: (ERGO) – Danyar shaqo la’aan ahaa oo ku nool magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee xarunta gobolka Galgaduud ayaa dhaqaale ay ku maareeyaan noloshooda waxay ka helayaan biraha la isticmaalay ama la tuuray. Waxaa si joogto ah uga iibsada shirkado maxalli ah oo fadhigoodu yahay magaalada, una sii dhoofiya Muqdisho iyo dalka Ethiopia oo dib loogu warshadeeyo. Danyartan oo rag iyo dumar iskugu jira ayaa maalin kasta ku wareega xaafadaha magaalada oo ay ka aruuriyaan biraha. Guryaha ayay sidoo kale booqdaan, iyagoo dadka ka codsanaya inay siiyaan wixii bir ah oo aysan u baahneyn. Dad ku nool xeryaha lagu barakacay iyo danyar deegaan ah ayay u badan yihiin qoysaska sidan ku dabarra noloshooda. Dadkaas waxaa ka mid ah Aqbal Cadaawe Xaaji oo ku filnaatay maareynta nolosha qoys ka kooban toban qof. Waxay sheegtay in toddobaadka oo dhan ay qabato howshan, ayna ka hesho maalinkii $4 illaa $6 oo ay ku dabarto cunnada, biyaha iyo waxbarashada carruurteeda oo kaligeed ay koriso. Shaqadan oo ay bilowday bishii Jannaayo ayay xustay inay ka saartay cunno yari iyo nolol xumo ay wajahayeen. Waxay tilmaantay inay ku adkeyd helitaanka cunto hal waqti ah, Waxay mid ku soo gali jirtay dawarsi ay sheegtay in duruuftu ku qasabtay, markii ay waayeen waxay dabka ku shitaan. “Nolashayda hadda waxaan ahay qof bariiska ilmaha shaqaysanaysa, markii hore umadda ayaan dawarsanayay walaalow wax isii ayaan dhihi jiray. Qof baan albaabka ku garaaci jiray, mar la isiiyo iyo mar aan waayo ayay ahayd, horraantii waxaan ahaa qof barakac ah oo cid shaqso siisa waysay, waqtigaanna nolol baan helay oo waxaan ahay qof soo dhacsanaysa biilka qoyska.” Aqbal ayaa sheegtay in shaqadan oo ay qabato subixii illaa shanta galabnimo ay tahay mid adag, maaddama ay dusheeda ku xambaarto biraha, ayna lug ku marto xaafadaha iyo daafaha magaalada oo ay ka raadiso. Daruuf ayay tilmaantay inay ku qasabtay, balse ay ku faraxsantahay mar haddii aysan gaajo ku seexaneyn sagaal carruur ah oo lagu furay. Afar ka mid ah carruurteeda ayay geysay iskuul hoose iyo dugsi Qur’aan, waxayna bishii ka dhiibtaa $25. Waxay sheegtay in tani ay tahay mid ka mid ah riyooyinkeeda ugu muhiimsan oo muddo ay ku taameysay. “Carruurtayda oo markii hore wax ii dhigan jirin hadda waxbay ii bartaan. Bishaan ayaan geeyay iskuulka, nolashoodana waa haystaan iskuulkana waa aadan. Markii hore waxba ima dhigan jirin, maaddma aanan shaqo haysan oo aan rafaadsanaa. Hadase waxaan ku jiraa xaalad fiican.” Qoyska Aqbal oo colaad uga soo barakacay dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida Ethiopia ayaa tan iyo bishii Sebteember ee sanadkii hore deggan xerada Oog ee magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Siddeed bil oo halkan ay ku nooshahay ayay tilmaantay inay tahay markii ugu horeysay oo ay hesho shaqo ay ku maareyso qoyskeeda. Biyaha oo markii hore ay dadka ka soo baryi jirtay ayay sheegtay in hadda ay bishii iska bixiso $5 oo looga qaato tobbo ugu jirta guriga. Aqbal ayaa xustay in hadda ay leedahay keyd dhaqaale oo gaaraya $70. Uruurintan ayay sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto, si ay uga baaraan degto xaalad hubanti la’aan ah, maadaama aysan garaneyn xilli ay istaagi doonto shaqada ay ku tiirsantahay. “Waxa aan ka shaqeynayo waxaa laga dhex raadinaya qashinka meelaha lagu tuuro iyadoo sidaas ay tahay ayaan hadane waxaan is leeyahay, maaddama ay noloshiina wax ka badashay oo ay kuu suurta gashay in ilmihii ay iskuul kuu aadaan ka sii shaqee. Muhiimadeydu waa inaan ku noolaano nolol fiican oo xayaato leh.” Toddobo shirkadood oo magaalada deggan ayaa dadka ka gata biraha. Kiiladii ayay ka siiyaan qiime udhexeeya $0:15 illaa $0:20 sent. Ma aha warshado, balse waa ganacsato u sii dhoofiya magaalada Muqdisho iyo dalka Ethiopia, halkaas oo ay ku yaalaan warshado ka sameeya qalabka dhismaha. Qaar ka mid ah shirkadahan ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dad ka badan 150 qof ay u keenaan walxaha biraha ka sameysan, kadibna ay lacagtooda siiyaan isla marka ay ka miisaamaan. Tima-cadde Cabdi Kaabooy ayaa tilmaamay in tan iyo bishii Feberaayo oo uu ka shaqaynayo aruurinta biraha ay u suurta gashay in reerkiisa uu u helo cunto ku filan. Wuxuu sheegay in bishii uu ka helo ugu yaraan $160 oo uu xusay inay ku filantahay qoyskiisa oo 14 qof ka kooban. “Nin shaqaysto oo meel u baxayo oo shaqo meel ku og baan ahay oo wixii kasta oo gacantiisa qabata. Hadda ayay nolasheenu wanaagsan tahay, qurxuun tahayna, Inkastoo la dhahay ;soomaalidu waa samar taa ee ma dharagto. Marka annagu waan samarnaa.” Howshan ka hor ayuu tilmaamay inuu ahaa nin shaqo la’aan ah oo carruutiisa oo 11 ah ay gaajo ku seexdaan. Xerada Shabeelle oo 15 daqiiqo oo socod ah u jirta magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayuu maalin kasta uga soo kallahaa shaqadan.  Waa isha kaliya dhaqaale ee uu maanta ku tiirsan yahay, balse dadka qaar ayuu sheegay inay u arkaan qof dhimirka ka xanuunsan, marka ay arkaan isagoo xambaarsan jawaan ay ku jiraan biro daxaleystay. “Bulshada waa ku dhibaataynayaan. Kuwa ayaa ku tuur-yaynaya. Kuwa kale waa kugu qaylinayaan. Mid baa ku xumanaya gurigiisa markaad ag-maraysid. Kii naxumeeyana lama hadalno Alxamdullilaah baan dhahnaa, kii na fiicneeyana Rabilcaallamiim ayaan dhahnaa.” Ninkan ayaa xusay in dhaqaalaha uu ka helo shaqadan uu qeyb ka mid ah uu bil kasta u diro saddex kamid ah carruurtiisa, kuwaas oo duruuf dhaqaale awgeed uu uga soo tagay qoys deggan miyiga gobolka Mudug. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in bisha May uu qorsheynayo in iskuul uu geeyo afar carruur ah oo waxbarasho gaaray, balse markii hore ay dhaqaale la’aantu hor taagneyd. Qoyska Timacadde ayaa lix bil ka hor soo deggay xerada Shabeelle, markii abaar ay uga dhinteen xoolo uu ku dhaqanayay gobolka Mudug. Shirkadaha ka macaasha birta ayaa ah kuwo ogolaasho ka haysta maamulka Galmudug. Cabdullaahi Axmed Baraale oo ah maamulaha shirkadda Bir-libaax oo saddex xarumood ku leh magaalooyinka Dhuusamareeb iyo Guriceel ayaa sheegay in ku dhowaad sanad ay shaqeynayaan ay shaqo u abuureen danyar u keena walxa la tuuray oo aan lacag ugu fadhin, balse ay ka gataan iyagu. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in shirkadoodu ay shaqeeleysiisay labaatan dhallinyaro ah. Cabdullaahi ayaa tilmaamay in sharkaddu ay la timid hal-abuur ay dhaqaale uga hesho biro duugoobay oo caqabad mooyee aan manfac deegaanka u laheyn. “Anagu waxa aan ka helno ma fiirino nadaafaddii ayay ka qayb qaateen, dadka danyarta ahna shaqo abuur ayay u noqotay. Annagu intaas ayay ahayd ujeedadeenu. Cid nagu dhiirigaliso ama nagu taakulayso malahan maamul.” Xaaladda nololeed ee dadka ku nool xeryaha lagu barakacay ayaa sii adkaatay markii uu yaraaday gargaarka hay’adaha samafalka. Waa tiro yar inta hesha shaqooyin joogta ah ah oo ay ku maareeyaan noloshooda. Qof baan albaabka ku garaaci jiray, mar la isiiyo iyo mar aan waayo ayay ahayd, horraantii waxaan ahaa qof barakac ah oo cid shaqso siisa waysay, waqtigaanna nolol baan helay oo waxaan ahay qof soo dhacsanaysa biilka qoyska.” Aqbal ayaa sheegtay in shaqadan oo ay qabato subixii illaa shanta galabnimo ay tahay mid adag, maaddama ay dusheeda ku xambaarto biraha, ayna lug ku marto xaafadaha iyo daafaha magaalada oo ay ka raadiso. Daruuf ayay tilmaantay inay ku qasabtay, balse ay ku faraxsantahay mar haddii aysan gaajo ku seexaneyn sagaal carruur ah oo lagu furay. Afar ka mid ah carruurteeda ayay geysay iskuul hoose iyo dugsi Qur’aan, waxayna bishii ka dhiibtaa $25. Waxay sheegtay in tani ay tahay mid ka mid ah riyooyinkeeda ugu muhiimsan oo muddo ay ku taameysay. “Carruurtayda oo markii hore wax ii dhigan jirin hadda waxbay ii bartaan. Bishaan ayaan geeyay iskuulka, nolashoodana waa haystaan iskuulkana waa aadan. Markii hore waxba ima dhigan jirin, maaddma aanan shaqo haysan oo aan rafaadsanaa. Hadase waxaan ku jiraa xaalad fiican.” Qoyska Aqbal oo colaad uga soo barakacay dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida Ethiopia ayaa tan iyo bishii Sebteember ee sanadkii hore deggan xerada Oog ee magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Siddeed bil oo halkan ay ku nooshahay ayay tilmaantay inay tahay markii ugu horeysay oo ay hesho shaqo ay ku maareyso qoyskeeda. Biyaha oo markii hore ay dadka ka soo baryi jirtay ayay sheegtay in hadda ay bishii iska bixiso $5 oo looga qaato tobbo ugu jirta guriga. Aqbal ayaa xustay in hadda ay leedahay keyd dhaqaale oo gaaraya $70. Uruurintan ayay sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto, si ay uga baaraan degto xaalad hubanti la’aan ah, maadaama aysan garaneyn xilli ay istaagi doonto shaqada ay ku tiirsantahay. “Waxa aan ka shaqeynayo waxaa laga dhex raadinaya qashinka meelaha lagu tuuro iyadoo sidaas ay tahay ayaan hadane waxaan is leeyahay, maaddama ay noloshiina wax ka badashay oo ay kuu suurta gashay in ilmihii ay iskuul kuu aadaan ka sii shaqee. Muhiimadeydu waa inaan ku noolaano nolol fiican oo xayaato leh.” Toddobo shirkadood oo magaalada deggan ayaa dadka ka gata biraha. Kiiladii ayay ka siiyaan qiime udhexeeya $0:15 illaa $0:20 sent. Ma aha warshado, balse waa ganacsato u sii dhoofiya magaalada Muqdisho iyo dalka Ethiopia, halkaas oo ay ku yaalaan warshado ka sameeya qalabka dhismaha. Qaar ka mid ah shirkadahan ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dad ka badan 150 qof ay u keenaan walxaha biraha ka sameysan, kadibna ay lacagtooda siiyaan isla marka ay ka miisaamaan. Tima-cadde Cabdi Kaabooy ayaa tilmaamay in tan iyo bishii Feberaayo oo uu ka shaqaynayo aruurinta biraha ay u suurta gashay in reerkiisa uu u helo cunto ku filan. Wuxuu sheegay in bishii uu ka helo ugu yaraan $160 oo uu xusay inay ku filantahay qoyskiisa oo 14 qof ka kooban. “Nin shaqaysto oo meel u baxayo oo shaqo meel ku og baan ahay oo wixii kasta oo gacantiisa qabata. Hadda ayay nolasheenu wanaagsan tahay, qurxuun tahayna, Inkastoo la dhahay ;soomaalidu waa samar taa ee ma dharagto. Marka annagu waan samarnaa.” Howshan ka hor ayuu tilmaamay inuu ahaa nin shaqo la’aan ah oo carruutiisa oo 11 ah ay gaajo ku seexdaan. Xerada Shabeelle oo 15 daqiiqo oo socod ah u jirta magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayuu maalin kasta uga soo kallahaa shaqadan.  Waa isha kaliya dhaqaale ee uu maanta ku tiirsan yahay, balse dadka qaar ayuu sheegay inay u arkaan qof dhimirka ka xanuunsan, marka ay arkaan isagoo xambaarsan jawaan ay ku jiraan biro daxaleystay. “Bulshada waa ku dhibaataynayaan. Kuwa ayaa ku tuur-yaynaya. Kuwa kale waa kugu qaylinayaan. Mid baa ku xumanaya gurigiisa markaad ag-maraysid. Kii naxumeeyana lama hadalno Alxamdullilaah baan dhahnaa, kii na fiicneeyana Rabilcaallamiim ayaan dhahnaa.” Ninkan ayaa xusay in dhaqaalaha uu ka helo shaqadan uu qeyb ka mid ah uu bil kasta u diro saddex kamid ah carruurtiisa, kuwaas oo duruuf dhaqaale awgeed uu uga soo tagay qoys deggan miyiga gobolka Mudug. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in bisha May uu qorsheynayo in iskuul uu geeyo afar carruur ah oo waxbarasho gaaray, balse markii hore ay dhaqaale la’aantu hor taagneyd. Qoyska Timacadde ayaa lix bil ka hor soo deggay xerada Shabeelle, markii abaar ay uga dhinteen xoolo uu ku dhaqanayay gobolka Mudug. Shirkadaha ka macaasha birta ayaa ah kuwo ogolaasho ka haysta maamulka Galmudug. Cabdullaahi Axmed Baraale oo ah maamulaha shirkadda Bir-libaax oo saddex xarumood ku leh magaalooyinka Dhuusamareeb iyo Guriceel ayaa sheegay in ku dhowaad sanad ay shaqeynayaan ay shaqo u abuureen danyar u keena walxa la tuuray oo aan lacag ugu fadhin, balse ay ka gataan iyagu. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in shirkadoodu ay shaqeeleysiisay labaatan dhallinyaro ah. Cabdullaahi ayaa tilmaamay in sharkaddu ay la timid hal-abuur ay dhaqaale uga hesho biro duugoobay oo caqabad mooyee aan manfac deegaanka u laheyn. “Anagu waxa aan ka helno ma fiirino nadaafaddii ayay ka qayb qaateen, dadka danyarta ahna shaqo abuur ayay u noqotay. Annagu intaas ayay ahayd ujeedadeenu. Cid nagu dhiirigaliso ama nagu taakulayso malahan maamul.” Xaaladda nololeed ee dadka ku nool xeryaha lagu barakacay ayaa sii adkaatay markii uu yaraaday gargaarka hay’adaha samafalka. Waa tiro yar inta hesha shaqooyin joogta ah ah oo ay ku maareeyaan noloshooda. items.title: Madaxweynaha Puntland oo si kulul u weeraray Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Deni) ayaa maanta weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo uu ku eedeeyay inuu wiiqayo amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweynaha Puntland ayaa Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ku eedeeyay in uu burcad badeed ku abuuray xeebaha dalka, gaar ahaan kuwa Puntland. “Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhamaaday Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo uga gol leh in uu guud ahaan amniga dalka gacanta ka baxo, si uu uga gaaro dano gaaban iyo masaaliix waqtigeeda soo bixi doonto, wuxuu si bareer ah ugu abuuray burcad badeed xeebaha dalka Somaliya, gaar ahaan kuwa Puntland, ood ogtihiin dhacdooyinka ka dhacay billihii la soo dhaafay.” Ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Puntland. Isaga oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Wuxuu horey duulaan hubeysan ugu qaaday Magaalada Raaskambooni ee Dowladda Jubbaland, isagoo halkaa ku dilay muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed iyo in ciidamadii uu khalday ay isku dhiibaan ciidamada amniga ee dalka Kenya. Wuxuu sidoo kale afgembi siyaasadeed iyo qalqal amni ka sameeyay Magaalada Baydhabo, isagoo xoog ku maquuniyay, meeshana ka saaray nidaamkii maamul iyo kala dambayntii ka jirtay.” Waxa kaloo uu yiri “Wuxuu jujuub, xarig iyo dil uu ku hayaa muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool Magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan wuxuu weerar ku qaaday madaxdii hore ee Dowladda Federaalka Somaliya, iyagoo si nabad ah ugu sugan oo degan yihiin Magaalada Muqdisho.” Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa hadalkiisa ku xoojiyay “Sida aad la socotaan Madaxweynihii hore, wuxuu hagardaamo iyo in uu fashiliyo isugu dayay kacdoonkii shacabka ee Magaalada Laascaanood ka dhacay bishii December ee 2022 illaa August ee 2023, isagoo markii dambena isku dayay inuu colaad siyaasadeed iyo kala qaybin bulsho dhex dhigo dadka walaalaha ah ee guud ahaan Puntland ku nool. Hase yeeshee garashada wanaagsan ee shacabka Gobolka Sool iyo guud ahaan Puntland ayaa ka fogaaday inay dhacaan dhagarta Madaxweynihii hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud.” Madaxweyne Deni ayaa dhanka kale Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku eedeeyay in uu isku dayay inuu fashiliyo dagaalka ay Ciidanka Puntland kula jiraan maleeshiyada Daacish iyo inuu is hortaagay taageero ay ka heli lahaayeen saaxiibada caalamka qaarkood. “Sidoo kale Xasan Sheekh ayaa isku dayay inuu fashiliyo halganka ciidamada geesiyaasha ah ee Puntland ee muddada dheer kula jiray cadowga argagixisada Daacish, isagoo is hortaag ku sameeyay taageerada iyo saad kala duwan oo aan ka heli lahayn qaar ka mid ah saaxiibada caalamka. Wuxuu kaloo carqaladayn joogta ah ku sameeyay diyaaradihii ciidanka ka gacan siinayay dagaalka iyo kuwii dhaawacyada dibadda u qaadaayay, iyada oo si joogta ah loogu diidaayay in la siiyo ruqsadaha duulimaadka hawada Somaliya.” Deni oo Magaalada Garoowe ka furay Kalfadhigga 58aad ee Baarlamaanka Puntlland ayaa xusay “Dowladda iyo shacabka Puntland oo fahamsan dhagaraha Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa isha ku haya fara-gelinta joogtada ah ee uu doonayo inuu ku carqaladeeyo amniga iyo xasilloonida ka jira deegaanada Puntland. Dowladda Puntland waxay si dhow ula socotaa in Madaxweynihii hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu dhaqaale ku bixinayo in dhallinyaro maleeshiyaad hubeysan ah lagu abuuro deegaano ka tirsan Xaafuun, Bayla, Eyl iyo Jariiban ee Puntland. Dhallinyaradaas ayaa qaarkood loo diyaarinayaa inay gacan siiyaan, kana qayb qaataan hawlgalada burcad badeedda ee lagu abaabulayo xeebaha degmooyinkaas.” Deni ayaa ka digay “Dowladda Puntland waxay si adag uga digeysaa wixii fara-gelin amni ah ee Madaxweynihii hore ka dhex wado meelo ka mid ah deegaanada Puntland.”

items.title: Maamulka gobolka Banaadir oo maanta Imtixaanka fasalka 8-aad ka qaaday 46 Kun oo arday
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa Isniinta maanta ah si rasmi ah u daah-furay Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ah ee Dugsiyada Dhexe ee Gobolka Banaadir, iyadoo sanadkan ay imtixaanka u fariisteen in ka badan 46,000 oo arday. Imtixaanka oo lagu galayo 125 xarumood oo ku kala yaalla degmooyinka Gobolka Banaadir, ayaa loo sameeyay diyaar-garow dhameystiran oo lagu xaqiijinayo habsami-u-socodka imtixaanka, amniga xarumaha iyo ilaalinta tayada maamulka imtixaanaadka. “Xarun kasta oo imtixaan lagu galayo waxaa la geeyay kooxo caafimaad, gaadiidka gurmadka degdegga ah iyo ciidamada dab-damiska, si loogu diyaargaroobo xaalad kasta oo soo derista inta uu socdo imtixaanka.” ayuu yiri, Cabdiraxmaan Agaasimaha Guud ee Agaasinka Waxbarashada Gobolka Banaadir. Sidoo kale Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir Muungaab, ayaa ardayda u rajeeyay guul waxa uuna sheegay in maamulka gobolka uu sanadkan sii wadi doono dhiirrigelinta iyo abaalmarinta ardayda kaalmaha hore ka gala imtixaanka, sida uu soo-jireenka ka dhigay sanadkii hore. Duqa Muqdisho ayaa sheegay in sanadkan markii ugu horreysay ay imtixaanka ka qaybgalayaan arday muwaadiniin reer Suudaan ah oo waxbarasho ka dhigta magaalada Muqdisho, arrintaas oo muujinaysa kaalinta ay caasimaddu ka qaadanayso taageeridda waxbarashada iyo adeegyada bulshada ee walaalaha soo magansaday. The post Maamulka gobolka Banaadir oo maanta Imtixaanka fasalka 8-aad ka qaaday 46 Kun oo arday appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somaliland president lays wreath at tomb of Zionism’s founder during Israel visit
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somaliland President Abdirahman Abdullahi Irro has paid tribute at two of Israel’s most significant historical sites on the opening day of his first state visit to the territory, as the two sides mark a deepening diplomatic relationship that has drawn sharp criticism from Somalia and many Muslim nations. Tributes at Mount Herzl and Yad Vashem Irro laid a wreath at the tomb of Theodor Herzl, the founder of modern political Zionism, on Mount Herzl on Sunday, before visiting Yad Vashem, Israel’s Holocaust memorial, his office said in a statement on Facebook . At Yad Vashem, officials briefed Irro on accounts of the Holocaust, walking him through the history of the atrocity and the events that shaped it. The Somaliland leader also visited the Grove of Nations, where he planted a tree described by his office as a symbol of friendship, cooperation and lasting relations between Somaliland and Israel. The tree, the statement said, represents a living and sustaining bond that will outlast the visit itself, marking a historic friendship that strengthens ties between the two sides. Somaliland President Irro and his wife at the Theodor Herzl tomb in Jerusalem during a historic state visit to Israel. Irro and Herzog hold joint press conference in Jerusalem Irro touched down in Jerusalem for his first state visit to Israel, where he held a joint press conference with Israeli President Isaac Herzog. “We are deeply appreciative that the State of Israel has chosen to receive us with such an honour on this historic occasion. By doing so, Israel has taken part in a moment that will be remembered in the diplomatic history of our nation, and we do not take that gesture lightly,” he said. “Somaliland has been talking, has been reaching out to world leaders for the last 35 years. They were asking only one question: to see us. Only one country desired to see us and recognise Somaliland, and that’s the government of Israel and its people,” Irro added. Herzog, speaking at the same press conference, dwelt at length on the relationship between the two nations. “The beautiful images of the people of Somaliland waving Israeli flags in celebration of this new relationship warmed all of our hearts, Mr President. Today, we are equally delighted to have the flags of Somaliland flying here at the President’s Residence and all throughout Jerusalem,” he said. Herzog described the visit as a symbol of the “great potential of this wonderful new partnership,” pointing to shared challenges around “radical extremism” and the need for “security and stability in the region and in the Horn of Africa.” He characterised Somaliland’s separate administration from the rest of Somalia as “a reality on the ground for several decades” – a description that aligns with Israel’s formal recognition of the territory in December 2025. Regional fallout over recognition and embassy plans The visit comes just days after Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud strongly criticised Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, describing it not as recognition but as a “trap” designed by Israel to pursue its own security interests against Iran-aligned Houthi forces and draw Somalia into a war that is not its own. He warned of a looming threat to the country as a result of the move, saying its early signs were already visible. Irro is also scheduled to open an embassy that Somaliland has established in Jerusalem, making it the second Muslim-majority territory to do so – a move that has drawn condemnation from 19 Muslim-majority countries . Somalia has also condemned the move , regarding Somaliland as part of its own territory. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

They were asking only one question: to see us. Only one country desired to see us and recognise Somaliland, and that’s the government of Israel and its people,” Irro added. Herzog, speaking at the same press conference, dwelt at length on the relationship between the two nations. “The beautiful images of the people of Somaliland waving Israeli flags in celebration of this new relationship warmed all of our hearts, Mr President. Today, we are equally delighted to have the flags of Somaliland flying here at the President’s Residence and all throughout Jerusalem,” he said. Herzog described the visit as a symbol of the “great potential of this wonderful new partnership,” pointing to shared challenges around “radical extremism” and the need for “security and stability in the region and in the Horn of Africa.” He characterised Somaliland’s separate administration from the rest of Somalia as “a reality on the ground for several decades” – a description that aligns with Israel’s formal recognition of the territory in December 2025. Regional fallout over recognition and embassy plans The visit comes just days after Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud strongly criticised Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, describing it not as recognition but as a “trap” designed by Israel to pursue its own security interests against Iran-aligned Houthi forces and draw Somalia into a war that is not its own. He warned of a looming threat to the country as a result of the move, saying its early signs were already visible. Irro is also scheduled to open an embassy that Somaliland has established in Jerusalem, making it the second Muslim-majority territory to do so – a move that has drawn condemnation from 19 Muslim-majority countries . Somalia has also condemned the move , regarding Somaliland as part of its own territory. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: FIFA to pay Somali referee after US entry bar disrupted World Cup role
items.description: World football governing body FIFA has taken an exceptional decision regarding the compensation of referee Omar Abdulkadir Artan after his World Cup participation was disrupted by his denial of entry into the United States, sources familiar with the matter said. The 34-year-old was deported after an 11-hour interrogation by immigration officials in Miami, preventing him from taking part in the tournament, where he had been set to become the first referee from Somalia to officiate at a World Cup. FIFA customarily pays match officials at the conclusion of a World Cup based on their involvement, but Artan’s case is understood to have been treated as exceptional due to the circumstances surrounding his absence. Artan had been widely viewed as a landmark appointment for Somali football development after being selected for the tournament. Since the incident, he has received backing from across the football community. European football governing body UEFA has appointed him to officiate the Super Cup between Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa in August. Artan was named Africa’s best male referee in 2025, further raising expectations ahead of his World Cup debut. Somalia is among nearly 40 countries affected by expanded US travel restrictions introduced under former President Donald Trump’s immigration measures. items.title: Galmudug demands consensus-led election amid tensions
items.description: Somalia’s Galmudug state has rejected any election model imposed without political agreement, distancing itself from the recent vote process held in Southwest State and calling for a consensus-based approach, officials said. Galmudug Information Minister Ali Mohamed Farah Seeko said on Saturday the regional administration would not accept an electoral process conducted without agreement among stakeholders, insisting elections must align with the constitution. Speaking to Universal Somali TV, Seeko said Galmudug opposed replicating the model used in Southwest State and urged local leaders and communities to jointly determine the electoral framework. “ Galmudug administration is still insisting on previous agreements regarding the three-tier elections, namely local government elections, Galmudug administration and the federal government,” he said. He accused the federal government of suspending earlier preparations for regional elections, saying committees and funding had already been put in place. Seeko said his remarks reflect the official position of the administration led by Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye Qoor Qoor. “ An election similar to the one that took place in Southwest will not happen in Galmudug, and we will not accept it,” he said. His comments follow the conclusion of regional elections in Southwest State, where lawmakers and a regional president were elected despite objections from some candidates and opposition figures who alleged federal interference. In that vote, former federal speaker Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur Madobe was elected president after rival candidate Sharif Hassan Sheikh Aden withdrew, citing alleged violations of agreed electoral procedures. items.title: UN releases $10 mln to avert famine in Somalia as hunger crisis
items.description: The United Nations has released $10 million from its emergency fund to help avert famine in Somalia, where millions face acute food insecurity. The funding, announced Sunday by UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher, will support food, nutrition, health and water assistance for about 640,000 people, the United Nations said. “The window to prevent famine in Somalia is short,” Fletcher said. The United Nations said around 6 million people are experiencing severe hunger, including 1.9 million in emergency levels of food insecurity. “The situation has deteriorated due to increased food insecurity, widespread malnutrition, and reduced access to basic services,” Fletcher said in a separate statement. The UN warned that a “plausible risk of famine” has been identified in parts of Bay and Bakool regions in South West State, particularly in agropastoral areas. More than 500,000 people have been displaced since the start of 2026, according to the UN. Somalia is facing a severe drought following successive failed or below-average rainy seasons, compounded by conflict, displacement, disease outbreaks and rising food prices. Humanitarian agencies have warned that funding shortages are forcing cuts to critical aid programmes even as needs continue to rise across the country. The post UN releases $10 mln to avert famine in Somalia as hunger crisis first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo sheegay in ay dileen 14 katirsan kooxda AS
items.description: Shabeellaha Hoose ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa howlgal lagu bartilmaameedsaday maleeshiyaad katirsan Al-shabaab ka fuliyay degmada Kurtunwaarey ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Howlgalka ayaa lla sheegay in lagu beegsaday goobo ay ku sugnaayeen horjoogayaal iyo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Intii uu socday howlgalka, waxaana la tilmaamay in lagu dilay 14 ka tirsanaa Al-shabaab. Sidoo kale, Ciidanka ayaa sheegay in ay burburiyeen kayd hub, walxaha qarxa iyo agab kale oo Shabaab u adeegsan jirtay diyaarinta iyo fulinta falalka argagixisanimo ee lagu dhibaateeyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Saraakiisha ciidanka ayaa sheegay in Howlgalkan uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay ugu jiraan ciribtirka Al-shabaab, kuwaas oo ay ku eedeeyeen in ay ku caan baxay cabburinta shacabka, dhaca hantidooda iyo falalka amni-darrada ah ee ay ka geystaan deegaannada dalka. Sidoo kale Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, ayaa xusay in ay ka go’an tahay sii wadidda howlgalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo nabadda dalka. The post Ciidanka Danab oo sheegay in ay dileen 14 katirsan kooxda AS appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay wada-hadallada DF iyo mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xubnaha Beesha Caalamka ee fadhigoodu yahay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa weli sii wada dadaalladooda ku aadan dhex-dhexaadinta madaxda Dowadda Federaalka iyo kuwa mucaaradka, si loo bilaabo wada-hadallo toos ah oo xal loogu raadinayo khilaafka hareeyay hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in labada dhinac ay muujiyeen dabacsanaan, kadib cadaadis aan kala joogsi lahayn oo ay saartay Beesha Caalamka, oo iyadu farogelin, billowday kadib dagaalkii dhawaan labada dhinac ku dhexmaray xaafado ka tirsan magaalada Muqdisho. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed oo ka kooban Madasha Samatabixinta, Jubbaland iyo Puntland ayaa haatan soo magacaabay guddi farsamo oo loo xil saaray isku dubbaridka dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu bilaabo wada-hadal u dhexeeya Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, guddigan ayaa ka kooban xubno kala metelaya Madasha Samatabixinta iyo labada maamul ee ku midoobay Golahan, waxayna kala yihiin;- 1- Wasiir hore Maxamed Dhabancad oo metelaya Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullahi Deni, 2-Cabdirashiid Jire oo isna metelaya Madaxweynaha Jubaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) iyo saddex xubnood oo kale oo iyana metalaya mucaaradka Muqdisho, kuwaas oo kala ah Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur Warsame, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) iyo Cabdiraxmaan Ceynte. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in xubnahan ay diiradda saari doonaan sidii loo mideyn lahaa dadaallada kala duwan ee Beesha Caalamka ee ku aadan xal ka gaaridda khilaafka ka taagan dalka ee ka dhashay arrimaha doorashada iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka kumeel gaarka ah. Dhinaca kale, Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda wadda diyaar garow ku aadan wada-hadallada bilaabanaya oo ay door weyn ku leeyihiin dalalka Turkiga, Mareykanka, Ingiriiska iyo Qaramada Midoobay, kuwaas oo qaaday tallaabooyin lagu qaboojinayo xiisadda taagan. Dadaalladan oo maalmo badan socda ayaa haatan uu muuqdo kuwa suuragelin kara in markale ay miiska wada-hadalka isugu yimaadaan dowladda iyo mucaaradka oo horay ugu kala kacay shirar kala duwan oo ay yeesheen. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxlad xasaasi ah oo ka dhalatay is mariwaaga siyaasadeed ee dhinacyadan, taas oo keentay in qalqal amni laga dareemo gudaha caasimada, inkastoo haatan xaaladdu ay dagan tahay. The post War cusub oo kasoo kordhay wada-hadallada DF iyo mucaaradka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DFS oo Magacowday Taliyaha Qaybta 54-aad iyo Puntland oo Si Adag uga Soo Horjeedda
items.description: Xog ay heshay Goobjoog ayaa muujinaysa in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay Jimcaale Jaamac Takar u magacowday Taliyaha Qaybta 54-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, oo xarunteedu tahay magaalada Garoowe. Magacaabistan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallo ay dowladda federaalku ku ballaarinayso qaab-dhismeedka ciidanka qaranka, iyadoo dhawaan ciidanka Federaalka lagu daray askar hore uga tirsanaa ciidamada Puntland oo ku sugnaa Garoowe iyo Boosaaso. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegaya in ujeedada dowladda ay tahay dib u soo nooleynta taliskii Ciidanka Xoogga ee hore uga jiray deegaannada Puntland kahor burburkii dowladdii dhexe. Si kastaba, tallaabadan ayaa wajahaysa diidmo xooggan oo ka timid Puntland. Jimcaale Jaamac Takar ayaan hore uga tirsanaan jirin Ciidanka Federaalka, balse wuxuu caan ku yahay inuu hoggaamin jiray ciidamada Danab ee Puntland, kuwaas oo hoos taga maamulka Puntland kana madax-bannaan taliska Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, inkastoo saldhigyadoodu ku yaallaan Garoowe. Magacaabistan ayaa noqoneysa tii ugu horreysay ee Dowladda Federaalka ay taliye qaybeed si toos ah ugu magacowdo Puntland tan iyo sanadkii 1991-kii, iyadoo aan jirin wax oggolaansho ama wada-tashi rasmi ah oo lala yeeshay maamulka Puntland. Arrintan ayaa la filayaa inay sii xoojiso khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe, xilli labada dhinac ay hore ugu kala aragti duwanaayeen arrimo la xiriira awood-qaybsiga, dastuurka iyo maamulka ciidamada.

items.title: Puntland oo madaxweyne Xasan ku eedeeysay in uu abuuray burcad badeed hubeysan oo weerara Maraakiibta
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Maamulka Puntland ayaa ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud abuurida burcad Badeed hubeysan oo weeraro ku qaaday gaadiid badeed isticmaalaya biyaha caalamiga ah iyo Xeebaha Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha Puntland oo ka hadlayay furitaanka kalfadhiga 58-aad ee Baarlamaanka Puntland, ayaa sheegay in ay Xasan Sheekh uu Soomaali kala diray, laguna xadgudbay oo laburburiyey nidaamkii Federaalka ee heshiiska lagu lahaa, dhammaan maamulada dalka ka jira lagu wada duulay sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale madaxweyne Deni ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay si cad uga hortimi, isla markaana aysan aqbali doonin afduub siyaasadeed iyo mid sharciga dalka loo geystay oo ay ka dagaalamayso. “Puntland waxay ka hortimid afduub siyaasadeed iyo sharci oo uu Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka ku sameeyey hanaankii heshiiska lagu ahaa, wuxuuna duullaan toos ah ku hayaa hanaankii federalka iyo maamulada kajira dalka” ayuu yiri Siciid Deni. Sidoo kale Deni oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Madaxweynihii hore si bareer ah u abuuray Burcad-badeed, wuxuu horay duullaan hubaysan ugu qaaday Raaskambooni oo uu ku diley muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu sidooo kale khalkhal siyaasadeed iyo afgambi ka sameeyey ka sameeyey Magaalada Baydhabo isagoo meesha ka saaray hanaankii maamul ee ka jirey Koonfur Galbeed”Ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland Siciid Deni. Hadalka madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland, ayaa ku soo aadaya xili xiisada siyaasadeed ee dalka ay cirka isku shareereyso, isla markaana mucaaradka iyo dowladda federaalka ay meel adag kala taagan yihiin, sidoo kalana ay burbureen wada-hadalo ay dhinacyado sheegeen kuwaasi oo looga hadlayay arrima doorashooyinka. Sidoo kale Deni oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Madaxweynihii hore si bareer ah u abuuray Burcad-badeed, wuxuu horay duullaan hubaysan ugu qaaday Raaskambooni oo uu ku diley muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu sidooo kale khalkhal siyaasadeed iyo afgambi ka sameeyey ka sameeyey Magaalada Baydhabo isagoo meesha ka saaray hanaankii maamul ee ka jirey Koonfur Galbeed”Ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland Siciid Deni. Hadalka madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland, ayaa ku soo aadaya xili xiisada siyaasadeed ee dalka ay cirka isku shareereyso, isla markaana mucaaradka iyo dowladda federaalka ay meel adag kala taagan yihiin, sidoo kalana ay burbureen wada-hadalo ay dhinacyado sheegeen kuwaasi oo looga hadlayay arrima doorashooyinka. items.title: Maamulka Puntland oo ku dhawaaqay inuu sidii dawlad madax-bannaan u dhaqmi doono
items.description: Madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullahi Deni, ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay sii wadi doonto inay si madaxbannaan u maamulato arrimaheeda ilaa laga helayo dowlad Soomaaliyeed oo heshiis iyo wada-ogol lagu yahay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa hadalkan ka jeediyay furitaanka kal-fadhiga 58-aad ee Golaha Wakiillada Puntland, halkaas oo uu kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Deni wuxuu ku eedeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inay ku fashilantay ilaalinta nidaamka dowladnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, isaga oo sheegay in tallaabooyinka ay qaaday ay horseedeen khilaafyo siyaasadeed iyo amni darro. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyay dowladda dhexe inay qayb ka tahay abuurista xaalado amni oo halis gelinaya xasilloonida dalka, asagoo sheegay in gudaha Puntland laga wado falal lagu carqaladaynayo jiritaanka maamulkaas. Madaxweynaha Puntland ayaa adkeeyay in maamulkiisu uu sii wadi doono difaaca danaha shacabka Puntland iyo ilaalinta nidaamka dowladnimo ee ay dhisteen, isagoo ku baaqay in la helo hannaan siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan wada-tashi, heshiis iyo kalsooni dhex marta dhinacyada Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo jawaab culus ka soo saaray booqashada uu C/raxmaan Cirro ku tegay Israel
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) — Maamulka Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay safarka madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro uu shalay ku tagay Israel, xilli xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee Hargeysa iyo Tel Aviv uu weli abuurayo caro ballaaran oo ka taagan Soomaaliya, gobolka iyo dalal ka tirsan dunida Carabta. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee maamulka Xuutiyiinta ee fadhigoodu yahay magaalada Sanca ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku tilmaantay Cirro “madaxweynaha is-magacaabay ee Somaliland”, iyadoo sheegtay in booqashadiisa Israel ay tahay tallaabo ceeb ah oo sii fogeynaysa Hargeysa. Bayaanka, oo ay daabacday wakaaladda wararka Saba ee ay maamulaan Xuutiyiinta, ayaa lagu yiri: “Qof kasta oo booqda, gacan qaada ama aqoonsada dambiilayaasha dagaalka ee Sahyuuniyadda waa inuu dareemaa ceeb iyo hoos-u-dhac.” Wasaaradda ayaa Israel ku eedeysay in gacmaheedu “ku wasakhoobeen dhiigga Carabta” ee Falastiin, Lubnaan, Iran iyo Yemen, iyadoo ku tilmaantay Israel cadowga ummadda Islaamka iyo goobaha barakeysan. “Xiriirka sii kordhaya ee Hargeysa la sameyneyso Israel waxba kama tarayo danaha Somaliland, mana gaarsiinayo ujeeddooyinka ay raadineyso,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Maamulka Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xiriirka Hargeysa iyo Tel Aviv uu Somaliland ka sii fogeyn doono deegaanka Carabta iyo Islaamka, halkii uu u horseedi lahaa aqoonsi iyo taageero siyaasadeed oo ballaaran. Bayaanka ayaa intaas ku daray in dalalka Carabta looga baahan yahay in aysan ku ekaan cambaareyn afka ah, balse ay qaadaan “tallaabooyin muuqda” oo looga hortagayo waxa uu ku tilmaamay “tallaabooyinka ceebta ah” ee Hargeysa. Cambaareynta Xuutiyiinta ayaa imaneysa xilli Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Cirro uu gaaray Israel, safar loo arko mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinkii ugu waaweynaa ee Hargeysa qaaddo tan iyo markii Israel ay noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay oo si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland. Warbaahinta Israel ayaa sheegtay in safarka Cirro uu qeyb ka yahay dadaal lagu xoojinayo xiriirka labada dhinac, islamarkaana lagu wado in lagu furo safaarad Somaliland ku yeelato magaalada Qudus, oo Hargeysa ay u aqoonsatay caasimadda Israel. Tallaabadaas ayaa si weyn uga careysiisay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Midowga Afrika ayaa horey u diiday aqoonsiga Israel ee Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadaas ay ka hor imaaneyso mabda’a ilaalinta midnimada, madaxbannaanida iyo dhuleed ee dalalka Afrika. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xiriirka Israel iyo Somaliland uu qeyb ka yahay qorshe khatar ku ah gobolka Geeska Afrika, halka Hargeysa ay ku adkeysaneyso in ay xaq u leedahay sameysashada xiriir dibadeed oo u adeega danaheeda amni, dhaqaale iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Bayaanka Xuutiyiinta ayaa muranka Somaliland iyo Israel siinaya xagal cusub oo ku xiran Badda Cas iyo siyaasadda gobolka. Xuutiyiinta, oo taageero ka hela Iran, ayaa muddooyinkii dambe si weyn ugu lug lahaa xiisadaha ka taagan Badda Cas, iyagoo weeraro ku qaaday maraakiib ay ku sheegaan inay xiriir la leeyihiin Israel ama ay u socdaan dekedaha Israel. Maamulka Sanca ayaa sheegay in Israel aysan ku guuleysan doonin qorshayaasheeda ku wajahan Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika, isagoo ballan qaaday in Yemen ay ka hor imaan doonto dadaalladaas. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay si buuxda u taageerayaan Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, si ay uga hortagto waxa ay ku tilmaameen “mashruuc Sahyuuni ah” oo lagu beegsanayo Soomaaliya, Geeska Afrika iyo guud ahaan gobolka. The post Xuutiyiinta oo jawaab culus ka soo saaray booqashada uu C/raxmaan Cirro ku tegay Israel appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Mareykanka iyo Iran oo kala saxiixday heshiis buuxa oo aysan qeyb ka aheyn Israa’iil
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa gaaray heshiis lagu soo afjarayo dagaalkii u dhaxeeyay labada dal, sida ay Axaddii shaaciyeen madaxweyne Donald Trump iyo ra’iisul wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif, oo dalkiisu door dhexdhexaadin ah ka ciyaaray wadahadallada. Trump ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa Truth Social ku sheegay in “heshiiska Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran uu hadda dhammeystiran yahay,” isagoo sidoo kale ku dhawaaqay in si degdeg ah loo furayo marinka muhiimka ah ee Strait of Hormuz. “Hambalyo dhammaan!” ayuu qoray Trump. “Waxaan si buuxda u oggolaaday furitaanka lacag la’aanta ah ee Strait of Hormuz, isla markaana waxaan oggolaaday in si degdeg ah loo qaado xayiraadda badeed ee Mareykanka saaray dekedaha Iran.” Trump ayaa hadalkiisa ku daray: “Maraakiibta caalamka, mishiinnadiinna shita. Saliidda ha socoto!” Ra’iisul wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif ayaa isna sheegay in Washington iyo Tehran ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed oo dhigaya in si degdeg ah oo joogto ah loo joojiyo howl-gallada militari ee dhammaan jihooyinka, oo ay ku jirto Lubnaan. Sharif ayaa sheegay in heshiiska si rasmi ah loogu saxiixi doono Jimcaha dalka Switzerland. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya kadib ku dhowaad afar bilood oo dagaal ah, kaas oo sababay dhimashada kumannaan qof, inta badan Iran iyo Lubnaan, isla markaana gilgilay suuqyada tamarta caalamka. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale cadaadis weyn saaray dalalka Khaliijka ee martigeliya saldhigyada Mareykanka, kadib markii Iran ay weerarro ku qaadday Israel iyo qaar ka mid ah xarumaha Mareykanka ee gobolka. Marinka Hormuz oo dib loo furayo Qodobka ugu weyn ee heshiiska ayaa ah dib u furista Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin biyood istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah dhaqaalaha caalamka. Iran ayaa muddo bilo ah si wax ku ool ah u xirtay marinkan, taas oo hakad gelisay maraakiibta saliidda iyo gaaska qaada. Arrintaas ayaa sare u qaaday qiimaha tamarta, gaar ahaan shidaalka iyo saliidda cayriin, waxayna cabsi gelisay dalal badan oo ku tiirsan sahayda Khaliijka. Mareykanka ayaa dhankiisa xayiraad badeed saaray dekedaha Iran, taas oo sii kordhisay xiisadda labada dhinac. Sida ay ilo dhowr ah hore u sheegeen, qodobbada hordhaca ah ee heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in Iran ay dib u furto Marinka Hormuz, halka Mareykanku uu qaadayo xayiraadda badeed ee saaran dekedaha Iran. Marinkan ayaa isku xira Khaliijka Faaris, Gacanka Cumaan iyo Badda Carabta, waxaana mara qayb weyn oo ka mid ah saliidda iyo gaaska dunida. Wadahadallo nukliyeer oo xiga Inkasta oo heshiisku soo afjarayo dagaalka, haddana arrinta ugu adag ee barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran ayaa loo dhaafay wadahadallo kale oo socon doona 60 maalmood. Qodobbada la sheegay ayaa dhigaya in Iran aysan soo saari doonin ama heli doonin hub nukliyeer, isla markaana aysan ballaarin doonin xarumaheeda nukliyeerka inta wadahadalladu socdaan. Mareykanka ayaa doonaya in heshiiska kama dambaysta ah uu horseedo in Iran ay si weyn u xaddiddo barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka. Iran ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysaneysa in aysan doonayn hub nukliyeer, balse ay xaq u leedahay barnaamij nukliyeer oo nabadeed. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu Iran siinayo fursad dhaqaale, oo ay ku jiraan ka dhaafis cunaqabateyn saliid, hakinta cunaqabateymo cusub inta wadahadalladu socdaan, iyo sii deynta lacago badan oo Iran uga xayiran dibadda. Israel oo ka baxsan heshiiska Israel ayaa sheegtay inaysan qeyb ka ahayn heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana ay sii wadan doonto waxa ay ku tilmaanto xorriyadda howl-galladeeda militari ee Lubnaan. Heshiiska ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Israel ay duqeyn ku qaadday duleedka koonfureed ee Beirut, taas oo dhalisay caro ka timid Tehran iyo dhaliil uu jeediyay Trump. Trump ayaa sheegay in weerarkaas “uusan dhici lahayn,” maadaama Mareykanka uu ku dhowaa heshiis nabadeed oo uu la galo Iran. Haddii heshiisku hirgalo, wuxuu noqon karaa isbeddel weyn oo gobolka ka dhaca, isagoo yareyn kara xiisadda Khaliijka, dib u furi kara marin muhiim u ah saliidda caalamka, isla markaana bilaabi kara wadahadallo cusub oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. Qodobbada la sheegay ayaa dhigaya in Iran aysan soo saari doonin ama heli doonin hub nukliyeer, isla markaana aysan ballaarin doonin xarumaheeda nukliyeerka inta wadahadalladu socdaan. Mareykanka ayaa doonaya in heshiiska kama dambaysta ah uu horseedo in Iran ay si weyn u xaddiddo barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka. Iran ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysaneysa in aysan doonayn hub nukliyeer, balse ay xaq u leedahay barnaamij nukliyeer oo nabadeed. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu Iran siinayo fursad dhaqaale, oo ay ku jiraan ka dhaafis cunaqabateyn saliid, hakinta cunaqabateymo cusub inta wadahadalladu socdaan, iyo sii deynta lacago badan oo Iran uga xayiran dibadda. Israel oo ka baxsan heshiiska Israel ayaa sheegtay inaysan qeyb ka ahayn heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana ay sii wadan doonto waxa ay ku tilmaanto xorriyadda howl-galladeeda militari ee Lubnaan. Heshiiska ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Israel ay duqeyn ku qaadday duleedka koonfureed ee Beirut, taas oo dhalisay caro ka timid Tehran iyo dhaliil uu jeediyay Trump. Trump ayaa sheegay in weerarkaas “uusan dhici lahayn,” maadaama Mareykanka uu ku dhowaa heshiis nabadeed oo uu la galo Iran. Haddii heshiisku hirgalo, wuxuu noqon karaa isbeddel weyn oo gobolka ka dhaca, isagoo yareyn kara xiisadda Khaliijka, dib u furi kara marin muhiim u ah saliidda caalamka, isla markaana bilaabi kara wadahadallo cusub oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. items.title: Madaxda adduunka oo soo dhaweysay heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran
items.description: Hoggaamiyeyaasha caalamka qaarkood ayaa soo dhaweeyay ku dhawaaqista Mareykanka iyo Iran ee ku saabsan in ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey, António Guterres ayaa soo dhaweeyay heshiiska nabadeed ee labada dal ee lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Bariga Dhexe. Xoghaye Guterres ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaamay tallaabo keeneysa in wada hadal lagu xaliyo colaadda. Hoggaamiyeyaasha Midowga Yurub iyo Ingiriiska ayaa soo dhaweeyay heshiiska lagu dhameynayo ku dhawaad afar bilood oo dagaal iyo xiisado ay ka jireen Gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Raysal Wasaaraha Ingiriiska, Keir Starmer ayaa heshiiska ku sheegay tallaabo aad muhiim u ah oo hore loo qaaday, laguna soo afjarayo dagaalka. Raysal Wasaaraha Australia, Anthony Albanese oo heshiiska bogaadiyay ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo in heshiisku uu horseedo nabad waarta. Raysal Wasaaraha Japan, Sanae Takaichi ayaa ka mid noqotay hoggaamiyeyaashii ugu dambeeyay ee amaanay heshiiska. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda New Zealand, Winston Peters ayaa dhankiisa heshiiska ku qeexay mid wax ku ool ah iyo tallaabo loo qaaday dhismista xiisadaha iyo horumarinta xasilloonida gobolka, oo muhiim u ah buu yiri amniga dhaqaalaha adduunka. Hoggaamiyeyaasha dunida ayaa si isku mid ah u taageeray dadaalada socda ee dib loogu furayo marin biyoodka Hormuz, kaas oo wax ka taraya hubanti la’aanta sahayda tamarta adduunka iyo sicirka bararka baahsan ee ka jira suuqyada caalamiga ah. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in heshiiska lala galay Iran uu ogolanaayo in maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ay si lacag ah ku maraan Marinka Hormuz. Marinka Hormuz ayaa laf dhabar u ah dhaqaalaha adduunka, waana isha ugu weyn ee uu ka gudbo batroolka iyo gaaska Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: Warbaahinta dawladda Iran oo baahisay 14 qodob oo ay sheegtya in lagau heshiiyay
items.description: Warbaahinta dawladda Iran oo baahisay 14 qodob oo ay sheegtya in lagau heshiiyay Warbaahinta dowladda Iiraan ayaa baahinaysa waxa ay ku sheegtay faahfaahinta qabyo-qoraal heshiis 14 qodob ah oo u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Qodobadan si rasmi ah looma xaqiijin labada dhinac midkoodna. Mehr News Agency ayaa sheegtay in qodobada ay ka mid yihiin: Xabbad-joojin joogto ah oo ka hirgasha dhammaan jihooyinka, oo ay ku jirto Lubnaan Ballanqaad Maraykanka uu ku galay inuusan faragelin arrimaha gudaha ee Iiraan In 30 maalmood gudahood la qaado go’doominta badda ee Maraykanka In ciidamada Maraykanka laga saaro Iiraan In marinka Hormuz dib loo furo 30 maalmood gudahood “iyadoo lagu maamulayo habka Iiraan” Maraykanka iyo xulafadiisa oo soo bandhigaya qorshe dib-u-dhis Iiraan ah oo ugu yaraan gaaraya $300 bilyan In la joojiyo cunaqabateynta saliidda iyo tamarta Iiraan Iiraan oo mar kale xaqiijinaysa inayan soo saari doonin hub nukliyeer ah Maraykanka oo ballanqaadaya inuusan kordhin doonin ciidamadiisa gobolka isla markaana uusan soo rogi doonin cunaqabatayn cusub Mehr News Agency ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in:“Wada-hadallada kama dambaysta ah aysan bilaaban doonin ilaa qayb ka mid ah lacagaha Iiraan ee la xannibay la sii daayo, cunaqabataynta saliidda la hakiyo, isla markaana go’doominta badda la qaado.” Waxay intaas ku dartay in heshiiska ugu dambeeya lagu ansixin doono qaraar ka soo baxa Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada midoobey

items.title: Saciid Deni oo arrimo xasaasi ah ku eedeeyay Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maamul-goboleedka Puntland, Mudane Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo maanta furay kalfadhigga 58-aad ee Baarlamaanka maamulkaas ayaa weerar culus oo dhanka afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isaga oo u jeediyay eedeymo culus. Saciid Deni ayaa Madaxweynaha ku eedeeyay in xeebaha Puntland, gaar ahaan deegaannada Xaafuun, Eyl iyo Jariiban uu ku abuuray burcadbadeed hubeysan oo weerarro ku qaaday maraakiib iyo doonyo isticmaala xeebaha bari ee Soomaaliya iyo sidoo kale biyaha caalamiga ah, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu Xasan Sheekh oo ay si wayn isugu hayaan arrimaha siyaasadda uu ku eedeeyey inuu isku dayay inuu colaad ka huriyo deegaannada Puntland, gaar ahaan dadka reee Sool iyo maamulka Puntland. “Madaxweynihii hore ee DFS wuxuu ku dadaaley inuu colaad ka dhex abuuro dadka walaala ah ee Reer Sool iyo Puntland, laakiin dadka reer Sool oo aad u garasho badan way diideen ina colaadaasi dhacdo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Saciid Deni. Dhanka kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka, isaga oo sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu kala diray Soomaaliya, Isla markaana uu ku xadgudbay nidaamkii Federaalka ee heshiiska lagu lahaa, laguna duulay maamul goboleedyada dalka. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in Puntland ay si cad uga hortimid afduub siyaasadeed iyo mid sharci oo dalka loo geysto, ayna ka dagaalamayso, sida uu ku dooday, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni. “Puntland waxay ka hortimid afduub siyaasadeed iyo mid sharci oo uu Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka ku sameeyey hannaankii heshiiska lagu ahaa, wuxuuna duullaan toos ah ku hayaa hannaankii federaalka iyo maamullada ka jira dalka, wuxuu horay duullaan hubeysan ugu qaaday Raaskambooni oo uu ku dilay muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu sidooo kale khalkhal siyaasadeed iyo afgambi ka sameeyey magaalada Baydhaba, isagoo meesha ka saaray hannaankii maamul ee ka jirey Koonfur Galbeed, “ayuu yiri markale yiri Madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan dowladda Soomaaliya ay kordhisay dhaqdhaqaaqeeda gudaha Puntland, isla markaana ay ka wado qorista ciidamo federaal ah oo ka howlgala deegaannada maamulkaas, si ay saameyn ugu yeelato halkaasi. The post Saciid Deni oo arrimo xasaasi ah ku eedeeyay Xasan Sheekh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia famine risk: UN releases $10M in urgent aid to save millions
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United Nations has unlocked an urgent $10 million emergency allocation to stave off a burgeoning catastrophe in Somalia, where the delicate balance between survival and starvation is fracturing under the weight of a deepening humanitarian crisis. Tom Fletcher, the UN’s humanitarian chief, issued a stark warning this Sunday: the window to avert a full-scale famine is closing with chilling speed. As a protracted cycle of drought and conflict ravages the Horn of Africa, the international body is scrambling to reach the most vulnerable before the situation reaches a point of no return. The Human Toll The scale of the emergency is immense. Current data paints a harrowing picture: 6 million people —nearly one-third of the nation’s population—are grappling with acute food insecurity. Of these, 1.9 million are already teetering on the edge of survival, classified as living in emergency conditions. “The situation has deteriorated due to increased food insecurity, widespread malnutrition, and reduced access to basic services,” Mr. Fletcher stated, emphasizing the urgency of the intervention. The $10 million injection is designed as a lifeline, aiming to deliver essential nutrition, emergency healthcare, clean water, and food supplies to 640,000 individuals who have been hardest hit by the systemic collapse of local support structures. Geography of Despair While the crisis is national in scope, the UN has identified specific “red zones” where the risk of famine is no longer a distant threat, but a plausible reality. The Bay and Bakool regions within South West state, particularly the agropastoral communities, are currently the frontline of this battle for survival. The misery is further compounded by a massive displacement crisis. Since the dawn of 2026, more than 500,000 people have been forced from their homes, joining a vast population of internally displaced persons who have already exhausted their meager resources. A Perfect Storm Somalia’s current fragility is the result of a “perfect storm” of converging factors: Climate Collapse: Successive failed or significantly below-average rainy seasons have turned once-fertile lands into dust, decimating livestock and harvests. Persistent Conflict: Ongoing instability has crippled trade routes and hampered the ability of humanitarian agencies to reach those trapped in isolated enclaves. Economic Strain: Surging global commodity prices have rendered basic staples unaffordable for families already struggling with plummeting purchasing power. Public Health: Reduced access to clean water and sanitation has triggered localized disease outbreaks, which strike hardest at malnourished children and the elderly. As the international community watches, the focus shifts to whether this latest emergency funding can act as a sufficient firewall. For the 1.9 million people currently in emergency conditions, the next few weeks are not merely a calendar entry—they represent a desperate, daily struggle to outpace the threat of total collapse. items.title: The Rhetoric of “Civilizational Erasure”: Historical Distortion and Hyperbole in Contemporary Transatlantic Politics
items.description: By Buraale Xiniin Abstract This essay examines the growing intersection of right-wing populism, xenophobic rhetoric, and the manipulation of historical memory within the contemporary transatlantic alliance. Focusing on recent actions by European leaders, specifically the newly appointed Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Janša, and controversial rhetoric from high-ranking American officials like Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and President Donald Trump, this essay explores how the weaponization of history serves to justify exclusionary immigration and foreign policies. By juxtaposing the symbolic removal of the Palestinian flag in Ljubljana with Hegseth’s 2026 D-Day anniversary speech, which compared migrant arrivals to the Allied invasion of Nazi-occupied Europe, this study analyzes the structural distortion of international law and human rights framework. It argues that while comparisons to a “Fourth Reich” may be hyperbole, the systemic dehumanization of global-south refugees and the uncritical defense of military occupation represent a profound fracturing of the post-WWII international order. Introduction: The Re-Writing of European Sovereignty The foundational mythos of the post-World War II liberal international order rests on two pillars: the absolute rejection of fascism and a professed commitment to universal human rights, enshrined in international humanitarian law. However, the contemporary geopolitical landscape reveals a stark fracturing of these ideals. The rise of nationalist, right-wing populist leaders across the United States and Europe has increasingly shifted the parameters of mainstream political discourse, normalizing rhetoric that historically belonged to the fringes of the far-right. This ideological realignment is characterized by a dual phenomenon: an obsession with demographic shifts, frequently framed through the lens of a migrant “invasion,” and a simultaneous erosion of solidarity with colonized or occupied populations. The immediate decision by Slovenia’s newly re-elected Prime Minister, Janez Janša, to order the removal of the Palestinian flag from government headquarters stands as an acute manifestation of this shift. This act, coupled with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s unprecedented deployment of anti-immigrant rhetoric during the 82nd anniversary of D-Day in Normandy, illustrates a dangerous convergence. Rather than viewing the refugee crisis as a direct consequence of decades of Western-led military interventions and asymmetric global wealth distribution, these leaders frame dispossessed migrants as an existential, civilizational threat. This essay interrogates the psychological and structural framework driving these policies, analyzing how the historical memory of liberating Europe from Nazism is being inverted to justify a new era of ethno-nationalist exclusion and the systematic bypass of international law. A- Symbolic Violence and Foreign Policy Pivot:  “The Slovenian Case “ In June 2026, within hours of assuming his fourth term as Prime Minister of Slovenia, Janez Janša ordered the immediate removal of the Palestinian flag from the main government building in Ljubljana. The flag had been hoisted under his predecessor, Robert Golob, whose administration had officially recognized Palestinian statehood in 2024 and vocalized intense criticism of Israeli military actions in Gaza, labeling them violations of international law. Janša’s swift reversal was not merely an administrative shift; it was a potent act of symbolic violence. From an academic perspective, Janša’s policy can be understood through the framework of ideological alignment with the Trump administration’s transactional foreign policy. By framing the removal of the flag as part of a “responsible” foreign policy “based on facts,” the Slovenian executive sought to delegitimize the humanitarian and legal obligations codified under the Geneva Conventions regarding occupied territories. The immediate diplomatic response, Israel’s announcement to open an embassy in Ljubljana, underscores the transactional nature of this governance style. The psychological underpinnings of such actions rely on a reductionist logic: the belief that complex, systemic crises can be solved by erasing the visual symbols of the oppressed. This “ostrich policy” assumes that by removing a flag, a state can insulated itself from the moral and legal implications of ongoing global conflicts. This ideological pivot is shared by a broader network of European right-wing leaders who treat international solidarity not as a legal obligation under the United Nations framework, but as an optional ideological ornament that can be discarded to signal loyalty to Western hegemony. B- Historical Inversion at Normandy:  The Weaponization of D-Day Perhaps the most glaring and dangerous manifestation of this ideological drift occurred on June 6, 2026, at the Normandy American Cemetery in Colleville-sur-Mer. Speaking on the 82nd anniversary of the Allied landings, the very operation that initiated the dismantling of Nazi totalitarianism, U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth declared: “Sadly, today, different European beaches are stormed by different dangerous ideologies. Beaches in Spain, in Italy, in Greece, and Bulgaria, boats and men arrive. When will European capitals do something about that invasion, or is it too late?” This rhetorical maneuver represents a profound distortion of historical reality. The Normandy landings were a highly organized, heavily armed industrial military assault launched by sovereign nations to crush a genocidal fascist empire. To compare desperate, unarmed refugees fleeing conflict zones in rubber dinghies to the Allied forces of 1944 is a severe category error. The danger of this rhetoric lies in its pedagogical effect. By utilizing the sacred memory of D-Day, Hegseth explicitly reframed the victims of global instability as the perpetrators of a military invasion. This satisfies the criteria of what sociologist Stanley Cohen termed a “moral panic”, wherein a displaced group is cast as a folk devil threatening societal values. The relative silence or tepid pushback from mainstream Western media apparatuses regarding this speech indicates the degree to which dehumanizing frameworks have been normalized within transatlantic defense discourse. It suggests that the contemporary state apparatus is increasingly willing to abandon the very values of anti-fascism celebrated at Normandy in order to defend a fortified “Fortress Europe.” C- Causality and Decontextualization :  The Roots of Global Migration Central to the ideology of both the Trump administration and its European counterparts is a structural blindness to causality. The prevailing right-wing narrative treats mass migration as an unprovoked, spontaneous cultural assault on Western civilization, entirely disconnected from historical and contemporary Western foreign policy. In reality, the flows of refugees from the Middle East, North Africa, and South Asia are directly linked to decades of asymmetrical interventions, illegal wars, and economic destabilization orchestrated by the United States, NATO allies, and regional partners. The destruction of state infrastructures in Iraq, Libya, and Afghanistan, alongside the unchecked bombardment and displacement of populations in Gaza and Lebanon, has rendered vast swathes of the global South unlivable. The psychological coping mechanism of Western leadership requires a complete decoupling of action from consequence. To acknowledge that Western policy created the material conditions for the migration crisis would require an admission of systemic legal and moral accountability. Instead, these leaders engage in a collective amnesia, projecting the image of Western nations as innocent, pristine sanctuaries being arbitrarily invaded by populations who, prior to the destruction of their homes, had no inherent desire to leave their native lands. D- The Selective Application of International Law and the “Fourth Reich” Question. The starkest contradiction in contemporary international relations is the selective application, and blatant abandonment, of international humanitarian law. While Western powers frequently invoke the “rules-based international order” to sanction geopolitical adversaries, they offer near-total diplomatic, economic, and military immunity to allies like Israel, even amidst documented campaigns of ethnic cleansing, illegal settlement expansion, and the targeting of sovereign state infrastructures in Lebanon and Syria. T his systemic hypocrisy prompts the urgent question: “Are we witnessing the rise of a “Fourth Reich” in Europe?” While the historical specificity of Nazi Germany, characterized by total state-directed industrial genocide, totalitarian mobilization, and overt biological racism, differs from the fragmented, neoliberal populism of today, the structural parallels are deeply alarming. If a “Fourth Reich” is understood not as a literal carbon copy of the 1930s Nazi state, but as the emergence of a Western consensus that treats international law as a tool for the powerful and human rights as a selective privilege based on nationality and ethnicity, then the comparison gains analytical weight. When a superpower’s Defense Secretary can stand on the graves of anti-fascist soldiers to demand the militarized exclusion of refugees, and when European states willingly comply with policies that prioritize geopolitical alignment over the prevention of genocide, the moral framework that separated the post-war West from its fascist past faces a profound and dangerous collapse. Conclusion: The Crisis of Post-Colonial Compliance The tragedy of the current global crisis is compounded by the compliance of certain regional leaderships within the global south. Rather than forming independent, multipolar security and economic alliances, such as pursuing robust strategic agreements with rising global powers like China, or regional actors like Turkey and Pakistan, many leaders remain trapped within the paradigms of Western dependency. This compliance perpetuates a system of asymmetric sovereignty where global south nations are expected to endure bombardment, occupation, and economic deprivation, while simultaneously being barred from seeking safety or asserting diplomatic autonomy. Ultimately, the collective mental state and political philosophy of leaders like Trump, Hegseth, and Janša are not aberrations; they are the logical conclusion of a western-centric order that has refused to decolonize its conceptions of power and human value. The fixation on flags and borders is a desperate attempt to maintain hegemony through exclusion. If international law and human rights are to survive as meaningful concepts, they must be rescued from the selective custody of Western capitals and reasserted as universal truths that apply equally to the powerful and the dispossessed. items.title: Muungaab oo furay imtixaan laga qaadayo 46,000 oo arday + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa maanta daah-furay Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ah ee Dugsiyada Dhexe ee Gobolka Banaadir, kaas oo ay sanadkan u fariisteen in ka badan illaa 46,000 oo arday. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay maamulka gobolka ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in imtixaanka oo lagu galayo 125 xarumood oo ku kala yaalla degmooyinka gobolka Banaadir loo sameeyay diyaar-garow dhammaystiran oo lagu xaqiijinayo habsami-u-socodka imtixaanka, amniga xarumaha iyo ilaalinta tayada maamulka imtixaanaadka. Sidoo kale, imtixaanka sanadkan ayaa lagu daray adeegyo iyo duruufo u gaar ah dadka baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba, si’ loo xaqiijiyo helitaanka fursad loo siman yahay. Ugu horreyn munaasabadda daah-furka imtixaanka waxaa ka hadlay Agaasimaha Guud ee Agaasinka Waxbarashada Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Cali Maxamed oo sheegay in ay si weyn ugu diyaar garoobeen imtixaanka, isla markaana ay diyaariyeen wax kasta oo ay u baahan yihiin ardayda. “Xarun kasta oo imtixaan lagu galayo waxaa la geeyay kooxo caafimaad, gaadiidka gurmadka degdegga ah iyo ciidamada dab-damiska, si loogu diyaargaroobo xaalad kasta oo soo derista inta uu socdo imtixaanka.” ayuu yiri, agaasime Cabdiraxmaan Cali Maxamed. Intaas kadib Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho oo hadalka qaatay aya ardayda guul u rajeeyay, isaga oo ballan qaaday in maamulka gobolka uu sanadkan sii wadi doono dhiirrigelinta iyo abaalmarinta ardayda kaalmaha hore ka gala imtixaanka, sida uu soo-jireenka ka dhigay sanadkii hore. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Waxaa xusid mudan in sanadkan markii ugu horreysay ay imtixaanka ka qaybgalayaan arday muwaadiniin reer Suudaan ah oo waxbarasho ka dhigta magaalada Muqdisho, arrintaas oo muujinaysa kaalinta ay caasimaddu ka qaadanayso taageeridda waxbarashada iyo adeegyada bulshada ee walaalaha soo magansaday. Munaasabadda daah-furka imtixaanka waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Bulshada Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Cabdicasiis Cismaan Maxamed, Taliyaha Qaybta Guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, Gaashaanle Sare Mahdi Cumar Muumin (Macallin Mahdi) iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir. The post Muungaab oo furay imtixaan laga qaadayo 46,000 oo arday + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: FIFA to pay Somali referee Omar Artan despite U.S. entry ban
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somali referee Omar Artan will receive his full FIFA World Cup officiating fee despite being denied entry into the United States and missing football’s biggest tournament, according to sources familiar with the matter. The decision means Artan will receive the full fee attached to his FIFA World Cup appointment even though he was unable to officiate at the competition. Artan, widely regarded as one of Africa’s leading match officials, had been selected to officiate at the World Cup in what would have been a historic milestone for Somali football. His appointment was set to make him the first Somali referee to officiate at the sport’s most prestigious tournament. The opportunity ended abruptly when U.S. authorities denied him entry before the competition. The Trump administration said the decision was based on what it described as links to “suspected members of terror organizations.” Despite his absence from the tournament, FIFA has committed to paying Artan the full fee associated with his World Cup assignment. The episode attracted widespread attention across Somalia, where Artan’s rise from domestic football to the highest levels of international officiating has become a source of national pride. Named Africa’s Referee of the Year in 2025, Artan has built a reputation as one of the continent’s most respected officials. His selection for the World Cup was viewed as a landmark achievement not only for his career but also for Somali football, which has long sought greater representation on the global stage. News of his exclusion from the tournament sparked disappointment among many Somalis, who had hoped to see one of their own participate in football’s premier event. Yet the setback has done little to slow his ascent within the game. In a major boost to his international standing, UEFA has appointed Artan to officiate the UEFA Super Cup in August between Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa. The annual match, which pits the winners of Europe’s two major club competitions against each other, is among the continent’s most prestigious officiating assignments. The appointment is widely seen as a strong endorsement of Artan’s abilities and professionalism, reinforcing his status among football’s elite referees despite the controversy surrounding his World Cup absence. For many observers, the UEFA assignment marks a remarkable turnaround. A referee who was unable to take part in the World Cup will now oversee one of the biggest fixtures in European football just weeks later. Artan returned to Somalia to a warm welcome from supporters , sports officials and members of the public, many of whom hailed him as a trailblazer for a new generation of Somali athletes and officials seeking international recognition. His journey from Somali football to the global stage continues to resonate across the Horn of Africa, where his achievements are viewed as evidence that talent from Somalia can compete and excel at the highest levels of world sport. As preparations begin for the UEFA Super Cup, attention is once again focused on Omar Artan – not because of the opportunity he missed at the FIFA World Cup, but because of the historic role he is set to play in the next chapter of his career. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Iran iyo Mareykanka oo gaaray heshiis cusub
items.description: Dowladaha Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa gaaray heshiis qabyo, kaas oo lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, oo ay ku jirto xabad joojin laga sameeyo Lubnaan. Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif ayaa sheegay in labada dal ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed, oo lagu soo afjarayo buu yiri howlaha militari ee dhinac walba ah, oo ay qayb ka tahay Lubnaan. Heshiiska ayaa waxaa ku jira in la qaado cunaqabateynta caalamiga ah ee muddada dheer saaran Iran iyo dib-u-furista marin biyoodka Hormuz, oo ku xirmay duulaankii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi. Xirnaanshaha Marinka Hormuz ayaa cadaadis siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaalaba ku noqday Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump, iyadoo kor u kaca qiimaha batroolka ee gudaha Mareykanka uu gaaray meeshii ugu sarreysay, muddo dhowr sano ah. Sidoo kale dagaalkan ayaa sii wiiqay dhaqaalaha Iran, marka aad eegto xayiraadaha uu Mareykanka bishii May saaray Dekedaha Iran. Wasiir Kuxigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Kazem Gharibabadi ayaa sheegay in heshiisku uu socon doono muddo lixdan maalmood ah, iyada oo mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay in la qaado dhammaan cunaqabateynada ka dhanka ah dalkiisa. Wasiir Kuxigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Isniintan sheegay in dhexdhexaadiyeyaal ka socda Qatar ay Axaddii Magaalada Tehran ku yeesheen wada hadal qaatay 14-15 saacadood, si ay is afgarad uga gaaraan heshiis qabyo ah oo u dhaxeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran. “Wafdi ka socda Qatar ayaa shalay ku sugnaa Tehran, si ay u soo geba-gabeeyaan doodaha ku saabsan qoraalka Islamabad ee heshiiska is afgaradka ee Iran iyo Mareykanka.” Ayuu yiri Gharibabadi. Gharibabadi ayaa intaasi ku daray in Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran ay ugu dambayn aqbashay hindisaha heshiiskan, oo sida uu sheegay ay ka soo shaqeysay Dowladda Pakistan. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa ku dhawaaqay in labada dal ay gaareen heshiis looga gol leeyahay in lagu dhameeyo colaadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa tilmaamay in heshiiska la dhaqangeli doono Jimcaha, markaas oo sida uu sheegay ay dhinacyada saxiixi doonaan. Qoraalka heshiiska oo dhameystiran ayaan weli lala wadaagin Warbaahinta, waxaana la filayaa in saxiixa heshiiska uu ka dhici doono Switzerland. Heshiiskan ayaa u muuqdo kiisii ugu weynaa ee labada dhinac ay gaaraan, tan iyo markii uu dagaalka ballaaran ka qarxay Bariga Dhexe, muddo laga joogo in ka badan 100 maalmood.

Xirnaanshaha Marinka Hormuz ayaa cadaadis siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaalaba ku noqday Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump, iyadoo kor u kaca qiimaha batroolka ee gudaha Mareykanka uu gaaray meeshii ugu sarreysay, muddo dhowr sano ah. Sidoo kale dagaalkan ayaa sii wiiqay dhaqaalaha Iran, marka aad eegto xayiraadaha uu Mareykanka bishii May saaray Dekedaha Iran. Wasiir Kuxigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Kazem Gharibabadi ayaa sheegay in heshiisku uu socon doono muddo lixdan maalmood ah, iyada oo mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay in la qaado dhammaan cunaqabateynada ka dhanka ah dalkiisa. Wasiir Kuxigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Isniintan sheegay in dhexdhexaadiyeyaal ka socda Qatar ay Axaddii Magaalada Tehran ku yeesheen wada hadal qaatay 14-15 saacadood, si ay is afgarad uga gaaraan heshiis qabyo ah oo u dhaxeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran. “Wafdi ka socda Qatar ayaa shalay ku sugnaa Tehran, si ay u soo geba-gabeeyaan doodaha ku saabsan qoraalka Islamabad ee heshiiska is afgaradka ee Iran iyo Mareykanka.” Ayuu yiri Gharibabadi. Gharibabadi ayaa intaasi ku daray in Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran ay ugu dambayn aqbashay hindisaha heshiiskan, oo sida uu sheegay ay ka soo shaqeysay Dowladda Pakistan. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa ku dhawaaqay in labada dal ay gaareen heshiis looga gol leeyahay in lagu dhameeyo colaadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa tilmaamay in heshiiska la dhaqangeli doono Jimcaha, markaas oo sida uu sheegay ay dhinacyada saxiixi doonaan. Qoraalka heshiiska oo dhameystiran ayaan weli lala wadaagin Warbaahinta, waxaana la filayaa in saxiixa heshiiska uu ka dhici doono Switzerland. Heshiiskan ayaa u muuqdo kiisii ugu weynaa ee labada dhinac ay gaaraan, tan iyo markii uu dagaalka ballaaran ka qarxay Bariga Dhexe, muddo laga joogo in ka badan 100 maalmood.

items.title: Wax ka Ogaw Qodobada Ku Jira Is-afgaradka Mareykanka iyo Iiraan
items.description: Wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa soo xigatay sarkaal sare oo Iiraani ah, kaas oo sheegay in nuqulka ugu dambeeya ee heshiis is-afgarad ah oo ay ka wada xaajoonayaan Mareykanka iyo Iiraan uu ka kooban yahay qodobbo dhowr ah oo la xiriira arrimaha nukliyeerka, cunaqabataymaha iyo amniga marin-biyoodka gobolka. Sida xogta la baahiyay lagu sheegay, Iiraan ayaa oggolaaneysa inay si degdeg ah dib ugu furto marin-biyoodka Hormuz dhammaan maraakiibta ganacsiga, halka Mareykankuna uu bilaabi doono qaadista go’doominta dhinaca badda ee dekedaha Iiraan, iyadoo tallaabadaasi ay dhaqan geli doonto marka la saxiixo heshiiska is-afgaradka, isla markaana si buuxda loogu dhammeystiri doono muddo 30 maalmood gudahood ah. Qoraalka la sheegay ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in Iiraan ay aqbali doonto inaanay soo saarin ama haysan hub nukliyeer ah, ayadoo inta laga gaarayo heshiis kama dambeys ahna, Tehran ay ilaalin doonto xaaladda hadda jirta ee barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka, iyadoo ka fogaan doonta kobcinta uranium-ka iyo ballaarinta xarumaha nukliyeerka. Dhanka kale, Mareykanka ayaa la sheegay inuu oggolaanayo in mustaqbalka laga wada xaajoodo qaab lagu dhimayo kaydka uranium-ka aadka loo kobciyay ee Iiraan ku jira, taas oo qayb ka noqon doonta heshiis dhammaystiran oo dambe. Labada dhinac ayaa lagu wadaa inay muddo 60 maalmood gudahood ah ku dhammeystiraan wada-xaajoodyada la xiriira barnaamijka nukliyeerka iyo hawlaha kobcinta uranium-ka, iyadoo qodobadaasi lagu dari doono heshiiska kama dambaysta ah. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Mareykanku uu ka waantoobi doono saarista cunaqabatayn cusub inta ay wadaxaajoodyadu socdaan,haddii heshiis rasmi ah la gaarona, waxaa si tartiib tartiib ah loo qaadi doonaa dhammaan cunaqabataymaha ay Mareykanka iyo Qaramada Midoobay saareen Iiraan, iyadoo lagu salaynayo jadwal ay labada dhinac ku heshiiyaan. Qodobada kale ee la xusay waxaa ka mid ah in Mareykanku muddo cayiman ka qaadi doono Iiraan cunaqabataymaha dhinaca saliidda, taas oo u oggolaanaysa Tehran inay dhoofiso saliiddeeda isla markaana hesho dakhliga ka soo xarooda, ayadoo Sidoo kale, Mareykanka lagu wadaa inuu sii daayo hanti Iiraani ah oo la xayiray, taas oo lagu qiyaasay 25 bilyan oo doollar. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan warar rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay Washington ama Tehran oo si buuxda u xaqiijinaya qodobadan, hase yeeshee warbixinta Reuters ayaa muujinaysa in dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo xooggan ay socdaan si loo gaaro heshiis cusub oo dhex mara labada dal.
